```python
"""Live source probe: which candidate sources a plain httpx client can fetch, and what extractors need.

Run `uv run python scripts/probe_sources.py` (live) or `--reanalyze` (re-score the saved HTML offline).
Writes metadata only to evals/data/source_probe.json; raw HTML stays in evals/data/private/probe/.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import re
import statistics
import time
import tomllib
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Iterable
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit, urlunsplit

import httpx
import lxml.html
from lxml import etree
from selectolax.lexbor import LexborHTMLParser, LexborNode

from veritrade.errors import VtError
from veritrade.fetch import consent, detect
from veritrade.fetch.headers import accept_encoding, browser_headers, is_sec_host

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCES_TOML = ROOT / "backend/src/veritrade/data/sources.toml"
OUT_JSON = ROOT / "evals/data/source_probe.json"
RAW_DIR = ROOT / "evals/data/private/probe"

MIN_GAP_S = 1.0
SEC_MIN_GAP_S = 0.2  # 5 req/s, half of EDGAR's fair-access ceiling
MAX_REDIRECTS = 5
MAX_EDGAR_INDEXES = 25
MIN_P_WORDS = 6
USABLE_BODY_WORDS = 120
NEWS_TYPES = frozenset(
    {"NewsArticle", "Article", "ReportageNewsArticle", "AnalysisNewsArticle", "BlogPosting", "Report"}
)
FRAMEWORK_MARKERS = {
    "next_data": 'id="__NEXT_DATA__"',
    "next_flight": "self.__next_f",
    "nuxt": "__NUXT__",
    "initial_state": "__INITIAL_STATE__",
    "preloaded_state": "__PRELOADED_STATE__",
    "apollo_state": "__APOLLO_STATE__",
    "fusion": "Fusion.globalContent",
    "remix": "__remixContext",
    "sveltekit": "data-sveltekit",
}
NOISE_RE = re.compile(
    r"related|recirc|read-?more|more-?(?:on|from)|newsletter|sign-?up|subscribe|promo|advert|sponsor|"
    r"(?:^|[-_ ])ads?(?:$|[-_ ])|ticker|quote|chart|video|share|social|disclaimer|author|bio\b|embed|"
    r"caption|trending|taboola|outbrain|teaser|cta|paywall|premium|comment|feedback|toolbar",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
PAYWALL_RE = re.compile(r"paywall|subscriber|premium|metered|locked|regwall", re.IGNORECASE)
# Paragraph-start labels for press-release / filing boilerplate; only the label is recorded, never text.
PR_MARKERS = (
    ("forward-looking statements", "forward_looking"),
    ("forward looking statements", "forward_looking"),
    ("cautionary", "forward_looking"),
    ("safe harbor", "forward_looking"),
    ("about ", "about"),
    ("media contact", "contacts"),
    ("investor contact", "contacts"),
    ("investor relations", "contacts"),
    ("contacts", "contacts"),
    ("contact:", "contacts"),
    ("source:", "source_line"),
    ("source ", "source_line"),
    ("view original content", "view_original"),
    ("###", "end_marker"),
)
STABLE_TOKEN = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$")
HASHY_TOKEN = re.compile(r"(?:^|[-_])(?=[a-z0-9]*\d)[a-z0-9]{5,}$|__[A-Za-z0-9]{4,}$")
SELECTOR_ATTRS = ("data-testid", "data-component", "itemprop", "data-module", "data-test")


# --- polite fetching ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class Politeness:
    """Sequential requests per registrable domain with a minimum gap; SEC gets its own faster ceiling."""

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._locks: dict[str, asyncio.Lock] = {}
        self._last: dict[str, float] = {}

    @staticmethod
    def domain(url: str) -> str:
        host = (urlsplit(url).hostname or "").lower()
        return ".".join(host.split(".")[-3:] if host.endswith(".co.uk") else host.split(".")[-2:])

    async def wait(self, url: str) -> asyncio.Lock:
        key = self.domain(url)
        lock = self._locks.setdefault(key, asyncio.Lock())
        await lock.acquire()
        gap = SEC_MIN_GAP_S if is_sec_host(urlsplit(url).hostname or "") else MIN_GAP_S
        delay = self._last.get(key, 0.0) + gap - time.monotonic()
        if delay > 0:
            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
        return lock

    def done(self, url: str, lock: asyncio.Lock) -> None:
        self._last[self.domain(url)] = time.monotonic()
        lock.release()


@dataclass
class Fetched:
    url: str
    final_url: str
    status: int | None = None
    http_version: str | None = None
    content_type: str | None = None
    server: str | None = None
    redirects: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    bytes: int = 0
    fetch_ms: float = 0.0
    consent_ms: float | None = None
    outcome: str = "ok"
    error: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    body: bytes = field(default=b"", repr=False)
    headers: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict, repr=False)

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return self.body.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

    def meta(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        data = asdict(self)
        data.pop("body")
        data.pop("headers")
        return data


async def polite_get(client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, url: str) -> httpx.Response:
    lock = await polite.wait(url)
    try:
        return await client.get(url, headers=browser_headers(url), follow_redirects=False)
    finally:
        polite.done(url, lock)


async def fetch(client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, url: str, *, classify: bool = True) -> Fetched:
    """Manual redirect loop like the serving fetcher; a consent hop is answered once, then retried."""
    result = Fetched(url=url, final_url=url)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    current, consent_used = url, False
    try:
        for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
            response = await polite_get(client, polite, current)
            location = response.headers.get("location")
            if response.status_code in consent.REDIRECT_STATUSES and location:
                target = urljoin(current, location)
                result.redirects.append({"status": response.status_code, "to": target})
                if consent.is_consent_url(target) and not consent_used:
                    outcome = await consent.reject_all(client, target)
                    result.consent_ms = round(outcome.elapsed_ms, 1)
                    consent_used, current = True, url
                    continue
                current = target
                if consent.is_consent_url(target):
                    break
                continue
            break
        else:
            response = None
        result.final_url = current
        if response is not None:
            result.status = response.status_code
            result.http_version = response.http_version
            result.content_type = response.headers.get("content-type")
            result.server = response.headers.get("server")
            result.body = response.content
            result.headers = dict(response.headers)
            result.bytes = len(response.content)
        result.fetch_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 1)
        if classify:
            detect.classify(result.status or 0, result.headers, result.text, result.final_url)
    except VtError as exc:
        result.outcome = exc.code.value
        result.error = {"code": exc.code.value, "message": exc.message, "hint": exc.hint}
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        result.outcome = "transport_error"
        result.error = {"code": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc) or type(exc).__name__, "hint": None}
    result.fetch_ms = result.fetch_ms or round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 1)
    return result


# --- discovery ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def normalize(url: str) -> str:
    """https, no query or fragment: article URLs here are path-addressed and feeds append tracking params."""
    parts = urlsplit(url.strip())
    return urlunsplit(("https", parts.netloc.lower(), parts.path, "", ""))


def feed_links(body: bytes) -> list[str]:
    """Item links of an RSS or Atom document, namespace-agnostic and tolerant of broken XML."""
    parser = etree.XMLParser(recover=True, resolve_entities=False, no_network=True)
    root = etree.fromstring(body, parser)
    if root is None:
        return []
    links: list[str] = []
    for item in root.iter("{*}item", "{*}entry"):
        for link in item.iter("{*}link"):
            href = link.get("href") or (link.text or "").strip()
            if href:
                links.append(href)
                break
    return links


def section_links(html: str, base: str) -> list[str]:
    hrefs = re.findall(r"""(?:href=|<loc>)["']?([^"'<> ]+)""", html)
    return [urljoin(base, href) for href in hrefs]


def pick(urls: Iterable[str], cfg: dict[str, Any], limit: int) -> list[str]:
    pattern = re.compile(cfg["article_pattern"])
    exclude = re.compile(cfg["exclude_pattern"]) if cfg.get("exclude_pattern") else None
    chosen: list[str] = []
    for raw in urls:
        url = normalize(raw)
        if url in chosen or not pattern.match(url) or (exclude and exclude.search(url)):
            continue
        chosen.append(url)
        if len(chosen) == limit:
            break
    return chosen


def edgar_exhibit(index_html: str, index_url: str) -> str | None:
    """EX-99.1 document link from an EDGAR filing index table (inline-XBRL viewer links unwrapped)."""
    doc = lxml.html.fromstring(index_html)
    for row in doc.cssselect("table.tableFile tr"):
        cells = [cell.text_content().strip() for cell in row.cssselect("td")]
        if len(cells) >= 4 and cells[3].upper().startswith("EX-99.1"):
            links = row.cssselect("a[href]")
            if links:
                href = str(links[0].get("href")).replace("/ix?doc=", "")
                return urljoin(index_url, href)
    return None


async def discover(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, key: str, cfg: dict[str, Any], limit: int
) -> tuple[list[str], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    attempts: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    entries = [(url, "feed") for url in cfg.get("feeds", [])] + [(url, "section") for url in cfg.get("sections", [])]
    for url, kind in entries:
        got = await fetch(client, polite, url, classify=kind == "section")
        save_raw(key, f"discovery-{len(attempts) + 1}", got.body)
        links = feed_links(got.body) if kind == "feed" and got.outcome == "ok" else []
        if kind == "section" and got.outcome == "ok":
            links = section_links(got.text, got.final_url)
        record = got.meta() | {"kind": kind, "links_found": len(links)}
        attempts.append(record)
        if cfg.get("discovery") == "edgar-8k-ex99":
            exhibits = await resolve_edgar(client, polite, links, limit, record)
            if exhibits:
                return exhibits, attempts
            continue
        chosen = pick(links, cfg, limit)
        record["links_matching"] = len(chosen)
        if len(chosen) == limit:
            return chosen, attempts
    return [], attempts


async def resolve_edgar(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, index_urls: list[str], limit: int, record: dict[str, Any]
) -> list[str]:
    exhibits: list[str] = []
    checked = 0
    for index_url in index_urls[:MAX_EDGAR_INDEXES]:
        checked += 1
        got = await fetch(client, polite, normalize(index_url), classify=False)
        if got.status == 200 and (exhibit := edgar_exhibit(got.text, got.final_url)):
            exhibits.append(normalize(exhibit))
            if len(exhibits) == limit:
                break
    record["edgar_indexes_checked"] = checked
    record["links_matching"] = len(exhibits)
    return exhibits


def save_raw(key: str, name: str, body: bytes) -> None:
    folder = RAW_DIR / key
    folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (folder / f"{name}.html").write_bytes(body)


# --- page analysis (metadata only: selectors, counts, labels; never text) -------------------------------


def words_of(node: LexborNode) -> int:
    return len(node.text(deep=True, separator=" ").split())


def stable(token: str) -> bool:
    return bool(STABLE_TOKEN.match(token)) and not HASHY_TOKEN.search(token) and len(token) <= 40


def css_for(node: LexborNode, depth: int = 0) -> str:
    """Simple selector (tag, id, attribute, class, descendant) valid in both selectolax and lxml cssselect."""
    tag = node.tag or "div"
    attrs = node.attributes
    node_id = attrs.get("id") or ""
    if node_id and stable(node_id):
        return f"{tag}#{node_id}"
    for name in SELECTOR_ATTRS:
        value = attrs.get(name)
        if value and stable(value):
            return f'{tag}[{name}="{value}"]'
    classes = [cls for cls in (attrs.get("class") or "").split() if stable(cls)][:2]
    if classes:
        return tag + "".join(f".{cls}" for cls in classes)
    parent = node.parent
    if parent is not None and parent.tag not in (None, "html", "body") and depth < 3:
        return f"{css_for(parent, depth + 1)} {tag}"
    return tag


def jsonld_summary(html: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    types: set[str] = set()
    body_words = 0
    free: Any = None
    has_part: list[str] = []
    headline = date = author = False
    for node in detect.jsonld_nodes(html):
        raw_type = node.get("@type")
        node_types = {raw_type} if isinstance(raw_type, str) else set(raw_type or [])
        types |= {str(t) for t in node_types}
        if node_types & NEWS_TYPES:
            headline |= bool(node.get("headline"))
            date |= bool(node.get("datePublished"))
            author |= bool(node.get("author"))
            body = node.get("articleBody")
            if isinstance(body, str):
                body_words = max(body_words, len(body.split()))
        if "isAccessibleForFree" in node:
            free = node["isAccessibleForFree"]
        if node.get("cssSelector"):
            has_part.append(str(node["cssSelector"]))
    return {
        "types": sorted(types),
        "news_article": bool(types & NEWS_TYPES),
        "article_body_words": body_words,
        "is_accessible_for_free": free,
        "headline": headline,
        "date_published": date,
        "author": author,
        "has_part_selectors": sorted(set(has_part)),
    }


def framework_json(html: str, tree: LexborHTMLParser) -> dict[str, Any]:
    found: dict[str, Any] = {name: marker in html for name, marker in FRAMEWORK_MARKERS.items()}
    if found["next_data"] and (node := tree.css_first("script#__NEXT_DATA__")) is not None:
        found["next_data_bytes"] = len(node.text() or "")
    return found


def lxml_counts(doc: Any, selector: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
    nodes = doc.cssselect(selector)
    words = sum(len(node.text_content().split()) for node in nodes)
    return len(nodes), words


def body_candidates(tree: LexborHTMLParser, doc: Any) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], LexborNode | None]:
    """Ancestors of substantive <p>s ranked by the words they hold; best = tightest one with >= 85% of max."""
    agg: dict[int, list[Any]] = {}
    for p in tree.css("p"):
        words = words_of(p)
        if words < MIN_P_WORDS:
            continue
        node, depth = p.parent, 1
        while node is not None and node.tag not in (None, "html", "body") and depth <= 6:
            entry = agg.setdefault(node.mem_id, [node, 0, 0, depth])
            entry[1] += 1
            entry[2] += words
            entry[3] = min(entry[3], depth)
            node, depth = node.parent, depth + 1
    if not agg:
        return [], None
    ranked = sorted(agg.values(), key=lambda e: (-e[2], e[3]))
    top_words = ranked[0][2]
    best = min((e for e in ranked if e[2] >= 0.85 * top_words), key=lambda e: e[3])[0]
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for node, paragraphs, words, depth in ranked[:12]:
        selector = css_for(node)
        if selector in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(selector)
        sx_nodes = tree.css(f"{selector} p")
        lx_count, lx_words = lxml_counts(doc, f"{selector} p")
        out.append(
            {
                "selector": selector,
                "is_best": node.mem_id == best.mem_id,
                "p_direct_depth": depth,
                "substantive_p": paragraphs,
                "words": words,
                "matches": len(tree.css(selector)),
                "p_selectolax": len(sx_nodes),
                "p_words_selectolax": sum(words_of(n) for n in sx_nodes),
                "p_lxml": lx_count,
                "p_words_lxml": lx_words,
            }
        )
        if len(out) == 6:
            break
    return out, best


def noise_blocks(container: LexborNode) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    found: Counter[str] = Counter()
    words: Counter[str] = Counter()
    for node in container.css("*"):
        if node.tag in ("p", "a", "span", "b", "strong", "em", "i", "br", "sup", "sub"):
            continue
        attrs = node.attributes
        label = " ".join(str(attrs.get(name) or "") for name in ("class", "id", *SELECTOR_ATTRS))
        if label.strip() and NOISE_RE.search(label):
            selector = css_for(node)
            found[selector] += 1
            words[selector] += words_of(node)
    return [{"selector": sel, "count": n, "words": words[sel]} for sel, n in found.most_common(12)]


def boilerplate_markers(container: LexborNode) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    paragraphs = [p for p in container.css("p") if words_of(p) > 0]
    hits: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for index, p in enumerate(paragraphs):
        head = p.text(deep=True, separator=" ").strip().lower()[:40]
        for prefix, label in PR_MARKERS:
            if head.startswith(prefix):
                hits.append({"label": label, "paragraph_index": index, "of": len(paragraphs), "words": words_of(p)})
                break
    return hits


def profile_check(html: str, profile: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Apply a sources.toml profile with both parsers; counts must agree for a selector to be portable."""
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    sx = LexborHTMLParser(html)
    for selector in profile.get("drop", []):
        for node in sx.css(selector):
            node.decompose()
    sx_paras = [n for n in sx.css(profile["body"]) if words_of(n) > 0]
    doc = lxml.html.fromstring(html)
    for selector in profile.get("drop", []):
        for el in doc.cssselect(selector):
            el.drop_tree()
    lx_paras = [el for el in doc.cssselect(profile["body"]) if el.text_content().split()]
    lede_n = int(profile.get("lede_paragraphs", 2))
    result["paragraphs_selectolax"] = len(sx_paras)
    result["paragraphs_lxml"] = len(lx_paras)
    result["words_selectolax"] = sum(words_of(n) for n in sx_paras)
    result["words_lxml"] = sum(len(el.text_content().split()) for el in lx_paras)
    result["lede_words"] = sum(words_of(n) for n in sx_paras[:lede_n])
    stops = [m.lower() for m in profile.get("stop_markers", [])]
    if stops:
        cut = next(
            (i for i, n in enumerate(sx_paras) if i >= lede_n and _is_stop(n, stops)),
            None,
        )
        result["stop_at_paragraph"] = cut
        kept = sx_paras[:cut] if cut is not None else sx_paras
        result["words_after_stop"] = sum(words_of(n) for n in kept)
    if title := profile.get("title"):
        node = LexborHTMLParser(html).css_first(title)
        result["title_found"] = node is not None and bool(node.text(strip=True))
    if paywall := profile.get("paywall"):
        result["paywall_marker"] = LexborHTMLParser(html).css_first(paywall) is not None
    return result


def _is_stop(node: LexborNode, stops: list[str]) -> bool:
    text = node.text(deep=True, separator=" ").strip().lower()
    return any(text.startswith(stop) for stop in stops) and len(text.split()) <= 12


def analyze(html: str, profile: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    tree = LexborHTMLParser(html)
    doc = lxml.html.fromstring(html)
    candidates, best = body_candidates(tree, doc)
    h1 = tree.css("h1")
    analysis: dict[str, Any] = {
        "jsonld": jsonld_summary(html),
        "framework_json": framework_json(html, tree),
        "title": {
            "h1_count": len(h1),
            "h1_selector": css_for(h1[0]) if h1 else None,
            "og_title": tree.css_first('meta[property="og:title"]') is not None,
        },
        "body_candidates": candidates,
        "page_p_words": sum(words_of(p) for p in tree.css("p")),
        "paywall_classes": sorted(
            {
                css_for(node)
                for node in tree.css("[class]")
                if PAYWALL_RE.search(node.attributes.get("class") or "")
            }
        )[:8],
    }
    if best is not None:
        paragraphs = [p for p in best.css("p") if words_of(p) > 0]
        analysis["best"] = {
            "selector": css_for(best),
            "lede_words": [words_of(p) for p in paragraphs[:3]],
            "tables": len(best.css("table")),
            "noise": noise_blocks(best),
            "boilerplate_markers": boilerplate_markers(best),
        }
    if profile:
        analysis["profile_check"] = profile_check(html, profile)
    return analysis


# --- orchestration --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def summarize(articles: list[dict[str, Any]], discovery_ok: bool) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ok = [a for a in articles if a["fetch"]["outcome"] == "ok"]
    usable = [
        a
        for a in ok
        if max((c["words"] for c in a["analysis"].get("body_candidates", [])), default=0) >= USABLE_BODY_WORDS
        or a["analysis"]["jsonld"]["article_body_words"] >= USABLE_BODY_WORDS
    ]
    outcomes = Counter(a["fetch"]["outcome"] for a in articles)
    fetch_ms = [a["fetch"]["fetch_ms"] for a in ok]
    usable_flag = discovery_ok and len(usable) >= 2
    return {
        "attempted": len(articles),
        "ok": len(ok),
        "usable_body": len(usable),
        "outcomes": dict(outcomes),
        "fetch_ms_median": round(statistics.median(fetch_ms), 1) if fetch_ms else None,
        "bytes_median": int(statistics.median(a["fetch"]["bytes"] for a in ok)) if ok else None,
        "jsonld_news_article": sum(a["analysis"]["jsonld"]["news_article"] for a in ok),
        "jsonld_article_body": sum(a["analysis"]["jsonld"]["article_body_words"] > 0 for a in ok),
        "consent_handled": sum(a["fetch"]["consent_ms"] is not None for a in articles),
        "verdict": "usable" if usable_flag else "not_usable",
    }


async def probe_source(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, key: str, cfg: dict[str, Any], limit: int
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    urls, attempts = await discover(client, polite, key, cfg, limit)
    articles: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for n, url in enumerate(urls, start=1):
        got = await fetch(client, polite, url)
        save_raw(key, str(n), got.body)
        analysis = analyze(got.text, cfg.get("profile")) if got.outcome == "ok" and got.body else {"jsonld": {}}
        analysis["jsonld"].setdefault("news_article", False)
        analysis["jsonld"].setdefault("article_body_words", 0)
        articles.append({"n": n, "fetch": got.meta(), "analysis": analysis})
        print(f"  {key}#{n} {got.status} {got.outcome} {got.fetch_ms:.0f}ms {got.bytes}B {url}", flush=True)
    print(f"{key}: discovered {len(urls)} via {[a['url'] for a in attempts]}", flush=True)
    return {
        "name": cfg["name"],
        "kind": cfg["kind"],
        "discovery": attempts,
        "articles": articles,
        "summary": summarize(articles, bool(urls)),
    }


def reanalyze(previous: dict[str, Any], sources: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Recompute page analysis from saved HTML so profiles can be tuned without re-hitting publishers."""
    for key, entry in previous["sources"].items():
        cfg = sources.get(key, {})
        for article in entry["articles"]:
            path = RAW_DIR / key / f"{article['n']}.html"
            if article["fetch"]["outcome"] == "ok" and path.exists():
                article["analysis"] = analyze(path.read_text(errors="replace"), cfg.get("profile"))
        entry["summary"] = summarize(entry["articles"], bool(entry["articles"]))
    previous["reanalyzed_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    return previous


async def run_live(sources: dict[str, Any], keys: list[str], limit: int, vantage: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    polite = Politeness()
    timeout = httpx.Timeout(15.0, connect=5.0)
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(http2=True, timeout=timeout) as client:
        results = await asyncio.gather(*(probe_source(client, polite, k, sources[k], limit) for k in keys))
    return {
        "generated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        "vantage": vantage,
        "client": {
            "library": f"httpx {httpx.__version__}",
            "http2": True,
            "headers": sorted(browser_headers("https://example.com/")),
            "user_agent": browser_headers("https://example.com/")["User-Agent"],
            "accept_encoding": accept_encoding(),
            "redirects": "manual, max 5; consent hop answered with reject-all once",
        },
        "politeness": {"min_gap_s": MIN_GAP_S, "sec_min_gap_s": SEC_MIN_GAP_S, "per": "registrable domain"},
        "sources": dict(zip(keys, results, strict=True)),
    }


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--only", help="comma-separated source keys")
    parser.add_argument("--articles", type=int, default=3)
    parser.add_argument("--vantage", default="local", help="where the probe ran, e.g. 'EU (BG) residential'")
    parser.add_argument("--reanalyze", action="store_true", help="re-score saved HTML, no network")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    sources: dict[str, Any] = tomllib.loads(SOURCES_TOML.read_text())["sources"]
    if args.reanalyze:
        report = reanalyze(json.loads(OUT_JSON.read_text()), sources)
    else:
        keys = args.only.split(",") if args.only else list(sources)
        report = asyncio.run(run_live(sources, keys, args.articles, args.vantage))
        if args.only and OUT_JSON.exists():
            merged = json.loads(OUT_JSON.read_text())
            merged["sources"].update(report["sources"])
            report = merged | {k: v for k, v in report.items() if k != "sources"}
    OUT_JSON.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    OUT_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    for key, entry in report["sources"].items():
        s = entry["summary"]
        print(f"{key:14} {s['verdict']:11} ok={s['ok']}/{s['attempted']} body={s['usable_body']} {s['outcomes']}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
async def polite_get(client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, url: str) -> httpx.Response:
    lock = await polite.wait(url)
    try:
        return await client.get(url, headers=browser_headers(url), follow_redirects=False)
    finally:
        polite.done(url, lock)


async def fetch(client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, url: str, *, classify: bool = True) -> Fetched:
    """Manual redirect loop like the serving fetcher; a consent hop is answered once, then retried."""
    result = Fetched(url=url, final_url=url)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    current, consent_used = url, False
    try:
        for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
            response = await polite_get(client, polite, current)
            location = response.headers.get("location")
            if response.status_code in consent.REDIRECT_STATUSES and location:
                target = urljoin(current, location)
                result.redirects.append({"status": response.status_code, "to": target})
                if consent.is_consent_url(target) and not consent_used:
                    outcome = await consent.reject_all(client, target)
                    result.consent_ms = round(outcome.elapsed_ms, 1)
                    consent_used, current = True, url
                    continue
                current = target
                if consent.is_consent_url(target):
                    break
                continue
            break
        else:
            raise httpx.TooManyRedirects(f"more than {MAX_REDIRECTS} redirects")
        result.final_url = current
        result.status = response.status_code
        result.http_version = response.http_version
        result.content_type = response.headers.get("content-type")
        result.server = response.headers.get("server")
        result.body = response.content
        result.headers = dict(response.headers)
        result.size_bytes = len(response.content)
        result.fetch_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 1)
        if classify:
            detect.classify(result.status or 0, result.headers, result.text, result.final_url)
    except VtError as exc:
        result.outcome = exc.code.value
        result.error = {"code": exc.code.value, "message": exc.message, "hint": exc.hint}
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        result.outcome = "transport_error"
        result.error = {"code": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc) or type(exc).__name__, "hint": None}
    result.fetch_ms = result.fetch_ms or round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 1)
    return result
```

```bash
async def polite_get(client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, url: str) -> tuple[httpx.Response, float]:
    """One request after the per-domain gap; the returned ms excludes the politeness wait."""
    lock = await polite.wait(url)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        response = await client.get(url, headers=browser_headers(url), follow_redirects=False)
        return response, (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000
    finally:
        polite.done(url, lock)


async def fetch(client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, url: str, *, classify: bool = True) -> Fetched:
    """Manual redirect loop like the serving fetcher; a consent hop is answered once, then retried."""
    result = Fetched(url=url, final_url=url)
    network_ms = 0.0
    current, consent_used = url, False
    try:
        for _ in range(MAX_REDIRECTS + 1):
            response, hop_ms = await polite_get(client, polite, current)
            network_ms += hop_ms
            location = response.headers.get("location")
            if response.status_code in consent.REDIRECT_STATUSES and location:
                target = urljoin(current, location)
                result.redirects.append({"status": response.status_code, "to": target})
                if consent.is_consent_url(target) and not consent_used:
                    outcome = await consent.reject_all(client, target)
                    result.consent_ms = round(outcome.elapsed_ms, 1)
                    consent_used, current = True, url
                    continue
                current = target
                if consent.is_consent_url(target):
                    break
                continue
            break
        else:
            raise httpx.TooManyRedirects(f"more than {MAX_REDIRECTS} redirects")
        result.final_url = current
        result.status = response.status_code
        result.http_version = response.http_version
        result.content_type = response.headers.get("content-type")
        result.server = response.headers.get("server")
        result.body = response.content
        result.headers = dict(response.headers)
        result.size_bytes = len(response.content)
        if classify:
            started = time.perf_counter()
            try:
                detect.classify(result.status, result.headers, result.text, result.final_url)
            finally:
                result.detect_ms = round((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, 2)
    except VtError as exc:
        result.outcome = exc.code.value
        result.error = {"code": exc.code.value, "message": exc.message, "hint": exc.hint}
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        result.outcome = "transport_error"
        result.error = {"code": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc) or type(exc).__name__, "hint": None}
    result.fetch_ms = round(network_ms, 1)
    return result
```

```
async def probe_source(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, polite: Politeness, key: str, cfg: dict[str, Any], limit: int
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    urls, attempts = await discover(client, polite, key, cfg, limit)
    print(f"{key}: discovered {len(urls)} via {[a['url'] for a in attempts]}", flush=True)
    articles = await probe_articles(client, polite, key, cfg, urls)
    return {
        "name": cfg["name"],
        "kind": cfg["kind"],
        "discovery": attempts,
        "discovered_by": "own" if urls else "failed",
        "articles": articles,
        "summary": summarize(articles),
    }


def reanalyze(previous: dict[str, Any], sources: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Recompute page analysis from saved HTML so profiles can be tuned without re-hitting publishers."""
    for key, entry in previous["sources"].items():
        cfg = sources.get(key, {})
        for article in entry["articles"]:
            path = RAW_DIR / key / f"{article['n']}.html"
            if article["fetch"]["outcome"] == "ok" and path.exists():
                article["analysis"] = analyze(path.read_text(errors="replace"), cfg.get("profile"))
        entry["summary"] = summarize(entry["articles"], bool(entry["articles"]))
    previous["reanalyzed_at"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    return previous
```

```python
"""Scratch: compact per-article view of source_probe.json for profile authoring."""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

data = json.loads(Path("evals/data/source_probe.json").read_text())
keys = sys.argv[1].split(",") if len(sys.argv) > 1 else list(data["sources"])
for key in keys:
    entry = data["sources"][key]
    print(f"\n######## {key} {entry['summary']}")
    for art in entry["articles"]:
        f, a = art["fetch"], art["analysis"]
        print(f"--- #{art['n']} {f['status']} {f['outcome']} {f['fetch_ms']}ms detect={f.get('detect_ms')} {f['url'][-70:]}")
        if f["outcome"] != "ok":
            print("   ", f["error"])
            continue
        j = a["jsonld"]
        print(f"   jsonld types={j['types'][:8]} body_words={j['article_body_words']} free={j['is_accessible_for_free']} parts={j['has_part_selectors']}")
        fw = {k: v for k, v in a["framework_json"].items() if v}
        print(f"   framework={fw} title={a['title']} page_p_words={a['page_p_words']} paywall_cls={a['paywall_classes']}")
        for c in a["body_candidates"][:5]:
            print(f"   cand {'*' if c['is_best'] else ' '} {c['selector'][:70]:70} w={c['words']} sp={c['substantive_p']} m={c['matches']} sx={c['p_selectolax']}/{c['p_words_selectolax']} lx={c['p_lxml']}/{c['p_words_lxml']}")
        best = a.get("best", {})
        print(f"   best={best.get('selector')} lede={best.get('lede_words')} tables={best.get('tables')}")
        for n in best.get("noise", [])[:8]:
            print(f"     noise {n}")
        if best.get("boilerplate_markers"):
            print(f"     markers {best['boilerplate_markers']}")
        if "profile_check" in a:
            print(f"   PROFILE {a['profile_check']}")

```

```python
"""Scratch: outline the element tree under a selector (tag/attrs/word counts + short text heads) for profiling."""

import sys

from selectolax.lexbor import LexborHTMLParser, LexborNode

path, selector = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
max_depth = int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 else 3
head_words = int(sys.argv[4]) if len(sys.argv) > 4 else 6
tree = LexborHTMLParser(open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read())


def label(node: LexborNode) -> str:
    a = node.attributes
    parts = [node.tag or "?"]
    if a.get("id"):
        parts.append("#" + str(a["id"]))
    if a.get("class"):
        parts.append("." + ".".join(str(a["class"]).split()[:4]))
    for k in ("data-testid", "data-component", "data-test", "itemprop", "role", "aria-hidden", "hidden"):
        if k in a:
            parts.append(f"[{k}={a.get(k)}]")
    return "".join(parts)


def walk(node: LexborNode, depth: int) -> None:
    for child in node.iter(include_text=False):
        if child.tag in ("script", "style", "svg", "noscript", "path"):
            continue
        text = child.text(deep=True, separator=" ").split()
        if not text and child.tag not in ("img", "iframe", "figure"):
            continue
        head = " ".join(text[:head_words])
        print(f"{'  ' * depth}{label(child)} w={len(text)} p={len(child.css('p'))} | {head}")
        if depth < max_depth:
            walk(child, depth + 1)


for root in tree.css(selector)[:2]:
    print(f"== {label(root)} w={len(root.text(deep=True, separator=' ').split())}")
    walk(root, 1)

```

```python
def classify(status: int, headers: Mapping[str, str], html: str, final_url: str) -> None:
    """Raise SourceBlocked, ConsentRequired or Paywalled for the page, or return when it looks readable."""
    host = (urlsplit(final_url).hostname or "").lower()
    lowered = {key.lower(): value for key, value in headers.items()}
    window = html[:SCAN_WINDOW].lower()

    if host in CONSENT_HOSTS or any(marker in window for marker in _CONSENT_MARKERS):
        raise ConsentRequired(
            f"{host or final_url} answered with a cookie-consent wall",
            hint=_hint(ConsentRequired, host),
            upstream_status=status,
        )

    vendor = _challenge_vendor(lowered, window)
    if status in BLOCK_STATUSES or vendor:
        by = f" with a {vendor} challenge" if vendor else ""
        raise SourceBlocked(
            f"{host or final_url} refused the request (HTTP {status}){by}",
            hint=_hint(SourceBlocked, host),
            retryable=status == 429,
            upstream_status=status,
        )

    if "isaccessibleforfree" in window or "isAccessibleForFree" in html:
        free, body_words = jsonld_access(html)
        if free is False and max(body_words, paragraph_words(html)) < PAYWALL_MIN_WORDS:
            raise Paywalled(
                f"{host or final_url} marks the article as not free and serves only a teaser",
                hint=_hint(Paywalled, host),
                upstream_status=status,
            )


def _challenge_vendor(headers: Mapping[str, str], window: str) -> str | None:
    if headers.get("cf-mitigated", "").lower() == "challenge":
        return "Cloudflare"
    if "x-dd-b" in headers:
        return "DataDome"
    if "<title>access denied</title>" in window and "reference #" in window:
        return "Akamai"
    for vendor, needle in _BODY_MARKERS:
        if needle in window:
            return vendor
    return None


def _hint(kind: type[VtError], host: str) -> str:
    default, by_host = _HINTS[kind]
    for suffix, hint in by_host.items():
        if host == suffix or host.endswith("." + suffix):
            return hint
    return default


def jsonld_blocks(html: str) -> Iterator[Any]:
    """Yield every parseable JSON-LD payload; str.find keeps this linear and regex-free on large pages."""
    lower = html.lower()
    pos = 0
    while (start := lower.find("application/ld+json", pos)) != -1:
        open_end = lower.find(">", start)
        close = lower.find("</script", open_end)
        if open_end == -1 or close == -1:
            return
        pos = close
        try:
            yield json.loads(html[open_end + 1 : close])
        except ValueError:
            continue


def _walk(node: Any) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        yield node
        for value in node.values():
            yield from _walk(value)
    elif isinstance(node, list):
        for item in node:
            yield from _walk(item)


def jsonld_nodes(html: str) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Every JSON object nested anywhere in the page's JSON-LD (covers @graph and arrays)."""
    for block in jsonld_blocks(html):
        yield from _walk(block)


def jsonld_access(html: str) -> tuple[bool | None, int]:
    """isAccessibleForFree across JSON-LD (False wins) and the longest articleBody word count."""
    free: bool | None = None
    words = 0
    for node in jsonld_nodes(html):
        value = node.get("isAccessibleForFree")
        if value is not None:
            parsed = value if isinstance(value, bool) else str(value).strip().lower() == "true"
            free = parsed if free is None else free and parsed
        body = node.get("articleBody")
        if isinstance(body, str):
            words = max(words, len(body.split()))
    return free, words


_P_RE = re.compile(r"<p[\s>].*?</p>", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
_TAG_RE = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")


def paragraph_words(html: str) -> int:
    """Rough visible word count of <p> elements; only used on the rare not-free path."""
    return sum(len(_TAG_RE.sub(" ", match).split()) for match in _P_RE.findall(html))
```

```python
"""Scratch: classify() timing and outcome over every saved probe page (median of 5 runs)."""

import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path

from veritrade.errors import VtError
from veritrade.fetch.detect import classify

for path in sorted(Path("evals/data/private/probe").glob("*/[0-9].html")):
    html = path.read_text(errors="replace")
    runs = []
    outcome = "ok"
    for _ in range(5):
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        try:
            classify(200, {}, html, f"https://{path.parent.name}.example/")
        except VtError as exc:
            outcome = exc.code.value
        runs.append((time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000)
    print(f"{path.parent.name:14} {path.name:7} {len(html):>9} chars {statistics.median(runs):6.2f} ms {outcome}")
```

```diff
+def _edge_vendor(headers: Mapping[str, str]) -> str | None:
+    """Which CDN answered, so a bare 403 still says who refused it."""
+    server = headers.get("server", "").lower()
+    if "cf-ray" in headers or server == "cloudflare":
+        return "Cloudflare"
+    if "akamai" in server:
+        return "Akamai"
+    if "x-datadome" in headers:
+        return "DataDome"
+    return None
```

```
"""Pure, network-free classification of a fetched page into blocked, consent-walled or paywalled."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from veritrade.errors import ConsentRequired, Paywalled, SourceBlocked, VtError

BLOCK_STATUSES = frozenset({401, 403, 429, 451})
# Interstitials are a few KB with markers near the top; a bounded window keeps 6 MB pages cheap.
SCAN_WINDOW = 65_536
PAYWALL_MIN_WORDS = 200
CONSENT_HOSTS = frozenset({"consent.yahoo.com", "guce.yahoo.com"})

# (vendor, lowercase needle) pairs; each needle only occurs on the vendor's interstitial, not on
# normal pages it protects (e.g. Cloudflare's passive /challenge-platform/scripts/ beacon is excluded).
_BODY_MARKERS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("Cloudflare", "<title>just a moment...</title>"),
    ("Cloudflare", "_cf_chl_opt"),
    ("Cloudflare", "/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/h/"),
    ("Cloudflare", "attention required! | cloudflare"),
    ("DataDome", "captcha-delivery.com"),
    ("PerimeterX", "px-captcha"),
    ("PerimeterX", "press &amp; hold"),
    ("PerimeterX", "press & hold"),
    ("Akamai", "sec-if-cpt-container"),
    ("Akamai", "errors.edgesuite.net"),
    ("Imperva", "_incapsula_resource"),
)
_CONSENT_MARKERS = ('class="consent-form"', "consent.yahoo.com/v2/collectconsent")

_PAID_ELSEWHERE = "try Yahoo Finance, CNBC or the company's own press release."
# Host suffix -> hint, matched on the final URL so a syndicated copy is suggested where one usually exists.
_HINTS: dict[type[VtError], tuple[str, dict[str, str]]] = {
    SourceBlocked: (
        "The publisher refused an automated request; try the same story from another source.",
        {
            "reuters.com": "Reuters blocks automated clients; its wire stories are usually syndicated on "
            "Yahoo Finance.",
            "apnews.com": "AP News serves a bot challenge to automated clients; AP stories are syndicated on "
            "Yahoo Finance and many local outlets.",
            "businesswire.com": "Business Wire serves a bot challenge; the same release is usually on Yahoo "
            "Finance or the issuer's investor-relations site.",
            "benzinga.com": "Benzinga blocks automated clients; its stories are syndicated on Yahoo Finance.",
            "investing.com": "Investing.com blocks automated clients; the underlying wire or company news is "
            "usually on Yahoo Finance or CNBC.",
            "bloomberg.com": f"Bloomberg blocks automated clients; {_PAID_ELSEWHERE}",
        },
    ),
    ConsentRequired: (
        "The publisher demands a cookie-consent choice first; try another source for the story.",
        {
            "yahoo.com": "Yahoo's EU consent page could not be completed automatically; open the article in "
            "a browser or run the service from a non-EU network.",
        },
    ),
    Paywalled: (
        "The article is behind a paywall; pick a free source such as Yahoo Finance or a press-release wire.",
        {
            "wsj.com": f"WSJ is paywalled; {_PAID_ELSEWHERE}",
            "barrons.com": f"Barron's is paywalled; {_PAID_ELSEWHERE}",
            "ft.com": f"The FT is paywalled; {_PAID_ELSEWHERE}",
            "bloomberg.com": f"Bloomberg is paywalled; {_PAID_ELSEWHERE}",
        },
    ),
}
```

```toml
# Source registry shared by the fetcher, extractors, probe, Opus discovery and live smoke.
# Decided by scripts/probe_sources.py (evidence: evals/data/source_probe.json, .context/docs/design/02-source-probe.md).
#
# status            primary (served + evaluated, `rank` = preference order) | backup | rejected (`reason`)
# feeds             RSS/Atom URLs, tried in order; items with a non-English <dc:language> are skipped
# sections          HTML pages or sitemaps scanned for links when there is no usable feed
# article_pattern   regex on the normalized URL (https, no query or fragment) that marks an article
# exclude_pattern   regex that drops live blogs, video and galleries
# discovery         "edgar-8k-ex99": feed entries are filing indexes resolved to their EX-99.1 exhibit
#
# [sources.<key>.profile] (selectors are tag/class/id/attribute + descendant only, so selectolax and lxml
# cssselect agree; the probe checks both on every captured page)
# body              selector of the body paragraphs, in document order
# drop              selectors removed before `body` is applied (captions, widgets, promos, tables)
# title             selector of the headline element
# lede_paragraphs   paragraphs that form the lede (default 2); stop markers never cut inside the lede
# min_words         paragraphs shorter than this are ignored (default 1)
# stop_markers      case-insensitive paragraph prefixes; the body ends at the first match after the lede
#                   (press-release About / forward-looking / contacts, partner promo pitches)
# paywall           selector of the region the publisher marks as gated (JSON-LD hasPart); missing or
#                   empty means the server sent a teaser
# notes             what the probe saw that a selector cannot express

# --- primary: the final 10, in plan order with backups swapped in for rejected sources ---------------

[sources.yahoo]
name = "Yahoo Finance"
domains = ["finance.yahoo.com"]
kind = "news"
status = "primary"
rank = 1
sections = ["https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/stock-market-news/", "https://finance.yahoo.com/news/"]
article_pattern = '^https://finance\.yahoo\.com/(?:[a-z-]+/)*(?:news|articles)/[a-z0-9-]+\.html$'

[sources.yahoo.profile]
body = 'div[data-testid="article-body"] p'
drop = ['div[data-testid="inarticle-ad"]', 'div[data-testid="ad-container"]', "figure", "div.readmore"]
title = "h1.cover-title"
lede_paragraphs = 2
stop_markers = ["Before you buy stock in", "Should you invest $1,000 in", "Should you buy stock in"]
notes = """Most stock-market stories are partner copy (Motley Fool, Insider Monkey, 24/7 Wall St); the page \
JSON names the partner in providerId and partner promos survive inside the body. The second half of the \
text sits in div[data-testid=read-more] behind a 'Story continues' button and must be kept. No RSS any \
more (/news/rssindex is 404) and no JSON-LD articleBody. No consent redirect from the BG test IP in \
Oct 2026; the reject-all flow still works when Yahoo does redirect."""

[sources.cnbc]

[sources.cnbc.profile]

drop = ["div.InlineImage-imageEmbed", "div.InlineVideo-wrapper", "div.RelatedContent-relatedContent"]

CNBC PRO stories share the URL shape but are truncated and flagged isAccessibleForFree=false. No JSON-LD \
articleBody; the speakable cssSelector is '.group p'."""

[sources.fool]

[sources.prnewswire]

[sources.globenewswire]

[sources.sec]

domains = ["www.sec.gov", "sec.gov"]

]

no <p>, where this profile finds nothing and the cascade must fall back to density. EX-99.1 is also \
used for financial statements and decks; discovery prefers index descriptions that say press release, \
earnings or results. Requests carry the declared SEC_USER_AGENT and stay under 10 req/s."""
```

```python
"""Scratch: per-source profile check results from source_probe.json."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

data = json.loads(Path("evals/data/source_probe.json").read_text())
for key, entry in data["sources"].items():
    s = entry["summary"]
    if "profile_ok" not in s:
        continue
    print(f"\n{key}: profile_ok={s['profile_ok']}/{s['ok']}")
    for art in entry["articles"]:
        c = art["analysis"].get("profile_check")
        if c:
            print(
                f"  #{art['n']} p={c['paragraphs_selectolax']}/{c['paragraphs_lxml']} "
                f"w={c['words_selectolax']}/{c['words_lxml']} lede={c['lede_words']} order={c['same_order']} "
                f"stop={c['stopped_at']} kept={c['boilerplate_kept']} title={c.get('title_found')} "
                f"paywall={c.get('paywall_region_words', '-')} jsonld_body={art['analysis']['jsonld']['article_body_words']}"
            )

```

```python
"""Scratch: first paragraph where selectolax and lxml profile outputs disagree (prints short heads only)."""

import sys
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

import lxml.html
from selectolax.lexbor import LexborHTMLParser

key, n = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
profile = tomllib.loads(Path("backend/src/veritrade/data/sources.toml").read_text())["sources"][key]["profile"]
html = Path(f"evals/data/private/probe/{key}/{n}.html").read_text(errors="replace")
sx = LexborHTMLParser(html)
for sel in profile.get("drop", []):
    for node in sx.css(sel):
        node.decompose()
sx_t = [" ".join(x.text(deep=True, separator=" ").split()) for x in sx.css(profile["body"])]
doc = lxml.html.fromstring(html)
for sel in profile.get("drop", []):
    for el in doc.cssselect(sel):
        el.drop_tree()
lx_t = [" ".join(el.text_content().split()) for el in doc.cssselect(profile["body"])]
for i, (a, b) in enumerate(zip(sx_t, lx_t, strict=False)):
    if a.split()[:4] != b.split()[:4]:
        print(i, "SX:", a[:80])
        print(i, "LX:", b[:80])
        break
else:
    print("same", len(sx_t), len(lx_t))
```

```python
"""Scratch: heads of the first two and last three paragraphs a profile keeps, to eyeball drops and stops."""

import importlib.util
import sys
import tomllib
from pathlib import Path

from selectolax.lexbor import LexborHTMLParser

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("probe", "scripts/probe_sources.py")
assert spec and spec.loader
probe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(probe)

sources = tomllib.loads(Path("backend/src/veritrade/data/sources.toml").read_text())["sources"]
for key in sys.argv[1].split(","):
    profile = sources[key]["profile"]
    for n in (1, 2, 3):
        html = Path(f"evals/data/private/probe/{key}/{n}.html").read_text(errors="replace")
        tree = LexborHTMLParser(html)
        for sel in profile.get("drop", []):
            for node in tree.css(sel):
                node.decompose()
        texts = [" ".join(x.text(deep=True, separator=" ").split()) for x in tree.css(profile["body"])]
        kept, cut = probe.apply_profile(texts, profile)
        print(f"== {key}#{n} kept={len(kept)} cut={cut} of {len(texts)}")
        show = kept[:2] + ["..."] + kept[-3:] if len(kept) > 5 else kept
        for text in show:
            print("   ", " ".join(text.split()[:9]))
        if cut is not None:
            print("   CUT AT:", " ".join(texts[cut].split()[:8]) if cut < len(texts) else "?")

```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade.fetch import headers
from veritrade.fetch.headers import CHROME_MAJOR, browser_headers, is_sec_host


def test_publisher_hosts_get_the_chrome_navigation_set() -> None:
    sent = browser_headers("https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/01/x.html")
    assert f"Chrome/{CHROME_MAJOR}.0.0.0" in sent["User-Agent"]
    assert sent["Accept-Language"].startswith("en-US")
    assert sent["Sec-Fetch-Mode"] == "navigate"
    assert sent["Sec-Fetch-Dest"] == "document"
    assert sent["Upgrade-Insecure-Requests"] == "1"
    assert f'"Google Chrome";v="{CHROME_MAJOR}"' in sent["Sec-CH-UA"]


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fresh_settings")
def test_sec_hosts_get_the_declared_contact_agent(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setenv("SEC_USER_AGENT", "Example Org [redacted-email]")
    sent = browser_headers("https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1/2/x.htm")
    assert sent["User-Agent"] == "Example Org [redacted-email]"
    assert not any(name.startswith("Sec-") for name in sent)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("host", "expected"),
    [
        ("www.sec.gov", True),
        ("SEC.GOV.", True),
        ("efts.sec.gov", True),
        ("notsec.gov", False),
        ("sec.gov.example.com", False),
    ],
)
def test_is_sec_host(host: str, expected: bool) -> None:
    assert is_sec_host(host) is expected


@pytest.mark.usefixtures("fresh_settings")
def test_accept_encoding_only_advertises_installed_decoders(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(headers, "find_spec", lambda name: None)
    assert headers.accept_encoding() == "gzip, deflate"
    headers.accept_encoding.cache_clear()
    monkeypatch.setattr(headers, "find_spec", lambda name: object() if name == "brotli" else None)
    assert headers.accept_encoding() == "gzip, deflate, br"

```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json

import pytest

from veritrade.errors import ConsentRequired, Paywalled, SourceBlocked
from veritrade.fetch.detect import SCAN_WINDOW, classify, jsonld_access, jsonld_blocks

ARTICLE_URL = "https://news.example.com/2026/01/01/story"
FILLER = "lorem ipsum dolor sit amet " * 10


def page(body: str = "", head: str = "", paragraphs: int = 12) -> str:
    text = "".join(f"<p>{FILLER}</p>" for _ in range(paragraphs))
    return f"<html><head><title>Story</title>{head}</head><body>{body}{text}</body></html>"


def ld(payload: object) -> str:
    return f'<script type="application/ld+json">{json.dumps(payload)}</script>'


def test_ordinary_article_passes() -> None:
    assert classify(200, {"content-type": "text/html"}, page(), ARTICLE_URL) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", [401, 403, 429, 451])
def test_refusal_statuses_are_source_blocked(status: int) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(SourceBlocked) as caught:
        classify(status, {}, "<html></html>", ARTICLE_URL)
    assert caught.value.upstream_status == status
    assert caught.value.retryable is (status == 429)
    assert caught.value.hint


def test_cloudflare_managed_challenge_names_vendor_and_suggests_syndication() -> None:
    challenge = "<html><head><title>Just a moment...</title></head><body><script>window._cf_chl_opt={}</script>"
    with pytest.raises(SourceBlocked) as caught:
        classify(403, {"cf-mitigated": "challenge", "server": "cloudflare"}, challenge, "https://apnews.com/x")
    assert "Cloudflare challenge" in caught.value.message
    assert caught.value.hint is not None and "Yahoo Finance" in caught.value.hint


def test_bare_403_names_the_edge() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(SourceBlocked, match="Akamai edge"):
        classify(403, {"Server": "AkamaiGHost"}, "<html></html>", ARTICLE_URL)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("headers", "body", "vendor"),
    [
        ({}, "<title>Just a moment...</title>", "Cloudflare"),
        ({}, '<script src="/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/h/b/orchestrate/chl_page/v1"></script>', "Cloudflare"),
        ({}, "<title>Attention Required! | Cloudflare</title>", "Cloudflare"),
        ({}, '<script src="https://geo.captcha-delivery.com/captcha/"></script>', "DataDome"),
        ({"X-DD-B": "1"}, "<html></html>", "DataDome"),
        ({}, '<div id="px-captcha"></div>', "PerimeterX"),
        ({}, "<p>Press &amp; Hold to confirm you are a human</p>", "PerimeterX"),
        ({}, "<title>Access Denied</title><p>Reference #18.abc</p>", "Akamai"),
        ({}, '<div id="sec-if-cpt-container" role="main"></div>', "Akamai"),
        ({}, '<script src="/_Incapsula_Resource?x=1"></script>', "Imperva"),
    ],
)
def test_challenge_pages_served_with_200_are_blocked(headers: dict[str, str], body: str, vendor: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(SourceBlocked, match=f"{vendor} challenge"):
        classify(200, headers, f"<html>{body}</html>", ARTICLE_URL)


def test_business_wire_challenge_gets_its_hint() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(SourceBlocked) as caught:
        classify(200, {}, '<div id="sec-if-cpt-container"></div>', "https://www.businesswire.com/newsroom")
    assert caught.value.hint is not None and "Business Wire" in caught.value.hint


def test_passive_cloudflare_beacon_is_not_a_challenge() -> None:
    beacon = '<script src="/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/main.js"></script>'
    assert classify(200, {"cf-ray": "abc", "server": "cloudflare"}, page(head=beacon), ARTICLE_URL) is None


def test_markers_past_the_scan_window_are_ignored() -> None:
    html = page() + " " * SCAN_WINDOW + "<p>Press & Hold</p>"
    assert classify(200, {}, html, ARTICLE_URL) is None


def test_hint_matches_host_suffix_only() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(SourceBlocked) as caught:
        classify(403, {}, "", "https://www.reuters.com/markets/x")
    assert caught.value.hint is not None and "Reuters" in caught.value.hint
    with pytest.raises(SourceBlocked) as caught:
        classify(403, {}, "", "https://notreuters.com/x")
    assert caught.value.hint is not None and "Reuters" not in caught.value.hint


def test_landing_on_the_consent_host_is_consent_required() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConsentRequired) as caught:
        classify(200, {}, "<html></html>", "https://consent.yahoo.com/v2/collectConsent?sessionId=1")
    assert caught.value.hint is not None and "Yahoo" in caught.value.hint


def test_consent_form_markup_is_consent_required(consent_page: str) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ConsentRequired):
        classify(200, {}, consent_page, "https://finance.yahoo.com/news/x.html")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("flag", [False, "False", "false"])
def test_not_free_teaser_is_paywalled(flag: object) -> None:
    html = page(head=ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": flag}), paragraphs=2)
    with pytest.raises(Paywalled) as caught:
        classify(200, {}, html, "https://www.wsj.com/articles/x")
    assert caught.value.hint is not None and "WSJ" in caught.value.hint


def test_metered_page_with_full_visible_text_is_not_paywalled() -> None:
    html = page(head=ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": False}), paragraphs=12)
    assert classify(200, {}, html, ARTICLE_URL) is None


def test_metered_page_with_full_jsonld_body_is_not_paywalled() -> None:
    graph = {"@graph": [{"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": "false", "articleBody": FILLER * 3}]}
    assert classify(200, {}, page(head=ld(graph), paragraphs=0), ARTICLE_URL) is None


def test_free_short_page_is_not_paywalled() -> None:
    html = page(head=ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": True}), paragraphs=1)
    assert classify(200, {}, html, ARTICLE_URL) is None


def test_jsonld_scan_skips_broken_blocks_and_walks_graphs() -> None:
    html = (
        '<script type="application/ld+json">{not json</script>'
        + ld([{"@type": "WebPage"}, {"@graph": [{"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": True}]}])
        + ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": False, "articleBody": "one two three"})
    )
    assert len(list(jsonld_blocks(html))) == 2
    assert jsonld_access(html) == (False, 3)
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from urllib.parse import parse_qs

import httpx
import pytest
import respx

from veritrade.errors import ConsentRequired
from veritrade.fetch.consent import is_consent_url, parse_consent_form, reject_all

ENTRY = "https://guce.yahoo.com/consent?brandType=eu&done=https%3A%2F%2Ffinance.yahoo.com%2Fnews%2Fx.html"
FORM_URL = "https://consent.yahoo.com/v2/collectConsent?sessionId=3_cc-session_abc"
COPY_URL = "https://guce.yahoo.com/copyConsent?sessionId=3_cc-session_abc"
DONE_URL = "https://finance.yahoo.com/news/x.html?guccounter=1"


def test_is_consent_url() -> None:
    assert is_consent_url(ENTRY)
    assert is_consent_url(FORM_URL)
    assert not is_consent_url("https://finance.yahoo.com/news/x.html")
    assert not is_consent_url("https://consent.yahoo.com.example.org/")


def test_form_parser_picks_reject_and_never_accept(consent_page: str) -> None:
    form = parse_consent_form(consent_page, FORM_URL)
    fields = dict(form.fields)
    assert form.action == FORM_URL
    assert fields["reject"] == "reject"
    assert "agree" not in fields
    assert fields["csrfToken"] == "tok-123"
    assert fields["originalDoneUrl"] == "https://finance.yahoo.com/?guccounter=1"
    assert "q" not in fields


def test_form_without_reject_option_is_consent_required(consent_page: str) -> None:
    accept_only = consent_page.replace('name="reject" value="reject"', 'name="more" value="more"').replace(
        "reject-all", "manage"
    )
    with pytest.raises(ConsentRequired):
        parse_consent_form(accept_only, FORM_URL)


def test_form_posting_off_the_consent_hosts_is_refused(consent_page: str) -> None:
    hostile = consent_page.replace('action=""', 'action="https://collector.example.com/submit"')
    with pytest.raises(ConsentRequired):
        parse_consent_form(hostile, FORM_URL)


def test_reject_button_found_by_class_when_named_differently(consent_page: str) -> None:
    renamed = consent_page.replace('name="reject" value="reject"', 'name="choice" value="necessary"')
    assert dict(parse_consent_form(renamed, FORM_URL).fields)["choice"] == "necessary"


async def test_reject_all_posts_reject_and_keeps_cookies(consent_page: str) -> None:
    with respx.mock(assert_all_called=True) as router:
        router.get(ENTRY).respond(302, headers={"Location": FORM_URL})
        router.get(FORM_URL).respond(200, html=consent_page)
        post = router.post(FORM_URL).respond(302, headers={"Location": COPY_URL})
        router.get(COPY_URL).respond(
            302,
            headers={"Location": DONE_URL, "Set-Cookie": "GUC=AQAB; Domain=.yahoo.com; Path=/; Secure"},
        )
        seen: list[str] = []

        async def guard(url: str) -> None:
            seen.append(url)

        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
            outcome = await reject_all(client, ENTRY, guard=guard)
            assert client.cookies.get("GUC", domain=".yahoo.com") == "AQAB"

    assert outcome.done_url == DONE_URL
    assert outcome.elapsed_ms >= 0
    body = parse_qs(post.calls.last.request.content.decode())
    assert body["reject"] == ["reject"]
    assert "agree" not in body
    assert body["csrfToken"] == ["tok-123"]
    assert post.calls.last.request.headers["Origin"] == "https://consent.yahoo.com"
    assert seen == [ENTRY, FORM_URL, FORM_URL, COPY_URL]


async def test_existing_consent_short_circuits_without_posting() -> None:
    with respx.mock(assert_all_called=True) as router:
        router.get(ENTRY).respond(302, headers={"Location": DONE_URL})
        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
            outcome = await reject_all(client, ENTRY)
    assert outcome.done_url == DONE_URL


async def test_rejected_submission_is_consent_required(consent_page: str) -> None:
    with respx.mock() as router:
        router.get(FORM_URL).respond(200, html=consent_page)
        router.post(FORM_URL).respond(200, html=consent_page)
        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
            with pytest.raises(ConsentRequired) as caught:
                await reject_all(client, FORM_URL)
    assert caught.value.upstream_status == 200


async def test_redirect_loop_is_consent_required() -> None:
    with respx.mock() as router:
        router.get(ENTRY).respond(302, headers={"Location": ENTRY})
        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
            with pytest.raises(ConsentRequired, match="too many"):
                await reject_all(client, ENTRY)
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections.abc import Mapping

import pytest

from veritrade.errors import ConsentRequired, Paywalled, SourceBlocked, VtError
from veritrade.fetch.detect import SCAN_WINDOW, classify, jsonld_access, jsonld_blocks

ARTICLE_URL = "https://news.example.com/2026/01/01/story"
FILLER = "lorem ipsum dolor sit amet " * 10


def page(body: str = "", head: str = "", paragraphs: int = 12) -> str:
    text = "".join(f"<p>{FILLER}</p>" for _ in range(paragraphs))
    return f"<html><head><title>Story</title>{head}</head><body>{body}{text}</body></html>"


def ld(payload: object) -> str:
    return f'<script type="application/ld+json">{json.dumps(payload)}</script>'


def raised(
    kind: type[VtError], status: int, html: str, url: str, headers: Mapping[str, str] | None = None
) -> VtError:
    with pytest.raises(kind) as caught:
        classify(status, headers or {}, html, url)
    assert caught.value.hint
    return caught.value


def test_ordinary_article_passes() -> None:
    classify(200, {"content-type": "text/html"}, page(), ARTICLE_URL)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("status", [401, 403, 429, 451])
def test_refusal_statuses_are_source_blocked(status: int) -> None:
    error = raised(SourceBlocked, status, "<html></html>", ARTICLE_URL)
    assert error.upstream_status == status
    assert error.retryable is (status == 429)


def test_cloudflare_managed_challenge_names_vendor_and_suggests_syndication() -> None:
    challenge = "<title>Just a moment...</title><script>window._cf_chl_opt={}</script>"
    headers = {"cf-mitigated": "challenge", "server": "cloudflare"}
    error = raised(SourceBlocked, 403, challenge, "https://apnews.com/x", headers)
    assert "Cloudflare challenge" in error.message
    assert "Yahoo Finance" in str(error.hint)


def test_bare_403_names_the_edge() -> None:
    error = raised(SourceBlocked, 403, "<html></html>", ARTICLE_URL, {"Server": "AkamaiGHost"})
    assert "Akamai edge" in error.message


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("headers", "body", "vendor"),
    [
        ({}, "<title>Just a moment...</title>", "Cloudflare"),
        ({}, '<script src="/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/h/b/orchestrate/chl_page/v1"></script>', "Cloudflare"),
        ({}, "<title>Attention Required! | Cloudflare</title>", "Cloudflare"),
        ({}, '<script src="https://geo.captcha-delivery.com/captcha/"></script>', "DataDome"),
        ({"X-DD-B": "1"}, "<html></html>", "DataDome"),
        ({}, '<div id="px-captcha"></div>', "PerimeterX"),
        ({}, "<p>Press &amp; Hold to confirm you are a human</p>", "PerimeterX"),
        ({}, "<title>Access Denied</title><p>Reference #18.abc</p>", "Akamai"),
        ({}, '<div id="sec-if-cpt-container" role="main"></div>', "Akamai"),
        ({}, '<script src="/_Incapsula_Resource?x=1"></script>', "Imperva"),
    ],
)
def test_challenge_pages_served_with_200_are_blocked(headers: dict[str, str], body: str, vendor: str) -> None:
    error = raised(SourceBlocked, 200, f"<html>{body}</html>", ARTICLE_URL, headers)
    assert f"{vendor} challenge" in error.message


def test_business_wire_challenge_gets_its_hint() -> None:
    error = raised(SourceBlocked, 200, '<div id="sec-if-cpt-container"></div>', "https://www.businesswire.com/")
    assert "Business Wire" in str(error.hint)


def test_passive_cloudflare_beacon_is_not_a_challenge() -> None:
    beacon = '<script src="/cdn-cgi/challenge-platform/scripts/jsd/main.js"></script>'
    classify(200, {"cf-ray": "abc", "server": "cloudflare"}, page(head=beacon), ARTICLE_URL)


def test_markers_past_the_scan_window_are_ignored() -> None:
    classify(200, {}, page() + " " * SCAN_WINDOW + "<p>Press & Hold</p>", ARTICLE_URL)


def test_hint_matches_host_suffix_only() -> None:
    assert "Reuters" in str(raised(SourceBlocked, 403, "", "https://www.reuters.com/markets/x").hint)
    assert "Reuters" not in str(raised(SourceBlocked, 403, "", "https://notreuters.com/x").hint)


def test_landing_on_the_consent_host_is_consent_required() -> None:
    error = raised(ConsentRequired, 200, "<html></html>", "https://consent.yahoo.com/v2/collectConsent?s=1")
    assert "Yahoo" in str(error.hint)


def test_consent_form_markup_is_consent_required(consent_page: str) -> None:
    raised(ConsentRequired, 200, consent_page, "https://finance.yahoo.com/news/x.html")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("flag", [False, "False", "false"])
def test_not_free_teaser_is_paywalled(flag: object) -> None:
    html = page(head=ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": flag}), paragraphs=2)
    assert "WSJ" in str(raised(Paywalled, 200, html, "https://www.wsj.com/articles/x").hint)


def test_metered_page_with_full_visible_text_is_not_paywalled() -> None:
    classify(200, {}, page(head=ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": False})), ARTICLE_URL)


def test_metered_page_with_full_jsonld_body_is_not_paywalled() -> None:
    graph = {"@graph": [{"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": "false", "articleBody": FILLER * 5}]}
    classify(200, {}, page(head=ld(graph), paragraphs=0), ARTICLE_URL)


def test_free_short_page_is_not_paywalled() -> None:
    classify(200, {}, page(head=ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": True}), paragraphs=1), ARTICLE_URL)


def test_jsonld_scan_skips_broken_blocks_and_walks_graphs() -> None:
    html = (
        '<script type="application/ld+json">{not json</script>'
        + ld([{"@type": "WebPage"}, {"@graph": [{"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": True}]}])
        + ld({"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": False, "articleBody": "one two three"})
    )
    assert len(list(jsonld_blocks(html))) == 2
    assert jsonld_access(html) == (False, 3)
```

```bash
"""Scratch: list long non-URL strings and all distinct keys in source_probe.json (text-leak check)."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

data = json.loads(Path("evals/data/source_probe.json").read_text())
keys: set[str] = set()


def walk(node: object, path: str) -> None:
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        for k, v in node.items():
            keys.add(k)
            walk(v, f"{path}.{k}")
    elif isinstance(node, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(node):
            walk(v, f"{path}[{i}]")
    elif isinstance(node, str) and len(node) > 60 and not node.startswith("http"):
        print(path, "=>", node[:140])


walk(data, "$")
print(sorted(keys))
print(Path("evals/data/source_probe.json").stat().st_size, "bytes")
EOF
```
