```typescript
"use client";

import { useId, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";

import type { ModelsState } from "@/hooks/useModels";
import type { RunParams } from "@/hooks/useAnalysis";
import {
  EXTRACTORS,
  PARSERS,
  SCOPES,
  type Endpoint,
  type ExtractorName,
  type ModelInfo,
  type ParserName,
  type Scope,
} from "@/lib/api";
import type { Mode } from "@/lib/run-state";
import { SOURCES } from "@/lib/sources";

import styles from "./AnalyzeForm.module.css";

// Third-party extractors bring their own HTML parser, so the parser picker does not apply.
const PARSER_AWARE: ReadonlySet<ExtractorName> = new Set(["cascade", "jsonld", "profile", "density"]);

export function isHttpUrl(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "http:" || url.protocol === "https:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function modelLabel(model: ModelInfo, isDefault: boolean): string {
  const notes = [
    isDefault ? "default" : null,
    model.installed ? null : "not installed",
    model.evaluated ? null : "CI plumbing, unevaluated",
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return notes.length ? `${model.name} (${notes.join(", ")})` : model.name;
}

interface ModelSelectProps {
  label: string;
  endpoint: Endpoint;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  models: ModelsState;
}

function ModelSelect({ label, endpoint, value, onChange, models }: ModelSelectProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const ready = models.status === "ready" ? models.data : null;
  const fallback = ready?.defaults[endpoint];
  const options = ready ? ready.models.filter((m) => m.endpoints.includes(endpoint)) : [];
  return (
    <div className={styles.field}>
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <select id={id} value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}>
        <option value="">{fallback ? `Server default (${fallback})` : "Server default"}</option>
        {options.map((m) => (
          <option key={m.name} value={m.name} disabled={!m.installed}>
            {modelLabel(m, m.name === fallback)}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

interface AnalyzeFormProps {
  models: ModelsState;
  running: boolean;
  onSubmit: (params: RunParams) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function AnalyzeForm({ models, running, onSubmit, onCancel }: AnalyzeFormProps) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [urlError, setUrlError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("split");
  const [streaming, setStreaming] = useState(true);
  const [signalModel, setSignalModel] = useState("");
  const [summaryModel, setSummaryModel] = useState("");
  const [analyzeModel, setAnalyzeModel] = useState("");
  const [parser, setParser] = useState<ParserName>("selectolax");
  const [extractor, setExtractor] = useState<ExtractorName>("cascade");
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<Scope>("lede");

  const ids = { url: useId(), urlHelp: useId(), parser: useId(), extractor: useId(), scope: useId() };
  const ready = models.status === "ready" ? models.data : null;
  const parsers = ready?.parsers.length ? ready.parsers : PARSERS;
  const extractors = ready?.extractors.length ? ready.extractors : EXTRACTORS;
  const scopes = ready?.scopes.length ? ready.scopes : SCOPES;
  const parserApplies = PARSER_AWARE.has(extractor);

  function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = url.trim();
    if (!isHttpUrl(trimmed)) {
      setUrlError("Enter a full http(s) URL, for example https://www.cnbc.com/2026/...");
      return;
    }
    setUrlError(null);
    onSubmit({
      url: trimmed,
      mode,
      streaming,
      parser,
      extractor,
      scope,
      signalModel,
      summaryModel,
      analyzeModel,
    });
  }

  const examples = SOURCES.filter((s) => s.exampleUrl);

  return (
    <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate aria-label="Analyze an article">
      <div className={styles.urlRow}>
        <div className={styles.urlField}>
          <label htmlFor={ids.url}>Article URL</label>
          <input
            id={ids.url}
            name="url"
            type="url"
            inputMode="url"
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            placeholder="https://..."
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={urlError ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={ids.urlHelp}
            required
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.actions}>
          <button type="submit" className={styles.primary}>
            {running ? "Restart" : "Analyze"}
          </button>
          {running ? (
            <button type="button" className={styles.secondary} onClick={onCancel}>
              Cancel
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
      <p id={ids.urlHelp} className={urlError ? styles.error : styles.help}>
        {urlError ?? "A public news article, press release or SEC 8-K exhibit."}
      </p>

      <div className={styles.sources}>
        <span className={styles.sourcesLabel}>Tested sources:</span>
        <ul className={styles.chips}>
          {SOURCES.map((s) => (
            <li key={s.key} className={styles.chip}>
              {s.name}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {examples.length ? (
          <div className={styles.examples}>
            {examples.map((s) => (
              <button
                key={s.key}
                type="button"
                className={styles.secondary}
                onClick={() => setUrl(s.exampleUrl ?? "")}
              >
                Example: {s.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className={styles.groups}>
        <fieldset className={styles.group}>
          <legend>Mode</legend>
          <label className={styles.choice}>
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="mode"
              value="split"
              checked={mode === "split"}
              onChange={() => setMode("split")}
            />
            <span>
              Split
              <small>/api/signal and /api/summary fire together; the signal lands first.</small>
            </span>
          </label>
          <label className={styles.choice}>
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="mode"
              value="combined"
              checked={mode === "combined"}
              onChange={() => setMode("combined")}
            />
            <span>
              Combined
              <small>One /api/analyze call generates sentiment and summary together.</small>
            </span>
          </label>
          <label className={styles.choice}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={streaming} onChange={(e) => setStreaming(e.target.checked)} />
            <span>
              Streaming
              <small>Server-sent events; off uses the JSON endpoints.</small>
            </span>
          </label>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className={styles.group}>
          <legend>Models</legend>
          {mode === "split" ? (
            <>
              <ModelSelect
                label="Signal model"
                endpoint="signal"
                value={signalModel}
                onChange={setSignalModel}
                models={models}
              />
              <ModelSelect
                label="Summary model"
                endpoint="summary"
                value={summaryModel}
                onChange={setSummaryModel}
                models={models}
              />
            </>
          ) : (
            <ModelSelect
              label="Analyze model"
              endpoint="analyze"
              value={analyzeModel}
              onChange={setAnalyzeModel}
              models={models}
            />
          )}
          {models.status === "loading" ? <p className={styles.help}>Loading models...</p> : null}
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className={styles.group}>
          <legend>Extraction</legend>
          <div className={styles.field}>
            <label htmlFor={ids.extractor}>Extractor</label>
            <select
              id={ids.extractor}
              value={extractor}
              onChange={(e) => setExtractor(e.target.value as ExtractorName)}
            >
              {extractors.map((name) => (
                <option key={name} value={name}>
                  {name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.field}>
            <label htmlFor={ids.parser}>Parser</label>
            <select
              id={ids.parser}
              value={parser}
              onChange={(e) => setParser(e.target.value as ParserName)}
              disabled={!parserApplies}
            >
              {parsers.map((name) => (
                <option key={name} value={name}>
                  {name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            {!parserApplies ? <small className={styles.help}>{extractor} uses its own parser.</small> : null}
          </div>
          {mode === "split" ? (
            <div className={styles.field}>
              <label htmlFor={ids.scope}>Signal scope</label>
              <select id={ids.scope} value={scope} onChange={(e) => setScope(e.target.value as Scope)}>
                {scopes.map((name) => (
                  <option key={name} value={name}>
                    {name === "lede" ? "lede (headline + opening paragraphs)" : "full article"}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </fieldset>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```typescript
"use client";

import { useAnalysis } from "@/hooks/useAnalysis";
import { useModels } from "@/hooks/useModels";
import { capitalize } from "@/lib/format";
import {
  articleMeta,
  distinctErrors,
  laneById,
  type Lane,
  type LaneId,
  type RunState,
} from "@/lib/run-state";

import { AnalyzeForm } from "./AnalyzeForm";
import styles from "./AnalyzeApp.module.css";
import { ArticleMetaLine } from "./ArticleMetaLine";
import { ErrorBanner } from "./ErrorBanner";
import { LatencyBar, type LaneMark, type LatencyLane } from "./LatencyBar";
import { SignalCard } from "./SignalCard";
import { SummaryPanel } from "./SummaryPanel";

const LANE_LABELS: Record<LaneId, string> = { signal: "Signal", summary: "Summary", analyze: "Analyze" };

function toLatencyLane(lane: Lane): LatencyLane {
  const marks: LaneMark[] = [];
  if (lane.signalAtMs !== null) marks.push({ kind: "signal", label: "time to signal", atMs: lane.signalAtMs });
  if (lane.firstTokenAtMs !== null) {
    marks.push({ kind: "token", label: "time to first token", atMs: lane.firstTokenAtMs });
  }
  return {
    id: lane.id,
    label: LANE_LABELS[lane.id],
    status: lane.status,
    timings: lane.timings,
    endMs: lane.endAtMs,
    marks,
  };
}

function announcement(state: RunState): string {
  if (state.running && !state.signal) return "Analyzing...";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (state.signal) {
    parts.push(`Signal ${capitalize(state.signal.sentiment)}${state.signal.abstained ? ", abstained" : ""}.`);
  }
  if (!state.running && state.summary) parts.push("Summary complete.");
  return parts.join(" ");
}

export function AnalyzeApp() {
  const models = useModels();
  const { state, start, cancel } = useAnalysis();

  const split = state.mode === "split";
  const signalLane = laneById(state, split ? "signal" : "analyze");
  const summaryLane = laneById(state, split ? "summary" : "analyze");
  const meta = articleMeta(state);
  const errors = distinctErrors(state);
  const showLatency = state.lanes.some((l) => l.timings || l.signalAtMs !== null || l.firstTokenAtMs !== null);

  return (
    <>
      <AnalyzeForm models={models} running={state.running} onSubmit={start} onCancel={cancel} />

      <p role="status" className="visually-hidden">
        {announcement(state)}
      </p>

      {models.status === "error" ? <ErrorBanner error={models.error} context="Model list" /> : null}
      {errors.map(({ lanes, error }) => (
        <ErrorBanner
          key={`${error.code}-${lanes.join("-")}`}
          error={error}
          context={lanes.map((id) => LANE_LABELS[id]).join(" and ")}
        />
      ))}

      {state.lanes.length ? (
        <div className={styles.results}>
          {meta ? <ArticleMetaLine meta={meta} /> : null}
          <div className={styles.cards}>
            {signalLane ? (
              <SignalCard
                status={signalLane.status}
                signal={state.signal}
                entity={state.entity}
                model={signalLane.meta?.model}
                timeToSignalMs={signalLane.signalAtMs}
                serverMs={state.serverSignalMs}
              />
            ) : null}
            {summaryLane ? (
              <SummaryPanel
                status={summaryLane.status}
                text={state.summary}
                model={summaryLane.meta?.model}
                streaming={state.streaming}
                firstTokenMs={summaryLane.firstTokenAtMs}
              />
            ) : null}
          </div>
          {showLatency ? <LatencyBar lanes={state.lanes.map(toLatencyLane)} /> : null}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.empty}>
          Results appear here. Split mode shows the signal as soon as /api/signal answers while the
          summary keeps streaming; combined mode gets both from one generation.
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

import styles from "./Benchmarks.module.css";

export interface Column<T> {
  header: string;
  /** Expanded header text for abbreviations, read by screen readers. */
  title?: string;
  numeric?: boolean;
  cell: (row: T) => ReactNode;
}

interface DataTableProps<T> {
  caption: string;
  columns: Column<T>[];
  rows: T[];
  rowKey: (row: T, index: number) => string;
  highlight?: (row: T) => boolean;
}

export function DataTable<T>({ caption, columns, rows, rowKey, highlight }: DataTableProps<T>) {
  return (
    // Focusable so keyboard users can scroll wide tables horizontally.
    <div className={styles.scroll} role="region" aria-label={caption} tabIndex={0}>
      <table className={styles.table}>
        <caption className={styles.caption}>{caption}</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {columns.map((col) => (
              <th
                key={col.header}
                scope="col"
                className={col.numeric ? styles.num : undefined}
                title={col.title}
              >
                {col.title ? <abbr title={col.title}>{col.header}</abbr> : col.header}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {rows.length === 0 ? (
            <tr>
              <td colSpan={columns.length} className={styles.emptyCell}>
                No rows yet.
              </td>
            </tr>
          ) : (
            rows.map((row, i) => (
              <tr key={rowKey(row, i)} data-selected={highlight?.(row) || undefined}>
                {columns.map((col) => (
                  <td key={col.header} className={col.numeric ? styles.num : undefined}>
                    {col.cell(row)}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))
          )}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import {
  LATENCY_BUDGETS,
  withinBudget,
  type BenchmarksV1,
  type ExtractionBenchmark,
  type LatencyBenchmark,
  type SelectionEndpoint,
  type SignalBenchmark,
  type SummaryBenchmark,
} from "@/lib/benchmarks";
import { formatInt, formatMs, formatNum, formatPct } from "@/lib/format";
import { sourceName } from "@/lib/sources";

import styles from "./Benchmarks.module.css";
import { DataTable, type Column } from "./DataTable";

const SELECTION_ORDER: readonly SelectionEndpoint[] = ["signal", "summary", "analyze"];

function Selected() {
  return <span className={styles.selected}>selected</span>;
}

function ModelCell({ model, selected, note }: { model: string; selected: boolean; note?: string | null }) {
  return (
    <>
      <code>{model}</code>
      {selected ? <Selected /> : null}
      {note ? <span className={styles.sub}>{note}</span> : null}
    </>
  );
}

function isSelected(data: BenchmarksV1, endpoint: string, model: string): boolean {
  return (
    (endpoint === "signal" || endpoint === "summary" || endpoint === "analyze") &&
    data.selection[endpoint]?.model === model
  );
}

export function BenchmarksView({ data }: { data: BenchmarksV1 }) {
  const signalColumns: Column<SignalBenchmark>[] = [
    {
      header: "Model",
      cell: (r) => <ModelCell model={r.model} selected={isSelected(data, r.endpoint, r.model)} note={r.kind} />,
    },
    {
      header: "Endpoint",
      cell: (r) => (
        <>
          {r.endpoint}
          {r.fieldOrder ? <span className={styles.sub}>{r.fieldOrder}</span> : null}
        </>
      ),
    },
    { header: "Policy", cell: (r) => r.policy },
    { header: "Scope", cell: (r) => r.scope },
    {
      header: "Dataset",
      cell: (r) => (
        <>
          {r.dataset} / {r.split}
          <span className={styles.sub}>prompt {r.promptVersion}</span>
        </>
      ),
    },
    { header: "n", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatInt(r.n) },
    {
      header: "F0.5",
      title: "F0.5 macro over bullish and bearish (selection metric)",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => (
        <>
          <strong>{formatNum(r.f05Macro)}</strong>
          {r.ciLow !== null && r.ciHigh !== null ? (
            <span className={styles.sub}>
              {formatNum(r.ciLow, 2)} to {formatNum(r.ciHigh, 2)}
            </span>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ),
    },
    { header: "P bull", title: "Precision, bullish", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatNum(r.precisionBullish) },
    { header: "P bear", title: "Precision, bearish", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatNum(r.precisionBearish) },
    { header: "R bull", title: "Recall, bullish", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatNum(r.recallBullish) },
    { header: "R bear", title: "Recall, bearish", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatNum(r.recallBearish) },
    {
      header: "Inversion",
      title: "Bullish called bearish or the reverse (cap 2%)",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => (
        <span data-over={r.inversionRate > 0.02 || undefined} className={styles.flag}>
          {formatPct(r.inversionRate)}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    { header: "Coverage", title: "Share of rows not abstained", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatPct(r.coverage) },
  ];

  const latencyColumns: Column<LatencyBenchmark>[] = [
    { header: "Endpoint", cell: (r) => r.endpoint },
    { header: "Model", cell: (r) => <ModelCell model={r.model} selected={isSelected(data, r.endpoint, r.model)} /> },
    { header: "Scope", cell: (r) => r.scope },
    { header: "Streaming", cell: (r) => (r.streaming ? "SSE" : "JSON") },
    { header: "Backend", cell: (r) => r.backend },
    { header: "n", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatInt(r.n) },
    { header: "p50", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatMs(r.p50Ms) },
    { header: "p95", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatMs(r.p95Ms) },
    { header: "TTFT", title: "Time to first summary token, p50", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatMs(r.ttftP50Ms) },
    {
      header: "To signal",
      title: "Time to sentiment, p50",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => formatMs(r.timeToSignalP50Ms),
    },
    {
      header: "Budget",
      cell: (r) => {
        const ok = withinBudget(r);
        if (ok === null) return <span className={styles.sub}>n/a</span>;
        return (
          <span className={styles.flag} data-over={!ok || undefined}>
            {ok ? "within" : "over"}
          </span>
        );
      },
    },
  ];

  const summaryColumns: Column<SummaryBenchmark>[] = [
    { header: "Endpoint", cell: (r) => r.endpoint },
    { header: "Model", cell: (r) => <ModelCell model={r.model} selected={isSelected(data, r.endpoint, r.model)} /> },
    { header: "n", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatInt(r.n) },
    {
      header: "Checks",
      title: "Deterministic pass rate: numbers grounded, entity named, length",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => formatPct(r.deterministicPassRate),
    },
    {
      header: "Key facts",
      title: "Key-fact coverage by embedding similarity",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => formatPct(r.keyFactCoverage),
    },
    {
      header: "Faithful",
      title: "Judge faithfulness, 1 to 5",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => formatNum(r.judgeFaithfulness, 1),
    },
    { header: "Cover", title: "Judge coverage, 1 to 5", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatNum(r.judgeCoverage, 1) },
    {
      header: "Halluc.",
      title: "Share of summaries with a hallucination flag",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => formatPct(r.hallucinationRate),
    },
  ];

  const extractionColumns: Column<ExtractionBenchmark>[] = [
    { header: "Parser", cell: (r) => r.parser ?? <span className={styles.sub}>own</span> },
    { header: "Extractor", cell: (r) => <code>{r.extractor}</code> },
    { header: "n", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatInt(r.n) },
    { header: "p50", numeric: true, cell: (r) => `${formatNum(r.p50Ms, 1)} ms` },
    { header: "p95", numeric: true, cell: (r) => `${formatNum(r.p95Ms, 1)} ms` },
    { header: "P", title: "Token precision vs gold body", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatNum(r.precision, 2) },
    { header: "R", title: "Token recall vs gold body", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatNum(r.recall, 2) },
    { header: "F1", numeric: true, cell: (r) => <strong>{formatNum(r.f1, 2)}</strong> },
    {
      header: "Leakage",
      title: "Share of output tokens that are boilerplate",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => formatPct(r.leakage),
    },
    { header: "Tokens", title: "Tokens sent to the LLM", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatInt(r.tokensToLlm) },
    { header: "Fail", title: "Failure rate", numeric: true, cell: (r) => formatPct(r.failureRate) },
    {
      header: "Install",
      title: "Install size in MB",
      numeric: true,
      cell: (r) => (r.installMb === null ? "-" : `${formatNum(r.installMb, 1)} MB`),
    },
  ];

  const sources = Object.entries(data.articles.perSource);
  const env = data.environment;

  return (
    <div className={styles.page}>
      <h1>Benchmarks</h1>
      {data.sample ? (
        <p className={styles.sampleBanner} data-testid="sample-banner">
          <strong>Sample data.</strong> These numbers are illustrative placeholders, not measurements. They
          are replaced by <code>evals/results/benchmarks.json</code> once the eval suite has run.
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <p className={styles.env}>
        {env.chip}, {env.ramGb} GB RAM, Ollama {env.ollamaVersion}, backend <code>{env.backend}</code>
        {data.generatedAt ? `, generated ${data.generatedAt}` : ""}
        {env.gitSha ? (
          <>
            {" "}
            at <code>{env.gitSha.slice(0, 10)}</code>
          </>
        ) : null}
        .
      </p>

      <section aria-labelledby="selection-heading" className={styles.section}>
        <h2 id="selection-heading">Selected models</h2>
        <ul className={styles.selection}>
          {SELECTION_ORDER.map((endpoint) => {
            const pick = data.selection[endpoint];
            return (
              <li key={endpoint} className={styles.pick}>
                <span className={styles.pickEndpoint}>/api/{endpoint}</span>
                <code className={styles.pickModel}>{pick?.model ?? "-"}</code>
                <span className={styles.pickReason}>{pick?.reason ?? "Not selected yet."}</span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="signal-heading" className={styles.section}>
        <h2 id="signal-heading">Signal accuracy</h2>
        <p className={styles.lead}>
          Winner = best F0.5 macro over the directional classes within the latency budget, with bullish/bearish
          inversions capped at 2%. Neutral is the safe default, so precision is weighted over recall.
        </p>
        <DataTable
          caption="Signal accuracy by model, policy, scope and dataset"
          columns={signalColumns}
          rows={data.signal}
          rowKey={(r, i) => `${r.model}-${r.endpoint}-${r.policy}-${r.scope}-${r.dataset}-${r.split}-${i}`}
          highlight={(r) => isSelected(data, r.endpoint, r.model)}
        />
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="latency-heading" className={styles.section}>
        <h2 id="latency-heading">Latency</h2>
        <p className={styles.lead}>
          Budgets (native, warm, excluding fetch): /signal lede p50 at most{" "}
          {formatMs(LATENCY_BUDGETS.signalLedeP50Ms)}; /summary and /analyze time to first token at most{" "}
          {formatMs(LATENCY_BUDGETS.ttftMs)} and complete p50 at most {formatMs(LATENCY_BUDGETS.completeP50Ms)}.
        </p>
        <DataTable
          caption="Latency by endpoint, model, scope, transport and backend"
          columns={latencyColumns}
          rows={data.latency}
          rowKey={(r, i) => `${r.endpoint}-${r.model}-${r.scope}-${r.streaming}-${r.backend}-${i}`}
          highlight={(r) => isSelected(data, r.endpoint, r.model)}
        />
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="summary-heading" className={styles.section}>
        <h2 id="summary-heading">Summary quality</h2>
        <DataTable
          caption="Summary quality by endpoint and model"
          columns={summaryColumns}
          rows={data.summary}
          rowKey={(r, i) => `${r.endpoint}-${r.model}-${i}`}
          highlight={(r) => isSelected(data, r.endpoint, r.model)}
        />
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="extraction-heading" className={styles.section}>
        <h2 id="extraction-heading">Extraction matrix</h2>
        <p className={styles.lead}>
          Own strategies run on each parser backend; third-party extractors bring their own parser.
        </p>
        <DataTable
          caption="Extraction speed and quality by parser and extractor"
          columns={extractionColumns}
          rows={data.extraction}
          rowKey={(r, i) => `${r.parser ?? "own"}-${r.extractor}-${i}`}
        />
      </section>

      <section aria-labelledby="articles-heading" className={styles.section}>
        <h2 id="articles-heading">Article set</h2>
        <p className={styles.lead}>
          {formatInt(data.articles.n)} labelled articles; labeller agreement {formatPct(data.articles.agreement)},
          Cohen&apos;s kappa {formatNum(data.articles.kappa, 2)}.
        </p>
        <DataTable
          caption="Articles per source and label"
          columns={[
            { header: "Source", cell: ([key]) => sourceName(key) ?? key },
            { header: "Bullish", numeric: true, cell: ([, c]) => formatInt(c.bullish) },
            { header: "Bearish", numeric: true, cell: ([, c]) => formatInt(c.bearish) },
            { header: "Neutral", numeric: true, cell: ([, c]) => formatInt(c.neutral) },
            { header: "Total", numeric: true, cell: ([, c]) => formatInt(c.bullish + c.bearish + c.neutral) },
          ]}
          rows={sources}
          rowKey={([key]) => key}
        />
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import type { Metadata } from "next";

import { BenchmarksView } from "@/components/benchmarks/BenchmarksView";
import raw from "@/data/benchmarks.json";
import { isBenchmarksV1 } from "@/lib/benchmarks";

export const metadata: Metadata = { title: "Benchmarks" };

// Rendered at build time from the JSON that scripts/copy-benchmarks.mjs puts in src/data.
export default function BenchmarksPage() {
  const data: unknown = raw;
  if (!isBenchmarksV1(data)) {
    return (
      <>
        <h1>Benchmarks</h1>
        <p>
          No compatible benchmark results were bundled. Run the eval suite to produce{" "}
          <code>evals/results/benchmarks.json</code> (version 1) and rebuild.
        </p>
      </>
    );
  }
  return <BenchmarksView data={data} />;
}
```

```
// Copies the canonical eval results into the app; falls back to the committed sample before evals exist.
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const canonical = resolve(here, "../../evals/results/benchmarks.json");
const sample = resolve(here, "../src/data/benchmarks.sample.json");
const target = resolve(here, "../src/data/benchmarks.json");

function isVersion1(path) {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8")).version === 1;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

let source = sample;
if (existsSync(canonical)) {
  if (isVersion1(canonical)) source = canonical;
  else console.warn(`benchmarks: ${canonical} is not a version 1 file; using the sample`);
}

mkdirSync(dirname(target), { recursive: true });
copyFileSync(source, target);
console.log(`benchmarks: ${source} -> ${target}`);

```

```typescript
};

export interface MetaOptions {
  endpoint: Endpoint;
  model?: string | null;
  parser?: ParserName;
  extractor?: ExtractorName;
  scope?: Scope;
}

export function articleMeta({ endpoint, model, parser, extractor, scope }: MetaOptions): ArticleMeta {
  const resolvedModel = model || models.defaults[endpoint];
  const kind = models.models.find((m) => m.name === resolvedModel)?.kind ?? "generative";
  const resolvedExtractor = extractor ?? "cascade";
  return {
    url: FIXTURE_URL,
    final_url: FIXTURE_URL,
    title: "Acme Corp beats estimates and lifts full-year outlook",
    source: null,
    published_at: "2026-10-16T12:30:00Z",
    endpoint,
    model: resolvedModel,
    model_kind: kind,
    prompt_version: "v1-fixture",
    parser: parser ?? "selectolax",
    extractor: resolvedExtractor,
    extraction_method: resolvedExtractor === "cascade" ? "jsonld" : resolvedExtractor,
    scope: scope ?? (endpoint === "signal" ? "lede" : "full"),
    input_chars: endpoint === "signal" ? 1180 : 4920,
    word_count: 812,
    field_order: endpoint === "analyze" ? "sentiment-first" : null,
    cached: false,
    backend: "native-metal",
  };
}

export const bullishDecision: SignalResult = {
  sentiment: "bullish",
  abstained: false,
  policy: "probability",
  confidence: 0.82,
  probabilities: { bullish: 0.82, bearish: 0.05, neutral: 0.13 },
};

export const bullishOrdinal: SignalResult = {
  sentiment: "bullish",
  abstained: false,
  policy: "ordinal",
  score: 2,
};

export function timings(inference: Timings["inference"], totalMs: number): Timings {
  return {
    total_ms: totalMs,
    fetch_ms: 182,
    parse_ms: 6.4,
    extract_ms: 3.1,
    inference,
    cache: { fetch: "miss", result: "miss" },
  };
}

export function signalResponse(options: Omit<MetaOptions, "endpoint"> = {}): SignalResponse {
  return {
    meta: articleMeta({ endpoint: "signal", ...options }),
    signal: bullishDecision,
    timings: timings({ wall_ms: 341 }, 535),
  };
}

export function summaryResponse(options: Omit<MetaOptions, "endpoint"> = {}): SummaryResponse {
  return {
    meta: articleMeta({ endpoint: "summary", ...options }),
    summary: SUMMARY_TEXT,
    timings: timings(
      { wall_ms: 2410, ttft_ms: 512, load_ms: 12, prompt_eval_ms: 420, eval_ms: 1930, eval_tokens: 46 },
      2610,

}

export function analyzeResponse(options: Omit<MetaOptions, "endpoint"> = {}): AnalyzeResponse {

}

}
```

```typescript
import { HttpResponse } from "msw";

import type { StreamEventType } from "@/lib/sse";

export function sseFrame(event: StreamEventType, data: unknown): string {
  return `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
}

export const SSE_PING = ": ping\n\n";

/** Pull-based so a test can hold the stream open between chunks (e.g. awaiting a gate). */
export function sseStream(chunks: AsyncIterable<string> | Iterable<string>): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const iterator =
    Symbol.asyncIterator in chunks ? chunks[Symbol.asyncIterator]() : toAsync(chunks[Symbol.iterator]());
  return new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    async pull(controller) {
      const { value, done } = await iterator.next();
      if (done) controller.close();
      else controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(value));
    },
    async cancel() {
      await iterator.return?.();
    },
  });
}

function toAsync(iterator: Iterator<string>): AsyncIterator<string> {
  return { next: async () => iterator.next() };
}

export function sseResponse(chunks: AsyncIterable<string> | Iterable<string>): HttpResponse<ReadableStream> {
  return new HttpResponse(sseStream(chunks), {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "text/event-stream", "Cache-Control": "no-cache" },
  });
}

export interface Gate {
  promise: Promise<void>;
  open: () => void;
}

export function gate(): Gate {
  let open: () => void = () => undefined;
  const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    open = resolve;
  });
  return { promise, open };
}

```

```typescript
import { http, HttpResponse, type HttpHandler } from "msw";

import type { AnalyzeBody, ErrorBody, SignalBody, SummaryBody } from "@/lib/api";

import {
  SUMMARY_CHUNKS,
  analyzeResponse,
  articleMeta,
  health,
  metaEvent,
  models,
  sentimentEvent,
  signalResponse,
  summaryResponse,
} from "./fixtures";
import { SSE_PING, sseFrame, sseResponse } from "./sse";

// "*/api" matches any origin, so the same handlers serve jsdom, next dev and Playwright.
export const API = "*/api";

export function summaryStreamChunks(body: SummaryBody): string[] {
  const done = summaryResponse(body);
  return [
    sseFrame("meta", metaEvent(done.meta)),
    SSE_PING,
    ...SUMMARY_CHUNKS.map((text) => sseFrame("summary_delta", { text })),
    sseFrame("done", { result: done }),
  ];
}

export function analyzeStreamChunks(body: AnalyzeBody): string[] {
  const done = analyzeResponse(body);
  return [
    sseFrame("meta", metaEvent(articleMeta({ endpoint: "analyze", ...body }))),
    sseFrame("sentiment", sentimentEvent),
    ...SUMMARY_CHUNKS.map((text) => sseFrame("summary_delta", { text })),
    sseFrame("done", { result: done }),
  ];
}

export function errorResponse(status: number, error: ErrorBody): HttpResponse<{ error: ErrorBody }> {
  return HttpResponse.json({ error }, { status });
}

export const handlers: HttpHandler[] = [
  http.get(`${API}/health`, () => HttpResponse.json(health)),
  http.get(`${API}/models`, () => HttpResponse.json(models)),
  http.post(`${API}/signal`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(signalResponse((await request.json()) as SignalBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/summary`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(summaryResponse((await request.json()) as SummaryBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, async ({ request }) =>
    sseResponse(summaryStreamChunks((await request.json()) as SummaryBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/analyze`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(analyzeResponse((await request.json()) as AnalyzeBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/analyze/stream`, async ({ request }) =>
    sseResponse(analyzeStreamChunks((await request.json()) as AnalyzeBody)),
  ),
];
```

```typescript
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { SseParser, readSseFrames, streamEvents, toStreamEvent, type SseFrame } from "@/lib/sse";

function parseAll(chunks: string[]): SseFrame[] {
  const parser = new SseParser();
  return chunks.flatMap((chunk) => parser.push(chunk));
}

function byteStream(chunks: Uint8Array[]): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {
  return new ReadableStream({
    start(controller) {
      for (const chunk of chunks) controller.enqueue(chunk);
      controller.close();
    },
  });
}

async function collect<T>(iterable: AsyncIterable<T>): Promise<T[]> {
  const out: T[] = [];
  for await (const item of iterable) out.push(item);
  return out;
}

const STREAM =
  ": ping\n\n" +
  'event: meta\ndata: {"meta":{"title":"Acme"}}\n\n' +
  'event: sentiment\ndata: {"signal":{"sentiment":"bullish"},\ndata: "elapsed_ms":12}\n\n' +
  ": keep-alive\r\n" +
  'event: summary_delta\r\ndata: {"text":"Shares rose"}\r\n\r\n' +
  'event: summary_delta\rdata: {"text":" 8%."}\r\r' +
  'event: done\ndata: {"result":{}}\n\n';

const EXPECTED: Pick<SseFrame, "event" | "data">[] = [
  { event: "meta", data: '{"meta":{"title":"Acme"}}' },
  { event: "sentiment", data: '{"signal":{"sentiment":"bullish"},\n"elapsed_ms":12}' },
  { event: "summary_delta", data: '{"text":"Shares rose"}' },
  { event: "summary_delta", data: '{"text":" 8%."}' },
  { event: "done", data: '{"result":{}}' },
];

const strip = (frames: SseFrame[]) => frames.map(({ event, data }) => ({ event, data }));

describe("SseParser", () => {
  it("parses events, multi-line data and every line terminator, skipping comments", () => {
    expect(strip(parseAll([STREAM]))).toEqual(EXPECTED);
  });

  it("yields identical frames for a split at every character offset", () => {
    for (let i = 1; i < STREAM.length; i++) {
      const frames = parseAll([STREAM.slice(0, i), STREAM.slice(i)]);
      expect(strip(frames), `split at ${i}`).toEqual(EXPECTED);
    }
  });

  it("yields identical frames when fed one character at a time", () => {
    expect(strip(parseAll([...STREAM]))).toEqual(EXPECTED);
  });

  it("treats a CR ending one chunk and LF starting the next as one line break", () => {
    const frames = parseAll(["event: done\r", "\ndata: {}\r", "\n\r", "\n"]);
    expect(strip(frames)).toEqual([{ event: "done", data: "{}" }]);
  });

  it("defaults the event type and keeps the last id", () => {
    const frames = parseAll(["id: 7\ndata:x\n\n", "data\n\n"]);
    expect(frames).toEqual([
      { event: "message", data: "x", id: "7" },
      { event: "message", data: "", id: "7" },
    ]);
  });

  it("does not dispatch a block without data lines", () => {
    expect(parseAll(["event: meta\n\n", ": ping\n\n", "retry: 1000\n\n"])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("holds back a frame until its blank line arrives", () => {
    const parser = new SseParser();
    expect(parser.push('event: meta\ndata: {"a":1}\n')).toEqual([]);
    expect(strip(parser.push("\n"))).toEqual([{ event: "meta", data: '{"a":1}' }]);
  });
});

describe("toStreamEvent", () => {
  it("parses JSON payloads of known events", () => {
    const event = toStreamEvent({ event: "summary_delta", data: '{"text":"hi"}', id: null });
    expect(event).toEqual({ type: "summary_delta", data: { text: "hi" } });
  });

  it("ignores unknown event names", () => {
    expect(toStreamEvent({ event: "message", data: "{}", id: null })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("throws a typed error on malformed JSON", () => {
    expect(() => toStreamEvent({ event: "done", data: "{oops", id: null })).toThrow(ApiError);
  });
});

describe("readSseFrames", () => {
  it("decodes UTF-8 characters split across byte chunks", async () => {
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode('event: summary_delta\ndata: {"text":"EUR € up"}\n\n');
    const euro = bytes.indexOf(0xe2);
    const chunks = [bytes.slice(0, euro + 1), bytes.slice(euro + 1, euro + 2), bytes.slice(euro + 2)];
    const frames = await collect(readSseFrames(byteStream(chunks)));
    expect(frames.map((f) => JSON.parse(f.data))).toEqual([{ text: "EUR € up" }]);
  });

  it("drops an unterminated trailing frame", async () => {
    const bytes = new TextEncoder().encode("event: meta\ndata: {}\n\nevent: done\ndata: {}\n");
    const frames = await collect(readSseFrames(byteStream([bytes])));
    expect(frames.map((f) => f.event)).toEqual(["meta"]);
  });
});

describe("streamEvents", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  function stubFetch(response: Response) {
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (_url: string | URL | Request, _init?: RequestInit) => response);
    vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock);
    return fetchMock;
  }

  const sse = (text: string) =>
    new Response(byteStream([new TextEncoder().encode(text)]), {
      headers: { "Content-Type": "text/event-stream" },
    });

  it("POSTs JSON and yields typed events until done", async () => {
    const fetchMock = stubFetch(
      sse(
        'event: meta\ndata: {"meta":{}}\n\n' +
          'event: summary_delta\ndata: {"text":"a"}\n\n' +
          'event: done\ndata: {"result":{"summary":"a"}}\n\n' +
          'event: summary_delta\ndata: {"text":"after done"}\n\n',
      ),
    );
    const events = await collect(streamEvents("/api/summary/stream", { url: "https://x.test/a" }));
    expect(events.map((e) => e.type)).toEqual(["meta", "summary_delta", "done"]);

    const [url, init] = fetchMock.mock.calls[0];
    expect(String(url)).toMatch(/\/api\/summary\/stream$/);
    expect(init?.method).toBe("POST");
    expect(new Headers(init?.headers).get("Accept")).toBe("text/event-stream");
    expect(JSON.parse(String(init?.body))).toEqual({ url: "https://x.test/a" });
  });

  it("stops at an error event", async () => {
    stubFetch(sse('event: error\ndata: {"error":{"code":"inference_timeout","message":"slow"}}\n\n'));
    const events = await collect(streamEvents("/api/analyze/stream", {}));
    expect(events).toEqual([{ type: "error", data: { error: { code: "inference_timeout", message: "slow" } } }]);
  });

  it("throws when the stream closes without a terminal event", async () => {
    stubFetch(sse('event: meta\ndata: {"meta":{}}\n\n'));
    await expect(collect(streamEvents("/api/summary/stream", {}))).rejects.toMatchObject({
      code: "bad_response",
    });
  });

  it("throws the error envelope sent before the stream opens", async () => {
    stubFetch(
      Response.json(
        { error: { code: "paywalled", message: "Paywall", hint: "Try a free source", retryable: false } },
        { status: 422 },
      ),
    );
    await expect(collect(streamEvents("/api/summary/stream", {}))).rejects.toMatchObject({
      code: "paywalled",
      status: 422,
      hint: "Try a free source",
    });
  });
});
```

```typescript
        code: "source_blocked",
        message: "Blocked by Cloudflare",
        hint: "Try another source",
        retryable: false,
        upstream_status: 403,

      message: "Blocked by Cloudflare",
      hint: "Try another source",
      status: 502,
      retryable: false,
      upstreamStatus: 403,
    });

  it.each(ERROR_CODES)("keeps the %s code", (code) => {
    expect(errorFromPayload(400, { error: { code, message: "m" } }).code).toBe(code);
  });

  it("maps FastAPI validation detail to invalid_request", () => {
    const err = errorFromPayload(422, {
      detail: [{ loc: ["body", "url"], msg: "Input should be a valid URL", type: "url_parsing" }],
    });
    expect(err).toMatchObject({ code: "invalid_request", message: "url: Input should be a valid URL" });
  });

  it("falls back to http_error for unknown codes and junk", () => {
    expect(errorFromPayload(500, { error: { code: "nope", message: "x" } }).code).toBe("http_error");
    expect(errorFromPayload(503, null)).toMatchObject({ code: "http_error", retryable: true });
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { SignalCard, leaning } from "@/components/SignalCard";
import type { SignalResult } from "@/lib/api";

const decision: SignalResult = {
  sentiment: "bearish",
  abstained: false,
  policy: "probability",
  confidence: 0.71,
  probabilities: { bullish: 0.09, bearish: 0.71, neutral: 0.2 },
};

describe("SignalCard", () => {
  it("renders the badge, confidence, probabilities, policy and timing", () => {
    render(<SignalCard status="done" signal={decision} model="nimble:9b-q4_K_M" timeToSignalMs={412.4} />);
    const badge = screen.getByTestId("signal-badge");
    expect(badge).toHaveTextContent("Bearish");
    expect(badge).toHaveAttribute("data-sentiment", "bearish");
    expect(screen.queryByText("Abstained")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Confidence").nextSibling).toHaveTextContent("71.0%");
    expect(screen.getByText("probability")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("nimble:9b-q4_K_M")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Time to signal").nextSibling).toHaveTextContent("412 ms");

    const probs = within(screen.getByRole("list", { name: "Class probabilities" })).getAllByRole("listitem");
    expect(probs.map((li) => li.textContent)).toEqual(["Bullish9.0%", "Bearish71.0%", "Neutral20.0%"]);
  });

  it("explains an abstained call as below the confidence threshold", () => {
    const abstained: SignalResult = {
      sentiment: "neutral",
      abstained: true,
      policy: "probability",
      confidence: 0.44,
      probabilities: { bullish: 0.44, bearish: 0.2, neutral: 0.36 },

    expect(screen.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveTextContent("Neutral");

    expect(screen.getByText(/request failed/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    rerender(<SignalCard status="cancelled" signal={null} />);
    expect(screen.getByText("Cancelled.")).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

describe("leaning", () => {
  it("uses probabilities, then score sign, then the label", () => {
    expect(leaning(decision)).toBe("bearish");
    expect(leaning({ sentiment: "neutral", abstained: true, policy: "ordinal", score: -1 })).toBe("bearish");
    expect(leaning({ sentiment: "neutral", abstained: true, policy: "ordinal", score: 0 })).toBe("neutral");
```

```typescript
import { render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { LatencyBar, niceStep, stageSegments, type LatencyLane } from "@/components/LatencyBar";
import type { Timings } from "@/lib/api";

const base: Omit<Timings, "inference" | "total_ms"> = {
  fetch_ms: 200,
  parse_ms: 10,
  extract_ms: 5,
  cache: { fetch: "miss", result: "miss" },
};

const generative: Timings = {
  ...base,
  total_ms: 1900,
  inference: { wall_ms: 1680, ttft_ms: 400, load_ms: 20, prompt_eval_ms: 360, eval_ms: 1280 },
};

const decision: Timings = { ...base, total_ms: 560, inference: { wall_ms: 340 } };

describe("stageSegments", () => {
  it("lays stages end to end and fills the client remainder with other", () => {
    const segments = stageSegments(generative, 2000);
    expect(segments.map((s) => [s.key, s.startMs, s.ms])).toEqual([
      ["fetch", 0, 200],
      ["parse", 200, 10],
      ["extract", 210, 5],
      ["load", 215, 20],
      ["prompt", 235, 360],
      ["generation", 595, 1280],
      ["other", 1875, 125],
    ]);
  });

  it("uses one inference segment when only wall time is known", () => {
    const keys = stageSegments(decision, null).map((s) => s.key);
    expect(keys).toEqual(["fetch", "parse", "extract", "inference", "other"]);
  });

  it("skips zero stages and never emits a negative remainder", () => {
    const cached: Timings = { ...decision, fetch_ms: 0, total_ms: 300 };
    expect(stageSegments(cached, 100).map((s) => s.key)).toEqual(["parse", "extract", "inference"]);
  });
});

describe("niceStep", () => {
  it("rounds to 1, 2, 2.5 or 5 times a power of ten", () => {
    expect(niceStep(430)).toBe(500);
    expect(niceStep(180)).toBe(200);
    expect(niceStep(2400)).toBe(2500);
    expect(niceStep(7)).toBe(10);
  });
});

describe("LatencyBar", () => {
  const lanes: LatencyLane[] = [
    {
      id: "signal",
      label: "Signal",
      status: "done",
      timings: decision,
      endMs: 600,
      marks: [{ kind: "signal", label: "time to signal", atMs: 600 }],
    },
    {
      id: "summary",
      label: "Summary",
      status: "done",
      timings: generative,
      endMs: 2000,
      marks: [{ kind: "token", label: "time to first token", atMs: 650 }],
    },
  ];

  it("draws two lanes on one shared client time axis", () => {
    render(<LatencyBar lanes={lanes} />);
    expect(screen.getByTestId("lane-signal")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId("lane-summary")).toBeInTheDocument();
    // Axis spans the slowest lane (2000 ms), so the 600 ms signal lane ends at 30%.
    expect(screen.getByTestId("segment-signal-fetch")).toHaveStyle({ left: "0%", width: "10%" });
    expect(screen.getByTestId("mark-signal-signal")).toHaveStyle({ left: "30%" });
    expect(screen.getByTestId("segment-summary-generation")).toHaveStyle({ left: "29.75%", width: "64%" });
    expect(screen.getByTestId("mark-summary-token")).toHaveStyle({ left: "32.5%" });

  it("lists every value as text for screen readers", () => {
```

```typescript
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { ERROR_TITLES, ErrorBanner } from "@/components/ErrorBanner";
import { ApiError, ERROR_CODES, type ApiErrorCode } from "@/lib/api";

const ALL_CODES: ApiErrorCode[] = [
  ...ERROR_CODES,
  "network_error",
  "invalid_request",
  "http_error",
  "bad_response",
];

describe("ErrorBanner", () => {
  it("has a title for every server error code", () => {
    expect(ERROR_CODES.every((code) => ERROR_TITLES[code])).toBe(true);
  });

  it.each(ALL_CODES)("renders %s as an alert with title, code and message", (code) => {
    render(<ErrorBanner error={new ApiError({ code, message: `message for ${code}` })} />);
    const alert = screen.getByRole("alert");
    expect(alert).toHaveAttribute("data-code", code);
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent(ERROR_TITLES[code]);
    expect(screen.getByText(code, { selector: "code" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(`message for ${code}`)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("prefers the server hint and shows status details", () => {
    render(
      <ErrorBanner
        context="Signal and Summary"
        error={
          new ApiError({
            code: "source_blocked",
            message: "403 from the publisher",
            hint: "Use the press release instead.",
            status: 502,
            retryable: true,
            upstreamStatus: 403,
          })
        }
      />,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent("Signal and Summary: Blocked by the source");
    expect(screen.getByText("HTTP 502")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText("Use the press release instead.")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/Upstream status 403\. Retrying may help\./)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("falls back to a local hint when the server sent none", () => {
    render(<ErrorBanner error={{ code: "paywalled", message: "Subscriber-only article" }} />);
    expect(screen.getByText(/behind a paywall/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { articleMeta, distinctErrors, initialRunState, runReducer, type RunAction } from "@/lib/run-state";
import { articleMeta as metaFixture, bullishDecision, summaryResponse } from "@/mocks/fixtures";

const start: RunAction = { type: "start", runId: 1, mode: "split", streaming: true, lanes: ["signal", "summary"] };

function play(actions: RunAction[]) {
  return actions.reduce(runReducer, initialRunState);
}

describe("runReducer", () => {
  it("tracks deltas, first token and the authoritative final summary", () => {
    const done = summaryResponse();
    const state = play([
      start,
      { type: "meta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 50, meta: done.meta },
      { type: "delta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 300, text: "Acme " },
      { type: "delta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 340, text: "beat" },
      { type: "done", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 900, meta: done.meta, timings: done.timings, summary: "Final." },
    ]);
    const lane = state.lanes.find((l) => l.id === "summary");
    expect(lane).toMatchObject({ status: "done", firstTokenAtMs: 300, endAtMs: 900 });
    expect(state.summary).toBe("Final.");
    expect(state.running).toBe(true);
    expect(articleMeta(state)?.title).toBe(done.meta.title);
  });

  it("records time to signal from a JSON signal response and finishes the run", () => {
    const state = play([
      start,
      {
        type: "done",
        runId: 1,
        lane: "signal",
        atMs: 420,
        meta: metaFixture({ endpoint: "signal" }),
        timings: summaryResponse().timings,
        signal: bullishDecision,
      },
      { type: "error", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 500, error: new ApiError({ code: "llm_unreachable", message: "x" }) },
    ]);
    expect(state.signal).toEqual(bullishDecision);
    expect(state.lanes.find((l) => l.id === "signal")?.signalAtMs).toBe(420);
    expect(state.running).toBe(false);
  });

  it("ignores events from a superseded run", () => {
    const state = play([
      start,
      { ...start, runId: 2 },
      { type: "delta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 10, text: "stale" },
    ]);
    expect(state.summary).toBe("");
    expect(state.runId).toBe(2);
  });

  it("marks active lanes cancelled", () => {
    const state = play([start, { type: "cancel", runId: 1, atMs: 120 }]);
    expect(state.lanes.map((l) => l.status)).toEqual(["cancelled", "cancelled"]);
    expect(state.running).toBe(false);
  });

  it("merges identical failures across lanes", () => {
    const err = () => new ApiError({ code: "paywalled", message: "Paywall" });
    const state = play([
      start,
      { type: "error", runId: 1, lane: "signal", atMs: 1, error: err() },
      { type: "error", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 2, error: err() },
    ]);
    expect(distinctErrors(state).map((e) => e.lanes)).toEqual([["signal", "summary"]]);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import sample from "@/data/benchmarks.sample.json";
import { isBenchmarksV1, withinBudget, type LatencyBenchmark } from "@/lib/benchmarks";

const row = (overrides: Partial<LatencyBenchmark>): LatencyBenchmark => ({
  endpoint: "signal",
  model: "m",
  scope: "lede",
  streaming: false,
  backend: "native-metal",
  n: 30,
  p50Ms: 400,
  p95Ms: 600,
  ttftP50Ms: null,
  timeToSignalP50Ms: null,
  ...overrides,
});

describe("benchmarks", () => {
  it("accepts the committed sample and flags it as sample data", () => {
    expect(isBenchmarksV1(sample)).toBe(true);
    expect(sample.sample).toBe(true);
  });

  it("rejects other shapes", () => {
    expect(isBenchmarksV1({ generatedAt: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(isBenchmarksV1({ ...sample, version: 2 })).toBe(false);
    expect(isBenchmarksV1({ ...sample, signal: null })).toBe(false);
  });

  it("applies the latency budgets per endpoint", () => {
    expect(withinBudget(row({ p50Ms: 480 }))).toBe(true);
    expect(withinBudget(row({ p50Ms: 640 }))).toBe(false);
    expect(withinBudget(row({ scope: "full", p50Ms: 900 }))).toBeNull();
    expect(withinBudget(row({ endpoint: "summary", ttftP50Ms: 600, p50Ms: 3400 }))).toBe(true);
    expect(withinBudget(row({ endpoint: "analyze", ttftP50Ms: 2600, p50Ms: 3400 }))).toBe(false);
    expect(withinBudget(row({ endpoint: "analyze", ttftP50Ms: 600, p50Ms: 14800 }))).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { render, screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent, { type UserEvent } from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { http, HttpResponse } from "msw";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import { AnalyzeApp } from "@/components/AnalyzeApp";
import type { AnalyzeBody, SignalBody, SummaryBody } from "@/lib/api";
import { ENTITY, FIXTURE_URL, SUMMARY_CHUNKS, SUMMARY_TEXT, signalResponse } from "@/mocks/fixtures";
import { API, analyzeStreamChunks, errorResponse, summaryStreamChunks } from "@/mocks/handlers";
import { gate, sseResponse } from "@/mocks/sse";

import { setupMswServer } from "./msw";

const server = setupMswServer();

async function submit(user: UserEvent, url = FIXTURE_URL) {
  const input = screen.getByLabelText("Article URL");
  await user.clear(input);
  await user.click(input);
  await user.paste(url);
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^(Analyze|Restart)$/ }));
}

const optionLabels = (select: HTMLElement) =>
  within(select)
    .getAllByRole("option")
    .map((o) => o.textContent);

const tick = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));

describe("Analyze page", () => {
  it("populates the pickers from /api/models and sends the chosen options", async () => {
    const bodies: { signal?: SignalBody; summary?: SummaryBody } = {};
    server.use(
      http.post(`${API}/signal`, async ({ request }) => {
        bodies.signal = (await request.json()) as SignalBody;
        return HttpResponse.json(signalResponse(bodies.signal));
      }),
      http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, async ({ request }) => {
        bodies.summary = (await request.json()) as SummaryBody;
        return sseResponse(summaryStreamChunks(bodies.summary));
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);

    const signalSelect = screen.getByLabelText("Signal model");
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(optionLabels(signalSelect)).toEqual([
        "Server default (nimble:9b-q4_K_M)",
        "clef-flash:9b-q8_0",
        "nimble:9b-q4_K_M (default)",
        "tev1:0.8b-q8_0 (CI plumbing, unevaluated)",
        "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0",
      ]),
    );
    expect(optionLabels(screen.getByLabelText("Summary model"))).toEqual([
      "Server default (qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M)",
      "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0",
      "qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M",
      "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M (default)",
    ]);

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: /Combined/ }));
    const analyzeSelect = screen.getByLabelText("Analyze model");
    expect(optionLabels(analyzeSelect)).toContain("ministral-3:3b");
    expect(within(analyzeSelect).getByRole("option", { name: /qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M/ })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText("Signal scope")).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: /Split/ }));
    await user.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText("Signal model"), "clef-flash:9b-q8_0");
    await user.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText("Signal scope"), "full");
    await user.selectOptions(screen.getByLabelText("Extractor"), "trafilatura");
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Parser")).toBeDisabled();
    await submit(user);

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete"));
    expect(bodies.signal).toEqual({
      url: FIXTURE_URL,
      parser: "selectolax",
      extractor: "trafilatura",
      scope: "full",
      model: "clef-flash:9b-q8_0",
    });
    expect(bodies.summary).toEqual({ url: FIXTURE_URL, parser: "selectolax", extractor: "trafilatura" });
    expect(screen.getByText("clef-flash:9b-q8_0", { selector: "dd code" })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("split mode shows the signal before the summary stream completes", async () => {
    const hold = gate();
    server.use(
      http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, async ({ request }) => {
        const [meta, ping, first, ...rest] = summaryStreamChunks((await request.json()) as SummaryBody);
        return sseResponse(
          (async function* () {
            yield meta;
            yield ping;
            yield first;
            await hold.promise;
            yield* rest;
          })(),
        );
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    try {
      await submit(user);

      expect(await screen.findByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveTextContent("Bullish");
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text")).toHaveTextContent(SUMMARY_CHUNKS[0].trim()));
      expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Streaming...");
      expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text")).not.toHaveTextContent(SUMMARY_CHUNKS[2]);
      expect(screen.getByText("Acme Corp beats estimates and lifts full-year outlook")).toBeInTheDocument();

      hold.open();
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete"));
      expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text")).toHaveTextContent(SUMMARY_TEXT);

      const latency = within(screen.getByTestId("latency"));
      expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-signal")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-summary")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-signal-signal")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-summary-token")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(latency.getByTestId("segment-signal-inference")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(latency.getByTestId("segment-summary-generation")).toBeInTheDocument();
    } finally {
      hold.open();
    }
  });

  it("combined streaming renders sentiment, then summary deltas, then timings", async () => {
    const afterSentiment = gate();
    const afterDeltas = gate();
    server.use(
      http.post(`${API}/analyze/stream`, async ({ request }) => {
        const [meta, sentiment, ...rest] = analyzeStreamChunks((await request.json()) as AnalyzeBody);
        const done = rest.pop() as string;
        return sseResponse(
          (async function* () {
            yield meta;
            yield sentiment;
            await afterSentiment.promise;
            yield* rest;
            await afterDeltas.promise;
            yield done;
          })(),
        );
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    try {
      await user.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: /Combined/ }));
      await submit(user);

      expect(await screen.findByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveTextContent("Bullish");
      expect(screen.getByText(ENTITY)).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByText("Score").nextSibling).toHaveTextContent("+2");
      expect(screen.queryByTestId("summary-text")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByTestId("mark-analyze-signal")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByText("server total")).not.toBeInTheDocument();

      afterSentiment.open();
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text")).toHaveTextContent(SUMMARY_TEXT));
      expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Streaming...");
      expect(screen.getByTestId("mark-analyze-token")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByText("server total")).not.toBeInTheDocument();

      afterDeltas.open();
      expect(await screen.findByText("server total")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete");
      expect(screen.getByTestId("segment-analyze-prompt")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.getByTestId("segment-analyze-generation")).toBeInTheDocument();
    } finally {
      afterSentiment.open();
      afterDeltas.open();
    }
  });

  it("uses the JSON endpoints when streaming is off", async () => {
    const streamed = vi.fn();
    server.use(
      http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, () => {
        streamed();
        return HttpResponse.error();
      }),
      http.post(`${API}/analyze/stream`, () => {
        streamed();
        return HttpResponse.error();
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Streaming/ }));

    await submit(user);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete"));
    expect(screen.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveTextContent("Bullish");
    expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text")).toHaveTextContent(SUMMARY_TEXT);
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("mark-summary-token")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId("segment-summary-generation")).toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: /Combined/ }));
    await submit(user);
    expect(await screen.findByText(ENTITY)).toBeInTheDocument();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete"));
    expect(screen.getByTestId("lane-analyze")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(streamed).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("shows one error banner with code and hint when both requests hit a paywall", async () => {
    const paywalled = () =>
      errorResponse(422, {
        code: "paywalled",
        message: "The article is for subscribers only.",
        hint: "Try the company press release instead.",
        retryable: false,
        upstream_status: null,
      });
    server.use(http.post(`${API}/signal`, paywalled), http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, paywalled));
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    await submit(user);

    const alert = await screen.findByRole("alert");
    await waitFor(() => expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("Signal and Summary"));
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("Paywalled article");
    expect(within(alert).getByText("paywalled")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("HTTP 422");
    expect(alert).toHaveTextContent("Try the company press release instead.");
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("alert")).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(screen.getByText(/No signal: the request failed/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Failed");
  });

  it("aborts the previous run on resubmit and on cancel", async () => {
    const hold = gate();
    let calls = 0;
    server.use(
      http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, async ({ request }) => {
        calls += 1;
        const chunks = summaryStreamChunks((await request.json()) as SummaryBody);
        if (calls > 1) return sseResponse(chunks);
        return sseResponse(
          (async function* () {
            yield chunks[0];
            yield chunks[2];
            await hold.promise;
            yield* chunks.slice(3);
          })(),
        );
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    try {
      await submit(user);
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text")).toHaveTextContent(SUMMARY_CHUNKS[0].trim()));

      await submit(user);
      await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete"));
      hold.open();
      await tick();
      expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text").textContent).toBe(SUMMARY_TEXT);
      expect(calls).toBe(2);
    } finally {
      hold.open();
    }

    const stuck = gate();
    server.use(
      http.post(`${API}/signal`, async () => {
        await stuck.promise;
        return HttpResponse.json(signalResponse());
      }),
    );
    try {
      await submit(user);
      await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));
      expect(screen.getByText("Cancelled.")).toBeInTheDocument();
      stuck.open();
      await tick();
      expect(screen.queryByTestId("signal-badge")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    } finally {
      stuck.open();
    }
  });

  it("rejects a non-http URL without calling the API", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    await submit(user, "ftp://example.com/file");
    expect(screen.getByText(/Enter a full http\(s\) URL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Article URL")).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("summary-status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";

import BenchmarksPage from "@/app/benchmarks/page";
import { BenchmarksView } from "@/components/benchmarks/BenchmarksView";
import sample from "@/data/benchmarks.sample.json";
import { isBenchmarksV1, type BenchmarksV1 } from "@/lib/benchmarks";

// Pin the page to the committed sample even after real eval results are copied in.
vi.mock("@/data/benchmarks.json", async () => ({
  default: (await import("@/data/benchmarks.sample.json")).default,
}));

function sampleData(): BenchmarksV1 {
  if (!isBenchmarksV1(sample)) throw new Error("benchmarks.sample.json does not match BenchmarksV1");
  return sample;
}

describe("Benchmarks page", () => {
  it("renders the sample with a visible sample-data banner and every table", () => {
    render(<BenchmarksPage />);
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Benchmarks" })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId("sample-banner")).toHaveTextContent("Sample data.");

    for (const name of [
      "Selected models",
      "Signal accuracy",
      "Latency",
      "Summary quality",
      "Extraction matrix",
      "Article set",
    ]) {
      expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name })).toBeInTheDocument();
    }

    const data = sampleData();
    const signal = screen.getByRole("table", { name: /Signal accuracy by model/ });
    expect(within(signal).getAllByRole("row")).toHaveLength(data.signal.length + 1);
    const latency = screen.getByRole("table", { name: /Latency by endpoint/ });
    expect(within(latency).getAllByRole("row")).toHaveLength(data.latency.length + 1);
    expect(within(latency).getAllByText("over").length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const extraction = screen.getByRole("table", { name: /Extraction speed and quality/ });
    expect(within(extraction).getAllByRole("row")).toHaveLength(data.extraction.length + 1);
    const articles = screen.getByRole("table", { name: /Articles per source/ });
    expect(within(articles).getByText("Yahoo Finance")).toBeInTheDocument();

    const picks = screen.getByRole("heading", { name: "Selected models" }).parentElement as HTMLElement;
    expect(within(picks).getByText("/api/signal")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(within(picks).getByText(data.selection.signal.reason)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("hides the banner for measured results", () => {
    render(<BenchmarksView data={{ ...sampleData(), sample: false, generatedAt: "2026-10-20T10:00:00Z" }} />);
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("sample-banner")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/generated 2026-10-20T10:00:00Z/)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

```typescript
const CI = Boolean(process.env.CI);

// Runs against an already-running stack (docker compose serves the export and the API on one origin).
export default defineConfig({
  testDir: "./e2e",
  // One Ollama instance: parallel inference would only measure contention.
  fullyParallel: false,
  workers: 1,
  forbidOnly: CI,
  retries: CI ? 1 : 0,
  // CPU-only inference on CI runners is slow; assertions wait on results, not on fixed sleeps.
```

```typescript
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

// The fixture site serves skeleton articles; models stay at server defaults unless overridden.
const ARTICLE_URL = process.env.E2E_ARTICLE_URL ?? "";
const SIGNAL_MODEL = process.env.E2E_SIGNAL_MODEL ?? "";
const SUMMARY_MODEL = process.env.E2E_SUMMARY_MODEL ?? "";
const ANALYZE_MODEL = process.env.E2E_ANALYZE_MODEL ?? "";
const EXTRACTOR = process.env.E2E_EXTRACTOR ?? "trafilatura";

// Model-agnostic: any valid label passes, the point is the plumbing.
const SENTIMENT = /^(Bullish|Bearish|Neutral)$/;

async function open(page: Page, mode: "Split" | "Combined", streaming = true) {
  await page.goto("/");
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeVisible();
  // Pickers fill from /api/models; waiting here keeps selectOption from racing the fetch.
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Signal model")).toContainText("default");
  await page.getByRole("radio", { name: new RegExp(mode) }).check();
  const toggle = page.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Streaming/ });
  if (streaming) await toggle.check();
  else await toggle.uncheck();
}

async function pick(page: Page, label: string, value: string) {
  if (value) await page.getByLabel(label).selectOption(value);
}

async function analyze(page: Page) {
  await page.getByLabel("Article URL").fill(ARTICLE_URL);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Analyze" }).click();
}

test.describe("analyze page", () => {
  test.skip(!ARTICLE_URL, "set E2E_ARTICLE_URL to an article the stack can fetch");

  test("split mode shows the signal, a streamed summary and timings", async ({ page }) => {
    await open(page, "Split");
    await pick(page, "Signal model", SIGNAL_MODEL);
    await pick(page, "Summary model", SUMMARY_MODEL);
    await analyze(page);

    await expect(page.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveText(SENTIMENT);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveText("Complete");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-text")).not.toBeEmpty();
    await expect(page.getByRole("alert")).toHaveCount(0);

    const latency = page.getByTestId("latency");
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-signal")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-summary")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-signal-signal")).toBeAttached();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-summary-token")).toBeAttached();
    await expect(latency.getByText("server total")).toHaveCount(2);
  });

  test("combined streaming delivers sentiment, summary and timings in one call", async ({ page }) => {
    await open(page, "Combined");
    await pick(page, "Analyze model", ANALYZE_MODEL);
    await analyze(page);

    await expect(page.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveText(SENTIMENT);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveText("Complete");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-text")).not.toBeEmpty();
    const latency = page.getByTestId("latency");
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-analyze")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-analyze-signal")).toBeAttached();
    await expect(latency.getByText("server total")).toHaveCount(1);
  });

  test("switching the extractor is reflected in the article metadata", async ({ page }) => {
    await open(page, "Split", false);
    await pick(page, "Signal model", SIGNAL_MODEL);
    await pick(page, "Summary model", SUMMARY_MODEL);
    await page.getByLabel("Extractor").selectOption(EXTRACTOR);
    await expect(page.getByLabel("Parser")).toBeDisabled();
    await analyze(page);

    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveText("Complete");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("article-extraction")).toContainText(EXTRACTOR);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveText(SENTIMENT);
  });
});

```

````markdown
# Frontend

Next.js 16 (App Router, strict TypeScript, CSS modules) built as a **static export**. In production FastAPI
serves `out/` from the same origin as `/api`, so no Node process runs and the browser talks to the API with no
proxy hop.

## Pages

- `/` (Analyze): URL input, Split vs Combined mode, streaming on/off, model, parser, extractor and scope pickers
  filled from `GET /api/models`. Split mode fires `/api/signal` and `/api/summary/stream` together so the
  signal card renders as soon as it lands; Combined mode calls `/api/analyze` (or `/api/analyze/stream`). The
  latency bar puts the server stage timings of each request on one client time axis (`performance.now()`
  from submit), with time-to-signal and time-to-first-token marks. Resubmitting aborts the in-flight run.
- `/benchmarks/`: renders `src/data/benchmarks.json`, which `scripts/copy-benchmarks.mjs` copies from
  `evals/results/benchmarks.json`, falling back to the committed `benchmarks.sample.json` (shown with a
  "sample data" banner).

## Layout

| Path | Role |
|---|---|
| `src/lib/api.ts` | Typed fetch helpers over the generated `api-schema.d.ts`; error envelope to `ApiError` |
| `src/lib/sse.ts` | POST + `TextDecoderStream` SSE parser yielding typed `meta` / `sentiment` / `summary_delta` / `done` / `error` events |
| `src/lib/run-state.ts`, `src/hooks/` | Run reducer (per-lane status and client timing marks) and the hooks that drive it |
| `src/components/` | `AnalyzeForm`, `SignalCard`, `SummaryPanel`, `ArticleMetaLine`, `LatencyBar`, `ErrorBanner`, benchmark tables |
| `src/mocks/` | MSW handlers and synthetic fixtures, shared by tests and any mocked dev run |
| `tests/unit`, `tests/integration` | Vitest + Testing Library; integration tests run the real components against MSW |
| `e2e/` | Playwright specs for the docker compose stack |

## Commands

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev            # http://localhost:3000; set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE=http://localhost:8000 for a local API
pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck
pnpm test           # unit + MSW integration tests, no backend needed
pnpm build          # static export to out/
pnpm gen:api        # regenerate src/lib/api-schema.d.ts from backend/openapi.json
E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000 E2E_ARTICLE_URL=... pnpm e2e   # against a running stack
```

`NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE` is inlined at build time; leave it unset for the production build so requests stay
same-origin. In development the backend must allow the dev origin through `VT_CORS_ORIGINS`.

````
