```python
    vtx: int = 0
    vtx_seen: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def words(self, count: int, *, end: str = "") -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        sentence = 0
        for _ in range(max(count, 1)):
            word = self.rng.choice(VOCABULARY)
            if sentence == 0:
                word = word.capitalize()
            sentence += 1
            if sentence >= self.rng.randint(9, 17):
                word += "."
                sentence = 0
            elif self.rng.random() < 0.08:
                word += ","
            out.append(word)
        text = " ".join(out).rstrip(".,")
        return text + end

    def text(self, original: str, marker: str | None) -> str:
        lead, core, trail = _WS_EDGES.match(original).groups()  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        count = len(core.split())
        end = "." if core[-1] in ".!?" else ":" if core[-1] == ":" else ""
        body = self.words(count, end=end)
        if marker:
            rest = body.split(" ", 1)
            body = marker if len(rest) == 1 else f"{marker} {rest[1]}"
            if count == 1 and end:
                body += end
        return f"{lead}{body}{trail}"

    def next_vtb(self) -> str:
        self.vtb += 1
        return f"VTB-{self.vtb}"

    def next_vtx(self) -> str:
        self.vtx += 1
        marker = f"VTX-{self.vtx}"
        self.vtx_seen.append(marker)
        return marker


@dataclass
class Plan:
    keep: dict[str, int]  # data-vtk -> order among kept body paragraphs
    stops: dict[str, str]  # data-vtk -> stop marker phrase
    boilerplate: dict[str, str]  # data-vtk -> boilerplate phrase
    dropped: set[str]
    title_key: str | None


def plan_body(annotated: str, profile: Profile) -> Plan:
    """Replay the profile strategy on the annotated page so the skeleton matches what it keeps."""
    dom = parse(annotated, "lxml")
    nodes = profiles.select_body(dom, profile)
    texts = [node.text() for node in nodes]
    keep: dict[str, int] = {}
    stops: dict[str, str] = {}
    boilerplate: dict[str, str] = {}
    for node, verdict in zip(nodes, profiles.triage(texts, profile), strict=True):
        key = node.attr(KEY_ATTR) or ""
        if verdict.fate is Fate.KEEP:
            keep[key] = len(keep)
        elif verdict.fate is Fate.STOP and verdict.phrase:
            stops[key] = verdict.phrase
        elif verdict.fate is Fate.BOILERPLATE and verdict.phrase:
            boilerplate[key] = verdict.phrase
    fresh = parse(annotated, "lxml")
    dropped = {node.attr(KEY_ATTR) or "" for css in profile.drop for node in fresh.select(css)}
    title_key = None
    if profile.title:
        title_key = next((n.attr(KEY_ATTR) for n in parse(annotated, "lxml").select(profile.title)), None)
    return Plan(keep, stops, boilerplate, dropped, title_key)


@dataclass
class Walker:
    synth: Synth
    plan: Plan
    body_seen: dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=dict)
    title_marker: str | None = None

    def run(self, root: Any) -> None:
        self._walk(root, kept=None, dropped=False, special=None, in_title=False)

    def _text(self, text: str | None, kept: str | None, dropped: bool, special: list[str] | None) -> str | None:
        if not text or not _ALNUM.search(text):
            return text
        if special is not None:
            # First text of a stop/boilerplate paragraph carries the phrase so the rules fire again.
            if special:
                phrase = special.pop()
                lead = _WS_EDGES.match(text).group(1)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                filler = self.synth.text(" ".join(text.split()[1:]) or "x", self.synth.next_vtx())
                return f"{lead}{phrase.rstrip()} {filler.strip()} "
            return " "
        if kept is not None and not dropped:
            marker = None
            if not self.body_seen.get(kept):
                self.body_seen[kept] = True
                marker = self.synth.next_vtb()
            return self.synth.text(text, marker)
        return self.synth.text(text, self.synth.next_vtx())

    def _walk(self, el: Any, kept: str | None, dropped: bool, special: list[str] | None, in_title: bool) -> None:
        key = el.get(KEY_ATTR)
        dropped = dropped or key in self.plan.dropped
        if key in self.plan.keep and kept is None:
            kept = key
        if key in self.plan.stops:
            special = [self.plan.stops[key]]
        elif key in self.plan.boilerplate:
            special = [self.plan.boilerplate[key].capitalize()]
        in_title = in_title or (key is not None and key == self.plan.title_key)
        before = self.synth.vtx
        el.text = self._text(el.text, kept, dropped, special)
        if in_title and self.title_marker is None and self.synth.vtx > before:
            self.title_marker = f"VTX-{self.synth.vtx}"
        for child in list(el):
            if not isinstance(child.tag, str):
                _remove_keep_tail(child)
                continue
            if child.tag in SKIP_CONTENT:
                _empty(child)
            else:
                self._walk(child, kept, dropped, special, in_title)
            before = self.synth.vtx
            child.tail = self._text(child.tail, kept, dropped, special)
            if in_title and self.title_marker is None and self.synth.vtx > before:
                self.title_marker = f"VTX-{self.synth.vtx}"


def _remove_keep_tail(node: Any) -> None:
    parent = node.getparent()
    if parent is None:
        return
    tail = node.tail
    previous = node.getprevious()
    parent.remove(node)
    if tail:
        if previous is not None:
            previous.tail = (previous.tail or "") + tail
        else:
            parent.text = (parent.text or "") + tail


def _empty(el: Any) -> None:
    if el.tag == "script" and "ld+json" in (el.get("type") or ""):
        return
    el.text = None
    for child in list(el):
        el.remove(child)


def _url_like(value: str) -> bool:
    return bool(_URL_LIKE.search(value.strip()))


def scrub_attributes(root: Any, synth: Synth, profile_ids: set[str]) -> None:
    slug_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
    for el in root.iter():
        if not isinstance(el.tag, str):
            continue
        meta_key = (el.get("property") or el.get("name") or "").lower() if el.tag == "meta" else ""
        for name, value in list(el.attrib.items()):
            lname = name.lower()
            if lname in DROP_ATTRS or lname.startswith("on") or lname == KEY_ATTR:
                del el.attrib[name]
            elif lname == "content" and el.tag == "meta":
                el.set(name, _meta_content(meta_key, value, el, synth))
            elif lname in URL_ATTRS or (lname.startswith("data-") and _url_like(value)):
                el.set(name, f"{INVALID_URL} 1x" if "srcset" in lname else INVALID_URL)
            elif lname in TEXT_ATTRS:
                if _ALNUM.search(value):
                    el.set(name, synth.words(len(value.split())))
            elif lname == "id":
                if value not in profile_ids and not (_STABLE_ID.match(value) and value.count("-") <= 2):
                    el.set(name, slug_ids.setdefault(value, f"vt-id-{len(slug_ids) + 1}"))
            elif lname in ("class", "datetime", "type", "rel", "lang", "dir", "role") or _identifier(value):
                continue
            elif _url_like(value):
                el.set(name, INVALID_URL)
            else:
                el.set(name, synth.words(min(len(value.split()), 12)) if _ALNUM.search(value) else value)


def _identifier(value: str) -> bool:
    return len(value) <= 64 and not any(c.isspace() for c in value) and not _url_like(value)


def _meta_content(key: str, value: str, el: Any, synth: Synth) -> str:
    if (el.get("http-equiv") or "").lower() == "refresh":
        return "0"
    if key in STRUCTURAL_METAS or _ISO_DATE.match(value.strip()) or not _ALNUM.search(value):
        return value
    if _url_like(value):
        return INVALID_URL
    if key in TITLE_METAS:
        return "{title}"  # filled once the title text is known
    return synth.words(min(len(value.split()), 30))


# --- JSON-LD ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def synth_jsonld(value: Any, synth: Synth, title: str, body: str, *, article: bool = False) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [synth_jsonld(v, synth, title, body, article=article) for v in value]
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    is_article = bool(jsonld.types_of(value) & jsonld.ARTICLE_TYPES)
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, item in value.items():
        if key in JSONLD_KEEP_KEYS:
            out[key] = item
        elif key == "articleBody" and isinstance(item, str):
            out[key] = body
        elif key in ("headline", "alternativeHeadline") or (key == "name" and is_article):
            out[key] = title if isinstance(item, str) else synth_jsonld(item, synth, title, body)
        elif isinstance(item, str):
            out[key] = _jsonld_string(key, item, synth)
        else:
            out[key] = synth_jsonld(item, synth, title, body, article=is_article)
    return out


def _jsonld_string(key: str, value: str, synth: Synth) -> str:
    if key == "@id" or _url_like(value):
        return INVALID_URL
    if _ISO_DATE.match(value.strip()) or not _ALNUM.search(value):
        return value
    return synth.text(normalize(value), synth.next_vtx())


def rewrite_jsonld(root: Any, synth: Synth, title: str, body_paragraphs: list[str]) -> bool:
    had_body = False
    for script in root.iter("script"):
        if "ld+json" not in (script.get("type") or ""):
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(script.text or "", strict=False)
        except ValueError:
            script.text = None
            continue
        original_body = jsonld.article_body([data])
        had_body = had_body or bool(original_body)
        joiner = "\n\n" if "\n" in original_body else " "
        script.text = json.dumps(
            synth_jsonld(data, synth, title, joiner.join(body_paragraphs)), ensure_ascii=False
        ).replace("</", "<\\/")
    return had_body


# --- driver -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def capture(key: str, pick: int, probe: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    profile = profiles.profile_for(key)
    source = profiles.sources()[key]
    if profile is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"{key}: no [sources.{key}.profile] in sources.toml")
    articles = {a["n"]: a for a in probe["sources"][key]["articles"]}
    url = articles[pick]["fetch"]["final_url"]
    html = (PROBE_DIR / key / f"{pick}.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

    root = lxml.html.document_fromstring(strip_xml_declaration(html))
    for index, el in enumerate(e for e in root.iter() if isinstance(e.tag, str)):
        el.set(KEY_ATTR, str(index))
    annotated = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    plan = plan_body(annotated, profile)

    synth = Synth(random.Random(f"veritrade-skeleton-{key}"))
    walker = Walker(synth, plan)
    walker.run(root)

    title_el = next((e for e in root.iter() if e.get(KEY_ATTR) == plan.title_key), None) if plan.title_key else None
    head_title = root.find(".//title")
    if title_el is None and head_title is not None and _ALNUM.search(head_title.text or ""):
        title_el = head_title
        walker.title_marker = (re.search(r"VTX-\d+", head_title.text or "") or [None])[0]  # type: ignore[index]
    title = normalize(title_el.text_content()) if title_el is not None else ""
    if head_title is not None and title:
        head_title.text = title

    slug = f"article-{pick}"
    fixture_url = f"https://{source.domains[0]}/vt-skeleton/{slug}"
    skeleton = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    paragraphs = profiles.extract(parse(skeleton, "lxml"), fixture_url, key)
    profile_ids = {m.group(1) for css in (profile.body, *profile.drop, profile.title or "") for m in re.finditer(r"#([\w-]+)", css)}
    scrub_attributes(root, synth, profile_ids)
    had_body = rewrite_jsonld(root, synth, title, paragraphs)
    for meta in root.iter("meta"):
        if meta.get("content") == "{title}":
            meta.set("content", title)

    out = OUT_DIR / key
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    document = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode", doctype="<!DOCTYPE html>")
    (out / f"{slug}.html").write_text(document + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    expected = {
        "source": key,
        "slug": slug,
        "captured_at": probe.get("generated_at"),
        "url_sha256": hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "fixture_url": fixture_url,
        "title_marker": walker.title_marker,
        "body_markers": [f"VTB-{k}" for k in range(1, synth.vtb + 1)],
        "jsonld_body": had_body,
        "stop_marker": next(iter(plan.stops.values()), None),
        "bytes": len(document.encode()),
    }
    (out / f"{slug}.expected.json").write_text(json.dumps(expected, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return expected


def write_vocabulary() -> None:
    phrases = sorted(
        {m for s in profiles.sources().values() if s.profile for m in s.profile.stop_markers}
        | set(GENERIC_STOPS)
        | {line.capitalize() for line in BOILERPLATE_LINES}
    )
    payload = {"words": list(VOCABULARY), "phrases": phrases, "url": INVALID_URL, "jsonld_keep_keys": sorted(JSONLD_KEEP_KEYS)}
    (OUT_DIR / "vocabulary.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    parser.add_argument("--source", action="append", help="source key (repeatable); default: primary + backup")
    parser.add_argument("--pick", action="append", default=[], help="KEY=N: use probe capture N for KEY")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    probe = json.loads(PROBE_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    picks = {k: int(v) for k, v in (p.split("=", 1) for p in args.pick)}
    keys = args.source or [k for k, s in profiles.sources().items() if s.status in ("primary", "backup")]
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write_vocabulary()
    for key in keys:
        if not (PROBE_DIR / key).exists():
            print(f"{key}: no probe captures under {PROBE_DIR / key}; run scripts/probe_sources.py", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        expected = capture(key, picks.get(key, 1), probe)
        print(
            f"{key}: {len(expected['body_markers'])} body paragraphs, title {expected['title_marker']}, "
            f"jsonld_body={expected['jsonld_body']}, {expected['bytes'] // 1024} KB"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
@dataclass
class Walker:
    synth: Synth
    plan: Plan
    body_seen: dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=dict)
    title_marker: str | None = None

    def run(self, root: Any) -> None:
        self._walk(root, kept=None, dropped=False, special=None, in_title=False)

    def _text(
        self, text: str | None, kept: str | None, dropped: bool, special: list[Any] | None
    ) -> str | None:
        if not text or not _ALNUM.search(text):
            return text
        if special is not None:
            # The first text of a stop or boilerplate paragraph carries the phrase so the rules fire again.
            if not special:
                return " "
            phrase, filler = special.pop()
            lead = _WS_EDGES.match(text).group(1)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            if not filler:
                return f"{lead}{phrase} "
            rest = self.synth.text(" ".join(text.split()[1:]) or "x", self.synth.next_vtx())
            return f"{lead}{phrase.rstrip()} {rest.strip()} "
        if kept is not None and not dropped:
            marker = None
            if not self.body_seen.get(kept):
                self.body_seen[kept] = True
                marker = self.synth.next_vtb()
            return self.synth.text(text, marker)
        return self.synth.text(text, self.synth.next_vtx())

    def _walk(
        self, el: Any, kept: str | None, dropped: bool, special: list[Any] | None, in_title: bool
    ) -> None:
        key = el.get(KEY_ATTR)
        dropped = dropped or key in self.plan.dropped
        if key in self.plan.keep and kept is None:
            kept = key
        if key in self.plan.special:
            special = [self.plan.special[key]]
        in_title = in_title or (key is not None and key == self.plan.title_key)
        before = self.synth.vtx
        el.text = self._text(el.text, kept, dropped, special)
        if in_title and self.title_marker is None and self.synth.vtx > before:
            self.title_marker = f"VTX-{self.synth.vtx}"
        for child in list(el):
            if not isinstance(child.tag, str):
                _remove_keep_tail(child)
                continue
            if child.tag in SKIP_CONTENT:
                _empty(child)
            else:
                self._walk(child, kept, dropped, special, in_title)
            before = self.synth.vtx
            child.tail = self._text(child.tail, kept, dropped, special)
            if in_title and self.title_marker is None and self.synth.vtx > before:
                self.title_marker = f"VTX-{self.synth.vtx}"


def _remove_keep_tail(node: Any) -> None:
    parent = node.getparent()
    if parent is None:
        return
    tail = node.tail
    previous = node.getprevious()
    parent.remove(node)
    if tail:
        if previous is not None:
            previous.tail = (previous.tail or "") + tail
        else:
            parent.text = (parent.text or "") + tail


def _empty(el: Any) -> None:
    if el.tag == "script" and "ld+json" in (el.get("type") or ""):
        return
    el.text = None
    for child in list(el):
        el.remove(child)


def _url_like(value: str) -> bool:
    return bool(_URL_LIKE.search(value.strip()))


def scrub_attributes(root: Any, synth: Synth, profile_ids: set[str]) -> None:
    slug_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
    for el in root.iter():
        if not isinstance(el.tag, str):
            continue
        meta_key = (el.get("property") or el.get("name") or "").lower() if el.tag == "meta" else ""
        for name, value in list(el.attrib.items()):
            lname = name.lower()
            if lname in DROP_ATTRS or lname.startswith("on") or lname == KEY_ATTR:
                del el.attrib[name]
            elif lname == "content" and el.tag == "meta":
                el.set(name, _meta_content(meta_key, value, el, synth))
            elif lname in URL_ATTRS or (lname.startswith("data-") and _url_like(value)):
                el.set(name, f"{INVALID_URL} 1x" if "srcset" in lname else INVALID_URL)
            elif lname in TEXT_ATTRS:
                if _ALNUM.search(value):
                    el.set(name, synth.words(len(value.split())))
            elif lname == "id":
                if value not in profile_ids and not (_STABLE_ID.match(value) and value.count("-") <= 2):
                    el.set(name, slug_ids.setdefault(value, f"vt-id-{len(slug_ids) + 1}"))
            elif lname in ("class", "datetime", "type", "rel", "lang", "dir", "role") or _identifier(value):
                continue
            elif _url_like(value):
                el.set(name, INVALID_URL)
            else:
                el.set(name, synth.words(min(len(value.split()), 12)) if _ALNUM.search(value) else value)


def _identifier(value: str) -> bool:
    return len(value) <= 64 and not any(c.isspace() for c in value) and not _url_like(value)


def _meta_content(key: str, value: str, el: Any, synth: Synth) -> str:
    if (el.get("http-equiv") or "").lower() == "refresh":
        return "0"
    if key in STRUCTURAL_METAS or _ISO_DATE.match(value.strip()) or not _ALNUM.search(value):
        return value
    if _url_like(value):
        return INVALID_URL
    if key in TITLE_METAS:
        return "{title}"  # filled once the title text is known
    return synth.words(min(len(value.split()), 30))


# --- JSON-LD ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def synth_jsonld(value: Any, synth: Synth, title: str, body: str) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [synth_jsonld(v, synth, title, body) for v in value]
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    is_article = bool(jsonld.types_of(value) & jsonld.ARTICLE_TYPES)
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, item in value.items():
        if key in JSONLD_KEEP_KEYS:
            out[key] = item
        elif key == "articleBody" and isinstance(item, str):
            out[key] = body
        elif key in ("headline", "alternativeHeadline") or (key == "name" and is_article):
            out[key] = title if isinstance(item, str) else synth_jsonld(item, synth, title, body)
        elif isinstance(item, str):
            out[key] = _jsonld_string(key, item, synth)
        else:
            out[key] = synth_jsonld(item, synth, title, body)
    return out


def _jsonld_string(key: str, value: str, synth: Synth) -> str:
    if key == "@id" or _url_like(value):
        return INVALID_URL
    if _ISO_DATE.match(value.strip()) or not _ALNUM.search(value):
        return value
    return synth.text(normalize(value), synth.next_vtx())


def rewrite_jsonld(root: Any, synth: Synth, title: str, body_paragraphs: list[str]) -> bool:
    had_body = False
    for script in root.iter("script"):
        if "ld+json" not in (script.get("type") or ""):
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(script.text or "", strict=False)
        except ValueError:
            script.text = None
            continue
        original_body = jsonld.article_body([data])
        had_body = had_body or bool(original_body)
        joiner = "\n\n" if "\n" in original_body else " "
        script.text = json.dumps(
            synth_jsonld(data, synth, title, joiner.join(body_paragraphs)), ensure_ascii=False
        ).replace("</", "<\\/")
    return had_body


# --- driver -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def capture(key: str, pick: int, probe: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    profile = profiles.profile_for(key)
    source = profiles.sources()[key]
    if profile is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"{key}: no [sources.{key}.profile] in sources.toml")
    articles = {a["n"]: a for a in probe["sources"][key]["articles"]}
    url = articles[pick]["fetch"]["final_url"]
    html = (PROBE_DIR / key / f"{pick}.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

    root = lxml.html.document_fromstring(strip_xml_declaration(html))
    for index, el in enumerate(e for e in root.iter() if isinstance(e.tag, str)):
        el.set(KEY_ATTR, str(index))
    annotated = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    plan = plan_body(annotated, profile)

    synth = Synth(random.Random(f"veritrade-skeleton-{key}"))
    walker = Walker(synth, plan)
    walker.run(root)

    slug = f"article-{pick}"
    fixture_url = f"https://{source.domains[0]}/vt-skeleton/{slug}"
    skeleton = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    paragraphs = profiles.extract(parse(skeleton, "lxml"), fixture_url, key)
    # The title as the registry reads it; pages without a profile title fall back to <title>.
    titled = parse(skeleton, "lxml").select(profile.title) if profile.title else []
    head_title = root.find(".//title")
    title = titled[0].text() if titled else ""
    if not title and head_title is not None:
        title = normalize(head_title.text or "")

    if head_title is not None and title:
        head_title.text = title
    selectors = (profile.body, *profile.drop, profile.title or "")
    profile_ids = {m.group(1) for css in selectors for m in re.finditer(r"#([\w-]+)", css)}
    scrub_attributes(root, synth, profile_ids)
    had_body = rewrite_jsonld(root, synth, title, paragraphs)
    for meta in root.iter("meta"):
        if meta.get("content") == "{title}":
            meta.set("content", title)

    out = OUT_DIR / key
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    document = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode", doctype="<!DOCTYPE html>")
    (out / f"{slug}.html").write_text(document + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    expected = {
        "source": key,
        "slug": slug,
        "captured_at": probe.get("generated_at"),

        "fixture_url": fixture_url,
        "title_marker": walker.title_marker,
        "body_markers": [f"VTB-{k}" for k in range(1, synth.vtb + 1)],
        "jsonld_body": had_body,
        "stop_marker": next((p for p, filler in plan.special.values() if filler), None),
        "bytes": len(document.encode()),
    }
    (out / f"{slug}.expected.json").write_text(json.dumps(expected, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return expected
```

```python
"""Skeleton fixtures: real publisher DOM structure, synthetic text (written by scripts/capture_skeletons.py)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from functools import cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

SKELETONS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "fixtures" / "skeletons"
BODY_MARKER = re.compile(r"VTB-\d+")
OTHER_MARKER = re.compile(r"VTX-\d+")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Skeleton:
    source: str
    html: str
    expected: dict[str, Any]

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return str(self.expected["fixture_url"])

    @property
    def body_markers(self) -> list[str]:
        return list(self.expected["body_markers"])

    def recall(self, text: str) -> float:
        found = set(BODY_MARKER.findall(text))
        return len(found & set(self.body_markers)) / len(self.body_markers)


@cache
def skeletons() -> tuple[Skeleton, ...]:
    out = []
    for expected_path in sorted(SKELETONS.glob("*/*.expected.json")):
        expected = json.loads(expected_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        html = expected_path.with_name(f"{expected['slug']}.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        out.append(Skeleton(expected["source"], html, expected))
    return tuple(out)


@cache
def vocabulary() -> dict[str, Any]:
    data: dict[str, Any] = json.loads((SKELETONS / "vocabulary.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return data

```

```python
"""Every extractor on every skeleton: body-marker recall and leakage of non-body text."""

from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade.extract import third_party
from veritrade.extract.registry import extract
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSERS, ExtractorName, ParserName

from ._skeletons import OTHER_MARKER, Skeleton, skeletons

SKELETONS = skeletons()
OWN_EXACT: tuple[ExtractorName, ...] = ("jsonld", "profile", "cascade")
THIRD_PARTY: tuple[ExtractorName, ...] = (
    "trafilatura",
    "trafilatura-precision",
    "readability",
    "newspaper",
    "justext",
    "strip-tags",
)


def _ids(skeleton: Skeleton) -> str:
    return skeleton.source


def test_every_primary_source_has_a_skeleton() -> None:
    assert len(SKELETONS) >= 10
    assert all(s.body_markers for s in SKELETONS)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("extractor", OWN_EXACT)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("skeleton", SKELETONS, ids=_ids)
def test_own_strategy_recovers_the_body_without_leakage(
    skeleton: Skeleton, extractor: ExtractorName, parser: ParserName
) -> None:
    if extractor == "jsonld" and not skeleton.expected["jsonld_body"]:
        pytest.skip("page has no JSON-LD articleBody")
    article = extract(skeleton.html, skeleton.url, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)

    assert article.source == skeleton.source
    assert skeleton.recall(article.text) >= 0.9
    assert OTHER_MARKER.findall(article.text) == []
    if title_marker := skeleton.expected["title_marker"]:
        assert title_marker in article.title


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("skeleton", SKELETONS, ids=_ids)
def test_density_finds_most_of_the_body(skeleton: Skeleton, parser: ParserName) -> None:
    article = extract(skeleton.html, skeleton.url, parser=parser, extractor="density")

    leaked = [p for p in article.paragraphs if OTHER_MARKER.search(p)]
    assert skeleton.recall(article.text) >= 0.8
    assert len(leaked) <= 0.1 * len(article.paragraphs)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("skeleton", SKELETONS, ids=_ids)
def test_cascade_takes_jsonld_only_when_the_page_has_a_body(skeleton: Skeleton) -> None:
    article = extract(skeleton.html, skeleton.url, extractor="cascade")

    assert article.method == ("jsonld" if skeleton.expected["jsonld_body"] else "profile")
    # A JSON-LD hit never builds a DOM.
    assert (article.parse_ms == 0.0) is (article.method == "jsonld")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("extractor", THIRD_PARTY)
@pytest.mark.parametrize("skeleton", SKELETONS, ids=_ids)
def test_third_party_smoke(skeleton: Skeleton, extractor: ExtractorName) -> None:
    paragraphs = third_party.extract(extractor, skeleton.html, skeleton.url)

    assert isinstance(paragraphs, list)
    assert all(isinstance(p, str) and p for p in paragraphs)
    if (extractor, skeleton.source) not in {("trafilatura", "sec"), ("trafilatura-precision", "sec")}:
        assert paragraphs
```

```bash
$ cat > .temp/P2/extract/skeleton_matrix.py <<'EOF'
"""Recall / leakage of every extractor x parser on the committed skeletons (markers only)."""

import sys

sys.path.insert(0, "backend")
from tests.unit.extract._skeletons import BODY_MARKER, OTHER_MARKER, skeletons  # noqa: E402

from veritrade.errors import ExtractionEmpty  # noqa: E402
from veritrade.extract import third_party  # noqa: E402
from veritrade.extract.registry import extract  # noqa: E402
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSERS  # noqa: E402

for s in skeletons():
    cells = []
    for ex in ("jsonld", "profile", "density", "cascade"):
        vals = []
        for parser in PARSERS:
            try:
                a = extract(s.html, s.url, parser=parser, extractor=ex)
            except ExtractionEmpty:
                vals.append("--")
                continue
            leaked = sum(1 for p in a.paragraphs if OTHER_MARKER.search(p) and not BODY_MARKER.search(p))
            vals.append(f"{s.recall(a.text):.2f}/{leaked}")
        cells.append(f"{ex}:" + ",".join(vals))
    tp = []
    for ex in ("trafilatura", "trafilatura-precision", "readability", "newspaper", "justext", "strip-tags"):
        paras = third_party.extract(ex, s.html, s.url)
        text = "\n".join(paras)
        leaked = sum(1 for p in paras if OTHER_MARKER.search(p) and not BODY_MARKER.search(p))
        tp.append(f"{ex}:{s.recall(text):.2f}/{leaked}of{len(paras)}")
    print(s.source, " ".join(cells))
    print("   ", " ".join(tp))
EOF
```

```python
"""Skeletons must not carry publisher text: every string is built from the fixed synthetic vocabulary."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from collections.abc import Iterator
from typing import Any

import lxml.html
import pytest

from ._skeletons import Skeleton, skeletons, vocabulary

SKELETONS = skeletons()
VOCAB = vocabulary()
WORDS = frozenset(VOCAB["words"])
PHRASES = sorted((p.strip() for p in VOCAB["phrases"]), key=len, reverse=True)
INVALID_URL = VOCAB["url"]
JSONLD_KEEP = frozenset(VOCAB["jsonld_keep_keys"])
MARKER = re.compile(r"VT[BX]-\d+")
TOKEN = re.compile(r"[^\W\d_]+|\d+")
ISO_DATE = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(?:[T ][\d:.+\-Z]*)?$")
TEXT_ATTRS = ("alt", "title", "aria-label", "placeholder", "aria-description")
TEXT_METAS = frozenset({"description", "og:title", "og:description", "twitter:title", "twitter:description"})


def synthetic(text: str) -> bool:
    """Only vocabulary words and markers, optionally after one stop/boilerplate phrase at the start."""
    rest = text.strip()
    for phrase in PHRASES:
        if rest.lower().startswith(phrase.lower()):
            rest = rest[len(phrase) :]
            break
    return all(token.lower() in WORDS for token in TOKEN.findall(MARKER.sub(" ", rest)))


def _ids(skeleton: Skeleton) -> str:
    return skeleton.source


def _strings(value: Any, key: str = "") -> Iterator[tuple[str, str]]:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for k, v in value.items():
            yield from _strings(v, k)
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for item in value:
            yield from _strings(item, key)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        yield key, value


def test_vocabulary_is_small_and_plain() -> None:
    assert 40 <= len(WORDS) <= 150
    assert all(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z]+", w) for w in WORDS)


def test_detector_rejects_real_prose() -> None:
    assert synthetic("VTB-3 The company said the plan was shared with the board.")
    assert synthetic("About VTX-9 the group")
    assert not synthetic("Shares of Acme jumped 12% after earnings beat estimates.")
    assert not synthetic("VTB-3 the company said revenue")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("skeleton", SKELETONS, ids=_ids)
def test_text_nodes_are_synthetic(skeleton: Skeleton) -> None:
    root = lxml.html.document_fromstring(skeleton.html)
    offenders = []
    for el in root.iter():
        if not isinstance(el.tag, str):
            offenders.append("comment or processing instruction")
            continue
        if el.tag in ("script", "style"):
            ld = el.tag == "script" and "ld+json" in (el.get("type") or "")
            if el.text and el.text.strip() and not ld:
                offenders.append(f"non-empty <{el.tag}>")
        elif el.text and not synthetic(el.text):
            offenders.append(f"<{el.tag}> text")
        if el.tail and not synthetic(el.tail):
            offenders.append(f"<{el.tag}> tail")
    assert offenders == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("skeleton", SKELETONS, ids=_ids)
def test_jsonld_strings_are_synthetic(skeleton: Skeleton) -> None:
    root = lxml.html.document_fromstring(skeleton.html)
    offenders = []
    for script in root.iter("script"):
        if "ld+json" not in (script.get("type") or ""):
            continue
        for key, value in _strings(json.loads(script.text or "null")):
            structural = key in JSONLD_KEEP or (key.startswith("@") and key != "@id")
            if structural or value == INVALID_URL or ISO_DATE.match(value) or synthetic(value):
                continue
            offenders.append(key)
    assert offenders == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize("skeleton", SKELETONS, ids=_ids)
def test_attributes_carry_no_publisher_text_or_links(skeleton: Skeleton) -> None:
    root = lxml.html.document_fromstring(skeleton.html)
    offenders = []
    for el in root.iter():
        if not isinstance(el.tag, str):
            continue
        for name in TEXT_ATTRS:
            if (value := el.get(name)) and not synthetic(value):
                offenders.append(f"<{el.tag} {name}>")
        for name in ("href", "src"):
            if (value := el.get(name)) and value != INVALID_URL:
                offenders.append(f"<{el.tag} {name}>")
        key = (el.get("property") or el.get("name") or "").lower()
        content = el.get("content") or ""
        if el.tag == "meta" and key in TEXT_METAS and content != INVALID_URL and not synthetic(content):
            offenders.append(f"<meta {key}>")
    assert offenders == []
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade.extract.dom import head_title, normalize, parse, scan_json_ld, split_sentences
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSERS, ParserName

PAGE = """<!doctype html><html><head><title>Plain title | Site</title>
<meta property="og:title" content="Social &amp; title">
<script type="application/ld+json">{"@type": "NewsArticle", "headline": "LD headline"}</script>
<script type="application/ld+json"><!-- {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Org"} --></script>
<script type="application/ld+json">{not json</script>
</head><body>
<div id="main" class="story body">
  <p><span class="dropcap">R</span>ogue traders<br>were <b>caught</b>&nbsp;today​.</p>
  <ul><li>First <a href="/x">point</a></li></ul>
  <p>Second<!-- hidden --> paragraph<script>var x = 1;</script> here.</p>
  <div class="ad"><div class="ad"><p>nested ad copy</p></div></div>
</div>
<p class="tail">Outside text</p>
</body></html>"""


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_text_joins_inline_runs_and_separates_breaks(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    dom = parse(PAGE, parser)
    texts = [node.text() for node in dom.select("div#main p, div#main li")]

    assert texts == ["Rogue traders were caught today.", "First point", "Second paragraph here.", "nested ad copy"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_remove_handles_nested_matches(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    dom = parse(PAGE, parser)

    assert dom.remove("div.ad") == 2
    assert [n.text() for n in dom.select("p")][-2:] == ["Second paragraph here.", "Outside text"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_attr_and_tag(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    node = parse(PAGE, parser).select("div#main")[0]

    assert node.tag == "div"
    assert node.attr("class") == "story body"
    assert node.attr("missing") is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_blocks_carry_link_density_and_container_path(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    dom = parse(PAGE, parser)
    blocks = {b.text: b for b in dom.iter_blocks()}

    item = blocks["First point"]
    assert item.tag == "li"
    assert item.link_chars == len("point")
    assert 0.4 < item.link_density < 0.5
    assert [c.tag for c in item.path[:3]] == ["li", "ul", "div"]
    assert item.path[2].hint.strip() == "story body main"
    assert blocks["Rogue traders were caught today."].link_density == 0.0
    assert "var x = 1;" not in " ".join(blocks)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_title_prefers_og_title(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    assert parse(PAGE, parser).title() == "Social & title"
    assert parse("<html><head><title> Only  title </title></head></html>", parser).title() == "Only title"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_json_ld_is_parser_independent_and_skips_bad_blocks(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    dom = parse(PAGE, parser)

    assert dom.json_ld() == [
        {"@type": "NewsArticle", "headline": "LD headline"},
        {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Org"},
    ]
    assert dom.parse_ms == 0.0  # JSON-LD never builds the tree


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_tree_is_built_lazily_and_timed(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    dom = parse(PAGE, parser)
    assert dom.parser == parser
    assert dom.parse_ms == 0.0
    dom.select("p")
    assert dom.parse_ms > 0.0


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_xhtml_with_encoding_declaration(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    page = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><html><body><p>Hello world</p></body></html>'

    assert [n.text() for n in parse(page, parser).select("p")] == ["Hello world"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_empty_document(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    dom = parse("", parser)

    assert dom.select("p") == []
    assert list(dom.iter_blocks()) == []
    assert dom.title() == ""


def test_normalize_collapses_whitespace_and_invisible_characters() -> None:
    assert normalize(" a \n b​­c\t") == "a bc"


def test_scan_json_ld_handles_cdata_and_case() -> None:
    page = '<SCRIPT TYPE="application/ld+json">//<![CDATA[\n{"a": 1}\n//]]></SCRIPT>'
    assert scan_json_ld('<script type="application/ld+json"><![CDATA[{"a": 1}]]></script>') == [{"a": 1}]
    assert scan_json_ld(page) == []  # a JS comment prefix is not JSON; the block is skipped, not fatal


def test_head_title_reads_meta_then_title_tag() -> None:
    assert head_title('<meta content="Meta &amp; title" property="og:title"><title>T</title>') == "Meta & title"
    assert head_title("<title>Just <b>T</b></title>") == "Just T"
    assert head_title("<p>no title</p>") == ""


def test_split_sentences_respects_abbreviations_and_numbers() -> None:
    text = "Acme Inc. rose 3.5% in the U.S. market. J. Smith said so. Is it over? Yes!"

    assert split_sentences(text) == [
        "Acme Inc. rose 3.5% in the U.S. market.",
        "J. Smith said so.",
        "Is it over?",
        "Yes!",
    ]
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade.extract import profiles
from veritrade.extract.dom import parse
from veritrade.extract.profiles import Fate, Profile, refine, source_for_url, stop_marker, triage
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSERS, ParserName

RELEASE = Profile(source="pr", body="p", lede_paragraphs=2, min_words=3, stop_markers=("About ", "Contacts"))


def fates(texts: list[str], profile: Profile | None = RELEASE) -> list[str]:
    return [v.fate.value for v in triage(texts, profile)]


def test_sources_load_with_profiles_for_every_primary() -> None:
    sources = profiles.sources()
    primary = [s for s in sources.values() if s.status == "primary"]

    assert len(primary) == 10
    assert all(s.profile is not None and s.profile.body for s in primary)
    assert profiles.profile_for("sec") is not None
    assert profiles.profile_for("sec").min_words == 4  # type: ignore[union-attr]
    assert profiles.profile_for("apnews") is None
    assert profiles.profile_for(None) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("url", "key"),
    [
        ("https://finance.yahoo.com/news/x-1.html", "yahoo"),
        ("https://uk.finance.yahoo.com/news/x-1.html", "yahoo"),
        ("https://edition.cnn.com/2026/10/17/business/x", "cnn"),
        ("https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/abc", "bbc"),
        ("https://FORTUNE.com./2026/10/17/x/", "fortune"),
        ("https://apnews.com/article/x", "apnews"),
        ("https://notfortune.com/x", None),
        ("https://yahoo.com/news/x", None),
        ("not a url", None),
    ],
)
def test_source_for_url_matches_listed_domains_and_subdomains(url: str, key: str | None) -> None:
    assert source_for_url(url) == key


def test_short_paragraphs_and_boilerplate_lines_are_dropped() -> None:
    texts = ["CITY, Oct 1 /Wire/ -- Acme announced results.", "Acme Corp", "Story continues", ""]

    assert fates(texts) == ["keep", "short", "boilerplate", "empty"]
    assert triage(texts, RELEASE)[2].phrase == "story continues"


def test_stop_markers_never_cut_the_lede() -> None:
    texts = [
        "About Acme: the lede that starts like a marker.",
        "Second lede paragraph with words.",
        "Third paragraph of the body.",
        "About Acme",
        "Acme makes things for many people.",
    ]

    assert fates(texts) == ["keep", "keep", "keep", "stop", "after_stop"]
    assert refine(texts, RELEASE) == texts[:3]


def test_name_style_marker_needs_a_capital_or_a_short_heading() -> None:
    markers = ("About ",)
    long_tail = " of the 2,000 staff will move to the new site next year, the company said."

    assert stop_marker("About 40%" + long_tail, markers) is None
    assert stop_marker("About half" + long_tail, markers) is None
    assert stop_marker("About the Company", markers) == "About "
    assert stop_marker("About Acme Corp. Acme is a maker of tools used by millions.", markers) == "About "
    assert stop_marker("about acme", markers) == "About "


def test_generic_stops_apply_without_a_profile() -> None:
    texts = ["Lede one has words.", "Lede two has words.", "Body.", "Forward-Looking Statements", "Legal."]

    assert fates(texts, None) == ["keep", "keep", "keep", "stop", "after_stop"]


def test_inner_matches_of_a_selector_list_are_not_duplicated() -> None:
    texts = ["Outer item with an inner paragraph and more", "inner paragraph", "and more", "Next one."]

    assert fates(texts, Profile(source="x", body="p")) == ["keep", "nested", "nested", "keep"]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_profile_strategy_applies_drops_and_stops(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    page = """<html><body><h1>Headline here</h1><div id="article-body">
      <p>Shares of Acme <span class="ticker-mention">( ACME -1.2% )</span> rose after the update today.</p>
      <p>Second paragraph of the story has words.</p>
      <div class="image"><p>Caption text for an image.</p></div>
      <p>Third paragraph of the story has words.</p>
      <p>Before you buy stock in Acme, consider this pitch.</p>
      <p>Pitch body that must not appear.</p>
    </div></body></html>"""
    paragraphs = profiles.extract(parse(page, parser), "https://www.fool.com/investing/x/", "fool")

    assert paragraphs == [
        "Shares of Acme rose after the update today.",
        "Second paragraph of the story has words.",
        "Third paragraph of the story has words.",
    ]


def test_profile_strategy_is_empty_for_unknown_sources() -> None:
    assert profiles.extract(parse("<p>text</p>"), "https://example.com/", None) == []


def test_fate_values_are_stable() -> None:
    assert {f.value for f in Fate} == {"keep", "empty", "nested", "short", "boilerplate", "stop", "after_stop"}
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade.extract import jsonld
from veritrade.extract.dom import parse

GRAPH: list[Any] = [
    {
        "@context": "https://schema.org",
        "@graph": [
            {"@type": "WebPage", "isAccessibleForFree": "False"},
            {"@type": ["https://schema.org/NewsArticle"], "headline": "Acme &amp; Co beat", "articleBody": "short"},
            {
                "@type": "ReportageNewsArticle",
                "name": "Second",
                "datePublished": "2026-10-17T09:00:00Z",
                "articleBody": "Para one.\n\nPara two.",
            },
        ],
    }
]


def test_article_nodes_walk_graphs_and_type_urls() -> None:
    assert len(jsonld.article_nodes(GRAPH)) == 2
    assert jsonld.types_of({"@type": "schema:NewsArticle"}) == {"NewsArticle"}


def test_body_is_the_longest_article_body() -> None:
    assert jsonld.article_body(GRAPH) == "Para one.\n\nPara two."
    assert jsonld.paragraphs(GRAPH, None) == ["Para one.", "Para two."]


def test_body_falls_back_to_any_node() -> None:
    assert jsonld.article_body([{"@type": "WebPage", "articleBody": "x y"}]) == "x y"
    assert jsonld.article_body([{"@type": "WebPage"}]) == ""


def test_metadata_fields() -> None:
    assert jsonld.headline(GRAPH) == "Acme & Co beat"
    assert jsonld.date_published(GRAPH) == "2026-10-17T09:00:00Z"
    assert jsonld.headline([{"@type": "WebPage", "headline": "not an article"}]) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "paywalled"), [(False, True), ("False", True), (" false ", True), (True, False), ("True", False)]
)
def test_paywall_flag(value: object, paywalled: bool) -> None:
    assert jsonld.is_paywalled([{"@type": "NewsArticle", "isAccessibleForFree": value}]) is paywalled
    assert jsonld.is_paywalled([{"@type": "NewsArticle"}]) is False


def test_split_body_handles_lines_and_html() -> None:
    assert jsonld.split_body("One.\nTwo.\n\n") == ["One.", "Two."]
    assert jsonld.split_body("<p>One &amp; two.</p><p>Three<br>four.</p>") == ["One & two.", "Three", "four."]


def test_blob_bodies_are_regrouped_into_paragraphs() -> None:
    sentence = "The company said the new plan was shared with the board this week."  # 13 words
    paragraphs = jsonld.split_body(" ".join([sentence] * 10))

    assert len(paragraphs) == 4
    assert paragraphs[0] == " ".join([sentence] * 3)
    assert all(len(p.split()) <= 90 for p in paragraphs)


def test_strategy_applies_profile_rules() -> None:
    body = "Lede one.\n\nLede two.\n\nBody three.\n\nForward-Looking Statements\n\nLegal text."
    page = f'<script type="application/ld+json">{{"@type": "NewsArticle", "articleBody": {body!r}}}</script>'
    page = page.replace("'", '"').replace("\n", "\\n")

    assert jsonld.extract(parse(page), "https://example.com/a", None) == ["Lede one.", "Lede two.", "Body three."]
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade.extract import density
from veritrade.extract.dom import parse
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSERS, ParserName

SENTENCE = "The regional office said the new plan was shared with the board during the week"


def para(n: int) -> str:
    return f"<p>Paragraph {n}: {SENTENCE}, and staff noted the schedule.</p>"


def story_page() -> str:
    story = "".join(para(i) for i in range(1, 7))
    related = "".join(f'<li><a href="/r{i}">Related headline number {i} goes here today</a></li>' for i in range(8))
    comments = "".join(f"<p>Reader comment {i}: {SENTENCE}, they wrote at length.</p>" for i in range(3))
    return f"""<html><body>
      <header><p>Site banner text that is long enough to count as prose here.</p></header>
      <main>
        <div class="xl:grid-[content]">
          <h1>Headline</h1>
          <div class="StoryBody-storyBody">{story}
            <div class="InlineImage-imageEmbedCaption">An image caption that runs on for several words.</div>
          </div>
          <div class="RelatedContent-list"><ul>{related}</ul></div>
          <section id="comments">{comments}</section>
        </div>
      </main>
      <footer><p>Copyright notice and other footer prose that is quite long.</p></footer>
    </body></html>"""


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_density_keeps_the_story_and_nothing_around_it(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    paragraphs = density.extract(parse(story_page(), parser), "https://example.com/a", None)

    assert [p.split(":")[0] for p in paragraphs] == [f"Paragraph {i}" for i in range(1, 7)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_data_tables_do_not_vote_but_layout_tables_still_work(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    rows = "".join(f"<tr><td>Row {i} has a long label for the metric</td><td>{i}</td></tr>" for i in range(40))
    page = f"<html><body><div class='post'>{para(1)}{para(2)}{para(3)}</div><table>{rows}</table></body></html>"
    layout = f"<html><body><table><tr><td>{para(1)}{para(2)}{para(3)}</td></tr></table></body></html>"

    assert len(density.extract(parse(page, parser), "https://example.com/", None)) == 3
    assert len(density.extract(parse(layout, parser), "https://example.com/", None)) == 3


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_short_stop_heading_ends_a_release(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    body = "".join(para(i) for i in range(1, 4))
    page = f"<html><body><div>{body}<p><b>About Acme</b></p><p>Acme is a company, {SENTENCE}.</p></div></body></html>"

    paragraphs = density.extract(parse(page, parser), "https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/x", "globenewswire")

    assert len(paragraphs) == 3


def test_empty_page() -> None:
    assert density.extract(parse("<html><body><p>Too short.</p></body></html>"), "https://e.com/", None) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("hint", "negative"),
    [
        ("RelatedContent-nonCollapsibleContent", True),
        ("InlineImage-imageEmbedCaption", True),
        ("ssrcss-1emzoi7-PromoHeadline", True),
        ("comments", True),
        ("foolcom-grid-content-sidebar mt-9", False),
        ("xl:group-[:has(#right-rail-recirc-active)]/article:max-w-full", False),
        ("ArticleBody-articleBody", False),
        ("article-body body-text", False),
        ("", False),
    ],
)
def test_negative_hints(hint: str, negative: bool) -> None:
    assert density.negative_hint(hint) is negative


def test_positive_hints() -> None:
    assert density.positive_hint("article-body")
    assert not density.positive_hint("related-article")
    assert not density.positive_hint("flex gap-4")

```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from veritrade.extract import cascade
from veritrade.extract.dom import parse

SENTENCE = "The regional office said the new plan was shared with the board during the week."
YAHOO = "https://finance.yahoo.com/news/acme-plan-123.html"


def page(*, ld_body: str | None = None, yahoo_paragraphs: int = 0, other_paragraphs: int = 0) -> str:
    ld = ""
    if ld_body is not None:
        payload = json.dumps({"@type": "NewsArticle", "headline": "H", "articleBody": ld_body})
        ld = f'<script type="application/ld+json">{payload}</script>'
    yahoo = "".join(f"<p>Y{i} {SENTENCE}</p>" for i in range(yahoo_paragraphs))
    other = "".join(f"<p>D{i} {SENTENCE}</p>" for i in range(other_paragraphs))
    return f"""<html><head>{ld}</head><body>
      <div data-testid="article-body">{yahoo}</div><div class="story">{other}</div>
    </body></html>"""


def test_jsonld_wins_without_building_the_tree() -> None:
    dom = parse(page(ld_body=" ".join([SENTENCE] * 6), yahoo_paragraphs=8))

    method, paragraphs = cascade.run(dom, YAHOO, "yahoo")

    assert method == "jsonld"
    assert paragraphs
    assert dom.parse_ms == 0.0


def test_short_jsonld_falls_through_to_the_profile() -> None:
    method, paragraphs = cascade.run(parse(page(ld_body=SENTENCE, yahoo_paragraphs=8)), YAHOO, "yahoo")

    assert method == "profile"
    assert len(paragraphs) == 8


def test_unknown_source_uses_density() -> None:
    method, paragraphs = cascade.run(parse(page(other_paragraphs=6)), "https://example.com/a", None)

    assert method == "density"
    assert len(paragraphs) == 6


def test_thin_profile_yields_to_a_richer_density_pass() -> None:
    method, paragraphs = cascade.run(parse(page(yahoo_paragraphs=1, other_paragraphs=8)), YAHOO, "yahoo")

    assert method == "density"
    assert len(paragraphs) == 8


def test_thin_profile_beats_an_empty_density_pass() -> None:
    method, paragraphs = cascade.run(parse(page(yahoo_paragraphs=3)), YAHOO, "yahoo")

    assert (method, len(paragraphs)) == ("profile", 3)

```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json

import pytest

from veritrade.errors import ErrorCode, ExtractionEmpty
from veritrade.extract import registry
from veritrade.extract.registry import extract, source_for_url
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSERS, ParserName

SENTENCE = "The regional office said the new plan was shared with the board during the week."
BODY = "".join(f"<p>{SENTENCE} Item {i}.</p>" for i in range(8))


def page(ld: dict[str, object] | None = None, head: str = "") -> str:
    script = f'<script type="application/ld+json">{json.dumps(ld)}</script>' if ld else ""
    return f"<html><head>{script}{head}</head><body><div class='story'>{BODY}</div></body></html>"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("parser", PARSERS)
def test_article_fields_from_json_ld(parser: ParserName) -> None:
    ld = {"@type": "NewsArticle", "headline": "LD title", "datePublished": "2026-10-17", "isAccessibleForFree": False}

    article = extract(page(ld), "https://example.com/a", parser=parser, extractor="density")

    assert (article.title, article.published_at, article.paywalled) == ("LD title", "2026-10-17", True)
    assert (article.source, article.method, article.parser, article.extractor) == (None, "density", parser, "density")
    assert len(article.paragraphs) == 8
    assert article.parse_ms > 0.0
    assert article.extract_ms > 0.0


def test_fallbacks_to_meta_tags() -> None:
    head = (
        '<meta property="og:title" content="OG title"><title>Tag title</title>'
        '<meta content="2026-10-16T08:00:00Z" property="article:published_time">'
    )

    article = extract(page(head=head), "https://example.com/a")

    assert (article.title, article.published_at, article.paywalled) == ("OG title", "2026-10-16T08:00:00Z", False)
    assert article.method == "density"


def test_profile_title_selector_wins_over_og_title_for_known_sources() -> None:
    html = page(head='<meta property="og:title" content="OG title">').replace(
        "<body>", '<body><h1 class="cover-title">Visible headline</h1><div data-testid="article-body">'
    ).replace("</body>", "</div></body>")

    article = extract(html, "https://finance.yahoo.com/news/acme-1.html", extractor="profile")

    assert (article.source, article.title, article.method) == ("yahoo", "Visible headline", "profile")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("extractor", ["trafilatura", "strip-tags"])
def test_third_party_reports_no_parser(extractor: str) -> None:
    article = extract(page({"@type": "NewsArticle", "headline": "LD"}), "https://example.com/a", extractor=extractor)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

    assert (article.parser, article.parse_ms, article.method, article.title) == (None, 0.0, extractor, "LD")
    assert article.word_count >= registry.MIN_WORDS


def test_too_little_text_raises_extraction_empty() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ExtractionEmpty) as caught:
        extract("<html><body><p>Only a few words.</p></body></html>", "https://example.com/a")

    assert caught.value.code is ErrorCode.EXTRACTION_EMPTY
    assert caught.value.http_status == 422
    assert "example.com" in caught.value.message
    assert caught.value.hint


def test_source_lookup_is_reexported() -> None:
    assert source_for_url("https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/17/x.html") == "cnbc"

```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade.extract.scope import LEDE_MAX_TOKENS, build_input, estimate_tokens, lede_paragraphs
from veritrade.extract.types import Article

SENTENCE = "The regional office said the new plan was shared with the board."  # 64 chars


def article(paragraphs: list[str], *, title: str = "Acme plan", source: str | None = None) -> Article:
    return Article(
        url="https://example.com/a",
        title=title,
        paragraphs=tuple(paragraphs),
        published_at=None,
        source=source,
        method="profile",
        parser="selectolax",
        extractor="cascade",
        parse_ms=0.0,
        extract_ms=0.0,
    )


def para(sentences: int, tag: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(f"{tag}{i} {SENTENCE}" for i in range(sentences))


def test_lede_is_title_plus_first_two_paragraphs() -> None:
    body = [para(2, "A"), para(2, "B"), para(2, "C")]

    assert build_input(article(body), "lede", 4000) == f"TITLE: Acme plan\n\n{body[0]}\n\n{body[1]}"


def test_lede_uses_the_profile_paragraph_count() -> None:
    body = [para(1, "A"), para(1, "B"), para(1, "C"), para(1, "D")]

    assert lede_paragraphs(article(body, source="sec")) == body[:3]


def test_tiny_opening_paragraphs_are_topped_up() -> None:
    body = ["CITY, Oct 1 /Wire/ --", "Acme Corp.", para(2, "C"), para(2, "D")]

    assert lede_paragraphs(article(body)) == body[:3]


def test_lede_is_capped_at_a_sentence_boundary() -> None:
    body = [para(20, "A"), para(20, "B")]

    text = build_input(article(body), "lede", 4000)
    lede = text.split("\n\n", 1)[1]

    assert estimate_tokens(lede) <= LEDE_MAX_TOKENS
    assert lede.endswith(".")
    assert body[0].startswith(lede)


def test_full_keeps_whole_paragraphs_under_the_cap() -> None:
    body = [para(3, "A"), para(3, "B"), para(3, "C")]

    assert build_input(article(body), "full", 4000) == "TITLE: Acme plan\n\n" + "\n\n".join(body)
    capped = build_input(article(body), "full", 120)
    assert estimate_tokens(capped) <= 120
    assert capped.endswith(".")
    assert "C0" not in capped


@pytest.mark.parametrize("max_tokens", [5, 17, 33, 64, 100, 257])
def test_estimate_never_exceeds_the_cap(max_tokens: int) -> None:
    body = [para(4, "A"), "x" * 900, para(4, "C")]

    assert estimate_tokens(build_input(article(body), "full", max_tokens)) <= max_tokens


def test_a_giant_first_sentence_is_cut_at_a_word() -> None:
    body = [" ".join(["word"] * 400)]

    text = build_input(article(body, title=""), "full", 50)

    assert not text.startswith("TITLE")
    assert text == " ".join(["word"] * 40)


def test_invalid_budget() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="positive"):
        build_input(article(["x"]), "full", 0)
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import socket
from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade.extract import third_party
from veritrade.extract.types import EXTRACTORS, PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS

from ._skeletons import skeletons


def test_every_non_own_extractor_has_an_adapter() -> None:
    assert set(third_party.ADAPTERS) == set(EXTRACTORS) - PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS


def test_adapters_never_touch_the_network(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    def refuse(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        raise AssertionError("an extractor tried to open a connection")

    monkeypatch.setattr(socket.socket, "connect", refuse)
    monkeypatch.setattr(socket, "create_connection", refuse)
    skeleton = next(s for s in skeletons() if s.source == "fool")

    for name in third_party.ADAPTERS:
        assert third_party.extract(name, skeleton.html, skeleton.url)


def test_strip_tags_returns_every_visible_run() -> None:
    page = "<html><head><title>T</title><style>p{}</style></head><body><p>One <b>two</b></p><div>three</div></body></html>"

    assert third_party.extract("strip-tags", page, "https://example.com/") == ["One two", "three"]
```

```python
"""Per-source profiles from sources.toml and the paragraph rules every own strategy applies."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tomllib
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from functools import cache
from importlib import resources
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from veritrade.extract.dom import Dom, Node, normalize

# Unambiguous press-release tails; they end the body on any page, on top of a profile's own markers.
GENERIC_STOPS = (
    "Forward-Looking Statement",
    "Forward Looking Statement",
    "Cautionary Statement",
    "Safe Harbor",
    "Media Contact",
    "Investor Contact",
    "Investors Contact",
    "Investor Relations Contact",
)
# Whole-line UI leftovers that sit between body paragraphs.

    {

)  # fmt: skip
_BOILERPLATE_TRAIL = " .:»›>…"
# "About Acme" ends a release, "About 40% of" does not: name-style markers need a capital or a short line.
_HEADING_WORDS = 8


class Fate(StrEnum):

    SHORT = "short"
    BOILERPLATE = "boilerplate"
    STOP = "stop"
    AFTER_STOP = "after_stop"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Verdict:
    fate: Fate
    phrase: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Profile:
```
