```python
"""Turn one probe capture per source into a publisher-text-free skeleton fixture for the extractor tests.

The DOM (tags, classes, ids, data-*, JSON-LD shape) is kept; every text node, text attribute and JSON-LD
string is replaced from a small fixed vocabulary, so the fixtures can be committed. Body paragraphs carry
VTB-<k> markers, all other text VTX-<k>, which lets tests measure recall and leakage per extractor.

    uv run python scripts/capture_skeletons.py                 # every primary/backup source, capture 1
    uv run python scripts/capture_skeletons.py --pick sec=2    # another capture for one source
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import random
import re
import sys
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import lxml.html
from lxml import etree

from veritrade.extract import jsonld, profiles
from veritrade.extract.dom import normalize, parse, strip_xml_declaration
from veritrade.extract.profiles import BOILERPLATE_LINES, GENERIC_STOPS, Fate, Profile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROBE_DIR = ROOT / "evals/data/private/probe"
PROBE_JSON = ROOT / "evals/data/source_probe.json"
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "backend/tests/fixtures/skeletons"
INVALID_URL = "https://example.invalid/"
EM_DASH = chr(0x2014)
CONTACT_EMAIL = "[redacted-email]"  # keeps contact lines recognisable without a real address
KEY_ATTR = "data-vtk"

# Neutral, sentiment-free English with stopwords, so stopword-based extractors (justext, newspaper) still
# see prose. Small on purpose: a purity test asserts no other word survives in a fixture.
VOCABULARY = (
    "a", "added", "after", "also", "an", "and", "annual", "are", "as", "at", "be", "board", "by", "can",
    "city", "common", "company", "current", "design", "detail", "during", "early", "final", "first", "for",
    "from", "general", "group", "had", "has", "have", "in", "is", "it", "its", "later", "level", "listed",
    "local", "meeting", "member", "month", "network", "new", "noted", "of", "office", "on", "other",
    "outlined", "panel", "period", "plan", "planned", "process", "program", "project", "public", "recent",
    "region", "regional", "report", "resident", "review", "reviewed", "said", "says", "schedule", "season",
    "second", "series", "service", "several", "shared", "staff", "system", "team", "that", "the", "this",
    "to", "update", "visitor", "was", "week", "were", "while", "will", "with", "would", "year",
)  # fmt: skip

URL_ATTRS = frozenset(
    {
        "action", "background", "cite", "data", "data-href", "data-src", "data-srcset", "data-url",
        "formaction", "href", "longdesc", "poster", "src", "srcset",
    }
)  # fmt: skip
TEXT_ATTRS = frozenset(
    {
        "abbr", "alt", "aria-description", "aria-label", "aria-roledescription", "aria-valuetext", "label",
        "placeholder", "summary", "title", "value",
    }
)  # fmt: skip
DROP_ATTRS = frozenset({"style", "srcdoc", "integrity", "nonce"})
# Structural attributes whose values are markup, not prose; any other value with letters becomes "vt".
KEEP_VALUE_ATTRS = frozenset(
    {
        "aria-expanded", "aria-hidden", "aria-level", "aria-live", "async", "charset", "class", "colspan",
        "crossorigin", "data-component", "data-cy", "data-module", "data-test", "data-testid", "datetime",
        "decoding", "defer", "dir", "height", "hidden", "http-equiv", "itemprop", "itemscope", "lang",
        "loading", "media", "method", "open", "rel", "reversed", "role", "rowspan", "scope", "sizes", "start",
        "tabindex", "target", "type", "viewbox", "width",
    }
)  # fmt: skip
NAMESPACE_ATTRS = frozenset({"xmlns", "itemtype"})  # schema/namespace URIs, not publisher links
# Ids survive only when every word in them is layout vocabulary; heading-derived slugs are renamed.
STRUCTURAL_ID_WORDS = frozenset(
    {
        "ad", "ads", "app", "article", "body", "bottom", "comments", "container", "content", "footer",
        "gallery", "global", "header", "image", "inner", "layout", "left", "logo", "main", "media", "menu",
        "nav", "navigation", "outer", "page", "player", "primary", "related", "right", "root", "search",
        "secondary", "section", "sidebar", "site", "skip", "story", "text", "top", "video", "wrapper",
    }
)  # fmt: skip
TITLE_METAS = frozenset({"og:title", "twitter:title", "title", "sailthru.title", "parsely-title"})
STRUCTURAL_METAS = frozenset(
    {
        "viewport", "robots", "googlebot", "og:type", "og:locale", "twitter:card", "theme-color",
        "format-detection", "referrer", "color-scheme", "content-language", "content-type",
    }
)  # fmt: skip
# JSON-LD values that are structure, not prose: kept verbatim and exempt from the purity test.
JSONLD_KEEP_KEYS = frozenset(
    {
        "@context", "@type", "contentReferenceTime", "cssSelector", "dateCreated", "dateModified",
        "datePublished", "duration", "encodingFormat", "height", "inLanguage", "isAccessibleForFree",
        "position", "uploadDate", "width", "wordCount",
    }
)  # fmt: skip
SKIP_CONTENT = frozenset({"script", "style", "noscript", "template", "svg", "math", "iframe", "object"})

_URL_LIKE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:https?:)?//|^www\.|^/[\w./-]|^mailto:|^tel:|\.(?:jpe?g|png|gif|webp|svg|html?)\b"
)
_ISO_DATE = re.compile(r"^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}(?:[T ][\d:.+\-Z]*)?$")
_LETTER_RUN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z]{3,}")
_SELECTOR_ATTR = re.compile(r"\[([\w-]+)")
_ALNUM = re.compile(r"[^\W_]")
_WS_EDGES = re.compile(r"^(\s*)(.*?)(\s*)$", re.DOTALL)


@dataclass
class Synth:
    """Deterministic text factory; markers are numbered in document order."""

    rng: random.Random
    vtb: int = 0
    vtx: int = 0
    vtx_seen: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

    def words(self, count: int, *, end: str = "") -> str:
        out: list[str] = []
        sentence = 0
        for _ in range(max(count, 1)):
            word = self.rng.choice(VOCABULARY)
            if sentence == 0:
                word = word.capitalize()
            sentence += 1
            if sentence >= self.rng.randint(9, 17):
                word += "."
                sentence = 0
            elif self.rng.random() < 0.08:
                word += ","
            out.append(word)
        text = " ".join(out).rstrip(".,")
        return text + end

    def text(self, original: str, marker: str | None) -> str:
        lead, core, trail = _WS_EDGES.match(original).groups()  # type: ignore[union-attr]
        count = len(core.split())
        end = "." if core[-1] in ".!?" else ":" if core[-1] == ":" else ""
        body = self.words(count, end=end)
        if marker:
            rest = body.split(" ", 1)
            body = marker if len(rest) == 1 else f"{marker} {rest[1]}"
            if count == 1 and end:
                body += end
        return f"{lead}{body}{trail}"

    def next_vtb(self) -> str:
        self.vtb += 1
        return f"VTB-{self.vtb}"

    def next_vtx(self) -> str:
        self.vtx += 1
        marker = f"VTX-{self.vtx}"
        self.vtx_seen.append(marker)
        return marker


@dataclass
class Plan:
    keep: set[str]  # data-vtk keys of kept body paragraphs
    special: dict[str, tuple[str, str]]  # key -> (mode, phrase) for stop, boilerplate and contact lines
    dropped: set[str]
    title_key: str | None


def plan_body(annotated: str, profile: Profile) -> Plan:
    """Replay the profile strategy on the annotated page so the skeleton matches what it keeps."""
    dom = parse(annotated, "lxml")
    nodes = profiles.select_body(dom, profile)
    texts = [node.text() for node in nodes]
    keep: set[str] = set()
    special: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
    for node, verdict in zip(nodes, profiles.triage(texts, profile), strict=True):
        key = node.attr(KEY_ATTR) or ""
        if verdict.fate is Fate.KEEP:
            keep.add(key)
        elif verdict.fate is Fate.STOP and verdict.phrase:
            special[key] = ("stop", verdict.phrase)
        elif verdict.fate is Fate.BOILERPLATE and verdict.phrase:
            special[key] = ("boilerplate", verdict.phrase.capitalize())
        elif verdict.fate is Fate.CONTACT:
            special[key] = ("contact", CONTACT_EMAIL)
    fresh = parse(annotated, "lxml")
    dropped = {node.attr(KEY_ATTR) or "" for css in profile.drop for node in fresh.select(css)}
    titles = fresh.select(profile.title) if profile.title else []
    return Plan(keep, special, dropped, titles[0].attr(KEY_ATTR) if titles else None)


@dataclass
class Walker:
    synth: Synth
    plan: Plan
    body_seen: dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=dict)
    title_marker: str | None = None

    def run(self, root: Any) -> None:
        self._walk(root, kept=None, dropped=False, special=None, in_title=False)

    def _text(
        self, text: str | None, kept: str | None, dropped: bool, special: list[Any] | None
    ) -> str | None:
        if not text or not _ALNUM.search(text):
            return text
        if special is not None:
            # The first text of a stop or boilerplate paragraph carries the phrase so the rules fire again.
            if not special:
                return " "
            mode, phrase = special.pop()
            lead = _WS_EDGES.match(text).group(1)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
            if mode == "boilerplate":
                return f"{lead}{phrase} "
            rest = self.synth.text(" ".join(text.split()[1:]) or "x", self.synth.next_vtx()).strip()
            return f"{lead}{rest} {phrase} " if mode == "contact" else f"{lead}{phrase.rstrip()} {rest} "
        if kept is not None and not dropped:
            marker = None
            if not self.body_seen.get(kept):
                self.body_seen[kept] = True
                marker = self.synth.next_vtb()
            return self.synth.text(text, marker)
        return self.synth.text(text, self.synth.next_vtx())

    def _walk(
        self, el: Any, kept: str | None, dropped: bool, special: list[Any] | None, in_title: bool
    ) -> None:
        key = el.get(KEY_ATTR)
        dropped = dropped or key in self.plan.dropped
        if key in self.plan.keep and kept is None:
            kept = key
        if key in self.plan.special:
            special = [self.plan.special[key]]
        in_title = in_title or (key is not None and key == self.plan.title_key)
        before = self.synth.vtx
        el.text = self._text(el.text, kept, dropped, special)
        if in_title and self.title_marker is None and self.synth.vtx > before:
            self.title_marker = f"VTX-{self.synth.vtx}"
        for child in el:
            if child.tag in SKIP_CONTENT:
                _empty(child)
            else:
                self._walk(child, kept, dropped, special, in_title)
            before = self.synth.vtx
            child.tail = self._text(child.tail, kept, dropped, special)
            if in_title and self.title_marker is None and self.synth.vtx > before:
                self.title_marker = f"VTX-{self.synth.vtx}"


def strip_comments(root: Any) -> None:
    """Remove comments and PIs first, merging their tails, so every text slot is walked exactly once."""
    for node in list(root.iter(etree.Comment, etree.ProcessingInstruction)):
        parent = node.getparent()
        if parent is None:
            continue
        tail, previous = node.tail, node.getprevious()
        parent.remove(node)
        if tail and previous is not None:
            previous.tail = (previous.tail or "") + tail
        elif tail:
            parent.text = (parent.text or "") + tail


def _empty(el: Any) -> None:
    if el.tag == "script" and "ld+json" in (el.get("type") or ""):
        return
    el.text = None
    for child in list(el):
        el.remove(child)


def _url_like(value: str) -> bool:
    return bool(_URL_LIKE.search(value.strip()))


def scrub_attributes(root: Any, synth: Synth, keep_ids: set[str], keep_attrs: set[str]) -> None:
    renamed: dict[str, str] = {}
    for el in root.iter():
        if not isinstance(el.tag, str):
            continue
        meta_key = (el.get("property") or el.get("name") or "").lower() if el.tag == "meta" else ""
        for name, value in list(el.attrib.items()):
            lname = name.lower()
            if lname in DROP_ATTRS or lname.startswith("on") or lname == KEY_ATTR:
                del el.attrib[name]
            elif el.tag == "meta" and lname == "content":
                el.set(name, _meta_content(meta_key, value, el, synth))
            elif lname in NAMESPACE_ATTRS or (el.tag == "meta" and lname in ("name", "property")):
                continue
            elif lname in TEXT_ATTRS:
                if _ALNUM.search(value):
                    el.set(name, synth.words(len(value.split())))
            elif lname in URL_ATTRS or _url_like(value):
                el.set(name, f"{INVALID_URL} 1x" if "srcset" in lname else INVALID_URL)
            elif lname == "id":
                if value not in keep_ids and not _structural_id(value):
                    el.set(name, renamed.setdefault(value, f"vt-id-{len(renamed) + 1}"))
            elif lname in KEEP_VALUE_ATTRS or lname in keep_attrs:
                if lname != "class" and not _identifier(value):
                    el.set(name, "vt")
            elif _LETTER_RUN.search(value):
                el.set(name, "vt")


def _structural_id(value: str) -> bool:
    return all(word.lower() in STRUCTURAL_ID_WORDS for word in _LETTER_RUN.findall(value))


def _identifier(value: str) -> bool:
    return len(value) <= 64 and not any(c.isspace() for c in value)


def _meta_content(key: str, value: str, el: Any, synth: Synth) -> str:
    if (el.get("http-equiv") or "").lower() == "refresh":
        return "0"
    if key in STRUCTURAL_METAS or _ISO_DATE.match(value.strip()) or not _ALNUM.search(value):
        return value
    if _url_like(value):
        return INVALID_URL
    if key in TITLE_METAS:
        return "{title}"  # filled once the title text is known
    return synth.words(min(len(value.split()), 30))


# --- JSON-LD ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def synth_jsonld(value: Any, synth: Synth, title: str, body: str, key: str = "") -> Any:
    """Rebuild a JSON-LD value; strings are rewritten at any depth, including inside lists."""
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [synth_jsonld(v, synth, title, body, key) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return _jsonld_string(key, value, synth)
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return value
    title_keys = {"headline", "alternativeHeadline"}
    if jsonld.types_of(value) & jsonld.ARTICLE_TYPES:
        title_keys.add("name")
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for k, item in value.items():
        if k in JSONLD_KEEP_KEYS:
            out[k] = item
        elif k == "articleBody" and isinstance(item, str):
            out[k] = body
        elif k in title_keys and isinstance(item, str):
            out[k] = title
        else:
            out[k] = synth_jsonld(item, synth, title, body, k)
    return out


def _jsonld_string(key: str, value: str, synth: Synth) -> str:
    if key == "@id" or _url_like(value):
        return INVALID_URL
    if _ISO_DATE.match(value.strip()) or not _ALNUM.search(value):
        return value
    return synth.text(normalize(value), synth.next_vtx())


def rewrite_jsonld(root: Any, synth: Synth, title: str, body_paragraphs: list[str]) -> bool:
    had_body = False
    for script in root.iter("script"):
        if "ld+json" not in (script.get("type") or ""):
            continue
        try:
            data = json.loads(script.text or "", strict=False)
        except ValueError:
            script.text = None
            continue
        original_body = jsonld.article_body([data])
        had_body = had_body or bool(original_body)
        joiner = "\n\n" if "\n" in original_body else " "
        script.text = json.dumps(
            synth_jsonld(data, synth, title, joiner.join(body_paragraphs)), ensure_ascii=False
        ).replace("</", "<\\/")
    return had_body


# --- driver -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def capture(key: str, pick: int, probe: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    profile = profiles.profile_for(key)
    source = profiles.sources()[key]
    if profile is None:
        raise SystemExit(f"{key}: no [sources.{key}.profile] in sources.toml")
    articles = {a["n"]: a for a in probe["sources"][key]["articles"]}
    url = articles[pick]["fetch"]["final_url"]
    html = (PROBE_DIR / key / f"{pick}.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

    root = lxml.html.document_fromstring(strip_xml_declaration(html))
    strip_comments(root)
    for index, el in enumerate(e for e in root.iter() if isinstance(e.tag, str)):
        el.set(KEY_ATTR, str(index))
    annotated = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    plan = plan_body(annotated, profile)

    synth = Synth(random.Random(f"veritrade-skeleton-{key}"))
    walker = Walker(synth, plan)
    walker.run(root)

    slug = f"article-{pick}"
    fixture_url = f"https://{source.domains[0]}/vt-skeleton/{slug}"
    skeleton = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode")
    paragraphs = profiles.extract(parse(skeleton, "lxml"), fixture_url, key)
    # The title as the registry reads it; pages without a profile title fall back to <title>.
    titled = parse(skeleton, "lxml").select(profile.title) if profile.title else []
    head_title = root.find(".//title")
    title = titled[0].text() if titled else ""
    if not title and head_title is not None:
        title = normalize(head_title.text or "")
        found = re.search(r"VTX-\d+", title)
        walker.title_marker = found.group(0) if found else None
    if head_title is not None and title:
        head_title.text = title
    selectors = (profile.body, *profile.drop, profile.title or "", profile.paywall or "")
    keep_ids = {m.group(1) for css in selectors for m in re.finditer(r"#([\w-]+)", css)}
    keep_attrs = {m.group(1).lower() for css in selectors for m in _SELECTOR_ATTR.finditer(css)}
    scrub_attributes(root, synth, keep_ids, keep_attrs)
    had_body = rewrite_jsonld(root, synth, title, paragraphs)
    for meta in root.iter("meta"):
        if meta.get("content") == "{title}":
            meta.set("content", title)

    out = OUT_DIR / key
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    # Punctuation-only text nodes survive verbatim; the repo style bans the em-dash character outright.
    document = lxml.html.tostring(root, encoding="unicode", doctype="<!DOCTYPE html>").replace(EM_DASH, "-")
    (out / f"{slug}.html").write_text(document + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    expected = {
        "source": key,
        "slug": slug,
        "captured_at": probe.get("generated_at"),
        "url_sha256": hashlib.sha256(url.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "fixture_url": fixture_url,
        "title_marker": walker.title_marker,
        "body_markers": [f"VTB-{k}" for k in range(1, synth.vtb + 1)],
        "jsonld_body": had_body,
        "stop_marker": next((phrase for mode, phrase in plan.special.values() if mode == "stop"), None),
        "bytes": len(document.encode()),
    }
    (out / f"{slug}.expected.json").write_text(json.dumps(expected, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return expected


def write_vocabulary() -> None:
    phrases = sorted(
        {m for s in profiles.sources().values() if s.profile for m in s.profile.stop_markers}
        | set(GENERIC_STOPS)
        | {line.capitalize() for line in BOILERPLATE_LINES}
    )
    payload = {
        "contact_email": CONTACT_EMAIL,
        "words": list(VOCABULARY),
        "phrases": phrases,
        "url": INVALID_URL,
        "jsonld_keep_keys": sorted(JSONLD_KEEP_KEYS),
    }
    (OUT_DIR / "vocabulary.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter
    )
    parser.add_argument(
        "--source", action="append", help="source key (repeatable); default: primary + backup"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--pick", action="append", default=[], help="KEY=N: use probe capture N for KEY")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    probe = json.loads(PROBE_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    picks = {k: int(v) for k, v in (p.split("=", 1) for p in args.pick)}
    keys = args.source or [k for k, s in profiles.sources().items() if s.status in ("primary", "backup")]
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    write_vocabulary()
    for key in keys:
        if not (PROBE_DIR / key).exists():
            print(
                f"{key}: no probe captures under {PROBE_DIR / key}; run scripts/probe_sources.py",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            continue
        expected = capture(key, picks.get(key, 1), probe)
        print(
            f"{key}: {len(expected['body_markers'])} body paragraphs, title {expected['title_marker']}, "
            f"jsonld_body={expected['jsonld_body']}, {expected['bytes'] // 1024} KB"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```
```
"""Per-source profiles from sources.toml and the paragraph rules every own strategy applies."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import tomllib
from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from functools import cache
from importlib import resources
from typing import Any
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from veritrade.extract.dom import Dom, Node

# Unambiguous press-release tails; they end the body on any page, on top of a profile's own markers.
GENERIC_STOPS = (
    "Forward-Looking Statement",
    "Forward Looking Statement",
    "Cautionary Statement",
    "Safe Harbor",
    "Media Contact",
    "Investor Contact",
    "Investors Contact",
    "Investor Relations Contact",
    "Contact:",
    "Contacts:",
    "Contact Information",
)
# Whole-line UI leftovers that sit between body paragraphs.
BOILERPLATE_LINES = frozenset(
    {
        "advertisement", "continue reading", "read more", "read next", "recommended stories",
        "related articles", "related content", "related stories", "scroll to continue", "share this article",
        "show less", "show more", "sign up", "skip advertisement", "story continues", "subscribe",
        "view comments",
    }
)  # fmt: skip
_BOILERPLATE_TRAIL = " .:»›>…"
# "About Acme" ends a release, "About 40% of" does not: name-style markers need a capital or a short line.
_HEADING_WORDS = 8
# A short line with an e-mail address is a contact line; dropped, not a stop, since "Send tips to ..."
# promos also sit mid-article.
_EMAIL = re.compile(r"[\w.+-]+@[\w-]+(?:\.[\w-]+)+")
CONTACT_MAX_WORDS = 15


class Fate(StrEnum):
    KEEP = "keep"
    EMPTY = "empty"
    NESTED = "nested"
    SHORT = "short"
    BOILERPLATE = "boilerplate"
    CONTACT = "contact"
    STOP = "stop"
    AFTER_STOP = "after_stop"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Verdict:
    fate: Fate
    phrase: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Profile:
    source: str
    body: str
    drop: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    title: str | None = None
    lede_paragraphs: int = 2
    min_words: int = 1
    stop_markers: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    paywall: str | None = None

    @property
    def stops(self) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        return self.stop_markers + tuple(m for m in GENERIC_STOPS if m not in self.stop_markers)



@cache
def _domain_index() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {domain: key for key, source in sources().items() for domain in source.domains}


def source_for_url(url: str) -> str | None:
    """Source key for the URL's host or its closest listed parent domain (uk.finance.yahoo.com -> yahoo)."""
    host = (urlsplit(url).hostname or "").rstrip(".").lower()
    index = _domain_index()
    while host:
        if (key := index.get(host)) is not None:
            return key
        _, _, host = host.partition(".")
    return None


def profile_for(source_key: str | None) -> Profile | None:
    source = sources().get(source_key) if source_key else None
    return source.profile if source else None


# --- paragraph rules --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def stop_marker(text: str, markers: Sequence[str]) -> str | None:
    lowered = text.lower()
    for marker in markers:
        if not lowered.startswith(marker.lower()):
            continue
        rest = text[len(marker) :]
        if marker.endswith(" ") and rest and not rest[0].isupper() and len(text.split()) > _HEADING_WORDS:
            continue
        return marker
    return None


def boilerplate_line(text: str) -> str | None:
    line = text.lower().rstrip(_BOILERPLATE_TRAIL)
    return line if line in BOILERPLATE_LINES else None


def contact_line(text: str) -> bool:
    return len(text.split()) <= CONTACT_MAX_WORDS and _EMAIL.search(text) is not None


def triage(texts: Sequence[str], profile: Profile | None) -> list[Verdict]:
    """Fate of every candidate paragraph, in order; the skeleton capture replays these to stay in sync."""
    min_words = profile.min_words if profile else 1
    lede = profile.lede_paragraphs if profile else 2
    stops = profile.stops if profile else GENERIC_STOPS
    verdicts: list[Verdict] = []
    anchor = ""
    kept = 0
    stopped = False
    for text in texts:
        if stopped:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.AFTER_STOP))
            continue
        if not text:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.EMPTY))
            continue
        # A selector list can match an <li> and the <p> inside it; the outer text already holds the inner.
        if anchor and len(text) < len(anchor) and text in anchor:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.NESTED))
            continue
        anchor = text
        if phrase := boilerplate_line(text):
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.BOILERPLATE, phrase))
        elif contact_line(text):
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.CONTACT))
        # Before min_words: a two-word "About Acme" heading must still end the body.
        elif kept >= lede and (marker := stop_marker(text, stops)):
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.STOP, marker))
            stopped = True
        elif len(text.split()) < min_words:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.SHORT))
        else:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.KEEP))
            kept += 1
    return verdicts


def refine(texts: Sequence[str], profile: Profile | None) -> list[str]:
    return [text for text, v in zip(texts, triage(texts, profile), strict=True) if v.fate is Fate.KEEP]


# --- strategy -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def select_body(dom: Dom, profile: Profile) -> list[Node]:
    """Body candidates in document order after the profile's drop selectors ran."""
    for css in profile.drop:
        dom.remove(css)
    return dom.select(profile.body)


def extract(dom: Dom, url: str, source_key: str | None) -> list[str]:
    profile = profile_for(source_key)
    if profile is None:
        return []
    return refine([node.text() for node in select_body(dom, profile)], profile)
```

```python
    def _blocks(self, root: E) -> list[Block]:
        """Split visible text at every non-inline boundary; each run remembers its container path."""
        out: list[Block] = []
        buffer: list[str] = []
        link_chars = 0
        stack: list[Container] = [Container(self._tag(root), root, 0, self._hint)]

        def flush() -> None:
            nonlocal link_chars
            if buffer:
                text = normalize("".join(buffer))
                if text:
                    path = tuple(reversed(stack))
                    out.append(Block(text, min(link_chars, len(text)), stack[-1].tag, path))
                buffer.clear()
            link_chars = 0

        def walk(el: E, in_link: bool) -> None:
            nonlocal link_chars
            for item in self._content(el):
                if isinstance(item, str):
                    buffer.append(item)
                    if in_link:
                        link_chars += len(item.strip())
                    continue
                tag = self._tag(item)
                if tag in SKIP_TAGS:
                    continue
                if tag in INLINE_TAGS:
                    walk(item, in_link or tag == "a")
                elif tag == "br":
                    buffer.append(" ")
                else:
                    flush()
                    stack.append(Container(tag, item, len(stack), self._hint))
                    walk(item, in_link)
                    flush()
                    stack.pop()

        walk(root, False)
        flush()
        return out


# --- selectolax (Lexbor) --------------------------------------------------------------------------


class SelectolaxDom(_TreeDom[LexborNode]):
    name: ParserName = "selectolax"

    def _build(self, html: str) -> None:
        self._tree = LexborHTMLParser(html)

    def _select(self, css: str) -> list[LexborNode]:
        return list(self._tree.css(css))

    def _drop(self, el: LexborNode) -> None:
        el.decompose()

    def _tag(self, el: LexborNode) -> str:
        return el.tag or ""

    def _attr(self, el: LexborNode, name: str) -> str | None:
        value = el.attrs.get(name)
        return value if isinstance(value, str) else None

    def _content(self, el: LexborNode) -> Iterator[LexborNode | str]:
        for child in el.iter(include_text=True):
            tag = child.tag
```

>   - **Rewritten:** `__init__.py`, now a docstring only, so `extract.types` (imported by the API contract) does not load the parsers.
> - `scripts/capture_skeletons.py`
> - `backend/tests/fixtures/skeletons/`: 10 sources × (`article-1.html` + `.expected.json`), plus `vocabulary.json`. Total 1.0 MB.
> - `backend/tests/unit/extract/`: `__init__.py`, `_skeletons.py` (a helper module, not a conftest), and tests for dom, profiles, jsonld, density, cascade, registry, scope, third-party, skeletons and purity.
> - `sources.toml` was not edited. Its `M` status comes from P1.
> 
> ### What works
> - `uv run pytest backend/tests/unit/extract -q`: 359 passed, 36 skipped, 2.5 s. The skips are the jsonld cells on the 9 skeletons that have no JSON-LD body.
> - On skeletons, own strategies on all 4 parsers find every body marker with zero non-body text. Density finds 87–100% of body markers and never outputs a non-body line.
> - `uv run ruff check` and `ruff format --check` on my paths: clean.
> - `uv run mypy backend/src/veritrade/extract backend/tests/unit/extract scripts/capture_skeletons.py`: no issues in 23 files.
> - `uv run python scripts/capture_skeletons.py`: running it again gives byte-identical files (shasum).
>   - A leak scan against the source pages found 0 shared 4-word sequences.
>   - Purity tests check every text node, every JSON-LD string, the alt/title/aria attributes and the text metas against a 98-word vocabulary. All links point to `example.invalid`.
> - Real probe HTML (`.temp/P2/extract/summary.py`): mean words per page over 3 pages. P/R is token precision/recall against the profile output.
> 
> | source | profile | density P/R | cascade | trafilatura P/R |
> |---|---|---|---|---|
> | yahoo | 846 | 1.00/1.00 | profile | 0.91/1.00 |
> | cnbc | 835 | 1.00/0.99 | profile | 0.99/1.00 |
> | fool | 518 | 0.94/1.00 | profile | 0.95/1.00 |
> | prnewswire | 437 | 1.00/1.00 | profile | 0.90/1.00 |
> | globenewswire | 706 | 1.00/1.00 | profile | 0.72/1.00 |
> | sec | 4225 | 1.00/0.99 | profile | empty |
> | cnn | 816 (jsonld 801) | 0.98/1.00 | jsonld | 0.97/1.00 |
> | fortune | 1035 | 0.98/0.99 | profile | 0.97/1.00 |
> | guardian | 630 | 1.00/1.00 | profile | 1.00/1.00 |
> | bbc | 1132 | 1.00/0.97 | profile | 0.95/1.00 |
> 
>   The gap between GlobeNewswire's 706 words and the third-party tools' ~935 is the "About" section, forward-looking statements and contacts that the profile cuts.
> - Timing per page, warm run, p50/p95 in ms:
> 
> | extractor | selectolax | lxml | bs4 | bs4-lxml |
> |---|---|---|---|---|
> | cascade | 1.1/2.1 | 1.9/3.6 | 12.6/35.3 | 9.6/25.2 |
> | jsonld | 0.2/1.9 | 0.2/1.9 | 0.2/1.9 | 0.2/1.9 |
> 
>   Third-party (no parser choice), p50/p95 ms: trafilatura 11/50, trafilatura-precision 15/54, readability 15/122, newspaper 66/143, justext 10/41, strip-tags 2/12.
> 
> ### Deviations from the plan and why
> - **Lazy DOM:** the tree is only built when a strategy needs it, and its build time goes to `parse_ms`. JSON-LD is read from the raw HTML string, so it gives the same result on every parser. When JSON-LD wins the cascade, nothing is parsed: CNN's 5.5 MB pages take about 2 ms instead of 8–36 ms.
> - **Profile rules, compared with `apply_profile`:**
>   - Stop markers are checked before `min_words`. Otherwise a two-word "About Acme" heading never ends the release; on SEC page 2 that cut about 1,450 words of boilerplate.
>   - Markers ending in a space ("About ") need a capital letter next or a heading of at most 8 words, so "About 40% of…" does not cut a story.
>   - The generic forward-looking/contacts stops now apply to every profile.
>   - Boilerplate lines such as "Story continues" are dropped.
>   - A line of at most 15 words containing an email address is dropped as a contact line rather than ending the body, because "Send tips to…" lines can sit mid-article.
>   - When a selector list matches both an `<li>` and the `<p>` inside it, the inner text is no longer duplicated.
> - **Density leakage:** a "leaked line" is one that holds only non-body text. Fool's inline ticker chips inside body paragraphs therefore do not count.
> - **Skeleton attributes:** attribute values that are not structural and contain letters become "vt". Ids made from headline words are renamed. `data-testid`, `data-cy`, `itemprop` and attributes used in profile selectors are kept.
> - **lxml:** it now uses `huge_tree`, because without it libxml2 silently drops text nested more than 256 levels deep. The tree walkers no longer use recursion, for the same deeply nested pages.
> - **`Article.paywalled`:** set whenever JSON-LD marks the article not free. CNN and Fortune are flagged even though their text is complete.
> 
> ### Open issues
> - **bs4 with html.parser** gives different results on PR Newswire pages 1 and 3 (+54 words) and SEC page 3. html.parser does not repair unclosed tags the way an HTML5 parser does; the matrix should show this.
> - **Third-party failures:** trafilatura returns nothing on real SEC exhibits, which are wrapped in EDGAR's SGML envelope. readability fails on Fool and Fortune.
> - **SEC pages have no title.** `build_input` then leaves out the `TITLE:` line.
> - **e2e fixtures:** `fixtures.local` is not a known source, so the cascade falls back to density there unless e2e serves the fixtures under the source domains.
> - **Yahoo:** partner promos inside the body are still kept.
> 
> ### Requests
> - **E2e/compose owner:** keep each fixture's source hostname in the URL (`expected.json` has `fixture_url`), or we agree on a host-to-source override. No dependency or contract changes are needed.

```
"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    tests = ["backend/tests", "evals/tests"] if full else ["backend/tests/unit", "evals/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true", help="unit tests only, no build (default)")
    mode.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="integration tests, coverage floor, build")
    parser.add_argument("--backend", action="store_true", help="only backend + evals")
    parser.add_argument("--frontend", action="store_true", help="only frontend")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_be = not args.frontend or args.backend
    run_fe = not args.backend or args.frontend
    steps = (backend_steps(args.full) if run_be else []) + (frontend_steps(args.full) if run_fe else [])

    failed = []
    for name, cmd, cwd in steps:
        print(f"\n== {name}: {' '.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
        if subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd).returncode != 0:
            failed.append(name)
    if failed:
        sys.exit(f"\nFAILED: {', '.join(failed)}")
    print("\nall checks passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"""Write backend/openapi.json from the FastAPI app; --check fails on drift (CI contract gate)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from veritrade.api.app import create_app
from veritrade.config import Settings

TARGET = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "backend" / "openapi.json"


def render() -> str:
    app = create_app(Settings(static_dir=None))
    return json.dumps(app.openapi(), indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rendered = render()
    if args.check:
        if not TARGET.exists() or TARGET.read_text() != rendered:
            sys.exit("backend/openapi.json is stale: run `uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py`")
        print("openapi.json up to date")
        return
    TARGET.write_text(rendered)
    print(f"wrote {TARGET}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```
"""Parse Claude Code *dynamic Workflow* runs (issue #174, PR1 — parse only).

A Workflow tool_use launches an orchestrator that fans out into many
side-channel sub-agents. On disk (see ``work/dynamic-workflow-support.md``
§1) a run under a trunk session ``<sid>/`` leaves:

    <sid>/subagents/workflows/<runId>/
        journal.jsonl                 live spine: started/result events, keyed by agentId
        agent-<agentId>.jsonl         per-agent side-channel transcript
        agent-<agentId>.meta.json     {"agentType": "workflow-subagent"}
    <sid>/workflows/<runId>.json      terminal snapshot: phases + per-agent metadata
                                      + the script that ran (+ args, summary,
                                      error, run totals)

This module turns that into a :class:`WorkflowRun`. Strategy (D1):
journal-led, ``<runId>.json``-enriched — ``journal.jsonl`` is the
authoritative live spine (present from the start, carries full results,
keyed by ``agentId``); ``<runId>.json`` is *optional* enrichment present
only after completion (phases + tokens/state/model per agent). A running
workflow with no snapshot still parses: agents in journal order, no phase
grouping.

This module does **no rendering** — wiring runs into the message tree is
a later phase. ``load_transcript`` is imported lazily to avoid a circular
import with ``converter``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Optional, cast

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_WF_META_RE = re.compile(
    r"export\s+(?:const|let|var)\s+meta\s*=\s*\{(.*?)\n\}", re.DOTALL
)
# A JS string literal in any of the three quote styles, with backslash-escape
# support — real meta descriptions contain escaped quotes ('SAM\'s ...'),
# which a naive [^'\"]* would truncate at.
_WF_JS_STRING = (
    r"(?:'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)'"
    r'|"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"'
    r"|`((?:[^`\\]|\\.)*)`)"
)
_WF_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"\bname\s*:\s*" + _WF_JS_STRING)
_WF_DESC_RE = re.compile(r"\bdescription\s*:\s*" + _WF_JS_STRING)
_WF_PHASES_KEY_RE = re.compile(r"\bphases\s*:")
_WF_TITLE_RE = re.compile(r"title\s*:\s*" + _WF_JS_STRING)




def _parse_journal(path: Path) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, Any]]:
    """Parse ``journal.jsonl`` into (agent order, {agentId: result}).

    Order is by first appearance (``started`` preferred, else ``result``).
    The last ``result`` for an agent wins (covers retries/attempts).
    """
    order: list[str] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for raw_row in _read_jsonl(path):
        if not isinstance(raw_row, dict):
            continue
        row = cast("dict[str, Any]", raw_row)
        agent_id = row.get("agentId")
        if not isinstance(agent_id, str):
            continue
        if agent_id not in seen:
            seen.add(agent_id)
            order.append(agent_id)
        if row.get("type") == "result":
            results[agent_id] = row.get("result")
    return order, results


def _load_snapshot(
    path: Path,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[dict[str, Any]], dict[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """Load ``<runId>.json`` → (raw, phases[], {agentId: agent-progress-node}).

    Returns empty structures when the file is missing or unparseable, so
    callers can treat the snapshot as purely optional enrichment.
    """
    try:
        loaded = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {}, [], {}
    if not isinstance(loaded, dict):
        return {}, [], {}
    raw = cast("dict[str, Any]", loaded)

    raw_phases = raw.get("phases")
    phases: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if isinstance(raw_phases, list):
        phases = [
            cast("dict[str, Any]", p)
            for p in cast("list[Any]", raw_phases)
            if isinstance(p, dict)
        ]

    agent_meta: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    raw_progress = raw.get("workflowProgress")
    if isinstance(raw_progress, list):
        for raw_node in cast("list[Any]", raw_progress):
            if not isinstance(raw_node, dict):
                continue
            node = cast("dict[str, Any]", raw_node)
            if node.get("type") != "workflow_agent":
                continue
            aid = node.get("agentId")
            if isinstance(aid, str):
                agent_meta[aid] = node
    return raw, phases, agent_meta


def parse_workflow_run(
    run_dir: Path,
    snapshot_path: Optional[Path] = None,
    *,
    silent: bool = True,
) -> Optional[WorkflowRun]:
    """Parse one workflow run from its ``subagents/workflows/<runId>/`` dir.

    ``snapshot_path`` is the optional ``<runId>.json`` terminal snapshot.
    A run that failed before launching any agent leaves a snapshot but NO
    run dir/journal — that still parses (as a snapshot-only run with an
    empty ``agents`` list), so the failure stays visible at the tool_use.
    Returns ``None`` when there is neither a journal nor a snapshot (not a
    workflow run).
    """
    journal = run_dir / "journal.jsonl"
    has_journal = journal.is_file()
    order: list[str] = []
    results: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if has_journal:
        order, results = _parse_journal(journal)
    elif snapshot_path is None or not snapshot_path.is_file():
        return None

    run_id = run_dir.name
    task_id = workflow_name = status = ""
    total_tokens: Optional[int] = None
    agent_count: Optional[int] = None
    run_result: Any = None
    phases_meta: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    agent_meta: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
    has_snapshot = False
    script = script_path = summary = error = default_model = ""
    run_args: Any = None
    duration_ms: Optional[int] = None
    total_tool_calls: Optional[int] = None

    if snapshot_path is not None and snapshot_path.is_file():
        raw, phases_meta, agent_meta = _load_snapshot(snapshot_path)
        if raw:
            has_snapshot = True
            run_id = raw.get("runId") or run_id
            task_id = raw.get("taskId") or ""
            workflow_name = raw.get("workflowName") or ""
            status = raw.get("status") or ""
            total_tokens = _as_int(raw.get("totalTokens"))
            agent_count = _as_int(raw.get("agentCount"))
            run_result = raw.get("result")
            script = _as_str(raw.get("script"))
            script_path = _as_str(raw.get("scriptPath"))
            run_args = raw.get("args")
            summary = _as_str(raw.get("summary"))
            error = _as_str(raw.get("error"))
            default_model = _as_str(raw.get("defaultModel"))
            duration_ms = _as_int(raw.get("durationMs"))
            total_tool_calls = _as_int(raw.get("totalToolCalls"))

    if not has_journal and not has_snapshot:
        # A snapshot file that failed to load — nothing to build a run from.
        return None

    # Union of journal order with any snapshot-only agent ids (defensive).
    all_ids = list(order)
    for aid in agent_meta:
        if aid not in all_ids:
            all_ids.append(aid)

    # Lazy import avoids a circular dependency with converter.
    from claude_code_log.converter import load_transcript

    agents: list[WorkflowAgent] = []
    for aid in all_ids:
        meta = agent_meta.get(aid, {})
        agent_file = run_dir / f"agent-{aid}.jsonl"
        entries: list[Any] = []
        if agent_file.is_file():
            entries = load_transcript(agent_file, silent=silent)
        agents.append(
            WorkflowAgent(
                agent_id=aid,
                label=meta.get("label") or "",
                phase_index=_as_int(meta.get("phaseIndex")),
                phase_title=meta.get("phaseTitle") or "",
                model=meta.get("model") or "",
                state=meta.get("state") or "",
                tokens=_as_int(meta.get("tokens")),
                tool_calls=_as_int(meta.get("toolCalls")),
                duration_ms=_as_int(meta.get("durationMs")),
                attempt=_as_int(meta.get("attempt")),
                result=results.get(aid),
                result_preview=meta.get("resultPreview") or "",
                entries=entries,
            )
        )

    phases = _group_into_phases(phases_meta, agents)

    return WorkflowRun(
        run_id=run_id,
        task_id=task_id,
        workflow_name=workflow_name,
        status=status,
        phases=phases,
        agents=agents,
        result=run_result,
        total_tokens=total_tokens,
        agent_count=agent_count,
        has_snapshot=has_snapshot,
        script=script,
        script_path=script_path,
        args=run_args,
        summary=summary,
        error=error,
        default_model=default_model,
        duration_ms=duration_ms,


def discover_workflow_runs(session_dir: Path) -> list[tuple[Path, Optional[Path]]]:
    """Find ``(run_dir, snapshot_path)`` pairs under one trunk session dir.

    ``run_dir`` is ``<session_dir>/subagents/workflows/<runId>/`` (must
    contain ``journal.jsonl``); ``snapshot_path`` is the matching
    ``<session_dir>/workflows/<runId>.json`` if present, else ``None``.

    Also surfaces *snapshot-only* runs: a workflow that died before
    launching any agent (e.g. a script error on the first line) leaves a
    ``<session_dir>/workflows/<runId>.json`` but no run dir at all. These
    yield a (non-existent) ``run_dir`` path alongside their snapshot, which
    :func:`parse_workflow_run` accepts.
    """
    base = session_dir / "subagents" / "workflows"
    snapshots_dir = session_dir / "workflows"
    runs: list[tuple[Path, Optional[Path]]] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    if base.is_dir():
        for run_dir in sorted(base.iterdir()):
            if not run_dir.is_dir() or not (run_dir / "journal.jsonl").is_file():
                continue
            seen.add(run_dir.name)
            snapshot = snapshots_dir / f"{run_dir.name}.json"
            runs.append((run_dir, snapshot if snapshot.is_file() else None))
    if snapshots_dir.is_dir():
        for snapshot in sorted(snapshots_dir.glob("*.json")):
            run_id = snapshot.stem
            if run_id not in seen:
                runs.append((base / run_id, snapshot))
    return runs


def _runs_in_session_dir(
    session_dir: Path, *, silent: bool = True
) -> list[WorkflowRun]:
    """Parse every workflow run under one trunk session dir's
    ``subagents/workflows/``. Shared by the directory and single-file loaders."""
    runs: list[WorkflowRun] = []
    for run_dir, snapshot in discover_workflow_runs(session_dir):
        parsed = parse_workflow_run(run_dir, snapshot, silent=silent)
        if parsed is not None:
            runs.append(parsed)
    return runs


def load_workflow_runs(
    directory_path: Path, *, silent: bool = True
) -> list[WorkflowRun]:
    """Discover and parse every workflow run under a project directory.

    Each trunk ``<session>.jsonl`` has a sibling ``<session>/`` dir whose
    ``subagents/workflows/<runId>/`` subtrees are the runs. Parse-only —
    the caller decides what to do with the returned runs.
    """
    runs: list[WorkflowRun] = []
    for session_dir in sorted(p for p in directory_path.iterdir() if p.is_dir()):
        runs.extend(_runs_in_session_dir(session_dir, silent=silent))
    return runs


def load_session_workflow_runs(
    transcript_path: Path, *, silent: bool = True
) -> list[WorkflowRun]:
    """Discover + parse workflow runs for a SINGLE session transcript file
    (issue #174 PR3 — single-file rendering).

    The runs live in the sibling ``<SID>/subagents/workflows/<runId>/`` dir
    (snapshot ``<SID>/workflows/<runId>.json``), where ``<SID>`` is the
    transcript filename without its ``.jsonl`` suffix. Mirrors
    :func:`load_workflow_runs` scoped to one session, so
    ``claude-code-log <project>/<SID>.jsonl`` renders the workflow tree just
    like a directory load.
    """
    return _runs_in_session_dir(transcript_path.with_suffix(""), silent=silent)


def _tool_result_text(content: Any) -> str:
    """Best-effort plain text from a raw ``ToolResultContent.content`` (a
    string, or a list of ``{type, text, ...}`` dicts) for ``Task ID:`` lookup."""
```

```python
"""Structure-only survey of the session files: types, subtypes, keys. Prints no content values."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
SID = sys.argv[2]

files = [ROOT / f"{SID}.jsonl"]
sd = ROOT / SID
files += sorted(p for p in (sd / "subagents").rglob("*.jsonl"))

types: Counter[str] = Counter()
att: Counter[str] = Counter()
sysst: Counter[str] = Counter()
blocks: Counter[str] = Counter()
keys_by_type: dict[str, Counter[str]] = {}
msg_keys: Counter[str] = Counter()
tr_content_types: Counter[str] = Counter()
tool_names: Counter[str] = Counter()
api_keys: Counter[str] = Counter()
entrypoints: Counter[str] = Counter()
versions: Counter[str] = Counter()
for f in files:
    for line in f.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            types["<bad-json>"] += 1
            continue
        t = r.get("type", "<none>")
        types[t] += 1
        keys_by_type.setdefault(t, Counter()).update(r.keys())
        if "entrypoint" in r:
            entrypoints[str(r["entrypoint"])] += 1
        if "version" in r:
            versions[str(r["version"])] += 1
        if t == "attachment":
            a = r.get("attachment", {})
            att[str(a.get("type"))] += 1
        if t == "system":
            sysst[str(r.get("subtype"))] += 1
        if t.startswith("api-request"):
            for k, v in r.items():
                api_keys[f"{t}.{k}"] += 1
                if isinstance(v, dict):
                    for k2 in v:
                        api_keys[f"{t}.{k}.{k2}"] += 1
        m = r.get("message")
        if isinstance(m, dict):
            msg_keys.update(f"{t}.{k}" for k in m)
            c = m.get("content")
            if isinstance(c, list):
                for b in c:
                    if isinstance(b, dict):
                        blocks[f"{t}.{b.get('type')}"] += 1
                        if b.get("type") == "tool_use":
                            tool_names[str(b.get("name"))] += 1
                        if b.get("type") == "tool_result":
                            cc = b.get("content")
                            if isinstance(cc, list):
                                for x in cc:
                                    if isinstance(x, dict):
                                        tr_content_types[str(x.get("type"))] += 1
                            else:
                                tr_content_types[type(cc).__name__] += 1
            else:
                blocks[f"{t}.<{type(c).__name__}>"] += 1

print("files", len(files))
for name, c in [
    ("types", types),
    ("attachment", att),
    ("system", sysst),
    ("blocks", blocks),
    ("tr_content", tr_content_types),
    ("tools", tool_names),
    ("msg_keys", msg_keys),
    ("api_keys", api_keys),
    ("entrypoints", entrypoints),
    ("versions", versions),
]:
    print(f"== {name}")
    for k, v in sorted(c.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1]):
        print(f"  {v:6d} {k}")
print("== keys by type")
for t, c in keys_by_type.items():
    print(f"  {t}: {sorted(c)}")
```

```python
"""Survey config-ish values (thinking params, effort, modes) and nested key shapes. No free text."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
SID = sys.argv[2]
files = [ROOT / f"{SID}.jsonl", *sorted((ROOT / SID / "subagents").rglob("*.jsonl"))]

c: Counter[str] = Counter()


def shape(v: object) -> str:
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return "{" + ",".join(sorted(v)) + "}"
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return f"list[{len(v)}]"
    return type(v).__name__


for f in files:
    for line in f.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        t = r.get("type")
        if t == "api-request":
            p = r["params"]
            c[f"params.thinking={json.dumps(p.get('thinking'), sort_keys=True)}"] += 1
            c[f"params.output_config={json.dumps(p.get('output_config'), sort_keys=True)[:200]}"] += 1
            c[f"params.model={p.get('model')}"] += 1
            c[f"api.querySource={r.get('querySource')}"] += 1
        if t == "assistant":
            for k in ("effort", "perTurnEffort", "thinkingDisplay", "requestedModel", "advisorModel"):
                if k in r:
                    c[f"asst.{k}={json.dumps(r[k])[:120]}"] += 1
            for k in ("serverClassifierRequest", "wireIngestContext", "wireToolInputs", "requestRef",
                      "attributionAgent", "attributionSkill"):
                if k in r:
                    c[f"asst.{k} shape={shape(r[k])}"] += 1
            m = r["message"]
            for k in ("container", "diagnostics", "context_management", "input_transformations", "usage"):
                c[f"asst.msg.{k} shape={shape(m.get(k))}"] += 1
            u = m.get("usage") or {}
            for k, v in u.items():
                if isinstance(v, dict):
                    c[f"usage.{k} keys={sorted(v)}"] += 1
            for b in m.get("content", []):
                if b.get("type") == "thinking":
                    c[f"thinking keys={sorted(b)} textlen>0={bool(b.get('thinking'))}"] += 1
        if t == "user":
            for k in ("serverClassifierContext", "toolUseResult", "origin", "promptSource", "turnCompanion",
                      "turnOrigin", "permissionDecision", "queueSkipAttachments"):
                if k in r:
                    c[f"user.{k} shape={shape(r[k])[:200]}"] += 1
        if t == "attachment":
            a = r["attachment"]
            if a.get("type") in ("model", "date", "plan_mode", "skill_mention", "ultra_effort_enter",
                                 "queued_command", "plan_mode_exit", "auto_mode"):
                c[f"att.{a['type']} keys={sorted(a)}"] += 1
            c[f"att.rendered shape={shape(r.get('rendered'))}"] += 1
        if t == "mode":
            c[f"mode={r.get('mode')}"] += 1
        if t == "permission-mode":
            c[f"permission-mode={r.get('permissionMode')}"] += 1
        if t == "system":
            c[f"system.{r.get('subtype')} level={r.get('level')} content_shape={shape(r.get('content'))}"] += 1
        if t == "cost-state":
            c[f"cost-state.modelUsage shape={shape(r.get('modelUsage'))}"] += 1

for k, v in sorted(c.items()):
    print(f"{v:6d} {k}")
```

```
    # Hold what we just parsed for the next tick, BEFORE the whole-file
    # passes below — they mutate entries in place (back-patching
    # `spawnedAgentId`) and splice agent blocks in, and a resumed parse
    # must start from the raw per-line products and re-run them.
    if byte_parse is not None and entry_store is not None:
        byte_parse.commit(entry_store, messages, agent_ids)

    # How many entries came straight off the file's own lines, before any
    # of the whole-file passes below can add or alter one. The append-only
    # cache write is gated on this being the whole story (see
    # `_appended_rows`).
    parsed_line_count = len(messages)
    had_agent_refs = bool(agent_ids)

    # Sidecar-driven spawn linking (issue #213): resolve each spawning
    # tool_use to its sub-agent via the agent-<id>.meta.json files. This is
    # what makes NESTED spawns discoverable — a sub-agent's own spawn
    # tool_results carry no ``toolUseResult.agentId`` (trunk-only
    # enrichment), and an interrupted spawn has no usable tool_result at
    # all; the sidecar's ``toolUseId`` covers both.
    subagent_meta = _subagent_meta_map(jsonl_path, _meta_maps)
    _apply_subagent_meta_links(messages, subagent_meta, agent_ids, jsonl_path)

    # Prompt-hash fallback: link Task tool_results that lack a structured
    # agentId (common for true teammate subagents) by matching the
    # tool_use's prompt input against the <teammate-message
    # teammate_id="team-lead"> body of each unlinked subagent file's
    # first entry. See issue #91 — also fixes #79 and #90 along the way.
    _link_subagents_by_prompt_hash(messages, jsonl_path, agent_ids)

    # Load agent files if any were referenced
    # Build a map of agentId -> agent messages
```

```
def parse_webfetch_output(
    tool_result: ToolResultContent,
    file_path: Optional[str],
    tool_use_result: Optional[ToolUseResult] = None,
) -> Optional[WebFetchOutput]:
    """Parse WebFetch tool result from structured toolUseResult.

    WebFetch results include metadata from toolUseResult:
    - bytes: Size of fetched content
    - code: HTTP status code
    - codeText: HTTP status text
    - result: The processed markdown result
    - durationMs: Time taken in milliseconds
    - url: The URL that was fetched

    Args:
        tool_result: The tool result content (used as fallback)
        file_path: Unused for WebFetch tool
        tool_use_result: Structured result containing rich metadata

    Returns:
        WebFetchOutput if parsing succeeds, None otherwise
    """
    del file_path  # Unused

    # Prefer structured toolUseResult when available
    if tool_use_result is not None and isinstance(tool_use_result, dict):
        url = tool_use_result.get("url")
        result = tool_use_result.get("result")
        is_codex_web_result = tool_use_result.get("codexWebResult") is True
        source_refs_raw = tool_use_result.get("sourceRefs", [])
        source_refs = (
            [ref for ref in cast(list[Any], source_refs_raw) if isinstance(ref, str)]
            if isinstance(source_refs_raw, list)
            else []
        )

        # Claude supplies a URL; Codex's ref-based open/find actions may not.
        if result and (url or is_codex_web_result):
            return WebFetchOutput(
                url=str(url or ""),
                result=str(result),
                bytes=tool_use_result.get("bytes"),
                code=tool_use_result.get("code"),
                code_text=tool_use_result.get("codeText"),
                duration_ms=tool_use_result.get("durationMs"),
                source_refs=source_refs,
            )
        # Structured data present but incomplete — don't fall through
        return None

    # Fallback: use text content as result (agent progress entries lack toolUseResult).
    # URL comes from the tool_use input title, not needed here for rendering.
    content = _extract_tool_result_text(tool_result)
    if content:
        return WebFetchOutput(url="", result=content)

    return None


# Text form of a successful Artifact deploy: ``Published <path> at <url>``.
# Fallback for entries that lack the structured toolUseResult.
_ARTIFACT_PUBLISHED_RE = re.compile(
    r"^Published (?P<path>.+) at (?P<url>https?://\S+)$"
)
) -> Optional[ReadOutput]:
    """Parse Read tool result into structured content.

    Prefers the structured ``toolUseResult.file`` payload (clean content
    plus accurate ``filePath`` / ``startLine`` / ``numLines`` / ``totalLines``
    metadata) when available; falls back to re-parsing the ``cat -n``
    formatted ``tool_result.content`` text for older transcripts.

    Args:
        tool_result: The tool result content (cat-n formatted text)
        file_path: Path to the file that was read (required for ReadOutput)
        tool_use_result: Structured toolUseResult; ``file`` dict gives us
            clean content + exact line metadata without re-parsing cat-n

    Returns:
        ReadOutput if parsing succeeds, None otherwise
    """
    if not file_path:
        return None

    # Preferred path: structured toolUseResult.file is byte-clean and carries
    # the exact line metadata. Avoids the lossy cat-n round-trip and gives us
    # totalLines (which the text-only fallback cannot recover).
    if isinstance(tool_use_result, dict):
        file_info: dict[str, Any] = tool_use_result.get("file") or {}
        content_field: Any = file_info.get("content")
        if isinstance(content_field, str):
            # ``numLines`` may legitimately be 0 for an empty-file read, so
            # distinguish *absent* from *zero* explicitly — the
            # ``... or default`` truthiness shortcut would silently promote
            # the zero case to the fallback. Same for ``totalLines`` and
            # ``startLine``. ``splitlines()`` over ``split("\n")`` for the
            # absent-numLines fallback so content ending in ``\n`` does not
            # tack on a phantom trailing element ("x\ny\n".splitlines() →
            # ["x", "y"], length 2 not 3).
            num_lines_raw = file_info.get("numLines")
            num_lines = (
                int(num_lines_raw)
                if num_lines_raw is not None
                else len(content_field.splitlines())
            )
            total_lines_raw = file_info.get("totalLines")
            total_lines = (
                int(total_lines_raw) if total_lines_raw is not None else num_lines
            )
            start_line_raw = file_info.get("startLine")
            start_line = int(start_line_raw) if start_line_raw is not None else 1
            return ReadOutput(
                file_path=str(file_info.get("filePath") or file_path),
                content=content_field,
                start_line=start_line,
```

```python
"""Classify system reminder tag occurrences (what follows the tag, where it sits). Prints no content."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
SID = sys.argv[2]
files = [ROOT / f"{SID}.jsonl", *sorted((ROOT / SID / "subagents").rglob("*.jsonl"))]
OPEN = "<" + "system reminder>"
CLOSE = "</" + "system reminder>"
c: Counter[str] = Counter()


def walk(v: Any, where: str) -> None:
    if isinstance(v, str):
        for m in re.finditer(re.escape(OPEN), v):
            nxt = v[m.end() : m.end() + 1]
            has_close = CLOSE in v[m.end() :]
            pos = "start" if m.start() == 0 else ("after-nl" if v[m.start() - 1] == "\n" else "inline")
            c[f"{where} next={nxt!r} close={has_close} pos={pos}"] += 1
    elif isinstance(v, dict):
        for k, x in v.items():
            walk(x, f"{where}.{k}" if k in ("message", "content", "attachment", "input", "text") else where)
    elif isinstance(v, list):
        for x in v:
            walk(x, where)


for f in files:
    for line in f.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        t = r.get("type")
        if t not in ("user", "assistant", "attachment", "system", "queue-operation"):
            continue
        walk(r, str(t))

for k, v in sorted(c.items()):
    print(f"{v:6d} {k}")
```

```python
"""Check whether usage differs across content-block records sharing one message.id."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
SID = sys.argv[2]
files = [ROOT / f"{SID}.jsonl", *sorted((ROOT / SID / "subagents").rglob("*.jsonl"))]
c: Counter[str] = Counter()
for f in files:
    groups: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = defaultdict(list)
    for line in f.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if r.get("type") == "assistant":
            m = r["message"]
            groups[m["id"]].append(m.get("usage") or {})
    for _mid, us in groups.items():
        c[f"records_per_id={min(len(us), 5)}"] += 1
        same = all(json.dumps(u, sort_keys=True) == json.dumps(us[0], sort_keys=True) for u in us)
        c[f"identical={same}"] += 1
        if not same:
            outs = [u.get("output_tokens") for u in us]
            c[f"output_monotonic={outs == sorted(outs)}"] += 1
    c["files"] += 1
for k, v in sorted(c.items()):
    print(v, k)
```

```python
"""List isMeta user records (length + short head) and Skill tool inputs, to judge skill-body exposure."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(sys.argv[1])
SID = sys.argv[2]
files = [ROOT / f"{SID}.jsonl", *sorted((ROOT / SID / "subagents").rglob("*.jsonl"))]
for f in files:
    for line in f.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
        try:
            r = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            continue
        if r.get("type") == "user" and r.get("isMeta"):
            c = r["message"]["content"]
            text = c if isinstance(c, str) else " | ".join(
                b.get("text", f"<{b.get('type')}>") for b in c if isinstance(b, dict)
            )
            print(f"META {f.name[:20]} len={len(text)} head={text[:90]!r}")
        if r.get("type") == "assistant":
            for b in r["message"]["content"]:
                if b.get("type") == "tool_use" and b.get("name") in ("Skill", "Workflow", "Agent"):
                    inp = {k: (v if len(str(v)) < 80 else f"<{len(str(v))} chars>") for k, v in b["input"].items()}
                    print(f"TOOL {f.name[:20]} {b['name']} {inp}")
        if r.get("type") == "attachment" and r["attachment"].get("type") in ("skill_mention", "queued_command"):
            a = r["attachment"]
            print(f"ATT {f.name[:20]} {a.get('type')} keys={sorted(a)} skill={a.get('skillName')}")
```
