```python
"""Export this repo's Claude Code session as a redacted transcript: raw JSONL, HTML/Markdown, meta.json.

Everything is built in a staging dir; outputs reach --out only after a leak gate scans every file.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from collections.abc import Iterator
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
DEFAULT_STAGING = ROOT / ".temp" / "transcript" / "staging"
DEFAULT_OUT = ROOT / ".context" / "transcript"
DEFAULT_DENYLIST = ROOT / ".temp" / "transcript" / "denylist.txt"
RENDERER = "claude-code-log@1.7.0"
RENDER_FLAGS = ("--depth", "tool", "--image-export-mode", "placeholder", "--no-cache")
PROJECT_NAME = "veritrade-analytics"
STAGING_MARKER = ".transcript-staging"
OUTPUT_NAMES = ("raw", "rendered", "meta.json", "README.md")
MAX_FILE_BYTES = 50 * 1024 * 1024

ALLOWED_EMAILS = frozenset({"kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com", "noreply@anthropic.com"})
PRIVATE_DATA = "evals/data/private"
HTML_MIN_CHARS = 2048
WEB_MIN_CHARS = 4096
PRIVATE_MENTION_MIN_CHARS = 1024
FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS = 300
SKILL_BODY_MIN_CHARS = 500

# Assembled at runtime so this file's source, once it appears in the transcript it exports,
# carries none of the literals the gate hunts for.
SR = "system" + "-reminder"
BLOB = "api-request" + "-blob"
SESSION_CTX = "session" + "_context"

KEEP_TYPES = frozenset(
    {"user", "assistant", "system", "attachment", "mode", "permission-mode", "ai-title", "custom-title"}
    | {"agent-name"}
)
KEEP_SYSTEM = frozenset({"informational", "turn_duration", "away_summary"})
KEEP_ATTACHMENTS = frozenset(
    {"plan_mode", "ultra_effort_enter", "model", "date", "skill_mention", "queued_command"}
)
BASE_KEYS = frozenset(
    {"type", "uuid", "parentUuid", "logicalParentUuid", "isSidechain", "userType", "cwd", "sessionId"}
    | {"version", "gitBranch", "agentId", "timestamp", "isMeta", "entrypoint"}
)
TYPE_KEYS: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {
    "user": frozenset(
        {"message", "sourceToolUseID", "sourceToolAssistantUUID", "toolUseResult", "permissionMode"}
        | {"origin", "isCompactSummary", "isVisibleInTranscriptOnly"}
    ),
    "assistant": frozenset({"message", "requestId", "isApiErrorMessage", "error", "effort"}),
    "system": frozenset({"subtype", "content", "level", "durationMs", "messageCount", "compactMetadata"}),
    "attachment": frozenset({"attachment"}),
    "mode": frozenset({"mode"}),
    "permission-mode": frozenset({"permissionMode"}),
    "ai-title": frozenset({"aiTitle"}),
    "custom-title": frozenset({"customTitle"}),
    "agent-name": frozenset({"agentName"}),
}
MESSAGE_KEYS = frozenset({"id", "type", "role", "model", "content", "stop_reason", "stop_sequence", "usage"})
# toolUseResult duplicates tool output (files, pages, stdout); only spawn/workflow/answer links survive.
LINK_RESULT_KEYS = frozenset({"agentId", "taskId", "runId", "answers"})
SLIM_RESULT_KEYS = frozenset(
    {"agentId", "status", "description", "isAsync", "resolvedModel", "taskId", "taskType", "runId"}
    | {"workflowName", "summary", "answers", "questions", "annotations"}
)
MODEL_AUTHORED_TOOLS = frozenset(
    {"Agent", "Task", "Workflow", "SendMessage", "AskUserQuestion", "ExitPlanMode", "EnterPlanMode"}
    | {"Skill", "TodoWrite", "ToolSearch", "TaskOutput", "SubagentHandback"}
)
TARGET_KEYS = frozenset({"file_path", "path", "notebook_path", "pattern", "glob", "command", "url"})
WEB_TOOL_RE = re.compile(r"fetch|get_page_text|read_page|scrape", re.IGNORECASE)
FETCH_CMD_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:curl|wget)\b|requests\.get|urlopen|httpx\.get")
GREP_HIT_RE = re.compile(re.escape(PRIVATE_DATA) + r"/\S*:\d+:")

REMINDER_BLOCK_RE = re.compile("<" + SR + r">(?:\r?\n|\\+n)[\s\S]*?(?:</" + SR + r">|\Z)")
REMINDER_TAG_RE = re.compile("</?" + SR + ">")
MARKER_WORDS = ((SR, "system reminder"), (BLOB, "api request blob"), (SESSION_CTX, "session context"))
EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)*\.[A-Za-z]{2,}")
HOME_RE = re.compile(r"~/\s\"'`<>|:;,)\]}]*")
ENCODED_HOME_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])-Users-[A-Za-z0-9_.]+")
# Short account names collide with real path segments (/dev, /bin), so only distinctive ones count.
_USER = Path.home().name
USER_FRAGMENT_RE = re.compile("/" + re.escape(_USER) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9])") if len(_USER) >= 5 else None
SECRET_RES: dict[str, re.Pattern[str]] = {
    "sk_key": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}"),
    "github_token": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}"),
    "github_pat": re.compile(r"github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}"),
    "aws_key": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Z0-9])AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}(?![A-Z0-9])"),
    "private_key": re.compile(r"-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*KEY-----(?:[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*KEY-----)?"),
    "slack_token": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])xox[abposr]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}"),
    "jwt": re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}"),
    "hf_token": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}"),
    "google_key": re.compile(r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}"),
}
_Q = r"(?:\"|'|&quot;|&#34;|&#39;|&#x27;)"
INSTRUCTIONS_TYPE_RE = re.compile(_Q + r"type" + _Q + r"\s*[:=]\s*" + _Q + r"instructions" + _Q)
# A CSS selector in the renderer's stylesheet is the only legitimate leftover of the reminder word.
SR_LEAK_RE = re.compile(r"(?<!\.)" + re.escape(SR))


def load_denylist(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    if not path.is_file():
        return []
    terms = (line.strip() for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
    return [t for t in terms if t and not t.startswith("#")]


def is_html(text: str) -> bool:
    low = text.lower()
    return "<html" in low or "<!doctype html" in low


@dataclass
class Sanitizer:
    denylist: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    counts: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        terms = sorted(self.denylist, key=len, reverse=True)
        alternation = "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in terms)
        self._deny = re.compile(alternation, re.IGNORECASE) if terms else None

    def _sub(self, rule: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], repl: str, text: str) -> str:
        text, n = regex.subn(repl, text)
        if n:
            self.counts[rule] += n
        return text

    def _email(self, m: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        if m.group(0).lower() in ALLOWED_EMAILS:
            return m.group(0)
        self.counts["email"] += 1
        return "[redacted-email]"

    def redact(self, text: str) -> str:
        for name, regex in SECRET_RES.items():
            text = self._sub(f"secret:{name}", regex, "[redacted-secret]", text)
        text = EMAIL_RE.sub(self._email, text)
        text = self._sub("home_path", HOME_RE, "~", text)
        text = self._sub("home_path", ENCODED_HOME_RE, "-~", text)
        if USER_FRAGMENT_RE is not None:
            text = self._sub("home_path", USER_FRAGMENT_RE, "/[user]", text)
        if self._deny is not None:
            text = self._sub("denylist", self._deny, "[redacted]", text)
        return text

    def strip_reminders(self, text: str) -> str:
        text = self._sub("system_reminder", REMINDER_BLOCK_RE, "", text)
        text = REMINDER_TAG_RE.sub(lambda m: "[/system reminder]" if m[0][1] == "/" else "[system reminder]", text)
        for word, repl in MARKER_WORDS:
            if word in text:
                self.counts["marker_neutralized"] += text.count(word)
                text = text.replace(word, repl)
        return text

    def text(self, text: str) -> str:
        return self.redact(self.strip_reminders(text))

    def omit(self, text: str, reason: str) -> str:
        self.counts[f"omitted:{reason}"] += 1
        digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:16]
        return f"[omitted: publisher/web content, sha256={digest}, {len(text)} chars]"

    def any(self, value: Any) -> Any:
        """Clean every string in a JSON value; long raw HTML anywhere is treated as publisher content."""
        if isinstance(value, str):
            stripped = self.strip_reminders(value)
            if len(stripped) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(stripped):
                return self.omit(stripped, "html")
            return self.redact(stripped)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [self.any(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {k: self.any(v) for k, v in value.items()}
        return value


@dataclass
class ToolInfo:
    name: str
    private: bool = False
    fetch_like: bool = False


def tool_info(block: dict[str, Any]) -> ToolInfo:
    name = str(block.get("name", ""))
    inp = block.get("input") if isinstance(block.get("input"), dict) else {}
    assert isinstance(inp, dict)
    targets = [str(v) for k, v in inp.items() if k in TARGET_KEYS and isinstance(v, str)]
    command = str(inp.get("command", ""))
    return ToolInfo(
        name=name,
        private=any(PRIVATE_DATA in t for t in targets),
        fetch_like=name == "Bash" and bool(FETCH_CMD_RE.search(command)),
    )


def result_text(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(str(i.get("text", "")) for i in content if isinstance(i, dict))
    return ""


def omission_reason(info: ToolInfo | None, text: str) -> str | None:
    """Why a tool result must not be published, or None to keep it."""
    name = info.name if info else ""
    if info and info.private:
        return "private_data"
    if len(text) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(text):
        return "html"
    if WEB_TOOL_RE.search(name) and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if info and info.fetch_like and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if name not in MODEL_AUTHORED_TOOLS and PRIVATE_DATA in text:
        if len(text) > PRIVATE_MENTION_MIN_CHARS or GREP_HIT_RE.search(text):
            return "private_mention"
    return None


@dataclass
class FileContext:
    san: Sanitizer
    tools: dict[str, ToolInfo]


def clean_tool_input(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("id")))
    inp = block.get("input")
    if not isinstance(inp, dict):
        return {**block, "input": ctx.san.any(inp)}
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in inp.items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            stripped = ctx.san.strip_reminders(value)
            if info and info.private and len(stripped) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, "private_data")
            elif len(stripped) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(stripped):
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, "html")
            else:
                out[key] = ctx.san.redact(stripped)
        elif info and info.private and len(json.dumps(value)) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
            out[key] = ctx.san.omit(json.dumps(value), "private_data")
        else:
            out[key] = ctx.san.any(value)
    return {**block, "input": out}


def clean_tool_result(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    content = block.get("content")
    stripped = ctx.san.any_strip(content) if False else _strip_nested(content, ctx.san)
    reason = omission_reason(ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("tool_use_id"))), result_text(stripped))
    if reason:
        return {**block, "content": ctx.san.omit(result_text(stripped), reason)}
    if isinstance(stripped, list):
        items = [omitted_media(i) if is_media(i) else i for i in stripped]
        return {**block, "content": [ctx.san.any(i) for i in items]}
    return {**block, "content": ctx.san.any(stripped)}


def _strip_nested(value: Any, san: Sanitizer) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return san.strip_reminders(value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_strip_nested(v, san) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: _strip_nested(v, san) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def is_media(block: Any) -> bool:
    return isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") in ("image", "document")


def omitted_media(block: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "text", "text": f"[omitted: {block.get('type')}]"}


def clean_text_block(text: str, ctx: FileContext, meta: bool) -> str:
    stripped = ctx.san.strip_reminders(text)
    if meta and len(stripped) > SKILL_BODY_MIN_CHARS:
        ctx.san.counts["omitted:skill_body"] += 1
        return f"[omitted: skill/command instructions, {len(stripped)} chars]"
    if not stripped.strip() and text.strip():
        return "[removed: harness reminder]"
    return ctx.san.redact(stripped)


def clean_content(content: Any, ctx: FileContext, meta: bool) -> Any:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return clean_text_block(content, ctx, meta)
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        return ctx.san.any(content)
    out: list[Any] = []
    for block in content:
        if not isinstance(block, dict):
            out.append(ctx.san.any(block))
            continue
        kind = block.get("type")
        if is_media(block):
            out.append(omitted_media(block))
        elif kind == "text":
            out.append({**block, "text": clean_text_block(str(block.get("text", "")), ctx, meta)})
        elif kind == "thinking":
            kept = {k: v for k, v in block.items() if k != "signature"}
            out.append({**kept, "thinking": ctx.san.text(str(block.get("thinking", "")))})
        elif kind == "redacted_thinking":
            out.append({"type": "text", "text": "[omitted: redacted_thinking]"})
        elif kind == "tool_use":
            out.append(clean_tool_input(block, ctx))
        elif kind == "tool_result":
            out.append(clean_tool_result(block, ctx))
        else:
            out.append(ctx.san.any(block))
    return out


def record_key(rec: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    kind = str(rec.get("type", "<none>"))
    if kind == "attachment":
        return f"attachment:{(rec.get('attachment') or {}).get('type')}"
    if kind == "system":
        return f"system:{rec.get('subtype')}"
    return kind


def filter_record(rec: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Allowlist one transcript record and sanitize what survives; None means drop."""
    kind = rec.get("type")
    if kind not in KEEP_TYPES:
        return None
    if kind == "system" and rec.get("subtype") not in KEEP_SYSTEM:
        return None
    if kind == "attachment" and (rec.get("attachment") or {}).get("type") not in KEEP_ATTACHMENTS:
        return None
    allowed = BASE_KEYS | TYPE_KEYS[str(kind)]
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in rec.items():
        if key not in allowed:
            continue
        if key == "message" and isinstance(value, dict):
            msg = {k: v for k, v in value.items() if k in MESSAGE_KEYS}
            msg["content"] = clean_content(value.get("content"), ctx, bool(rec.get("isMeta")))
            out[key] = ctx.san.any({k: v for k, v in msg.items() if k != "content"}) | {
                "content": msg["content"]
            }
        elif key == "toolUseResult":
            if isinstance(value, dict) and LINK_RESULT_KEYS & value.keys():
                out[key] = ctx.san.any({k: v for k, v in value.items() if k in SLIM_RESULT_KEYS})
        else:
            out[key] = ctx.san.any(value)
    return out


@dataclass
class Harvest:
    """Metadata collected from every record before the allowlist drops anything."""

    versions: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    entrypoints: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    models: dict[str, Counter[str]] = field(default_factory=lambda: defaultdict(Counter))
    usage: dict[tuple[str, str, str], dict[str, int]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    usage_model: dict[tuple[str, str, str], str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    efforts: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    thinking: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    permission_modes: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    modes: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    attachments_seen: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    skills: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    tools: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    subagents: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    workflows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    titles: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    timestamps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    kept: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    dropped: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    cost: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    bad_lines: int = 0

    def record(self, rec: dict[str, Any], scope: str, file_key: str) -> None:
        kind = rec.get("type")
        if isinstance(rec.get("version"), str):
            self.versions[rec["version"]] += 1
        if isinstance(rec.get("entrypoint"), str):
            self.entrypoints[rec["entrypoint"]] += 1
        if isinstance(rec.get("timestamp"), str):
            self.timestamps.append(rec["timestamp"])
        if kind == "assistant":
            self._assistant(rec, scope, file_key)
        elif kind == "api-request":
            thinking = (rec.get("params") or {}).get("thinking")
            if isinstance(thinking, dict):
                picked = {k: thinking[k] for k in ("type", "display") if k in thinking}
                self.thinking[json.dumps(picked, sort_keys=True)] += 1
        elif kind == "permission-mode":
            self.permission_modes[str(rec.get("permissionMode"))] += 1
        elif kind == "mode":
            self.modes[str(rec.get("mode"))] += 1
        elif kind == "attachment":
            att = rec.get("attachment") or {}
            self.attachments_seen[str(att.get("type"))] += 1
            if att.get("type") == "skill_mention" and att.get("skillName"):
                self.skills[str(att["skillName"])] += 1
        elif kind in ("ai-title", "custom-title"):
            title = rec.get("customTitle") or rec.get("aiTitle")
            if isinstance(title, str):
                self.titles.append(title)
        elif kind == "cost-state" and scope == "main":
            self.cost = {k: rec.get(k) for k in ("totalCostUSD", "totalLinesAdded", "totalLinesRemoved")}

    def _assistant(self, rec: dict[str, Any], scope: str, file_key: str) -> None:
        msg = rec.get("message") or {}
        mid = str(msg.get("id", rec.get("uuid")))
        model = str(msg.get("model", "unknown"))
        key = (scope, file_key, mid)
        if key not in self.usage:
            self.models[scope][model] += 1
            self.usage[key] = {}
        self.usage_model[key] = model
        usage = msg.get("usage") or {}
        details = usage.get("output_tokens_details") or {}
        fields = {
            "input": usage.get("input_tokens"),
            "cache_creation": usage.get("cache_creation_input_tokens"),
            "cache_read": usage.get("cache_read_input_tokens"),
            "output": usage.get("output_tokens"),
            "thinking": details.get("thinking_tokens"),
        }
        # Content blocks of one response repeat its usage; streaming makes later copies larger, so keep max.
        for name, value in fields.items():
            if isinstance(value, int):
                self.usage[key][name] = max(self.usage[key].get(name, 0), value)
        for name in ("effort", "perTurnEffort"):
            if isinstance(rec.get(name), str):
                self.efforts[f"{name}={rec[name]}"] += 1
        if isinstance(rec.get("thinkingDisplay"), str):
            self.thinking[json.dumps({"display": rec["thinkingDisplay"]})] += 1
        for block in msg.get("content") or []:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_use":
                self.tools[str(block.get("name"))] += 1
                if block.get("name") == "Skill":
                    self.skills[str((block.get("input") or {}).get("skill"))] += 1

    def usage_summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        def zero() -> dict[str, int]:
            return dict.fromkeys(("input", "cache_creation", "cache_read", "output", "thinking"), 0)

        by_scope: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, int]]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(zero))
        total = zero()
        for key, fields in self.usage.items():
            scope, model = key[0], self.usage_model[key]
            for name, value in fields.items():
                by_scope[scope][model][name] += value
                total[name] += value
        return {
            "note": "summed once per (file, message.id); thinking is a subset of output",
            "total": total,
            "by_scope_and_model": {s: dict(m) for s, m in by_scope.items()},
        }


def read_jsonl(path: Path, harvest: Harvest) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            rec = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            harvest.bad_lines += 1  # the live session's last line can be mid-write
            continue
        if isinstance(rec, dict):
            yield rec


def write_jsonl(path: Path, records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines = (json.dumps(r, ensure_ascii=False) for r in records)
    path.write_text("".join(f"{line}\n" for line in lines), encoding="utf-8")


def stage_transcript(src: Path, dest: Path, scope: str, san: Sanitizer, harvest: Harvest) -> None:
    records = list(read_jsonl(src, harvest))
    tools: dict[str, ToolInfo] = {}
    for rec in records:
        harvest.record(rec, scope, src.name)
        content = (rec.get("message") or {}).get("content") if rec.get("type") == "assistant" else None
        for block in content if isinstance(content, list) else []:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_use":
                tools[str(block.get("id"))] = tool_info(block)
    ctx = FileContext(san=san, tools=tools)
    kept: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for rec in records:
        cleaned = filter_record(rec, ctx)
        if cleaned is None:
            harvest.dropped[record_key(rec)] += 1
        else:
            harvest.kept[record_key(rec)] += 1
            kept.append(cleaned)
    write_jsonl(dest, kept)


def stage_journal(src: Path, dest: Path, san: Sanitizer, harvest: Harvest) -> None:
    run = harvest.workflows.setdefault(src.parent.name, {"run_id": src.parent.name, "agents": {}})
    records = list(read_jsonl(src, harvest))
    for rec in records:
        harvest.kept[f"journal:{rec.get('type')}"] += 1
        if rec.get("type") == "started" and isinstance(rec.get("agentId"), str):
            agent = run["agents"].setdefault(rec["agentId"], {})
            agent.update({"label": rec.get("label"), "phase": rec.get("phase")})
    write_jsonl(dest, [san.any(r) for r in records])


def stage_json(src: Path, dest: Path, san: Sanitizer) -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = json.loads(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(san.any(data), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def harvest_snapshot(data: dict[str, Any], harvest: Harvest) -> None:
    run = harvest.workflows.setdefault(str(data.get("runId")), {"run_id": data.get("runId"), "agents": {}})
    run.update({k: data.get(k) for k in ("workflowName", "status", "agentCount", "totalTokens", "durationMs")})
    for node in data.get("workflowProgress") or []:
        if isinstance(node, dict) and node.get("type") == "workflow_agent":
            agent = run["agents"].setdefault(str(node.get("agentId")), {})
            for key in ("label", "agentType", "model", "state", "tokens"):
                if node.get(key) is not None:
                    agent[key] = node[key]
            agent.setdefault("phase", node.get("phaseTitle"))


def stage_session(project_dir: Path, sid: str, dest: Path, san: Sanitizer, harvest: Harvest) -> None:
    """Mirror the session's main JSONL, subagents/** and workflows/** into dest, filtered and redacted."""
    stage_transcript(project_dir / f"{sid}.jsonl", dest / f"{sid}.jsonl", "main", san, harvest)
    session_dir = project_dir / sid
    for src in sorted((session_dir / "subagents").rglob("*")):
        rel = src.relative_to(project_dir)
        if not src.is_file():
            continue
        if src.name == "journal.jsonl":
            stage_journal(src, dest / rel, san, harvest)
        elif src.suffix == ".jsonl":
            stage_transcript(src, dest / rel, "subagents", san, harvest)
        elif src.name.endswith(".meta.json"):
            meta = stage_json(src, dest / rel, san)
            run_id = src.parent.name if src.parent.parent.name == "workflows" else None
            harvest.subagents.append({"agentType": meta.get("agentType"), "model": meta.get("model")})
            if run_id:
                run = harvest.workflows.setdefault(run_id, {"run_id": run_id, "agents": {}})
                agent = run["agents"].setdefault(src.name.removeprefix("agent-").removesuffix(".meta.json"), {})
                agent.setdefault("agentType", meta.get("agentType"))
                agent.setdefault("model", meta.get("model"))
    for src in sorted((session_dir / "workflows").glob("*.json")):
        harvest_snapshot(stage_json(src, dest / src.relative_to(project_dir), san), harvest)
    for src in sorted((session_dir / "workflows" / "scripts").glob("*.js")):
        target = dest / src.relative_to(project_dir)
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(san.text(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), encoding="utf-8")
        run_id = src.stem.rsplit("-wf_", 1)[-1]
        run = harvest.workflows.setdefault(f"wf_{run_id}", {"run_id": f"wf_{run_id}", "agents": {}})
        run["script"] = src.name


def build_meta(harvest: Harvest, san: Sanitizer, sid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    by_type: Counter[str] = Counter(str(s.get("agentType")) for s in harvest.subagents)
    by_model: Counter[str] = Counter(str(s.get("model")) for s in harvest.subagents)
    workflows = [
        {**{k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "agents"}, "agents": list(run["agents"].values())}
        for run in sorted(harvest.workflows.values(), key=lambda r: str(r.get("run_id")))
    ]
    stamps = sorted(harvest.timestamps)
    meta = {
        "session_id": sid,
        "title": harvest.titles[-1] if harvest.titles else None,
        "harness": {
            "name": "Claude Code",
            "version": harvest.versions.most_common(1)[0][0] if harvest.versions else None,
            "versions_seen": dict(harvest.versions),
            "entrypoint": harvest.entrypoints.most_common(1)[0][0] if harvest.entrypoints else None,
        },
        "models": {"note": "responses per model, deduped by message.id"}
        | {scope: dict(c) for scope, c in harvest.models.items()},
        "effort": dict(harvest.efforts),
        "thinking": dict(harvest.thinking),
        "modes": {
            "permission_modes": dict(harvest.permission_modes),
            "modes": dict(harvest.modes),
            "plan_mode_used": harvest.permission_modes["plan"] > 0 or harvest.attachments_seen["plan_mode"] > 0,
            "ultra_effort_entered": harvest.attachments_seen["ultra_effort_enter"] > 0,
            "auto_mode_used": harvest.permission_modes["auto"] > 0 or harvest.attachments_seen["auto_mode"] > 0,
        },
        "skills_invoked": dict(harvest.skills),
        "tools_used": dict(harvest.tools.most_common()),
        "workflows": workflows,
        "subagents": {"total": len(harvest.subagents), "by_type": dict(by_type), "by_model": dict(by_model)},
        "usage_tokens": harvest.usage_summary(),
        "cost_estimate": harvest.cost or None,
        "date_range": {"start": stamps[0] if stamps else None, "end": stamps[-1] if stamps else None},
        "records": {
            "kept_total": sum(harvest.kept.values()),
            "dropped_total": sum(harvest.dropped.values()),
            "kept": dict(sorted(harvest.kept.items())),
            "dropped": dict(sorted(harvest.dropped.items())),
            "unparseable_lines": harvest.bad_lines,
        },
        "redactions": dict(sorted(san.counts.items())),
    }
    return neutral_keys(Sanitizer(denylist=san.denylist).any(meta))


def neutral_keys(value: Any) -> Any:
    """Dropped-record tallies are keyed by marker type names; rewrite keys as the gate expects."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        out: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for key, inner in value.items():
            for word, repl in MARKER_WORDS:
                key = key.replace(word, repl)
            out[key] = neutral_keys(inner)
        return out
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [neutral_keys(v) for v in value]
    return value


def readme(meta: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    dates = meta["date_range"]
    return f"""# AI conversation transcript

Exported from the Claude Code session that built this repo (`{meta["session_id"]}`,
{dates["start"]} to {dates["end"]} UTC), including every subagent and workflow run it spawned.

## Contents

- `rendered/transcript.html`, `rendered/transcript.md`: readable render ({RENDERER}, depth `tool`).
- `raw/`: the filtered, redacted JSONL in the original session layout (main thread, `subagents/**`,
  `workflows/**`); re-renderable with claude-code-log.
- `meta.json`: harness version, models, effort and thinking settings, modes, skills, workflows,
  subagent counts, token usage, record counts and redaction counts.

## What was removed, and why

- Harness plumbing: API request records, file-history snapshots, prompt snapshots, hook output,
  environment, listing and delta attachments. Noise for a reader, and some of it holds private configuration.
- Private context: the author's global instruction file, account and session context, credential data,
  harness reminder blocks inside messages and tool results, skill instruction bodies.
- Thinking-block signatures, images and documents.
- Third-party content: tool calls touching `{PRIVATE_DATA}/`, raw HTML pages over 2 KB and fetched web
  content over 4 KB become `[omitted: publisher/web content, sha256=<prefix>, <n> chars]`.
- Redactions: home paths become `~`; emails other than the author's public address become
  `[redacted-email]`; credential-shaped strings become `[redacted-secret]`; private terms become `[redacted]`.

## How it was produced

`uv run python scripts/export_transcript.py`: allowlist filter and redaction into a staging dir, render with
`uvx {RENDERER}`, then a leak gate over every output file (paths, emails, secrets, private markers,
size). Only a passing export is moved here. The final turns that ran this export and pushed it are not included.
"""


def render(session_file: Path, out_dir: Path, cache: Path) -> None:
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    env = {**os.environ, "CLAUDE_CODE_LOG_CACHE_PATH": str(cache)}
    for fmt, name in (("html", "transcript.html"), ("md", "transcript.md")):
        cmd = ["uvx", RENDERER, str(session_file), "-o", str(out_dir / name), "-f", fmt, *RENDER_FLAGS]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, env=env, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)


def scrub_rendered(out_dir: Path, san: Sanitizer) -> None:
    """The renderer may echo staging paths into its output; run the redactor over it once more."""
    for path in sorted(out_dir.rglob("*")):
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix in (".html", ".md", ".json", ".txt"):
            text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
            cleaned = san.redact(text)
            if cleaned != text:
                path.write_text(cleaned, encoding="utf-8")


def scan_line(line: str, deny: re.Pattern[str] | None) -> list[str]:
    hits: list[str] = []
    if "~" in line:
        hits.append("home-path")
    if USER_FRAGMENT_RE is not None and USER_FRAGMENT_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("user-path-fragment")
    if any(m.group(0).lower() not in ALLOWED_EMAILS for m in EMAIL_RE.finditer(line)):
        hits.append("email")
    hits += [f"secret:{name}" for name, regex in SECRET_RES.items() if regex.search(line)]
    if deny is not None and deny.search(line):
        hits.append("denylist")
    if SR_LEAK_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("marker:reminder")
    if BLOB in line:
        hits.append("marker:request-blob")
    if SESSION_CTX in line:
        hits.append("marker:session-context")
    if INSTRUCTIONS_TYPE_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("marker:instructions-attachment")
    return hits


def scan_paths(target: Path, denylist: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Leak gate: one `file:line: rule` entry per hit across every file under target."""
    terms = sorted(denylist, key=len, reverse=True)
    deny = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(t) for t in terms), re.IGNORECASE) if terms else None
    files = [target] if target.is_file() else sorted(p for p in target.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    hits: list[str] = []
    for path in files:
        rel = path.relative_to(target) if target.is_dir() else path.name
        if path.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
            hits.append(f"{rel}:0: size>50MB")
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        for lineno, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            hits += [f"{rel}:{lineno}: {rule}" for rule in scan_line(line, deny)]
    return hits


def report_gate(hits: list[str]) -> int:
    if not hits:
        print("gate: PASS")
        return 0
    print(f"gate: FAIL ({len(hits)} hits)", file=sys.stderr)
    for hit in hits[:200]:
        print(f"  {hit}", file=sys.stderr)
    if len(hits) > 200:
        print(f"  ... {len(hits) - 200} more", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1


def resolve_session(projects_root: Path, session: str | None) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    encoded = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", "-", str(ROOT))
    project_dir = projects_root / encoded if (projects_root / encoded).is_dir() else projects_root
    candidates = sorted(project_dir.glob(f"{session or ''}*.jsonl"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
    if not candidates:
        sys.exit(f"no session JSONL matching {session or '*'!r} in {project_dir}")
    if session and len(candidates) > 1:
        sys.exit(f"session prefix {session!r} is ambiguous in {project_dir}")
    return project_dir, candidates[-1].stem


def reset_staging(staging: Path) -> None:
    if staging.exists():
        if any(staging.iterdir()) and not (staging / STAGING_MARKER).exists():
            sys.exit(f"refusing to clear {staging}: not an export staging dir (no {STAGING_MARKER})")
        shutil.rmtree(staging)
    staging.mkdir(parents=True)
    (staging / STAGING_MARKER).touch()


def publish(export_dir: Path, out: Path) -> None:
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name in OUTPUT_NAMES:
        target = out / name
        if target.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(target)
        elif target.exists():
            target.unlink()
        shutil.move(str(export_dir / name), str(target))


def export(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    denylist = load_denylist(args.denylist)
    project_dir, sid = resolve_session(args.projects_root, args.session)
    print(f"session {sid} from {project_dir.name}")
    staging: Path = args.staging
    reset_staging(staging)
    session_root = staging / "projects" / PROJECT_NAME
    export_dir = staging / "export"
    san, harvest = Sanitizer(denylist=denylist), Harvest()
    stage_session(project_dir, sid, session_root, san, harvest)
    meta = build_meta(harvest, san, sid)
    shutil.copytree(session_root, export_dir / "raw")
    if not args.no_render:
        render(session_root / f"{sid}.jsonl", export_dir / "rendered", staging / "ccl-cache.db")
        scrub_rendered(export_dir / "rendered", Sanitizer(denylist=denylist))
    else:
        (export_dir / "rendered").mkdir(parents=True)
    (export_dir / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", "utf-8")
    (export_dir / "README.md").write_text(readme(meta), encoding="utf-8")
    records = meta["records"]
    print(f"records kept {records['kept_total']}, dropped {records['dropped_total']}")
    print("redactions " + json.dumps(meta["redactions"]))
    for path in sorted((export_dir / "rendered").glob("*")):
        print(f"rendered {path.name}: {path.stat().st_size / 1_048_576:.1f} MB")
    if report_gate(scan_paths(export_dir, denylist)):
        print(f"export kept in {export_dir}; nothing moved to {args.out}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    publish(export_dir, args.out)
    print(f"published to {args.out}")
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    config_dir = Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", Path.home() / ".claude"))
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUT)
    parser.add_argument("--staging", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_STAGING)
    parser.add_argument("--scan-only", type=Path, help="only run the leak gate over this file or dir")
    parser.add_argument("--projects-root", type=Path, default=config_dir / "projects")
    parser.add_argument("--session", help="session id or prefix (default: most recently written)")
    parser.add_argument("--denylist", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_DENYLIST)
    parser.add_argument("--no-render", action="store_true", help="skip claude-code-log (raw + meta only)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.scan_only:
        sys.exit(report_gate(scan_paths(args.scan_only, load_denylist(args.denylist))))
    sys.exit(export(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
def load_denylist(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    if not path.is_file():
        return []
    terms = (line.strip() for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
    return [t for t in terms if t and not t.startswith("#")]


def is_html(text: str) -> bool:
    low = text.lower()
    return "<html" in low or "<!doctype html" in low


@dataclass
class Sanitizer:
    denylist: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    counts: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        terms = sorted(self.denylist, key=len, reverse=True)
        alternation = "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in terms)
        self._deny = re.compile(alternation, re.IGNORECASE) if terms else None

    def _sub(self, rule: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], repl: str, text: str) -> str:
        text, n = regex.subn(repl, text)
        if n:
            self.counts[rule] += n
```

```python
def omission_reason(info: ToolInfo | None, text: str) -> str | None:
    """Why a tool result must not be published, or None to keep it."""
    name = info.name if info else ""
    if info and info.private:
        return "private_data"
    if len(text) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(text):
        return "html"
    if WEB_TOOL_RE.search(name) and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if info and info.fetch_like and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if name not in MODEL_AUTHORED_TOOLS and PRIVATE_DATA in text:
        if len(text) > PRIVATE_MENTION_MIN_CHARS or GREP_HIT_RE.search(text):
            return "private_mention"
    return None
```

```python
def build_meta(harvest: Harvest, san: Sanitizer, sid: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    by_type: Counter[str] = Counter(str(s.get("agentType")) for s in harvest.subagents)
    by_model: Counter[str] = Counter(str(s.get("model")) for s in harvest.subagents)
    workflows = [
        {**{k: v for k, v in run.items() if k != "agents"}, "agents": list(run["agents"].values())}
        for run in sorted(harvest.workflows.values(), key=lambda r: str(r.get("run_id")))
    ]
    stamps = sorted(harvest.timestamps)
    models: dict[str, Any] = {"note": "responses per model, deduped by message.id"}
    models.update({scope: dict(c) for scope, c in harvest.models.items()})
    meta: dict[str, Any] = {
        "session_id": sid,
        "title": harvest.titles[-1] if harvest.titles else None,
        "harness": {
            "name": "Claude Code",
            "version": harvest.versions.most_common(1)[0][0] if harvest.versions else None,
            "versions_seen": dict(harvest.versions),
            "entrypoint": harvest.entrypoints.most_common(1)[0][0] if harvest.entrypoints else None,
        },
        "models": models,
        "effort": dict(harvest.efforts),
        "thinking": dict(harvest.thinking),
        "modes": {
            "permission_modes": dict(harvest.permission_modes),
            "modes": dict(harvest.modes),
            "plan_mode_used": harvest.permission_modes["plan"] > 0
            or harvest.attachments_seen["plan_mode"] > 0,
            "ultra_effort_entered": harvest.attachments_seen["ultra_effort_enter"] > 0,
            "auto_mode_used": harvest.permission_modes["auto"] > 0
            or harvest.attachments_seen["auto_mode"] > 0,
        },
        "skills_invoked": dict(harvest.skills),
        "tools_used": dict(harvest.tools.most_common()),
        "workflows": workflows,
        "subagents": {"total": len(harvest.subagents), "by_type": dict(by_type), "by_model": dict(by_model)},
        "usage_tokens": harvest.usage_summary(),
        "cost_estimate": harvest.cost or None,
        "date_range": {"start": stamps[0] if stamps else None, "end": stamps[-1] if stamps else None},
        "records": {
            "kept_total": sum(harvest.kept.values()),
            "dropped_total": sum(harvest.dropped.values()),
            "kept": dict(sorted(harvest.kept.items())),
            "dropped": dict(sorted(harvest.dropped.items())),
            "unparseable_lines": harvest.bad_lines,
        },
        "redactions": dict(sorted(san.counts.items())),
    }
    return neutral_keys(Sanitizer(denylist=san.denylist).any(meta))


def neutral_keys(value: Any) -> Any:
    """Dropped-record tallies are keyed by marker type names; rewrite keys as the gate expects."""
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        out: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for key, inner in value.items():
            for word, repl in MARKER_WORDS:
                key = key.replace(word, repl)
            out[key] = neutral_keys(inner)
        return out
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [neutral_keys(v) for v in value]
    return value


def readme(meta: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    dates = meta["date_range"]
    return f"""# AI conversation transcript

Exported from the Claude Code session that built this repo (`{meta["session_id"]}`,
{dates["start"]} to {dates["end"]} UTC), including every subagent and workflow run it spawned.

## Contents

- `rendered/transcript.html`, `rendered/transcript.md`: readable render ({RENDERER}, depth `tool`).
- `raw/`: the filtered, redacted JSONL in the original session layout (main thread, `subagents/**`,
  `workflows/**`); re-renderable with claude-code-log.
- `meta.json`: harness version, models, effort and thinking settings, modes, skills, workflows,
  subagent counts, token usage, record counts and redaction counts.

## What was removed, and why

- Harness plumbing: API request records, file-history snapshots, prompt snapshots, hook output,
  environment, listing and delta attachments. Noise for a reader, and some of it holds private configuration.
- Private context: the author's global instruction file, account and session context, credential data,
  harness reminder blocks inside messages and tool results, skill instruction bodies.
- Thinking-block signatures, images and documents.
- Third-party content: tool calls touching `{PRIVATE_DATA}/`, raw HTML pages over 2 KB and fetched web
  content over 4 KB become `[omitted: publisher/web content, sha256=<prefix>, <n> chars]`.
- Redactions: home paths become `~`; emails other than the author's public address become
  `[redacted-email]`; credential-shaped strings become `[redacted-secret]`; private terms become `[redacted]`.

## How it was produced

`uv run python scripts/export_transcript.py`: allowlist filter and redaction into a staging dir, render with
`uvx {RENDERER}`, then a leak gate over every output file (paths, emails, secrets, private markers,
size). Only a passing export is moved here. The final turns that ran this export and pushed it are not included.
"""


def render(session_file: Path, out_dir: Path, cache: Path) -> None:
```

```python
def scan_line(line: str, deny: re.Pattern[str] | None) -> list[str]:
    hits: list[str] = []
    if "~" in line:
        hits.append("home-path")
    if USER_FRAGMENT_RE is not None and USER_FRAGMENT_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("user-path-fragment")
    if any(m.group(0).lower() not in ALLOWED_EMAILS for m in EMAIL_RE.finditer(line)):
        hits.append("email")
    hits += [f"secret:{name}" for name, regex in SECRET_RES.items() if regex.search(line)]
    if deny is not None and deny.search(line):
        hits.append("denylist")
    if SR_LEAK_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("marker:reminder")
    if BLOB in line:
        hits.append("marker:request-blob")
    if SESSION_CTX in line:
        hits.append("marker:session-context")
    if INSTRUCTIONS_TYPE_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("marker:instructions-attachment")
    return hits


def scan_paths(target: Path, denylist: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Leak gate: one `file:line: rule` entry per hit across every file under target."""
    terms = sorted(denylist, key=len, reverse=True)
    deny = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(t) for t in terms), re.IGNORECASE) if terms else None
    files = [target] if target.is_file() else sorted(p for p in target.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    hits: list[str] = []
    for path in files:
        rel = path.relative_to(target) if target.is_dir() else path.name
        if path.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
            hits.append(f"{rel}:0: size>50MB")
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        for lineno, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            hits += [f"{rel}:{lineno}: {rule}" for rule in scan_line(line, deny)]
    return hits
```

```python
"""Count occurrences of probe phrases in an export dir, per file, without printing surrounding content."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

TARGET = Path(sys.argv[1])
PROBES = [p.strip() for p in Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text().splitlines() if p.strip()]
CONTEXT = len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3] == "--context"

hits: Counter[str] = Counter()
for path in sorted(p for p in TARGET.rglob("*") if p.is_file()):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    low = text.lower()
    for probe in PROBES:
        n = low.count(probe.lower())
        if n:
            hits[f"{probe} | {path.relative_to(TARGET)}"] += n
            if CONTEXT:
                i = low.index(probe.lower())
                print(f"--- {probe} @ {path.name}: ...{text[max(0, i - 120) : i + 120]!r}...")
for key, n in sorted(hits.items()):
    print(f"{n:5d} {key}")
```

```python
"""Attribute probe-phrase hits in exported raw JSONL to the tool call (or text block) that carries them."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

RAW = Path(sys.argv[1])
PROBES = [p.strip().lower() for p in Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text().splitlines() if p.strip()]
ONLY = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else ""


def found(value: Any) -> set[str]:
    text = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).lower()
    return {p for p in PROBES if p in text}


hits: Counter[str] = Counter()
for path in sorted(RAW.rglob("*.jsonl")):
    if ONLY and ONLY not in path.name:
        continue
    tools: dict[str, str] = {}
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        rec = json.loads(line)
        msg = rec.get("message") or {}
        content = msg.get("content")
        if not isinstance(content, list):
            if rec.get("type") in ("user", "assistant") and found(content):
                hits[f"{path.name[:24]} {rec['type']}-text {sorted(found(content))}"] += 1
            elif found(rec) and "message" not in rec:
                hits[f"{path.name[:24]} {rec.get('type')}-record {sorted(found(rec))}"] += 1
            continue
        for block in content:
            kind = block.get("type")
            if kind == "tool_use":
                inp = block.get("input") or {}
                summary = str(inp.get("command") or inp.get("file_path") or inp.get("pattern") or "")[:110]
                tools[block["id"]] = f"{block['name']}: {summary}"
                if found(inp):
                    hits[f"{path.name[:24]} USE {tools[block['id']]!r} {sorted(found(inp))}"] += 1
            elif kind == "tool_result":
                if found(block.get("content")):
                    origin = tools.get(block.get("tool_use_id"), "?")
                    hits[f"{path.name[:24]} RESULT of {origin!r} {sorted(found(block.get('content')))}"] += 1
            elif found(block):
                hits[f"{path.name[:24]} {rec['type']}-{kind} {sorted(found(block))}"] += 1
for key, n in sorted(hits.items()):
    print(f"{n:3d} {key}")

```

```python
"""List tool targets (paths, commands) that point outside the repo, with result sizes, from exported raw JSONL."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

RAW = Path(sys.argv[1])
REPO = "~/krisjobs/standalone/veritrade-analytics"
OUTSIDE = re.compile(r"(?:~|~/\s]+|\$HOME)(?:/[^\s'\"|;&)]*)?")

counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
for path in sorted(RAW.rglob("*.jsonl")):
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        rec = json.loads(line)
        content = (rec.get("message") or {}).get("content")
        if not isinstance(content, list):
            continue
        for block in content:
            if block.get("type") != "tool_use":
                continue
            inp = block.get("input") or {}
            for key in ("file_path", "path", "command", "pattern", "glob"):
                value = inp.get(key)
                if not isinstance(value, str):
                    continue
                for m in OUTSIDE.finditer(value):
                    target = m.group(0)
                    if target.startswith(REPO) or target.startswith("~/.cache") or target in ("~", "~/"):
                        if target not in ("~", "~/"):
                            continue
                    parts = target.split("/")
                    counts[f"{block['name']}.{key}: {'/'.join(parts[:3])}"] += 1
for key, n in sorted(counts.items()):
    print(f"{n:4d} {key}")
```

```python
    def strip_reminders(self, text: str) -> str:
        text = self._sub("system_reminder", REMINDER_BLOCK_RE, "", text)
        text = REMINDER_TAG_RE.sub(
            lambda m: "[/system reminder]" if m[0][1] == "/" else "[system reminder]", text
        )
        for word, repl in MARKER_WORDS:
            if word in text:
                self.counts["marker_neutralized"] += text.count(word)
                text = text.replace(word, repl)
        return text

    def text(self, text: str) -> str:
        return self.redact(self.strip_reminders(text))

    def omit(self, text: str, reason: str) -> str:
        self.counts[f"omitted:{reason}"] += 1
        digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:16]
        return f"[omitted: publisher/web content, sha256={digest}, {len(text)} chars]"

    def any(self, value: Any) -> Any:
        """Clean every string in a JSON value; long raw HTML anywhere is treated as publisher content."""
        if isinstance(value, str):
            stripped = self.strip_reminders(value)
            if len(stripped) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(stripped):
                return self.omit(stripped, "html")
            return self.redact(stripped)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [self.any(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            return {k: self.any(v) for k, v in value.items()}
        return value


@dataclass
class ToolInfo:
    name: str
    private: bool = False
    fetch_like: bool = False


def tool_info(block: dict[str, Any]) -> ToolInfo:
    name = str(block.get("name", ""))
    raw = block.get("input")
    inp: dict[str, Any] = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    targets = [str(v) for k, v in inp.items() if k in TARGET_KEYS and isinstance(v, str)]
    command = str(inp.get("command", ""))
    return ToolInfo(
        name=name,
        private=any(PRIVATE_DATA in t for t in targets),
        fetch_like=name == "Bash" and bool(FETCH_CMD_RE.search(command)),
    )


def result_text(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(str(i.get("text", "")) for i in content if isinstance(i, dict))
    return ""


def omission_reason(info: ToolInfo | None, text: str) -> str | None:
    """Why a tool result must not be published, or None to keep it."""
    name = info.name if info else ""
    if info and info.private:
        return "private_data"
    if len(text) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(text):
        return "html"
    if WEB_TOOL_RE.search(name) and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if info and info.fetch_like and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    long_or_grep = len(text) > PRIVATE_MENTION_MIN_CHARS or bool(GREP_HIT_RE.search(text))
    if name not in MODEL_AUTHORED_TOOLS and PRIVATE_DATA in text and long_or_grep:
        return "private_mention"
    return None


@dataclass
class FileContext:
    san: Sanitizer
    tools: dict[str, ToolInfo]


def clean_tool_input(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("id")))
    inp = block.get("input")
    if not isinstance(inp, dict):
        return {**block, "input": ctx.san.any(inp)}
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in inp.items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            stripped = ctx.san.strip_reminders(value)
            if info and info.private and len(stripped) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, "private_data")
            elif len(stripped) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(stripped):
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, "html")
            else:
                out[key] = ctx.san.redact(stripped)
        elif info and info.private and len(json.dumps(value)) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
            out[key] = ctx.san.omit(json.dumps(value), "private_data")
        else:
            out[key] = ctx.san.any(value)
    return {**block, "input": out}


def strip_nested(value: Any, san: Sanitizer) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return san.strip_reminders(value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [strip_nested(v, san) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: strip_nested(v, san) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def clean_tool_result(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stripped = strip_nested(block.get("content"), ctx.san)
    text = result_text(stripped)
    reason = omission_reason(ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("tool_use_id"))), text)
    if reason:
        return {**block, "content": ctx.san.omit(text, reason)}
    if isinstance(stripped, list):
        items = [omitted_media(i) if is_media(i) else i for i in stripped]
        return {**block, "content": [ctx.san.any(i) for i in items]}
    return {**block, "content": ctx.san.any(stripped)}


def is_media(block: Any) -> bool:
    return isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") in ("image", "document")
```

```python
"""Heuristic second-pass scan of an export: secret-like assignments, IPv4s, tmp paths. Prints rule, file, short masked match."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

TARGET = Path(sys.argv[1])
RULES = {
    "assign": re.compile(r"(?i)(?:api[_-]?key|token|secret|passw(?:or)?d)\s*[\"']?\s*[:=]\s*[\"']?([A-Za-z0-9_\-./+]{16,})"),
    "ipv4": re.compile(r"\b(?!127\.|0\.|10\.|192\.168\.|172\.(?:1[6-9]|2\d|3[01])\.)(\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})\b"),
    "bearer": re.compile(r"(?i)bearer\s+([A-Za-z0-9_\-.]{20,})"),
    "tmp": re.compile(r"(/var/folders/\S{0,20}|/private/tmp/\S{0,30})"),
}
c: Counter[str] = Counter()
for path in sorted(p for p in TARGET.rglob("*") if p.is_file()):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    for name, rx in RULES.items():
        for m in rx.finditer(text):
            val = m.group(1)
            masked = val[:4] + "..." + str(len(val)) if name in ("assign", "bearer") else val
            c[f"{name} {masked} | {path.name[:28]}"] += 1
for k, v in sorted(c.items()):
    print(f"{v:4d} {k}")

```

```python
"""Locate a term inside one decoded JSONL record: print the JSON path and repr of a short window."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

path, lineno, term = Path(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3].lower()
rec = json.loads(path.read_text().splitlines()[lineno - 1])


def walk(v: Any, where: str) -> None:
    if isinstance(v, str):
        i = v.lower().find(term)
        if i >= 0:
            print(where, repr(v[max(0, i - 30) : i + len(term) + 30]))
    elif isinstance(v, dict):
        for k, x in v.items():
            if term in k.lower():
                print(where, "KEY", repr(k[:200]))
            walk(x, f"{where}.{k}")
    elif isinstance(v, list):
        for n, x in enumerate(v):
            walk(x, f"{where}[{n}]")


walk(rec, "$")

```

```python
def stage_journal(src: Path, dest: Path, san: Sanitizer, harvest: Harvest) -> None:
    run = harvest.workflows.setdefault(src.parent.name, {"run_id": src.parent.name, "agents": {}})
    records = list(read_jsonl(src, harvest))
    for rec in records:
        harvest.kept[f"journal:{rec.get('type')}"] += 1
        if rec.get("type") == "started" and isinstance(rec.get("agentId"), str):
            agent = run["agents"].setdefault(rec["agentId"], {})
            agent.update({"label": rec.get("label"), "phase": rec.get("phase")})
    write_jsonl(dest, [san.any(r) for r in records])


def stage_json(src: Path, dest: Path, san: Sanitizer) -> dict[str, Any]:
    data = json.loads(src.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(san.any(data), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
```

```diff
+def reparent(rec: dict[str, Any], skipped: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Point past dropped records to the nearest kept ancestor so the renderer keeps the thread."""
+    for key in ("parentUuid", "logicalParentUuid"):
+        parent, seen = rec.get(key), set()
+        while isinstance(parent, str) and parent in skipped and parent not in seen:
+            seen.add(parent)
+            parent = skipped[parent]
+        if key in rec:
+            rec[key] = parent
+    return rec
```

```python
    efforts: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    thinking: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    permission_modes: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    modes: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    attachments_seen: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    skills: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    tools: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    subagents: list[dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=list)
    workflows: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = field(default_factory=dict)
    titles: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    timestamps: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    kept: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    dropped: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    cost: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    bad_lines: int = 0

    def record(self, rec: dict[str, Any], scope: str, file_key: str) -> None:
        kind = rec.get("type")
        if isinstance(rec.get("version"), str):
            self.versions[rec["version"]] += 1
        if isinstance(rec.get("entrypoint"), str):
            self.entrypoints[rec["entrypoint"]] += 1
        if isinstance(rec.get("timestamp"), str):
            self.timestamps.append(rec["timestamp"])
        if kind == "assistant":
            self._assistant(rec, scope, file_key)
        elif kind == "api-request":
            thinking = (rec.get("params") or {}).get("thinking")
            if isinstance(thinking, dict):
                picked = {k: thinking[k] for k in ("type", "display") if k in thinking}
                self.thinking[json.dumps(picked, sort_keys=True)] += 1
        elif kind == "permission-mode":
            self.permission_modes[str(rec.get("permissionMode"))] += 1
        elif kind == "mode":
            self.modes[str(rec.get("mode"))] += 1
        elif kind == "attachment":
            att = rec.get("attachment") or {}
            self.attachments_seen[str(att.get("type"))] += 1
            if att.get("type") == "skill_mention" and att.get("skillName"):
                self.skills[str(att["skillName"])] += 1
        elif kind in ("ai-title", "custom-title"):
            title = rec.get("customTitle") or rec.get("aiTitle")
            if isinstance(title, str):
                self.titles.append(title)
        elif kind == "cost-state" and scope == "main":
            self.cost = {k: rec.get(k) for k in ("totalCostUSD", "totalLinesAdded", "totalLinesRemoved")}

    def _assistant(self, rec: dict[str, Any], scope: str, file_key: str) -> None:
        msg = rec.get("message") or {}
        mid = str(msg.get("id", rec.get("uuid")))
        model = str(msg.get("model", "unknown"))
        key = (scope, file_key, mid)
        if key not in self.usage:
            self.models[scope][model] += 1
            self.usage[key] = {}
        self.usage_model[key] = model
        usage = msg.get("usage") or {}
        details = usage.get("output_tokens_details") or {}
        fields = {
            "input": usage.get("input_tokens"),
            "cache_creation": usage.get("cache_creation_input_tokens"),
            "cache_read": usage.get("cache_read_input_tokens"),
            "output": usage.get("output_tokens"),
            "thinking": details.get("thinking_tokens"),
        }
        # Content blocks of one response repeat its usage; streaming makes later copies larger, so keep max.
        for name, value in fields.items():
            if isinstance(value, int):
                self.usage[key][name] = max(self.usage[key].get(name, 0), value)
        for name in ("effort", "perTurnEffort"):
            if isinstance(rec.get(name), str):
                self.efforts[f"{name}={rec[name]}"] += 1
        if isinstance(rec.get("thinkingDisplay"), str):
            self.thinking[json.dumps({"display": rec["thinkingDisplay"]})] += 1
        for block in msg.get("content") or []:
            if isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") == "tool_use":
                self.tools[str(block.get("name"))] += 1
                if block.get("name") == "Skill":
                    self.skills[str((block.get("input") or {}).get("skill"))] += 1

    def usage_summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        def zero() -> dict[str, int]:
            return dict.fromkeys(("input", "cache_creation", "cache_read", "output", "thinking"), 0)

        by_scope: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, int]]] = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(zero))
        total = zero()
        for key, fields in self.usage.items():
            scope, model = key[0], self.usage_model[key]
            for name, value in fields.items():
                by_scope[scope][model][name] += value
                total[name] += value
        return {
            "note": "summed once per (file, message.id); thinking is a subset of output",
            "total": total,
            "by_scope_and_model": {s: dict(m) for s, m in by_scope.items()},
        }


def read_jsonl(path: Path, harvest: Harvest) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            rec = json.loads(line)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            harvest.bad_lines += 1  # the live session's last line can be mid-write
            continue
        if isinstance(rec, dict):
            yield rec
```

```python
"""Tests for scripts/export_transcript.py on synthetic session fixtures."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "export_transcript.py"
_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("export_transcript", _PATH)
assert _SPEC is not None and _SPEC.loader is not None
et = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
sys.modules["export_transcript"] = et
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(et)

# Leak-shaped values are concatenated so this file stays legible in the redacted transcript it ends up in.
EMAIL = "someone" + "@example.com"
HOME = "/Users" + "/someone"
OPEN, CLOSE = f"<{et.SR}>", f"</{et.SR}>"
SID = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"


def rec(kind: str, uuid: str, parent: str | None = None, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    base = {"type": kind, "uuid": uuid, "parentUuid": parent, "isSidechain": False, "userType": "external"}
    return base | {"cwd": f"{HOME}/repo", "sessionId": SID, "version": "9.9.9", "timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"} | extra


def attachment(uuid: str, parent: str | None, kind: str, **payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return rec("attachment", uuid, parent, attachment={"type": kind, **payload}, rendered=[f"{OPEN}\nx\n{CLOSE}"])


def assistant(uuid: str, parent: str | None, mid: str, blocks: list[dict[str, Any]], **usage: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    msg = {"id": mid, "type": "message", "role": "assistant", "model": "claude-test", "content": blocks}
    return rec("assistant", uuid, parent, message=msg | {"usage": usage}, effort="high")


def user(uuid: str, parent: str | None, content: Any, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return rec("user", uuid, parent, message={"role": "user", "content": content}, **extra)


def tool_use(tid: str, name: str, **inp: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "tool_use", "id": tid, "name": name, "input": inp}


def tool_result(tid: str, content: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": tid, "content": content}


def write_jsonl(path: Path, records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in records))


def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]


def stage(tmp_path: Path, records: list[dict[str, Any]], denylist: list[str] | None = None) -> tuple[Any, Any, Path]:
    project = tmp_path / "proj"
    write_jsonl(project / f"{SID}.jsonl", records)
    san, harvest = et.Sanitizer(denylist=denylist or []), et.Harvest()
    et.stage_session(project, SID, tmp_path / "staged", san, harvest)
    return san, harvest, tmp_path / "staged" / f"{SID}.jsonl"


def test_allowlist_keeps_conversation_and_drops_plumbing(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    records = [
        user("u1", None, "hello"),
        attachment("a1", "u1", "instructions", content="private global rules"),
        attachment("a2", "a1", et.SESSION_CTX, content=f"mail {EMAIL}"),
        attachment("a3", "a2", "plan_mode", planFilePath=f"{HOME}/.claude/plans/p.md"),
        attachment("a4", "a3", "hook_success", content="hook out"),
        rec("system", "s1", "a4", subtype="turn_duration", durationMs=5),
        rec("system", "s2", "s1", subtype="stop_hook_summary"),
        {"type": et.BLOB, "message": {"content": "request body"}},
        {"type": "api-request", "params": {"thinking": {"type": "adaptive", "display": "updates", "budget": 1}}},
        {"type": "file-history-snapshot", "snapshot": {}},
        {"type": "permission-mode", "permissionMode": "plan", "sessionId": SID},
        {"type": "custom-title", "customTitle": "t", "sessionId": SID},
        assistant("x1", "s2", "m1", [{"type": "text", "text": "hi"}], output_tokens=1),
    ]
    _, harvest, out = stage(tmp_path, records)
    kept = read_jsonl(out)
    kinds = [et.record_key(r) for r in kept]
    assert kinds == [
        "user",
        "attachment:plan_mode",
        "system:turn_duration",
        "permission-mode",
        "custom-title",
        "assistant",
    ]
    assert all("rendered" not in r for r in kept)
    assert harvest.dropped["attachment:instructions"] == 1
    assert harvest.dropped[et.BLOB] == 1
    assert harvest.thinking_params == {(("type", "adaptive"), ("display", "updates")): 1}
    assert kept[1]["attachment"]["planFilePath"] == "~/.claude/plans/p.md"
    # u1 <- a3 and s1 <- x1 chains skip the dropped records in between.
    assert kept[1]["parentUuid"] == "u1"
    assert kept[-1]["parentUuid"] == "s1"


def test_reminders_stripped_from_nested_tool_result_content(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    nested = [
        {"type": "text", "text": f"file body\n{OPEN}\nsecret rule\n{CLOSE}\ntrailer"},
        {"type": "text", "text": f'escaped json: "{OPEN}\\nsecret rule\\n{CLOSE}" end'},
        {"type": "image", "source": {"type": "base64", "data": "AAAA"}},
    ]
    records = [
        assistant("x1", None, "m1", [tool_use("t1", "Bash", command="cat notes.txt")]),
        user("u1", "x1", [tool_result("t1", nested)]),
        user("u2", "u1", f"we strip {OPEN} tags in prose"),
    ]
    san, _, out = stage(tmp_path, records)
    result, prose = read_jsonl(out)[1:]
    texts = [i["text"] for i in result["message"]["content"][0]["content"]]
    assert texts == ["file body\n\ntrailer", 'escaped json: "" end', "[omitted: image]"]
    assert san.counts["system_reminder"] == 2
    assert et.SR not in json.dumps(prose)
    assert "[system reminder] tags" in prose["message"]["content"]


def test_thinking_signature_and_redacted_thinking(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    blocks = [
        {"type": "thinking", "thinking": "", "signature": "Eq" + "x" * 80},
        {"type": "redacted_thinking", "data": "opaque"},
    ]
    _, _, out = stage(tmp_path, [assistant("x1", None, "m1", blocks)])
    content = read_jsonl(out)[0]["message"]["content"]
    assert content == [{"type": "thinking", "thinking": ""}, {"type": "text", "text": "[omitted: redacted_thinking]"}]


def test_redaction_rules_and_counts(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    secrets = [
        "sk-" + "a1B2" * 6,
        "ghp_" + "Z" * 36,
        "AKIA" + "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOP",
        "eyJ" + "a" * 10 + ".eyJ" + "b" * 10 + "." + "c" * 10,
        "-----BEGIN " + "OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----\nabc\n-----END OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----",
    ]
    text = f"{EMAIL} kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com {HOME}/repo/x.py Acme Corp " + " ".join(secrets)
    records = [user("u1", None, text), user("u2", "u1", "ok", toolUseResult={"answers": {f"ask {EMAIL}?": "yes"}})]
    san, _, out = stage(tmp_path, records, denylist=["acme corp"])
    first, second = read_jsonl(out)
    body = first["message"]["content"]
    assert body.startswith("[redacted-email] kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com ~/repo/x.py [redacted] ")
    assert body.count("[redacted-secret]") == len(secrets)
    assert first["cwd"] == "~/repo"
    assert second["toolUseResult"] == {"answers": {"ask [redacted-email]?": "yes"}}
    assert san.counts["email"] == 2
    assert san.counts["denylist"] == 1
    assert san.counts["home_path"] == 3
    assert sum(v for k, v in san.counts.items() if k.startswith("secret:")) == len(secrets)


def test_usage_summed_once_per_message_id(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    text = [{"type": "text", "text": "a"}]
    records = [
        assistant("x1", None, "m1", text, input_tokens=10, cache_read_input_tokens=100, output_tokens=5),
        assistant("x2", "x1", "m1", text, input_tokens=10, cache_read_input_tokens=100, output_tokens=7),
        assistant("x3", "x2", "m2", text, input_tokens=1, cache_creation_input_tokens=50, output_tokens=2),
    ]
    _, harvest, _ = stage(tmp_path, records)
    summary = harvest.usage_summary()
    assert summary["total"] == {"input": 11, "cache_creation": 50, "cache_read": 100, "output": 9, "thinking": 0}
    assert harvest.models["main"] == {"claude-test": 2}


def test_publisher_and_private_config_content_omitted(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    page = "<!DOCTYPE html><html><body>" + "story " * 600 + "</body></html>"
    records = [
        assistant(
            "x1",
            None,
            "m1",
            [
                tool_use("t1", "Read", file_path=f"{et.PRIVATE_DATA}/site/a.html"),
                tool_use("t2", "Write", file_path=f"{et.PRIVATE_DATA}/b.txt", content="article text " * 40),
                tool_use("t3", "Bash", command="cat fixture"),
                tool_use("t4", "WebFetch", url="https://news.example/a", prompt="summarize"),
                tool_use("t5", "WebFetch", url="https://news.example/b", prompt="summarize"),
                tool_use("t6", "Read", file_path=f"{HOME}/.ssh/config"),
                tool_use("t7", "Write", file_path="backend/x.py", content=f'PRIVATE = "{et.PRIVATE_DATA}"'),
            ],
        ),
        user(
            "u1",
            "x1",
            [
                tool_result("t1", "publisher paragraph"),
                tool_result("t2", "ok"),
                tool_result("t3", page),
                tool_result("t4", "w" * (et.WEB_MIN_CHARS + 1)),
                tool_result("t5", "short summary"),
                tool_result("t6", "Host box\n  HostName 10.0.0.1"),
                tool_result("t7", "ok"),
            ],
        ),
    ]
    san, _, out = stage(tmp_path, records)
    uses, results = (r["message"]["content"] for r in read_jsonl(out))
    contents = [r["content"] for r in results]
    assert contents[0].startswith("[omitted: publisher/web content, sha256=")
    assert contents[0].endswith(f", {len('publisher paragraph')} chars]")
    assert contents[2].startswith("[omitted: publisher/web content")
    assert contents[3].startswith("[omitted: publisher/web content")
    assert contents[4] == "short summary"
    assert contents[5].startswith("[omitted: private local config, sha256=")
    assert contents[6] == "ok"
    assert uses[1]["input"]["content"].startswith("[omitted: publisher/web content")
    assert uses[1]["input"]["file_path"] == f"{et.PRIVATE_DATA}/b.txt"
    assert uses[6]["input"]["content"] == f'PRIVATE = "{et.PRIVATE_DATA}"'
    assert san.counts["omitted:private_data"] == 3
    assert san.counts["omitted:html"] == 1
    assert san.counts["omitted:web_fetch"] == 1
    assert san.counts["omitted:private_config"] == 1

def test_session_layout_collected_and_others_excluded(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    project = tmp_path / "proj"
    session = project / SID
    write_jsonl(project / "other-session.jsonl", [user("o1", None, "other project")])
    write_jsonl(session / "subagents" / "agent-a1.jsonl", [user("s1", None, "sub")])
    (session / "subagents" / "agent-a1.meta.json").write_text(json.dumps({"agentType": "Explore", "model": "opus"}))
    run = session / "subagents" / "workflows" / "wf_abc"
    write_jsonl(run / "journal.jsonl", [{"type": "started", "agentId": "b1", "label": "probe", "phase": "P"}])
    write_jsonl(run / "agent-b1.jsonl", [user("w1", None, "wf agent")])
    (run / "agent-b1.meta.json").write_text(json.dumps({"agentType": "workflow-subagent", "model": "opus"}))
    (session / "workflows" / "scripts").mkdir(parents=True)
    (session / "workflows" / "scripts" / "build-it-wf_abc.js").write_text(f"const repo = '{HOME}/repo'\n")
    (session / "tool-results").mkdir()
    (session / "tool-results" / "big.txt").write_text("fetched page")
    _, harvest, _ = stage(tmp_path, [user("u1", None, "main")])
    staged = sorted(str(p.relative_to(tmp_path / "staged")) for p in (tmp_path / "staged").rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    assert staged == [
        f"{SID}.jsonl",
        f"{SID}/subagents/agent-a1.jsonl",
        f"{SID}/subagents/agent-a1.meta.json",
        f"{SID}/subagents/workflows/wf_abc/agent-b1.jsonl",
        f"{SID}/subagents/workflows/wf_abc/agent-b1.meta.json",
        f"{SID}/subagents/workflows/wf_abc/journal.jsonl",
        f"{SID}/workflows/scripts/build-it-wf_abc.js",
    ]
    assert (tmp_path / "staged" / SID / "workflows" / "scripts" / "build-it-wf_abc.js").read_text() == (
        "const repo = '~/repo'\n"
    )
    agent = harvest.workflows["wf_abc"]["agents"]["b1"]
    assert agent == {"label": "probe", "phase": "P", "agentType": "workflow-subagent", "model": "opus"}
    assert harvest.workflows["wf_abc"]["workflowName"] == "build-it"


def test_gate_flags_leaks_and_passes_clean_output(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    leaky = tmp_path / "leaky"
    leaky.mkdir()
    (leaky / "a.md").write_text(f"ok\npath {HOME}/x\nmail {EMAIL}\n{OPEN}\nnote acme corp\n")
    (leaky / "b.jsonl").write_text(json.dumps({"type": "attachment", "attachment": {"type": "instructions"}}) + "\n")
    (leaky / "c.html").write_text("<style>.x ." + et.SR + " {color: red}</style>\n" + "y" * 64)
    monkeypatch.setattr(et, "MAX_FILE_BYTES", 32)
    hits = et.scan_paths(leaky, ["acme corp"])
    assert hits == [
        "a.md:2: home-path",
        "a.md:3: email",
        "a.md:4: marker:reminder",
        "a.md:5: denylist",
        "b.jsonl:1: marker:instructions-attachment",
        "c.html:0: size>50MB",
    ]
    assert et.report_gate(hits) == 1

    clean = tmp_path / "clean"
    clean.mkdir()
    code = json.dumps({"text": "@router.post\n" * 3 + "kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com ~/repo [redacted-email]"})
    (clean / "raw.jsonl").write_text(code + "\n")
    assert et.scan_paths(clean, ["acme corp"]) == []
    assert et.report_gate([]) == 0


def test_export_publishes_only_when_gate_passes(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    write_jsonl(tmp_path / "proj" / f"{SID}.jsonl", [user("u1", None, f"see {HOME}/repo"), *[]])
    args = argparse.Namespace(
        out=tmp_path / "out",
        staging=tmp_path / "staging",
        projects_root=tmp_path / "proj",
        session=SID[:8],
        denylist=tmp_path / "missing.txt",
        no_render=True,
    )
    monkeypatch.setattr(et, "scan_paths", lambda *_: ["raw/x.jsonl:1: email"])
    assert et.export(args) == 1
    assert not args.out.exists()

    monkeypatch.undo()
    assert et.export(args) == 0
    assert sorted(p.name for p in args.out.iterdir()) == ["README.md", "meta.json", "raw", "rendered"]
    meta = json.loads((args.out / "meta.json").read_text())
    assert meta["session_id"] == SID
    assert meta["records"]["kept"] == {"user": 1}
    assert et.scan_paths(args.out, []) == []
```
