def scan_line(line: str, deny: re.Pattern[str] | None) -> list[str]:
    # A JSON escape glued to code reads as an address ("\[redacted-email]"); splitting on it hides nothing.
    line = JSON_ESCAPE_RE.sub(" ", line)
    hits: list[str] = []
    if "~" in line:
        hits.append("home-path")
    if USER_FRAGMENT_RE is not None and USER_FRAGMENT_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("user-path-fragment")
    if any(m.group(0).lower() not in ALLOWED_EMAILS for m in EMAIL_RE.finditer(line)):
        hits.append("email")
    hits += [f"secret:{name}" for name, regex in SECRET_RES.items() if regex.search(line)]
    if deny is not None and deny.search(line):
        hits.append("denylist")
    if SR_LEAK_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("marker:reminder")
    if BLOB in line:
        hits.append("marker:request-blob")
    if SESSION_CTX in line:
        hits.append("marker:session-context")
    if INSTRUCTIONS_TYPE_RE.search(line):
        hits.append("marker:instructions-attachment")
    return hits


def scan_paths(target: Path, denylist: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Leak gate: one `file:line: rule` entry per hit across every file under target."""
    terms = sorted(denylist, key=len, reverse=True)
    deny = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(t) for t in terms), re.IGNORECASE) if terms else None
    files = [target] if target.is_file() else sorted(p for p in target.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    hits: list[str] = []
    for path in files:
        rel = path.relative_to(target) if target.is_dir() else path.name
        if path.stat().st_size > MAX_FILE_BYTES:
            hits.append(f"{rel}:0: size>50MB")
        text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        for lineno, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
            hits += [f"{rel}:{lineno}: {rule}" for rule in scan_line(line, deny)]

SECRET_RES: dict[str, re.Pattern[str]] = {
    "sk_key": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}"),
    "github_token": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}"),
    "github_pat": re.compile(r"github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}"),
    "aws_key": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Z0-9])AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}(?![A-Z0-9])"),
    "private_key": re.compile(r"-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*KEY-----(?:[\s\S]*?-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*KEY-----)?"),
    "slack_token": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])xox[abposr]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}"),
    "jwt": re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}"),
    "hf_token": re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9])hf_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,}"),
    "google_key": re.compile(r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}"),
}
_Q = r"(?:\"|'|&quot;|&#34;|&#39;|&#x27;)"
INSTRUCTIONS_TYPE_RE = re.compile(_Q + r"type" + _Q + r"\s*[:=]\s*" + _Q + r"instructions" + _Q)
# A CSS selector in the renderer's stylesheet is the only legitimate leftover of the reminder word.
SR_LEAK_RE = re.compile(r"(?<!\.)" + re.escape(SR))
JSON_ESCAPE_RE = re.compile(r"\\(?:[nrtbf\"\\/]|u[0-9a-fA-F]{4})")


def load_denylist(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    if not path.is_file():
        return []
    terms = (line.strip() for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines())
    return [t for t in terms if t and not t.startswith("#")]


def is_html(text: str) -> bool:
    low = text.lower()
    return "<html" in low or "<!doctype html" in low


@dataclass
class Sanitizer:
    denylist: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    counts: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        terms = sorted(self.denylist, key=len, reverse=True)
        alternation = "|".join(re.escape(t) for t in terms)
        self._deny = re.compile(alternation, re.IGNORECASE) if terms else None

    def _sub(self, rule: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], repl: str, text: str) -> str:
        text, n = regex.subn(repl, text)
        if n:
            self.counts[rule] += n
        return text

    def _email(self, m: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        if m.group(0).lower() in ALLOWED_EMAILS:
            return m.group(0)
        self.counts["email"] += 1
        return "[redacted-email]"

    def redact(self, text: str) -> str:
        for name, regex in SECRET_RES.items():
            text = self._sub(f"secret:{name}", regex, "[redacted-secret]", text)
        text = EMAIL_RE.sub(self._email, text)
        text = self._sub("home_path", HOME_RE, "~", text)
        text = self._sub("home_path", ENCODED_HOME_RE, "-~", text)
        if USER_FRAGMENT_RE is not None:
            text = self._sub("home_path", USER_FRAGMENT_RE, "/[user]", text)
        if self._deny is not None:
            text = self._sub("denylist", self._deny, "[redacted]", text)
        return text

    def strip_reminders(self, text: str) -> str:
        text = self._sub("system_reminder", REMINDER_BLOCK_RE, "", text)
        text = REMINDER_TAG_RE.sub(
            lambda m: "[/system reminder]" if m[0][1] == "/" else "[system reminder]", text
        )
        for word, repl in MARKER_WORDS:
            if word in text:
                self.counts["marker_neutralized"] += text.count(word)
                text = text.replace(word, repl)
        return text

    def text(self, text: str) -> str:
        return self.redact(self.strip_reminders(text))

    def omit(self, text: str, reason: str) -> str:
        self.counts[f"omitted:{reason}"] += 1
        digest = hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()[:16]
        label = "private local config" if reason == "private_config" else "publisher/web content"
        return f"[omitted: {label}, sha256={digest}, {len(text)} chars]"

    def any(self, value: Any) -> Any:
        """Clean every string in a JSON value; long raw HTML anywhere is treated as publisher content."""
        if isinstance(value, str):
            stripped = self.strip_reminders(value)
            if len(stripped) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(stripped):
                return self.omit(stripped, "html")
            return self.redact(stripped)
        if isinstance(value, list):
            return [self.any(v) for v in value]
        if isinstance(value, dict):
            # Keys can be prose too: AskUserQuestion answers are keyed by the question text.
            return {self.text(k) if isinstance(k, str) else k: self.any(v) for k, v in value.items()}
        return value


@dataclass
class ToolInfo:
    name: str
    flag: str | None = None  # omission reason that covers both the call's long inputs and its result
    fetch_like: bool = False


def tool_info(block: dict[str, Any]) -> ToolInfo:
    name = str(block.get("name", ""))
    raw = block.get("input")
    inp: dict[str, Any] = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    targets = [str(v) for k, v in inp.items() if k in TARGET_KEYS and isinstance(v, str)]
    flag = None
    if any(PRIVATE_DATA in t for t in targets):
        flag = "private_data"
    elif any(rx.search(t) for t in targets for rx in PRIVATE_CONFIG_RES):
        flag = "private_config"
    command = str(inp.get("command", ""))
    return ToolInfo(name=name, flag=flag, fetch_like=name == "Bash" and bool(FETCH_CMD_RE.search(command)))

def result_text(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(str(i.get("text", "")) for i in content if isinstance(i, dict))
    return ""


def omission_reason(info: ToolInfo | None, text: str) -> str | None:
    """Why a tool result must not be published, or None to keep it."""
    name = info.name if info else ""
    if info and info.flag:
        return info.flag
    if len(text) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(text):
        return "html"
    if WEB_TOOL_RE.search(name) and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if info and info.fetch_like and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    long_or_grep = len(text) > PRIVATE_MENTION_MIN_CHARS or bool(GREP_HIT_RE.search(text))
    if name not in MODEL_AUTHORED_TOOLS and PRIVATE_DATA in text and long_or_grep:
        return "private_mention"
    return None


@dataclass
class FileContext:
    san: Sanitizer
    tools: dict[str, ToolInfo]


def clean_tool_input(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("id")))
    inp = block.get("input")
    if not isinstance(inp, dict):
        return {**block, "input": ctx.san.any(inp)}
    flag = info.flag if info else None
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in inp.items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            stripped = ctx.san.strip_reminders(value)
            if flag and len(stripped) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, flag)
            elif len(stripped) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(stripped):
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, "html")
            else:
                out[key] = ctx.san.redact(stripped)
        elif flag and len(json.dumps(value)) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
            out[key] = ctx.san.omit(json.dumps(value), flag)
        else:
            out[key] = ctx.san.any(value)
    return {**block, "input": out}


def strip_nested(value: Any, san: Sanitizer) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return san.strip_reminders(value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [strip_nested(v, san) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: strip_nested(v, san) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def clean_tool_result(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stripped = strip_nested(block.get("content"), ctx.san)
    text = result_text(stripped)
    reason = omission_reason(ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("tool_use_id"))), text)
    if reason:
        return {**block, "content": ctx.san.omit(text, reason)}
    if isinstance(stripped, list):
        items = [omitted_media(i) if is_media(i) else i for i in stripped]
        return {**block, "content": [ctx.san.any(i) for i in items]}
    return {**block, "content": ctx.san.any(stripped)}


def is_media(block: Any) -> bool:
    return isinstance(block, dict) and block.get("type") in ("image", "document")


def omitted_media(block: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "text", "text": f"[omitted: {block.get('type')}]"}


def clean_text_block(text: str, ctx: FileContext, meta: bool) -> str:
    stripped = ctx.san.strip_reminders(text)
    if meta and len(stripped) > SKILL_BODY_MIN_CHARS:
        ctx.san.counts["omitted:skill_body"] += 1
        return f"[omitted: skill/command instructions, {len(stripped)} chars]"
    if not stripped.strip() and text.strip():
        return "[removed: harness reminder]"
    return ctx.san.redact(stripped)


def clean_content(content: Any, ctx: FileContext, meta: bool) -> Any:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return clean_text_block(content, ctx, meta)
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        return ctx.san.any(content)
    out: list[Any] = []
    for block in content:
        if not isinstance(block, dict):
            out.append(ctx.san.any(block))
            continue
        kind = block.get("type")
        if is_media(block):
            out.append(omitted_media(block))
        elif kind == "text":
            out.append({**block, "text": clean_text_block(str(block.get("text", "")), ctx, meta)})
        elif kind == "thinking":
            kept = {k: v for k, v in block.items() if k != "signature"}
            out.append({**kept, "thinking": ctx.san.text(str(block.get("thinking", "")))})
        elif kind == "redacted_thinking":
            out.append({"type": "text", "text": "[omitted: redacted_thinking]"})
        elif kind == "tool_use":
            out.append(clean_tool_input(block, ctx))
        elif kind == "tool_result":
            out.append(clean_tool_result(block, ctx))
        else:
            out.append(ctx.san.any(block))
    return out


def record_key(rec: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    kind = str(rec.get("type", "<none>"))
    if kind == "attachment":
        return f"attachment:{(rec.get('attachment') or {}).get('type')}"
    if kind == "system":
        return f"system:{rec.get('subtype')}"
    return kind


def filter_record(rec: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Allowlist one transcript record and sanitize what survives; None means drop."""
    kind = rec.get("type")
    if kind not in KEEP_TYPES:
        return None
    if kind == "system" and rec.get("subtype") not in KEEP_SYSTEM:
        return None
    if kind == "attachment" and (rec.get("attachment") or {}).get("type") not in KEEP_ATTACHMENTS:
        return None
    allowed = BASE_KEYS | TYPE_KEYS[str(kind)]
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in rec.items():
        if key not in allowed:
            continue
        if key == "message" and isinstance(value, dict):
            msg = {k: ctx.san.any(v) for k, v in value.items() if k in MESSAGE_KEYS and k != "content"}
            msg["content"] = clean_content(value.get("content"), ctx, bool(rec.get("isMeta")))
            out[key] = msg
        elif key == "toolUseResult":
            if isinstance(value, dict) and LINK_RESULT_KEYS & value.keys():
                out[key] = ctx.san.any({k: v for k, v in value.items() if k in SLIM_RESULT_KEYS})
        else:
            out[key] = ctx.san.any(value)
    return out

def report_gate(hits: list[str]) -> int:
    if not hits:
        print("gate: PASS")
        return 0
    print(f"gate: FAIL ({len(hits)} hits)", file=sys.stderr)
    for hit in hits[:200]:
        print(f"  {hit}", file=sys.stderr)
    if len(hits) > 200:
        print(f"  ... {len(hits) - 200} more", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1


def resolve_session(projects_root: Path, session: str | None) -> tuple[Path, str]:
    encoded = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", "-", str(ROOT))
    project_dir = projects_root / encoded if (projects_root / encoded).is_dir() else projects_root
    candidates = sorted(project_dir.glob(f"{session or ''}*.jsonl"), key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
    if not candidates:
        sys.exit(f"no session JSONL matching {session or '*'!r} in {project_dir}")
    if session and len(candidates) > 1:
        sys.exit(f"session prefix {session!r} is ambiguous in {project_dir}")
    return project_dir, candidates[-1].stem


def reset_staging(staging: Path) -> None:
    if staging.exists():
        if any(staging.iterdir()) and not (staging / STAGING_MARKER).exists():
            sys.exit(f"refusing to clear {staging}: not an export staging dir (no {STAGING_MARKER})")
        shutil.rmtree(staging)
    staging.mkdir(parents=True)
    (staging / STAGING_MARKER).touch()


def publish(export_dir: Path, out: Path) -> None:
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for name in OUTPUT_NAMES:
        target = out / name
        if target.is_dir():
            shutil.rmtree(target)
        elif target.exists():
            target.unlink()
        shutil.move(str(export_dir / name), str(target))


def export(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    denylist = load_denylist(args.denylist)
    project_dir, sid = resolve_session(args.projects_root, args.session)
    print(f"session {sid}")
    staging: Path = args.staging
    reset_staging(staging)
    session_root = staging / "projects" / PROJECT_NAME
    export_dir = staging / "export"
    san, harvest = Sanitizer(denylist=denylist), Harvest()
    stage_session(project_dir, sid, session_root, san, harvest)
    meta = build_meta(harvest, san, sid)
    shutil.copytree(session_root, export_dir / "raw")
    if not args.no_render:
        render(session_root / f"{sid}.jsonl", export_dir / "rendered", staging / "ccl-cache.db")
        scrub_rendered(export_dir / "rendered", Sanitizer(denylist=denylist))
    else:
        (export_dir / "rendered").mkdir(parents=True)
    (export_dir / "meta.json").write_text(json.dumps(meta, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", "utf-8")
    (export_dir / "README.md").write_text(readme(meta), encoding="utf-8")
    records = meta["records"]
    print(f"records kept {records['kept_total']}, dropped {records['dropped_total']}")
    print("redactions " + json.dumps(meta["redactions"]))
    for path in sorted((export_dir / "rendered").glob("*")):
        print(f"rendered {path.name}: {path.stat().st_size / 1_048_576:.1f} MB")
    if report_gate(scan_paths(export_dir, denylist)):
        print(f"export kept in {export_dir}; nothing moved to {args.out}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    publish(export_dir, args.out)
    print(f"published to {args.out}")
    return 0


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    config_dir = Path(os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR", Path.home() / ".claude"))
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_OUT)
    parser.add_argument("--staging", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_STAGING)
    parser.add_argument("--scan-only", type=Path, help="only run the leak gate over this file or dir")
    parser.add_argument("--projects-root", type=Path, default=config_dir / "projects")
    parser.add_argument("--session", help="session id or prefix (default: most recently written)")
    parser.add_argument("--denylist", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_DENYLIST)
    parser.add_argument("--no-render", action="store_true", help="skip claude-code-log (raw + meta only)")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.scan_only:
        sys.exit(report_gate(scan_paths(args.scan_only, load_denylist(args.denylist))))
    sys.exit(export(args))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# AI conversation transcript

Exported from the Claude Code session that built this repo (`0024648c-2a0d-4dde-9495-8d22e0c9ccaa`,
2026-10-16T10:22:16.947Z to 2026-10-18T10:41:54.698Z UTC), including every subagent and workflow run it spawned.

## Contents

- `rendered/transcript.html`, `rendered/transcript.md`: readable render (claude-code-log@1.7.0, depth `tool`).
- `raw/`: the filtered, redacted JSONL in the original session layout (main thread, `subagents/**`,
  `workflows/**`); re-renderable with claude-code-log.
- `meta.json`: harness version, models, effort and thinking settings, modes, skills, workflows,
  subagent counts, token usage, record counts and redaction counts.

## What was removed, and why

- Harness plumbing: API request records, file-history snapshots, prompt snapshots, hook output,
  environment, listing and delta attachments. Noise for a reader, and some of it holds private configuration.
- Private context: the author's global instruction file, account and session context, credential data,
  harness reminder blocks inside messages and tool results, skill instruction bodies, and the output of
  tool calls that read local configuration (Claude config dirs other than this session's plan file,
  SSH/git/editor/env files, other session logs, listings above the repo) which becomes
  `[omitted: private local config, sha256=<prefix>, <n> chars]`.
- Thinking-block signatures, images and documents.
- Third-party content: tool calls touching `evals/data/private/`, raw HTML pages over 2 KB and fetched web
  content over 4 KB become `[omitted: publisher/web content, sha256=<prefix>, <n> chars]`.
- Redactions: home paths become `~`; emails other than the author's public address become
  `[redacted-email]`; credential-shaped strings become `[redacted-secret]`; private terms become `[redacted]`.

## How it was produced

`uv run python scripts/export_transcript.py`: allowlist filter and redaction into a staging dir,
render with `uvx claude-code-log@1.7.0`, then a leak gate over every output file (paths, emails, secrets,
private markers, size). Only a passing export is moved here. The final turns that ran this export
and pushed it are not included.

"""List which tool calls had their results or inputs replaced by an omission marker, grouped by label."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

RAW = Path(sys.argv[1])
LABEL = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "publisher/web content"
c: Counter[str] = Counter()
for path in sorted(RAW.rglob("*.jsonl")):
    tools: dict[str, str] = {}
    for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
        rec = json.loads(line)
        content = (rec.get("message") or {}).get("content")
        if not isinstance(content, list):
            continue
        for b in content:
            if b.get("type") == "tool_use":
                inp = b.get("input") or {}
                what = str(inp.get("command") or inp.get("file_path") or inp.get("url") or inp.get("path") or "")
                tools[b["id"]] = f"{b['name']}: {what[:90]}"
                if f"[omitted: {LABEL}" in json.dumps(inp):
                    c[f"INPUT  {path.name[:22]} {tools[b['id']]}"] += 1
            elif b.get("type") == "tool_result" and str(b.get("content", "")).startswith(f"[omitted: {LABEL}"):
                c[f"RESULT {path.name[:22]} {tools.get(b.get('tool_use_id'), '?')}"] += 1
for k, v in sorted(c.items()):
    print(f"{v:3d} {k}")

"""Recompute tool_info and omission_reason for tool calls matching a needle in a source transcript."""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("et", Path("scripts/export_transcript.py"))
assert spec is not None
assert spec.loader is not None
et = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
sys.modules["et"] = et
spec.loader.exec_module(et)

src, needle = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
infos: dict[str, object] = {}
for line in src.read_text().splitlines():
    try:
        rec = json.loads(line)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        continue
    content = (rec.get("message") or {}).get("content")
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        continue
    for b in content:
        if b.get("type") == "tool_use" and needle in json.dumps(b.get("input")):
            infos[b["id"]] = et.tool_info(b)
        elif b.get("type") == "tool_result" and b.get("tool_use_id") in infos:
            info = infos[b["tool_use_id"]]
            text = et.result_text(et.strip_nested(b.get("content"), et.Sanitizer()))
            print(info, len(text), et.is_html(text), et.omission_reason(info, text))

@dataclass
class FileContext:
    san: Sanitizer
    tools: dict[str, ToolInfo]


def clean_tool_input(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    info = ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("id")))
    inp = block.get("input")
    if not isinstance(inp, dict):
        return {**block, "input": ctx.san.any(inp)}
    flag = info.flag if info else None
    code_file = bool(info and info.code_file)
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in inp.items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            stripped = ctx.san.strip_reminders(value)
            if flag and len(stripped) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, flag)
            elif len(stripped) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(stripped) and not code_file:
                out[key] = ctx.san.omit(stripped, "html")
            else:
                out[key] = ctx.san.redact(stripped)
        elif flag and len(json.dumps(value)) > FLAGGED_INPUT_MAX_CHARS:
            out[key] = ctx.san.omit(json.dumps(value), flag)
        else:
            out[key] = ctx.san.any(value)
    return {**block, "input": out}


def strip_nested(value: Any, san: Sanitizer) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return san.strip_reminders(value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [strip_nested(v, san) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: strip_nested(v, san) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value


def clean_tool_result(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stripped = strip_nested(block.get("content"), ctx.san)
    text = result_text(stripped)
    reason = omission_reason(ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("tool_use_id"))), text)
    if reason:
        return {**block, "content": ctx.san.omit(text, reason)}
    if isinstance(stripped, list):
        items = [omitted_media(i) if is_media(i) else i for i in stripped]

def clean_tool_result(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stripped = strip_nested(block.get("content"), ctx.san)
    text = result_text(stripped)
    reason = omission_reason(ctx.tools.get(str(block.get("tool_use_id"))), text)
    if reason:
        return {**block, "content": ctx.san.omit(text, reason)}
    if isinstance(stripped, list):
        items = [omitted_media(i) if is_media(i) else i for i in stripped]
        return {**block, "content": [ctx.san.any(i) for i in items]}
    return {**block, "content": ctx.san.any(stripped)}

+    """A read-only `cat`/`head`/`sed -n` over source files shows code, whatever tags it contains."""
+    if not VIEW_CMD_RE.match(command) or "http" in command:

"""List kept strings over 2 KB in exported raw JSONL that contain an HTML document tag, with their origin."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

RAW = Path(sys.argv[1])
DOC = re.compile(r"<!doctype\s+html|<html[\s>]", re.IGNORECASE)
LOOSE = re.compile(r"<html|<!doctype html", re.IGNORECASE)


def strings(v: Any, where: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    if isinstance(v, str):
        return [(where, v)]
    if isinstance(v, dict):
        return [s for k, x in v.items() for s in strings(x, f"{where}.{k}")]
    if isinstance(v, list):
        return [s for x in v for s in strings(x, where)]
    return []


for path in sorted(RAW.rglob("*.json*")):
    tools: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = path.read_text().splitlines() if path.suffix == ".jsonl" else [path.read_text()]
    for line in lines:
        rec = json.loads(line)
        content = (rec.get("message") or {}).get("content") if isinstance(rec, dict) else None
        if isinstance(content, list):
            for b in content:
                if b.get("type") == "tool_use":
                    inp = b.get("input") or {}
                    tools[b["id"]] = f"{b['name']}: {str(inp.get('command') or inp.get('file_path') or '')[:80]}"
        for where, s in strings(rec, ""):
            if len(s) > 2048 and LOOSE.search(s):
                origin = ""
                if isinstance(content, list):
                    ids = [b.get("tool_use_id") for b in content if b.get("type") == "tool_result"]
                    origin = " | ".join(tools.get(str(i), "?") for i in ids)
                strict = "DOC" if DOC.search(s) else "mention"
                print(f"{strict:7} {len(s):6d} {path.name[:22]} {where[:40]} {origin[:110]}")

```

"""Export this repo's Claude Code session as a redacted transcript: raw JSONL, HTML/Markdown, meta.json.

from __future__ import annotations

DEFAULT_STAGING = ROOT / ".temp" / "transcript" / "staging"
DEFAULT_OUT = ROOT / ".context" / "transcript"
DEFAULT_DENYLIST = ROOT / ".temp" / "transcript" / "denylist.txt"
RENDERER = "claude-code-log@1.7.0"
RENDER_FLAGS = ("--depth", "tool", "--image-export-mode", "placeholder", "--no-cache")
PROJECT_NAME = "veritrade-analytics"
STAGING_MARKER = ".transcript-staging"
OUTPUT_NAMES = ("raw", "rendered", "meta.json", "README.md")

# Assembled at runtime so this file's source, once it appears in the transcript it exports,

TYPE_KEYS: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {

"""Histogram of kept (non-omitted) tool result sizes per tool for one exported raw JSONL, plus the largest commands."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

path = Path(sys.argv[1])
tools: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}
buckets: Counter[str] = Counter()
largest: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
    rec = json.loads(line)
    content = (rec.get("message") or {}).get("content")
    if not isinstance(content, list):
        continue
    for b in content:
        if b.get("type") == "tool_use":
            inp = b.get("input") or {}
            tools[b["id"]] = (b["name"], str(inp.get("command") or inp.get("url") or inp.get("file_path") or "")[:70])
        elif b.get("type") == "tool_result":
            text = b["content"] if isinstance(b["content"], str) else json.dumps(b["content"])
            if text.startswith("[omitted:"):
                continue
            name, what = tools.get(b["tool_use_id"], ("?", ""))
            size = len(text)
            bucket = "<1k" if size < 1000 else "1-4k" if size < 4096 else ">4k"
            buckets[f"{name} {bucket}"] += 1
            largest.append((size, f"{name}: {what}"))
for k, v in sorted(buckets.items()):
    print(f"{v:4d} {k}")
for size, what in sorted(largest, reverse=True)[:8]:
    print(f"{size:6d} {what}")

```

"""Tests for scripts/export_transcript.py on synthetic session fixtures."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "export_transcript.py"
_SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("export_transcript", _PATH)
assert _SPEC is not None
assert _SPEC.loader is not None
et = importlib.util.module_from_spec(_SPEC)
sys.modules["export_transcript"] = et
_SPEC.loader.exec_module(et)

# Leak-shaped values are concatenated so this file stays legible in the redacted transcript it ends up in.
EMAIL = "someone" + "@example.com"
HOME = "/Users" + "/someone"
OPEN, CLOSE = f"<{et.SR}>", f"</{et.SR}>"
SID = "11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555"


def rec(kind: str, uuid: str, parent: str | None = None, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    base = {"type": kind, "uuid": uuid, "parentUuid": parent, "isSidechain": False, "userType": "external"}
    return (
        base
        | {"cwd": f"{HOME}/repo", "sessionId": SID, "version": "9.9.9", "timestamp": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
        | extra
    )


def attachment(uuid: str, parent: str | None, kind: str, **payload: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return rec(
        "attachment", uuid, parent, attachment={"type": kind, **payload}, rendered=[f"{OPEN}\nx\n{CLOSE}"]
    )


def assistant(
    uuid: str, parent: str | None, mid: str, blocks: list[dict[str, Any]], **usage: int
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    msg = {"id": mid, "type": "message", "role": "assistant", "model": "claude-test", "content": blocks}
    return rec("assistant", uuid, parent, message=msg | {"usage": usage}, effort="high")


def user(uuid: str, parent: str | None, content: Any, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return rec("user", uuid, parent, message={"role": "user", "content": content}, **extra)


def tool_use(tid: str, name: str, **inp: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "tool_use", "id": tid, "name": name, "input": inp}


def tool_result(tid: str, content: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": tid, "content": content}


def write_jsonl(path: Path, records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(r) + "\n" for r in records))


def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]


def stage(
    tmp_path: Path, records: list[dict[str, Any]], denylist: list[str] | None = None
) -> tuple[Any, Any, Path]:
    project = tmp_path / "proj"
    write_jsonl(project / f"{SID}.jsonl", records)
    san, harvest = et.Sanitizer(denylist=denylist or []), et.Harvest()
    et.stage_session(project, SID, tmp_path / "staged", san, harvest)
    return san, harvest, tmp_path / "staged" / f"{SID}.jsonl"

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1.7
# Stage 1: static Next.js export (FastAPI serves it from the same origin, so no Node at runtime).
FROM node:24-slim AS fe
WORKDIR /src/frontend
RUN corepack enable
COPY frontend/package.json frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml frontend/pnpm-workspace.yaml ./
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.local/share/pnpm/store pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
COPY frontend/ ./
COPY evals/results/ /src/evals/results/
RUN pnpm build

# Stage 2: locked, non-editable backend install (runtime image carries no source tree).
FROM ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:python3.13-bookworm-slim AS py
ENV UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1 UV_LINK_MODE=copy UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=never
WORKDIR /app
COPY pyproject.toml uv.lock .python-version ./
COPY backend/pyproject.toml backend/pyproject.toml
COPY evals/pyproject.toml evals/pyproject.toml
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-install-workspace --package veritrade-backend
COPY backend/ backend/
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/root/.cache/uv \
    uv sync --frozen --no-dev --no-editable --package veritrade-backend

# Stage 3: slim runtime.
FROM python:3.13-slim-bookworm AS runtime
RUN useradd --create-home --uid 10001 app
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=py /app/.venv /app/.venv
COPY --from=fe /src/frontend/out /app/static
ENV PATH=/app/.venv/bin:$PATH \
    PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    VT_STATIC_DIR=/app/static
USER app
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=10s --timeout=4s --start-period=20s --retries=5 CMD ["veritrade-healthcheck"]
CMD ["uvicorn", "veritrade.api.app:create_app", "--factory", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
EOF
cat > docker/ollama-pull.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# One-shot init: pull the comma-separated VT_PULL_MODELS into the shared ollama volume.
set -eu
old_ifs=$IFS
IFS=','
for model in $VT_PULL_MODELS; do
  IFS=$old_ifs
  echo "pulling ${model}"
  ollama pull "${model}"
done
echo "models ready"
EOF
cat > .dockerignore <<'EOF'
.git
.github
.temp
.context
.venv
**/__pycache__
**/.mypy_cache
**/.ruff_cache
**/.pytest_cache
frontend/node_modules
frontend/.next
frontend/out
frontend/test-results
frontend/playwright-report
evals/data
backend/tests
**/.DS_Store
EOF
cat > compose.yaml <<'EOF'
# Default: the app talks to native Ollama on the host (Metal on macOS).
# Bundled CPU Ollama (Linux / CI / no native install):
#   docker compose --env-file deploy/bundled.env up -d
name: veritrade

services:
  app:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: docker/app.Dockerfile
    image: veritrade-app:local
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    environment:
      OLLAMA_BASE_URL: ${VT_OLLAMA_BASE_URL:-http://host.docker.internal:11434}
      VT_OLLAMA_BACKEND_LABEL: ${VT_OLLAMA_BACKEND_LABEL:-native-metal}
      # Host-side OLLAMA_MODELS restricts the allowlist; never passed raw into the ollama container,
      # where the same name means "model storage dir".
      VT_MODELS: ${OLLAMA_MODELS:-}
      VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SIGNAL: ${VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SIGNAL:-}
      VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SUMMARY: ${VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SUMMARY:-}
      VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_ANALYZE: ${VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_ANALYZE:-}
      SEC_USER_AGENT: ${SEC_USER_AGENT:-VeriTrade Analytics PoC kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com}
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    depends_on:
      ollama-pull:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: false

  ollama:
    profiles: [bundled]
    image: ollama/ollama:${OLLAMA_IMAGE_TAG:-0.40.6}
    volumes:
      - ${OLLAMA_MODEL_DIR:-ollama-models}:/root/.ollama
    environment:
      OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE: 30m
      OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS: "2"
      OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION: "1"
      OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE: q8_0
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "ollama", "list"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 30

  ollama-pull:
    profiles: [bundled]
    image: ollama/ollama:${OLLAMA_IMAGE_TAG:-0.40.6}
    depends_on:
      ollama:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      OLLAMA_HOST: http://ollama:11434
      VT_PULL_MODELS: ${VT_PULL_MODELS:-qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0,tev1:0.8b-q8_0}
    volumes:
      - ./docker/ollama-pull.sh:/scripts/ollama-pull.sh:ro
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "/scripts/ollama-pull.sh"]
    restart: "no"

volumes:
  ollama-models:
EOF

```
     168 .context/docs/design/02-source-probe.md
# 02 - Source probe

Question (Q18, Q19): which of the 14 candidate publishers can a plain Python client fetch, with no evasion,
and what do the extractors need to know about each one? The answer is measured, not assumed:
`scripts/probe_sources.py` fetched every candidate live on 2026-10-18 and its output decided
`backend/src/veritrade/data/sources.toml`.

## Method

- **Client**: `httpx 0.28.1` `AsyncClient`, HTTP/2, the Chrome 155 desktop header set from
  `veritrade.fetch.headers` (UA, Accept, `Accept-Language: en-US`, client hints, `Sec-Fetch-*`,
  `Upgrade-Insecure-Requests`, `Priority`), `Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br` because `brotli` is installed.
  `sec.gov` gets the declared `SEC_USER_AGENT` and no Chrome hints. No cookies are pre-seeded, no TLS
  impersonation, headless browser, proxy or captcha solving (Q19).
- **Redirects**: followed by hand (max 5), exactly as the serving fetcher will; a hop to Yahoo's consent hosts is
  answered once with reject-all (`veritrade.fetch.consent`) and the original URL retried.
- **Politeness**: one request at a time per registrable domain with at least 1 s between them; EDGAR at 5 req/s
  (half its 10 req/s fair-access ceiling). Reported fetch times exclude these waits.
- **Discovery**: each source's `feeds` (RSS/Atom, non-English `dc:language` items skipped) or `sections`
  (HTML pages and sitemaps), filtered by `article_pattern`; the 3 newest matches are probed. EDGAR resolves the
  8-K Atom feed to filing indexes and then to the EX-99.1 exhibit, preferring index descriptions that say press
  release, earnings or results. When a source refuses its own hubs, links to it are harvested from the other
  sources' captured pages (AP).
- **Per article** (all in `evals/data/source_probe.json`, metadata only): status, final URL, redirects, bytes,
  network ms, `detect.classify` outcome and time, JSON-LD types / `articleBody` words / `isAccessibleForFree` /
  `hasPart` selectors, framework JSON markers, ranked body-container candidates with paragraph and word counts
  under both parsers, noise blocks inside the best container (selectors only) and press-release boilerplate
  labels (label and position only). Raw HTML goes to `evals/data/private/probe/<source>/<n>.html` (gitignored).
- **Profile check**: every `[sources.<key>.profile]` is applied with selectolax (Lexbor) and lxml `cssselect`;
  it passes when both parsers keep the same paragraphs in the same order (non-whitespace characters within 1%)
  and the body has at least 120 words. `--reanalyze` reruns all analysis on the saved HTML without network,
  which is how the profiles were tuned.

## Results

Vantage: residential ISP in Bulgaria (EU), macOS, Sunday 2026-10-18. Fetch ms is network time per article
(median, max of 3); size is the median HTML size.

| Source | Discovery used | OK | Fetch ms | Size | JSON-LD NewsArticle / articleBody | `isAccessibleForFree` | Blocks, consent | Profile |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yahoo Finance | `/topic/stock-market-news/` page (RSS now 404) | 3/3 | 477 (575) | 682 KB | 3 / 0 | absent | none; no consent redirect | 3/3 |
| CNBC | RSS `id/100003114` | 3/3 | 161 (221) | 838 KB | 3 / 0 | absent | none | 3/3 |
| Motley Fool | RSS `foolwatch` | 3/3 | 202 (235) | 372 KB | 3 / 0 | absent | none | 3/3 |
| PR Newswire | RSS financial services | 3/3 | 34 (43) | 219 KB | 3 / 0 | absent | none | 3/3 |
| GlobeNewswire | RSS public companies | 3/3 | 552 (662) | 74 KB | 3 / 0 | true | none | 3/3 |
| SEC 8-K EX-99.1 | Atom, 25 indexes, 2 releases + 1 statement | 3/3 | 135 (538) | 19 KB | 0 / 0 | absent | none (declared UA) | 3/3 |
| CNN Business | `edition.cnn.com/business` page (no RSS) | 3/3 | 35 (50) | 5.7 MB | 3 / 3 | false, full text served | none; www redirects to edition for EU | 3/3 |
| Fortune | RSS | 3/3 | 367 (495) | 431 KB | 3 / 0 | "False", full text served | none | 3/3 |
| Guardian Business | RSS `uk/business` | 3/3 | 116 (169) | 412 KB | 3 / 0 | true | none | 3/3 |
| BBC Business | RSS | 3/3 | 26 (62) | 394 KB | 3 / 0 | absent | none | 3/3 |
| AP News | hub + news sitemap both 403; 3 links harvested | 0/3 | - | - | - | - | Cloudflare managed challenge (403, `cf-mitigated: challenge`) on every path | - |
| Investing.com | RSS works | 0/3 | - | - | - | - | Cloudflare 403 with a 3-byte body on every HTML page | - |
| Benzinga | Google News sitemap works | 0/3 | - | - | - | - | Cloudflare "Sorry, you have been blocked" 403 on every HTML page | - |
| Business Wire | MRSS feed works | 0/3 | - | - | - | - | Akamai 403 "Page Unavailable" on releases; `/newsroom` serves an Akamai interactive challenge with HTTP 200 | - |

Every response came over HTTP/2 and no article URL redirected. One PR Newswire release took 6.8 s on a cache
miss during an earlier run, close to the 8 s fetch deadline.

+## Build-time findings that adjusted the plan
+
+Measured during P1/P2, recorded here so the deviations are traceable. Inputs for the Ollama probe were synthetic
+(`evals/results/ollama_probe.json`, native Metal, warm, n=5).
+
+- **Sources** (`02-source-probe.md`): AP News, Investing.com, Benzinga and Business Wire refuse a plain client at
+  their CDN (Cloudflare / Akamai), so all four backups were promoted. Final 10: Yahoo Finance, CNBC, Motley Fool,
+  PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, SEC EDGAR EX-99.1, CNN Business, Fortune, Guardian Business, BBC Business.
+- **R7 sanity gate passed**: each endpoint has at least one candidate inside its budget, so no budget moved.
+  - `/signal`: `qwen3.5:0.8b` answers in 190 ms at ~510 prompt tokens. The 9B decision models take 1.3-1.5 s
+    at the same size, so they are reported against the budget rather than the budget relaxed for them.
+  - `/summary`: `qwen3.5:2b` shows first text at 0.93 s and finishes at 2.2 s on ~1.6k-token articles;
+    `qwen3.5:4b` misses the 1.5 s TTFT budget at that size (2.4 s).
+  - `/analyze`: `ministral-3:3b` reaches the score at 1.47 s and finishes at 3.5 s on ~1.75k tokens; the 4B
+    qwen models miss TTFT at full-article size.
+- **Logprobs**: Ollama 0.40.6 also returns logprobs on streamed chunks (undocumented). The knob comparison stays
+  on non-streaming `/signal`; `/analyze` keeps the ordinal knob. Logprob-weighted streaming confidence goes to
+  the backlog.
+- **Field order**: `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507` ignores schema property order (always entity, score, summary) and
+  ignores `think:false` when a schema is set, so the field-order dimension runs on `qwen3.5:4b` and
+  `ministral-3:3b` only.
+- **Fetch cap** raised from 5 MB to 10 MB: CNN article pages are 5.7-6.6 MB decompressed.

@dataclass
class ToolInfo:
    name: str
    flag: str | None = None  # omission reason that covers both the call's long inputs and its result
    fetch_like: bool = False
    code_file: bool = False


def tool_info(block: dict[str, Any]) -> ToolInfo:
    name = str(block.get("name", ""))
    raw = block.get("input")
    inp: dict[str, Any] = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    targets = [str(v) for k, v in inp.items() if k in TARGET_KEYS and isinstance(v, str)]
    flag = None
    if any(PRIVATE_DATA in t for t in targets):
        flag = "private_data"
    elif any(rx.search(t) for t in targets for rx in PRIVATE_CONFIG_RES):
        flag = "private_config"
    command = str(inp.get("command", ""))
    file_path = inp.get("file_path") or inp.get("notebook_path")
    code_file = isinstance(file_path, str) and Path(file_path).suffix.lower() in CODE_SUFFIXES
    return ToolInfo(
        name=name,
        flag=flag,
        fetch_like=name == "Bash" and bool(FETCH_CMD_RE.search(command)),
        code_file=code_file or (name == "Bash" and views_code_only(command)),
    )


def views_code_only(command: str) -> bool:
    """A read-only `cat`/`head`/`sed -n` over source files shows code, whatever tags it contains."""
    if not VIEW_CMD_RE.match(command) or "http" in command:
        return False
    files = [Path(f) for f in FILE_TOKEN_RE.findall(command)]
    return bool(files) and all(f.suffix.lower() in CODE_SUFFIXES or f.name.startswith(".") for f in files)


def result_text(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        return "\n".join(str(i.get("text", "")) for i in content if isinstance(i, dict))
    return ""


def omission_reason(info: ToolInfo | None, text: str) -> str | None:
    """Why a tool result must not be published, or None to keep it."""
    name = info.name if info else ""
    if info and info.flag:
        return info.flag
    if len(text) > HTML_MIN_CHARS and is_html(text) and not (info and info.code_file):
        return "html"
    if WEB_TOOL_RE.search(name) and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if info and info.fetch_like and len(text) > WEB_MIN_CHARS:
        return "web_fetch"
    if name not in MODEL_AUTHORED_TOOLS and PRIVATE_CONTENT_RE.search(text):
        return "private_mention"
    return None


@dataclass
class FileContext:
    san: Sanitizer
    tools: dict[str, ToolInfo]


def clean_tool_input(block: dict[str, Any], ctx: FileContext) -> dict[str, Any]:

> 1. Composition: `create_app(settings=None, *, fetcher=None, ollama=None)` (keep the factory usable by `uvicorn veritrade.api.app:create_app --factory`). Injectables for tests. Clean shutdown (aclose).
> 2. services/article.py: fetch through the single-flight cache (CacheResult.status -> CacheInfo.fetch; no_cache -> "bypass"), then extract (extract.registry.extract with the request's parser/extractor) off the event loop for CPU-heavy extractors (bs4 and third-party at least; your call for selectolax/lxml, measure it), then extract.scope.build_input(article, scope, spec.max_input_tokens). Timings: fetch_ms and consent_ms from FetchResult (fetch_ms already excludes consent_ms), parse_ms and extract_ms from Article.
> 3. services/signal.py, summary.py, analyze.py using inference.adapters (classify_signal, summarize, summarize_stream, analyze, analyze_stream). Resolve the model via Registry.resolve(endpoint, model) BEFORE any network work (ModelNotAllowed -> 400). Map Verdict -> SignalResult. meta: every ArticleMeta field (endpoint, model, model_kind, prompt_version, parser, extractor, extraction_method, scope, input_chars, word_count, field_order for analyze, cached, backend=settings.ollama_backend_label, source, title, published_at, final_url). Timings: total_ms from request receipt; inference timings from ChatResult/DecisionResult.
> 4. Result cache: key (endpoint, normalize_url(url), model, prompt_version, parser, extractor, scope); TTL setting; no_cache bypasses both caches. Cache only successful results. Streaming endpoints on a hit replay the cached result as events (meta with cached=true, sentiment if analyze, one summary_delta with the whole summary, done).
> 5. SSE (FastAPI's native fastapi.sse EventSourceResponse/ServerSentEvent, already used by the route stubs): /summary/stream emits meta -> summary_delta* -> done; /analyze/stream emits meta -> sentiment (exactly once, the moment the scanner closes the score; ordinal policy via adapters.score_verdict) and summary_delta* in generation order -> done. Errors that happen before the stream opens (invalid URL, SSRF, model not allowed, fetch/extract errors) must be raised BEFORE returning the EventSourceResponse so the client gets a normal JSON error with the right HTTP status. Failures after the stream opens emit one `error` event and close. Wrap adapter streams in contextlib.aclosing; a client disconnect must stop the upstream Ollama stream (test this). SentimentEvent.elapsed_ms and the stream's ttft_ms are measured from request receipt; ttft is the first summary_delta (user-visible text), not the first JSON punctuation chunk. Send no-cache / no-buffering headers.
> 6. GET /api/models: allowlist x installed tags from OllamaClient (installed, size_bytes; cache the tag list for ~10 s; Ollama down -> installed=false for all, still 200), defaults, evaluated flag, plus parsers/extractors/scopes from extract.types. GET /api/health: Ollama reachable + version; status "degraded" when unreachable or version < 0.40.4; backend label; app version. Always 200.
> 7. Keep the static export mount at "/" after the routers, CORS only when configured. Keep the hot path lean (this service is judged on latency): no per-request client construction, no blocking calls on the loop, no redundant JSON round trips.

# VeriTrade Analytics prescreen - implementation plan

## Context

VeriTrade's prescreen (`.context/prescreen-brief-kristiyan-dimitrov.md`) asks for a Python API that takes a public
financial-news URL, fetches and extracts the article, and returns an LLM summary + Bullish/Bearish/Neutral sentiment
with low latency, plus a basic frontend, a README (design, latency trade-offs, run/test, AI tools) and the committed AI
conversation log. Kris handpicked the approach from `.context/openai-research.md` in a `/grill-me` interview (Q1-Q20,
R1-R10, 3 follow-ups); every decision below is settled. Guiding principle: this is a PoC, balance rigor per aspect.
Deliverable: public repo `cleverjobs/veritrade-analytics`, everything pushed, transcript + meta under `.context/`.

Greenfield repo: only `.context/` exists, so there is nothing to reuse; evals import the serving code so what is
measured is what is served.

## Settled decisions (copied verbatim into `.context/docs/design/01-decisions.md`)

| Area | Decision |
|---|---|
| Stack | FastAPI + uv (Python 3.13 workspace: `backend`, `evals`); Next.js 16 static export served BY FastAPI (one origin, zero proxy hops, no nginx/Node at runtime); dev = `pnpm dev` + CORS localhost |
| Ollama | Native brew Ollama 0.40.4 (Metal) is the Mac default; compose profile `bundled` (ollama/ollama:0.40.5 + pull init) for Linux/CI; `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` switch; results labelled `native-metal` / `docker-cpu` |
| Split group | `/api/signal`: decision models `clef-flash:9b-q8_0`, `nimble:9b-q4_K_M` (`/v1/systemone`, native probabilities) + generative baseline `qwen3.5:0.8b`; `/api/summary`: `qwen3.5:2b`, `qwen3.5:4b` |
| Combined group | `/api/analyze`: `qwen3.5:4b`, `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507`, `ministral-3:3b`; `qwen3.5:9b` holdout-only quality ceiling |
| Objective | F0.5 macro over {bullish, bearish}; bullish<->bearish inversion cap 2%; winner = best F0.5 within latency budget, else Pareto knee (stated) |
| Confidence | Compare label-token logprob threshold vs ordinal -2..+2 \|score\| threshold for generative models; decision models threshold `probabilities`; API returns `sentiment` + `abstained` (+ confidence/score) |
| Scope | `/signal` `scope=lede` (default) vs `full`, both evaluated |
| Streaming | Both SSE and JSON variants for `/summary` and `/analyze`; SSE events `meta` -> `sentiment` -> `summary_delta*` -> `done` (sentiment exactly once before `done`; position follows frozen field order) |
| Budgets (native, warm, excl. fetch) | `/signal` lede p50 <= 500 ms; `/summary` + `/analyze` TTFT <= 1.5 s, complete p50 <= 4 s; surfaced to Kris (not moved) if unrealistic after baseline |
| Data | Dev: stratified 300 Twitter FNS train; holdout: full Twitter validation + FPB AllAgree (zip, never committed) + FinEntity single-label; 90 Opus-labelled articles (10 sources x 3 classes x 3; 30 dev / 60 test), double label + adjudicator, no human check |
| Prompts | Lean grid per model (2 rubrics x few-shot {0,4} x field order where relevant, <= 8 configs), one error-analysis pass, freeze, holdout once |
| Summaries | <= 3 sentences / 60 words, lead with market-moving fact; eval = deterministic checks + embedding key-fact coverage + Opus-as-judge on finalists |
| Extraction | Matrix: parsers {selectolax, lxml, bs4+html.parser, bs4+lxml} x own {jsonld, profile, density, cascade} + trafilatura {default, precision}, readability-lxml, newspaper4k, justext, strip-tags; Opus gold bodies (gitignored); switchable from UI |
| Sources | Yahoo Finance, CNBC, AP News, Investing.com, Motley Fool, Benzinga, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, SEC EDGAR 8-K EX-99.1, CNN Business; backups Fortune, Business Wire, Guardian, BBC; `probe_sources.py` decides |
| Fetching | Browser header set, no evasion; typed `source_blocked` / `paywalled` / `consent_required` with hints; Yahoo consent = reject-all + cookie cache, fallback `consent_required`; `SEC_USER_AGENT` env |
| Tests/CI | Unit + integration BE/FE, Playwright e2e on compose, all on GitHub Actions; skeleton fixtures (real DOM, synthetic text) + weekly non-blocking live smoke |
| Repo | Milestone commits straight to `main` (no branches); repo-local `Kristiyan Dimitrov <kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com>`; MIT; `.context/` committed; transcript = session `0024648c-...` only, redacted |
| Ops | Stop all other running Docker containers during setup (names recorded); leave them stopped; final message gives the exact `docker start ...` |

## Architecture

```
pyproject.toml uv.lock .python-version(3.13)   # uv workspace root; ruff, mypy, pytest config
backend/src/veritrade/
  config.py errors.py timing.py models_registry.py
  data/{models.toml, sources.toml}              # single serving config + source registry
  fetch/{client,ssrf,headers,consent,detect,cache}.py
  extract/{dom,jsonld,profiles,density,cascade,third_party,registry,scope}.py
  prompts/{registry.py, data/<endpoint>/<model>.toml}
  inference/{schemas,ollama,decision,adapters,confidence,incremental}.py
  services/{article,signal,summary,analyze}.py
  api/{app,routes,contracts,sse}.py  healthcheck.py
backend/tests/{unit,integration,live}/  backend/tests/fixtures/{skeletons/<source>/,ollama/}
evals/src/veritrade_evals/{__main__,datasets,splits,runner,metrics,extraction_bench,latency,opus,select,report}.py
evals/{opus_prompts/, data/{splits,articles,judgements}/, results/}   evals/data/private/ (gitignored)
frontend/{src/app/{page,benchmarks/page}.tsx, src/lib/{api,sse}.ts, src/components/, tests/, e2e/}
docker/app.Dockerfile  docker/ollama-pull.sh  compose.yaml  compose.e2e.yaml  env/{bundled.env,ci-models.txt}
scripts/{check,dev_setup,probe_sources,capture_skeletons,export_openapi,export_transcript}.py
.github/workflows/{ci.yml,live-smoke.yml}
.context/{brief, research, docs/design/{00-overview,01-decisions,02-source-probe,03-extraction,04-evals,05-latency,90-optional-backlog}.md, transcript/}
```

Backend essentials:
- **fetch/**: one `httpx.AsyncClient(http2=True, follow_redirects=False)`; manual redirect loop (max 5) with
  `ssrf.check_target` on every hop (http/https, ports 80/443, all resolved IPs `is_global`); streamed body cap 5 MB,
  HTML content-type gate, 3 s connect / 8 s deadline. `headers.py` Chrome set, `sec.gov` uses `SEC_USER_AGENT`
  (default: public commit contact), EDGAR <= 10 req/s. `consent.py` Yahoo reject-all POST + retry once.
  `detect.classify` maps 401/403/429 + challenge markers (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai) to
  `SourceBlocked`, JSON-LD `isAccessibleForFree:false` to `Paywalled`. `cache.SingleFlightCache` (LRU+TTL,
  in-flight task sharing; typed errors 60 s negative TTL).
- **extract/**: `Dom` protocol over 4 parser backends; own strategies run on `Dom` (16 cells); third-party
  extractors lazy-imported (parser N/A); `registry.extract(html, url, parser, extractor) -> Article`;
  `scope.build_input` lede (~200 tokens) / full, capped by model `max_input_tokens`. Press-release boilerplate
  (forward-looking statements, About, contacts) dropped by profiles.
- **prompts/**: TOML per (endpoint, model) with versions `v1..vN`, `active=`; `prompt_version` includes content
  sha so caches invalidate. Article text fenced as untrusted data.
- **inference/**: `ollama.OllamaClient` (httpx) is the ONLY Ollama path for app and evals: `chat`/`chat_stream`
  (`think:false`, JSON-schema `format`, `temperature:0`, `seed`, `num_ctx`/`num_predict` from `models.toml`,
  `logprobs:true, top_logprobs:20` on non-streaming label calls), `systemone` (criteria order neutral, bullish,
  bearish; client-side timing), `embed`, `ps`, `unload`, `show`, `version`. `confidence.py` policies:
  `ProbabilityPolicy`, `LabelLogprobPolicy` (first-token probs of the 3 labels; score-sign fallback if tokens
  collide), `OrdinalPolicy`; streaming and `/analyze` always use ordinal. `incremental.JsonFieldScanner` emits
  `ScoreClosed` / `SummaryText` from chunk deltas (escape-safe).
- **config**: `models.toml` holds allowlist, per-endpoint defaults, `num_ctx`, `num_predict`, scope default, ordinal
  `t` (always) and `tau` (when knob L wins); `freeze` writes it. Container env: `VT_MODELS`, `VT_PULL_MODELS`
  (host-side compose var `OLLAMA_MODELS` maps to these; never passed raw into the ollama container),
  `VT_OLLAMA_BACKEND_LABEL`, `VT_SSRF_TEST_ALLOW_HOSTS` (refused unless `VT_ENV=test`).
- **API** (`/api`): `POST /signal`, `/summary`, `/summary/stream`, `/analyze`, `/analyze/stream`; `GET /models`
  (allowlist x installed tags x defaults), `GET /health` (Ollama reachable, version >= 0.40.4, backend label).
  Requests carry `url, model?, parser, extractor, scope, no_cache`. Responses carry `meta` (model, prompt_version,
  parser, extractor, scope, cached) and `timings` (fetch, consent, parse, extract, inference wall/ttft/load/
  prompt_eval/eval, cache hit/miss/joined). One error table in `contracts.py`: 400 invalid_url /
  blocked_destination / model_not_allowed; 422 paywalled / consent_required / extraction_empty /
  unsupported_content; 502 source_blocked / upstream_http; 503 model_unavailable / llm_unreachable; 504 timeouts.
  Fetch/extract errors return before a stream opens; mid-stream failures emit `error`. Static export mounted at `/`
  after the routers.
- **Frontend**: Next 16 App Router, strict TS, CSS modules, `output:'export'`. Analyze page: URL, mode
  split|combined, streaming toggle, model/parser/extractor/scope pickers from `/api/models`, SignalCard (abstained
  state), streaming SummaryPanel, ErrorBanner (code + hint), LatencyBar (two lanes in split mode). Split mode fires
  `/signal` + `/summary/stream` concurrently (backend single-flight shares the fetch). `lib/sse.ts` = fetch +
  `TextDecoderStream` frame parser + AbortController. Benchmarks page renders `benchmarks.json` (prebuild copies
  `evals/results/benchmarks.json`, falls back to committed `benchmarks.sample.json`). Types generated from
  `backend/openapi.json` (drift-checked).
- **Docker**: `app.Dockerfile` stages node:24-slim (pnpm build) -> uv python3.13 (`uv sync --frozen --no-dev
  --no-editable --package veritrade-backend`) -> python:3.13-slim runtime, non-root, `veritrade-healthcheck`
  console script, `uvicorn veritrade.api.app:create_app --factory`. `compose.yaml`: `app` (8000, default
  `OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:11434`, `extra_hosts` host-gateway); profile `bundled`: `ollama`
  (named volume, no host port, healthcheck `ollama list`) + `ollama-pull` (`service_completed_successfully`,
  `required:false`), enabled via `--profile bundled --env-file env/bundled.env`. `compose.e2e.yaml`: nginx
  `fixture-site` serving skeletons as `fixtures.local`, test env, model dir bind mount for CI cache.

## Evaluation (`uv run python -m veritrade_evals <cmd>`)

- **Datasets**: Twitter FNS parquet via `hf_hub_download` at pinned revision; FPB zip ->
  `Sentences_AllAgree.txt` (iso-8859-1, `rsplit("@",1)`); FinEntity single-label rows. Committed: revisions lock,
  split ids + text hashes; never dataset text. dev300 balanced 100/100/100 (seed 20261018) with prevalence weights
  applied to metrics and tau selection (flagged in docs).
- **Runner**: async, bounded concurrency (4 for accuracy, 1 for latency), resumable JSONL prediction cache keyed by
  sha(config, model digest, rendered prompt, harness version), one model resident at a time via
  `OllamaClient.ps/unload`. Sentiment-first runs stop after the score closes (later tokens cannot change it).
- **Grid** (lean): decision models: instructions {plain, rubric} x criteria descriptions {none, one-line};
  `qwen3.5:0.8b` signal: rubric {A, B} x k {0, 4} x schema {label, ordinal} (gives both knobs); combined models:
  rubric x k (4) sentiment-first, then best config summary-first (field-order check, only if the M3 probe confirms
  Ollama honours schema property order); scope lede vs full on articles_dev for signal finalists. Few-shot shots
  are synthetic (no dataset leakage). Error pass writes `.temp/eval/error-analysis/*.md`, one revision, then
  `freeze` writes `active=` versions + thresholds into `models.toml`.
- **Metrics**: weighted per-class P/R, F0.5 macro, inversion rate, coverage/signal rate, 3x4 confusion, risk-coverage
  sweep, operating point = max F0.5 under 2% inversion; bootstrap CIs (B=1000) on headline metrics only.
  Holdout-once guard (`evals/results/holdout_runs.json`).
- **Opus pipeline** (Claude Code subagents, every spawn `model: "opus"`, prompts in `evals/opus_prompts/`):
  1. discover per source (RSS/sections, last 60 days, oversample 5/class, keep only URLs our fetcher retrieves;
     HTML saved to `evals/data/private/html/`);
  2. gold body + 3-5 key facts in one pass (gold to `private/gold/`, validated as >= 95% substrings of page text);
  3. labellers A and B in parallel, isolated, see only gold body; 4. adjudicator on disagreement/ambiguity,
     replacements re-run 2-4; 5. finalize 3/3/3 per source (+-1, 30/30/30 overall), seeded 30/60 split,
     agreement + Cohen's kappa; 6. judge finalist summaries anonymised (faithfulness 1-5, coverage 1-5,
     hallucination flags, leads-with-market-moving-fact).
  Committed: `evals/data/articles/articles.jsonl` (url, fetched_at, sha256, label, score, entity, ticker,
  rationale, key_facts, split, agreement), `evals/data/judgements/`. Never committed: HTML, gold bodies.
- **Summary eval**: numeric faithfulness, entity named, length; key-fact coverage via `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`
  (cosine >= 0.75, spot-checked); Opus judge on dev for selection, winner judged on test.
- **Extraction matrix**: 22 combos over 90 local HTML: p50/p95 ms (median of 5), token P/R/F1 vs gold, leakage,
  tokens-to-LLM, failure rate, downstream signal agreement (lede of each extraction vs gold), install MB.
- **Latency**: preflight asserts no running containers + records Ollama env/version/backend; `no_cache=true`;
  cold n=3, warm n=30 over articles_dev; p50/p95, TTFT from request receipt, time-to-signal per field order,
  per-stage timings via in-process app with local fetcher; one `docker-cpu` pass through the bundled app (winners,
  n=10).
- **Select**: filter inversion <= 2% + budgets, max F0.5 (summary: judge faithfulness then coverage, gated on
  deterministic pass >= 0.8), else Pareto knee; `select --write` updates `models.toml` defaults and
  `env/bundled.env` pull list (winners if <= ~10 GB, else best finalist that fits; clef-flash alone never fits).
  Order: freeze -> latency -> select -> holdout once -> report.
- **Report**: `evals/results/benchmarks.json` (canonical), `evals/results/README.md`, README tables between markers.
- **Compute**: ~36 GB of pulls; ~3-4 h machine time on the M4 Pro (resumable, background) + Opus wall time.

## Testing and CI

- **BE unit**: extractors on skeletons (own strategies x 4 parsers: body-marker recall >= 0.9 and zero leakage for
  jsonld/profile/cascade; density recall >= 0.8, leakage <= 10%; third-party smoke), skeleton purity, SSRF (all
  address classes, rebinding via injected resolver, per-hop redirects, caps), detect/consent (respx), prompt goldens,
  confidence policies, stream scanner split at every byte offset (both field orders), schemas + openapi drift,
  every allowlisted model resolves prompt + thresholds.
- **BE integration**: ASGI app + respx (publishers and Ollama, hand-written NDJSON chunk fixtures with delays):
  signal (decision + generative), summary/analyze JSON + SSE event order, single-flight (2 requests, 1 upstream
  hit), result cache, error status table, Ollama down, health, models. Coverage floor 75%.
- **FE**: Vitest + RTL (sse parser chunking, components incl. abstained/errors); MSW 3 integration (sentiment
  renders before summary completes, timings, model list, benchmarks page); prettier/eslint/tsc.
- **E2E** (Playwright, compose stack on CI): analyze happy path, signal-only with `tev1:0.8b-q8_0` (CI-only,
  unevaluated plumbing model, documented), extractor switch, `/benchmarks/`. Models `qwen3.5:0.8b` +
  `tev1:0.8b-q8_0`; model-agnostic assertions.
- **CI** (`ci.yml`, push/PR): `backend` (uv cache, `scripts/check.py --backend --full`, transcript scan-only
  guard), `frontend` (pnpm cache, gen:api check, lint, typecheck, vitest, build), `e2e` (needs both; free disk,
  buildx gha cache, ollama model cache, compose up, wait pull, health, warm-up, playwright, upload logs on failure).
  `live-smoke.yml` weekly + dispatch, informational only.

## Transcript export (`scripts/export_transcript.py`, the very last step)

Collect session `0024648c-2a0d-4dde-9495-8d22e0c9ccaa` main JSONL + `subagents/**` + workflow scripts/journals
(exclude `tool-results/`, other sessions) -> staging in `.temp/transcript/`. Allowlist record types (user,
assistant, system informational, mode, permission-mode, titles) and attachments (plan_mode, ultra_effort_enter,
model, date, skill_mention); drop everything else (api-request*, instructions, session context, credential_org,
hooks, listings). Strip thinking signatures and system reminder blocks. Replace tool_result text and Write/Edit
inputs touching `evals/data/private/**` or dataset text with `[omitted: sha256]`. Redact home path, emails other
than the public commit email and `noreply@anthropic.com`, secret patterns, and a gitignored denylist (work
domain, other org/project/container names). Render with `uvx claude-code-log@1.7.0` (HTML + MD). `meta.json`:
Claude Code 2.1.301, `claude-opus-5-5`, effort xhigh, adaptive thinking, ultracode, plan mode, skills, workflows,
subagents (type/model), deduped token usage, date range, redaction counts. Gate: zero hits for `~`, private
emails, denylist, secret regexes, dropped record markers, and 12-word shingles from gold bodies/FPB; only then move
to `.context/transcript/{raw,rendered,meta.json,README.md}` (README notes the export/push turns themselves are
not included, and carries Kris's note to the reviewers).

## Execution phases (Workflows; every agent `model: 'opus'`; main loop commits after each gate)

| Phase | Work | Gate -> commit to main |
|---|---|---|
| P0 | Main loop: record + `docker stop` running containers; `brew install ollama`, `brew services start`, `launchctl setenv OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS`; background model pulls; `git init`, repo-local identity, `.gitignore`, MIT, `gh repo create cleverjobs/veritrade-analytics --public`, SSH-alias remote; workspace + all deps declared and locked; contracts (`contracts.py`, protocols, `openapi.json`), `models.toml`/`sources.toml` skeletons; `ci.yml` backend + frontend jobs; design docs 00/01 | `check.py --fast`, CI green, M0 push |
| P1 | Probe agent: `probe_sources.py` over 14 sources -> `02-source-probe.md`, final 10 + profile hints | 10 usable sources, M1 |
| P2 | 5 parallel file-disjoint agents: fetch/, extract/ + skeleton capture, inference/ + scanner, frontend (MSW against contract), evals loaders/metrics | `check.py --fast`; M3-style probe on real Ollama (logprobs in stream? schema order honoured? systemone shape?) + baseline dev300 + latency probe; **R7 sanity gate: if budgets look unrealistic, stop and ask Kris** -> M2 |
| P3 | (a) api/services/caches/SSE + integration tests; (b) Opus article sub-workflow: discover -> gold + key facts -> labellers A/B -> adjudicate -> finalize | `check.py --full`; one analyze per source on native Ollama; M3 |
| P4 | (a) Docker, compose, e2e, Playwright (iterate on main); (b) accuracy grid, knobs, scope, field order, error pass, freeze, extraction matrix (background); (c) summary eval + Opus judge on finalists | CI incl. e2e green (`gh run watch`), M4 |
| P5 | Exclusive (no builds/agents): re-stop containers, latency suite, select --write, holdout once, docker-cpu pass, report, design docs 03-05 + 90, README | budgets reported, M5 |
| P6 | Verification checklist, fresh-clone smoke, transcript export + gate | M6 push; final message with `docker start ...` command |

Ad-hoc scripts live in `.temp/<slug>/` and run via `uv run python`; no inline Python; terse WHY-only comments; no
em-dashes; no git stash.

## Verification

1. `uv run python scripts/check.py --full` passes (ruff, format, mypy, BE unit + integration, evals tests, FE lint/
   typecheck/prettier/vitest/build, openapi + type drift).
2. Native path: `brew services list` shows ollama; `docker compose up -d`; `/api/health` reports `native-metal`;
   one `/api/analyze` (JSON + stream) succeeds per source; blocked/paywalled cases return typed errors.
3. Bundled path: `docker compose --profile bundled --env-file env/bundled.env up -d` healthy; one analyze succeeds.
4. UI: split and combined modes, streaming toggle, model/parser/extractor/scope switches, Benchmarks page.
5. Latency report vs R7 budgets printed and committed; holdout run recorded once.
6. GitHub Actions `ci.yml` green on HEAD incl. e2e; `live-smoke.yml` dispatched once and noted.
7. `git ls-files` contains nothing from `evals/data/private/`; skeleton purity test passes; every commit authored by
   Kristiyan Dimitrov with the Co-Authored-By trailer.
8. Fresh clone into `.temp/fresh-clone/` builds and serves one analyze without private data.
9. Transcript gate passes with zero hits; rendered HTML skimmed; README links resolve.

## Risks

- Label-token logprobs may be ambiguous or masked by grammar -> score-sign fallback or ordinal only (probe decides).
- Ollama may ignore schema property order -> field-order dimension dropped, documented.
- 9B decision models may miss the 500 ms lede budget -> Pareto knee, stated.
- 30/60 article sets give wide CIs; Opus-only labels may inflate agreement; thresholds from tweets may not transfer.
- Publisher DOMs, Yahoo consent forms and blocking change; runner IPs get blocked differently than Kris's IP.
- Docker Desktop restart can revive stopped containers -> re-stop before P5.
- Brew Ollama 0.40.4 vs container 0.40.5 version drift -> versions recorded with every benchmark.

````
</details>
