```
"""Committed split files hold ids, normalised-text sha1 and labels only; licences keep the text out."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections import defaultdict
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal, get_args

import numpy as np

from veritrade.inference.types import SENTIMENTS, Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.datasets import (
    DatasetName,
    Example,
    Store,
    class_counts,
    finentity_single,
    fpb_allagree,
    text_hash,
    twitter_fns,
)
from veritrade_evals.paths import SPLITS_DIR

SplitName = Literal["dev300", "tfns_val", "fpb_allagree", "finentity_single"]
SPLIT_NAMES: tuple[SplitName, ...] = get_args(SplitName)
HOLDOUT_SPLITS: tuple[SplitName, ...] = ("tfns_val", "fpb_allagree", "finentity_single")

DEV_SEED = 20261018
DEV_PER_CLASS = 100
# Stored in every split file so a changed normaliser fails `splits verify` instead of silently re-keying.
NORMALISATION = "nfkc-casefold-nourl-ws"


class SplitError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SplitSource:
    dataset: DatasetName
    source_split: str
    selection: str
    load: Callable[[Store], list[Example]]


SOURCES: dict[SplitName, SplitSource] = {
    "dev300": SplitSource(
        "tfns",
        "train",
        f"stratified {DEV_PER_CLASS} per class (seed {DEV_SEED}) from train after keeping one row per "
        "normalised text and excluding texts also in validation or labelled inconsistently in train",
        lambda store: twitter_fns("train", store=store),
    ),
    "tfns_val": SplitSource(
        "tfns", "validation", "all rows", lambda store: twitter_fns("validation", store=store)
    ),
    "fpb_allagree": SplitSource(
        "fpb",
        "all",
        "Sentences_AllAgree; exact duplicates collapsed, sentences with conflicting labels dropped",
        lambda store: fpb_allagree(store=store),
    ),
    "finentity_single": SplitSource(
        "finentity",
        "all",
        "rows with >= 1 entity annotation and exactly one distinct label",
        lambda store: finentity_single(store=store),
    ),
}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Split:
    name: SplitName
    examples: tuple[Example, ...]
    class_weights: dict[Sentiment, float] | None = None

    def example_weights(self) -> list[float] | None:
        """Per-example prevalence weights for metrics, or None when the split already has the true prior."""
        if self.class_weights is None:
            return None
        return [self.class_weights[e.label] for e in self.examples]


# --- selection (pure) ------------------------------------------------------------------------


def dev_pool(train: Sequence[Example], validation: Sequence[Example]) -> tuple[list[Example], dict[str, int]]:
    """Train rows eligible for dev: no validation overlap, one row per normalised text, no label conflicts."""
    val_hashes = {text_hash(e.text) for e in validation}
    groups: dict[str, list[Example]] = defaultdict(list)
    overlap = 0
    for e in train:
        h = text_hash(e.text)
        if h in val_hashes:
            overlap += 1
        else:
            groups[h].append(e)
    pool: list[Example] = []
    duplicates = conflicts = 0
    for members in groups.values():
        if len({m.label for m in members}) > 1:
            conflicts += len(members)
            continue
        duplicates += len(members) - 1
        pool.append(members[0])
    order = {e.id: i for i, e in enumerate(train)}
    pool.sort(key=lambda e: order[e.id])
    excluded = {"validation_overlap": overlap, "train_duplicates": duplicates, "label_conflicts": conflicts}
    return pool, excluded


def stratified_sample(pool: Sequence[Example], per_class: int, seed: int) -> list[Example]:
    """Same pool and seed give the same ids; output keeps pool order."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    order = {e.id: i for i, e in enumerate(pool)}
    chosen: list[Example] = []
    for label in SENTIMENTS:
        members = [e for e in pool if e.label == label]
        if len(members) < per_class:
            raise SplitError(f"only {len(members)} {label} examples, need {per_class}")
        picks = rng.choice(len(members), size=per_class, replace=False)
        chosen.extend(members[int(i)] for i in picks)
    return sorted(chosen, key=lambda e: order[e.id])


def prevalence_weights(
    population: Sequence[Example], sample: Sequence[Example]
) -> tuple[dict[Sentiment, float], dict[Sentiment, float]]:
    """(population prior, weight = prior / sample prior) so balanced-sample metrics estimate the real mix."""
    pop, smp = class_counts(population), class_counts(sample)
    prior = {c: pop[c] / len(population) for c in SENTIMENTS}
    weights = {c: prior[c] / (smp[c] / len(sample)) for c in SENTIMENTS if smp[c]}
    return prior, weights


# --- split files -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def split_payload(
    name: SplitName, examples: Sequence[Example], *, revision: str, extra: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    source = SOURCES[name]
    return {
        "name": name,
        "dataset": source.dataset,
        "source_split": source.source_split,
        "revision": revision,
        "selection": source.selection,
        "normalisation": NORMALISATION,
        "n": len(examples),
        "class_counts": class_counts(examples),
        **(extra or {}),
        "examples": [{"id": e.id, "sha1": text_hash(e.text), "label": e.label} for e in examples],
    }


def dumps_split(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Header pretty-printed, one example per line, so diffs stay readable."""
    head = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "examples"}
    lines = json.dumps(head, indent=2).splitlines()[:-1]
    lines[-1] += ","
    rows = [json.dumps(row) for row in payload["examples"]]
    lines += ['  "examples": [', *(f"    {row}," for row in rows[:-1]), *(f"    {row}" for row in rows[-1:])]
    return "\n".join([*lines, "  ]", "}"]) + "\n"


def split_path(name: SplitName, splits_dir: Path = SPLITS_DIR) -> Path:
    return splits_dir / f"{name}.json"


def read_split_file(name: SplitName, splits_dir: Path = SPLITS_DIR) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = split_path(name, splits_dir)
    if not path.exists():
        raise SplitError(f"no split file {path}; run `uv run python -m veritrade_evals splits make`")
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return payload


def resolve_split(payload: Mapping[str, Any], available: Mapping[str, Example]) -> Split:
    """Rebuild a split from dataset rows, failing on any missing id, text drift or label drift."""
    name: SplitName = payload["name"]
    if payload.get("normalisation") != NORMALISATION:
        raise SplitError(f"{name}: normalisation {payload.get('normalisation')!r} != {NORMALISATION!r}")
    problems: list[str] = []
    examples: list[Example] = []
    for row in payload["examples"]:
        example = available.get(row["id"])
        if example is None:
            problems.append(f"{row['id']}: missing from dataset")
        elif text_hash(example.text) != row["sha1"]:
            problems.append(f"{row['id']}: text hash mismatch")
        elif example.label != row["label"]:
            problems.append(f"{row['id']}: label {example.label} != {row['label']}")
        else:
            examples.append(example)
    if problems:
        raise SplitError(f"{name}: {len(problems)} bad rows, e.g. {'; '.join(problems[:3])}")
    weights = payload.get("class_weights")
    return Split(name, tuple(examples), dict(weights) if weights is not None else None)


# --- orchestration ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def build_split(name: SplitName, store: Store, cache: dict[SplitName, list[Example]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    revision = store.entry(SOURCES[name].dataset).revision
    if name != "dev300":
        return split_payload(name, _load(name, store, cache), revision=revision)
    train = _load("dev300", store, cache)
    pool, excluded = dev_pool(train, _load("tfns_val", store, cache))
    sample = stratified_sample(pool, DEV_PER_CLASS, DEV_SEED)
    prior, weights = prevalence_weights(train, sample)
    extra = {"seed": DEV_SEED, "train_prior": prior, "class_weights": weights, "excluded": excluded}
    return split_payload(name, sample, revision=revision, extra=extra)


def make_splits(*, store: Store | None = None, splits_dir: Path = SPLITS_DIR) -> dict[SplitName, Path]:
    store = store or Store()
    cache: dict[SplitName, list[Example]] = {}
    splits_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    written: dict[SplitName, Path] = {}
    for name in SPLIT_NAMES:
        path = split_path(name, splits_dir)
        path.write_text(dumps_split(build_split(name, store, cache)), encoding="utf-8")
        written[name] = path
    return written


def load_split(name: SplitName, *, store: Store | None = None, splits_dir: Path = SPLITS_DIR) -> Split:
    store = store or Store()
    payload = read_split_file(name, splits_dir)
    locked = store.entry(SOURCES[name].dataset).revision
    if payload["revision"] != locked:
        raise SplitError(
            f"{name} was made at {payload['revision']} but the lock pins {locked}; re-run splits make"
        )
    return resolve_split(payload, {e.id: e for e in SOURCES[name].load(store)})


def _load(name: SplitName, store: Store, cache: dict[SplitName, list[Example]]) -> list[Example]:
    if name not in cache:
        cache[name] = SOURCES[name].load(store)
    return cache[name]
"""Signal metrics: bullish/bearish calls are the positives; neutral and abstain are the safe default."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from numpy.typing import NDArray

from veritrade.inference.types import SENTIMENTS, Sentiment

DIRECTIONAL: tuple[Sentiment, Sentiment] = ("bullish", "bearish")
CONFUSION_COLUMNS = ("bullish", "bearish", "neutral", "abstain")
BETA = 0.5
INVERSION_CAP = 0.02
HEADLINE = ("f05_macro", "inversion_rate", "coverage", "signal_rate", "accuracy")
BOOTSTRAP_SEED = 20261018

FloatArray = NDArray[np.float64]
IndexArray = NDArray[np.intp]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ClassScores:
    precision: float
    recall: float
    f05: float
    calls: float
    support: float


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SignalMetrics:
    """Rates are prevalence-weighted when weights are given; `confusion` is raw counts (gold x columns)."""

    n: int
    per_class: dict[str, ClassScores]
    f05_macro: float
    inversion_rate: float
    coverage: float
    signal_rate: float
    accuracy: float
    selective_accuracy: float
    confusion: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _div(num: float, den: float) -> float:
    # Zero calls or zero support score 0 (not NaN): "always neutral" cannot look good and JSON stays strict.
    return float(num / den) if den > 0 else 0.0


def fbeta(precision: float, recall: float, beta: float = BETA) -> float:
    b2 = beta * beta
    den = b2 * precision + recall
    return (1 + b2) * precision * recall / den if den > 0 else 0.0


def _labels(values: Sequence[str], what: str) -> NDArray[np.str_]:
    arr = np.asarray(list(values), dtype=np.str_)
    unknown = set(arr.tolist()) - set(SENTIMENTS)
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown {what} labels: {sorted(unknown)}")
    return arr


def _weights(weights: Sequence[float] | None, n: int) -> FloatArray:
    if weights is None:
        return np.ones(n, dtype=np.float64)
    w = np.asarray(weights, dtype=np.float64)
    if w.shape != (n,) or (w < 0).any() or w.sum() <= 0:
        raise ValueError("weights must be one non-negative value per example with a positive sum")
    return w
```

```
def _csv(value: str) -> list[str]:
    return [item.strip() for item in value.split(",") if item.strip()]


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix="VT_", extra="ignore")

    env: Literal["dev", "test", "prod"] = "dev"

    ollama_base_url: str = Field(
        "http://localhost:11434",
        validation_alias=AliasChoices("VT_OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "OLLAMA_BASE_URL"),
    )
    ollama_backend_label: str = "native-metal"
    ollama_keep_alive: str = "30m"
    inference_timeout_s: float = 90.0
    # Comma-separated restriction of the models.toml allowlist; empty keeps the full allowlist.
    models: str = ""
    default_model_signal: str | None = None
    default_model_summary: str | None = None
    default_model_analyze: str | None = None

    sec_user_agent: str = Field(
        "VeriTrade Analytics PoC kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com",

    )
    fetch_connect_timeout_s: float = 3.0
    fetch_deadline_s: float = 8.0
    fetch_max_bytes: int = 10_000_000
    fetch_max_redirects: int = 5
    fetch_cache_ttl_s: float = 600.0
    fetch_error_ttl_s: float = 60.0
    result_cache_ttl_s: float = 3600.0
    cache_max_entries: int = 512

    cors_origins: str = ""
    static_dir: Path | None = None
    # Lets e2e reach the fixture container; refused outside VT_ENV=test so prod keeps the full SSRF guard.
    ssrf_test_allow_hosts: str = ""

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _guard_test_only_settings(self) -> Settings:
        if self.ssrf_test_allow_hosts and self.env != "test":
            raise ValueError("VT_SSRF_TEST_ALLOW_HOSTS is only allowed when VT_ENV=test")
        return self

    @property
    def model_restriction(self) -> list[str]:
        return _csv(self.models)

    @property
    def cors_origin_list(self) -> list[str]:
        return _csv(self.cors_origins)

    @property
    def ssrf_allow_hosts(self) -> frozenset[str]:
        return frozenset(host.lower() for host in _csv(self.ssrf_test_allow_hosts))


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_settings() -> Settings:
```

```
@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Source:
    key: str
    name: str
    domains: tuple[str, ...]
    status: str
    kind: str
    profile: Profile | None


def _profile(key: str, raw: dict[str, Any]) -> Profile:
    return Profile(
        source=key,
        body=str(raw["body"]),
        drop=tuple(str(s) for s in raw.get("drop", ())),
        title=raw.get("title"),
        lede_paragraphs=int(raw.get("lede_paragraphs", 2)),
        min_words=int(raw.get("min_words", 1)),
        stop_markers=tuple(str(s) for s in raw.get("stop_markers", ())),
        paywall=raw.get("paywall"),
    )


@cache
def sources() -> dict[str, Source]:
    text = resources.files("veritrade").joinpath("data/sources.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    out: dict[str, Source] = {}
    for key, raw in tomllib.loads(text).get("sources", {}).items():
        profile = raw.get("profile")
        out[key] = Source(
            key=key,
            name=str(raw.get("name", key)),
            domains=tuple(str(d).lower() for d in raw.get("domains", ())),
            status=str(raw.get("status", "")),
            kind=str(raw.get("kind", "")),
            profile=_profile(key, profile) if isinstance(profile, dict) else None,
        )
    return out


@cache
def _domain_index() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {domain: key for key, source in sources().items() for domain in source.domains}


def source_for_url(url: str) -> str | None:
    """Source key for the URL's host or its closest listed parent domain (uk.finance.yahoo.com -> yahoo)."""
    host = (urlsplit(url).hostname or "").rstrip(".").lower()
    index = _domain_index()
    while host:
        if (key := index.get(host)) is not None:
            return key
        _, _, host = host.partition(".")
    return None


def profile_for(source_key: str | None) -> Profile | None:
    source = sources().get(source_key) if source_key else None
    return source.profile if source else None


# --- paragraph rules --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def stop_marker(text: str, markers: Sequence[str]) -> str | None:
    lowered = text.lower()
    for marker in markers:
        if not lowered.startswith(marker.lower()):
            continue
        rest = text[len(marker) :]
        if marker.endswith(" ") and rest and not rest[0].isupper() and len(text.split()) > _HEADING_WORDS:
            continue
        return marker
    return None


def boilerplate_line(text: str) -> str | None:
    line = text.lower().rstrip(_BOILERPLATE_TRAIL)
    return line if line in BOILERPLATE_LINES else None


def contact_line(text: str) -> bool:
    return len(text.split()) <= CONTACT_MAX_WORDS and _EMAIL.search(text) is not None


def triage(texts: Sequence[str], profile: Profile | None) -> list[Verdict]:
    """Fate of every candidate paragraph, in order; the skeleton capture replays these to stay in sync."""
    min_words = profile.min_words if profile else 1
    lede = profile.lede_paragraphs if profile else 2
    stops = profile.stops if profile else GENERIC_STOPS
    verdicts: list[Verdict] = []
    anchor = ""
    kept = 0
    stopped = False
    for text in texts:
        if stopped:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.AFTER_STOP))
            continue
        if not text:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.EMPTY))
            continue
        # A selector list can match an <li> and the <p> inside it; the outer text already holds the inner.
        if anchor and len(text) < len(anchor) and text in anchor:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.NESTED))
            continue
        anchor = text
        if phrase := boilerplate_line(text):
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.BOILERPLATE, phrase))
        elif contact_line(text):
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.CONTACT))
        # Before min_words: a two-word "About Acme" heading must still end the body.
        elif kept >= lede and (marker := stop_marker(text, stops)):
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.STOP, marker))
            stopped = True
        elif len(text.split()) < min_words:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.SHORT))
        else:
            verdicts.append(Verdict(Fate.KEEP))
            kept += 1
```

```
"""Cheapest trustworthy strategy first: JSON-LD, then the source profile, then text density."""

from __future__ import annotations

from veritrade.extract import density, jsonld, profiles
from veritrade.extract.dom import Dom

JSONLD_MIN_CHARS = 400
PROFILE_MIN_WORDS = 80


def _words(paragraphs: list[str]) -> int:
    return sum(len(p.split()) for p in paragraphs)


def run(dom: Dom, url: str, source_key: str | None) -> tuple[str, list[str]]:
    """(winning method, paragraphs); a JSON-LD hit returns before the DOM is ever built."""
    tried: list[tuple[str, list[str]]] = []
    body = jsonld.extract(dom, url, source_key)
    if sum(len(p) for p in body) >= JSONLD_MIN_CHARS:
        return "jsonld", body
    tried.append(("jsonld", body))
    if profiles.profile_for(source_key) is not None:
        body = profiles.extract(dom, url, source_key)
        if _words(body) >= PROFILE_MIN_WORDS:
            return "profile", body
        tried.append(("profile", body))
    tried.append(("density", density.extract(dom, url, source_key)))
    # A short release beats an empty density pass; ties go to the more specific method.
    return max(tried, key=lambda item: _words(item[1]))


def extract(dom: Dom, url: str, source_key: str | None) -> list[str]:
    return run(dom, url, source_key)[1]
```

```python
"""Print the Sitemap: lines of each primary source's robots.txt (URLs only, no page text)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time

import httpx

from veritrade.fetch.headers import browser_headers

HOSTS = [
    "finance.yahoo.com",
    "www.cnbc.com",
    "www.fool.com",
    "www.prnewswire.com",
    "www.globenewswire.com",
    "www.sec.gov",
    "edition.cnn.com",
    "www.cnn.com",
    "fortune.com",
    "www.theguardian.com",
    "www.bbc.com",
    "www.bbc.co.uk",
]


def main() -> None:
    with httpx.Client(http2=True, timeout=15.0, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        for host in HOSTS:
            url = f"https://{host}/robots.txt"
            try:
                r = client.get(url, headers=browser_headers(url))
            except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
                print(f"{host}: error {type(exc).__name__}")
                continue
            sitemaps = [
                line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                for line in r.text.splitlines()
                if line.lower().startswith("sitemap:")
            ]
            print(f"{host}: {r.status_code} sitemaps={len(sitemaps)}")
            for s in sitemaps[:25]:
                print(f"   {s}")
            time.sleep(1.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""Structure of archive URLs (sitemaps, listing pages, EDGAR FTS): counts, dates, sample URLs; never titles."""

from __future__ import annotations

import gzip
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

import httpx
from lxml import etree

from veritrade.fetch.headers import browser_headers

LAST: dict[str, float] = {}


def polite_get(client: httpx.Client, url: str) -> httpx.Response:
    host = urlsplit(url).hostname or ""
    gap = 0.25 if host.endswith("sec.gov") else 1.0
    wait = LAST.get(host, 0.0) + gap - time.monotonic()
    if wait > 0:
        time.sleep(wait)
    try:
        return client.get(url, headers=browser_headers(url))
    finally:
        LAST[host] = time.monotonic()


def describe_xml(body: bytes) -> None:
    parser = etree.XMLParser(recover=True, resolve_entities=False, no_network=True, huge_tree=True)
    root = etree.fromstring(body, parser)
    if root is None:
        print("   xml: unparseable")
        return
    tag = etree.QName(root).localname
    locs = [str(el.text or "").strip() for el in root.iter("{*}loc")]
    mods = sorted(str(el.text or "")[:10] for el in root.iter("{*}lastmod"))
    pubs = sorted(str(el.text or "")[:10] for el in root.iter("{*}publication_date"))
    pubdates = sorted(str(el.text or "") for el in root.iter("{*}pubDate"))
    titles = sum(1 for _ in root.iter("{*}title"))
    items = sum(1 for _ in root.iter("{*}item"))
    print(f"   xml root={tag} locs={len(locs)} items={items} titles={titles}")
    if mods:
        print(f"   lastmod {mods[0]} .. {mods[-1]}")
    if pubs:
        print(f"   news:publication_date {pubs[0]} .. {pubs[-1]}")
    if pubdates:
        print(f"   pubDate n={len(pubdates)}")
    for loc in locs[:4] + (["..."] if len(locs) > 8 else []) + locs[-4:] if len(locs) > 8 else locs:
        print(f"     {loc}")


def describe_html(text: str, base: str, pattern: str | None) -> None:
    hrefs = [urljoin(base, h) for h in re.findall(r"""href=["']([^"'<> ]+)""", text)]
    print(f"   html hrefs={len(hrefs)}")
    if pattern:
        rx = re.compile(pattern)
        hits = list(dict.fromkeys(h.split("?")[0].split("#")[0] for h in hrefs if rx.search(h)))
        print(f"   matching {pattern!r}: {len(hits)}")
        for h in hits[:4] + hits[-3:]:
            print(f"     {h}")


def describe_json(body: bytes) -> None:
    data = json.loads(body)
    print(f"   json keys={sorted(data)[:12]}")
    hits = data.get("hits", {})
    if isinstance(hits, dict):
        total = hits.get("total")
        rows = hits.get("hits", [])
        print(f"   hits.total={total} rows={len(rows)}")
        for row in rows[:3]:
            src = row.get("_source", {})
            keys = sorted(src)
            print(f"     _id={row.get('_id')} keys={keys}")
            print(
                f"       file_type={src.get('file_type')} root_forms={src.get('root_forms')} "
                f"file_date={src.get('file_date')} ciks={src.get('ciks')} adsh={src.get('adsh')}"
            )


def main() -> None:
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    pattern = None
    if args and args[0].startswith("--pattern="):
        pattern = args[0].split("=", 1)[1]
        args = args[1:]
    with httpx.Client(http2=True, timeout=20.0, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        for url in args:
            try:
                r = polite_get(client, url)
            except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
                print(f"{url}\n   error {type(exc).__name__}")
                continue
            body = r.content
            if body[:2] == b"\x1f\x8b":
                body = gzip.decompress(body)
            ctype = r.headers.get("content-type", "")
            final = str(r.url)
            print(f"{url}\n   {r.status_code} {ctype} bytes={len(body)} final={final if final != url else '='}")
            if r.status_code != 200:
                continue
            head = body[:400].lstrip().lower()
            if "json" in ctype:
                describe_json(body)
            elif head.startswith(b"<?xml") or b"<urlset" in head or b"<sitemapindex" in head or b"<rss" in head:
                describe_xml(body)
            else:
                describe_html(body.decode("utf-8", "replace"), final, pattern)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```python
"""Check whether candidate archive paths are allowed by each host's robots.txt (stdlib parser)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
import urllib.robotparser
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import httpx

from veritrade.fetch.headers import CHROME_UA, browser_headers

PATHS = [
    "https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/AAPL/news/",
    "https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/earnings/",
    "https://finance.yahoo.com/topic/stock-market-news/",
    "https://www.cnbc.com/site-map/articles/2026/October/16/",
    "https://www.fool.com/sitemap/2026/09",
    "https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/news-releases-list/?page=2&pagesize=100",
    "https://www.prnewswire.com/search/news/?keyword=guidance&page=1&pagesize=100",
    "https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/financial-services-latest-news/earnings-list/?page=2",
    "https://www.globenewswire.com/search/keyword/guidance?page=2",
    "https://www.globenewswire.com/NewsRoom?page=2",
    "https://www.globenewswire.com/search/subject/ERN?page=2",
    "https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index?q=guidance&forms=8-K",
    "https://edition.cnn.com/sitemap/article/business/2026/09.xml",
    "https://fortune.com/articles-2026-09.xml",
    "https://fortune.com/section/finance/page/2/",
    "https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/oct/16/all",
    "https://www.theguardian.com/business?page=2",
    "https://www.bbc.co.uk/search?q=profit&d=NEWS_PS",
    "https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/business?page=2",
    "https://www.bbc.com/business",
]


def main() -> None:
    parsers: dict[str, urllib.robotparser.RobotFileParser] = {}
    with httpx.Client(http2=True, timeout=15.0, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        for url in PATHS:
            host = urlsplit(url).hostname or ""
            if host not in parsers:
                robots = f"https://{host}/robots.txt"
                r = client.get(robots, headers=browser_headers(robots))
                rp = urllib.robotparser.RobotFileParser()
                rp.parse(r.text.splitlines() if r.status_code == 200 else [])
                parsers[host] = rp
                time.sleep(1.0)
            rp = parsers[host]
            print(f"{'allowed' if rp.can_fetch(CHROME_UA, url) else 'DISALLOWED':10} {url}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```python
"""For listing pages: date-like strings near the first matching links (dates only, no prose)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
import time
from urllib.parse import urljoin

import httpx

from veritrade.fetch.headers import browser_headers

DATE_RE = re.compile(
    r"20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d(?:T[\d:.]+(?:Z|[+-]\d\d:?\d\d)?)?|"
    r"(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Sept|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.? \d{1,2}, 20\d\d(?:, \d\d:\d\d(?: ET)?)?|"
    r"\d{1,2} (?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]* 20\d\d|"
    r"\b1[78]\d{8}(?:\d{3})?\b|"
    r"\d+ (?:hours?|days?|mins?|minutes?) ago"
)
ATTR_RE = re.compile(r"""(datetime|data-[a-z-]*time[a-z-]*|"(?:firstPublished|lastPublished|datePublished|pubtime|published)[A-Za-z]*")\s*[=:]\s*["']?([^"'<>,}]{4,40})""")


def main() -> None:
    url, pattern = sys.argv[1], re.compile(sys.argv[2])
    with httpx.Client(http2=True, timeout=20.0, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        r = client.get(url, headers=browser_headers(url))
    html = r.text
    if "json" in r.headers.get("content-type", ""):
        data = json.loads(html)
        for row in data.get("hits", {}).get("hits", [])[:5]:
            src = row.get("_source", {})
            print(
                f"_id={row.get('_id')} file_type={src.get('file_type')} form={src.get('form')} "
                f"root_forms={src.get('root_forms')} file_date={src.get('file_date')} "
                f"period={src.get('period_ending')} ciks={src.get('ciks')} adsh={src.get('adsh')} "
                f"items={src.get('items')} keys={sorted(src)}"
            )
        aggs = data.get("aggregations", {})
        print("aggregations:", sorted(aggs))
        return
    print(f"status={r.status_code} bytes={len(html)}")
    seen = 0
    for m in re.finditer(r"""href=["']([^"'<> ]+)""", html):
        link = urljoin(url, m.group(1)).split("?")[0]
        if not pattern.search(link):
            continue
        seen += 1
        before = html[max(0, m.start() - 1500) : m.start()]
        after = html[m.end() : m.end() + 1500]
        b = [d.group(0) for d in DATE_RE.finditer(before)][-2:]
        a = [d.group(0) for d in DATE_RE.finditer(after)][:2]
        ab = [f"{k}={v}" for k, v in ATTR_RE.findall(before)][-2:]
        aa = [f"{k}={v}" for k, v in ATTR_RE.findall(after)][:2]
        print(f"{link}\n   before={b} after={a}\n   attrs_before={ab} attrs_after={aa}")
        if seen >= 3:
            break
    print("iso-datetimes in page:", len(re.findall(r"20\d\d-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d", html)))
    time.sleep(1.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
"""Tag skeleton around the first link matching a pattern: tags kept, text replaced by #<len> unless it is a date."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from urllib.parse import urljoin

import httpx

from veritrade.fetch.headers import browser_headers

DATE_RE = re.compile(r"^(?:[A-Z][a-z]{2} \d{1,2}, 20\d\d(?:, \d\d:\d\d ET)?)$")


def main() -> None:
    url, pattern = sys.argv[1], re.compile(sys.argv[2])
    with httpx.Client(http2=True, timeout=20.0, follow_redirects=True) as client:
        html = client.get(url, headers=browser_headers(url)).text
    for m in re.finditer(r"""href=["']([^"'<> ]+)""", html):
        if pattern.search(urljoin(url, m.group(1)).split("?")[0]):
            start = html.rfind("<", 0, m.start())
            chunk = html[max(0, start - 600) : start + 1400]
            out = []
            for piece in re.split(r"(<[^>]+>)", chunk):
                if piece.startswith("<"):
                    tag = re.sub(r"""href=["'][^"']*["']""", "href=…", piece)
                    tag = re.sub(r"""(alt|title)=["'][^"']*["']""", r"\1=…", tag)
                    out.append(tag[:120])
                elif piece.strip():
                    text = " ".join(piece.split())
                    out.append(text if DATE_RE.match(text) else f"#{len(text)}")
            print("\n".join(out))
            return


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

```python
"""Candidate article discovery: feeds, sitemaps, archive and listing pages, EDGAR full-text search.

Requests are sequential per domain with a minimum gap, checked against robots.txt and cached for a few hours,
so agents can re-run discovery with new queries without hitting publishers again.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import email.utils
import hashlib
import html as html_lib
import json
import re
import time
import tomllib
import urllib.robotparser
import zlib
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta
from importlib import resources
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal
from urllib.parse import quote_plus, urlencode, urljoin, urlsplit, urlunsplit

import httpx
import lxml.html
from lxml import etree

from veritrade.extract.dom import normalize as normalize_text
from veritrade.fetch.headers import browser_headers, is_sec_host

MIN_GAP_S = 1.0
SEC_MIN_GAP_S = 0.2  # 5 req/s, half of EDGAR's fair-access ceiling
TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout(20.0, connect=5.0)
MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES = 32_000_000
CACHE_TTL_S = 6 * 3600
EDGAR_FTS = "https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index"
EDGAR_PAGE = 100
MAX_EDGAR_RESOLVE = 40
MONTH_ABBR = ("jan", "feb", "mar", "apr", "may", "jun", "jul", "aug", "sep", "oct", "nov", "dec")

ArchiveKind = Literal["feed", "sitemap", "monthly", "daily", "listing", "paged", "search", "edgar-fts"]
IndexSelect = Literal["all", "newest"]


# --- polite fetching (shared with scripts/probe_sources.py) ---------------------------------------------


class Politeness:
    """Sequential requests per registrable domain with a minimum gap; SEC gets its own faster ceiling."""

    def __init__(self, min_gap_s: float = MIN_GAP_S, sec_min_gap_s: float = SEC_MIN_GAP_S) -> None:
        self._locks: dict[str, asyncio.Lock] = {}
        self._last: dict[str, float] = {}
        self._min_gap_s = min_gap_s
        self._sec_min_gap_s = sec_min_gap_s

    @staticmethod
    def domain(url: str) -> str:
        host = (urlsplit(url).hostname or "").lower()
        return ".".join(host.split(".")[-3:] if host.endswith(".co.uk") else host.split(".")[-2:])

    async def wait(self, url: str) -> asyncio.Lock:
        key = self.domain(url)
        lock = self._locks.setdefault(key, asyncio.Lock())
        await lock.acquire()
        gap = self._sec_min_gap_s if is_sec_host(urlsplit(url).hostname or "") else self._min_gap_s
        delay = self._last.get(key, 0.0) + gap - time.monotonic()
        if delay > 0:
            await asyncio.sleep(delay)
        return lock

    def done(self, url: str, lock: asyncio.Lock) -> None:
        self._last[self.domain(url)] = time.monotonic()
        lock.release()


# --- URL helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def normalize(url: str) -> str:
    """https, no query or fragment: article URLs here are path-addressed and feeds append tracking params."""
    parts = urlsplit(url.strip())
    return urlunsplit(("https", parts.netloc.lower(), parts.path, "", ""))


def feed_links(body: bytes) -> list[str]:
    """Item links of an RSS or Atom document, namespace-agnostic and tolerant of broken XML."""
    return [link.url for link in feed_items(body)]


def section_links(html: str, base: str) -> list[str]:
    hrefs = re.findall(r"""(?:href=|<loc>)["']?([^"'<> ]+)""", html)
    return [urljoin(base, href) for href in hrefs]


def pick(urls: Iterable[str], cfg: Mapping[str, Any], limit: int) -> list[str]:
    pattern = re.compile(cfg["article_pattern"])
    exclude = re.compile(cfg["exclude_pattern"]) if cfg.get("exclude_pattern") else None
    chosen: list[str] = []
    for raw in urls:
        url = normalize(raw)
        if url in chosen or not pattern.match(url) or (exclude and exclude.search(url)):
            continue
        chosen.append(url)
        if len(chosen) == limit:
            break
    return chosen


def edgar_exhibit(index_html: str, index_url: str) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    """EX-99.1 document link and description from an EDGAR filing index (inline-XBRL viewer unwrapped)."""
    doc = lxml.html.fromstring(index_html)
    for row in doc.cssselect("table.tableFile tr"):
        cells = [cell.text_content().strip() for cell in row.cssselect("td")]
        if len(cells) >= 4 and cells[3].upper().startswith("EX-99.1"):
            links = row.cssselect("a[href]")
            if links:
                href = str(links[0].get("href")).replace("/ix?doc=", "")
                return urljoin(index_url, href), cells[1]
    return None


# --- dates ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

_ISO_DATE = re.compile(r"(20\d\d)-(\d\d)-(\d\d)")
_URL_DATE = re.compile(r"/(20\d\d)/(\d\d|[a-z]{3})/(\d\d)(?=/|$)")
_TEXT_DATE = re.compile(
    r"\b(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Sept|Oct|Nov|Dec)[a-z]*\.? (\d{1,2}), (20\d\d)"
    r"(?:,? \d{1,2}:\d\d(?: ?[AP]M)?(?: [A-Z]{2,4})?)?"
)


def _safe_date(year: int, month: int, day: int) -> date | None:
    try:
        return date(year, month, day)
    except ValueError:
        return None


def parse_date(text: str | None) -> date | None:
    """ISO, RFC 822 (RSS) or 'Aug 17, 2026' text; anything else is undated rather than guessed."""
    if not text:
        return None
    text = text.strip()
    if m := _ISO_DATE.match(text):
        return _safe_date(int(m[1]), int(m[2]), int(m[3]))
    try:
        return email.utils.parsedate_to_datetime(text).date()
    except (TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
        pass
    if m := _TEXT_DATE.search(text):
        return _safe_date(int(m[3]), MONTH_ABBR.index(m[1][:3].lower()) + 1, int(m[2]))
    return None


def url_date(url: str) -> date | None:
    """Date in the path, /2026/10/18/ or the Guardian's /2026/oct/18/."""
    m = _URL_DATE.search(urlsplit(url).path)
    if not m:
        return None
    month = int(m[2]) if m[2].isdigit() else MONTH_ABBR.index(m[2]) + 1 if m[2] in MONTH_ABBR else 0
    return _safe_date(int(m[1]), month, int(m[3])) if month else None


def months_between(since: date, until: date) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
    months: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    year, month = since.year, since.month
    while (year, month) <= (until.year, until.month):
        months.append((year, month))
        year, month = (year + 1, 1) if month == 12 else (year, month + 1)
    return months


def days_between(since: date, until: date) -> list[date]:
    return [since + timedelta(days=n) for n in range((until - since).days + 1)]


# --- parsers (pure) ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Link:
    url: str
    title: str | None = None
    published: str | None = None
    extra: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)


def _xml_root(body: bytes) -> Any:
    parser = etree.XMLParser(recover=True, resolve_entities=False, no_network=True, huge_tree=True)
    return etree.fromstring(body, parser) if body.strip() else None


def _local(el: Any) -> str:
    return etree.QName(el).localname if isinstance(el.tag, str) else ""


def _child_text(el: Any, *names: str) -> str | None:
    for child in el.iter():
        if _local(child) in names and child.text and child.text.strip():
            return str(child.text).strip()
    return None


def _iso(day: date | None) -> str | None:
    return day.isoformat() if day else None


def feed_items(body: bytes) -> list[Link]:
    """Items of an RSS or Atom feed with title and date; non-English items are skipped."""
    root = _xml_root(body)
    if root is None:
        return []
    links: list[Link] = []
    for item in root.iter("{*}item", "{*}entry"):
        # Wires mix translated copies into one feed; the models are evaluated on English only.
        language = next((str(el.text or "") for el in item.iter("{*}language")), "en")
        if not language.lower().startswith("en"):
            continue
        href = None
        for link in item.iter("{*}link"):
            href = link.get("href") or (link.text or "").strip()
            if href:
                break
        if not href:
            continue
        title = _child_text(item, "title")
        when = parse_date(_child_text(item, "pubDate", "published", "updated", "date"))
        links.append(Link(href, normalize_text(html_lib.unescape(title)) if title else None, _iso(when)))
    return links


def sitemap_entries(body: bytes) -> tuple[str, list[Link]]:
    """('sitemapindex' | 'urlset', entries); image and video locs are ignored, news titles and dates kept."""
    root = _xml_root(body)
    if root is None:
        return "", []
    kind = _local(root)
    links: list[Link] = []
    for el in root:
        if _local(el) not in ("url", "sitemap"):
            continue
        loc = next((str(c.text).strip() for c in el if _local(c) == "loc" and c.text), None)
        if not loc:
            continue
        news = next((c for c in el if _local(c) == "news"), None)
        title = _child_text(news, "title") if news is not None else None
        published = parse_date(_child_text(news, "publication_date")) if news is not None else None
        lastmod = next((str(c.text).strip() for c in el if _local(c) == "lastmod" and c.text), None)
        extra = {"lastmod": lastmod} if lastmod else {}
        links.append(Link(loc, normalize_text(title) if title else None, _iso(published), extra))
    return kind, links


_ANCHOR = re.compile(r"<a\b([^>]*)>(.*?)</a\s*>", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
_HREF = re.compile(r"""\bhref\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s>]+))""", re.IGNORECASE)
_HEADING = re.compile(r"<h[1-6]\b[^>]*>(.*?)</h[1-6]\s*>", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
_DATETIME_ATTR = re.compile(r"""\bdatetime\s*=\s*["']([^"']+)["']""", re.IGNORECASE)
_NOISE = re.compile(r"<(script|style|svg)\b.*?</\1\s*>", re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL)
_TAG = re.compile(r"<[^>]+>")


def _fragment_text(fragment: str) -> str:
    return normalize_text(html_lib.unescape(_TAG.sub(" ", _NOISE.sub(" ", fragment))))


def listing_links(html: str, base: str) -> list[Link]:
    """Anchors of an HTML listing with their heading text and a date found inside the anchor, one per URL."""
    found: dict[str, Link] = {}
    for m in _ANCHOR.finditer(html):
        href = _HREF.search(m.group(1))
        if href is None:
            continue
        raw = next(g for g in href.groups() if g is not None)
        url = urljoin(base, html_lib.unescape(raw).strip())
        if not url.startswith(("https://", "http://")):
            continue
        inner = m.group(2)
        heading = _HEADING.search(inner)
        text = _fragment_text(heading.group(1) if heading else inner)
        when = parse_date(stamp.group(1)) if (stamp := _DATETIME_ATTR.search(inner)) else None
        if (in_text := _TEXT_DATE.search(text)) is not None:
            when = when or parse_date(in_text.group(0))
            text = normalize_text(text.replace(in_text.group(0), " "))
        previous = found.get(url)
        title = text or None
        if previous is not None:
            title = max((t for t in (previous.title, title) if t), key=len, default=None)
            when = when or parse_date(previous.published)
        found[url] = Link(url, title, _iso(when))
    return list(found.values())


def parse_any(body: bytes, base: str) -> tuple[str, list[Link]]:
    """Sniff a response: ('sitemapindex' | 'urlset' | 'feed' | 'html', links)."""
    head = body[:2048].lstrip().lower()
    if b"<urlset" in head or b"<sitemapindex" in head:
        return sitemap_entries(body)
    if b"<rss" in head or b"<feed" in head or b"<rdf:rdf" in head:
        return "feed", feed_items(body)
    return "html", listing_links(body.decode("utf-8", "replace"), base)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class EdgarHit:
    adsh: str
    filename: str
    cik: str
    file_type: str
    file_date: str | None
    items: tuple[str, ...]
    company: str
    description: str

    @property
    def folder(self) -> str:
        return f"https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/{int(self.cik)}/{self.adsh.replace('-', '')}"

    @property
    def url(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.folder}/{self.filename}"

    @property
    def index_url(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.folder}/{self.adsh}-index.htm"

    def link(self, url: str | None = None) -> Link:
        title = " | ".join(part for part in (self.company, self.description) if part)
        extra = {"form": "8-K", "file_type": self.file_type, "items": ",".join(self.items)}
        return Link(url or self.url, title or None, self.file_date, extra)


_CIK_SUFFIX = re.compile(r"\s*\(CIK \d+\)\s*$")


def edgar_fts_hits(payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[EdgarHit]:
    """Rows of an efts.sec.gov search-index response; `_id` is '<accession>:<file name>'."""
    hits: list[EdgarHit] = []
    rows = payload.get("hits", {}).get("hits", [])
    for row in rows if isinstance(rows, list) else []:
        source = row.get("_source", {})
        adsh, _, filename = str(row.get("_id", "")).partition(":")
        ciks = source.get("ciks") or []
        if not adsh or not filename or not ciks:
            continue
        names = source.get("display_names") or [""]
        hits.append(
            EdgarHit(
                adsh=str(source.get("adsh") or adsh),
                filename=filename,
                cik=str(ciks[0]),
                file_type=str(source.get("file_type") or ""),
                file_date=source.get("file_date"),
                items=tuple(str(i) for i in source.get("items") or ()),
                company=normalize_text(_CIK_SUFFIX.sub("", str(names[0]))),
                description=normalize_text(str(source.get("file_description") or "")),
            )
        )
    return hits

# The feed links releases under org id 0, the sitemaps under the issuer's id; both resolve.
PATTERN_OVERRIDES: dict[str, str] = {"globenewswire": GNW_PATTERN}


def load_sources() -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    text = resources.files("veritrade").joinpath("data/sources.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    sources: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = tomllib.loads(text)["sources"]
    return sources


def primary_sources(sources: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None) -> list[str]:
    registry = sources if sources is not None else load_sources()
    keys = [k for k, cfg in registry.items() if cfg.get("status") == "primary"]
    return sorted(keys, key=lambda k: int(registry[k].get("rank", 99)))


def source_archives(key: str, cfg: Mapping[str, Any], listing_urls: Sequence[str] = ()) -> list[Archive]:
    archives = [Archive("feed", url) for url in cfg.get("feeds", [])]
    archives += [Archive("listing", url) for url in cfg.get("sections", [])]
    archives += ARCHIVES.get(key, ())
    archives += [Archive("listing", url) for url in listing_urls]
    return archives


def on_source_domain(url: str, cfg: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    host = (urlsplit(url).hostname or "").lower()
    return any(host == d or host.endswith("." + d) for d in cfg.get("domains", []))


def expand(archive: Archive, since: date, until: date, queries: Sequence[str]) -> list[tuple[str, str | None]]:
    """Concrete (url, query) requests for one archive over the window."""
    template = archive.url
    if archive.kind == "monthly":
        return [(template.format(yyyy=y, mm=f"{m:02d}"), None) for y, m in months_between(since, until)]
    if archive.kind == "daily":
        return [
            (template.format(yyyy=d.year, mm=f"{d.month:02d}", mon=MONTH_ABBR[d.month - 1], dd=f"{d.day:02d}"), None)
            for d in reversed(days_between(since, until))
        ]
    if archive.kind == "paged":
        return [(template.format(page=p), None) for p in range(1, archive.pages + 1)]
    if archive.kind == "search":
        return [
            (template.format(query=quote_plus(q), page=p), q) for q in queries for p in range(1, archive.pages + 1)
        ]
    return [(template, None)]


def edgar_fts_url(query: str | None, since: date, until: date, offset: int) -> str:
    params = {"forms": "8-K", "dateRange": "custom", "startdt": since.isoformat(), "enddt": until.isoformat()}
    if query:
        # Multi-word queries are phrases ("net loss"), which is what directional keywords need.
        params["q"] = f'"{query}"' if " " in query and not query.startswith('"') else query
    if offset:
        params["from"] = str(offset)
    return f"{EDGAR_FTS}?{urlencode(params)}"


_STEM_TOKEN = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")


def query_matches(query: str, haystack: str) -> bool:
    """Every query word, loosely stemmed, starts some word of the title or URL slug."""
    words = _STEM_TOKEN.findall(haystack.lower())
    for token in _STEM_TOKEN.findall(query.lower()):
        stem = token if len(token) <= 4 else token[: max(4, len(token) - 2)]
        if not any(word.startswith(stem) for word in words):
            return False
    return True


def slug_text(url: str) -> str:
    return " ".join(_STEM_TOKEN.findall(urlsplit(url).path.lower()))


# --- network ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Response:
    url: str
    final_url: str
    status: int | None
    body: bytes = b""
    error: str | None = None
    cached: bool = False


class ArchiveClient:
    """Polite GET for archive pages: robots.txt, per-domain gap, size cap, gzip, and a short disk cache."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        cache_dir: Path,
        *,
        ttl_s: float = CACHE_TTL_S,
        refresh: bool = False,
        polite: Politeness | None = None,
        client: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._cache_dir = cache_dir
        self._ttl_s = ttl_s
        self._refresh = refresh
        self._polite = polite or Politeness()
        self._client = client or httpx.AsyncClient(
            http2=True, timeout=TIMEOUT, follow_redirects=True, max_redirects=5, trust_env=False
        )
        self._robots: dict[str, urllib.robotparser.RobotFileParser] = {}
        self.requests = 0

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._client.aclose()

    def _cache_paths(self, url: str) -> tuple[Path, Path]:
        key = hashlib.sha1(url.encode()).hexdigest()
        return self._cache_dir / f"{key}.bin", self._cache_dir / f"{key}.json"

    async def _raw_get(self, url: str) -> Response:
        lock = await self._polite.wait(url)
        self.requests += 1
        try:
            async with self._client.stream("GET", url, headers=browser_headers(url)) as response:
                body = bytearray()
                async for chunk in response.aiter_bytes():
                    body += chunk
                    if len(body) > MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES:
                        return Response(url, str(response.url), response.status_code, error="too_large")
                return Response(url, str(response.url), response.status_code, _gunzip(bytes(body)))
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            return Response(url, url, None, error=type(exc).__name__)
        finally:
            self._polite.done(url, lock)

    async def allowed(self, url: str) -> bool:
        parts = urlsplit(url)
        host = f"{parts.scheme}://{parts.netloc}"
        parser = self._robots.get(host)
        if parser is None:
            got = await self._raw_get(f"{host}/robots.txt")
            parser = urllib.robotparser.RobotFileParser()
            if got.status == 200:
                parser.parse(got.body.decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines())
            elif got.status is not None and got.status >= 500:
                parser.disallow_all = True
            else:
                parser.allow_all = True
            self._robots[host] = parser
        return parser.can_fetch(browser_headers(url)["User-Agent"], url)

    async def get(self, url: str) -> Response:
        body_path, meta_path = self._cache_paths(url)
        if not self._refresh and meta_path.exists() and body_path.exists():
            meta = json.loads(meta_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            if time.time() - float(meta["fetched_at"]) < self._ttl_s:
                return Response(url, meta["final_url"], meta["status"], body_path.read_bytes(), cached=True)
        if not await self.allowed(url):
            return Response(url, url, None, error="robots_disallowed")
        got = await self._raw_get(url)
        if got.status == 200 and got.error is None:
            self._cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            body_path.write_bytes(got.body)
            meta = {"url": url, "final_url": got.final_url, "status": got.status, "fetched_at": time.time()}
            meta_path.write_text(json.dumps(meta), encoding="utf-8")
        return got


def _gunzip(body: bytes) -> bytes:
    if body[:2] != b"\x1f\x8b":
        return body
    inflater = zlib.decompressobj(16 + zlib.MAX_WBITS)
    return inflater.decompress(body, MAX_ARCHIVE_BYTES)


# --- discovery run ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(slots=True)
class ArchiveStats:
    kind: str
    url: str
    requests: int = 0
    ok: int = 0
    errors: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)
    links: int = 0
    matched: int = 0

    def failed(self, code: str) -> None:
        self.errors[code] = self.errors.get(code, 0) + 1


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Found:
    link: Link
    via: str
    via_url: str
    query: str | None


@dataclass(slots=True)
class DiscoverRun:
    source: str
    found: list[Found] = field(default_factory=list)
    archives: list[ArchiveStats] = field(default_factory=list)


class Discoverer:
    """Collects article links for one source from every archive it has, filtered by its article pattern."""

    def __init__(self, client: ArchiveClient, sources: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]] | None = None) -> None:
        self._client = client
        self._sources = sources if sources is not None else load_sources()

    def pattern(self, key: str) -> re.Pattern[str]:
        return re.compile(PATTERN_OVERRIDES.get(key) or self._sources[key]["article_pattern"])

    def keep(self, key: str, url: str) -> bool:
        cfg = self._sources[key]
        exclude = cfg.get("exclude_pattern")
        if not self.pattern(key).match(url) or ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE.search(url):
            return False
        return not (exclude and re.search(exclude, url))

    async def run(
        self,
        key: str,
        *,
        since: date,
        until: date,
        queries: Sequence[str] = (),
        listing_urls: Sequence[str] = (),
    ) -> DiscoverRun:
        cfg = self._sources[key]
        run = DiscoverRun(key)
        for archive in source_archives(key, cfg, listing_urls):
            if archive.kind == "search" and not queries:
                continue
            stats = ArchiveStats(archive.kind, archive.url)
            run.archives.append(stats)
            if archive.kind == "edgar-fts":
                await self._edgar_fts(run, stats, archive, since, until, queries)
            elif archive.kind == "feed" and cfg.get("discovery") == "edgar-8k-ex99":
                await self._edgar_feed(run, stats, archive.url)
            else:
                for url, query in expand(archive, since, until, queries):
                    await self._collect(run, stats, archive, url, query)
        return run

    async def _fetch(self, stats: ArchiveStats, url: str) -> Response | None:
        stats.requests += 1
        got = await self._client.get(url)
        if got.error or got.status != 200:
            stats.failed(got.error or f"http_{got.status}")
            return None
        stats.ok += 1
        return got

    async def _collect(
        self, run: DiscoverRun, stats: ArchiveStats, archive: Archive, url: str, query: str | None
    ) -> None:
        got = await self._fetch(stats, url)
        if got is None:
            return
        kind, links = parse_any(got.body, got.final_url)
        if kind == "sitemapindex":
            children = [link.url for link in links]
            if archive.select == "newest":
                children = sorted(children, key=_trailing_number)[-1:]
            for child in children:
                await self._collect(run, stats, Archive("sitemap", child), child, query)
            return
        self._add(run, stats, links, archive.kind, url, query)

    def _add(
        self, run: DiscoverRun, stats: ArchiveStats, links: Sequence[Link], kind: str, url: str, query: str | None
    ) -> None:
        stats.links += len(links)
        for link in links:
            canonical = normalize(link.url)
            if self.keep(run.source, canonical):
                stats.matched += 1
                run.found.append(Found(Link(canonical, link.title, link.published, link.extra), kind, url, query))

    async def _edgar_fts(
        self,
        run: DiscoverRun,
        stats: ArchiveStats,
        archive: Archive,
        since: date,
        until: date,
        queries: Sequence[str],
    ) -> None:
        exhibits: dict[str, Link] = {}
        main_docs: dict[str, EdgarHit] = {}
        for query in list(queries) or [None]:
            for page in range(archive.pages):
                url = edgar_fts_url(query, since, until, page * EDGAR_PAGE)
                got = await self._fetch(stats, url)
                if got is None:
                    break
                try:
                    hits = edgar_fts_hits(json.loads(got.body))
                except ValueError:
                    stats.failed("bad_json")
                    break
                stats.links += len(hits)
                for hit in hits:
                    if hit.file_type.upper().startswith("EX-99.1"):
                        exhibits.setdefault(hit.adsh, hit.link())
                        self._add_one(run, stats, exhibits[hit.adsh], url, query)
                    elif hit.file_type.upper() == "8-K":
                        main_docs.setdefault(hit.adsh, hit)
                if len(hits) < EDGAR_PAGE:
                    break
        # A query can match the 8-K cover text rather than the exhibit; resolve those filings via the index.
        pending = [hit for adsh, hit in main_docs.items() if adsh not in exhibits][:MAX_EDGAR_RESOLVE]
        for hit in pending:
            got = await self._fetch(stats, hit.index_url)
            if got is not None and (found := edgar_exhibit(got.body.decode("utf-8", "replace"), got.final_url)):
                self._add_one(run, stats, hit.link(found[0]), hit.index_url, None)

    async def _edgar_feed(self, run: DiscoverRun, stats: ArchiveStats, feed_url: str) -> None:
        got = await self._fetch(stats, feed_url)
        if got is None:
            return
        entries = feed_items(got.body)
        stats.links += len(entries)
        for entry in entries[:MAX_EDGAR_RESOLVE]:
            index = await self._fetch(stats, normalize(entry.url))
            if index is not None and (found := edgar_exhibit(index.body.decode("utf-8", "replace"), index.final_url)):
                self._add_one(run, stats, Link(found[0], entry.title, entry.published), feed_url, None)

    def _add_one(self, run: DiscoverRun, stats: ArchiveStats, link: Link, url: str, query: str | None) -> None:
        canonical = normalize(link.url)
        if self.keep(run.source, canonical):
            stats.matched += 1
            run.found.append(Found(Link(canonical, link.title, link.published, link.extra), "edgar-fts", url, query))


def _trailing_number(url: str) -> int:
    m = re.search(r"(\d+)\D*$", url)
    return int(m.group(1)) if m else -1


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
```

```python
"""Opus-labelled article set: ids, file layout, agent output schemas, committed rows and the eval loader.

Publisher text (HTML, titles, bodies) only ever lives under evals/data/private/articles; committed rows carry
URLs, hashes, labels and model-written facts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError

from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.paths import ARTICLES_DIR, OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR, PRIVATE_ARTICLES_DIR, REPO_ROOT

REFERENCE_DATE = date(2026, 10, 18)
WINDOW_DAYS = 60
WINDOW_START = REFERENCE_DATE - timedelta(days=WINDOW_DAYS)
SEED = 20261018
PER_CLASS = 3
MIN_BODY_WORDS = 120
KEY_FACTS_MIN = 3
KEY_FACTS_MAX = 5
KEY_FACT_MAX_WORDS = 25
RATIONALE_MAX_WORDS = 50
LABEL_PACKET_WORDS = 1200
SHINGLE_WORDS = 10

Stage = Literal["gold", "label_a", "label_b", "adjudicate"]
STAGES: tuple[Stage, ...] = get_args(Stage)
PacketStage = Literal["gold", "label", "adjudicate"]
PACKET_STAGES: tuple[PacketStage, ...] = get_args(PacketStage)
ArticleSplit = Literal["dev", "test"]
RejectReason = Literal[
    "not_article",
    "live_blog",
    "paywalled_stub",
    "roundup",
    "video_only",
    "too_short",
    "non_english",
    "duplicate",
    "other",
]
REJECT_REASONS: tuple[RejectReason, ...] = get_args(RejectReason)
PROMPTS: dict[PacketStage, Path] = {
    "gold": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "20-gold.md",
    "label": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "30-label.md",
    "adjudicate": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "40-adjudicate.md",
}


class ArticlesError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def article_id(url: str) -> str:
    return "art-" + hashlib.sha1(normalize_url(url).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]


def sha256_bytes(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    return sha256_bytes(path.read_bytes())


def rel(path: Path) -> str:
    """Repo-relative path for messages and packets, absolute when outside the repo (tests)."""
    try:
        return str(path.resolve().relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArticlePaths:
    private: Path = PRIVATE_ARTICLES_DIR
    committed: Path = ARTICLES_DIR

    def candidates(self, source: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "candidates" / f"{source}.jsonl"

    def view(self, source: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "views" / f"{source}.tsv"

    @property
    def cache(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "cache"

    @property
    def discovery_log(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "discovery_log.jsonl"

    def html(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "html" / f"{article}.html"

    def fetched(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "fetched" / f"{article}.json"

    def packet(self, stage: PacketStage, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / stage / f"{article}.md"

    def full_packet(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / "gold" / f"{article}.full.md"

    def lines(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / "gold" / f"{article}.lines.json"

    def out(self, stage: Stage, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "out" / stage / f"{article}.json"

    def out_dir(self, stage: Stage) -> Path:
        return self.private / "out" / stage

    def gold(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "gold" / f"{article}.txt"

    @property
    def adjudicate_ids(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "adjudicate_ids.txt"

    @property
    def rows(self) -> Path:
        return self.committed / "articles.jsonl"

    @property
    def stats(self) -> Path:
        return self.committed / "stats.json"


# --- records ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _Model(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class Candidate(_Model):
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    title: str | None = None
    published_at: str | None = None
    via: str
    via_url: str
    query: str | None = None
    extra: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def published(self) -> date | None:
        return date.fromisoformat(self.published_at) if self.published_at else None


class FetchRecord(_Model):
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    final_url: str | None = None
    fetched_at: str
    status: int | None = None
    error: str | None = None
    html_sha256: str | None = None
    words: int = 0
    method: str | None = None
    published_at: str | None = None
    published_date: str | None = None
    published_from: Literal["page", "candidate"] | None = None
    paywalled: bool = False
    extract_error: str | None = None

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.error is None and self.html_sha256 is not None

    @property
    def published(self) -> date | None:
        return date.fromisoformat(self.published_date) if self.published_date else None


# --- agent outputs (documented in evals/opus_prompts) --------------------------------------------------------


class GoldOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    usable: bool
    reject_reason: RejectReason | None = None
    title_line: int | None = None
    body_ranges: list[tuple[int, int]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    key_facts: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    entity: str | None = None
    ticker: str | None = None

class LabelOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: int = Field(ge=-2, le=2)
    entity: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ambiguous: bool
    confidence: int = Field(ge=1, le=5)


class AdjudicateOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    decision: Literal["keep", "replace"]
    label: Sentiment
    score: int = Field(ge=-2, le=2)
    entity: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str = Field(min_length=1)


OUTPUT_MODELS: dict[Stage, type[GoldOutput] | type[LabelOutput] | type[AdjudicateOutput]] = {
    "gold": GoldOutput,
    "label_a": LabelOutput,
    "label_b": LabelOutput,
    "adjudicate": AdjudicateOutput,
}


def schema_codes(exc: ValidationError) -> list[str]:
    """Error locations and types only; messages can echo input text."""
    codes = []
    for error in exc.errors(include_url=False, include_input=False):
        where = ".".join(str(part) for part in error["loc"]) or "model"
        codes.append(f"schema:{where}:{error['type']}")
    return codes


# --- committed rows ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class LabelSummary(_Model):
    label: Sentiment
    score: int
    ambiguous: bool
    confidence: int


class AdjudicationSummary(_Model):
    decision: Literal["keep", "replace"]
    label: Sentiment
    score: int


class ArticleLabels(_Model):
    a: LabelSummary
    b: LabelSummary
    adjudicated: AdjudicationSummary | None = None
    final: Sentiment


class ArticleRow(_Model):
    id: str
    url: str
    source: str
    published_at: str
    fetched_at: str
    html_sha256: str
    gold_sha256: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: float
    entity: str
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str
    key_facts: list[str]
    split: ArticleSplit
    labels: ArticleLabels


def read_jsonl[M: BaseModel](path: Path, model: type[M]) -> list[M]:
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.strip():
            rows.append(model.model_validate_json(line))
    return rows


def write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: Iterable[BaseModel]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    text = "".join(row.model_dump_json(exclude_none=False) + "\n" for row in rows)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def read_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> FetchRecord | None:
    path = paths.fetched(article)
    return FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else None


def iter_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, source: str | None = None) -> Iterator[FetchRecord]:
    folder = paths.private / "fetched"
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("art-*.json")) if folder.exists() else []:
        record = FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if source is None or record.source == source:
            yield record


def in_window(day: date | None, since: date = WINDOW_START, until: date = REFERENCE_DATE) -> bool:
    return day is not None and since <= day <= until


# --- verify + loader --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def row_problems(row: ArticleRow, paths: ArticlePaths) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    for kind, path, expected in (
        ("html", paths.html(row.id), row.html_sha256),
        ("gold", paths.gold(row.id), row.gold_sha256),
    ):
        if not path.exists():
            problems.append(f"{kind}_missing")
        elif sha256_file(path) != expected:
            problems.append(f"{kind}_drifted")
    return problems


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArticleExample:
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: float
    entity: str
    ticker: str | None
    key_facts: tuple[str, ...]
    gold_text: str
    html_path: Path
    split: ArticleSplit


def load_articles(split: ArticleSplit | Literal["all"], *, paths: ArticlePaths | None = None) -> list[ArticleExample]:
    """Committed rows joined with the local gold body and HTML path; missing or drifted files fail loudly."""
    paths = paths or ArticlePaths()
    rows = read_jsonl(paths.rows, ArticleRow)
    if not rows:
        raise ArticlesError(f"no article rows in {rel(paths.rows)}; run `articles finalize` first")
    examples: list[ArticleExample] = []
    problems: list[str] = []
    for row in rows:
        if split != "all" and row.split != split:
            continue
        if found := row_problems(row, paths):
            problems.extend(f"{row.id}:{code}" for code in found)
            continue
        examples.append(
            ArticleExample(
                id=row.id,
                source=row.source,
                url=row.url,
                label=row.label,
                score=row.score,
                entity=row.entity,
                ticker=row.ticker,
                key_facts=tuple(row.key_facts),
                gold_text=paths.gold(row.id).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
                html_path=paths.html(row.id),
                split=row.split,
            )
        )
    if problems:
        raise ArticlesError(
            f"{len(problems)} local article files missing or drifted, e.g. {', '.join(problems[:4])}; "
            "run `articles verify`"
        )
    return examples
```

```python
"""Candidate store: discovery results per source, deduplicated by article id and merged across runs."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date

from veritrade_evals.articles import ArticlePaths, Candidate, article_id, read_jsonl, write_jsonl
from veritrade_evals.discovery import (
    ArchiveClient,
    ArchiveStats,
    Discoverer,
    Found,
    query_matches,
    slug_text,
    url_date,
    utc_now,
)

SEARCH_KINDS = frozenset({"search", "edgar-fts"})


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SourceReport:
    source: str
    total: int = 0
    in_window: int = 0
    undated: int = 0
    new: int = 0
    matched: int = 0
    out_of_window: int = 0
    query_miss: int = 0
    capped: int = 0
    archives: list[ArchiveStats] = field(default_factory=list)


def published_of(found: Found) -> date | None:
    return date.fromisoformat(found.link.published) if found.link.published else url_date(found.link.url)


def matched_query(found: Found, queries: Sequence[str]) -> str | None:
    """Search archives already filtered server-side; everything else is matched on title and URL slug."""
    if found.via in SEARCH_KINDS and found.query:
        return found.query
    haystack = f"{found.link.title or ''} {slug_text(found.link.url)}"
    return next((q for q in queries if query_matches(q, haystack)), None)


def to_candidate(source: str, found: Found, query: str | None) -> Candidate:
    published = published_of(found)
    return Candidate(
        id=article_id(found.link.url),
        source=source,
        url=found.link.url,
        title=found.link.title,
        published_at=published.isoformat() if published else None,
        via=found.via,
        via_url=found.via_url,
        query=query,
        extra={k: v for k, v in found.link.extra.items() if k != "lastmod"},
    )


def merge(existing: Sequence[Candidate], incoming: Iterable[Candidate]) -> tuple[list[Candidate], int]:
    """Existing order first; a later sighting only fills a missing title or date."""
    merged = {c.id: c for c in existing}
    new = 0
    for candidate in incoming:
        old = merged.get(candidate.id)
        if old is None:
            merged[candidate.id] = candidate
            new += 1
            continue
        fill = {}
        if not old.title and candidate.title:
            fill["title"] = candidate.title
        if not old.published_at and candidate.published_at:
            fill["published_at"] = candidate.published_at
        if fill:
            merged[candidate.id] = old.model_copy(update=fill)
    return list(merged.values()), new


def select_found(
    report: SourceReport,
    found: Sequence[Found],
    *,
    since: date,
    until: date,
    queries: Sequence[str],
    max_new: int | None,
    known: set[str],
) -> list[Candidate]:
    picked: list[Candidate] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()
    for item in found:
        report.matched += 1
        published = published_of(item)
        if published is not None and not since <= published <= until:
            report.out_of_window += 1
            continue
        query = matched_query(item, queries) if queries else None
        if queries and query is None:
            report.query_miss += 1
            continue
        candidate = to_candidate(report.source, item, query)
        if candidate.id not in known and candidate.id not in seen and max_new is not None:
            if len(seen) >= max_new:
                report.capped += 1
                continue
        if candidate.id not in known:
            seen.add(candidate.id)
        picked.append(candidate)
    return picked


async def discover(
    sources: Sequence[str],
    *,
    since: date,
    until: date,
    queries: Sequence[str] = (),
    listing_urls: Sequence[str] = (),
    max_new: int | None = None,
    pages: int | None = None,
    refresh: bool = False,
    paths: ArticlePaths | None = None,
    client: ArchiveClient | None = None,
) -> list[SourceReport]:
    paths = paths or ArticlePaths()
    archive_client = client or ArchiveClient(paths.cache, refresh=refresh)
    discoverer = Discoverer(archive_client)
    try:
        runs = await asyncio.gather(
            *(
                discoverer.run(
                    key, since=since, until=until, queries=queries, listing_urls=listing_urls, pages=pages
                )
                for key in sources
            )
        )
    finally:
        if client is None:
            await archive_client.aclose()
    reports = []
    for run in runs:
        report = SourceReport(run.source, archives=run.archives)
        existing = read_jsonl(paths.candidates(run.source), Candidate)
        picked = select_found(
            report,
            run.found,
            since=since,
            until=until,
            queries=queries,
            max_new=max_new,
            known={c.id for c in existing},
        )
        merged, report.new = merge(existing, picked)
        write_jsonl(paths.candidates(run.source), merged)
        report.total = len(merged)
        report.undated = sum(c.published is None for c in merged)
        report.in_window = sum(c.published is not None and since <= c.published <= until for c in merged)
        log_run(paths, report, since=since, until=until, queries=queries)
        reports.append(report)
    return reports


def log_run(paths: ArticlePaths, report: SourceReport, *, since: date, until: date, queries: Sequence[str]) -> None:
    entry = {
        "at": utc_now(),
        "source": report.source,
        "since": since.isoformat(),
        "until": until.isoformat(),
        "queries": list(queries),
        "total": report.total,
        "in_window": report.in_window,
        "undated": report.undated,
        "new": report.new,
        "archives": [
            {"kind": a.kind, "url": a.url, "requests": a.requests, "ok": a.ok, "errors": a.errors,
             "links": a.links, "matched": a.matched}
            for a in report.archives
        ],
    }  # fmt: skip
    paths.discovery_log.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with paths.discovery_log.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(entry) + "\n")


def write_view(
    paths: ArticlePaths,
    source: str,
    *,
    queries: Sequence[str] = (),
    since: date | None = None,
    until: date | None = None,
    unfetched: bool = False,
    limit: int | None = None,
) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Private TSV (id, date, via, query, title or slug) for an agent to Read; returns (rows, candidates)."""
    candidates = read_jsonl(paths.candidates(source), Candidate)
    rows = []
    for c in sorted(candidates, key=lambda c: (c.published_at or "", c.id), reverse=True):
        if since and until and c.published is not None and not since <= c.published <= until:
            continue
        if unfetched and paths.fetched(c.id).exists():
            continue
        text = c.title or slug_text(c.url)
        if queries and not any(query_matches(q, f"{text} {slug_text(c.url)}") for q in queries):
            continue
        extra = c.extra.get("items", "")
        rows.append("\t".join((c.id, c.published_at or "-", c.via, c.query or "-", extra or "-", text)))
        if limit is not None and len(rows) >= limit:
            break
    path = paths.view(source)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    header = "id\tpublished\tvia\tquery\tedgar_items\ttitle_or_slug\n"
    path.write_text(header + "".join(row + "\n" for row in rows), encoding="utf-8")
    return len(rows), len(candidates)
```
