```python
"""Fetch candidates through the serving HttpFetcher, keep the raw HTML privately, sanity-check extraction."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from datetime import date

from veritrade.config import get_settings
from veritrade.errors import VtError
from veritrade.extract import registry
from veritrade.fetch import Fetcher, HttpFetcher
from veritrade_evals.articles import (
    ArticlePaths,
    ArticlesError,
    Candidate,
    FetchRecord,
    read_fetched,
    read_jsonl,
    sha256_bytes,
)
from veritrade_evals.discovery import ArchiveClient, Politeness, parse_date, utc_now


def pick_top(
    candidates: Sequence[Candidate], paths: ArticlePaths, n: int, *, since: date, until: date
) -> list[Candidate]:
    """Newest unfetched candidates in the window; undated ones come after every dated one."""
    pool = [
        c
        for c in candidates
        if not _fetched_ok(paths, c.id) and (c.published is None or since <= c.published <= until)
    ]
    pool.sort(key=lambda c: (c.published is not None, c.published_at or "", c.id), reverse=True)
    return pool[:n]


def _fetched_ok(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> bool:
    record = read_fetched(paths, article)
    return record is not None and record.ok


def resolve_ids(candidates: Sequence[Candidate], ids: Sequence[str]) -> list[Candidate]:
    by_id = {c.id: c for c in candidates}
    unknown = [i for i in ids if i not in by_id]
    if unknown:
        raise ArticlesError(f"{len(unknown)} ids are not candidates of this source, e.g. {', '.join(unknown[:3])}")
    return [by_id[i] for i in ids]


def analyze(html: str, url: str, candidate: Candidate) -> dict[str, object]:
    """Cascade extraction as a sanity check: word count, winning method, page publish date."""
    fields: dict[str, object] = {"words": 0, "method": None, "published_at": None, "extract_error": None}
    try:
        article = registry.extract(html, url, parser="selectolax", extractor="cascade")
    except VtError as exc:
        fields["extract_error"] = exc.code.value
    else:
        fields.update(
            words=article.word_count,
            method=article.method,
            published_at=article.published_at,
            paywalled=article.paywalled,
        )
    page_date = parse_date(str(fields["published_at"])) if fields["published_at"] else None
    if page_date is not None:
        fields.update(published_date=page_date.isoformat(), published_from="page")
    elif candidate.published_at:
        fields.update(published_date=candidate.published_at, published_from="candidate")
    return fields


async def fetch_one(
    candidate: Candidate, paths: ArticlePaths, fetcher: Fetcher, polite: Politeness, robots: ArchiveClient
) -> FetchRecord:
    base = {"id": candidate.id, "source": candidate.source, "url": candidate.url, "fetched_at": utc_now()}
    if not await robots.allowed(candidate.url):
        return FetchRecord(**base, error="robots_disallowed")
    lock = await polite.wait(candidate.url)
    try:
        result = await fetcher.get(candidate.url)
    except VtError as exc:
        return FetchRecord(**base, error=exc.code.value, status=exc.upstream_status)
    finally:
        polite.done(candidate.url, lock)
    raw = result.html.encode("utf-8")
    html_path = paths.html(candidate.id)
    html_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    html_path.write_bytes(raw)
    fields = analyze(result.html, result.final_url, candidate)
    return FetchRecord.model_validate(
        base | {"final_url": result.final_url, "status": result.status, "html_sha256": sha256_bytes(raw)} | fields
    )


async def fetch_articles(
    candidates: Sequence[Candidate],
    *,
    paths: ArticlePaths,
    force: bool = False,
    fetcher: Fetcher | None = None,
    robots: ArchiveClient | None = None,
) -> list[tuple[Candidate, FetchRecord | None]]:
    """Sequential fetches; (candidate, None) marks one skipped because it was already fetched."""
    own_fetcher = fetcher is None
    own_robots = robots is None
    active: Fetcher = fetcher or HttpFetcher(get_settings())
    robots_client = robots or ArchiveClient(paths.cache)
    polite = Politeness()
    results: list[tuple[Candidate, FetchRecord | None]] = []
    try:
        for candidate in candidates:
            if not force and _fetched_ok(paths, candidate.id):
                results.append((candidate, None))
                continue
            record = await fetch_one(candidate, paths, active, polite, robots_client)
            path = paths.fetched(candidate.id)
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_text(record.model_dump_json(indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            results.append((candidate, record))
    finally:
        if own_fetcher:
            await active.aclose()
        if own_robots:
            await robots_client.aclose()
    return results


def load_candidates(paths: ArticlePaths, source: str) -> list[Candidate]:
    candidates = read_jsonl(paths.candidates(source), Candidate)
    if not candidates:
        raise ArticlesError(f"no candidates for {source}; run `articles discover --source {source}` first")
    return candidates

```

```python
"""Checks on agent outputs: schema, line ranges, grounded numbers, no verbatim runs, label agreement."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic import ValidationError

from veritrade.inference.types import SENTIMENTS, Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.articles import (
    KEY_FACT_MAX_WORDS,
    KEY_FACTS_MAX,
    KEY_FACTS_MIN,
    MIN_BODY_WORDS,
    RATIONALE_MAX_WORDS,
    SHINGLE_WORDS,
    AdjudicateOutput,
    ArticlePaths,
    GoldOutput,
    LabelOutput,
    schema_codes,
)

_NUMBER = re.compile(r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)*")
_WORD = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")


def word_count(text: str) -> int:
    return len(text.split())


def number_set(text: str) -> set[str]:
    """Numbers as canonical decimals: thousands commas dropped, 1.50 == 1.5."""
    out: set[str] = set()
    for match in _NUMBER.finditer(text):
        raw = match.group(0).replace(",", "")
        try:
            out.add(format(Decimal(raw).normalize(), "f"))
        except InvalidOperation:
            out.add(raw)
    return out


def shingles(text: str, n: int = SHINGLE_WORDS) -> set[tuple[str, ...]]:
    tokens = _WORD.findall(text.lower())
    return {tuple(tokens[i : i + n]) for i in range(len(tokens) - n + 1)}


def shares_run(text: str, body_shingles: set[tuple[str, ...]], n: int = SHINGLE_WORDS) -> bool:
    return not shingles(text, n).isdisjoint(body_shingles)


def score_matches(label: Sentiment, score: int) -> bool:
    return (score > 0) if label == "bullish" else (score < 0) if label == "bearish" else score == 0


# --- gold -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GoldCheck:
    id: str
    output: GoldOutput | None
    codes: tuple[str, ...]
    body: str | None = None
    title: str | None = None

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.output is not None and not self.codes

    @property
    def usable(self) -> bool:
        return self.ok and self.output is not None and self.output.usable


def _ranges(output: GoldOutput, n_lines: int) -> list[str]:
    codes: list[str] = []
    ranges = sorted(output.body_ranges)
    for start, end in ranges:
        if start > end:
            codes.append("range_inverted")
        elif start < 1 or end > n_lines:
            codes.append("range_out_of_bounds")
    if any(later[0] <= earlier[1] for earlier, later in zip(ranges, ranges[1:], strict=False)):
        codes.append("ranges_overlap")
    title = output.title_line
    if title is not None and not 1 <= title <= n_lines:
        codes.append("title_out_of_bounds")
    elif title is not None and any(start <= title <= end for start, end in ranges):
        codes.append("title_in_body")
    return sorted(set(codes))


def _key_facts(facts: Sequence[str], body: str) -> list[str]:
    codes: set[str] = set()
    if not KEY_FACTS_MIN <= len(facts) <= KEY_FACTS_MAX:
        codes.add("key_facts_count")
    grounded = number_set(body)
    body_runs = shingles(body)
    for fact in facts:
        if not fact.strip():
            codes.add("key_fact_empty")
        if word_count(fact) > KEY_FACT_MAX_WORDS:
            codes.add("key_fact_too_long")
        if not number_set(fact) <= grounded:
            codes.add("key_fact_number_ungrounded")
        if shares_run(fact, body_runs):
            codes.add("key_fact_verbatim")
    return sorted(codes)


def check_gold(article: str, raw: str | None, lines: Sequence[str] | None) -> GoldCheck:
    if raw is None:
        return GoldCheck(article, None, ("missing_output",))
    try:
        output = GoldOutput.model_validate_json(raw)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        return GoldCheck(article, None, tuple(schema_codes(exc)))
    codes: list[str] = ["id_mismatch"] if output.id != article else []
    if not output.usable:
        if output.reject_reason is None:
            codes.append("missing:reject_reason")
        return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(codes))
    if lines is None:
        return GoldCheck(article, output, (*codes, "missing_packet_lines"))
    for name in ("title_line", "entity", "provisional_label"):
        value = getattr(output, name)
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip()):
            codes.append(f"missing:{name}")
    if not output.body_ranges:
        codes.append("missing:body_ranges")
    if codes:
        return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(codes))
    if range_codes := _ranges(output, len(lines)):
        return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(range_codes))
    body = "\n\n".join(lines[i - 1] for start, end in sorted(output.body_ranges) for i in range(start, end + 1))
    if word_count(body) < MIN_BODY_WORDS:
        codes.append("body_too_short")
    codes += _key_facts(output.key_facts, body)
    title = lines[output.title_line - 1] if output.title_line else None
    return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(codes), body=body, title=title)


def load_lines(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> list[str] | None:
    path = paths.lines(article)
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return [str(line) for line in payload["lines"]]


def _read(path: Path) -> str | None:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else None


def gold_check(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> GoldCheck:
    return check_gold(article, _read(paths.out("gold", article)), load_lines(paths, article))


# --- labels and adjudication ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LabelCheck:
    id: str
    output: LabelOutput | None
    codes: tuple[str, ...]

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.output is not None and not self.codes


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AdjudicateCheck:
    id: str
    output: AdjudicateOutput | None
    codes: tuple[str, ...]

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.output is not None and not self.codes


def _rationale(rationale: str, label: Sentiment, score: int, body: str | None) -> list[str]:
    codes = []
    if not score_matches(label, score):
        codes.append("score_label_mismatch")
    if word_count(rationale) > RATIONALE_MAX_WORDS:
        codes.append("rationale_too_long")
    if body is None:
        codes.append("gold_missing")
    elif shares_run(rationale, shingles(body)):
        codes.append("rationale_verbatim")
    return codes


def check_label(article: str, raw: str | None, body: str | None) -> LabelCheck:
    if raw is None:
        return LabelCheck(article, None, ("missing_output",))
    try:
        output = LabelOutput.model_validate_json(raw)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        return LabelCheck(article, None, tuple(schema_codes(exc)))
    codes = ["id_mismatch"] if output.id != article else []
    codes += _rationale(output.rationale, output.label, output.score, body)
    return LabelCheck(article, output, tuple(codes))


def check_adjudicate(article: str, raw: str | None, body: str | None, requested: set[str]) -> AdjudicateCheck:
    if raw is None:
        return AdjudicateCheck(article, None, ("missing_output",))
    try:
        output = AdjudicateOutput.model_validate_json(raw)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        return AdjudicateCheck(article, None, tuple(schema_codes(exc)))
    codes = ["id_mismatch"] if output.id != article else []
    if article not in requested:
        codes.append("not_requested")
    codes += _rationale(output.rationale, output.label, output.score, body)
    return AdjudicateCheck(article, output, tuple(codes))


def gold_body(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> str | None:
    return _read(paths.gold(article))


def label_check(paths: ArticlePaths, stage: str, article: str) -> LabelCheck:
    assert stage in ("label_a", "label_b")
    raw = _read(paths.out("label_a" if stage == "label_a" else "label_b", article))
    return check_label(article, raw, gold_body(paths, article))


def adjudicate_requested(paths: ArticlePaths) -> set[str]:
    text = _read(paths.adjudicate_ids) or ""
    return {line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()}


def adjudicate_check(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str, requested: set[str]) -> AdjudicateCheck:
    return check_adjudicate(article, _read(paths.out("adjudicate", article)), gold_body(paths, article), requested)


# --- agreement --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def needs_adjudication(a: LabelOutput, b: LabelOutput) -> bool:
    return a.label != b.label or a.ambiguous or b.ambiguous


def cohen_kappa(a: Sequence[Sentiment], b: Sequence[Sentiment]) -> float | None:
    """Chance-corrected agreement of two raters; 1.0 when both are constant and identical."""
    if len(a) != len(b):
        raise ValueError("both raters must label the same items")
    n = len(a)
    if n == 0:
        return None
    observed = sum(x == y for x, y in zip(a, b, strict=True)) / n
    expected = sum((a.count(c) / n) * (b.count(c) / n) for c in SENTIMENTS)
    if expected == 1.0:
        return 1.0 if observed == 1.0 else 0.0
    return (observed - expected) / (1.0 - expected)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Agreement:
    n: int
    agreed: int
    raw: float | None
    kappa: float | None
    to_adjudicate: tuple[str, ...]


def agreement(pairs: Mapping[str, tuple[LabelOutput, LabelOutput]]) -> Agreement:
    ids = sorted(pairs)
    a = [pairs[i][0].label for i in ids]
    b = [pairs[i][1].label for i in ids]
    agreed = sum(x == y for x, y in zip(a, b, strict=True))
    flagged = tuple(i for i in ids if needs_adjudication(*pairs[i]))
    return Agreement(len(ids), agreed, agreed / len(ids) if ids else None, cohen_kappa(a, b), flagged)

```

```python
"""Agent packets: numbered page lines for gold selection, capped gold bodies for labelling and adjudication.

Gold packets list every visible text block of the page (strip-tags) as an addressable line; menus and the
page chrome far from the extracted article are folded into marker lines that keep their numbers.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from veritrade.errors import VtError
from veritrade.extract import registry, third_party
from veritrade.extract.dom import normalize, split_sentences
from veritrade_evals.articles import (
    LABEL_PACKET_WORDS,
    PROMPTS,
    ArticlePaths,
    FetchRecord,
    rel,
    write_json,
)
from veritrade_evals.articles_validate import (
    AdjudicateCheck,
    LabelCheck,
    adjudicate_requested,
    gold_body,
    gold_check,
    label_check,
)

TINY_WORDS = 3
TINY_CHARS = 32
TINY_RUN = 3
MARGIN_LINES = 12
TITLE_REACH = 200
LONG_LINE_WORDS = 250
CHUNK_WORDS = 120
ANCHOR_CHARS = 60
MIN_PARTIAL_CHARS = 40


def split_long(text: str) -> list[str]:
    """Very long blocks (unparagraphed filings) become sentence chunks so ranges stay fine-grained."""
    if len(text.split()) <= LONG_LINE_WORDS:
        return [text]
    chunks: list[list[str]] = [[]]
    count = 0
    for sentence in split_sentences(text):
        size = len(sentence.split())
        if chunks[-1] and count + size > CHUNK_WORDS:
            chunks.append([])
            count = 0
        chunks[-1].append(sentence)
        count += size
    out: list[str] = []
    for chunk in chunks:
        words = " ".join(chunk).split()
        # A run-on "sentence" (a flattened table) is cut by words.
        out += [" ".join(words[i : i + LONG_LINE_WORDS]) for i in range(0, len(words), LONG_LINE_WORDS)]
    return out


def page_lines(html: str, url: str) -> list[str]:
    return [line for block in third_party.extract("strip-tags", html, url) for line in split_long(block)]


def is_tiny(line: str) -> bool:
    return len(line.split()) <= TINY_WORDS and len(line) <= TINY_CHARS


def _key(text: str) -> str:
    return normalize(text).casefold()


def _matches(line: str, paragraph: str, anchor: str) -> bool:
    return anchor in line or (len(line) >= MIN_PARTIAL_CHARS and line in paragraph)


def locate(lines: Sequence[str], title: str | None, paragraphs: Sequence[str]) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
    """0-based (first, last) lines of the extracted article, widened up to its headline when it is near."""
    if not paragraphs:
        return None
    keys = [_key(line) for line in lines]
    first = next(
        (
            i
            for p in paragraphs[:3]
            for i, k in enumerate(keys)
            if _matches(k, _key(p), _key(p)[:ANCHOR_CHARS])
        ),
        None,
    )
    if first is None:
        return None
    last = next(
        (
            i
            for p in reversed(paragraphs[-3:])
            for i in range(len(keys) - 1, first - 1, -1)
            if _matches(keys[i], _key(p), _key(p)[-ANCHOR_CHARS:])
        ),
        None,
    )
    if last is None:
        return None
    start = first
    if title and (wanted := _key(title)):
        for i in range(first - 1, max(-1, first - TITLE_REACH), -1):
            if keys[i] == wanted or (len(keys[i]) >= 20 and (wanted in keys[i] or keys[i] in wanted)):
                start = i
                break
    return start, last


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Row:
    """One packet row: a visible line (text set) or a folded run of lines (text None)."""

    start: int
    end: int
    text: str | None = None
    note: str = ""


def compact_rows(lines: Sequence[str], span: tuple[int, int] | None) -> list[Row]:
    if not lines:
        return []
    last = len(lines) - 1
    lo, hi = (max(0, span[0] - MARGIN_LINES), min(last, span[1] + MARGIN_LINES)) if span else (0, last)
    rows: list[Row] = []
    if lo > 0:
        rows.append(Row(1, lo, note="before the located article"))
    i = lo
    while i <= hi:
        j = i
        while j + 1 <= hi and is_tiny(lines[i]) and is_tiny(lines[j + 1]):
            j += 1
        if j - i + 1 >= TINY_RUN:
            rows.append(Row(i + 1, j + 1, note="short lines (menus, buttons, tickers)"))
            i = j + 1
            continue
        rows.append(Row(i + 1, i + 1, lines[i]))
        i += 1
    if hi < last:
        rows.append(Row(hi + 2, last + 1, note="after the located article"))
    return rows


def _num(n: int, width: int) -> str:
    return f"L{n:0{width}d}"


def render_rows(rows: Sequence[Row], total: int) -> list[str]:
    width = max(4, len(str(total)))
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        if row.text is not None:
            out.append(f"{_num(row.start, width)} {row.text}")
        else:
            size = row.end - row.start + 1
            out.append(f"{_num(row.start, width)}-{_num(row.end, width)} [{size} lines hidden: {row.note}]")
    return out


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GoldPacket:
    id: str
    lines: tuple[str, ...]
    rows: tuple[Row, ...]
    text: str
    full_text: str
    body_words: int
    located: bool

    @property
    def visible_words(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(row.text.split()) for row in self.rows if row.text is not None)


def build_gold_packet(record: FetchRecord, html: str, paths: ArticlePaths) -> GoldPacket:
    url = record.final_url or record.url
    lines = page_lines(html, url)
    try:
        article = registry.extract(html, url, parser="selectolax", extractor="cascade")
    except VtError:
        article = None
    span = locate(lines, article.title, article.paragraphs) if article else None
    rows = compact_rows(lines, span)
    full = paths.full_packet(record.id)
    header = [
        f"# Gold packet {record.id}",
        "",
        f"- id: {record.id}",
        f"- source: {record.source}",
        f"- url: {record.url}",
        f"- published_at: {record.published_date or 'unknown'}",
        f"- lines: {len(lines)}; folded runs keep their numbers and every line stays addressable",
        f"- every line, nothing folded: {rel(full)}",
        f"- follow: {rel(PROMPTS['gold'])}",
        f"- write your output to: {rel(paths.out('gold', record.id))}",
        "",
        "## Lines",
        "",
    ]
    width = max(4, len(str(len(lines))))
    full_lines = [f"{_num(n, width)} {line}" for n, line in enumerate(lines, start=1)]
    full_header = [f"# Full gold packet {record.id} (every line)", "", f"- compact packet: {rel(paths.packet('gold', record.id))}", ""]
    return GoldPacket(
        id=record.id,
        lines=tuple(lines),
        rows=tuple(rows),
        text="\n".join(header + render_rows(rows, len(lines))) + "\n",
        full_text="\n".join(full_header + full_lines) + "\n",
        body_words=article.word_count if article else 0,
        located=span is not None,
    )


def write_gold_packet(packet: GoldPacket, paths: ArticlePaths) -> Path:
    path = paths.packet("gold", packet.id)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(packet.text, encoding="utf-8")
    paths.full_packet(packet.id).write_text(packet.full_text, encoding="utf-8")
    write_json(paths.lines(packet.id), {"id": packet.id, "lines": list(packet.lines)})
    return path


# --- label and adjudication packets -----------------------------------------------------------------------


def cap_paragraphs(paragraphs: Sequence[str], limit: int = LABEL_PACKET_WORDS) -> tuple[list[str], int]:
    """Whole paragraphs up to `limit` words (the first one is cut if it alone is longer); returns omitted words."""
    kept: list[str] = []
    total = 0
    for paragraph in paragraphs:
        size = len(paragraph.split())
        if total + size > limit:
            if not kept:
                kept.append(" ".join(paragraph.split()[:limit]))
                total = limit
            break
        kept.append(paragraph)
        total += size
    all_words = sum(len(p.split()) for p in paragraphs)
    return kept, all_words - total


def label_body(article: str, title: str, body: str) -> list[str]:
    paragraphs = [p for p in body.split("\n\n") if p.strip()]
    kept, omitted = cap_paragraphs(paragraphs)
    lines = ["## Title", "", title, "", "## Article", ""]
    for paragraph in kept:
        lines += [paragraph, ""]
    if omitted:
        lines += [f"[{omitted} more words of the article are not shown]", ""]
    return lines


def render_label(article: str, title: str, body: str, paths: ArticlePaths) -> str:
    header = [
        f"# Label packet {article}",
        "",
        f"- id: {article}",
        f"- follow: {rel(PROMPTS['label'])}",
        f"- labeller A writes: {rel(paths.out('label_a', article))}",
        f"- labeller B writes: {rel(paths.out('label_b', article))}",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(header + label_body(article, title, body))


def _label_lines(name: str, check: LabelCheck) -> list[str]:
    out = check.output
    if out is None:
        return [f"## Labeller {name}", "", "(no valid output)", ""]
    return [
        f"## Labeller {name}",
        "",
        f"- label: {out.label}",
        f"- score: {out.score}",
        f"- entity: {out.entity}",
        f"- ticker: {out.ticker or 'none'}",
        f"- ambiguous: {str(out.ambiguous).lower()}",
        f"- confidence: {out.confidence}",
        f"- rationale: {out.rationale}",
        "",
    ]


def render_adjudicate(article: str, title: str, body: str, a: LabelCheck, b: LabelCheck, paths: ArticlePaths) -> str:
    header = [
        f"# Adjudication packet {article}",
        "",
        f"- id: {article}",
        f"- follow: {rel(PROMPTS['adjudicate'])}",
        f"- write your output to: {rel(paths.out('adjudicate', article))}",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(header + _label_lines("A", a) + _label_lines("B", b) + label_body(article, title, body))


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Prepared:
    id: str
    path: Path | None
    reason: str = ""
    stats: str = ""


def prepare_label(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> Prepared:
    check = gold_check(paths, article)
    body = gold_body(paths, article)
    if not check.usable or check.title is None or body is None or body != check.body:
        return Prepared(article, None, "gold_not_ingested")
    path = paths.packet("label", article)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(render_label(article, check.title, body, paths), encoding="utf-8")
    return Prepared(article, path, stats=f"body_words={len(body.split())}")


def prepare_adjudicate(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> Prepared:
    if article not in adjudicate_requested(paths):
        return Prepared(article, None, "not_requested")
    check = gold_check(paths, article)
    body = gold_body(paths, article)
    if not check.usable or check.title is None or body is None:
        return Prepared(article, None, "gold_not_ingested")
    a, b = label_check(paths, "label_a", article), label_check(paths, "label_b", article)
    path = paths.packet("adjudicate", article)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(render_adjudicate(article, check.title, body, a, b, paths), encoding="utf-8")
    return Prepared(article, path)


def describe(check: AdjudicateCheck) -> str:
    return "ok" if check.ok else ",".join(check.codes)

```

```python
"""Ledger over every pipeline stage, then the 90-article selection, seeded dev/test split and stats."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import random
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import date
from typing import Literal

from veritrade.inference.types import SENTIMENTS, Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.articles import (
    PER_CLASS,
    REFERENCE_DATE,
    SEED,
    WINDOW_START,
    AdjudicationSummary,
    ArticleLabels,
    ArticlePaths,
    ArticleRow,
    ArticlesError,
    ArticleSplit,
    Candidate,
    FetchRecord,
    LabelSummary,
    iter_fetched,
    read_jsonl,
    row_problems,
    sha256_bytes,
    write_json,
    write_jsonl,
)
from veritrade_evals.articles_validate import (
    AdjudicateCheck,
    GoldCheck,
    LabelCheck,
    adjudicate_check,
    adjudicate_requested,
    agreement,
    cohen_kappa,
    gold_body,
    gold_check,
    label_check,
    needs_adjudication,
    shares_run,
    shingles,
)

Route = Literal["agreed", "adjudicated"]
SLACK = 1
ALGORITHM = (
    "Eligible: gold usable, published in the window, both labellers valid, and either the labels agree with "
    "neither flagged ambiguous or the adjudicator kept the article (its label is final). Quotas start at "
    "min(3, eligible) per source and class; a source below 2 in any class makes the set impossible. Classes "
    "short of 30 (largest deficit first) take a 4th article from the source with the fewest selected so far, "
    "then the most spare eligible articles, then source rank. Within a cell, agreed articles precede "
    "adjudicated ones, each group in seeded order; one article per cell (seeded) goes to dev, the rest to test."
)


# --- ledger -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Entry:
    id: str
    source: str
    fetched: FetchRecord
    gold: GoldCheck
    gold_ingested: bool
    a: LabelCheck
    b: LabelCheck
    adjudication: AdjudicateCheck | None

    @property
    def pair_ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.gold_ingested and self.a.ok and self.b.ok

    @property
    def published(self) -> date | None:
        return self.fetched.published

    def final(self, since: date = WINDOW_START, until: date = REFERENCE_DATE) -> tuple[Sentiment, Route] | None:
        if not self.pair_ok or self.published is None or not since <= self.published <= until:
            return None
        a, b = self.a.output, self.b.output
        assert a is not None and b is not None
        if not needs_adjudication(a, b):
            return a.label, "agreed"
        adj = self.adjudication
        if adj is not None and adj.ok and adj.output is not None and adj.output.decision == "keep":
            return adj.output.label, "adjudicated"
        return None


def build_ledger(paths: ArticlePaths, source: str | None = None) -> list[Entry]:
    requested = adjudicate_requested(paths)
    entries = []
    for record in iter_fetched(paths, source):
        if not record.ok:
            continue
        gold = gold_check(paths, record.id)
        body = gold_body(paths, record.id)
        entries.append(
            Entry(
                id=record.id,
                source=record.source,
                fetched=record,
                gold=gold,
                gold_ingested=gold.usable and body is not None and body == gold.body,
                a=label_check(paths, "label_a", record.id),
                b=label_check(paths, "label_b", record.id),
                adjudication=adjudicate_check(paths, record.id, requested) if record.id in requested else None,
            )
        )
    return entries


# --- status -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(slots=True)
class SourceStatus:
    source: str
    candidates: int = 0
    in_window: int = 0
    undated: int = 0
    fetched_ok: int = 0
    fetch_errors: int = 0
    gold_usable: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)
    gold_rejected: int = 0
    gold_invalid: int = 0
    labelled_a: int = 0
    labelled_b: int = 0
    agreed: int = 0
    adjudicated_keep: int = 0
    adjudicated_replace: int = 0
    pending_adjudication: int = 0
    eligible: Counter[str] = field(default_factory=Counter)


def status(paths: ArticlePaths, sources: Sequence[str]) -> list[SourceStatus]:
    out = []
    for source in sources:
        row = SourceStatus(source)
        candidates = read_jsonl(paths.candidates(source), Candidate)
        row.candidates = len(candidates)
        row.in_window = sum(c.published is not None and WINDOW_START <= c.published <= REFERENCE_DATE for c in candidates)
        row.undated = sum(c.published is None for c in candidates)
        for record in iter_fetched(paths, source):
            if not record.ok:
                row.fetch_errors += 1
        for entry in build_ledger(paths, source):
            row.fetched_ok += 1
            gold = entry.gold
            if gold.output is None or not gold.ok:
                row.gold_invalid += gold.codes != ("missing_output",)
            elif not gold.output.usable:
                row.gold_rejected += 1
            elif entry.gold_ingested and gold.output.provisional_label:
                row.gold_usable[gold.output.provisional_label] += 1
            row.labelled_a += entry.a.ok
            row.labelled_b += entry.b.ok
            if entry.pair_ok and entry.a.output and entry.b.output:
                if not needs_adjudication(entry.a.output, entry.b.output):
                    row.agreed += 1
                elif entry.adjudication is None or not entry.adjudication.ok:
                    row.pending_adjudication += 1
            adj = entry.adjudication
            if adj is not None and adj.ok and adj.output is not None:
                if adj.output.decision == "keep":
                    row.adjudicated_keep += 1
                else:
                    row.adjudicated_replace += 1
            if final := entry.final():
                row.eligible[final[0]] += 1
        out.append(row)
    return out


# --- quotas, selection, split -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


class ShortfallError(ArticlesError):
    def __init__(self, problems: Sequence[str]) -> None:
        super().__init__("article set cannot be filled:\n  " + "\n  ".join(problems))
        self.problems = list(problems)


def plan_quotas(
    available: Mapping[str, Mapping[Sentiment, int]],
    order: Sequence[str],
    *,
    per_class: int = PER_CLASS,
    slack: int = SLACK,
) -> dict[str, dict[Sentiment, int]]:
    """Per (source, class) counts within per_class +- slack whose class totals are per_class * sources."""
    low, high, target = per_class - slack, per_class + slack, per_class * len(order)
    avail = {s: {c: int(available.get(s, {}).get(c, 0)) for c in SENTIMENTS} for s in order}
    problems = [
        f"{s} {c}: {avail[s][c]} eligible, at least {low} needed"
        for s in order
        for c in SENTIMENTS
        if avail[s][c] < low
    ]
    quota = {s: {c: min(per_class, avail[s][c]) for c in SENTIMENTS} for s in order}
    deficit = {c: target - sum(quota[s][c] for s in order) for c in SENTIMENTS}
    for c in sorted(SENTIMENTS, key=lambda c: (-deficit[c], SENTIMENTS.index(c))):
        while (total := sum(quota[s][c] for s in order)) < target:
            options = [s for s in order if quota[s][c] < high and avail[s][c] > quota[s][c]]
            if not options:
                capacity = sum(min(high, avail[s][c]) for s in order)
                problems.append(f"{c}: at most {capacity} of {target} with +-{slack} per source (have {total})")
                break
            best = min(
                options,
                key=lambda s: (sum(quota[s].values()), -(avail[s][c] - quota[s][c]), order.index(s)),
            )
            quota[best][c] += 1
    if problems:
        raise ShortfallError(problems)
    return quota


def _rng(seed: int, *parts: str) -> random.Random:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(":".join((str(seed), *parts)).encode("utf-8")).digest()
    return random.Random(int.from_bytes(digest[:8], "big"))


def choose(cell: Mapping[str, Route], k: int, *, seed: int, source: str, label: str) -> list[str]:
    rng = _rng(seed, "pick", source, label)
    groups = []
    for route in ("agreed", "adjudicated"):
        ids = sorted(i for i, r in cell.items() if r == route)
        rng.shuffle(ids)
        groups += ids
    return groups[:k]


def split_cell(ids: Sequence[str], *, seed: int, source: str, label: str) -> dict[str, ArticleSplit]:
    order = sorted(ids)
    _rng(seed, "split", source, label).shuffle(order)
    return {article: ("dev" if n == 0 else "test") for n, article in enumerate(order)}


# --- rows, guard, stats -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _summary(check: LabelCheck) -> LabelSummary:
    out = check.output
    assert out is not None
    return LabelSummary(label=out.label, score=out.score, ambiguous=out.ambiguous, confidence=out.confidence)


def build_row(entry: Entry, route: Route, split: ArticleSplit) -> ArticleRow:
    a, b, gold = entry.a.output, entry.b.output, entry.gold.output
    assert a is not None and b is not None and gold is not None and entry.gold.body is not None
    adj = entry.adjudication.output if entry.adjudication is not None and entry.adjudication.ok else None
    if route == "adjudicated":
        assert adj is not None
        label, score, entity, rationale = adj.label, float(adj.score), adj.entity, adj.rationale
    else:
        label, score, entity, rationale = a.label, (a.score + b.score) / 2, a.entity, a.rationale
    ticker = next((t for t in (adj.ticker if adj else None, a.ticker, b.ticker, gold.ticker) if t), None)
    summary = AdjudicationSummary(decision=adj.decision, label=adj.label, score=adj.score) if adj else None
    published = entry.published
    assert published is not None
    return ArticleRow(
        id=entry.id,
        url=entry.fetched.url,
        source=entry.source,
        published_at=published.isoformat(),
        fetched_at=entry.fetched.fetched_at,
        html_sha256=entry.fetched.html_sha256 or "",
        gold_sha256=sha256_bytes(entry.gold.body.encode("utf-8")),
        label=label,
        score=score,
        entity=entity,
        ticker=ticker,
        rationale=rationale,
        key_facts=list(gold.key_facts),
        split=split,
        labels=ArticleLabels(a=_summary(entry.a), b=_summary(entry.b), adjudicated=summary, final=label),
    )


TITLE_GUARD_WORDS = 5


def publisher_text_problems(
    rows: Sequence[ArticleRow], bodies: Mapping[str, str], titles: Mapping[str, str]
) -> list[str]:
    """Committed strings must not share a 10-word run with the body nor contain the headline."""
    problems = []
    for row in rows:
        body_runs = shingles(bodies.get(row.id, ""))
        title = (titles.get(row.id) or "").casefold()
        for name, text in [("rationale", row.rationale), ("entity", row.entity)] + [
            (f"key_facts[{n}]", fact) for n, fact in enumerate(row.key_facts)
        ]:
            if shares_run(text, body_runs):
                problems.append(f"{row.id}:{name}:verbatim_body")
            if len(title.split()) >= TITLE_GUARD_WORDS and title in text.casefold():
                problems.append(f"{row.id}:{name}:headline")
    return problems


def _rate(num: int, den: int) -> float | None:
    return round(num / den, 4) if den else None


def _round(value: float | None) -> float | None:
    return round(value, 4) if value is not None else None


def pool_stats(entries: Sequence[Entry]) -> dict[str, object]:
    pairs = {e.id: (e.a.output, e.b.output) for e in entries if e.pair_ok and e.a.output and e.b.output}
    agreed = agreement(pairs)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    adjudicated = [e for e in entries if e.adjudication is not None and e.adjudication.ok]
    replaced = sum(1 for e in adjudicated if e.adjudication and e.adjudication.output and e.adjudication.output.decision == "replace")
    return {
        "gold_usable": sum(e.gold_ingested for e in entries),
        "double_labelled": agreed.n,
        "label_agreement": agreed.agreed,
        "raw_agreement": _round(agreed.raw),
        "cohen_kappa": _round(agreed.kappa),
        "sent_to_adjudication": len(agreed.to_adjudicate),
        "adjudication_rate": _rate(len(agreed.to_adjudicate), agreed.n),
        "adjudicated": len(adjudicated),
        "replaced": replaced,
        "replacement_rate": _rate(replaced, len(adjudicated)),
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Finalized:
    rows: tuple[ArticleRow, ...]
    stats: dict[str, object]


def finalize(
    entries: Sequence[Entry], order: Sequence[str], *, seed: int = SEED, per_class: int = PER_CLASS
) -> Finalized:
    by_id = {e.id: e for e in entries}
    cells: dict[str, dict[Sentiment, dict[str, Route]]] = {s: {c: {} for c in SENTIMENTS} for s in order}
    for entry in entries:
        if entry.source in cells and (final := entry.final()):
            cells[entry.source][final[0]][entry.id] = final[1]
    available = {s: {c: len(cells[s][c]) for c in SENTIMENTS} for s in order}
    quota = plan_quotas(available, order, per_class=per_class)
    rows: list[ArticleRow] = []
    for source in order:
        for label in SENTIMENTS:
            picked = choose(cells[source][label], quota[source][label], seed=seed, source=source, label=label)
            splits = split_cell(picked, seed=seed, source=source, label=label)
            rows += [build_row(by_id[i], cells[source][label][i], splits[i]) for i in sorted(picked)]
    bodies = {r.id: by_id[r.id].gold.body or "" for r in rows}
    titles = {r.id: by_id[r.id].gold.title or "" for r in rows}
    if problems := publisher_text_problems(rows, bodies, titles):
        raise ArticlesError("publisher text in committed fields: " + ", ".join(problems[:6]))
    chosen = [by_id[r.id] for r in rows]
    final_a = [e.a.output.label for e in chosen if e.a.output]
    final_b = [e.b.output.label for e in chosen if e.b.output]
    stats: dict[str, object] = {
        "reference_date": REFERENCE_DATE.isoformat(),
        "window": {"since": WINDOW_START.isoformat(), "until": REFERENCE_DATE.isoformat()},
        "seed": seed,
        "n": len(rows),
        "splits": dict(sorted(Counter(r.split for r in rows).items())),
        "classes": {c: sum(r.label == c for r in rows) for c in SENTIMENTS},
        "per_source": {
            s: {c: sum(r.source == s and r.label == c for r in rows) for c in SENTIMENTS} for s in order
        },
        "quota_adjustments": [
            {"source": s, "label": c, "quota": quota[s][c]}
            for s in order
            for c in SENTIMENTS
            if quota[s][c] != per_class
        ],
        "pool": pool_stats(entries),
        "final_set": {
            "raw_agreement": _round(sum(x == y for x, y in zip(final_a, final_b, strict=True)) / len(rows))
            if rows
            else None,
            "cohen_kappa": _round(cohen_kappa(final_a, final_b)),
            "adjudicated_kept": sum(r.labels.adjudicated is not None for r in rows),
        },
        "algorithm": ALGORITHM,
    }
    return Finalized(tuple(rows), stats)


def write_finalized(result: Finalized, paths: ArticlePaths) -> None:
    write_jsonl(paths.rows, result.rows)
    write_json(paths.stats, result.stats)


def verify(paths: ArticlePaths) -> list[tuple[str, list[str]]]:
    rows = read_jsonl(paths.rows, ArticleRow)
    if not rows:
        raise ArticlesError(f"no committed rows at {paths.rows}")
    return [(row.id, row_problems(row, paths)) for row in rows]


def dumps_stats(stats: Mapping[str, object]) -> str:
    return json.dumps(stats, indent=2)
```

```bash
# --- ingest -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Ingested:
    id: str
    ok: bool
    codes: tuple[str, ...]
    note: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IngestReport:
    stage: Stage
    results: tuple[Ingested, ...]
    agreement: Agreement | None = None


def _output_ids(paths: ArticlePaths, stage: Stage, source: str | None) -> list[str]:
    folder = paths.out_dir(stage)
    ids = sorted(p.stem for p in folder.glob("art-*.json")) if folder.exists() else []
    if source is None:
        return ids
    return [i for i in ids if (record := read_fetched(paths, i)) is not None and record.source == source]


def ingest(paths: ArticlePaths, stage: Stage, source: str | None = None) -> IngestReport:
    """Validate one stage's outputs; gold writes bodies, label stages refresh the adjudication list."""
    results: list[Ingested] = []
    requested = adjudicate_requested(paths)
    for article in _output_ids(paths, stage, source):
        if stage == "gold":
            check = gold_check(paths, article)
            gold_path = paths.gold(article)
            if check.usable and check.body is not None and check.output is not None:
                gold_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                gold_path.write_text(check.body, encoding="utf-8")
                note = f"usable provisional={check.output.provisional_label} words={word_count(check.body)}"
            else:
                gold_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                reason = check.output.reject_reason if check.output is not None else None
                note = f"rejected:{reason}" if check.ok else ""
            results.append(Ingested(article, check.ok, check.codes, note))
        elif stage == "adjudicate":
            adjudicated = adjudicate_check(paths, article, requested)
            decision = adjudicated.output.decision if adjudicated.output is not None else ""
            results.append(Ingested(article, adjudicated.ok, adjudicated.codes, decision))
        else:
            labelled = label_check(paths, stage, article)
            note = f"{labelled.output.label} {labelled.output.score:+d}" if labelled.output is not None else ""
            results.append(Ingested(article, labelled.ok, labelled.codes, note))
    if stage not in ("label_a", "label_b"):
        return IngestReport(stage, tuple(results))
    pairs: dict[str, tuple[LabelOutput, LabelOutput]] = {}
    for article in sorted(set(_output_ids(paths, "label_a", None)) & set(_output_ids(paths, "label_b", None))):
        a, b = label_check(paths, "label_a", article), label_check(paths, "label_b", article)
        if a.ok and b.ok and a.output is not None and b.output is not None:
            pairs[article] = (a.output, b.output)
    stats = agreement(pairs)
    paths.adjudicate_ids.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    paths.adjudicate_ids.write_text("".join(f"{i}\n" for i in stats.to_adjudicate), encoding="utf-8")
    return IngestReport(stage, tuple(results), stats)
EOF
```

```python
"""`articles` command group. Output is ids, URLs, counts, statuses, dates and paths only, never publisher text."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence
from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from veritrade.inference.types import SENTIMENTS
from veritrade_evals.articles import (
    PACKET_STAGES,
    REFERENCE_DATE,
    SEED,
    STAGES,
    WINDOW_START,
    ArticlePaths,
    ArticlesError,
    FetchRecord,
    iter_fetched,
    read_fetched,
    rel,
)
from veritrade_evals.articles_candidates import discover, write_view
from veritrade_evals.articles_fetch import fetch_articles, load_candidates, pick_top, resolve_ids
from veritrade_evals.articles_finalize import build_ledger, finalize, status, verify, write_finalized
from veritrade_evals.articles_packets import build_gold_packet, prepare_adjudicate, prepare_label, write_gold_packet
from veritrade_evals.articles_validate import adjudicate_requested, ingest
from veritrade_evals.discovery import load_sources, on_source_domain, primary_sources


def _sources(raw: Sequence[str] | None) -> list[str]:
    primary = primary_sources()
    if not raw or raw == ["all"]:
        return primary
    keys = [k.strip() for item in raw for k in item.split(",") if k.strip()]
    unknown = [k for k in keys if k not in primary]
    if unknown:
        raise ArticlesError(f"unknown or non-primary sources {unknown}; choose from {primary}")
    return keys


def _ids(args: argparse.Namespace) -> list[str]:
    ids: list[str] = []
    if getattr(args, "ids", None):
        ids += [i.strip() for i in args.ids.split(",") if i.strip()]
    if getattr(args, "ids_file", None):
        ids += [line.strip() for line in Path(args.ids_file).read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]
    return ids


def _date(text: str) -> date:
    return date.fromisoformat(text)


# --- commands ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def cmd_discover(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    sources = _sources(args.source)
    registry = load_sources()
    for url in args.listing_url or []:
        if len(sources) != 1 or not on_source_domain(url, registry[sources[0]]):
            raise ArticlesError(f"--listing-url must be on the domain of exactly one --source: {url}")
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    reports = asyncio.run(
        discover(
            sources,
            since=args.since,
            until=args.until,
            queries=args.query or [],
            listing_urls=args.listing_url or [],
            max_new=args.max,
            pages=args.pages,
            refresh=args.refresh,
            paths=paths,
        )
    )
    for report in reports:
        print(
            f"{report.source}: total={report.total} in_window={report.in_window} undated={report.undated} "
            f"new={report.new} (matched={report.matched} out_of_window={report.out_of_window} "
            f"query_miss={report.query_miss} capped={report.capped}) -> {rel(paths.candidates(report.source))}"
        )
        for a in report.archives:
            errors = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in sorted(a.errors.items())) or "-"
            print(
                f"  {a.kind:9} req={a.requests} ok={a.ok} errors={errors} links={a.links} "
                f"matched={a.matched} {a.url}"
            )
    return 0


def cmd_candidates(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    for source in _sources(args.source):
        rows, total = write_view(
            paths,
            source,
            queries=args.query or [],
            since=None if args.all_dates else WINDOW_START,
            until=None if args.all_dates else REFERENCE_DATE,
            unfetched=args.unfetched,
            limit=args.limit,
        )
        print(f"{source}: rows={rows} of candidates={total} -> {rel(paths.view(source))}")
    return 0


def _fetch_line(record: FetchRecord) -> str:
    if not record.ok:
        return f"{record.id} error {record.error} status={record.status}"
    extra = f" extract_error={record.extract_error}" if record.extract_error else ""
    return (
        f"{record.id} ok {record.status} words={record.words} method={record.method} "
        f"published={record.published_date or '-'}({record.published_from or '-'}){extra}"
    )


def cmd_fetch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    [source] = _sources([args.source])
    candidates = load_candidates(paths, source)
    if args.top is not None:
        chosen = pick_top(candidates, paths, args.top, since=WINDOW_START, until=REFERENCE_DATE)
    else:
        chosen = resolve_ids(candidates, _ids(args))
    results = asyncio.run(fetch_articles(chosen, paths=paths, force=args.force))
    failed = 0
    for candidate, record in results:
        if record is None:
            print(f"{candidate.id} skip already fetched")
            continue
        failed += not record.ok
        print(_fetch_line(record))
    print(f"{source}: fetched={len(results)} errors={failed} -> {rel(paths.private / 'fetched')}")
    return 0


def _prepare_gold(paths: ArticlePaths, records: Sequence[FetchRecord], force: bool) -> int:
    written = 0
    for record in records:
        if not record.ok:
            continue
        if paths.packet("gold", record.id).exists() and not force:
            print(f"{record.id} skip packet exists")
            continue
        html = paths.html(record.id).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        packet = build_gold_packet(record, html, paths)
        write_gold_packet(packet, paths)
        ratio = packet.visible_words / packet.body_words if packet.body_words else 0.0
        print(
            f"{record.id} lines={len(packet.lines)} rows={len(packet.rows)} visible_words={packet.visible_words} "
            f"body_words={packet.body_words} ratio={ratio:.2f} located={str(packet.located).lower()} "
            f"bytes={len(packet.text.encode())}"
        )
        written += 1
    return written


def cmd_prepare(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    source = _sources([args.source])[0] if args.source else None
    wanted = set(_ids(args))
    records = [r for r in iter_fetched(paths, source) if not wanted or r.id in wanted]
    if args.stage == "gold":
        written = _prepare_gold(paths, records, args.force)
    else:
        ids = [r.id for r in records if r.ok]
        if args.stage == "adjudicate":
            requested = adjudicate_requested(paths)
            ids = [i for i in ids if i in requested]
        written = 0
        for article in ids:
            target = paths.packet(args.stage, article)
            if target.exists() and not args.force:
                continue
            prepared = prepare_label(paths, article) if args.stage == "label" else prepare_adjudicate(paths, article)
            if prepared.path is None:
                print(f"{article} skip {prepared.reason}")
                continue
            written += 1
            print(f"{article} ok {prepared.stats}".rstrip())
    print(f"{args.stage}: packets_written={written} -> {rel(paths.private / 'packets' / args.stage)}")
    return 0


def cmd_ingest(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    source = _sources([args.source])[0] if args.source else None
    report = ingest(paths, args.stage, source)
    for result in report.results:
        verdict = "PASS" if result.ok else "FAIL " + ",".join(result.codes)
        print(f"{result.id} {verdict} {result.note}".rstrip())
    passed = sum(r.ok for r in report.results)
    print(f"{args.stage}: pass={passed} fail={len(report.results) - passed}")
    if (stats := report.agreement) is not None:
        raw = f"{stats.raw:.3f}" if stats.raw is not None else "-"
        kappa = f"{stats.kappa:.3f}" if stats.kappa is not None else "-"
        print(
            f"agreement: pairs={stats.n} agreed={stats.agreed} raw={raw} kappa={kappa} "
            f"to_adjudicate={len(stats.to_adjudicate)} -> {rel(paths.adjudicate_ids)}"
        )
    return 0 if passed == len(report.results) else 1


def _counts(counter: Any) -> str:
    return "/".join(str(counter[c]) for c in SENTIMENTS)


def cmd_status(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    rows = status(paths, _sources(args.source))
    print("counts by class are bullish/bearish/neutral")
    header = (
        f"{'source':14}{'cand':>6}{'win':>6}{'undat':>6}{'fetch':>6}{'ferr':>5}  {'gold usable':>11}"
        f"{'rej':>4}{'inv':>4}{'A':>4}{'B':>4}{'agree':>6}{'keep':>5}{'repl':>5}{'pend':>5}  {'eligible':>9}"
    )
    print(header)
    for r in rows:
        print(
            f"{r.source:14}{r.candidates:>6}{r.in_window:>6}{r.undated:>6}{r.fetched_ok:>6}{r.fetch_errors:>5}"
            f"  {_counts(r.gold_usable):>11}{r.gold_rejected:>4}{r.gold_invalid:>4}{r.labelled_a:>4}"
            f"{r.labelled_b:>4}{r.agreed:>6}{r.adjudicated_keep:>5}{r.adjudicated_replace:>5}"
            f"{r.pending_adjudication:>5}  {_counts(r.eligible):>9}"
        )
    return 0


def cmd_finalize(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    order = primary_sources()
    result = finalize(build_ledger(paths), order, seed=args.seed)
    write_finalized(result, paths)
    print(f"rows={len(result.rows)} splits={result.stats['splits']} classes={result.stats['classes']}")
    print(f"-> {rel(paths.rows)}")
    print(f"-> {rel(paths.stats)}")
    return 0


def cmd_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    results = verify(paths)
    bad = [(i, problems) for i, problems in results if problems]
    for article, problems in bad:
        print(f"{article} {','.join(problems)}")
    print(f"verified={len(results)} ok={len(results) - len(bad)} problems={len(bad)}")
    return 1 if bad else 0


def guarded(func: Any) -> Any:
    def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
        try:
            code: int = func(args)
        except ArticlesError as exc:
            print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        return code

    return run


# --- parser -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def register(commands: Any) -> None:
    group = commands.add_parser("articles", help="Opus-labelled article set (discover -> finalize)")
    sub = group.add_subparsers(dest="action", required=True)

    d = sub.add_parser("discover", help="collect candidate URLs from feeds, sitemaps, archives and search")
    d.add_argument("--source", action="append", help="primary source key(s), comma-separated, or 'all'")
    d.add_argument("--since", type=_date, default=WINDOW_START)
    d.add_argument("--until", type=_date, default=REFERENCE_DATE)
    d.add_argument("--listing-url", action="append", help="extra listing page on the source's domain")
    d.add_argument("--query", action="append", help="keyword search where supported, else a title/slug filter")
    d.add_argument("--max", type=int, help="cap on new candidates per source in this run")
    d.add_argument("--pages", type=int, help="pages per paged listing, search and EDGAR query")
    d.add_argument("--refresh", action="store_true", help="ignore the archive cache")
    d.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_discover))

    c = sub.add_parser("candidates", help="write a private TSV view of the candidates for an agent to read")
    c.add_argument("--source", action="append", required=True)
    c.add_argument("--query", action="append")
    c.add_argument("--unfetched", action="store_true")
    c.add_argument("--all-dates", action="store_true", help="include candidates dated outside the window")
    c.add_argument("--limit", type=int)
    c.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_candidates))

    f = sub.add_parser("fetch", help="fetch candidates through the serving fetcher")
    f.add_argument("--source", required=True)
    which = f.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    which.add_argument("--ids", help="comma-separated article ids")
    which.add_argument("--ids-file", help="file with one article id per line")
    which.add_argument("--top", type=int, help="newest N unfetched candidates in the window")
    f.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    f.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_fetch))

    p = sub.add_parser("prepare", help="write agent packets for a stage")
    p.add_argument("--stage", choices=PACKET_STAGES, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--source")
    p.add_argument("--ids", help="comma-separated article ids")
    p.add_argument("--ids-file")
    p.add_argument("--force", action="store_true")
    p.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_prepare))

    i = sub.add_parser("ingest", help="validate agent outputs of a stage")
    i.add_argument("--stage", choices=STAGES, required=True)
    i.add_argument("--source")
    i.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_ingest))

    s = sub.add_parser("status", help="per-source pipeline counts")
    s.add_argument("--source", action="append")
    s.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_status))

    z = sub.add_parser("finalize", help="select 3/3/3 per source, split 30/60, write committed files")
    z.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=SEED)
    z.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_finalize))

    v = sub.add_parser("verify", help="committed rows match the local HTML and gold bodies")
    v.set_defaults(func=guarded(cmd_verify))


__all__ = ["read_fetched", "register"]
```

```python
# --- Discoverer over a fake client ------------------------------------------------------------------------


class FakeClient(ArchiveClient):
    def __init__(self, tmp_path: Path, pages: dict[str, bytes]) -> None:
        super().__init__(tmp_path / "cache", polite=Politeness(0.0, 0.0))
        self.pages = pages
        self.seen: list[str] = []

    async def get(self, url: str) -> Response:
        self.seen.append(url)
        if url not in self.pages:
            return Response(url, url, 404)
        return Response(url, url, 200, self.pages[url])


SOURCES: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "wire": {
        "status": "primary",
        "rank": 1,
        "domains": ["example.com"],
        "article_pattern": r"^https://example\.com/20\d\d/\d\d/\d\d/[a-z0-9-]+\.html$",
    },
    "sec": {
        "status": "primary",
        "rank": 2,
        "domains": ["www.sec.gov"],
        "article_pattern": r"^https://www\.sec\.gov/Archives/edgar/data/\d+/\d+/[^/]+\.html?$",
    },
}


async def test_discoverer_follows_the_newest_child_and_filters_by_pattern(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    newest = b"""<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">
    <url><loc>https://example.com/2026/10/01/kept-story.html?x=1</loc></url>
    <url><loc>https://example.com/video/2026/10/01/clip</loc></url>
    <url><loc>https://example.com/2026/10/01/all</loc></url></urlset>"""
    client = FakeClient(tmp_path, {"https://example.com/index.xml": INDEX, "https://example.com/all12.xml": newest})
    monkeypatch.setitem(discovery.ARCHIVES, "wire", (Archive("sitemap", "https://example.com/index.xml", select="newest"),))
    run = await Discoverer(client, SOURCES).run("wire", since=date(2026, 9, 1), until=date(2026, 10, 18))
    assert client.seen == ["https://example.com/index.xml", "https://example.com/all12.xml"]
    assert [f.link.url for f in run.found] == ["https://example.com/2026/10/01/kept-story.html"]
    assert run.archives[0].matched == 1


async def test_discoverer_edgar_resolves_cover_document_hits(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:

async def test_search_archives_only_run_with_queries(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    client = FakeClient(tmp_path, {})
    monkeypatch.setitem(discovery.ARCHIVES, "wire", (Archive("search", "https://example.com/s?q={query}&p={page}"),))
    run = await Discoverer(client, SOURCES).run("wire", since=date(2026, 9, 1), until=date(2026, 10, 18))
    assert client.seen == []
    assert run.archives == []
    await Discoverer(client, SOURCES).run("wire", since=date(2026, 9, 1), until=date(2026, 10, 18), queries=["loss"])
    assert client.seen == ["https://example.com/s?q=loss&p=1"]


# --- ArchiveClient: robots, gzip, cache --------------------------------------------------------------------


async def test_archive_client_honours_robots_and_caches(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    calls: list[str] = []

    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        calls.append(request.url.path)
        if request.url.path == "/robots.txt":
            return httpx.Response(200, text="User-agent: *\nDisallow: /search/\n")
        if request.url.path == "/sitemap.xml.gz":
            return httpx.Response(200, content=gzip.compress(URLSET))
        return httpx.Response(404)

    http = httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler))
    client = ArchiveClient(tmp_path / "cache", polite=Politeness(0.0, 0.0), client=http)
    blocked = await client.get("https://example.com/search/?q=x")
    assert blocked.error == "robots_disallowed"
    first = await client.get("https://example.com/sitemap.xml.gz")
    assert first.status == 200
    assert sitemap_entries(first.body)[0] == "urlset"
    second = await client.get("https://example.com/sitemap.xml.gz")
    assert second.cached
    assert calls == ["/robots.txt", "/sitemap.xml.gz"]
    await client.aclose()


async def test_archive_client_treats_robots_server_errors_as_disallow(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    http = httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(lambda request: httpx.Response(503)))
    client = ArchiveClient(tmp_path / "cache", polite=Politeness(0.0, 0.0), client=http)
    assert not await client.allowed("https://example.com/page")
    await client.aclose()

    assert Link("a").extra == {}
    assert Link("a").extra is not Link("b").extra
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment

from veritrade_evals.articles_validate import (

)

ID = "art-000000000001"
BODY_LINE = (
    "Velmora Robotics said quarterly revenue rose 28% to $1,250 million as factory orders for its welding arms "
    "outpaced the company's own forecast, and management lifted the full-year outlook to $2.4 billion."
)
LINES = ["Menu", "Velmora lifts outlook", BODY_LINE, BODY_LINE.replace("28%", "31%"), BODY_LINE.replace("Velmora", "It")]
FACTS = [
    "Velmora Robotics grew quarterly sales 28% to $1,250 million.",
    "Management raised the annual outlook to $2.4 billion.",
    "Orders for welding arms beat the internal forecast.",
]


def gold(**overrides: Any) -> str:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = {
        "id": ID,
        "usable": True,
        "title_line": 2,
        "body_ranges": [[3, 5]],
        "key_facts": FACTS,
        "entity": "Velmora Robotics",
        "ticker": "VLM",
        "provisional_label": "bullish",
    }
    payload.update(overrides)
    return json.dumps(payload)


def test_valid_gold_builds_the_body_and_title() -> None:
    check = check_gold(ID, gold(), LINES)
    assert check.ok, check.codes
    assert check.usable
    assert check.title == "Velmora lifts outlook"
    assert check.body == "\n\n".join(LINES[2:5])


@pytest.mark.parametrize(

        ({"key_facts": [*FACTS[:2], "quarterly revenue rose 28% to $1,250 million as factory orders for its"]}, "key_fact_verbatim"),

    )

def test_cohen_kappa_known_values() -> None:
    a: list[Sentiment] = ["bullish"] * 20 + ["bearish"] * 15 + ["neutral"] * 15
    b: list[Sentiment] = ["bullish"] * 15 + ["neutral"] * 5 + ["bearish"] * 15 + ["neutral"] * 15
    # observed 0.9, expected (20*15 + 15*15 + 15*25) / 2500 = 0.36
    assert cohen_kappa(a, b) == pytest.approx((0.9 - 0.36) / 0.64)
    assert cohen_kappa(["neutral", "neutral"], ["neutral", "neutral"]) == 1.0
    assert cohen_kappa([], []) is None
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="same items"):
        cohen_kappa(["neutral"], [])


def _out(label: Sentiment, score: int, ambiguous: bool = False) -> LabelOutput:
    return LabelOutput(
        id=ID, label=label, score=score, entity="X", rationale="r", ambiguous=ambiguous, confidence=3
    )


def test_agreement_flags_disagreement_and_ambiguity() -> None:
    pairs = {
        "art-1": (_out("bullish", 2), _out("bullish", 1)),
        "art-2": (_out("bullish", 1), _out("neutral", 0)),
        "art-3": (_out("bearish", -1), _out("bearish", -2, ambiguous=True)),
    }
    stats = agreement(pairs)
    assert stats.n == 3
    assert stats.agreed == 2
    assert stats.raw == pytest.approx(2 / 3)
    assert stats.to_adjudicate == ("art-2", "art-3")
    assert needs_adjudication(*pairs["art-3"])
    assert not needs_adjudication(*pairs["art-1"])
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from veritrade_evals.articles import ArticlePaths, FetchRecord
from veritrade_evals.articles_packets import (
    LONG_LINE_WORDS,
    Row,
    build_gold_packet,
    cap_paragraphs,
    compact_rows,
    is_tiny,
    locate,
    render_label,
    render_rows,
    split_long,
    write_gold_packet,
)

PARAGRAPHS = [
    f"Paragraph {n} of the synthetic story explains how Quillon Freight moved {n * 7} containers through "
    f"the harbour while rivals waited, according to figures the company shared with analysts this week."
    for n in range(1, 9)
]
NAV = "".join(f'<li><a href="/s{n}">Section {n}</a></li>' for n in range(30))
FOOTER = "".join(f'<li><a href="/f{n}">Footer link {n}</a></li>' for n in range(30))
HTML = f"""<html><head><title>Quillon Freight story</title></head><body>
<nav><ul>{NAV}</ul></nav>
<main><article><h1>Quillon Freight clears the backlog</h1>
<div class="byline">By A. Writer</div>
{"".join(f"<p>{p}</p>" for p in PARAGRAPHS)}
</article></main>
<aside>{"".join(f"<p>Unrelated promo block number {n} with a few more words to read.</p>" for n in range(40))}</aside>
<footer><ul>{FOOTER}</ul></footer>
</body></html>"""


def record() -> FetchRecord:
    return FetchRecord(
        id="art-0123456789ab",
        source="cnbc",
        url="https://news.example.com/2026/10/16/quillon.html",
        fetched_at="2026-10-18T10:00:00+00:00",
        status=200,
        html_sha256="0" * 64,
        published_date="2026-10-16",
    )


def covered(rows: list[Row]) -> list[int]:
    return [n for row in rows for n in range(row.start, row.end + 1)]


def test_split_long_keeps_text_and_caps_line_length() -> None:
    assert split_long("short line") == ["short line"]
    sentence = " ".join(["word"] * 29) + "."
    text = " ".join([sentence] * 40)
    parts = split_long(text)
    assert len(parts) > 1
    assert " ".join(parts) == text
    assert all(len(p.split()) <= LONG_LINE_WORDS for p in parts)
    run_on = " ".join(["cell"] * (LONG_LINE_WORDS * 2 + 5))
    assert [len(p.split()) for p in split_long(run_on)] == [LONG_LINE_WORDS, LONG_LINE_WORDS, 5]


def test_is_tiny() -> None:
    assert is_tiny("Sign in")
    assert is_tiny("Markets")
    assert not is_tiny("Shares fell 4% after the results")
    assert not is_tiny("Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious-and-more")


def test_compact_rows_fold_tiny_runs_and_keep_every_number() -> None:
    lines = ["Home", "Markets", "Tech", "A long headline about the company today", "Body one is long enough here", "Share", "Body two"]
    rows = compact_rows(lines, None)
    assert covered(rows) == list(range(1, len(lines) + 1))
    assert rows[0] == Row(1, 3, note="short lines (menus, buttons, tickers)")
    # Runs shorter than three stay visible.
    assert Row(6, 6, "Share") in rows
    rendered = render_rows(rows, len(lines))
    assert rendered[0].startswith("L0001-L0003 [3 lines hidden")
    assert rendered[1].startswith("L0004 A long headline")


def test_compact_rows_fold_far_regions_around_the_span() -> None:
    lines = [f"line number {n} has several words in it" for n in range(100)]
    rows = compact_rows(lines, (40, 50))
    assert covered(rows) == list(range(1, 101))
    assert rows[0] == Row(1, 28, note="before the located article")
    assert rows[-1] == Row(64, 100, note="after the located article")
    assert rows[1].start == 29


def test_locate_finds_headline_first_and_last_paragraph() -> None:
    lines = ["Menu", "The headline", "By someone", *PARAGRAPHS, "Related stories"]
    assert locate(lines, "The headline", PARAGRAPHS) == (1, 2 + len(PARAGRAPHS))
    assert locate(lines, None, PARAGRAPHS) == (3, 2 + len(PARAGRAPHS))
    assert locate(lines, "x", ["not on the page at all, anywhere, in any form whatsoever"]) is None
    assert locate(lines, "x", []) is None


def test_gold_packet_is_compact_addressable_and_names_its_files(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    paths = ArticlePaths(private=tmp_path / "private", committed=tmp_path / "committed")
    packet = build_gold_packet(record(), HTML, paths)
    assert packet.located
    assert packet.body_words >= sum(len(p.split()) for p in PARAGRAPHS)
    assert packet.visible_words <= 1.5 * packet.body_words
    assert covered(list(packet.rows)) == list(range(1, len(packet.lines) + 1))
    assert "Quillon Freight clears the backlog" in packet.text
    assert all(p in packet.text for p in PARAGRAPHS)
    assert "Footer link 29" not in packet.text
    assert "Footer link 29" in packet.full_text
    assert f"out/gold/{record().id}.json" in packet.text
    assert "opus_prompts/20-gold.md" in packet.text
    write_gold_packet(packet, paths)
    assert paths.packet("gold", record().id).exists()
    assert paths.full_packet(record().id).exists()
    assert paths.lines(record().id).exists()


def test_gold_packet_without_an_extractable_article_shows_every_line(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    paths = ArticlePaths(private=tmp_path / "private", committed=tmp_path / "committed")
    packet = build_gold_packet(record(), "<html><body><p>Too short.</p></body></html>", paths)
    assert not packet.located
    assert packet.rows == (Row(1, 1, "Too short."),)


def test_cap_paragraphs_stops_at_a_boundary() -> None:
    paras = ["a " * 500, "b " * 500, "c " * 500]
    kept, omitted = cap_paragraphs([p.strip() for p in paras], 1200)
    assert len(kept) == 2
    assert omitted == 500
    kept, omitted = cap_paragraphs(["w " * 1500], 1200)
    assert len(kept[0].split()) == 1200
    assert omitted == 300
    assert cap_paragraphs(["x y"], 1200) == (["x y"], 0)


def test_label_packet_hides_source_url_and_other_labels(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    paths = ArticlePaths(private=tmp_path / "private", committed=tmp_path / "committed")
    body = "\n\n".join(PARAGRAPHS)
    text = render_label("art-0123456789ab", "Quillon Freight clears the backlog", body, paths)
    assert "Quillon Freight clears the backlog" in text
    assert PARAGRAPHS[-1] in text
    assert "example.com" not in text
    assert "cnbc" not in text
    assert "provisional" not in text
    assert "out/label_a/art-0123456789ab.json" in text
    assert "out/label_b/art-0123456789ab.json" in text
```
