```
"""What the model reads: the headline plus the lede or the whole body, cut to a token budget."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Sequence

from veritrade.extract.dom import split_sentences
from veritrade.extract.profiles import profile_for
from veritrade.extract.types import Article, Scope

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
LEDE_PARAGRAPHS = 2
LEDE_MIN_TOKENS = 60  # a dateline-only first paragraph is topped up with the next one
LEDE_MAX_TOKENS = 200
_SEP = "\n\n"


def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    return math.ceil(len(text) / CHARS_PER_TOKEN)


def lede_paragraphs(article: Article) -> list[str]:
    profile = profile_for(article.source)
    count = profile.lede_paragraphs if profile else LEDE_PARAGRAPHS
    out = list(article.paragraphs[:count])
    for paragraph in article.paragraphs[count:]:
        if estimate_tokens(_SEP.join(out)) >= LEDE_MIN_TOKENS:
            break
        out.append(paragraph)
    return out


def _cut(paragraph: str, room: int, *, mid_sentence: bool) -> str:
    kept = ""
    for sentence in split_sentences(paragraph):
        candidate = f"{kept} {sentence}" if kept else sentence
        if len(candidate) > room:
            break
        kept = candidate
    if kept or not mid_sentence:
        return kept
    head = paragraph[: room + 1]
    return head[:room] if " " not in head else head.rsplit(" ", 1)[0]


def fit(paragraphs: Sequence[str], budget_chars: int) -> list[str]:
    """Whole paragraphs, then whole sentences; words are cut only when not even one sentence fits."""
    out: list[str] = []
    used = 0
    for paragraph in paragraphs:
        sep = len(_SEP) if out else 0
        if used + sep + len(paragraph) <= budget_chars:
            out.append(paragraph)
            used += sep + len(paragraph)
            continue
        if partial := _cut(paragraph, budget_chars - used - sep, mid_sentence=not out):
            out.append(partial)
        break
    return out


def build_input(article: Article, scope: Scope, max_tokens: int) -> str:
    """'TITLE: ...' then a blank line and the body; the estimate (chars / 4) never exceeds max_tokens."""
    if max_tokens <= 0:
        raise ValueError("max_tokens must be positive")
    budget = max_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    head = f"TITLE: {article.title}" if article.title else ""
    if len(head) > budget:
        return _SEP.join(fit([head], budget))
    room = budget - len(head) - (len(_SEP) if head else 0)
    if scope == "lede":
        body = fit(lede_paragraphs(article), min(room, LEDE_MAX_TOKENS * CHARS_PER_TOKEN))
    else:
        body = fit(article.paragraphs, room)
    return _SEP.join([head, *body] if head else body)
"""Single entry point from HTML to Article; parse and extract time are measured separately."""

from __future__ import annotations

import html as html_lib
import re
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from veritrade.errors import ExtractionEmpty
from veritrade.extract import cascade, density, jsonld, profiles, third_party
from veritrade.extract.dom import Dom, head_title, normalize, parse, scan_json_ld
from veritrade.extract.profiles import source_for_url
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS, Article, ExtractorName, ParserName

__all__ = ["MIN_WORDS", "extract", "source_for_url"]

MIN_WORDS = 40

OWN: dict[ExtractorName, Callable[[Dom, str, str | None], list[str]]] = {
    "jsonld": jsonld.extract,
    "profile": profiles.extract,
    "density": density.extract,
}
_PUBLISHED_META = re.compile(
    r"""<meta\b[^>]*?(?:property|name|itemprop)\s*=\s*["']"""
    r"""(?:article:published_time|datePublished|pubdate|publishdate)["'][^>]*>""",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_CONTENT_ATTR = re.compile(r"""\bcontent\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')""", re.IGNORECASE)


def _published_meta(html: str) -> str | None:
    if (meta := _PUBLISHED_META.search(html)) and (content := _CONTENT_ATTR.search(meta.group(0))):
        return normalize(html_lib.unescape(content.group(1) or content.group(2) or "")) or None
    return None


def _dom_title(dom: Dom, source: str | None) -> str:
    profile = profiles.profile_for(source)
    if profile is not None and profile.title:
        for node in dom.select(profile.title):
            if text := node.text():
                return text
    return dom.title()


def extract(
    html: str,
    url: str,
    *,
    parser: ParserName = "selectolax",
    extractor: ExtractorName = "cascade",
) -> Article:
    """Raises ExtractionEmpty when fewer than MIN_WORDS words come out."""
    source = source_for_url(url)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    dom: Dom | None = None
    if extractor in PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS:
        dom = parse(html, parser)
        if extractor == "cascade":
            method, paragraphs = cascade.run(dom, url, source)
        else:
            method, paragraphs = extractor, OWN[extractor](dom, url, source)
        objects = dom.json_ld()
    else:
        method, paragraphs = extractor, third_party.extract(extractor, html, url)
        objects = scan_json_ld(html)
    words = sum(len(p.split()) for p in paragraphs)
    if words < MIN_WORDS:
        raise ExtractionEmpty(
            f"The {extractor} extractor found {words} words on {urlsplit(url).hostname or url}; "
            f"at least {MIN_WORDS} are needed",
            hint="Try another extractor (for example trafilatura), or check that the URL is a single "
            "article rather than a section or video page.",
        )
    title = jsonld.headline(objects) or (_dom_title(dom, source) if dom is not None else head_title(html))
    published_at = jsonld.date_published(objects) or _published_meta(html)
    total_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
"""/signal: one non-streaming classification of the lede (or the full article)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from veritrade.api.contracts import SignalRequest, SignalResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import classify_signal
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, inference_timings, signal_result
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


async def run_signal(runtime: Runtime, request: SignalRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SignalResponse:
    job = Job.resolve(runtime, "signal", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SignalResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = SignalResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(verdict),
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(raw)),
    )
    job.remember(response)
    return response
```

```
    gold_sha256: str

    rationale: str

def read_jsonl[M: BaseModel](path: Path, model: type[M]) -> list[M]:
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.strip():
            rows.append(model.model_validate_json(line))
    return rows


def write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: Iterable[BaseModel]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    text = "".join(row.model_dump_json(exclude_none=False) + "\n" for row in rows)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def read_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> FetchRecord | None:
    path = paths.fetched(article)
    return FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else None


def iter_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, source: str | None = None) -> Iterator[FetchRecord]:
    folder = paths.private / "fetched"
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("art-*.json")) if folder.exists() else []:
        record = FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if source is None or record.source == source:
            yield record


def in_window(day: date | None, since: date = WINDOW_START, until: date = REFERENCE_DATE) -> bool:
    return day is not None and since <= day <= until


# --- verify + loader --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def row_problems(row: ArticleRow, paths: ArticlePaths) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    for kind, path, expected in (
        ("html", paths.html(row.id), row.html_sha256),
        ("gold", paths.gold(row.id), row.gold_sha256),
    ):
        if not path.exists():
            problems.append(f"{kind}_missing")
        elif sha256_file(path) != expected:
            problems.append(f"{kind}_drifted")
    return problems
```

```
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Job:
    """A request with its model and prompt resolved; nothing has touched the network yet."""

    runtime: Runtime
    endpoint: Endpoint
    request: ArticleRequest
    url: str
    scope: Scope
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    key: ResultKey | None
    clock: StageTimer

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls, runtime: Runtime, endpoint: Endpoint, request: ArticleRequest, *, scope: Scope, clock: StageTimer
    ) -> Job:
        spec = runtime.registry.resolve(endpoint, request.model)
        prompt = runtime.prompt(endpoint, spec)
        url = str(request.url)
        key = None
        if not request.no_cache:
            key = ResultKey(
                endpoint=endpoint,
                url=normalize_url(url),
                model=spec.name,
                prompt_version=prompt.version,
                parser=request.parser,
                extractor=request.extractor,
                scope=scope,
            )
        return cls(runtime, endpoint, request, url, scope, spec, prompt, key, clock)

    def cached[R: (SignalResponse, SummaryResponse, AnalyzeResponse)](self, kind: type[R]) -> R | None:
        """The stored response marked as cached, with timings that describe this request."""
        hit = self.runtime.results.get(self.key) if self.key is not None else None
        if not isinstance(hit, kind):
            return None
        # A result hit runs no stage, so stage timings are zero and the article counts as a fetch hit.
        timings = Timings(
            total_ms=self.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=0.0,
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch="hit", result="hit"),
        )
        meta = hit.meta.model_copy(update={"cached": True})
        return hit.model_copy(update={"meta": meta, "timings": timings})

    def remember(self, response: SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> None:
        if self.key is not None:
            self.runtime.results.put(self.key, response)

    async def prepare(self) -> Prepared:
        loaded = await load_article(
            self.runtime,
            self.url,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            no_cache=self.request.no_cache,
        )
        text = build_input(loaded.article, self.scope, self.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return Prepared(
            job=self,
            loaded=loaded,
            text=text,
            meta=self._meta(loaded, text),
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch=loaded.fetch_status, result="bypass" if self.key is None else "miss"),
        )
    article: Article
    fetch_status: FetchStatus
    fetch_ms: float
    consent_ms: float | None


async def load_article(
    runtime: Runtime, url: str, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName, no_cache: bool
) -> LoadedArticle:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    status: FetchStatus
    if no_cache:
        page, status = await runtime.fetcher.get(url), "bypass"
    else:
        fetch = partial(runtime.fetcher.get, url)
        shared = await runtime.fetch_cache.get_or_create(normalize_url(url), fetch)
        page, status = shared.value, shared.status
    if status in ("miss", "bypass"):
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = page.fetch_ms, page.consent_ms
    else:
        # A hit or join reports this request's own wait, not the download it reused.
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, None
    article = await extract_article(page, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    return LoadedArticle(page, article, status, fetch_ms, consent_ms)


async def extract_article(page: FetchResult, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName) -> Article:
    run = partial(extract, page.html, page.final_url, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    if extractor in PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS and parser in INLINE_PARSERS:
        return run()
    return await asyncio.to_thread(run)
```

```
"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    backend_tests = "backend/tests" if full else "backend/tests/unit"
    tests = [backend_tests, "evals/tests", "scripts/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps
```

```
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint
from veritrade.models_registry import allowlist
from veritrade.prompts import registry as prompts
from veritrade.prompts.registry import OUTPUT_FIELDS, REQUIRED_VARIANTS, PromptRegistry, model_slug

PAIRS = [(endpoint, spec.name) for spec in allowlist().values() for endpoint in spec.endpoints]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("endpoint", "model"), PAIRS)
def test_every_allowlisted_model_resolves_a_prompt(endpoint: Endpoint, model: str) -> None:
    spec = allowlist()[model]
    prompt = prompts.get(endpoint, model)
    assert re.fullmatch(rf"{endpoint}/{re.escape(model)}/v\d+@[0-9a-f]{{8}}", prompt.version)
    article = "Acme Corp beats estimates."
    if spec.kind == "decision":
        assert [s for s, _ in prompt.criteria] == ["neutral", "bullish", "bearish"]
        assert prompt.instructions
        assert "Acme Corp" in prompt.state(article)
        return
    for variant in REQUIRED_VARIANTS[(endpoint, spec.kind)]:
        messages = prompt.messages(article, variant)
        assert messages[0]["role"] == "system"
        assert "{output}" not in messages[0]["content"]
        assert messages[-1] == {"role": "user", "content": f"<article>\n{article}\n</article>"}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("endpoint", "model"), PAIRS)
def test_every_prompt_fences_untrusted_text_and_states_the_rubric(endpoint: Endpoint, model: str) -> None:
    reg = PromptRegistry()
    for version in reg.versions(endpoint, model):
        prompt = reg.get(endpoint, model, version=version)
        text = (prompt.system + prompt.instructions).lower()
        assert "<article>" in prompt.user_template
        assert "instructions" in text
        assert "never follow" in text or "ignore" in text
        if endpoint != "summary":
            assert "economic" in text or "material" in text
        if endpoint in ("summary", "analyze"):
            assert "60 words" in text
            assert "3 sentences" in text


def test_version_is_stable_across_registries_and_tracks_content() -> None:
    first = PromptRegistry().get("signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0")
    again = PromptRegistry().get("signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0")
    assert first.version == again.version
    with_shots = PromptRegistry().get("signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", version="v2")
    assert with_shots.version.split("@")[1] != first.version.split("@")[1]
    # Two models sharing default.toml share the content hash but not the version string.
    other = PromptRegistry().get("analyze", "ministral-3:3b")
    same_file = PromptRegistry().get("analyze", "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M")
    assert other.version.split("@")[1] == same_file.version.split("@")[1]
```

```python
SignalSchema = Literal["label", "ordinal"]


class ModelSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    num_ctx: int | None = Field(None, gt=0)
    max_input_tokens: int = Field(gt=0)
    num_predict: dict[Endpoint, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    signal_schema: SignalSchema | None = None
    policy: PolicyName
    min_p: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, le=1)
    ordinal_t: int = Field(1, ge=1, le=2)
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    evaluated: bool = True

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _default_field_order(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict) and "analyze" in data.get("endpoints", ()) and not data.get("field_order"):
            return {**data, "field_order": "sentiment-first"}
        return data

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _check_consistency(self) -> ModelSpec:
        if self.kind == "decision":
            if self.endpoints != ("signal",) or self.policy != "probability":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{self.name}: decision models serve only /signal with the probability policy"
                )
        else:
            if self.policy == "probability":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models have no native class probabilities")
            if self.num_ctx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models need num_ctx")
            missing = [e for e in self.endpoints if e not in self.num_predict]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: num_predict missing for {missing}")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.signal_schema is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative /signal models need signal_schema")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.policy == "ordinal" and self.signal_schema != "ordinal":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: the ordinal policy needs signal_schema = 'ordinal'")
        if self.policy in ("probability", "label-logprob") and self.min_p is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: policy {self.policy} needs min_p")
        return self

    def serves(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> bool:
        return endpoint in self.endpoints


def parse_models_toml(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, ModelSpec], dict[Endpoint, str]]:
    raw = tomllib.loads(text)
    specs = {name: ModelSpec(name=name, **body) for name, body in raw.get("models", {}).items()}
    defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
    for endpoint, name in raw.get("defaults", {}).items():
        if endpoint not in ENDPOINTS:
            raise ValueError(f"models.toml: unknown endpoint in [defaults]: {endpoint}")
```

```python
def _threshold(
    name: PolicyName, probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float], min_p: float, score: int | None = None
) -> Verdict:
    top = winner(probabilities)
    confidence = probabilities[top]
    abstained = confidence < min_p
    return Verdict(
        sentiment="neutral" if abstained else top,
        abstained=abstained,
        policy=name,
        confidence=confidence,
        score=score,
        probabilities=probabilities,
    )

    return {s for s in TIE_ORDER if s.startswith(rest) or rest.startswith(s + '"')}
```

```
ordinal = "score please"

def _root(tmp_path: Path, files: dict[str, str]) -> Path:
    for name, text in files.items():
        path = tmp_path / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(text)
    return tmp_path

    assert custom.source == "signal/m_1b.toml"
```

```python
"""Eval runner: drives the serving adapters over examples and caches raw outputs for offline thresholds."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import sys
import time
from collections import deque
from collections.abc import Callable, Coroutine, Mapping, Sequence
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal, TextIO, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import LlmUnreachable, ModelUnavailable, SchemaViolation, VtError
from veritrade.inference.adapters import TOP_LOGPROBS, analyze_stream, chat_options, classify_signal
from veritrade.inference.confidence import score_sign_probabilities
from veritrade.inference.incremental import ScoreClosed
from veritrade.inference.ollama import FIXED_OPTIONS, OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.schemas import ANALYZE_MODELS, LabelOut, OrdinalOut, ollama_format
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade_evals.datasets import Example
from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR
from veritrade_evals.predcache import PredCache, PredError, canonical_json

# Part of every cache key: bump when the runner changes what it records for an unchanged config.
RUNNER_VERSION = "1"
# Signal cells record score_sign_probabilities output (fallback and sign_probs): bump when it changes.
SCORE_SIGN_VERSION = 2
DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 4
# Rendering the prompt with its own placeholder hashes everything the model sees except the input.
TEXT_SENTINEL = "{text}"
# Synthetic input that loads the model and warms the prompt cache before any timed call.
WARMUP_TEXT = "Ostrava Logistics appoints a new chief financial officer effective January 1."

Variant = Literal["decision", "label", "ordinal", "sentiment-first"]
VARIANTS: tuple[Variant, ...] = get_args(Variant)
VARIANT_ENDPOINT: dict[Variant, Endpoint] = {
    "decision": "signal",
    "label": "signal",
    "ordinal": "signal",
    "sentiment-first": "analyze",
}
Pred = dict[str, Any]
Timing = dict[str, float]


class RunAborted(RuntimeError):
    pass


def serving_spec(base: ModelSpec, variant: Variant) -> ModelSpec:
    """The allowlisted spec switched to the variant under test; thresholds are applied offline."""
    if (variant == "decision") != (base.kind == "decision"):
        raise ValueError(f"{base.name} is a {base.kind} model and cannot run the {variant} variant")
    update: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if variant == "label":
        update = {"signal_schema": "label", "policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": base.min_p or 0.5}
    elif variant == "ordinal":
        update = {"signal_schema": "ordinal", "policy": "ordinal"}
    elif variant == "sentiment-first":
        update = {"field_order": "sentiment-first"}
    return ModelSpec.model_validate({**base.model_dump(), **update})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RunSpec:
    """One grid cell: a model asked for one output variant under one prompt version."""

    name: str
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    variant: Variant
    dims: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def model(self) -> str:
        return self.spec.name

    @property
    def endpoint(self) -> Endpoint:
        return VARIANT_ENDPOINT[self.variant]

    def run_config(self, split: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        config: dict[str, Any] = {
            "runner": RUNNER_VERSION,
            "split": split,
            "endpoint": self.endpoint,
            "variant": self.variant,
            "prompt_version": self.prompt.version,
            "max_input_tokens": self.spec.max_input_tokens,
        }
        if self.variant != "decision":
            # Exactly what the client sends, so a change to the fixed decoding options re-keys the cache.
            config["options"] = {**chat_options(self.spec, self.endpoint), **FIXED_OPTIONS}
        if self.variant in ("label", "ordinal"):
            config["top_logprobs"] = TOP_LOGPROBS
            config["score_sign"] = SCORE_SIGN_VERSION
        if self.variant == "sentiment-first":
            config["stop_after_score"] = True
        return config

    def prompt_sha(self) -> str:
        payload: dict[str, Any]
        if self.variant == "decision":
            payload = {
                "state": self.prompt.state(TEXT_SENTINEL),
                "instructions": self.prompt.instructions,
                "criteria": self.prompt.criteria,
            }
        else:
            payload = {
                "messages": self.prompt.messages(TEXT_SENTINEL, self.variant),
                "format": ollama_format(_out_type(self.variant)),
            }
            if self.variant == "label":
                payload["fallback"] = {
                    "messages": self.prompt.messages(TEXT_SENTINEL, "ordinal"),
                    "format": ollama_format(OrdinalOut),
                }
        return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def cache(self, split: str, model_digest: str, root: Path = PREDS_DIR) -> PredCache:
        return PredCache(
            self.model,
            self.run_config(split),
            model_digest=model_digest,
            prompt_sha=self.prompt_sha(),
            root=root,
        )


def _out_type(variant: Variant) -> type[BaseModel]:
    if variant == "label":
        return LabelOut
    if variant == "ordinal":
        return OrdinalOut
    return ANALYZE_MODELS["sentiment-first"]


# --- one call --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _chat_timing(chat: ChatResult) -> Timing:
    timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": chat.wall_ms}
    timing.update({k: float(v) for k, v in asdict(chat.timings).items() if v is not None})
    return timing
```

```python
"""Eval runner: drives the serving adapters over examples and caches raw outputs for offline thresholds."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import sys
import time
from collections import deque
from collections.abc import Callable, Coroutine, Mapping, Sequence
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal, TextIO, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import LlmUnreachable, ModelUnavailable, SchemaViolation, VtError
from veritrade.inference.adapters import TOP_LOGPROBS, analyze_stream, chat_options, classify_signal
from veritrade.inference.confidence import score_sign_probabilities
from veritrade.inference.incremental import ScoreClosed
from veritrade.inference.ollama import FIXED_OPTIONS, OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.schemas import ANALYZE_MODELS, LabelOut, OrdinalOut, ollama_format
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade_evals.datasets import Example
from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR
from veritrade_evals.predcache import PredCache, PredError, canonical_json

# Part of every cache key: bump when the runner changes what it records for an unchanged config.
RUNNER_VERSION = "1"
# Signal cells record score_sign_probabilities output (fallback and sign_probs): bump when it changes.
SCORE_SIGN_VERSION = 2
DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 4
# Rendering the prompt with its own placeholder hashes everything the model sees except the input.
TEXT_SENTINEL = "{text}"
# Synthetic input that loads the model and warms the prompt cache before any timed call.
WARMUP_TEXT = "Ostrava Logistics appoints a new chief financial officer effective January 1."

Variant = Literal["decision", "label", "ordinal", "sentiment-first"]
VARIANTS: tuple[Variant, ...] = get_args(Variant)
VARIANT_ENDPOINT: dict[Variant, Endpoint] = {
    "decision": "signal",
    "label": "signal",
    "ordinal": "signal",
    "sentiment-first": "analyze",
}
Pred = dict[str, Any]
Timing = dict[str, float]


class RunAborted(RuntimeError):
    pass


def serving_spec(base: ModelSpec, variant: Variant) -> ModelSpec:
    """The allowlisted spec switched to the variant under test; thresholds are applied offline."""
    if (variant == "decision") != (base.kind == "decision"):
        raise ValueError(f"{base.name} is a {base.kind} model and cannot run the {variant} variant")
    update: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if variant == "label":
        update = {"signal_schema": "label", "policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": base.min_p or 0.5}
    elif variant == "ordinal":
        update = {"signal_schema": "ordinal", "policy": "ordinal"}
    elif variant == "sentiment-first":
        update = {"field_order": "sentiment-first"}
    return ModelSpec.model_validate({**base.model_dump(), **update})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RunSpec:
    """One grid cell: a model asked for one output variant under one prompt version."""

    name: str
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    variant: Variant
    dims: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def model(self) -> str:
        return self.spec.name

    @property
    def endpoint(self) -> Endpoint:
        return VARIANT_ENDPOINT[self.variant]

    def run_config(self, split: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        config: dict[str, Any] = {
            "runner": RUNNER_VERSION,
            "split": split,
            "endpoint": self.endpoint,
            "variant": self.variant,
            "prompt_version": self.prompt.version,
            "max_input_tokens": self.spec.max_input_tokens,
        }
        if self.variant != "decision":
            # Exactly what the client sends, so a change to the fixed decoding options re-keys the cache.
            config["options"] = {**chat_options(self.spec, self.endpoint), **FIXED_OPTIONS}
        if self.variant in ("label", "ordinal"):
            config["top_logprobs"] = TOP_LOGPROBS
            config["score_sign"] = SCORE_SIGN_VERSION
        if self.variant == "sentiment-first":
            config["stop_after_score"] = True
        return config

    def prompt_sha(self) -> str:
        payload: dict[str, Any]
        if self.variant == "decision":
            payload = {
                "state": self.prompt.state(TEXT_SENTINEL),
                "instructions": self.prompt.instructions,
                "criteria": self.prompt.criteria,
            }
        else:
            payload = {
                "messages": self.prompt.messages(TEXT_SENTINEL, self.variant),
                "format": ollama_format(_out_type(self.variant)),
            }
            if self.variant == "label":
                payload["fallback"] = {
                    "messages": self.prompt.messages(TEXT_SENTINEL, "ordinal"),
                    "format": ollama_format(OrdinalOut),
                }
        return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def cache(self, split: str, model_digest: str, root: Path = PREDS_DIR) -> PredCache:
        return PredCache(
            self.model,
            self.run_config(split),
            model_digest=model_digest,
            prompt_sha=self.prompt_sha(),
            root=root,
        )


def _out_type(variant: Variant) -> type[BaseModel]:
    if variant == "label":
        return LabelOut
    if variant == "ordinal":
        return OrdinalOut
    return ANALYZE_MODELS["sentiment-first"]


# --- one call --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _chat_timing(chat: ChatResult) -> Timing:
    timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": chat.wall_ms}
    timing.update({k: float(v) for k, v in asdict(chat.timings).items() if v is not None})
    return timing


def _parsed_label(content: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        return LabelOut.model_validate_json(content).label
    except ValidationError:
        return None


def _label_pred(verdict: Verdict, chat: ChatResult) -> Pred:
    """Records which branch of the serving fallback chain produced the probabilities, if any did."""
    if verdict.policy == "ordinal":
        fallback = "ordinal"
    elif verdict.score is not None:
        fallback = "score-sign"
    else:
        fallback = "none"
    return {
        "kind": "label",
        "label": _parsed_label(chat.content) if fallback == "none" else None,
        "probs": dict(verdict.probabilities) if verdict.probabilities is not None else None,
        "fallback": fallback,
        "score": verdict.score,
    }


async def _score_first(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """Stops at the score: later tokens cannot change it, and closing the stream frees Ollama early."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    stream = analyze_stream(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ScoreClosed):
                return {"kind": "analyze", "score": item.score}, {
                    "wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
                }
    raise SchemaViolation(f"{run.model} finished the stream without a score")


async def call_once(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """One example through the serving adapters; returns raw outputs, never the input."""
    if run.variant == "sentiment-first":
        return await _score_first(client, run, text)
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": raw.wall_ms}
        if raw.input_tokens is not None:
            timing["prompt_tokens"] = float(raw.input_tokens)
        pred: Pred = {
            "kind": "decision",
            "choice": raw.choice,
            "probs": dict(verdict.probabilities or {}),
            "model_confidence": raw.confidence,
        }
        return pred, timing
    if run.variant == "label":
        return _label_pred(verdict, raw), _chat_timing(raw)
    pred = {
        "kind": "ordinal",
        "score": verdict.score,
        "sign_probs": score_sign_probabilities(raw.content, raw.logprobs),
    }
    return pred, _chat_timing(raw)


# --- model residency -------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def model_digest(client: OllamaClient, model: str) -> str:
    for entry in await client.tags():
        if model in (entry.get("name"), entry.get("model")) and isinstance(entry.get("digest"), str):
            return str(entry["digest"])
    raise ModelUnavailable(f"{model} is not installed in Ollama", hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {model}`.")


async def make_resident(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, *, log: TextIO = sys.stderr) -> None:
    """Unload every other model, then warm this one so the first timed call is not a cold load."""
    for entry in await client.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != run.model:
            try:
                await client.unload(name)
            except VtError as exc:
                print(f"warning: could not unload {name}: {exc.message}", file=log)
    await call_once(client, run, WARMUP_TEXT)


# --- cell run --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RunStats:
    key: str
    path: Path
    total: int
    cached: int
    called: int
    errors: int


class Progress:
    """Counts only: neither inputs nor outputs reach the console."""

    def __init__(self, label: str, total: int, cached: int, *, every_s: float, out: TextIO) -> None:
        self.label, self.total, self.cached = label, total, cached
        self.every_s, self.out = every_s, out
        self.called = self.errors = 0
        self._t0 = self._last = time.monotonic()

    def tick(self, *, error: bool) -> None:
        self.called += 1
        self.errors += error
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - self._last >= self.every_s:
            self._last = now
            self.emit()

    def emit(self, final: bool = False) -> None:
        rate = self.called / max(time.monotonic() - self._t0, 1e-9)
        status = "done" if final else "running"
        print(
            f"[{self.label}] {status} {self.cached + self.called}/{self.total} "
            f"(cached {self.cached}, new {self.called}, errors {self.errors}, {rate:.1f}/s)",
            file=self.out,
            flush=True,
        )


def _pred_error(exc: VtError) -> PredError:
    # Greedy seeded decoding repeats a schema failure, so it is final; transport failures retry on resume.
    retryable = not isinstance(exc, SchemaViolation) and (exc.retryable or isinstance(exc, ModelUnavailable))
    return PredError(exc.code.value, exc.message[:300], retryable)


async def _pool(workers: int, job: Callable[[], Coroutine[Any, Any, None]]) -> None:
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(job()) for _ in range(workers)]
    try:
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    finally:
        for task in tasks:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)


async def run_cell(
    client: OllamaClient,
    run: RunSpec,
    examples: Sequence[Example],
    *,
    split: str,
    model_digest: str,
    concurrency: int = DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
    root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    progress_every_s: float = 30.0,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> RunStats:
    """Run every example not yet in the cache; an unreachable Ollama aborts, other failures are recorded."""
    if concurrency < 1:
        raise ValueError("concurrency must be >= 1")
    with run.cache(split, model_digest, root) as cache:
        done = cache.done_ids()
        todo = deque(e for e in examples if e.id not in done)
        cached = len(examples) - len(todo)
        progress = Progress(
            f"{run.endpoint} {run.model} {run.name}", len(examples), cached, every_s=progress_every_s, out=log
        )

        async def worker() -> None:
            while todo:
                example = todo.popleft()
                t0 = time.perf_counter()
                try:
                    pred, timing = await call_once(client, run, example.text)
                except LlmUnreachable as exc:
                    raise RunAborted(f"{run.model} {run.name}: {exc.message}") from exc
                except VtError as exc:
                    wall = {"wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000}
                    cache.append(example.id, example.label, error=_pred_error(exc), t=wall)
                    progress.tick(error=True)
                else:
                    cache.append(example.id, example.label, pred=pred, t=timing)
                    progress.tick(error=False)

        if todo:
            await _pool(min(concurrency, len(todo)), worker)
        progress.emit(final=True)
        return RunStats(cache.key, cache.path, len(examples), cached, progress.called, progress.errors)

```
```
"""Resumable JSONL prediction cache, one file per (run config, model digest, prompt, harness) hash."""

from __future__ import annotations

import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from types import TracebackType
from typing import IO, Any, Self

from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR

# Bump when harness changes alter predictions for an unchanged config, so old caches stop matching.
HARNESS_VERSION = "1"
RESERVED_KEYS = frozenset({"id", "gold", "error", "t"})
# Publisher and dataset licences: a record may describe a prediction, never carry its input.
FORBIDDEN_KEYS = frozenset({"text", "input", "input_text", "prompt", "messages", "article"})


class PredCacheError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def canonical_json(obj: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)


def run_hash(
    run_config: Mapping[str, Any], model_digest: str, prompt_sha: str, harness_version: str = HARNESS_VERSION
) -> str:
    payload = {
        "config": run_config,
        "model_digest": model_digest,
        "prompt_sha": prompt_sha,
        "harness_version": harness_version,
    }
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]


def model_slug(model: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", model)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PredError:
    code: str
    message: str
    retryable: bool


def _terminal(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    error = record.get("error")
    return error is None or not error.get("retryable", False)


class PredCache:
    """Single writer per file (flock); every append is flushed so a killed run resumes from the last line."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str,
        run_config: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        model_digest: str,
        prompt_sha: str,
        root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
        harness_version: str = HARNESS_VERSION,
    ) -> None:
        self.key = run_hash(run_config, model_digest, prompt_sha, harness_version)
        self.sidecar = {
            "key": self.key,
            "model": model,
            "model_digest": model_digest,
            "prompt_sha": prompt_sha,
            "harness_version": harness_version,
            "run_config": json.loads(canonical_json(run_config)),
        }
        directory = root / model_slug(model)
        self.path = directory / f"{self.key}.jsonl"
        self.config_path = directory / f"{self.key}.config.json"
        self._fh: IO[str] | None = None

    def __enter__(self) -> Self:
        return self.open()

    def __exit__(
        self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None
    ) -> None:
        self.close()

    def open(self) -> Self:
        if self._fh is not None:
            return self
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._write_or_check_sidecar()
        fh = self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError as exc:
            fh.close()
            raise PredCacheError(f"{self.path} is already open for writing by another process") from exc
        self._drop_partial_tail()
        self._fh = fh
        return self

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._fh is not None:
            self._fh.close()
            self._fh = None
```

```python
def lp(token: str, p: float, alternatives: Sequence[tuple[str, float]] = ()) -> dict[str, Any]:
    top = [{"token": t, "logprob": math.log(q)} for t, q in alternatives]
    return {"token": token, "logprob": math.log(p), "top_logprobs": top}


def plain(tokens: Sequence[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [lp(t, 0.99, [(t, 0.99)]) for t in tokens]


def chat_body(content: str, logprobs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": "m",
        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": content},
        "done": True,
        "done_reason": "stop",
        "total_duration": 120_000_000,
        "load_duration": 1_000_000,
        "prompt_eval_count": 300,
        "prompt_eval_duration": 80_000_000,
        "eval_count": 7,
        "eval_duration": 40_000_000,
    }
    if logprobs is not None:
        body["logprobs"] = logprobs
    return body


def label_logprobs(first: str, alternatives: Sequence[tuple[str, float]], rest: Sequence[str]) -> list[Any]:
    return [*plain(['{"', "label", '":', ' "']), lp(first, alternatives[0][1], alternatives), *plain(rest)]


def decision_body(probs: dict[Sentiment, float], choice: Sentiment = "bullish") -> dict[str, Any]:
    answer = {"type": "choice", "choice": choice, "probabilities": probs, "confidence": 0.5}
    return {"model": DECISION, "answers": {"sentiment": answer}, "usage": {"input_tokens": 210}}


def ndjson(pieces: Sequence[str], *, hang_after: int | None = None) -> httpx.Response:
    chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        {"model": "m", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": p}, "done": False} for p in pieces
    ]
    chunks.append(chat_body("") | {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": ""}})

    async def lines() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
            if i == hang_after:
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
            yield (json.dumps(chunk) + "\n").encode()

    return httpx.Response(200, content=lines(), headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})


# --- raw outputs per model kind --------------------------------------------------------------


async def test_decision_keeps_normalised_probabilities(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    mock_ollama.post("/v1/systemone").respond(
        json=decision_body({"neutral": 0.2, "bullish": 0.6, "bearish": 0.2}, choice="bullish")
    )
    pred, t = await call_once(client, cell(DECISION, "decision"), "Zentor Mills beats estimates")
    assert pred["kind"] == "decision"
    assert pred["choice"] == "bullish"
    assert pred["probs"] == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.2, "bullish": 0.6, "bearish": 0.2})
    assert pred["model_confidence"] == 0.5
    assert t["prompt_tokens"] == 210
    assert t["wall_ms"] > 0


async def test_label_keeps_first_token_probabilities_and_ollama_timings(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    logprobs = label_logprobs("bull", [("bull", 0.6), ("neutral", 0.3), ("bear", 0.1)], ["ish", '"}'])
    route = mock_ollama.post("/api/chat").respond(json=chat_body('{"label": "bullish"}', logprobs))
    pred, t = await call_once(client, cell(SMALL, "label"), "Zentor Mills beats estimates")
    assert route.call_count == 1
    assert pred["kind"] == "label"
    assert (pred["label"], pred["fallback"], pred["score"]) == ("bullish", "none", None)
    assert pred["probs"] == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.3, "bullish": 0.6, "bearish": 0.1})
    assert t["total_ms"] == pytest.approx(120.0)
    assert (t["prompt_tokens"], t["eval_tokens"]) == (300, 7)


async def test_label_collision_records_the_score_sign_fallback(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    colliding = label_logprobs("b", [("b", 0.9), ("neutral", 0.1)], ["ullish", '"}'])
    sign = [
        *plain(['{"', "score", '":', " "]),
        lp("1", 0.7, [("1", 0.7), ("0", 0.2), ("-", 0.1)]),
        *plain(["}"]),
    ]
    mock_ollama.post("/api/chat").mock(
        side_effect=[
            httpx.Response(200, json=chat_body('{"label": "bullish"}', colliding)),
            httpx.Response(200, json=chat_body('{"score": 1}', sign)),
        ]
    )
    pred, t = await call_once(client, cell(SMALL, "label"), "Zentor Mills beats estimates")
    assert (pred["fallback"], pred["label"], pred["score"]) == ("score-sign", None, 1)
    assert pred["probs"] == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.2, "bullish": 0.7, "bearish": 0.1})
    assert t["eval_tokens"] == 14


async def test_label_without_logprobs_ends_at_the_ordinal_fallback(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    mock_ollama.post("/api/chat").mock(
        side_effect=[
            httpx.Response(200, json=chat_body('{"label": "bearish"}')),
            httpx.Response(200, json=chat_body('{"score": -2}')),
        ]
    )
    pred, _ = await call_once(client, cell(SMALL, "label"), "Orvane Bank posts a loss")
    assert (pred["fallback"], pred["probs"], pred["score"]) == ("ordinal", None, -2)


async def test_ordinal_keeps_score_and_sign_probabilities(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    sign = [*plain(['{"', "score", '":', " "]), lp("-", 0.8, [("-", 0.8), ("0", 0.2)]), *plain(["1", "}"])]
    route = mock_ollama.post("/api/chat").respond(json=chat_body('{"score": -1}', sign))
    pred, _ = await call_once(client, cell(SMALL, "ordinal"), "Orvane Bank posts a loss")
    assert json.loads(route.calls[0].request.content)["format"]["properties"] == {
        "score": {"enum": [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2], "type": "integer"}
    }
    assert (pred["kind"], pred["score"]) == ("ordinal", -1)
    assert pred["sign_probs"] == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.2, "bullish": 0.0, "bearish": 0.8})


async def test_sentiment_first_stops_reading_once_the_score_closes(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    pieces = ['{"score": ', "-1", ', "entity": "Orvane Bank", ', '"summary": "Never read."}']
    route = mock_ollama.post("/api/chat").mock(side_effect=lambda request: ndjson(pieces, hang_after=2))
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    pred, t = await call_once(client, cell(COMBINED, "sentiment-first"), "Orvane Bank posts a loss")
    # The upstream stalls for 5 s after the score; only an early stop returns well before that.
    assert time.perf_counter() - t0 < 2.0
    assert pred == {"kind": "analyze", "score": -1}
    assert set(t) == {"wall_ms"}
    sent = json.loads(route.calls[0].request.content)
    assert sent["stream"] is True
    assert list(sent["format"]["properties"]) == ["score", "entity", "summary"]


# --- cell runs -------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def test_resume_makes_no_repeat_calls_and_stores_no_text(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    route = mock_ollama.post("/v1/systemone").respond(
        json=decision_body({"neutral": 0.1, "bullish": 0.8, "bearish": 0.1})
    )
    run = cell(DECISION, "decision")
    first = await run_cell(client, run, EXAMPLES[:2], split="dev300", model_digest=DIGEST, root=tmp_path)
    assert (first.called, first.cached, route.call_count) == (2, 0, 2)

    again = await run_cell(client, run, EXAMPLES[:2], split="dev300", model_digest=DIGEST, root=tmp_path)
    assert (again.called, again.cached, route.call_count) == (0, 2, 2)
    assert again.key == first.key

    grown = await run_cell(client, run, EXAMPLES, split="dev300", model_digest=DIGEST, root=tmp_path)
    assert (grown.called, grown.cached, route.call_count) == (1, 2, 3)

    stored = first.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert all(e.text not in stored for e in EXAMPLES)
    assert [json.loads(line)["id"] for line in stored.splitlines()] == ["x:0", "x:1", "x:2"]


async def test_cache_key_follows_digest_and_prompt(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    mock_ollama.post("/v1/systemone").respond(
        json=decision_body({"neutral": 0.5, "bullish": 0.3, "bearish": 0.2})
    )
    kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {"split": "dev300", "root": tmp_path}
    a = await run_cell(client, cell(DECISION, "decision"), EXAMPLES[:1], model_digest=DIGEST, **kwargs)
    b = await run_cell(client, cell(DECISION, "decision"), EXAMPLES[:1], model_digest="f" * 64, **kwargs)
    c = await run_cell(client, cell(DECISION, "decision", "v2"), EXAMPLES[:1], model_digest=DIGEST, **kwargs)
    assert len({a.key, b.key, c.key}) == 3
    assert b.called == c.called == 1


async def test_failures_are_recorded_and_only_transient_ones_rerun(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    ok = decision_body({"neutral": 0.1, "bullish": 0.8, "bearish": 0.1})
    route = mock_ollama.post("/v1/systemone").mock(
        side_effect=[
            httpx.Response(200, json=ok),
            httpx.Response(500, json={"error": "runner crashed"}),
            httpx.Response(200, json={"model": DECISION, "answers": {}}),
        ]
    )
    run = cell(DECISION, "decision")
    stats = await run_cell(
        client, run, EXAMPLES, split="dev300", model_digest=DIGEST, root=tmp_path, concurrency=1
    )
    assert (stats.called, stats.errors) == (3, 2)
    records = run.cache("dev300", DIGEST, tmp_path).records()
    assert records["x:1"]["error"]["code"] == "model_unavailable"
    assert records["x:1"]["error"]["retryable"] is True
    assert records["x:2"]["error"]["code"] == "schema_violation"
    assert records["x:2"]["error"]["retryable"] is False

    route.side_effect = None
    route.return_value = httpx.Response(200, json=ok)
    resumed = await run_cell(client, run, EXAMPLES, split="dev300", model_digest=DIGEST, root=tmp_path)
    assert (resumed.cached, resumed.called, route.call_count) == (2, 1, 4)


async def test_unreachable_ollama_aborts_the_run(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    mock_ollama.post("/v1/systemone").mock(side_effect=httpx.ConnectError("refused"))
    run = cell(DECISION, "decision")
    with pytest.raises(RunAborted):
        await run_cell(client, run, EXAMPLES, split="dev300", model_digest=DIGEST, root=tmp_path)
    assert run.cache("dev300", DIGEST, tmp_path).records() == {}


async def test_concurrency_is_bounded(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    in_flight = peak = 0

    async def slow(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        nonlocal in_flight, peak
        in_flight += 1
        peak = max(peak, in_flight)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        in_flight -= 1
        return httpx.Response(200, json=decision_body({"neutral": 0.4, "bullish": 0.3, "bearish": 0.3}))

    mock_ollama.post("/v1/systemone").mock(side_effect=slow)
    many = [Example(f"x:{i}", f"headline {i}", "neutral", "tfns", "train") for i in range(9)]
    stats = await run_cell(
        client,
        cell(DECISION, "decision"),
        many,
        split="dev300",
        model_digest=DIGEST,
        root=tmp_path,
        concurrency=3,
    )
    assert stats.called == 9
    assert peak == 3
```

```
"""Lean prompt x knob grid on dev300: `uv run python -m veritrade_evals.grid {list,run,analyze}`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import itertools
import json
import sys
from collections.abc import Collection, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, TextIO

from veritrade.config import get_settings
from veritrade.inference.ollama import FIXED_OPTIONS, OllamaClient
from veritrade.models_registry import allowlist
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry
from veritrade_evals.analysis import (
    CellInput,
    DevSet,
    best_candidate,
    best_report,
    bucket_of,
    candidates,
    counts,
    diagnostics,
    directional_mass_report,
    error_patterns,
    knob_comparison,
    latency,
    policy_report,
    render_summary,
    rounded,
    served_calls,
)
from veritrade_evals.datasets import Example
from veritrade_evals.metrics import INVERSION_CAP
from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR, RESULTS_DIR
from veritrade_evals.predcache import canonical_json, model_slug
from veritrade_evals.runner import (
    DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
    RunSpec,
    Variant,
    make_resident,
    model_digest,
    run_cell,
    serving_spec,
)
from veritrade_evals.splits import HOLDOUT_SPLITS, Split, SplitName, load_split, read_split_file

GRID_SPLIT: SplitName = "dev300"
if GRID_SPLIT in HOLDOUT_SPLITS:
    raise RuntimeError("the grid tunes prompts and thresholds, so it must never read a holdout split")

GRID_DIR = RESULTS_DIR / "grid"
MANIFEST = GRID_DIR / "manifest.json"
NOTES = GRID_DIR / "notes.md"
VERSIONS = ("v1", "v2", "v3", "v4")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ModelPlan:
    model: str
    variants: tuple[Variant, ...]


# Execution order: the fast baseline first so a broken pipeline shows up in minutes.
PLAN: tuple[ModelPlan, ...] = (
    ModelPlan("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", ("label", "ordinal")),
    ModelPlan("clef-flash:9b-q8_0", ("decision",)),
    ModelPlan("nimble:9b-q4_K_M", ("decision",)),
    ModelPlan("ministral-3:3b", ("sentiment-first",)),
    ModelPlan("qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M", ("sentiment-first",)),
    ModelPlan("qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M", ("sentiment-first",)),
)
EXCLUDED = {
    "tev1:0.8b-q8_0": "CI plumbing model, not evaluated",
    "qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M": "holdout-only quality ceiling",
}
# What each prompt version varies; test_grid checks these labels against the prompt files.
DIMS: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, str]]] = {
    "decision": {
        "v1": {"instructions": "rubric", "criteria": "described"},
        "v2": {"instructions": "rubric", "criteria": "bare"},
        "v3": {"instructions": "plain", "criteria": "described"},
        "v4": {"instructions": "plain", "criteria": "bare"},
    },
    "generative": {
        "v1": {"rubric": "A", "shots": "0"},
        "v2": {"rubric": "A", "shots": "4"},
        "v3": {"rubric": "B", "shots": "0"},
        "v4": {"rubric": "B", "shots": "4"},
    },
}


def cell_name(version: str, variant: Variant) -> str:
    return f"{version}-{variant}" if variant in ("label", "ordinal") else version


def cell_key(cell: RunSpec) -> str:
    return f"{cell.endpoint}/{cell.model}/{cell.name}"


def grid_cells(models: Collection[str] = (), registry: PromptRegistry | None = None) -> list[RunSpec]:
    registry = registry or PromptRegistry()
    roster = allowlist()
    unknown = set(models) - {p.model for p in PLAN}
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"not in the grid: {sorted(unknown)}")
    cells: list[RunSpec] = []
    for plan in PLAN:
        if models and plan.model not in models:
            continue
        base = roster[plan.model]
        for variant in plan.variants:
            spec = serving_spec(base, variant)
            for version in VERSIONS:
                cell = RunSpec(
                    cell_name(version, variant),
                    spec,
                    registry.get(
                        "analyze" if variant == "sentiment-first" else "signal",
                        plan.model,
                        kind=base.kind,
                        version=version,
                    ),
                    variant,
                    DIMS[base.kind][version],
                )
                cells.append(cell)
    return cells


# --- manifest --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def read_manifest(path: Path = MANIFEST) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not path.exists():
        return {"split": GRID_SPLIT, "cells": {}}
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return payload


def write_manifest(manifest: dict[str, Any], path: Path = MANIFEST) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest["cells"] = dict(sorted(manifest["cells"].items()))
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    tmp.replace(path)


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


# --- run -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def run_grid(
    client: OllamaClient,
    cells: Sequence[RunSpec],
    examples: Sequence[Example],
    *,
    concurrency: int,
    preds_root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    manifest_path: Path = MANIFEST,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Model by model with only that model resident; the manifest is rewritten after every cell."""
    manifest = read_manifest(manifest_path)
    manifest["split"] = GRID_SPLIT
    manifest["ollama_version"] = await client.version()
    manifest["backend"] = get_settings().ollama_backend_label
    ids = {e.id for e in examples}
    for model, group in itertools.groupby(cells, key=lambda c: c.model):
        model_cells = list(group)
        digest = await model_digest(client, model)
```

```
# --- analyze ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def dev_set(split: Split) -> DevSet:
    weights = split.example_weights()
    return DevSet(
        ids=tuple(e.id for e in split.examples),
        gold=tuple(e.label for e in split.examples),
        weights=None if weights is None else tuple(weights),
        buckets=tuple(bucket_of(e.text) for e in split.examples),
    )


def cell_inputs(
    cells: Sequence[RunSpec], manifest: dict[str, Any], dev: DevSet, preds_root: Path, log: TextIO
) -> list[CellInput]:
    """Cached records per cell, aligned to the split; skips cells not run yet or run under other prompts."""
    out: list[CellInput] = []
    for cell in cells:
        entry = manifest.get("cells", {}).get(cell_key(cell))
        if entry is None:
            print(f"skip {cell_key(cell)}: not run yet", file=log)
            continue
        current = json.loads(canonical_json(cell.run_config(GRID_SPLIT)))
        if entry["prompt_sha"] != cell.prompt_sha() or entry["run_config"] != current:
            print(f"skip {cell_key(cell)}: prompt or config changed since the run; re-run it", file=log)
            continue
        records = cell.cache(GRID_SPLIT, entry["model_digest"], preds_root).records()
        aligned = tuple(records.get(i) for i in dev.ids)
        missing = sum(r is None for r in aligned)
        if missing:
            print(f"warning {cell_key(cell)}: {missing} examples missing, scored as abstentions", file=log)
        out.append(
            CellInput(
                endpoint=cell.endpoint,
                model=cell.model,
                name=cell.name,
                variant=cell.variant,
                prompt_version=cell.prompt.version,
                records=aligned,
                dims=dict(cell.dims),
                ordinal_t=cell.spec.ordinal_t,
                meta={"cache_key": entry["cache_key"], "model_digest": entry["model_digest"]},
            )
        )
    return out


def model_report(inputs: Sequence[CellInput], dev: DevSet, class_weights: Any, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cands = candidates(inputs, dev)
    first = inputs[0]
    configs = []
    for cell in inputs:
        own = [c for c in cands if c.cell is cell]
        configs.append(
            {
                "name": cell.name,
                "variant": cell.variant,
                "prompt_version": cell.prompt_version,
                "dims": dict(cell.dims),
                "cache_key": cell.meta.get("cache_key"),
                "counts": counts(cell.records),
                "diagnostics": diagnostics(cell),
                "latency": latency(cell.records),
                "policies": {c.evaluation.policy: policy_report(c.evaluation) for c in own},
            }
        )
    report: dict[str, Any] = {
        "endpoint": first.endpoint,
        "model": first.model,
        "model_digest": first.meta.get("model_digest"),
        "split": GRID_SPLIT,
        "n": len(dev.ids),
        "class_weights": class_weights,
        "inversion_cap": INVERSION_CAP,
        "generated_by": "uv run python -m veritrade_evals.grid analyze",
        "configs": configs,
        "best": best_report(cands, dev, n_boot),
    }
    knob = knob_comparison(cands, dev, n_boot) if first.variant in ("label", "ordinal") else None
    if knob is not None:
        report["knob_comparison"] = knob
    mass = directional_mass_report(inputs, cands, dev, n_boot)
    if mass is not None:
        report["directional_mass"] = mass
    return report


def analyze_grid(
    *,
    n_boot: int = 1000,
    preds_root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    manifest_path: Path = MANIFEST,
    out_dir: Path = GRID_DIR,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> list[Path]:
    split = load_split(GRID_SPLIT)
    payload = read_split_file(GRID_SPLIT)
    manifest = read_manifest(manifest_path)
    dev = dev_set(split)
    inputs = cell_inputs(grid_cells(), manifest, dev, preds_root, log)
    groups = [list(g) for _, g in itertools.groupby(inputs, key=lambda c: (c.endpoint, c.model))]
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    written: list[Path] = []
    reports: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    served = []
    for group in groups:
        report = rounded(model_report(group, dev, payload["class_weights"], n_boot))
        reports.append(report)
        served.append(served_calls(*best_candidate(candidates(group, dev))))
        path = out_dir / f"{report['endpoint']}__{model_slug(report['model'])}.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        written.append(path)
    if not reports:
        print("nothing to analyze: run the grid first", file=log)
        return written
    patterns = error_patterns(served, dev)
    concurrency = sorted({e.get("concurrency") for e in manifest["cells"].values()} - {None})
    header = {
        "n": len(dev.ids),
        "train_prior": payload["train_prior"],
        "n_boot": n_boot,
        "ollama_version": manifest.get("ollama_version", "?"),
        "backend": manifest.get("backend", "?"),
        "concurrency": ", ".join(str(c) for c in concurrency) or "?",
        "decoding": ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in FIXED_OPTIONS.items()),
    }
    notes = NOTES.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if out_dir == GRID_DIR and NOTES.exists() else None
    summary = out_dir / "summary.md"
    summary.write_text(render_summary(reports, patterns, header=header, notes=notes), encoding="utf-8")
    patterns_path = out_dir / "error_patterns.json"
    patterns_path.write_text(json.dumps(rounded(patterns), indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return [*written, summary, patterns_path]


# --- CLI -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def cmd_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    cells = grid_cells(args.model or ())
    for cell in cells:
        dims = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in cell.dims.items())
        print(f"{cell_key(cell):55s} {cell.prompt.version:45s} {dims}")
    per_model = {m: sum(c.model == m for c in cells) for m in dict.fromkeys(c.model for c in cells)}
    print(f"{len(cells)} configs: " + ", ".join(f"{m}={n}" for m, n in per_model.items()))
    print("excluded: " + "; ".join(f"{m} ({why})" for m, why in EXCLUDED.items()))
    return 0


async def _run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    cells = grid_cells(args.model or ())
    examples = list(load_split(GRID_SPLIT).examples)
    if args.limit:
        examples = examples[: args.limit]
    settings = get_settings()
    client = OllamaClient(
        args.base_url or settings.ollama_base_url,
        timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,
        keep_alive=settings.ollama_keep_alive,
    )
    async with client:
        manifest = await run_grid(
            client,
            cells,
            examples,
            concurrency=args.concurrency,
            preds_root=args.preds_root,
            manifest_path=args.manifest,
        )
    done = sum(e["done"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    errors = sum(e["errors"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    print(
        f"grid: {len(manifest['cells'])} cells in the manifest, {done} predictions, {errors} errors",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )
    return 0


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    return asyncio.run(_run(args))


def cmd_analyze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = analyze_grid(
        n_boot=args.n_boot, preds_root=args.preds_root, manifest_path=args.manifest, out_dir=args.out_dir
    )
    for path in paths:
        print(path)
    return 0 if paths else 1


def add_parser(subparsers: Any) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Registers `grid` on a parent CLI; dispatch with `run(args)`."""
    grid: argparse.ArgumentParser = subparsers.add_parser("grid", help="lean prompt x knob grid on dev300")
    actions = grid.add_subparsers(dest="grid_action", required=True)

    listing = actions.add_parser("list", help="print the grid configs")
    listing.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    listing.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_list)

    running = actions.add_parser("run", help="run (or resume) the grid against Ollama")
    running.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    running.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY)
    running.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="first N dev300 examples only (smoke runs)")
    running.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="Ollama URL (default from settings)")
    running.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    running.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    running.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_run)

    analyzing = actions.add_parser("analyze", help="score cached predictions and write evals/results/grid")
    analyzing.add_argument("--n-boot", type=int, default=1000)
    analyzing.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    analyzing.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    analyzing.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=GRID_DIR)
    analyzing.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_analyze)
    return grid


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    code: int = args.grid_func(args)
    return code


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals.grid", description=__doc__)
    add_parser(parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    return run(parser.parse_args(["grid", *(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```
"""Offline grid analysis: replay each serving policy on cached raw outputs, sweep its threshold, pick the
operating point under the inversion cap, then compare configs, knobs and models. Counts only, no text."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import Any, Literal, cast

import numpy as np

from veritrade.inference.confidence import normalise, winner
from veritrade.inference.schemas import score_sentiment
from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.metrics import (
    DIRECTIONAL,
    INVERSION_CAP,
    ConfidenceInterval,
    IndexArray,
    SignalMetrics,
    SweepPoint,
    bootstrap_cis,
    headline_cis,
    risk_coverage_sweep,
    select_operating_point,
    signal_metrics,
)
from veritrade_evals.runner import Variant

PolicyName = Literal["probability", "label-logprob", "ordinal"]
Record = Mapping[str, Any]

# Round min_p values to freeze; finer near 1 because decision models are often very peaked.
PROB_THRESHOLDS: tuple[float, ...] = (
    0.0,
    *(round(0.34 + 0.01 * i, 2) for i in range(66)),
    *(round(0.991 + 0.001 * i, 3) for i in range(9)),
    0.9995,
    0.9999,
)
ORDINAL_THRESHOLDS: tuple[float, ...] = (1.0, 2.0)
# A directional class can win a call with far less than 1/3 of the mass, so the grid starts near 0.
MASS_THRESHOLDS: tuple[float, ...] = tuple(
    sorted({round(0.02 * i, 2) for i in range(1, 17)} | set(PROB_THRESHOLDS[1:]))
)
# Score-sign probabilities stay out of the knobs: the qwen tokenizer fuses " -" into one token, so the
# first value token misses the sign decision (records keep them as raw `sign_probs`).
POLICIES: dict[Variant, tuple[PolicyName, ...]] = {
    "decision": ("probability",),
    "label": ("label-logprob",),
    "ordinal": ("ordinal",),
    "sentiment-first": ("ordinal",),
}

# Keyword heuristics for error analysis; the first match wins and nothing but the bucket name leaves.
BUCKETS: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = (
    (
        "analyst action",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(upgrade\w*|downgrade\w*|price target|target price|pt|initiat\w*|reiterat\w*|outperform|"
            r"underperform|overweight|underweight|equal[- ]weight|market perform|sector perform|"
            r"buy rating|sell rating|hold rating|rating)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "earnings / guidance",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(earnings|eps|revenue|revenues|sales|results|quarter\w*|q[1-4]|fy\d*|guidance|forecasts?|"
            r"outlook|profits?|loss(es)?|beats?|miss(es)?|dividend\w*)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "price move",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(ris(e|es|ing)|rose|jump\w*|surg\w*|soar\w*|rall\w*|gain\w*|climb\w*|fall(s|ing)?|fell|"
            r"drop\w*|slump\w*|sink\w*|sank|slid\w*|tumbl\w*|plung\w*|higher|lower|up|down)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "macro / markets",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(fed|inflation|rates?|treasur\w*|yields?|gdp|jobs|payrolls|unemployment|oil|dollar|"
            r"econom\w*|recession|cpi|ecb|tariffs?|stocks|markets?|futures|dow|nasdaq|s&p)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
)
OTHER_BUCKET = "other"
BUCKET_NAMES: tuple[str, ...] = (*(name for name, _ in BUCKETS), OTHER_BUCKET)


def bucket_of(text: str) -> str:
    for name, pattern in BUCKETS:
        if pattern.search(text):
            return name
    return OTHER_BUCKET


# --- policy replay ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _ordinal(score: int) -> tuple[Sentiment, float]:
    # A zero score is a confident neutral, never an abstention.
    label = score_sentiment(score)
    return label, math.inf if label == "neutral" else float(abs(score))


def replay(policy: PolicyName, record: Record | None, *, ordinal_t: int = 1) -> tuple[Sentiment, float]:
    """(raw class, confidence) as the serving policy sees one cached output; the row abstains when the
    confidence is below the threshold, so failed or missing calls (-inf) always abstain."""
    if record is None or record.get("error") is not None:
        return "neutral", -math.inf
    if policy == "ordinal":
        return _ordinal(int(record["score"]))
    probs = record.get("sign_probs") if record.get("kind") == "ordinal" else record.get("probs")
    if probs:
        p = normalise(cast(Mapping[Sentiment, float], probs))
        top = winner(p)
        return top, p[top]
    if policy == "probability" or record.get("score") is None:
        raise ValueError(f"record {record.get('id')!r} has no probabilities for {policy}")
    # Serving ends the fallback chain at the ordinal policy with the model's frozen t.
    label, confidence = _ordinal(int(record["score"]))
    return label, math.inf if confidence >= ordinal_t else -math.inf


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PolicyEval:
    policy: PolicyName | Literal["directional-mass"]
    labels: tuple[Sentiment, ...]
    confidences: tuple[float, ...]
    sweep: tuple[SweepPoint, ...]

    @property
```
