    @property
    def default(self) -> SweepPoint:
        return self.sweep[0]

    @property
    def operating(self) -> SweepPoint | None:
        return select_operating_point(self.sweep)

    def abstained(self, threshold: float) -> list[bool]:
        return [not c >= threshold for c in self.confidences]


def evaluate_policy(
    policy: PolicyName,
    records: Sequence[Record | None],
    gold: Sequence[Sentiment],
    weights: Sequence[float] | None,
    *,
    ordinal_t: int = 1,
) -> PolicyEval:
    calls = [replay(policy, r, ordinal_t=ordinal_t) for r in records]
    labels = tuple(label for label, _ in calls)
    confidences = tuple(c for _, c in calls)
    thresholds = ORDINAL_THRESHOLDS if policy == "ordinal" else PROB_THRESHOLDS
    sweep = risk_coverage_sweep(gold, labels, confidences, thresholds, weights)
    return PolicyEval(policy, labels, confidences, tuple(sweep))


# --- cells and candidates --------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DevSet:
    """Gold side of the split, aligned by position; buckets are keyword classes, never text."""

    ids: tuple[str, ...]
    gold: tuple[Sentiment, ...]
    weights: tuple[float, ...] | None
    buckets: tuple[str, ...] = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CellInput:
    endpoint: str
    model: str
    name: str
    variant: Variant
    prompt_version: str
    records: tuple[Record | None, ...]
    dims: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    ordinal_t: int = 1
    meta: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Candidate:
    cell: CellInput
    evaluation: PolicyEval
    order: int

    @property
    def reads(self) -> str:
        """What the threshold is applied to."""
        if self.evaluation.policy == "ordinal":
            return "score value"
        if self.cell.variant == "decision":
            return "class probabilities"
        return "label tokens" if self.cell.variant == "label" else "score-sign tokens"


def candidates(cells: Sequence[CellInput], dev: DevSet) -> list[Candidate]:
    out: list[Candidate] = []
    for cell in cells:
        for policy in POLICIES[cell.variant]:
            evaluation = evaluate_policy(
                policy, cell.records, dev.gold, dev.weights, ordinal_t=cell.ordinal_t
            )
            out.append(Candidate(cell, evaluation, len(out)))
    return out


def best_candidate(cands: Sequence[Candidate]) -> tuple[Candidate, bool]:
    """Max F0.5 at each candidate's operating point; earlier (simpler) configs win exact ties. When no
    candidate meets the inversion cap, falls back to the best no-abstention F0.5 and says so."""
    if not cands:
        raise ValueError("no candidates")
    eligible = [(c, op) for c in cands if (op := c.evaluation.operating) is not None]
    if eligible:
        best, _ = max(
            eligible, key=lambda co: (round(co[1].f05_macro, 12), round(co[1].coverage, 12), -co[0].order)
        )
        return best, True
    return max(cands, key=lambda c: (round(c.evaluation.default.f05_macro, 12), -c.order)), False


def chosen_point(candidate: Candidate, cap_met: bool) -> SweepPoint:
    op = candidate.evaluation.operating
    return op if cap_met and op is not None else candidate.evaluation.default


# --- summaries -------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def point_row(point: SweepPoint) -> dict[str, float]:
    m = point.metrics
    return {
        "threshold": point.threshold,
        "f05_macro": m.f05_macro,
        "precision_bullish": m.per_class["bullish"].precision,
        "precision_bearish": m.per_class["bearish"].precision,
        "recall_bullish": m.per_class["bullish"].recall,
        "recall_bearish": m.per_class["bearish"].recall,
        "inversion_rate": m.inversion_rate,
        "coverage": m.coverage,
        "signal_rate": m.signal_rate,
        "risk": point.risk,
    }


def thin_sweep(sweep: Sequence[SweepPoint]) -> list[dict[str, float]]:
    """Drops points whose metrics equal the previous point's, keeping the lowest threshold of each run."""
    rows: list[dict[str, float]] = []
    previous: dict[str, float] | None = None
    for point in sweep:
        row = point_row(point)
        body = {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "threshold"}
        if body != previous:
            rows.append(row)
        previous = body
    return rows


def metrics_dict(metrics: SignalMetrics) -> dict[str, Any]:
    out = metrics.to_dict()
    out["confusion"] = {
        "rows_gold": ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral"],
        "columns_pred": ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral", "abstain"],
        "counts": [list(row) for row in metrics.confusion],
    }
    return out


def percentile(values: Sequence[float], q: float) -> float | None:
    return float(np.percentile(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64), q)) if values else None


def latency(records: Sequence[Record | None]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ok = [r for r in records if r is not None and r.get("error") is None]
    wall = [float(r["t"]["wall_ms"]) for r in ok if "wall_ms" in r.get("t", {})]
    server = [float(r["t"]["total_ms"]) for r in ok if "total_ms" in r.get("t", {})]
    return {
        "n": len(wall),
        "wall_ms_p50": percentile(wall, 50),
        "wall_ms_p95": percentile(wall, 95),
        "server_ms_p50": percentile(server, 50),
    }


def counts(records: Sequence[Record | None]) -> dict[str, int]:
    present = [r for r in records if r is not None]
    errors = Counter(str(r["error"]["code"]) for r in present if r.get("error") is not None)
    return {
        "n": len(records),
        "done": len(present),
        "missing": len(records) - len(present),
        "errors": sum(errors.values()),
        **{f"error_{code}": n for code, n in sorted(errors.items())},
    }


def diagnostics(cell: CellInput) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Counts that explain a cell's behaviour: fallbacks, argmax disagreements, score histogram."""
    ok = [r for r in cell.records if r is not None and r.get("error") is None]
    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if cell.variant == "label":
        out["fallback"] = dict(sorted(Counter(str(r["fallback"]) for r in ok).items()))
        out["generated_label_not_argmax"] = sum(
            1
            for r in ok
            if r.get("probs") and r.get("label") and r["label"] != winner(normalise(cast(Any, r["probs"])))
        )
    if cell.variant == "decision":
        out["choice_not_argmax"] = sum(
            1 for r in ok if r["choice"] != winner(normalise(cast(Any, r["probs"])))
        )
    if cell.variant in ("ordinal", "sentiment-first"):
        hist = Counter(int(r["score"]) for r in ok)
        out["score_histogram"] = {str(s): hist.get(s, 0) for s in (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)}
    if cell.variant == "ordinal":
        out["no_sign_probs"] = sum(1 for r in ok if not r.get("sign_probs"))
    return out


def policy_report(evaluation: PolicyEval) -> dict[str, Any]:
    op = evaluation.operating
    return {
        "default": {
            "threshold": evaluation.default.threshold,
            "metrics": metrics_dict(evaluation.default.metrics),
        },
        "operating_point": None
        if op is None
        else {"threshold": op.threshold, "metrics": metrics_dict(op.metrics)},
        "sweep": thin_sweep(evaluation.sweep),
    }


def ci_dict(cis: Mapping[str, ConfidenceInterval]) -> dict[str, dict[str, float]]:
    return {k: {"point": v.point, "low": v.low, "high": v.high} for k, v in cis.items()}


def candidate_cis(candidate: Candidate, point: SweepPoint, dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    abstained = candidate.evaluation.abstained(point.threshold)
    return ci_dict(headline_cis(dev.gold, candidate.evaluation.labels, abstained, dev.weights, n_boot=n_boot))


def best_report(cands: Sequence[Candidate], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    best, cap_met = best_candidate(cands)
    point = chosen_point(best, cap_met)
    return {
        "config": best.cell.name,
        "variant": best.cell.variant,
        "policy": best.evaluation.policy,
        "prompt_version": best.cell.prompt_version,
        "threshold": point.threshold,
        "inversion_cap_met": cap_met,
        "metrics": metrics_dict(point.metrics),
        "cis": candidate_cis(best, point, dev, n_boot),
        "latency": latency(best.cell.records),
    }


# --- knob comparison -------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _knob(c: Candidate) -> str:
    return "ordinal" if c.evaluation.policy == "ordinal" else "logprob"


def paired_f05(
    a: tuple[Candidate, SweepPoint], b: tuple[Candidate, SweepPoint], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int
) -> dict[str, ConfidenceInterval]:
    """F0.5 of a, of b and of a - b on shared resamples, so example difficulty cancels in the gap."""
    g = np.asarray(dev.gold, dtype=np.str_)
    w = None if dev.weights is None else np.asarray(dev.weights, dtype=np.float64)
    served = [
        (np.asarray(c.evaluation.labels, dtype=np.str_), np.asarray(c.evaluation.abstained(p.threshold)))
        for c, p in (a, b)
    ]

    def f05(k: int, idx: IndexArray) -> float:
        pred, abstained = served[k]
        weights = None if w is None else w[idx].tolist()
        return signal_metrics(g[idx].tolist(), pred[idx].tolist(), abstained[idx].tolist(), weights).f05_macro

    def fn(idx: IndexArray) -> dict[str, float]:
        fa, fb = f05(0, idx), f05(1, idx)
        return {"a": fa, "b": fb, "gap": fa - fb}

    return bootstrap_cis(fn, dev.gold, n_boot=n_boot)


def _verdict(gap: ConfidenceInterval, a: str, b: str) -> str:
    return a if gap.low > 0 else b if gap.high < 0 else "tie"


def knob_comparison(cands: Sequence[Candidate], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Best logprob-threshold candidate vs best ordinal candidate, with a paired bootstrap on the gap."""
    by_knob = {k: [c for c in cands if _knob(c) == k] for k in ("logprob", "ordinal")}
    if not all(by_knob.values()):
        return None
    picks = {k: best_candidate(v) for k, v in by_knob.items()}
    points = {k: chosen_point(c, ok) for k, (c, ok) in picks.items()}
    paired = paired_f05(
        (picks["logprob"][0], points["logprob"]), (picks["ordinal"][0], points["ordinal"]), dev, n_boot
    )
    cis = {"logprob": paired["a"], "ordinal": paired["b"], "delta_logprob_minus_ordinal": paired["gap"]}
    verdict = _verdict(paired["gap"], "logprob", "ordinal")
    return {
        "knobs": {
            k: {
                "config": c.cell.name,
                "policy": c.evaluation.policy,
                "reads": c.reads,
                "inversion_cap_met": ok,
                **point_row(points[k]),
            }
            for k, (c, ok) in picks.items()
        },
        "paired_bootstrap": ci_dict(cis),
        "verdict": verdict,
    }


# --- informational: directional-mass threshold ------------------------------------------------


def directional_mass(record: Record | None) -> tuple[Sentiment, float]:
    """The likelier directional class and its probability, even when neutral is the argmax; rows without
    probabilities keep their ordinal outcome (directional calls never abstain at t=1)."""
    if record is None or record.get("error") is not None:
        return "neutral", -math.inf
    probs = record.get("probs")
    if not probs:
        return _ordinal(int(record["score"]))
    side: Sentiment = "bullish" if probs["bullish"] >= probs["bearish"] else "bearish"
    return side, float(normalise(cast(Mapping[Sentiment, float], probs))[side])


def evaluate_mass(records: Sequence[Record | None], dev: DevSet) -> PolicyEval:
    calls = [directional_mass(r) for r in records]
    labels = tuple(label for label, _ in calls)
    confidences = tuple(c for _, c in calls)
    sweep = risk_coverage_sweep(dev.gold, labels, confidences, MASS_THRESHOLDS, dev.weights)
    return PolicyEval("directional-mass", labels, confidences, tuple(sweep))


def directional_mass_report(
    cells: Sequence[CellInput], cands: Sequence[Candidate], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Not a serving policy: shows how much F0.5 the argmax rule leaves behind on neutral-leaning models.
    Below tau the row is served neutral (counted as an abstention)."""
    prob_cells = [c for c in cells if c.variant in ("decision", "label")]
    if not prob_cells:
        return None
    mass = [Candidate(cell, evaluate_mass(cell.records, dev), i) for i, cell in enumerate(prob_cells)]
    best, ok = best_candidate(mass)
    serving, serving_ok = best_candidate(cands)
    point, serving_point = chosen_point(best, ok), chosen_point(serving, serving_ok)
    paired = paired_f05((best, point), (serving, serving_point), dev, n_boot)
    return {
        "config": best.cell.name,
        "inversion_cap_met": ok,
        **point_row(point),
        "per_config_f05": {
            c.cell.name: chosen_point(c, c.evaluation.operating is not None).f05_macro for c in mass
        },
        "serving_best": {"config": serving.cell.name, "policy": serving.evaluation.policy},
        "paired_bootstrap": ci_dict(
            {"directional_mass": paired["a"], "serving": paired["b"], "gap": paired["gap"]}
        ),
        "verdict": _verdict(paired["gap"], "directional-mass", "serving"),
    }


# --- error patterns --------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Served:
    model: str
    pred: tuple[Sentiment, ...]
    abstained: tuple[bool, ...]
    failed: tuple[bool, ...]


def served_calls(best: Candidate, cap_met: bool) -> Served:
    point = chosen_point(best, cap_met)
    abstained = best.evaluation.abstained(point.threshold)
    failed = tuple(r is None or r.get("error") is not None for r in best.cell.records)
    return Served(best.cell.model, best.evaluation.labels, tuple(abstained), failed)


def _directional_call(s: Served, i: int) -> Sentiment | None:
    label = s.pred[i]
    return label if not s.abstained[i] and label in DIRECTIONAL else None


ERROR_KEYS = (
    "directional_calls",
    "wrong_calls",
    "neutral_called_bullish",
    "neutral_called_bearish",
    "bullish_called_bearish",
    "bearish_called_bullish",
    "bullish_missed",
    "bearish_missed",
    "failed",
)

    per_model: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for s in served:

            call = _directional_call(s, i)
            if s.failed[i]:
                tally["failed"] += 1
            if call is not None:
                tally["directional_calls"] += 1
                if call != gold:
                    tally["wrong_calls"] += 1
                    tally[f"{gold}_called_{call}"] += 1
            elif gold in DIRECTIONAL:

                        1 for i, c in calls if c is None and dev.gold[i] in DIRECTIONAL
                    ),
                }
            buckets[name] = row

# --- JSON helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def rounded(obj: Any, digits: int = 4) -> Any:
    """Rounds floats for compact committed JSON; non-finite values become null so JSON stays strict."""
    if isinstance(obj, float):
        return round(obj, digits) if math.isfinite(obj) else None
    if isinstance(obj, Mapping):
        return {k: rounded(v, digits) for k, v in obj.items()}
    if isinstance(obj, list | tuple):
        return [rounded(v, digits) for v in obj]
    return obj


# --- markdown --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _pct(x: float | None) -> str:
    return "-" if x is None else f"{100 * x:.1f}%"


def _num(x: float | None, digits: int = 3) -> str:
    return "-" if x is None else f"{x:.{digits}f}"


def _ms(x: float | None) -> str:
    return "-" if x is None else f"{x:.0f}"


def threshold_text(policy: str, threshold: float) -> str:
    if policy == "ordinal":
        return f"\\|s\\| >= {threshold:.0f}"
    return "none" if threshold == 0 else f"p >= {threshold:g}"


def _table(header: Sequence[str], rows: Sequence[Sequence[str]]) -> list[str]:
    return [
        "| " + " | ".join(header) + " |",
        "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in header) + "|",
        *("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |" for row in rows),
    ]


def _ci_text(cis: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, float]], key: str) -> str:
    ci = cis.get(key)
    return "-" if ci is None else f"{ci['point']:.3f} [{ci['low']:.3f}, {ci['high']:.3f}]"


def best_table(reports: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> list[str]:
    rows = []
    for rep in reports:
        best = rep["best"]
        m = best["metrics"]
        lat = best["latency"]
        rows.append(
            [
                f"/{rep['endpoint']}",
                f"`{rep['model']}`",
                best["config"],
                best["policy"],
                threshold_text(best["policy"], best["threshold"]),
                _ci_text(best["cis"], "f05_macro"),
                _num(m["per_class"]["bullish"]["precision"]),
                _num(m["per_class"]["bearish"]["precision"]),
                _pct(m["inversion_rate"]) + ("" if best["inversion_cap_met"] else " (cap missed)"),
                _pct(m["coverage"]),
                _pct(m["signal_rate"]),
                _ms(lat["wall_ms_p50"]),
                _ms(lat["wall_ms_p95"]),
            ]
        )
    header = [
        "endpoint", "model", "config", "policy", "threshold", "F0.5 macro [95% CI]", "P bull", "P bear",
        "inversion", "coverage", "signal rate", "p50 ms", "p95 ms",
    ]  # fmt: skip
    return _table(header, rows)


def config_table(report: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    rows = []
    for cfg in report["configs"]:
        dims = ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in cfg["dims"].items())
        for policy, pol in cfg["policies"].items():
            op = pol["operating_point"]
            m = op["metrics"] if op else None
            rows.append(
                [
                    cfg["name"],
                    dims,
                    policy,
                    _num(pol["default"]["metrics"]["f05_macro"]),
                    _num(m["f05_macro"]) if m else "cap missed",
                    threshold_text(policy, op["threshold"]) if op else "-",
                    _num(m["per_class"]["bullish"]["precision"]) if m else "-",
                    _num(m["per_class"]["bearish"]["precision"]) if m else "-",
                    _pct(m["inversion_rate"]) if m else "-",
                    _pct(m["coverage"]) if m else "-",
                    str(cfg["counts"]["errors"]),
                    _ms(cfg["latency"]["wall_ms_p50"]),
                ]
            )
    header = [
        "config", "dims", "policy", "F0.5 no abstain", "F0.5 @ op", "threshold", "P bull", "P bear",
        "inversion", "coverage", "errors", "p50 ms",
    ]  # fmt: skip
    return _table(header, rows)


def knob_lines(model: str, knob: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    rows = [
        [
            name,
            k["config"],
            k["reads"],
            threshold_text(k["policy"], k["threshold"]),
            _ci_text(knob["paired_bootstrap"], name),
            _num(k["precision_bullish"]),
            _num(k["precision_bearish"]),
            _pct(k["inversion_rate"]) + ("" if k["inversion_cap_met"] else " (cap missed)"),
            _pct(k["coverage"]),
        ]
        for name, k in knob["knobs"].items()
    ]
    delta = knob["paired_bootstrap"]["delta_logprob_minus_ordinal"]
    verdict = {
        "logprob": "the logprob threshold wins (95% CI of the gap excludes 0)",
        "ordinal": "the ordinal threshold wins (95% CI of the gap excludes 0)",
        "tie": "no significant difference at n=300 (95% CI of the gap spans 0)",
    }[knob["verdict"]]
    lines = [
        f"### `{model}`",
        "",
        *_table(
            [
                "knob",
                "config",
                "reads",
                "threshold",
                "F0.5 [95% CI]",
                "P bull",
                "P bear",
                "inversion",
                "coverage",
            ],
            rows,
        ),
        "",
        f"Paired bootstrap, logprob minus ordinal: F0.5 gap {delta['point']:+.3f} "
        f"[{delta['low']:+.3f}, {delta['high']:+.3f}]; {verdict}.",
    ]
    return lines


def error_lines(patterns: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    per_model = patterns["per_model"]
    rows = [[f"`{model}`", *(str(t[k]) for k in ERROR_KEYS)] for model, t in per_model.items()]
    header = [
        "model (best config)", "directional calls", "wrong", "neu -> bull", "neu -> bear", "bull -> bear",
        "bear -> bull", "missed bull", "missed bear", "failed calls",
    ]  # fmt: skip
    lines = _table(header, rows)
    buckets = patterns.get("buckets") or {}
    if buckets:
        models = list(per_model)
        header = ["bucket", "n (bull/bear/neu)", *(f"`{m}` wrong/calls, missed" for m in models)]
        brows = []
        for name, row in buckets.items():
            g = row["gold"]
            cells = [
                f"{v['wrong_calls']}/{v['directional_calls']}, {v['missed_directional']}"
                for v in (row["models"][m] for m in models)
            ]
            brows.append([name, f"{row['n']} ({g['bullish']}/{g['bearish']}/{g['neutral']})", *cells])
        lines += [
            "",
            "By keyword bucket (first match wins; heuristic, for orientation only):",
            "",
            *_table(header, brows),
        ]
    cross = patterns["cross_model"]
    lines += [
        "",
        f"Across the {cross['models']} best configs (tweet counts):",
        "",
        "- gold directional, no model calls it correctly: "
        f"{cross['directional_gold_no_model_calls_correctly']}",
        "- gold neutral, every model calls it directional: "
        f"{cross['neutral_gold_every_model_calls_directional']}",
        f"- gold directional, inverted by at least one model: {cross['any_model_inverts']}",
    ]
    return lines


def mass_lines(masses: Sequence[tuple[str, Mapping[str, Any]]]) -> list[str]:
    rows = []
    for model, m in masses:
        boot = m["paired_bootstrap"]
        gap = boot["gap"]
        rows.append(
            [
                f"`{model}`",
                m["config"],
                f"p(class) >= {m['threshold']:g}",
                _ci_text(boot, "directional_mass"),
                _num(m["precision_bullish"]),
                _num(m["precision_bearish"]),
                _pct(m["inversion_rate"]) + ("" if m["inversion_cap_met"] else " (cap missed)"),
                _pct(m["signal_rate"]),
                f"{m['serving_best']['config']}: {_ci_text(boot, 'serving')}",
                f"{gap['point']:+.3f} [{gap['low']:+.3f}, {gap['high']:+.3f}]",
            ]
        )
    header = [
        "model", "config", "threshold", "F0.5 [95% CI]", "P bull", "P bear", "inversion", "signal rate",
        "serving best F0.5", "gap",
    ]  # fmt: skip
    return [
        "## Not served yet: directional-mass threshold",
        "",
        "The serving policies abstain only when the winning class is unsure, so a model that keeps most "
        "of its mass on neutral is never pushed into a call. This informational policy calls bullish or "
        "bearish whenever that class's probability clears tau, even when neutral is the argmax. It is "
        "tuned on the same 300 tweets as everything else here (gap: paired bootstrap against the serving "
        "best config).",
        "",
        *_table(header, rows),
    ]


def render_summary(
    reports: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
    patterns: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    header: Mapping[str, Any],
    notes: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    weights = header["train_prior"]
    lines = [
        "# Signal grid on dev300",
        "",
        "Generated by `uv run python -m veritrade_evals.grid analyze` from the local prediction cache; "
        "no dataset text is stored here.",
        "",
        f"- Data: dev300, {header['n']} Twitter Financial News train tweets, 100 per class; every rate is "
        f"weighted back to the train prior (bullish {_pct(weights['bullish'])}, "
        f"bearish {_pct(weights['bearish'])}, neutral {_pct(weights['neutral'])}). "
        "Confusion and error counts are raw.",
        "- Selection: F0.5 macro over bullish/bearish; operating point = best F0.5 with bullish<->bearish "
        f"inversions <= {INVERSION_CAP:.0%} of directional calls; below the threshold the call abstains "
        "to neutral.",
        "- Policies: decision models threshold native class probabilities (min_p); generative /signal "
        "thresholds first-token label probabilities (label schema) or the |score| of an ordinal -2..2 schema "
        "(t in {1, 2}); /analyze is streamed sentiment-first and always uses |score|.",
        f"- Decoding: Ollama options {header['decoding']} on every generative call (greedy; overrides the "
        "penalties some Modelfiles ship).",
        f"- CIs: 95% stratified bootstrap (B={header['n_boot']}) at the chosen threshold; the threshold "
        "choice itself is not resampled, so these are optimistic.",
        f"- Latency: per-call wall ms during the grid run (Ollama {header['ollama_version']} "
        f"{header['backend']}, warm, client concurrency {header['concurrency']}); /analyze is time to the "
        "score with the stream stopped there. Indicative only: the latency suite runs separately.",
        "",
        "## Best config per model",
        "",
        *best_table(reports),
    ]
    for endpoint in ("signal", "analyze"):
        group = [r for r in reports if r["endpoint"] == endpoint]
        if not group:
            continue
        lines += ["", f"## /{endpoint} configs"]
        for rep in group:
            lines += ["", f"### `{rep['model']}`", "", *config_table(rep)]
    knobs = [(r["model"], r["knob_comparison"]) for r in reports if r.get("knob_comparison")]
    if knobs:
        lines += ["", "## Knob comparison: logprob threshold vs ordinal threshold"]
        for model, knob in knobs:
            lines += ["", *knob_lines(model, knob)]
    masses = [(r["model"], r["directional_mass"]) for r in reports if r.get("directional_mass")]
    if masses:
        lines += ["", *mass_lines(masses)]
    lines += [
        "",
        "## Error patterns (best config per model, at its operating point, raw counts)",
        "",
        *error_lines(patterns),
    ]
    if notes:
        lines += ["", notes.strip()]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

async def classify_signal(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> tuple[Verdict, ChatResult | DecisionResult]:
    """Label-logprob falls back label -> ordinal call (score sign) -> ordinal policy on the score."""
    text = fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens)
    policy = policy_for(spec, endpoint="signal")
    if isinstance(policy, ProbabilityPolicy):
        decision = await client.decide_sentiment(
            spec.name, prompt.state(text), prompt.instructions, prompt.criteria_map
        )
        return policy.decide(decision.probabilities), decision
    out, chat = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, spec.signal_schema or "ordinal")
    if isinstance(policy, LabelLogprobPolicy):
        verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is None and isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            out, second = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, "ordinal")
            chat = _combine(chat, second)
            verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is not None:
            return verdict, chat
    if not isinstance(out, OrdinalOut):
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name}: a label output needs the label-logprob policy")
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(out.score), chat


def _validate[T: BaseModel](out_type: type[T], content: str, model: str) -> T:

```
"""What the model reads: the headline plus the lede or the whole body, cut to a token budget."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Sequence

from veritrade.extract.dom import split_sentences
from veritrade.extract.profiles import profile_for
from veritrade.extract.types import Article, Scope

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
LEDE_PARAGRAPHS = 2
LEDE_MIN_TOKENS = 60  # a dateline-only first paragraph is topped up with the next one
LEDE_MAX_TOKENS = 200
_SEP = "\n\n"


def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    return math.ceil(len(text) / CHARS_PER_TOKEN)


def lede_paragraphs(article: Article) -> list[str]:
    profile = profile_for(article.source)
    count = profile.lede_paragraphs if profile else LEDE_PARAGRAPHS
    out = list(article.paragraphs[:count])
    for paragraph in article.paragraphs[count:]:
        if estimate_tokens(_SEP.join(out)) >= LEDE_MIN_TOKENS:
            break
        out.append(paragraph)
    return out


def _cut(paragraph: str, room: int, *, mid_sentence: bool) -> str:
    kept = ""
    for sentence in split_sentences(paragraph):
        candidate = f"{kept} {sentence}" if kept else sentence
        if len(candidate) > room:
            break
        kept = candidate
    if kept or not mid_sentence:
        return kept
    head = paragraph[: room + 1]
    return head[:room] if " " not in head else head.rsplit(" ", 1)[0]


def fit(paragraphs: Sequence[str], budget_chars: int) -> list[str]:
    """Whole paragraphs, then whole sentences; words are cut only when not even one sentence fits."""
    out: list[str] = []
    used = 0
    for paragraph in paragraphs:
        sep = len(_SEP) if out else 0
        if used + sep + len(paragraph) <= budget_chars:
            out.append(paragraph)
            used += sep + len(paragraph)
            continue
        if partial := _cut(paragraph, budget_chars - used - sep, mid_sentence=not out):
            out.append(partial)
        break
    return out


def build_input(article: Article, scope: Scope, max_tokens: int) -> str:
    """'TITLE: ...' then a blank line and the body; the estimate (chars / 4) never exceeds max_tokens."""
    if max_tokens <= 0:
        raise ValueError("max_tokens must be positive")
    budget = max_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    head = f"TITLE: {article.title}" if article.title else ""
    if len(head) > budget:
        return _SEP.join(fit([head], budget))
    room = budget - len(head) - (len(_SEP) if head else 0)
    if scope == "lede":
        body = fit(lede_paragraphs(article), min(room, LEDE_MAX_TOKENS * CHARS_PER_TOKEN))
    else:
        body = fit(article.paragraphs, room)
    return _SEP.join([head, *body] if head else body)

```
"""Single entry point from HTML to Article; parse and extract time are measured separately."""

from __future__ import annotations

import html as html_lib
import re
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from veritrade.errors import ExtractionEmpty
from veritrade.extract import cascade, density, jsonld, profiles, third_party
from veritrade.extract.dom import Dom, head_title, normalize, parse, scan_json_ld
from veritrade.extract.profiles import source_for_url
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS, Article, ExtractorName, ParserName

__all__ = ["MIN_WORDS", "extract", "source_for_url"]

MIN_WORDS = 40

OWN: dict[ExtractorName, Callable[[Dom, str, str | None], list[str]]] = {
    "jsonld": jsonld.extract,
    "profile": profiles.extract,
    "density": density.extract,
}
_PUBLISHED_META = re.compile(
    r"""<meta\b[^>]*?(?:property|name|itemprop)\s*=\s*["']"""
    r"""(?:article:published_time|datePublished|pubdate|publishdate)["'][^>]*>""",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_CONTENT_ATTR = re.compile(r"""\bcontent\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')""", re.IGNORECASE)


def _published_meta(html: str) -> str | None:
    if (meta := _PUBLISHED_META.search(html)) and (content := _CONTENT_ATTR.search(meta.group(0))):
        return normalize(html_lib.unescape(content.group(1) or content.group(2) or "")) or None
    return None


def _dom_title(dom: Dom, source: str | None) -> str:
    profile = profiles.profile_for(source)
    if profile is not None and profile.title:
        for node in dom.select(profile.title):
            if text := node.text():
                return text
    return dom.title()


def extract(
    html: str,
    url: str,
    *,
    parser: ParserName = "selectolax",
    extractor: ExtractorName = "cascade",
) -> Article:
    """Raises ExtractionEmpty when fewer than MIN_WORDS words come out."""
    source = source_for_url(url)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    dom: Dom | None = None
    if extractor in PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS:
        dom = parse(html, parser)
        if extractor == "cascade":
            method, paragraphs = cascade.run(dom, url, source)
        else:
            method, paragraphs = extractor, OWN[extractor](dom, url, source)
        objects = dom.json_ld()
    else:
        method, paragraphs = extractor, third_party.extract(extractor, html, url)
        objects = scan_json_ld(html)
    words = sum(len(p.split()) for p in paragraphs)
    if words < MIN_WORDS:
        raise ExtractionEmpty(
            f"The {extractor} extractor found {words} words on {urlsplit(url).hostname or url}; "
            f"at least {MIN_WORDS} are needed",
            hint="Try another extractor (for example trafilatura), or check that the URL is a single "
            "article rather than a section or video page.",
        )
    title = jsonld.headline(objects) or (_dom_title(dom, source) if dom is not None else head_title(html))
    published_at = jsonld.date_published(objects) or _published_meta(html)
    total_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
    parse_ms = dom.parse_ms if dom is not None else 0.0
    return Article(
        url=url,
        title=title,
        paragraphs=tuple(paragraphs),
        published_at=published_at,
        source=source,
        method=method,
        parser=parser if dom is not None else None,
        extractor=extractor,
        parse_ms=parse_ms,
        extract_ms=total_ms - parse_ms,
        paywalled=jsonld.is_paywalled(objects),
    )

    title: str

    @property
    def id(self) -> str:
        return self.example.id

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        """Gold title and body: the reference every number and claim is checked against."""
        return f"{self.title}\n\n{self.example.gold_text}" if self.title else self.example.gold_text


def load_eval_articles(split: ArticleSplit, article_paths: ArticlePaths) -> list[EvalArticle]:
    out = []
    for example in load_articles(split, paths=article_paths):
        record = read_fetched(article_paths, example.id)
        url = (record.final_url or record.url) if record is not None else example.url
        out.append(EvalArticle(example, url, gold_check(article_paths, example.id).title or ""))
    return out


def model_input(article: EvalArticle, spec: ModelSpec) -> str:
    """Exactly what the serving path sends: default extraction, full scope, capped by the model."""
    html = article.example.html_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    extracted = registry.extract(html, article.url, parser=PARSER, extractor=EXTRACTOR)
    return build_input(extracted, SCOPE, spec.max_input_tokens)


# --- generation ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GenRun:
    pair: Pair
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec

    @classmethod
    def resolve(cls, pair: Pair, prompts: PromptRegistry | None = None) -> GenRun:
        spec = allowlist().get(pair.model)
        if spec is None or not spec.serves(pair.endpoint):
            raise SummaryEvalError(f"{pair.model} is not allowlisted for /{pair.endpoint} in models.toml")
        prompt = (prompts or PromptRegistry()).get(pair.endpoint, pair.model, kind=spec.kind)
        return cls(pair, spec, prompt)

    @property
    def variant(self) -> str:
        return "default" if self.pair.endpoint == "summary" else self.spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"

    def run_config(self, split: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "harness": f"summary-{HARNESS_VERSION}",
            "split": split,
            "endpoint": self.pair.endpoint,
            "variant": self.variant,
            "prompt_version": self.prompt.version,
            parser=None,
            extractor="cascade",
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
        )


def page_for(example: ArticleExample, paths: ArticlePaths) -> Page:
    """The serving extractor receives the final URL, so the bench does too."""
    fetched = read_fetched(paths, example.id)
    check = gold_check(paths, example.id)
    if check.title is None or check.body != example.gold_text:
        raise BenchError(
            f"{example.id}: gold output does not match the committed gold body; run `articles verify`"
        )
    return Page(
        id=example.id,
        source=example.source,
        split=example.split,
        url=(fetched.final_url if fetched and fetched.final_url else example.url),
        html=example.html_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
        gold_text=example.gold_text,
        gold_title=check.title,
        label=example.label,
    )


def iter_pages(limit: int = 0, paths: ArticlePaths | None = None) -> Iterator[Page]:
    paths = paths or ArticlePaths()
    examples = load_articles("all", paths=paths)
    for example in examples[:limit] if limit else examples:
        yield page_for(example, paths)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Outcome:

def grid_result_path(model: str = SIGNAL_MODEL) -> Path:
    return GRID_DIR / f"signal__{model_slug(model)}.json"


def signal_config(result_path: Path | None = None) -> SignalConfig:
    """The grid's best config and operating threshold for the /signal decision model."""
    path = result_path or grid_result_path()
    if not path.exists():
        raise BenchError(f"{rel(path)} is missing; run `veritrade_evals.grid analyze` first")
    best = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["best"]
    cells = [c for c in grid_cells([SIGNAL_MODEL]) if c.name == best["config"]]
    if not cells:
        raise BenchError(f"grid config {best['config']!r} is not in the grid for {SIGNAL_MODEL}")
    if cells[0].prompt.version != best["prompt_version"]:
        raise BenchError(f"{rel(path)} was scored under another prompt version; re-run the grid analysis")
    return SignalConfig(cells[0], float(best["threshold"] or 0.0))


def record_key(row: str, article: str) -> str:
    return f"{row}|{article}"

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.analysis import (
    PROB_THRESHOLDS,
    CellInput,
    DevSet,
    Record,
    Served,
    best_candidate,
    bucket_of,
    candidates,
    chosen_point,
    counts,
    diagnostics,
    directional_mass,
    directional_mass_report,
    error_patterns,
    evaluate_policy,
    knob_comparison,
    latency,
    replay,
    rounded,
    served_calls,
    thin_sweep,
)
from veritrade_evals.runner import Variant

GOLD: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("bullish", "bullish", "bearish", "bearish", "neutral", "neutral")
DEV = DevSet(ids=tuple(f"x:{i}" for i in range(6)), gold=GOLD, weights=None)


def decision(bull: float, bear: float, neutral: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "kind": "decision",
        "choice": "neutral",
        "probs": {"bullish": bull, "bearish": bear, "neutral": neutral},
    }


def ordinal(score: int, sign_probs: dict[str, float] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"kind": "ordinal", "score": score, "sign_probs": sign_probs}


def analyze(score: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"kind": "analyze", "score": score}


def failed() -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"error": {"code": "schema_violation", "message": "x", "retryable": False}}


def make_cell(variant: Variant, records: Sequence[Record | None], name: str = "v1", **kw: Any) -> CellInput:
    return CellInput("signal", "m", name, variant, f"signal/m/{name}@0", tuple(records), **kw)


# Exact binary fractions: e1-e3 right, e4 inverts (bull on gold bear), e5 false alarm, e6 neutral.
DECISION_RECORDS = [
    decision(0.875, 0.0625, 0.0625),
    decision(0.625, 0.125, 0.25),
    decision(0.0625, 0.8125, 0.125),
    decision(0.5625, 0.25, 0.1875),
    decision(0.0625, 0.6875, 0.25),
    decision(0.0625, 0.0625, 0.875),
]


def test_replay_per_policy() -> None:
    assert replay("probability", DECISION_RECORDS[3]) == ("bullish", 0.5625)
    assert replay("ordinal", analyze(-2)) == ("bearish", 2.0)
    assert replay("ordinal", analyze(0)) == ("neutral", math.inf)
    top, p = replay("label-logprob", ordinal(1, {"bullish": 0.6, "neutral": 0.4, "bearish": 0.0}))
    assert top == "bullish"
    assert p == pytest.approx(0.6)
    label = {"kind": "label", "probs": {"bullish": 0.2, "bearish": 0.3, "neutral": 0.5}, "fallback": "none"}
    top, p = replay("label-logprob", label)
    assert top == "neutral"
    assert p == pytest.approx(0.5)
    # Without probabilities the serving chain applies the ordinal policy with the frozen t.
    fallback = {"kind": "label", "probs": None, "fallback": "ordinal", "score": 1}
    assert replay("label-logprob", fallback, ordinal_t=1) == ("bullish", math.inf)
    assert replay("label-logprob", fallback, ordinal_t=2) == ("bullish", -math.inf)
    assert replay("label-logprob", ordinal(-2, None)) == ("bearish", math.inf)
    assert replay("probability", None) == ("neutral", -math.inf)
    assert replay("ordinal", failed()) == ("neutral", -math.inf)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="no probabilities"):
        replay("probability", {"kind": "decision", "probs": None})


def test_probability_sweep_hand_computed() -> None:
    ev = evaluate_policy("probability", DECISION_RECORDS, GOLD, None)
    by_t = {p.threshold: p for p in ev.sweep}
    # t=0: bull calls e1 e2 e4 (P 2/3, R 1 -> F 5/7), bear calls e3 e5 (P 1/2, R 1/2 -> 1/2).
    assert by_t[0.0].f05_macro == pytest.approx((5 / 7 + 0.5) / 2)
    assert by_t[0.0].inversion_rate == pytest.approx(1 / 5)
    # 0.57 drops the inversion; 0.63 drops a right call; 0.69 drops the false alarm.
    assert by_t[0.57].f05_macro == pytest.approx(0.75)
    assert by_t[0.57].inversion_rate == 0.0
    assert by_t[0.63].f05_macro == pytest.approx((1.25 * 0.5 / 0.75 + 0.5) / 2)
    assert by_t[0.69].f05_macro == pytest.approx(1.25 * 0.5 / 0.75)
    assert by_t[0.69].coverage == pytest.approx(0.5)
    op = ev.operating
    assert op is not None
    assert op.threshold == 0.69
    assert ev.default.threshold == 0.0
    assert ev.abstained(0.69) == [False, True, False, True, True, False]


def test_weights_flow_into_precision() -> None:
    weighted = evaluate_policy("probability", DECISION_RECORDS, GOLD, [1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2])
    # The false alarm on a neutral now weighs 2: bear P = 1/3, R = 1/2 -> F0.5 = 5/14.
    assert weighted.default.f05_macro == pytest.approx((5 / 7 + 5 / 14) / 2)


def test_ordinal_thresholds_hand_computed() -> None:
    ev = evaluate_policy("ordinal", [analyze(s) for s in (2, 1, -2, 1, 0, -1)], GOLD, None)
    assert [p.threshold for p in ev.sweep] == [1.0, 2.0]
    t1, t2 = ev.sweep
    assert t1.f05_macro == pytest.approx((5 / 7 + 0.5) / 2)
    assert t1.inversion_rate == pytest.approx(1 / 5)
    assert t2.f05_macro == pytest.approx(1.25 * 0.5 / 0.75)
    # The zero score stays a confident neutral: e1, e3 and e5 answer.
    assert t2.coverage == pytest.approx(0.5)
    assert ev.operating is t2


def test_best_candidate_needs_the_inversion_cap() -> None:
    # Cell a: higher F0.5 but an inversion survives every threshold; cell b: fewer calls, none wrong.
    a = make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(s) for s in (2, 2, -2, 2, 0, 0)], "a")
    b = make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(s) for s in (2, 0, -2, 0, 0, 0)], "b")
    best, cap_met = best_candidate(candidates([a, b], DEV))
    assert (best.cell.name, cap_met) == ("b", True)
    assert chosen_point(best, cap_met).threshold == 1.0

    only_a, cap_met = best_candidate(candidates([a], DEV))
    assert (only_a.cell.name, cap_met) == ("a", False)
    assert chosen_point(only_a, cap_met) is only_a.evaluation.default


def test_exact_ties_go_to_the_earlier_config() -> None:
    same = [analyze(s) for s in (2, 0, -2, 0, 0, 0)]
    best, _ = best_candidate(
        candidates([make_cell("sentiment-first", same, "v1"), make_cell("sentiment-first", same, "v2")], DEV)
    )
    assert best.cell.name == "v1"


def test_each_variant_is_scored_by_its_serving_policy() -> None:
    sign = {"bullish": 0.9, "neutral": 0.1, "bearish": 0.0}
    cells = [
        make_cell("decision", DECISION_RECORDS),
        make_cell("label", [{"kind": "label", "fallback": "none", "label": "bullish", "probs": sign}] * 6),
        make_cell("ordinal", [ordinal(1, sign)] * 6),
        make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(1)] * 6),
    ]
    cands = candidates(cells, DEV)
    assert [c.evaluation.policy for c in cands] == ["probability", "label-logprob", "ordinal", "ordinal"]
    assert [c.reads for c in cands] == ["class probabilities", "label tokens", "score value", "score value"]


def test_knob_comparison_prefers_the_cleaner_knob() -> None:
    classes: list[Sentiment] = ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral"]
    gold = tuple(c for c in classes for _ in range(20))
    dev = DevSet(tuple(f"x:{i}" for i in range(60)), gold, None)
    sure = {"bullish": 0.9, "bearish": 0.05, "neutral": 0.05}
    label = [
        {"kind": "label", "fallback": "none", "label": g, "probs": {**{k: 0.05 for k in sure}, g: 0.9}}
        for g in gold
    ]
    # The ordinal cell calls every neutral bullish with |score| 2, so no t removes the false alarms.
    scores = [2] * 20 + [-2] * 20 + [2] * 20
    ords = [ordinal(s, {"bullish": 1.0, "bearish": 0.0, "neutral": 0.0} if s > 0 else None) for s in scores]
    cells = [make_cell("label", label, "v1-label"), make_cell("ordinal", ords, "v1-ordinal")]
    knob = knob_comparison(candidates(cells, dev), dev, n_boot=200)
    assert knob is not None
    assert knob["verdict"] == "logprob"
    assert knob["knobs"]["logprob"]["config"] == "v1-label"
    assert knob["knobs"]["ordinal"]["reads"] == "score value"
    assert knob["paired_bootstrap"]["delta_logprob_minus_ordinal"]["low"] > 0
    assert knob_comparison(candidates(cells[:1], dev), dev, n_boot=10) is None


def test_directional_mass_recovers_calls_the_argmax_rule_never_makes() -> None:
    def lab(bull: float, bear: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
        probs = {"bullish": bull, "bearish": bear, "neutral": 1 - bull - bear}
        return {"kind": "label", "fallback": "none", "label": "neutral", "probs": probs}

    # Neutral is the argmax everywhere, so every serving threshold makes zero calls.
    cell = make_cell(
        "label", [lab(0.4, 0), lab(0.2, 0), lab(0, 0.45), lab(0.1, 0.3), lab(0.05, 0.05), lab(0.3, 0)]
    )
    side, p = directional_mass(cell.records[3])
    assert side == "bearish"
    assert p == pytest.approx(0.3)
    assert directional_mass(cell.records[4])[0] == "bullish"
    assert directional_mass(failed()) == ("neutral", -math.inf)
    assert directional_mass({"kind": "label", "probs": None, "score": -1}) == ("bearish", 1.0)

    report = directional_mass_report([cell], candidates([cell], DEV), DEV, n_boot=50)
    assert report is not None
    # From tau 0.06 to 0.2: bull calls e0 e1 e5 (P 2/3, R 1 -> 5/7), bear calls e2 e3 (F0.5 1).
    assert report["threshold"] == 0.06
    assert report["f05_macro"] == pytest.approx((5 / 7 + 1) / 2)
    assert report["inversion_rate"] == 0.0
    assert report["paired_bootstrap"]["serving"]["point"] == 0.0
    assert report["verdict"] == "directional-mass"
    assert directional_mass_report([make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(1)] * 6)], [], DEV, 10) is None


def test_error_patterns_count_by_kind_bucket_and_model() -> None:
    dev = DevSet(DEV.ids, GOLD, None, buckets=("analyst action",) * 3 + ("other",) * 3)
    a = Served(
        "a",
        ("bullish", "neutral", "bullish", "bearish", "bearish", "neutral"),
        (False, False, False, True, False, False),
        (False, True, False, False, False, False),
    )
    b = Served("b", ("bullish",) * 6, (False,) * 6, (False,) * 6)
    patterns = error_patterns([a, b], dev)
    assert patterns["per_model"]["a"] == {
        "directional_calls": 3,
        "wrong_calls": 2,
        "neutral_called_bullish": 0,
        "neutral_called_bearish": 1,
        "bullish_called_bearish": 0,
        "bearish_called_bullish": 1,
        "bullish_missed": 1,
        "bearish_missed": 1,
        "failed": 1,
    }
    b_tally = patterns["per_model"]["b"]
    assert (b_tally["neutral_called_bullish"], b_tally["bearish_called_bullish"]) == (2, 2)
    analyst = patterns["buckets"]["analyst action"]
    assert analyst["gold"] == {"bullish": 2, "bearish": 1, "neutral": 0}
    assert analyst["models"]["a"] == {"directional_calls": 2, "wrong_calls": 1, "missed_directional": 1}
    assert patterns["cross_model"] == {
        "models": 2,
        "directional_gold_no_model_calls_correctly": 2,
        "neutral_gold_every_model_calls_directional": 1,
        "any_model_inverts": 2,
    }


def test_served_calls_follow_the_chosen_threshold() -> None:
    cell = make_cell("decision", [*DECISION_RECORDS[:5], failed()])
    best, cap_met = best_candidate(candidates([cell], DEV))
    served = served_calls(best, cap_met)
    assert served.failed == (False,) * 5 + (True,)
    assert served.abstained[-1] is True


def test_bucket_heuristics() -> None:
    assert bucket_of("Zentor upgraded to Buy at Halvard; PT raised to $40") == "analyst action"
    assert bucket_of("Orvane Q3 EPS beats by $0.05") == "earnings / guidance"
    assert bucket_of("Shares of Pellow jump 9% premarket") == "price move"
    assert bucket_of("Fed holds rates steady") == "macro / markets"
    assert bucket_of("Pellow names a new chair") == "other"


def test_latency_counts_and_diagnostics() -> None:
    records: list[Record | None] = [
        {"kind": "analyze", "score": 1, "error": None, "t": {"wall_ms": 100.0}},
        {"kind": "analyze", "score": -2, "error": None, "t": {"wall_ms": 300.0, "total_ms": 250.0}},
        {"kind": "analyze", "score": 0, "error": None, "t": {"wall_ms": 200.0}},
        {**failed(), "t": {"wall_ms": 5000.0}},
        None,
    ]
    lat = latency(records)
    assert (lat["n"], lat["wall_ms_p50"], lat["server_ms_p50"]) == (3, 200.0, 250.0)
    assert counts(records) == {"n": 5, "done": 4, "missing": 1, "errors": 1, "error_schema_violation": 1}
    hist = diagnostics(make_cell("sentiment-first", records))["score_histogram"]
    assert hist == {"-2": 1, "-1": 0, "0": 1, "1": 1, "2": 0}
    label = {
        "kind": "label",
        "fallback": "none",
        "label": "bullish",
        "probs": {"bullish": 0.4, "neutral": 0.6, "bearish": 0},
    }
    diag = diagnostics(make_cell("label", [label, {**label, "fallback": "ordinal", "probs": None}]))
    assert diag == {"fallback": {"none": 1, "ordinal": 1}, "generated_label_not_argmax": 1}


def test_thin_sweep_and_rounding() -> None:
    ev = evaluate_policy("probability", DECISION_RECORDS, GOLD, None)
    rows = thin_sweep(ev.sweep)
    assert rows[0]["threshold"] == 0.0
    # Thresholds up to the lowest winning probability change nothing, so they collapse into t=0.
    assert rows[1]["threshold"] == 0.57
    assert len(rows) < len(PROB_THRESHOLDS)
    assert rounded({"a": [1 / 3, math.inf], "b": (2.0,)}) == {"a": [0.3333, None], "b": [2.0]}

```
"""`uv run python -m veritrade_evals <command>`: dataset, split and (later) evaluation commands."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence

from veritrade_evals import articles_cli
from veritrade_evals.datasets import (
    SPECS,
    DatasetError,
    Example,
    class_counts,
    fetch_all,
    finentity_single,
    fpb_allagree,
    twitter_fns,
)
from veritrade_evals.splits import SPLIT_NAMES, SplitError, load_split, make_splits, read_split_file

PLANNED = {
    "signal": "signal accuracy run over a split",
    "grid": "prompt grid per model",
    "freeze": "write frozen prompt versions and thresholds into models.toml",
    "extraction": "parser x extractor matrix",
    "latency": "latency suite",
    "summary": "summary evaluation",
    "select": "pick per-endpoint winners",
    "holdout": "one-shot holdout run",
    "report": "benchmarks.json and results README",
    "opus": "Opus subagent prompts and judgements",
}


def _balance(examples: Sequence[Example]) -> str:
    counts = class_counts(examples)
    return " ".join(f"{k}={v} ({v / len(examples):.1%})" for k, v in counts.items())


def cmd_datasets_fetch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    lock = fetch_all(update=args.update)
    for name, entry in lock.items():
        print(f"{name}: {SPECS[name].repo_id}@{entry.revision[:12]} ({entry.license})")
    loaded = {
        "tfns train": twitter_fns("train"),
        "tfns validation": twitter_fns("validation"),
        "fpb allagree": fpb_allagree(),
        "finentity single": finentity_single(),
    }
    for label, examples in loaded.items():
        print(f"  {label}: n={len(examples)} {_balance(examples)}")
    return 0


def cmd_splits_make(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    for name, path in make_splits().items():
        payload = read_split_file(name)
        print(f"{name}: n={payload['n']} {payload['class_counts']} -> {path.name}")
        if "class_weights" in payload:
            print(f"  train_prior={payload['train_prior']} weights={payload['class_weights']}")
            print(f"  excluded={payload['excluded']}")
    return 0


def cmd_splits_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    failed = 0
    for name in SPLIT_NAMES:
        try:
            split = load_split(name)
        except (SplitError, DatasetError) as exc:
            failed += 1
            print(f"FAIL {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        print(f"ok {name}: n={len(split.examples)} {_balance(split.examples)}")
    return 1 if failed else 0


def cmd_planned(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    print(f"`{args.command}` is not implemented yet ({PLANNED[args.command]})", file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals", description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    datasets = commands.add_parser("datasets", help="public dataset downloads").add_subparsers(
        dest="action", required=True
    )
    fetch = datasets.add_parser(
        "fetch", help="download pinned revisions and record them in datasets.lock.json"
    )
    fetch.add_argument(
        "--update", action="store_true", help="re-resolve refs instead of reusing locked commits"
    )
    fetch.set_defaults(func=cmd_datasets_fetch)

    splits = commands.add_parser("splits", help="committed split files").add_subparsers(
        dest="action", required=True
    )
    splits.add_parser("make", help="write evals/data/splits/*.json").set_defaults(func=cmd_splits_make)
    splits.add_parser("verify", help="re-read datasets and check split hashes").set_defaults(
        func=cmd_splits_verify
    )

    articles_cli.register(commands)

    for name, help_text in PLANNED.items():
        planned = commands.add_parser(name, help=f"{help_text} (not implemented yet)")
        planned.set_defaults(func=cmd_planned)
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args, extra = parser.parse_known_args(argv)
    # Planned commands accept anything so scripts written against them fail with the clear message below.
    if extra and args.func is not cmd_planned:
        parser.error(f"unrecognized arguments: {' '.join(extra)}")
    code: int = args.func(args)
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade_evals import __main__ as cli
from veritrade_evals.datasets import Example
from veritrade_evals.splits import Split, SplitError, SplitName


@pytest.mark.parametrize("command", sorted(cli.PLANNED))
def test_planned_commands_exit_cleanly(command: str, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    assert cli.main([command, "--model", "x"]) == 2
    assert "not implemented yet" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_splits_verify_fails_when_any_split_fails(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    def fake_load(name: SplitName) -> Split:
        if name == "fpb_allagree":
            raise SplitError("fpb_allagree: 1 bad rows")
        return Split(name, (Example("x:0", "t", "bullish", "tfns", "train"),))

    monkeypatch.setattr(cli, "load_split", fake_load)
    assert cli.main(["splits", "verify"]) == 1
    out = capsys.readouterr()
    assert "ok dev300" in out.out
    assert "FAIL fpb_allagree" in out.err


@pytest.mark.parametrize("argv", [[], ["splits", "verify", "--bogus"]])
def test_bad_invocations_exit_with_usage(argv: list[str]) -> None:
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc:
        cli.main(argv)
    assert exc.value.code == 2

from veritrade_evals.splits import HOLDOUT_SPLITS, Split

def test_grid_enumerates_the_lean_plan() -> None:
    cells = grid.grid_cells()
    per_model = Counter(c.model for c in cells)
    assert per_model == {

    assert len({grid.cell_key(c) for c in cells}) == len(cells) == 28
    variants = {m: {c.variant for c in cells if c.model == m} for m in per_model}
    assert variants["qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0"] == {"label", "ordinal"}
    assert {c.endpoint for c in cells if c.variant == "sentiment-first"} == {"analyze"}
    # Models stay contiguous so each one is loaded once.
    order = [c.model for c in cells]
    assert order == sorted(order, key=list(dict.fromkeys(order)).index)


def test_dims_describe_the_prompt_files() -> None:
    cells = grid.grid_cells()
    for model in {c.model for c in cells}:
        own = {c.prompt.version_id: c for c in cells if c.model == model}
        v1 = own["v1"].prompt
        for version, cell in own.items():
            p = cell.prompt
            if cell.variant == "decision":
                bare = all(description is None for _, description in p.criteria)
                assert cell.dims["criteria"] == ("bare" if bare else "described"), (model, version)
                assert (cell.dims["instructions"] == "rubric") == (p.instructions == v1.instructions)
            else:
                assert cell.dims["shots"] == str(len(p.few_shot)), (model, version)
                assert (cell.dims["rubric"] == "A") == (p.system == v1.system), (model, version)


def test_grid_reads_dev300_only() -> None:
    assert grid.GRID_SPLIT == "dev300"
    assert grid.GRID_SPLIT not in HOLDOUT_SPLITS


def test_unknown_models_are_rejected() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="not in the grid"):
        grid.grid_cells(["tev1:0.8b-q8_0"])
    assert {c.model for c in grid.grid_cells([COMBINED])} == {COMBINED}


def test_cli_list_and_parent_parser_hooks(capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:
    assert grid.main(["list", "--model", DECISION]) == 0
    out = capsys.readouterr().out
    assert "4 configs: nimble:9b-q4_K_M=4" in out
    assert "excluded: tev1" in out

    parent = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    grid.add_parser(parent.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    args = parent.parse_args(["grid", "analyze", "--n-boot", "10"])
    assert args.grid_func is grid.cmd_analyze
    assert args.n_boot == 10
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit):
        parent.parse_args(["grid", "run", "--bogus"])


# --- end to end on synthetic data ------------------------------------------------------------


def _score(text: str) -> int:
    return (
        2 if "beats" in text or "upgraded" in text else -2 if "loss" in text else -1 if "sink" in text else 0
    )


def _systemone(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
    state = json.loads(request.content)["state"]
    score = _score(state)
    label: Sentiment = "bullish" if score > 0 else "bearish" if score < 0 else "neutral"
    probs = {s: (0.9 if s == label else 0.05) for s in ("neutral", "bullish", "bearish")}
    answer = {"type": "choice", "choice": label, "probabilities": probs, "confidence": 0.8}
    return httpx.Response(200, json={"model": DECISION, "answers": {"sentiment": answer}, "usage": {}})


def _chat(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
    text = json.loads(request.content)["messages"][-1]["content"]
    pieces = ['{"score": ', str(_score(text)), ', "entity": "Acme", ', '"summary": "Acme news."}']
    chunks = [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": p}, "done": False} for p in pieces]
    chunks.append({"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": ""}, "done": True, "eval_count": 9})
    body = "".join(json.dumps(c) + "\n" for c in chunks)
    return httpx.Response(200, content=body.encode(), headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})


@pytest.fixture
def mock_ollama() -> Iterator[respx.MockRouter]:
    with respx.mock(base_url=BASE_URL, assert_all_called=False) as router:
        router.get("/api/version").respond(json={"version": "0.40.6"})
        router.get("/api/ps").respond(json={"models": []})
        tags = [{"name": m, "model": m, "digest": d * 64} for m, d in ((DECISION, "a"), (COMBINED, "b"))]
        router.get("/api/tags").respond(json={"models": tags})
        router.post("/v1/systemone", name="decide").mock(side_effect=_systemone)
        router.post("/api/chat", name="chat").mock(side_effect=_chat)
        yield router


@pytest.fixture
async def client() -> AsyncIterator[OllamaClient]:
    ollama = OllamaClient(BASE_URL, timeout=2.0, keep_alive="5m")
    yield ollama
    await ollama.aclose()


@pytest.fixture
def synthetic_split(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:

    monkeypatch.setattr(grid, "load_split", lambda name: Split("dev300", tuple(EXAMPLES), WEIGHTS))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        grid, "read_split_file", lambda name: {"class_weights": WEIGHTS, "train_prior": prior}
    )


async def test_run_then_analyze_end_to_end(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path, synthetic_split: None
) -> None:
    cells = grid.grid_cells([DECISION, COMBINED])
    manifest_path, preds, out = tmp_path / "manifest.json", tmp_path / "preds", tmp_path / "out"
    log = io.StringIO()
    manifest = await grid.run_grid(
        client, cells, EXAMPLES, concurrency=2, preds_root=preds, manifest_path=manifest_path, log=log
    )
    assert len(manifest["cells"]) == 8
    assert {e["done"] for e in manifest["cells"].values()} == {6}
    assert manifest["ollama_version"] == "0.40.6"
    decide = mock_ollama.routes["decide"]
    calls_after_first_run = decide.call_count
    assert calls_after_first_run == 4 * 6 + 1  # 4 configs x 6 examples + 1 warm-up

    chat = mock_ollama.routes["chat"]
    chat_calls = chat.call_count
    await grid.run_grid(
        client, cells, EXAMPLES, concurrency=2, preds_root=preds, manifest_path=manifest_path, log=log
    )
    # Fully cached: no warm-up, no calls.
    assert (decide.call_count, chat.call_count) == (calls_after_first_run, chat_calls)

    more = [*EXAMPLES, Example("x:6", "Halden Ore wins a mining permit", "bullish", "tfns", "train")]
    await grid.run_grid(
        client, cells, more, concurrency=2, preds_root=preds, manifest_path=manifest_path, log=log
    )
    assert decide.call_count == calls_after_first_run + 1 + 4  # warm-up + the new example per config

    paths = grid.analyze_grid(n_boot=50, preds_root=preds, manifest_path=manifest_path, out_dir=out, log=log)
    names = sorted(p.name for p in paths)
    assert names == [
        "analyze__ministral-3_3b.json",
        "error_patterns.json",
        "signal__nimble_9b-q4_K_M.json",
        "summary.md",
    ]
    report = json.loads((out / "signal__nimble_9b-q4_K_M.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert [c["name"] for c in report["configs"]] == ["v1", "v2", "v3", "v4"]
    assert report["best"]["config"] == "v1"
    assert report["best"]["metrics"]["f05_macro"] == 1.0
    assert report["best"]["cis"]["f05_macro"]["low"] == 1.0
    assert report["configs"][0]["policies"]["probability"]["sweep"][0]["threshold"] == 0.0
    combined = json.loads((out / "analyze__ministral-3_3b.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    # One gold-bearish tweet scores -1, so |s| >= 2 abstains on it; t=1 keeps it and wins.
    assert combined["best"]["policy"] == "ordinal"
    assert combined["best"]["threshold"] == 1.0
    assert combined["configs"][0]["diagnostics"]["score_histogram"] == {
        "-2": 1,
        "-1": 1,
        "0": 2,
        "1": 0,
        "2": 2,
    }
    summary = (out / "summary.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "## Best config per model" in summary
    assert "`nimble:9b-q4_K_M`" in summary
    for path in [*paths, manifest_path]:
        written = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        assert all(text not in written for text, _ in TEXTS), path.name
    assert "skip signal/qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0/v1-label: not run yet" in log.getvalue()


async def test_analyze_skips_cells_whose_prompt_changed(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path, synthetic_split: None
) -> None:
    cells = grid.grid_cells([DECISION])
    manifest_path = tmp_path / "manifest.json"
    await grid.run_grid(
        client, cells, EXAMPLES, concurrency=1, preds_root=tmp_path, manifest_path=manifest_path
    )
    manifest: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    manifest["cells"][f"signal/{DECISION}/v2"]["prompt_sha"] = "0" * 64
    grid.write_manifest(manifest, manifest_path)
    log = io.StringIO()
    grid.analyze_grid(
        n_boot=10, preds_root=tmp_path, manifest_path=manifest_path, out_dir=tmp_path / "o", log=log
    )
    assert f"skip signal/{DECISION}/v2: prompt or config changed" in log.getvalue()
    report = json.loads((tmp_path / "o" / "signal__nimble_9b-q4_K_M.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert [c["name"] for c in report["configs"]] == ["v1", "v3", "v4"]

def replay_tau(record: Record | None, *, ordinal_t: int = 1) -> tuple[Sentiment, float]:
    \"\"\"The served directional_tau rule at min_p 0: a leading directional class is always called (inf); while
    neutral leads, the likelier directional class carries its probability and is served neutral below tau.
    Failed calls and ordinal-fallback abstentions (-inf) abstain.\"\"\"
    if record is None or record.get("error") is not None:
        return "neutral", -math.inf
    if probs := record.get("probs"):
        p = normalise(cast(Mapping[Sentiment, float], probs))
        top = winner(p)
        if top != "neutral":
            return top, math.inf
        side: Sentiment = "bullish" if p["bullish"] >= p["bearish"] else "bearish"
        return side, p[side]
    if record.get("score") is None:
        raise ValueError(f"record {record.get('id')!r} has neither probabilities nor a score")
    label, confidence = _ordinal(int(record["score"]))
    return label, math.inf if confidence >= ordinal_t else -math.inf

        return [label if c >= threshold else "neutral" for label, c in rows], [

    """The likelier directional class and its probability, even when neutral is the argmax; rows without

    if record is None or record.get("error") is not None:

def tau_report(cands: Sequence[Candidate], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Best directional_tau candidate vs best plain-rule candidate over the grid cells, paired bootstrap."""
    pool = grid_only(cands)
    tau = [c for c in pool if is_tau(c.evaluation.policy)]
    plain = [c for c in pool if not is_tau(c.evaluation.policy)]
    if not tau or not plain:
        return None
    picks = {"tau": best_candidate(tau), "plain": best_candidate(plain)}
    paired = paired_f05(
        *((c, chosen_point(c, ok)) for c, ok in (picks["tau"], picks["plain"])), dev=dev, n_boot=n_boot
    )
    return {
        **{name: _pick_row(c, ok) for name, (c, ok) in picks.items()},
        "paired_bootstrap": ci_dict({"tau": paired["a"], "plain": paired["b"], "gap": paired["gap"]}),
        "verdict": _verdict(paired["gap"], "tau", "plain"),
    }

## /signal configs
## directional_tau vs the plain rule

The plain rule calls the argmax class and abstains below min_p, so a model that keeps most of its mass on neutral is never pushed into a call. The served `directional_tau` rule (min_p 0) calls the likelier directional class when neutral leads and that class holds p >= tau; a leading directional class is always called, and below tau the row is a served neutral, not an abstention. Both rules are tuned on these 300 tweets; the gap is a paired bootstrap.

def error_patterns(served: Sequence[Served], dev: DevSet) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Raw counts (unweighted) of how each model's served calls go wrong, overall and per keyword bucket."""
    per_model: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for s in served:
        tally: Counter[str] = Counter()
        for i, gold in enumerate(dev.gold):
            call = _directional_call(s, i)
            if s.failed[i]:
                tally["failed"] += 1
            if call is not None:
                tally["directional_calls"] += 1
                if call != gold:
                    tally["wrong_calls"] += 1
                    tally[f"{gold}_called_{call}"] += 1
            elif gold in DIRECTIONAL:
                tally[f"{gold}_missed"] += 1
        per_model[s.model] = {k: tally.get(k, 0) for k in ERROR_KEYS}
    buckets: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if dev.buckets:
        for name in BUCKET_NAMES:
            idx = [i for i, b in enumerate(dev.buckets) if b == name]
            gold_counts = Counter(dev.gold[i] for i in idx)
            row: dict[str, Any] = {
                "n": len(idx),
                "gold": {k: gold_counts.get(k, 0) for k in ("bullish", "bearish", "neutral")},
                "models": {},
            }
            for s in served:
                calls = [(i, _directional_call(s, i)) for i in idx]
                made = [(i, c) for i, c in calls if c is not None]
                row["models"][s.model] = {
                    "directional_calls": len(made),
                    "wrong_calls": sum(1 for i, c in made if c != dev.gold[i]),

def error_patterns(
    served: Sequence[Served], dev: DevSet, bucket_names: Sequence[str] = BUCKET_NAMES
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Raw counts (unweighted) of how each model's served calls go wrong, overall and per keyword bucket."""
