```python
"""Grid finalists on the articles dev set: `uv run python -m veritrade_evals finalists {list,run,analyze}`.
Inputs are the serving extraction of the stored HTML cut to the serving scope, and every threshold comes
from dev300, so this checks the frozen operating points on real articles rather than tuning them."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
import sys
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, TextIO

from veritrade.config import get_settings
from veritrade.errors import VtError
from veritrade.extract import registry as extraction
from veritrade.extract.scope import build_input
from veritrade.extract.types import Article, ExtractorName, ParserName, Scope
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals import grid
from veritrade_evals.analysis import (
    POLICIES,
    Candidate,
    CellInput,
    DevSet,
    EvalPolicy,
    Served,
    SweepPoint,
    best_candidate,
    bucket_of,
    candidate_cis,
    candidates,
    chosen_point,
    counts,
    error_patterns,
    evaluate_policy,
    grid_only,
    latency,
    metrics_dict,
    paired_f05,
    point_row,
    rounded,
    threshold_text,
)
from veritrade_evals.articles import ArticleExample, ArticlePaths, ArticleSplit, load_articles, read_fetched
from veritrade_evals.metrics import INVERSION_CAP, select_operating_point
from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR, RESULTS_DIR
from veritrade_evals.predcache import canonical_json
from veritrade_evals.runner import RunSpec, make_resident, model_digest, run_cell

ARTICLE_SPLIT: ArticleSplit = "dev"
CACHE_SPLIT = "articles_dev"
OUT_DIR = RESULTS_DIR / "articles_dev"
MANIFEST = OUT_DIR / "manifest.json"
# The serving request defaults; test_finalists pins them to the API contract.
PARSER: ParserName = "selectolax"
EXTRACTOR: ExtractorName = "cascade"
# A collapse: the whole coverage CI sits under this share of the dev300 coverage.
COLLAPSE_SHARE = 0.5
DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 1


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Finalist:
    model: str
    config: str
    scope: Scope

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.model}/{self.config}/{self.scope}"


SIGNAL_FINALISTS = {"clef-flash:9b-q8_0": "v4", "nimble:9b-q4_K_M": "v1", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0": "v2-label"}
ANALYZE_FINALISTS = {
    "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M": ("v1", "v5", "v1-summary-first"),
    "ministral-3:3b": ("v1", "v5", "v1-summary-first"),
    "qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M": ("v1", "v5"),
}
SIGNAL_SCOPES: tuple[Scope, ...] = ("lede", "full")
FINALISTS: tuple[Finalist, ...] = (
    *(Finalist(m, c, s) for m, c in SIGNAL_FINALISTS.items() for s in SIGNAL_SCOPES),
    *(Finalist(m, c, "full") for m, configs in ANALYZE_FINALISTS.items() for c in configs),
)


def finalist_cells(finalists: Sequence[Finalist] = FINALISTS) -> list[tuple[Finalist, RunSpec]]:
    cells = {(c.model, c.name): c for c in grid.grid_cells({f.model for f in finalists})}
    return [(f, cells[(f.model, f.config)]) for f in finalists]


# --- inputs ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArticleInput:
    id: str
    text: str
    label: Sentiment


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Extracted:
    example: ArticleExample
    article: Article | None
    error: str | None = None


def extract_all(examples: Sequence[ArticleExample], paths: ArticlePaths) -> list[Extracted]:
    """The serving extractor on the stored HTML at the final URL, as a live request would see it."""
    out = []
    for example in examples:
        fetched = read_fetched(paths, example.id)
        url = fetched.final_url if fetched and fetched.final_url else example.url
        html = example.html_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            article = extraction.extract(html, url, parser=PARSER, extractor=EXTRACTOR)
        except VtError as exc:
            out.append(Extracted(example, None, exc.code.value))
            continue
        out.append(Extracted(example, article))
    return out


def inputs_for(
    extracted: Sequence[Extracted], scope: Scope, max_input_tokens: int
) -> tuple[list[ArticleInput], dict[str, Any]]:
    """Model inputs plus their identity for the cache key, so an extraction change re-runs the cell."""
    items = [
        ArticleInput(e.example.id, build_input(e.article, scope, max_input_tokens), e.example.label)
        for e in extracted
        if e.article is not None
    ]
    sha = hashlib.sha256(canonical_json([[i.id, i.text] for i in items]).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    identity = {"articles": ARTICLE_SPLIT, "parser": PARSER, "extractor": EXTRACTOR, "scope": scope, "sha": sha}
    return items, identity


# --- run -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def read_manifest(path: Path = MANIFEST) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not path.exists():
        return {"split": ARTICLE_SPLIT, "cells": {}}
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return payload


async def run_finalists(
    client: OllamaClient,
    cells: Sequence[tuple[Finalist, RunSpec]],
    extracted: Sequence[Extracted],
    *,
    concurrency: int = DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
    preds_root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    manifest_path: Path = MANIFEST,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Model by model on a shared Ollama (nothing is unloaded); the manifest is rewritten after every cell."""
    manifest = read_manifest(manifest_path)
    manifest["split"] = ARTICLE_SPLIT
    manifest["ollama_version"] = await client.version()
    manifest["backend"] = get_settings().ollama_backend_label
    for model, group in itertools.groupby(cells, key=lambda fc: fc[1].model):
        digest = await model_digest(client, model)
        prepared = [(f, cell, *inputs_for(extracted, f.scope, cell.spec.max_input_tokens)) for f, cell in group]
        if any(
            not {i.id for i in items} <= cell.cache(CACHE_SPLIT, digest, preds_root, identity).done_ids()
            for _, cell, items, identity in prepared
        ):
            print(f"== {model}: warming up", file=log, flush=True)
            await make_resident(client, prepared[0][1], shared=True, log=log)
        for finalist, cell, items, identity in prepared:
            stats = await run_cell(
                client,
                cell,
                items,
                split=CACHE_SPLIT,
                model_digest=digest,
                concurrency=concurrency,
                root=preds_root,
                inputs=identity,
                log=log,
            )
            records = cell.cache(CACHE_SPLIT, digest, preds_root, identity).records()
            manifest["cells"][finalist.key] = {
                "endpoint": cell.endpoint,
                "model": cell.model,
                "config": cell.name,
                "scope": finalist.scope,
                "variant": cell.variant,
                "prompt_version": cell.prompt.version,
                "prompt_sha": cell.prompt_sha(),
                "run_config": json.loads(canonical_json(cell.run_config(CACHE_SPLIT, identity))),
                "model_digest": digest,
                "cache_key": stats.key,
                "inputs": len(items),
                "extraction_failures": len(extracted) - len(items),
                "done": len(records),
                "errors": sum(1 for r in records.values() if r.get("error") is not None),
                "concurrency": concurrency,
                "shared_ollama": True,
                "updated_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            }
            grid.write_manifest(manifest, manifest_path)
    return manifest


# --- analyze ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Dev300Point:
    """A config's dev300 operating point under one policy: the threshold the articles are scored at."""

    candidate: Candidate
    point: SweepPoint
    cis: Mapping[str, Any]
    best: bool


def dev300_points(models: Sequence[str], n_boot: int, log: TextIO) -> dict[tuple[str, str, str], Dev300Point]:
    """(model, config, policy) -> dev300 operating point, recomputed from the grid caches."""
    dev = grid.dev_set(grid.load_split(grid.GRID_SPLIT))
    inputs = grid.cell_inputs(grid.grid_cells(models), grid.read_manifest(), dev, PREDS_DIR, log)
    out: dict[tuple[str, str, str], Dev300Point] = {}
    for model, group in itertools.groupby(inputs, key=lambda c: c.model):
        cands = candidates(list(group), dev)
        best, _ = best_candidate(grid_only(cands))
        for c in cands:
            point = chosen_point(c, c.evaluation.operating is not None)
            out[(model, c.cell.name, c.evaluation.policy)] = Dev300Point(
                c, point, candidate_cis(c, point, dev, n_boot), c is best
            )
    return out


def article_dev(extracted: Sequence[Extracted]) -> DevSet:
    return DevSet(
        ids=tuple(e.example.id for e in extracted),
        gold=tuple(e.example.label for e in extracted),
        weights=None,
        buckets=tuple(bucket_of(e.article.title) if e.article else "extraction failed" for e in extracted),
    )


def article_cells(
    cells: Sequence[tuple[Finalist, RunSpec]],
    extracted: Sequence[Extracted],
    manifest: Mapping[str, Any],
    dev: DevSet,
    preds_root: Path,
    log: TextIO,
) -> list[tuple[Finalist, CellInput]]:
    out = []
    for finalist, cell in cells:
        entry = manifest.get("cells", {}).get(finalist.key)
        if entry is None:
            print(f"skip {finalist.key}: not run yet", file=log)
            continue
        _, identity = inputs_for(extracted, finalist.scope, cell.spec.max_input_tokens)
        current = json.loads(canonical_json(cell.run_config(CACHE_SPLIT, identity)))
        if entry["prompt_sha"] != cell.prompt_sha() or entry["run_config"] != current:
            print(f"skip {finalist.key}: prompt, config or extraction changed since the run", file=log)
            continue
        records = cell.cache(CACHE_SPLIT, entry["model_digest"], preds_root, identity).records()
        aligned = tuple(records.get(i) for i in dev.ids)
        out.append(
            (
                finalist,
                CellInput(
                    endpoint=cell.endpoint,
                    model=cell.model,
                    name=f"{cell.name} {finalist.scope}",
                    variant=cell.variant,
                    prompt_version=cell.prompt.version,
                    records=aligned,
                    dims=dict(cell.dims),
                    ordinal_t=cell.spec.ordinal_t,
                    meta={
                        "cache_key": entry["cache_key"],
                        "extraction_failures": entry["extraction_failures"],
                    },
                ),
            )
        )
    return out


def _counts(point: SweepPoint) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Raw counts behind the rates; at n=30 a single inversion is 5% of the calls."""
    conf = point.metrics.confusion
    return {
        "directional_calls": sum(row[0] + row[1] for row in conf),
        "inversions": conf[0][1] + conf[1][0],
        "abstained": sum(row[3] for row in conf),
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Scored:
    finalist: Finalist
    cell: CellInput
    policy: EvalPolicy
    candidate: Candidate
    point: SweepPoint
    dev300: Dev300Point
    frozen: bool


def score_cells(
    cells: Sequence[tuple[Finalist, CellInput]], dev: DevSet, d300: Mapping[tuple[str, str, str], Dev300Point]
) -> list[Scored]:
    out = []
    for finalist, cell in cells:
        for i, policy in enumerate(POLICIES[cell.variant]):
            ref = d300.get((finalist.model, finalist.config, policy))
            if ref is None:
                continue
            evaluation = evaluate_policy(policy, cell.records, dev.gold, None, ordinal_t=cell.ordinal_t)
            point = next(p for p in evaluation.sweep if p.threshold == ref.point.threshold)
            # Signal finalists serve the dev300 best rule; /analyze configs have one rule each.
            frozen = ref.best or cell.endpoint == "analyze"
            out.append(Scored(finalist, cell, policy, Candidate(cell, evaluation, i), point, ref, frozen))
    return out


def clear_failure(s: Scored, cis: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    """Only failures the n=30 CI is sure of: the whole inversion CI above the cap, or a coverage collapse."""
    reasons = []
    if cis["inversion_rate"]["low"] > INVERSION_CAP:
        reasons.append(f"inversion CI low {cis['inversion_rate']['low']:.3f} > cap {INVERSION_CAP}")
    if cis["coverage"]["high"] < COLLAPSE_SHARE * s.dev300.point.coverage:
        reasons.append(
            f"coverage CI high {cis['coverage']['high']:.3f} < {COLLAPSE_SHARE} x dev300 {s.dev300.point.coverage:.3f}"
        )
    return reasons


def row_report(s: Scored, dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cis = candidate_cis(s.candidate, s.point, dev, n_boot)
    failure = clear_failure(s, cis) if s.frozen else []
    report: dict[str, Any] = {
        "key": s.finalist.key,
        "endpoint": s.cell.endpoint,
        "model": s.finalist.model,
        "config": s.finalist.config,
        "scope": s.finalist.scope,
        "variant": s.cell.variant,
        "policy": s.policy,
        "prompt_version": s.cell.prompt_version,
        "threshold": s.point.threshold,
        "frozen_rule": s.frozen,
        "articles": {**metrics_dict(s.point.metrics), **_counts(s.point), "cis": cis},
        "dev300": {
            "f05_macro": s.dev300.point.f05_macro,
            "coverage": s.dev300.point.coverage,
            "inversion_rate": s.dev300.point.inversion_rate,
            "cis": s.dev300.cis,
        },
        "counts": counts(s.cell.records),
        "extraction_failures": s.cell.meta.get("extraction_failures", 0),
        "latency": latency(s.cell.records),
        "clear_failure": failure,
    }
    if failure:
        op = select_operating_point(s.candidate.evaluation.sweep)
        report["repick"] = None if op is None else point_row(op)
    return report


def _paired(a: Scored, b: Scored, dev: DevSet, n_boot: int, what: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    boot = paired_f05((a.candidate, a.point), (b.candidate, b.point), dev, n_boot)
    gap = boot["gap"]
    return {
        "comparison": what,
        "a": a.finalist.key + f" ({a.policy})",
        "b": b.finalist.key + f" ({b.policy})",
        "a_f05": boot["a"].point,
        "b_f05": boot["b"].point,
        "gap": {"point": gap.point, "low": gap.low, "high": gap.high},
        "verdict": "a" if gap.low > 0 else "b" if gap.high < 0 else "tie",
    }


def comparisons(scored: Sequence[Scored], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    by = {(s.finalist.model, s.finalist.config, s.finalist.scope, s.policy): s for s in scored}
    out = []
    for s in scored:
        model, config, scope, policy = s.finalist.model, s.finalist.config, s.finalist.scope, s.policy
        if s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and scope == "lede" and s.frozen:
            if (full := by.get((model, config, "full", policy))) is not None:
                out.append(_paired(s, full, dev, n_boot, "scope: lede - full"))
        if s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and policy.endswith("+tau"):
            plain = by.get((model, config, scope, policy.removesuffix("+tau")))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            if plain is not None:
                out.append(_paired(s, plain, dev, n_boot, "rule: tau - plain"))
        if s.cell.endpoint == "analyze" and config != "v1":
            if (v1 := by.get((model, "v1", scope, policy))) is not None:
                what = "field order: summary-first - sentiment-first" if s.cell.variant == "summary-first" else (
                    f"prompt: {config} - v1"
                )
                out.append(_paired(s, v1, dev, n_boot, what))
    return out


def misses(scored: Sequence[Scored], dev: DevSet, extracted: Sequence[Extracted]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """How the frozen rules miss, by title keyword bucket and by source (counts only)."""
    served = []
    for s in scored:
        if not s.frozen or (s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and s.finalist.scope != "lede"):
            continue
        if s.cell.endpoint == "analyze" and s.cell.variant != "sentiment-first":
            continue
        pred, abstained = s.candidate.evaluation.served(s.point.threshold)
        failed = tuple(r is None or r.get("error") is not None for r in s.cell.records)
        served.append(Served(s.finalist.key, tuple(pred), tuple(abstained), failed))
    buckets = sorted(set(dev.buckets))
    sources = tuple(e.example.source for e in extracted)
    by_source = DevSet(dev.ids, dev.gold, None, buckets=sources)
    return {
        "by_title_bucket": error_patterns(served, dev, buckets),
        "by_source": error_patterns(served, by_source, sorted(set(sources)))["buckets"],
    }


def analyze_finalists(
    *,
    n_boot: int = 1000,
    preds_root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    manifest_path: Path = MANIFEST,
    out_dir: Path = OUT_DIR,
    paths: ArticlePaths | None = None,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> list[Path]:
    paths = paths or ArticlePaths()
    extracted = extract_all(load_articles(ARTICLE_SPLIT, paths=paths), paths)
    dev = article_dev(extracted)
    cells = finalist_cells()
    inputs = article_cells(cells, extracted, read_manifest(manifest_path), dev, preds_root, log)
    if not inputs:
        print("nothing to analyze: run the finalists first", file=log)
        return []
    d300 = dev300_points(sorted({f.model for f, _ in inputs}), n_boot, log)
    scored = score_cells(inputs, dev, d300)
    gold = Counter(dev.gold)
    report = rounded(
        {
            "split": ARTICLE_SPLIT,
            "n": len(dev.ids),
            "gold": {k: gold.get(k, 0) for k in ("bullish", "bearish", "neutral")},
            "weights": None,
            "extraction": {
                "parser": PARSER,
                "extractor": EXTRACTOR,
                "failures": sum(e.article is None for e in extracted),
                "failure_codes": dict(Counter(e.error for e in extracted if e.error)),
            },
            "inversion_cap": INVERSION_CAP,
            "collapse_share": COLLAPSE_SHARE,
            "n_boot": n_boot,
            "generated_by": "uv run python -m veritrade_evals finalists analyze",
            "rows": [row_report(s, dev, n_boot) for s in scored],
            "comparisons": comparisons(scored, dev, n_boot),
            "misses": misses(scored, dev, extracted),
        }
    )
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    json_path = out_dir / "summary.json"
    json_path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    md_path = out_dir / "summary.md"
    manifest = read_manifest(manifest_path)
    md_path.write_text(render(report, manifest), encoding="utf-8")
    return [json_path, md_path]


# --- markdown --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _pct(x: float | None) -> str:
    return "-" if x is None else f"{100 * x:.0f}%"


def _ci(ci: Mapping[str, float] | None, digits: int = 3) -> str:
    if ci is None or ci.get("point") is None:
        return "-"
    return f"{ci['point']:.{digits}f} [{ci['low']:.{digits}f}, {ci['high']:.{digits}f}]"


def _num(x: float | None) -> str:
    return "-" if x is None else f"{x:.2f}"


def _table(header: Sequence[str], rows: Sequence[Sequence[str]]) -> list[str]:
    return [
        "| " + " | ".join(header) + " |",
        "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in header) + "|",
        *("| " + " | ".join(row) + " |" for row in rows),
    ]


def _metric_row(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    a = row["articles"]
    pc = a["per_class"]
    return [
        _ci(a["cis"]["f05_macro"]),
        f"{_num(pc['bullish']['precision'])} / {_num(pc['bullish']['recall'])}",
        f"{_num(pc['bearish']['precision'])} / {_num(pc['bearish']['recall'])}",
        f"{a['inversions']}/{a['directional_calls']}",
        _pct(a["coverage"]),
        _ci(row["dev300"]["cis"].get("f05_macro")),
    ]


def _confusion(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    counts_ = row["articles"]["confusion"]["counts"]
    return " ; ".join("/".join(str(v) for v in r) for r in counts_)


def render(report: Mapping[str, Any], manifest: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    gold = report["gold"]
    ext = report["extraction"]
    rows = report["rows"]
    signal = [r for r in rows if r["endpoint"] == "signal"]
    analyze = [r for r in rows if r["endpoint"] == "analyze"]
    concurrency = sorted({e.get("concurrency") for e in manifest.get("cells", {}).values()} - {None})
    lines = [
        "# Grid finalists on the articles dev set",
        "",
        "Generated by `uv run python -m veritrade_evals finalists analyze` from the local prediction cache; "
        "counts and rates only, no article text.",
        "",
        f"- Data: the articles dev split, n={report['n']} news articles labelled for their primary entity "
        f"(bullish {gold['bullish']}, bearish {gold['bearish']}, neutral {gold['neutral']}). Balanced and "
        "unweighted: unlike dev300, rates are not reweighted to a class prior.",
        f"- Inputs: the serving path. `{ext['extractor']}` extraction with `{ext['parser']}` on the stored HTML "
        "at the fetch's final URL, then the endpoint scope (headline + lede, or the full body) cut to each "
        f"model's `max_input_tokens`. Extraction failures: {ext['failures']} (no call; scored as abstentions).",
        "- Thresholds: each config's dev300 operating point (max F0.5 with inversions <= "
        f"{report['inversion_cap']:.0%}), never re-tuned here. A rule counts as clearly failing only when the "
        "whole 95% CI of its inversion rate is above the cap, or the whole coverage CI is below "
        f"{report['collapse_share']:.0%} of its dev300 coverage.",
        f"- CIs: 95% stratified bootstrap (B={report['n_boot']}). With 10 articles per class they are wide: "
        "a gap needs roughly 0.2 F0.5 to clear zero, so most comparisons below are ties.",
        f"- Latency: wall ms per call on an Ollama {manifest.get('ollama_version', '?')} "
        f"{manifest.get('backend', '?')} shared with other eval runs (client concurrency "
        f"{', '.join(str(c) for c in concurrency) or '?'}); indicative only.",
        "",
        "## /signal finalists",
        "",
        "Frozen = the dev300 best rule for the model. P / R are precision / recall; inversions are raw "
        "bullish<->bearish calls over directional calls.",
        "",
    ]
    header = [
        "model", "config", "rule", "threshold (dev300)", "scope", "frozen", "F0.5 [95% CI]", "bull P / R",
        "bear P / R", "inversions", "coverage", "dev300 F0.5 [95% CI]", "p50 ms",
    ]  # fmt: skip
    lines += _table(
        header,
        [
            [
                f"`{r['model']}`",
                r["config"],
                r["policy"],
                threshold_text(r["policy"], r["threshold"]),
                r["scope"],
                "yes" if r["frozen_rule"] else "",
                *_metric_row(r)[:5],
                _metric_row(r)[5],
                "-" if r["latency"]["wall_ms_p50"] is None else f"{r['latency']['wall_ms_p50']:.0f}",
            ]
            for r in signal
        ],
    )
    lines += ["", "## /analyze (full article, ordinal |score| >= t)", ""]
    header = [
        "model", "config", "order", "threshold (dev300)", "F0.5 [95% CI]", "bull P / R", "bear P / R",
        "inversions", "coverage", "dev300 F0.5 [95% CI]", "p50 ms",
    ]  # fmt: skip
    lines += _table(
        header,
        [
            [
                f"`{r['model']}`",
                r["config"],
                r["variant"],
                threshold_text(r["policy"], r["threshold"]),
                *_metric_row(r),
                "-" if r["latency"]["wall_ms_p50"] is None else f"{r['latency']['wall_ms_p50']:.0f}",
            ]
            for r in analyze
        ],
    )
    lines += [
        "",
        "/analyze latency is time to the score: sentiment-first stops the stream there, summary-first "
        "has to generate the whole summary first.",
        "",
        "## Paired comparisons (same 30 articles, paired bootstrap on the F0.5 gap)",
        "",
    ]
    lines += _table(
        ["comparison", "a", "b", "F0.5 a", "F0.5 b", "gap a - b [95% CI]", "verdict"],
        [
            [
                c["comparison"],
                c["a"],
                c["b"],
                f"{c['a_f05']:.3f}",
                f"{c['b_f05']:.3f}",
                f"{c['gap']['point']:+.3f} [{c['gap']['low']:+.3f}, {c['gap']['high']:+.3f}]",
                {"a": "a wins", "b": "b wins", "tie": "tie"}[c["verdict"]],
            ]
            for c in report["comparisons"]
        ],
    )
    lines += [
        "",
        "## Confusion matrices (raw counts)",
        "",
        "Rows gold bullish ; bearish ; neutral, each as predicted bullish/bearish/neutral/abstained.",
        "",
    ]
    lines += _table(
        ["finalist", "rule", "confusion"],
        [[r["key"], r["policy"], _confusion(r)] for r in rows],
    )
    failures = [r for r in rows if r["clear_failure"]]
    lines += ["", "## Clear-failure check on the frozen rules", ""]
    if not failures:
        lines.append("No frozen rule clearly fails on the articles, so every dev300 operating point stands.")
    for r in failures:
        repick = r.get("repick")
        lines.append(
            f"- {r['key']} ({r['policy']}): {'; '.join(r['clear_failure'])}. Articles re-pick: "
            + ("none meets the cap" if repick is None else threshold_text(r["policy"], repick["threshold"]))
        )
    lines += ["", "## Misses of the frozen rules (served scope, raw counts)", ""]
    patterns = report["misses"]["by_title_bucket"]
    models = list(patterns["per_model"])
    lines += _table(
        ["finalist", "directional calls", "wrong", "missed bull", "missed bear", "failed"],
        [
            [m, *(str(t[k]) for k in ("directional_calls", "wrong_calls", "bullish_missed", "bearish_missed", "failed"))]
            for m, t in patterns["per_model"].items()
        ],
    )
    for title, buckets in (
        ("By headline keyword bucket (first match wins; heuristic):", patterns["buckets"]),
        ("By source:", report["misses"]["by_source"]),
    ):
        lines += [
            "",
            title,
            "",
            *_table(
                ["group", "n (bull/bear/neu)", *(f"{m} wrong/calls, missed" for m in models)],
                [
                    [
                        name,
                        f"{row['n']} ({row['gold']['bullish']}/{row['gold']['bearish']}/{row['gold']['neutral']})",
                        *(
                            f"{v['wrong_calls']}/{v['directional_calls']}, {v['missed_directional']}"
                            for v in (row["models"][m] for m in models)
                        ),
                    ]
                    for name, row in buckets.items()
                ],
            ),
        ]
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


# --- CLI -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def cmd_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    for finalist, cell in finalist_cells():
        print(f"{cell.endpoint:8s} {finalist.key:50s} {cell.prompt.version}")
    print(f"{len(FINALISTS)} cells on the articles {ARTICLE_SPLIT} split")
    return 0


async def _run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    extracted = extract_all(load_articles(ARTICLE_SPLIT, paths=paths), paths)
    cells = finalist_cells()
    if args.model:
        cells = [fc for fc in cells if fc[1].model in args.model]
    settings = get_settings()
    client = OllamaClient(
        args.base_url or settings.ollama_base_url,
        timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,
        keep_alive=settings.ollama_keep_alive,
    )
    async with client:
        manifest = await run_finalists(
            client,
            cells,
            extracted,
            concurrency=args.concurrency,
            preds_root=args.preds_root,
            manifest_path=args.manifest,
        )
    done = sum(e["done"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    errors = sum(e["errors"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    print(f"finalists: {len(manifest['cells'])} cells, {done} predictions, {errors} errors", file=sys.stderr)
    return 0


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    return asyncio.run(_run(args))


def cmd_analyze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = analyze_finalists(
        n_boot=args.n_boot, preds_root=args.preds_root, manifest_path=args.manifest, out_dir=args.out_dir
    )
    for path in paths:
        print(path)
    return 0 if paths else 1


def add_parser(subparsers: Any) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Registers `finalists` on a parent CLI; dispatch with `run(args)`."""
    parser: argparse.ArgumentParser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "finalists", help="grid finalists on the articles dev set (serving extraction, dev300 thresholds)"
    )
    actions = parser.add_subparsers(dest="finalists_action", required=True)
    actions.add_parser("list", help="print the finalist cells").set_defaults(finalists_func=cmd_list)

    running = actions.add_parser("run", help="run (or resume) the finalists on a shared Ollama")
    running.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    running.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY)
    running.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="Ollama URL (default from settings)")
    running.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    running.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    running.set_defaults(finalists_func=cmd_run)

    analyzing = actions.add_parser("analyze", help="score cached predictions and write evals/results/articles_dev")
    analyzing.add_argument("--n-boot", type=int, default=1000)
    analyzing.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    analyzing.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    analyzing.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=OUT_DIR)
    analyzing.set_defaults(finalists_func=cmd_analyze)
    return parser


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    code: int = args.finalists_func(args)
    return code


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals.finalists", description=__doc__)
    add_parser(parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    return run(parser.parse_args(["finalists", *(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
"""Freeze prompt versions and thresholds into models.toml: `uv run python -m veritrade_evals freeze`.
Reads committed results only (the dev300 grid reports and the articles dev summary), records the frozen set
in evals/results/frozen.json and leaves [defaults] to `select --write`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import re
import sys
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec, parse_models_toml
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry
from veritrade_evals.analysis import TAU_BASE, is_tau
from veritrade_evals.finalists import OUT_DIR as ARTICLES_DIR
from veritrade_evals.grid import GRID_DIR, PLAN
from veritrade_evals.paths import REPO_ROOT, RESULTS_DIR
from veritrade_evals.predcache import model_slug

MODELS_TOML = REPO_ROOT / "backend" / "src" / "veritrade" / "data" / "models.toml"
FROZEN_JSON = RESULTS_DIR / "frozen.json"
# The /analyze revision every analyze model serves, once its accuracy check passes.
ANALYZE_VERSION = "v5"
FIELD_ORDER_CHECK = "v1-summary-first"
# Summary-endpoint models that get the tightened summary prompt without an accuracy gate.
SUMMARY_VERSION = "v2"
SUMMARY_MODELS = ("qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M", "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M")
# Keys the freeze owns, in the order a models.toml table lists them.
KEY_ORDER = (
    "kind", "endpoints", "num_ctx", "max_input_tokens", "num_predict", "signal_schema", "policy", "min_p",
    "ordinal_t", "directional_tau", "field_order", "prompt", "evaluated",
)  # fmt: skip
FROZEN_KEYS = ("signal_schema", "policy", "min_p", "ordinal_t", "directional_tau", "field_order", "prompt")


class FreezeError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Frozen:
    """What one model serves after the freeze, plus the evidence behind each choice."""

    model: str
    values: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    prompt: dict[Endpoint, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    evidence: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


def _read(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not path.exists():
        raise FreezeError(f"{path.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)} is missing; run its analysis first")
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return payload


def grid_report(endpoint: Endpoint, model: str, grid_dir: Path = GRID_DIR) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return _read(grid_dir / f"{endpoint}__{model_slug(model)}.json")


def version_id(prompt_version: str, endpoint: Endpoint, model: str, registry: PromptRegistry) -> str:
    """`v4` from `signal/m/v4@hash`, after checking the prompt file still hashes the same."""
    version = prompt_version.split("/")[-1].split("@")[0]
    if registry.get(endpoint, model, version=version).version != prompt_version:
        raise FreezeError(f"{prompt_version} changed since it was scored; re-run the grid and the finalists")
    return version


def _article_rows(articles: Mapping[str, Any], model: str, config: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [r for r in articles["rows"] if r["model"] == model and r["config"] == config]


def _brief(row: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    a = row["articles"]
    return {
        "scope": row["scope"],
        "policy": row["policy"],
        "threshold": row["threshold"],
        "f05_macro": a["cis"]["f05_macro"],
        "inversions": f"{a['inversions']}/{a['directional_calls']}",
        "coverage": a["coverage"],
        "clear_failure": row["clear_failure"],
    }


def _comparison(articles: Mapping[str, Any], what: str, a_key: str) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    return next(
        (c for c in articles["comparisons"] if c["comparison"] == what and c["a"].startswith(a_key)), None
    )


def freeze_signal(model: str, articles: Mapping[str, Any], registry: PromptRegistry) -> Frozen:
    best = grid_report("signal", model)["best"]
    policy, threshold, variant = best["policy"], float(best["threshold"]), best["variant"]
    rows = [r for r in _article_rows(articles, model, best["config"]) if r["policy"] == policy]
    served = next((r for r in rows if r["scope"] == "lede"), None)
    evidence: dict[str, Any] = {
        "dev300": {"config": best["config"], "policy": policy, "threshold": threshold, **best["cis"]},
        "articles_dev": [_brief(r) for r in rows],
    }
    if served is not None and served["clear_failure"]:
        repick = served.get("repick")
        if repick is None:
            raise FreezeError(f"{model}: the dev300 rule clearly fails on the articles and no re-pick meets the cap")
        threshold = float(repick["threshold"])
        evidence["repicked_on_articles"] = {"threshold": threshold, "because": served["clear_failure"]}
    base = TAU_BASE[policy] if is_tau(policy) else policy
    values: dict[str, Any] = {
        "signal_schema": {"label": "label", "ordinal": "ordinal"}.get(variant),
        "policy": base,
        "min_p": None,
        "directional_tau": None,
    }
    if base == "ordinal":
        values["ordinal_t"] = int(threshold)
    elif is_tau(policy):
        values |= {"min_p": 0.0, "directional_tau": threshold}
    else:
        values["min_p"] = threshold
    version = version_id(best["prompt_version"], "signal", model, registry)
    return Frozen(model, values, {"signal": version}, {"signal": evidence})


def _gate(follow_up: Mapping[str, Any], articles_cmp: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> str | None:
    """Why a follow-up may not be frozen: significantly worse on dev300 or on the articles."""
    if follow_up["verdict"] == "against":
        gap = follow_up["paired_bootstrap"]["gap"]
        return f"dev300 F0.5 gap {gap['point']:+.3f} [{gap['low']:+.3f}, {gap['high']:+.3f}]"
    if articles_cmp is not None and articles_cmp["verdict"] == "b":
        gap = articles_cmp["gap"]
        return f"articles F0.5 gap {gap['point']:+.3f} [{gap['low']:+.3f}, {gap['high']:+.3f}]"
    return None


def freeze_analyze(model: str, articles: Mapping[str, Any], registry: PromptRegistry) -> Frozen:
    report = grid_report("analyze", model)
    follow_ups = {f["config"]: f for f in report.get("follow_ups", ())}
    revision = follow_ups.get(ANALYZE_VERSION)
    if revision is None:
        raise FreezeError(f"{model}: no dev300 result for analyze {ANALYZE_VERSION}; run the grid follow-ups")
    articles_cmp = _comparison(articles, f"prompt: {ANALYZE_VERSION} - v1", f"{model}/{ANALYZE_VERSION}/")
    if (why := _gate(revision, articles_cmp)) is not None:
        raise FreezeError(f"{model}: analyze {ANALYZE_VERSION} is clearly less accurate than v1 ({why})")
    rows = _article_rows(articles, model, ANALYZE_VERSION)
    if any(r["clear_failure"] for r in rows):
        raise FreezeError(f"{model}: analyze {ANALYZE_VERSION} clearly fails on the articles; decide by hand")
    order = "sentiment-first"
    check = follow_ups.get(FIELD_ORDER_CHECK)
    order_cmp = _comparison(articles, "field order: summary-first - sentiment-first", f"{model}/")
    # Summary-first gives up the early score, so it has to win on dev300 and not lose on the articles.
    if check is not None and check["verdict"] == "follow-up" and (order_cmp is None or order_cmp["verdict"] != "b"):
        order = "summary-first"
    evidence = {
        "dev300": {
            "config": ANALYZE_VERSION,
            "threshold": revision["threshold"],
            "f05_macro": revision["paired_bootstrap"]["follow_up"],
            "gap_vs_v1": revision["paired_bootstrap"]["gap"],
        },
        "articles_dev": [_brief(r) for r in rows],
        "articles_gap_vs_v1": None if articles_cmp is None else articles_cmp["gap"],
        "field_order": {
            "dev300_gap_summary_first": None if check is None else check["paired_bootstrap"]["gap"],
            "articles_gap_summary_first": None if order_cmp is None else order_cmp["gap"],
            "chosen": order,
        },
    }
    version = version_id(revision["prompt_version"], "analyze", model, registry)
    values = {"policy": "ordinal", "ordinal_t": int(revision["threshold"]), "field_order": order}
    return Frozen(model, values, {"analyze": version}, {"analyze": evidence})


def frozen_set(articles: Mapping[str, Any], registry: PromptRegistry | None = None) -> dict[str, Frozen]:
    registry = registry or PromptRegistry()
    out: dict[str, Frozen] = {}
    for plan in PLAN:
        endpoint: Endpoint = "analyze" if plan.variants[0] in ("sentiment-first", "summary-first") else "signal"
        freeze = freeze_analyze if endpoint == "analyze" else freeze_signal
        out[plan.model] = freeze(plan.model, articles, registry)
    for model in SUMMARY_MODELS:
        frozen = out.setdefault(model, Frozen(model))
        registry.get("summary", model, version=SUMMARY_VERSION)
        frozen.prompt["summary"] = SUMMARY_VERSION
        frozen.evidence["summary"] = "tightened summary rule; quality is scored by the summary eval"
    return out


# --- models.toml -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def toml_value(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return "true" if value else "false"
    if isinstance(value, int | float):
        return repr(value)
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return json.dumps(value)
    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
        return "{ " + ", ".join(f"{k} = {toml_value(v)}" for k, v in value.items()) + " }"
    raise TypeError(f"cannot write {value!r} to models.toml")


_KEY = re.compile(r"^([A-Za-z_]+)\s*=")


def set_keys(text: str, model: str, values: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Rewrites only the given keys inside one model's table (None removes a key); comments survive."""
    lines = text.split("\n")
    header = f'[models."{model}"]'
    if header not in lines:
        raise FreezeError(f"{model} has no table in models.toml")
    start = lines.index(header) + 1
    end = next((i for i in range(start, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith("[")), len(lines))
    while end > start and not lines[end - 1].strip():
        end -= 1
    block = lines[start:end]
    for key, value in values.items():
        keys = [m.group(1) if (m := _KEY.match(line)) else None for line in block]
        if key in keys:
            i = keys.index(key)
            if value is None:
                del block[i]
            else:
                block[i] = f"{key} = {toml_value(value)}"
        elif value is not None:
            rank = KEY_ORDER.index(key)
            after = [i for i, k in enumerate(keys) if k in KEY_ORDER and KEY_ORDER.index(k) < rank]
            block.insert(after[-1] + 1 if after else len(block), f"{key} = {toml_value(value)}")
    return "\n".join([*lines[:start], *block, *lines[end:]])


def _defaults_block(text: str) -> str:
    lines = text.split("\n")
    start = lines.index("[defaults]")
    end = next(i for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)) if lines[i].startswith("["))
    return "\n".join(lines[start:end])


def apply(text: str, frozen: Mapping[str, Frozen]) -> str:
    out = text
    current, _ = parse_models_toml(text)
    for model, f in frozen.items():
        prompt = {**current[model].prompt, **f.prompt}
        out = set_keys(out, model, {**f.values, "prompt": prompt or None})
    specs, _ = parse_models_toml(out)
    if _defaults_block(out) != _defaults_block(text):
        raise FreezeError("the freeze must not change [defaults]")
    for model, f in frozen.items():
        _check(specs[model], f)
    return out


def _check(spec: ModelSpec, frozen: Frozen) -> None:
    for key, value in frozen.values.items():
        if getattr(spec, key) != value:
            raise FreezeError(f"{spec.name}: {key} reads back as {getattr(spec, key)!r}, not {value!r}")
    for endpoint, version in frozen.prompt.items():
        if spec.prompt.get(endpoint) != version:
            raise FreezeError(f"{spec.name}: prompt for /{endpoint} did not stick")


def frozen_json(frozen: Mapping[str, Frozen], text: str, registry: PromptRegistry) -> dict[str, Any]:
    specs, defaults = parse_models_toml(text)
    models: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for model, f in frozen.items():
        spec = specs[model]
        models[model] = {
            endpoint: {
                "prompt": spec.prompt.get(endpoint),
                "prompt_version": registry.get(endpoint, model, version=spec.prompt.get(endpoint)).version,
                **(
                    {k: getattr(spec, k) for k in FROZEN_KEYS if k != "prompt"}
                    if endpoint != "summary"
                    else {}
                ),
                "evidence": f.evidence.get(endpoint),
            }
            for endpoint in spec.endpoints
            if endpoint in f.prompt
        }
    return {
        "generated_by": "uv run python -m veritrade_evals freeze",
        "sources": {
            "dev300": str(GRID_DIR.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)),
            "articles_dev": str((ARTICLES_DIR / "summary.json").relative_to(REPO_ROOT)),
        },
        "rules": {
            "signal": "dev300 best rule (max F0.5 with inversions <= 2%); re-picked on the articles only when "
            "the whole inversion CI is over the cap or coverage collapses",
            "analyze": f"{ANALYZE_VERSION} unless clearly less accurate than v1 on dev300 or the articles; t from "
            f"its own dev300 operating point; summary-first only if it wins on dev300 and does not lose on "
            "the articles",
            "summary": f"{SUMMARY_VERSION} for {', '.join(SUMMARY_MODELS)}",
        },
        "defaults_untouched": defaults,
        "models": models,
    }


# --- CLI -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def cmd_freeze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    articles = _read(args.articles)
    registry = PromptRegistry()
    frozen = frozen_set(articles, registry)
    before = MODELS_TOML.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    after = apply(before, frozen)
    for model, f in frozen.items():
        print(f"{model}: {', '.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in {**f.values, 'prompt': f.prompt}.items())}")
    if args.dry_run:
        print("dry run: models.toml unchanged" if after == before else "dry run: models.toml would change")
        return 0
    MODELS_TOML.write_text(after, encoding="utf-8")
    payload = frozen_json(frozen, after, registry)
    args.out.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote {MODELS_TOML.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)} and {args.out.relative_to(REPO_ROOT)}")
    return 0


def add_parser(subparsers: Any) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Registers `freeze` on a parent CLI; dispatch with `run(args)`."""
    parser: argparse.ArgumentParser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "freeze", help="write frozen prompt versions and thresholds into models.toml"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--articles", type=Path, default=ARTICLES_DIR / "summary.json")
    parser.add_argument("--out", type=Path, default=FROZEN_JSON)
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="print the frozen set without writing")
    return parser


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    try:
        return cmd_freeze(args)
    except FreezeError as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals.freeze", description=__doc__)
    add_parser(parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    return run(parser.parse_args(["freeze", *(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

```python
class Command(Protocol):

""",
```

```python
@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["decision", "label"])
def test_tau_replay_matches_the_serving_policy(kind: str) -> None:
    grid = [0.0, 0.05, 0.125, 0.25, 1 / 3, 0.4, 0.5, 0.75]
    rows = [(b, r) for b, r in itertools.product(grid, grid) if b + r <= 1]

        )

def test_tau_replay_keeps_fallbacks_and_failures() -> None:

    assert replay_tau(None) == ("neutral", -math.inf)
    # Without probabilities serving ends at the ordinal policy, so tau never applies.
    assert replay_tau({"kind": "label", "probs": None, "score": -1}) == ("bearish", math.inf)
    assert replay_tau({"kind": "label", "probs": None, "score": 1}, ordinal_t=2) == ("bullish", -math.inf)
    assert replay_tau({"kind": "label", "probs": None, "score": 0}) == ("neutral", math.inf)
    side, p = replay_tau(_label(0.1, 0.3))
    assert side == "bearish"
    assert p == pytest.approx(0.3)
    assert replay_tau(_label(0.5, 0.1)) == ("bullish", math.inf)


def test_tau_recovers_calls_the_plain_rule_never_makes() -> None:
    # Neutral leads everywhere, so every plain threshold makes zero calls.
    cell = make_cell(
        "label",
        [_label(0.4, 0), _label(0.2, 0), _label(0, 0.45), _label(0.1, 0.3), _label(0.05, 0.05), _label(0.3, 0)],
    )
    cands = candidates([cell], DEV)
    report = tau_report(cands, DEV, n_boot=50)
    assert report is not None
    # From tau 0.06 to 0.2: bull calls e0 e1 e5 (P 2/3, R 1 -> 5/7), bear calls e2 e3 (F0.5 1).
    assert (report["tau"]["policy"], report["tau"]["threshold"]) == ("label-logprob+tau", 0.06)
    assert report["tau"]["f05_macro"] == pytest.approx((5 / 7 + 1) / 2)
    # Below tau the row is a served neutral, not an abstention.
    assert report["tau"]["coverage"] == 1.0
    assert report["paired_bootstrap"]["plain"]["point"] == 0.0
    assert report["verdict"] == "tau"
    best = best_report(cands, DEV, n_boot=20)
    assert (best["policy"], best["threshold"]) == ("label-logprob+tau", 0.06)
    assert tau_report(candidates([make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(1)] * 6)], DEV), DEV, 10) is None
    assert min(TAU_THRESHOLDS) > 0
    assert max(TAU_THRESHOLDS) < 1


def test_follow_ups_are_compared_but_never_selected() -> None:
    v1 = make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(s) for s in (2, 0, -2, 0, 0, 0)], "v1")
    better = make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(s) for s in (2, 1, -2, -1, 0, 0)], "v5", against="v1")
    cands = candidates([v1, better], DEV)

    (row,) = follow_up_report(cands, DEV, n_boot=50)
    assert (row["config"], row["against"]["config"]) == ("v5", "v1")
    assert row["f05_macro"] == 1.0
    assert row["paired_bootstrap"]["gap"]["point"] == pytest.approx(1.0 - row["against"]["f05_macro"])
    orphan = make_cell("sentiment-first", [analyze(0)] * 6, "v6", against="v9")
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from veritrade.api.contracts import AnalyzeRequest, SignalRequest
from veritrade.extract.types import Article
from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals import finalists, grid
from veritrade_evals.analysis import (
    CellInput,
    DevSet,
    best_candidate,
    candidate_cis,
    candidates,
    chosen_point,
    rounded,
)
from veritrade_evals.articles import ArticleExample
from veritrade_evals.finalists import Dev300Point, Extracted, Finalist

GOLD: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("bullish", "bullish", "bearish", "bearish", "neutral", "neutral")
DEV = DevSet(tuple(f"art-{i}" for i in range(6)), GOLD, None, buckets=("price move",) * 3 + ("other",) * 3)
MODEL = "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0"


def test_inputs_follow_the_serving_request_defaults() -> None:
    assert finalists.PARSER == SignalRequest.model_fields["parser"].default
    assert finalists.EXTRACTOR == SignalRequest.model_fields["extractor"].default
    assert SignalRequest.model_fields["scope"].default in finalists.SIGNAL_SCOPES
    assert {f.scope for f in finalists.FINALISTS if f.model in finalists.ANALYZE_FINALISTS} == {
        AnalyzeRequest.model_fields["scope"].default
    }


def test_finalists_are_grid_cells_grouped_by_model() -> None:
    cells = finalists.finalist_cells()
    assert len(cells) == len(finalists.FINALISTS) == 14
    for finalist, cell in cells:
        assert cell.name == finalist.config
        assert cell.endpoint == ("signal" if finalist.model in finalists.SIGNAL_FINALISTS else "analyze")
    order = [cell.model for _, cell in cells]
    assert order == sorted(order, key=list(dict.fromkeys(order)).index)
    assert finalists.CACHE_SPLIT != grid.GRID_SPLIT


def _example(i: int, label: Sentiment) -> ArticleExample:
    return ArticleExample(
        id=f"art-{i}",
        source="bbc",
        url=f"https://example.test/{i}",
        label=label,
        score=0.0,
        entity="Acme",
        ticker=None,
        key_facts=(),
        gold_text="",
        html_path=Path("unused.html"),
        split="dev",
    )


def _article(title: str, paragraphs: tuple[str, ...]) -> Article:
    return Article(
        url="https://example.test",
        title=title,
        paragraphs=paragraphs,
        published_at=None,
        source=None,
        method="cascade",
        parser="selectolax",
        extractor="cascade",
        parse_ms=0.0,
        extract_ms=0.0,
    )


def test_inputs_carry_an_identity_that_re_keys_the_cache() -> None:
    body = tuple(f"Paragraph {i} about Acme results and the outlook for next year." for i in range(12))
    extracted = [
        Extracted(_example(0, "bullish"), _article("Acme beats", body)),
        Extracted(_example(1, "neutral"), None, "extraction_empty"),
    ]
    lede, lede_id = finalists.inputs_for(extracted, "lede", 3000)
    full, full_id = finalists.inputs_for(extracted, "full", 3000)
    assert [i.id for i in lede] == [i.id for i in full] == ["art-0"]
    assert lede[0].text.startswith("TITLE: Acme beats")
    assert len(lede[0].text) < len(full[0].text)
    assert lede_id["sha"] != full_id["sha"]
    assert {k: lede_id[k] for k in ("articles", "parser", "extractor", "scope")} == {
        "articles": "dev",
        "parser": "selectolax",
        "extractor": "cascade",
        "scope": "lede",
    }
    edited = [Extracted(extracted[0].example, _article("Acme misses", body))]
    assert finalists.inputs_for(edited, "lede", 3000)[1]["sha"] != lede_id["sha"]


def _label(bull: float, bear: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    probs = {"bullish": bull, "bearish": bear, "neutral": 1 - bull - bear}
    return {"kind": "label", "fallback": "none", "label": "neutral", "probs": probs, "t": {"wall_ms": 10.0}}


def _cell(name: str, records: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> CellInput:
    return CellInput("signal", MODEL, name, "label", f"signal/{MODEL}/v2@0", tuple(records))


def _dev300(cell: CellInput) -> dict[tuple[str, str, str], Dev300Point]:
    """A neutral-leaning model whose dev300 best is the tau rule."""
    cands = candidates([cell], DEV)
    best, _ = best_candidate(cands)
    out = {}
    for c in cands:
        point = chosen_point(c, c.evaluation.operating is not None)
        cis = candidate_cis(c, point, DEV, 20)
        out[(MODEL, "v2-label", c.evaluation.policy)] = Dev300Point(c, point, cis, c is best)
    return out


LEANING = [_label(0.4, 0), _label(0.2, 0), _label(0, 0.45), _label(0.1, 0.3), _label(0.05, 0.05), _label(0.3, 0)]


def test_articles_are_scored_at_the_dev300_thresholds_and_checked_for_clear_failures() -> None:
    d300 = _dev300(_cell("v2-label", LEANING))
    tau = d300[(MODEL, "v2-label", "label-logprob+tau")]
    assert tau.best
    # On the articles the lede reads like dev300; the full body flips every directional call.
    inverted = [_label(0, 0.3), _label(0, 0.3), _label(0.3, 0), _label(0.3, 0), _label(0, 0), _label(0, 0)]
    cells = [
        (Finalist(MODEL, "v2-label", "lede"), _cell("v2-label lede", LEANING)),
        (Finalist(MODEL, "v2-label", "full"), _cell("v2-label full", inverted)),
    ]
    scored = finalists.score_cells(cells, DEV, d300)
    assert [(s.finalist.scope, s.policy, s.frozen) for s in scored] == [
        ("lede", "label-logprob", False),
        ("lede", "label-logprob+tau", True),
        ("full", "label-logprob", False),
        ("full", "label-logprob+tau", True),
    ]
    assert all(s.point.threshold == d300[(MODEL, "v2-label", s.policy)].point.threshold for s in scored)

    rows = {(r["scope"], r["policy"]): r for r in (finalists.row_report(s, DEV, 50) for s in scored)}
    lede = rows[("lede", "label-logprob+tau")]
    assert lede["articles"]["f05_macro"] == tau.point.f05_macro
    assert lede["clear_failure"] == []
    full = rows[("full", "label-logprob+tau")]
    assert (full["articles"]["inversions"], full["articles"]["directional_calls"]) == (4, 4)
    assert full["clear_failure"] and "inversion CI low" in full["clear_failure"][0]
    assert full["repick"] is None
    # Plain rules are reported but never checked: they are not what the model serves.
    assert rows[("full", "label-logprob")]["clear_failure"] == []

    what = [c["comparison"] for c in finalists.comparisons(scored, DEV, 50)]
    assert what == ["scope: lede - full", "rule: tau - plain", "rule: tau - plain"]


def test_misses_and_markdown_use_the_frozen_rule_at_the_served_scope() -> None:
    d300 = _dev300(_cell("v2-label", LEANING))
    cells = [
        (Finalist(MODEL, "v2-label", scope), _cell(f"v2-label {scope}", LEANING)) for scope in ("lede", "full")
    ]
    scored = finalists.score_cells(cells, DEV, d300)
    extracted = [Extracted(_example(i, g), None) for i, g in enumerate(GOLD)]
    misses = finalists.misses(scored, DEV, extracted)
    assert list(misses["by_title_bucket"]["per_model"]) == [f"{MODEL}/v2-label/lede"]
    assert misses["by_source"]["bbc"]["n"] == 6
    report = rounded(
        {
            "n": 6,
            "gold": {"bullish": 2, "bearish": 2, "neutral": 2},
            "extraction": {"parser": "selectolax", "extractor": "cascade", "failures": 0},
            "inversion_cap": 0.02,
            "collapse_share": 0.5,
            "n_boot": 50,
            "rows": [finalists.row_report(s, DEV, 50) for s in scored],
            "comparisons": finalists.comparisons(scored, DEV, 50),
            "misses": misses,
        }
    )
    md = finalists.render(report, {"ollama_version": "0.40.6", "backend": "native", "cells": {}})
    for heading in ("## /signal finalists", "## Paired comparisons", "## Clear-failure check", "## Misses"):
        assert heading in md
    assert "No frozen rule clearly fails" in md
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import tomllib
from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade.models_registry import parse_models_toml, read_models_toml
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry
from veritrade_evals import freeze
from veritrade_evals.freeze import FreezeError, Frozen

TABLE = """# header comment
[defaults]
signal = "a"

[models."a"]
kind = "decision"
policy = "probability"
min_p = 0.5
ordinal_t = 1
evaluated = false  # kept

[models."b"]
kind = "generative"
"""


def test_set_keys_touches_only_the_named_table_and_keys() -> None:
    out = freeze.set_keys(
        TABLE, "a", {"min_p": 0.0, "directional_tau": 0.28, "prompt": {"signal": "v2"}, "evaluated": None}
    )
    assert out.splitlines() == [
        "# header comment",
        "[defaults]",
        'signal = "a"',
        "",
        '[models."a"]',
        'kind = "decision"',
        'policy = "probability"',
        "min_p = 0.0",
        "ordinal_t = 1",
        "directional_tau = 0.28",
        'prompt = { signal = "v2" }',
        "",
        '[models."b"]',
        'kind = "generative"',
    ]
    assert tomllib.loads(out)["models"]["a"]["prompt"] == {"signal": "v2"}
    kept = freeze.set_keys(TABLE, "a", {"field_order": "sentiment-first"})
    assert "evaluated = false  # kept" in kept
    with pytest.raises(FreezeError, match="no table"):
        freeze.set_keys(TABLE, "c", {"min_p": 0.5})


def _frozen() -> dict[str, Frozen]:
    return {
        "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0": Frozen(
            "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0",
            {"signal_schema": "label", "policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": 0.0, "directional_tau": 0.28},
            {"signal": "v2"},
        ),
        "clef-flash:9b-q8_0": Frozen(
            "clef-flash:9b-q8_0",
            {"signal_schema": None, "policy": "probability", "min_p": 0.8, "directional_tau": None},
            {"signal": "v4"},
        ),
        "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M": Frozen(
            "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M",
            {"policy": "ordinal", "ordinal_t": 1, "field_order": "sentiment-first"},
            {"analyze": "v5", "summary": "v2"},
        ),
    }


def test_apply_round_trips_through_the_registry_and_keeps_defaults() -> None:
    text = read_models_toml()
    out = freeze.apply(text, _frozen())
    specs, defaults = parse_models_toml(out)
    assert defaults == parse_models_toml(text)[1]
    qwen = specs["qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0"]
    assert (qwen.min_p, qwen.directional_tau, qwen.prompt) == (0.0, 0.28, {"signal": "v2"})
    assert specs["qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M"].prompt == {"analyze": "v5", "summary": "v2"}
    assert specs["clef-flash:9b-q8_0"].min_p == 0.8
    assert freeze.apply(out, _frozen()) == out
    untouched = ("tev1:0.8b-q8_0", "qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M")
    assert all(specs[m] == parse_models_toml(text)[0][m] for m in untouched)


def _best(policy: str, threshold: float, variant: str = "label") -> dict[str, Any]:
    prompt = PromptRegistry().get("signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", version="v2").version
    cis = {"f05_macro": {"point": 0.7, "low": 0.6, "high": 0.8}}
    return {
        "best": {
            "config": "v2-label",
            "variant": variant,
            "policy": policy,
            "threshold": threshold,
            "prompt_version": prompt,
            "cis": cis,
        }
    }


def _article_row(scope: str, policy: str, failure: list[str], repick: Any = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    row = {
        "model": "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0",
        "config": "v2-label",
        "scope": scope,
        "policy": policy,
        "threshold": 0.28,
        "articles": {"cis": {"f05_macro": {}}, "inversions": 0, "directional_calls": 5, "coverage": 1.0},
        "clear_failure": failure,
    }
    return row | ({"repick": repick} if failure else {})


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("policy", "threshold", "expected"),
    [
        ("label-logprob+tau", 0.28, {"policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": 0.0, "directional_tau": 0.28}),
        ("label-logprob", 0.0, {"policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": 0.0, "directional_tau": None}),
        ("label-logprob", 0.62, {"policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": 0.62, "directional_tau": None}),
    ],
)
def test_signal_freeze_maps_the_dev300_rule(
    policy: str, threshold: float, expected: dict[str, Any], monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(freeze, "grid_report", lambda endpoint, model: _best(policy, threshold))
    articles = {"rows": [_article_row("lede", policy, [])], "comparisons": []}
    frozen = freeze.freeze_signal("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", articles, PromptRegistry())
    assert {k: frozen.values[k] for k in expected} == expected
    assert frozen.values["signal_schema"] == "label"
    assert frozen.prompt == {"signal": "v2"}


def test_signal_freeze_re_picks_only_on_a_clear_failure(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(freeze, "grid_report", lambda endpoint, model: _best("label-logprob+tau", 0.28))
    failing = _article_row("lede", "label-logprob+tau", ["inversion CI low 0.05 > cap 0.02"], {"threshold": 0.4})
    frozen = freeze.freeze_signal("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", {"rows": [failing], "comparisons": []}, PromptRegistry())
    assert frozen.values["directional_tau"] == 0.4
    assert frozen.evidence["signal"]["repicked_on_articles"]["threshold"] == 0.4
    hopeless = _article_row("lede", "label-logprob+tau", ["coverage collapse"], None)
    with pytest.raises(FreezeError, match="no re-pick"):
        freeze.freeze_signal("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", {"rows": [hopeless], "comparisons": []}, PromptRegistry())
    # The full-body scope is reported, but /signal serves the lede.
    full = _article_row("full", "label-logprob+tau", ["inversion CI low 0.05 > cap 0.02"], None)
    frozen = freeze.freeze_signal("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", {"rows": [full], "comparisons": []}, PromptRegistry())
    assert frozen.values["directional_tau"] == 0.28


def _analyze_report(v5_verdict: str, order_verdict: str | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    registry = PromptRegistry()
    gap = {"point": 0.02, "low": -0.01, "high": 0.05}

    def follow_up(config: str, version: str, verdict: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        prompt = registry.get("analyze", "ministral-3:3b", version=version).version
        boot = {"follow_up": gap, "against": gap, "gap": gap}
        return {"config": config, "threshold": 1.0, "prompt_version": prompt, "verdict": verdict, "paired_bootstrap": boot}

    rows = [follow_up("v5", "v5", v5_verdict)]
    if order_verdict is not None:
        rows.append(follow_up("v1-summary-first", "v1", order_verdict))
    return {"follow_ups": rows}


def _comparison(what: str, a: str, verdict: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"comparison": what, "a": a, "verdict": verdict, "gap": {"point": 0.0, "low": -0.1, "high": 0.1}}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("v5", "articles_v5", "order", "articles_order", "expected"),
    [
        ("tie", "tie", "tie", "tie", "sentiment-first"),
        ("follow-up", "a", "follow-up", "tie", "summary-first"),
        ("tie", "tie", "follow-up", "b", "sentiment-first"),
        ("against", "tie", "tie", "tie", FreezeError),
        ("tie", "b", "tie", "tie", FreezeError),
    ],
)
def test_analyze_freeze_gates_the_revision_and_the_field_order(
    v5: str,
    articles_v5: str,
    order: str,
    articles_order: str,
    expected: Any,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(freeze, "grid_report", lambda endpoint, model: _analyze_report(v5, order))
    articles = {
        "rows": [],
        "comparisons": [
            _comparison("prompt: v5 - v1", "ministral-3:3b/v5/full (ordinal)", articles_v5),
            _comparison(
                "field order: summary-first - sentiment-first",
                "ministral-3:3b/v1-summary-first/full (ordinal)",
                articles_order,
            ),
        ],
    }
    if expected is FreezeError:
        with pytest.raises(FreezeError, match="clearly less accurate"):
            freeze.freeze_analyze("ministral-3:3b", articles, PromptRegistry())
        return
    frozen = freeze.freeze_analyze("ministral-3:3b", articles, PromptRegistry())
    assert frozen.values == {"policy": "ordinal", "ordinal_t": 1, "field_order": expected}
    assert frozen.prompt == {"analyze": "v5"}


def test_a_stale_prompt_hash_refuses_to_freeze() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(FreezeError, match="changed since it was scored"):
        freeze.version_id("signal/qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0/v2@00000000", "signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", PromptRegistry())
```

```python
"""One-off: explicit module mapping in the CLI dispatch test."""

from pathlib import Path

path = Path("evals/tests/unit/test_cli.py")

start = src.index("@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    \"argv\",")
end = src.index('@pytest.mark.parametrize("command", sorted(cli.PLANNED))')
src = (
    src[:start]

    ("argv", "module"),
    [
        (["grid", "list"], grid),
        (["finalists", "list"], finalists),
        (["freeze", "--dry-run"], freeze),
        (["extraction", "list"], extraction_bench),
        (["summary", "report", "--split", "dev"], summary_eval),
    ],
)
def test_wired_commands_dispatch_to_their_module(argv: list[str], module: cli.Command) -> None:
    assert cli.build_parser().parse_args(argv).func is module.run
    assert argv[0] not in cli.PLANNED


'''
    + src[end:]
)
src = src.replace(

    1,
)
path.write_text(src)
print("ok")

```
```
## Notes from the error-analysis read

Hand-written after reading the tables above; counts and my own descriptions only, no dataset text. These are
tweets, not articles: the thresholds and latencies here are a starting point for the article dev set, not a
substitute for it.

**A decoding fix came out of this grid.** The qwen3.5 Modelfiles ship `presence_penalty 1.5`, and the client
only pinned temperature and seed, so "greedy" qwen3.5 output was pushed away from any token in the recent
context. With four shots whose last answer is neutral (or score 0), the generated qwen3.5:0.8b label disagreed
with its own first-token argmax on 84/300 (v2) and 62/300 (v4) tweets, and v2-ordinal emitted -2 for 104/300.
`FIXED_OPTIONS` now neutralises the penalties; every number on this page comes from the greedy re-run. The
label-logprob cells were identical before and after (logprobs are reported before the penalty is applied), and
seven cells re-run to replace contended timings reproduced their predictions exactly, so the cache and decoding
are deterministic.

**Decision models lead on precision.** clef-flash v4 (plain question, bare labels) reaches F0.5 0.874 at
min_p 0.80 with no inversions, answering 73% of tweets and calling 33% directional against a 35% directional
prior. nimble over-calls: with no threshold it calls 65-74% of tweets directional, and it only becomes precise
at min_p 0.97-0.98, where it answers about a quarter of the tweets (F0.5 0.843 for v1). Both models are so
peaked that the directional-mass rule changes nothing for them.

**qwen3.5:0.8b is neutral-leaning, which caps the served label policy.** Its first-token argmax is neutral on
most directional tweets (0.3-7% signal rate across label configs), so a min_p threshold can only remove calls:
the best served config (v2-label, no abstention) misses 162 of 200 directional tweets at F0.5 0.512. Calling
the likelier directional class whenever its probability reaches 0.28, even when neutral wins, gives F0.5 0.730
[0.651, 0.795] with precision 0.91 / 0.92 and no inversions (+0.218 paired). That is the largest single lever
found here and needs a serving policy before it can be frozen.

**Knob verdict for qwen3.5:0.8b.** As served (argmax + min_p on label tokens vs |score| >= t on the ordinal
schema), the best label config beats the best ordinal config by +0.059 F0.5 [-0.068, +0.187]: not significant
at n=300. With the directional-mass rule the logprob knob wins clearly. The ordinal schema cannot borrow that
rule: this tokenizer fuses the space and the minus sign (" -") while the bare-space alternative keeps about a
quarter of the mass, so the sign is unobservable for negative scores. `score_sign_probabilities` used to read
those as bearish 1.0 (and miss the " -" mass behind positive scores). It now returns None for every negative
score in these cells (48, 32, 17 and 8 of 300), and serving falls back to the ordinal policy there.

**Prompt dimensions.**
- Rubric A (definitions) beats rubric B (impact questions) for every generative model. B's "is the change
  clear and material" framing makes the small models answer neutral: qwen3.5:0.8b v3-label calls 0.3% of
  tweets directional, and ministral drops from 0.660 to 0.440.
- Four synthetic shots help qwen3.5:0.8b on the label schema (0.365 to 0.512) but hurt every /analyze model:
  qwen3.5:4b 0.752 to 0.655, ministral 0.660 to 0.494, and qwen3-instruct v2 breaks the inversion cap. Shots
  also roughly double qwen3.5:4b's time to score.
- For the decision models the spread across prompts is small (clef 0.83-0.87, nimble 0.81-0.84). Bare labels
  with the short question are also the fastest variant (clef 468 vs 710 ms, nimble 751 vs 975 ms).

**Where the calls go wrong.**
- Inversions are nearly absent: one bullish tweet called bearish across all six best configs.
- Wrong calls are mostly gold-neutral tweets called directional (1-8 per model). Relative to its size, the
  earnings and guidance bucket holds the most of them (13 across the six models in 46 tweets, against 14 in
  128 for the catch-all bucket), which fits mixed results (a beat alongside a cut outlook) being the hard case.
- The real loss is recall: 34 (clef-flash) to 162 (qwen3.5:0.8b) directional tweets missed.
- The biggest miss bucket for every generative model is the price-move tweet: 33-44 of 57 directional ones
  missed, against 10 for clef-flash. The rubrics ask for economic impact, not tone, and the small models read
  a reported share-price move as not material, while the dataset labels such moves as directional. Whether to
  close that gap is a product question: on articles the impact reading is the intended behaviour.
- Analyst actions (upgrades, price targets) are handled well by the larger models (qwen3.5:4b catches 21 of
  22, clef-flash 19 of 22, with no wrong calls).
- 20 directional tweets get no correct call from any model; they are the first place to look for label noise
  or genuinely ambiguous items.

**Candidates for the one manual revision.**
1. qwen3.5:0.8b /signal: serve the directional-mass rule (see Requests in the grid report) rather than
   rewording the prompt; tune it again on the article dev set.
2. /analyze rubric A: one sentence saying a reported price move or analyst action is itself directional
   evidence, if the article dev set shows the same price-move misses.
3. Few-shot sets for /analyze: drop them (zero-shot wins for all three models) or rebalance them so the last
   shot is not neutral.

**Timing provenance.** Wall times are per call at client concurrency 1, warm. Concurrent load on the shared
machine (mostly the Docker Desktop VM saturating the CPU) inflated some tails, so clef-flash v2 and nimble v2/v3
were re-run at 19:28-19:47 and all eight qwen3.5:0.8b cells at 20:11-20:25, each with identical predictions.
The tables show the re-run timings. The qwen3.5:0.8b re-run still shared the machine (load about 30): on a
quiet machine earlier the same calls measured p50 155-200 ms with p95 near 210-300 ms, against 209-276 ms and
up to 1.06 s here. nimble v3's tail is also somewhat elevated.
```

```diff
+# directional_tau   optional, probability policies only: when neutral wins the argmax and the likelier

 # ordinal_t   directional call only when |score| >= ordinal_t (always set: streaming fallback)
+# field_order /analyze JSON order: sentiment-first (streams the score early) | summary-first
+# prompt      frozen prompt version per endpoint, e.g. { signal = "v4" }; an endpoint left out serves
```

```python

def serving_spec(base: ModelSpec, variant: Variant) -> ModelSpec:
    """The allowlisted spec switched to the variant under test; thresholds are applied offline."""
    if (variant == "decision") != (base.kind == "decision"):
        raise ValueError(f"{base.name} is a {base.kind} model and cannot run the {variant} variant")
    update: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if variant == "label":
        update = {"signal_schema": "label", "policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": base.min_p or 0.5}
    elif variant == "ordinal":
        update = {"signal_schema": "ordinal", "policy": "ordinal"}
    elif variant in ANALYZE_VARIANTS:
        update = {"field_order": variant}
    return ModelSpec.model_validate({**base.model_dump(), **update})
```

```python
"""One-off: rename the finalists' `frozen` flag to `served` (the rule a config serves)."""

from pathlib import Path

edits = {
    "evals/src/veritrade_evals/finalists.py": [
        ("    frozen: bool\n", "    served: bool\n"),
        (
            "            frozen = ref.best or cell.endpoint == \"analyze\"\n"
            "            out.append(Scored(finalist, cell, policy, Candidate(cell, evaluation, i), point, ref, frozen))\n",
            "            served = ref.best or cell.endpoint == \"analyze\"\n"
            "            out.append(Scored(finalist, cell, policy, Candidate(cell, evaluation, i), point, ref, served))\n",
        ),
        ("    failure = clear_failure(s, cis) if s.frozen else []\n", "    failure = clear_failure(s, cis) if s.served else []\n"),
        ('        "frozen_rule": s.frozen,\n', '        "served_rule": s.served,\n'),
        (
            '        if s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and scope == "lede" and s.frozen:\n',
            '        if s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and scope == "lede" and s.served:\n',
        ),
        (
            '    """How the frozen rules miss, by title keyword bucket and by source (counts only)."""\n',
            '    """How the served rules miss, by title keyword bucket and by source (counts only)."""\n',
        ),
        (
            '        if not s.frozen or (s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and s.finalist.scope != "lede"):\n',
            '        if not s.served or (s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and s.finalist.scope != "lede"):\n',
        ),
        ('"scope", "frozen", "F0.5 [95% CI]"', '"scope", "served", "F0.5 [95% CI]"'),
        ('                "yes" if r["frozen_rule"] else "",\n', '                "yes" if r["served_rule"] else "",\n'),
        ('"## Clear-failure check on the frozen rules"', '"## Clear-failure check on the served rules"'),
        ('"No frozen rule clearly fails on the articles', '"No served rule clearly fails on the articles'),
        ('"## Misses of the frozen rules (served scope, raw counts)"', '"## Misses of the served rules (served scope, raw counts)"'),
    ],
    "evals/tests/unit/test_finalists.py": [
        ("    assert [(s.finalist.scope, s.policy, s.frozen) for s in scored] == [\n", "    assert [(s.finalist.scope, s.policy, s.served) for s in scored] == [\n"),
        ("def test_misses_and_markdown_use_the_frozen_rule_at_the_served_scope() -> None:\n", "def test_misses_and_markdown_use_the_served_rule_at_the_served_scope() -> None:\n"),
        ('    assert "No frozen rule clearly fails" in md\n', '    assert "No served rule clearly fails" in md\n'),
    ],
}
for name, pairs in edits.items():
    path = Path(name)
    src = path.read_text()
    for old, new in pairs:
        assert src.count(old) == 1, (name, old)
        src = src.replace(old, new)
    path.write_text(src)
print("ok")
```
