```python

# --- analyze ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Dev300Point:
    """A config's dev300 operating point under one policy: the threshold the articles are scored at."""

    candidate: Candidate
    point: SweepPoint
    cis: Mapping[str, Any]
    best: bool


def dev300_points(models: Sequence[str], n_boot: int, log: TextIO) -> dict[tuple[str, str, str], Dev300Point]:
    """(model, config, policy) -> dev300 operating point, recomputed from the grid caches."""
    dev = grid.dev_set(load_split(grid.GRID_SPLIT))
    inputs = grid.cell_inputs(grid.grid_cells(models), grid.read_manifest(), dev, PREDS_DIR, log)
    out: dict[tuple[str, str, str], Dev300Point] = {}
    for model, group in itertools.groupby(inputs, key=lambda c: c.model):
        cands = candidates(list(group), dev)
        best, _ = best_candidate(grid_only(cands))
        for c in cands:
            point = chosen_point(c, c.evaluation.operating is not None)
            out[(model, c.cell.name, c.evaluation.policy)] = Dev300Point(
                c, point, candidate_cis(c, point, dev, n_boot), c is best
            )
    return out


def article_dev(extracted: Sequence[Extracted]) -> DevSet:
    return DevSet(
        ids=tuple(e.example.id for e in extracted),
        gold=tuple(e.example.label for e in extracted),
        weights=None,
        buckets=tuple(bucket_of(e.article.title) if e.article else "extraction failed" for e in extracted),
    )


def article_cells(
    cells: Sequence[tuple[Finalist, RunSpec]],
    extracted: Sequence[Extracted],
    manifest: Mapping[str, Any],
    dev: DevSet,
    preds_root: Path,
    log: TextIO,
) -> list[tuple[Finalist, CellInput]]:
    out = []
    for finalist, cell in cells:
        entry = manifest.get("cells", {}).get(finalist.key)
        if entry is None:
            print(f"skip {finalist.key}: not run yet", file=log)
            continue
        _, identity = inputs_for(extracted, finalist.scope, cell.spec.max_input_tokens)
        current = json.loads(canonical_json(cell.run_config(CACHE_SPLIT, identity)))
        if entry["prompt_sha"] != cell.prompt_sha() or entry["run_config"] != current:
            print(f"skip {finalist.key}: prompt, config or extraction changed since the run", file=log)
            continue
        records = cell.cache(CACHE_SPLIT, entry["model_digest"], preds_root, identity).records()
        aligned = tuple(records.get(i) for i in dev.ids)
        out.append(
            (
                finalist,
                CellInput(
                    endpoint=cell.endpoint,
                    model=cell.model,
                    name=f"{cell.name} {finalist.scope}",
                    variant=cell.variant,
                    prompt_version=cell.prompt.version,
                    records=aligned,
                    dims=dict(cell.dims),
                    ordinal_t=cell.spec.ordinal_t,
                    meta={
                        "cache_key": entry["cache_key"],
                        "extraction_failures": entry["extraction_failures"],
                    },
                ),
            )
        )
    return out


def _counts(point: SweepPoint) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Raw counts behind the rates; at n=30 a single inversion is 5% of the calls."""
    conf = point.metrics.confusion
    return {
        "directional_calls": sum(row[0] + row[1] for row in conf),
        "inversions": conf[0][1] + conf[1][0],
        "abstained": sum(row[3] for row in conf),
    }


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Scored:
    finalist: Finalist
    cell: CellInput
    policy: EvalPolicy
    candidate: Candidate
    point: SweepPoint
    dev300: Dev300Point
    served: bool


def score_cells(
    cells: Sequence[tuple[Finalist, CellInput]], dev: DevSet, d300: Mapping[tuple[str, str, str], Dev300Point]
) -> list[Scored]:
    out = []
    for finalist, cell in cells:
        for i, policy in enumerate(POLICIES[cell.variant]):
            ref = d300.get((finalist.model, finalist.config, policy))
            if ref is None:
                continue
            evaluation = evaluate_policy(policy, cell.records, dev.gold, None, ordinal_t=cell.ordinal_t)
            point = next(p for p in evaluation.sweep if p.threshold == ref.point.threshold)
            # Signal finalists serve the dev300 best rule; /analyze configs have one rule each.
            served = ref.best or cell.endpoint == "analyze"
            out.append(Scored(finalist, cell, policy, Candidate(cell, evaluation, i), point, ref, served))
    return out


def clear_failure(s: Scored, cis: Mapping[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    """Only failures the n=30 CI is sure of: the whole inversion CI above the cap, or a coverage collapse."""
    reasons = []
    if cis["inversion_rate"]["low"] > INVERSION_CAP:
        reasons.append(f"inversion CI low {cis['inversion_rate']['low']:.3f} > cap {INVERSION_CAP}")
    if cis["coverage"]["high"] < COLLAPSE_SHARE * s.dev300.point.coverage:
        dev300 = s.dev300.point.coverage
        reasons.append(
            f"coverage CI high {cis['coverage']['high']:.3f} < {COLLAPSE_SHARE} x dev300 {dev300:.3f}"
        )
    return reasons


def row_report(s: Scored, dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cis = candidate_cis(s.candidate, s.point, dev, n_boot)
    failure = clear_failure(s, cis) if s.served else []
    report: dict[str, Any] = {
        "key": s.finalist.key,
        "endpoint": s.cell.endpoint,
        "model": s.finalist.model,
        "config": s.finalist.config,
        "scope": s.finalist.scope,
        "variant": s.cell.variant,
        "policy": s.policy,
        "prompt_version": s.cell.prompt_version,
        "threshold": s.point.threshold,
        "served_rule": s.served,
        "articles": {**metrics_dict(s.point.metrics), **_counts(s.point), "cis": cis},
        "dev300": {
            "f05_macro": s.dev300.point.f05_macro,
            "coverage": s.dev300.point.coverage,
            "inversion_rate": s.dev300.point.inversion_rate,
            "cis": s.dev300.cis,
        },
        "counts": counts(s.cell.records),
        "extraction_failures": s.cell.meta.get("extraction_failures", 0),
        "latency": latency(s.cell.records),
        "clear_failure": failure,
    }
    if failure:
        # A threshold that makes no directional call meets the cap trivially, so it is no re-pick.
        op = select_operating_point([p for p in s.candidate.evaluation.sweep if p.metrics.signal_rate > 0])
        report["repick"] = None if op is None else point_row(op)
    return report


def _paired(a: Scored, b: Scored, dev: DevSet, n_boot: int, what: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    boot = paired_f05((a.candidate, a.point), (b.candidate, b.point), dev, n_boot)
    gap = boot["gap"]
    return {
        "comparison": what,
        "a": a.finalist.key + f" ({a.policy})",
        "b": b.finalist.key + f" ({b.policy})",
        "a_f05": boot["a"].point,
        "b_f05": boot["b"].point,
        "gap": {"point": gap.point, "low": gap.low, "high": gap.high},
        "verdict": "a" if gap.low > 0 else "b" if gap.high < 0 else "tie",
    }


def comparisons(scored: Sequence[Scored], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    by = {(s.finalist.model, s.finalist.config, s.finalist.scope, s.policy): s for s in scored}
    out = []
    for s in scored:
        model, config, scope, policy = s.finalist.model, s.finalist.config, s.finalist.scope, s.policy
        pairs: list[tuple[Scored | None, str]] = []
        if s.cell.endpoint == "signal" and scope == "lede" and s.served:
            pairs.append((by.get((model, config, "full", policy)), "scope: lede - full"))
        if is_tau(policy):
            pairs.append((by.get((model, config, scope, TAU_BASE[policy])), "rule: tau - plain"))
        if s.cell.endpoint == "analyze" and config != "v1":
            order = s.cell.variant == "summary-first"
            what = "field order: summary-first - sentiment-first" if order else f"prompt: {config} - v1"
            pairs.append((by.get((model, "v1", scope, policy)), what))
        out += [_paired(s, other, dev, n_boot, what) for other, what in pairs if other is not None]
    return out


def misses(scored: Sequence[Scored], dev: DevSet, extracted: Sequence[Extracted]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """How the served rules miss, by title keyword bucket and by source (counts only)."""
```

```
"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    backend_tests = "backend/tests" if full else "backend/tests/unit"
    tests = [backend_tests, "evals/tests", "scripts/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true", help="unit tests only, no build (default)")
    mode.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="integration tests, coverage floor, build")
    parser.add_argument("--backend", action="store_true", help="only backend + evals")
    parser.add_argument("--frontend", action="store_true", help="only frontend")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_be = not args.frontend or args.backend
    run_fe = not args.backend or args.frontend
    steps = (backend_steps(args.full) if run_be else []) + (frontend_steps(args.full) if run_fe else [])

    failed = []
    for name, cmd, cwd in steps:
        print(f"\n== {name}: {' '.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
        if subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd).returncode != 0:
            failed.append(name)
    if failed:
        sys.exit(f"\nFAILED: {', '.join(failed)}")
    print("\nall checks passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```
# Signal grid on dev300

Generated by `uv run python -m veritrade_evals.grid analyze` from the local prediction cache; no dataset text is stored here.

- Data: dev300, 300 Twitter Financial News train tweets, 100 per class; every rate is weighted back to the train prior (bullish 20.2%, bearish 15.1%, neutral 64.7%). Confusion and error counts are raw.
- Selection: F0.5 macro over bullish/bearish; operating point = best F0.5 with bullish<->bearish inversions <= 2% of directional calls; below the threshold the call abstains to neutral.
- Policies: decision models threshold native class probabilities (min_p); generative /signal thresholds first-token label probabilities (label schema) or the |score| of an ordinal -2..2 schema (t in {1, 2}); both probability policies are also swept with the served `directional_tau` rule (min_p 0, see below); /analyze is streamed sentiment-first and always uses |score|.
- Decoding: Ollama options temperature=0, seed=0, presence_penalty=0, frequency_penalty=0, repeat_penalty=1 on every generative call (greedy; overrides the penalties some Modelfiles ship).
- CIs: 95% stratified bootstrap (B=1000) at the chosen threshold; the threshold choice itself is not resampled, so these are optimistic.
- Latency: per-call wall ms during the grid run (Ollama 0.40.6 native-metal, warm, client concurrency 1); /analyze is time to the score with the stream stopped there. Indicative only: the latency suite runs separately.
```

```
# Grid finalists on the articles dev set

Generated by `uv run python -m veritrade_evals finalists analyze` from the local prediction cache; counts and rates only, no article text.

- Data: the articles dev split, n=30 news articles labelled for their primary entity (bullish 10, bearish 10, neutral 10). Balanced and unweighted: unlike dev300, rates are not reweighted to a class prior.
- Inputs: the serving path. `cascade` extraction with `selectolax` on the stored HTML at the fetch's final URL, then the endpoint scope (headline + lede, or the full body) cut to each model's `max_input_tokens`. Extraction failures: 0 (no call; scored as abstentions).
- Thresholds: each config's dev300 operating point (max F0.5 with inversions <= 2%), never re-tuned here. A rule counts as clearly failing only when the whole 95% CI of its inversion rate is above the cap, or the whole coverage CI is below 50% of its dev300 coverage.
- CIs: 95% stratified bootstrap (B=1000). With 10 articles per class they are wide: a gap needs roughly 0.2 F0.5 to clear zero, so most comparisons below are ties.
- Latency: wall ms per call on an Ollama 0.40.6 native-metal shared with other eval runs (client concurrency 1); indicative only.
```

```python
"""One-off: an analyze revision that fails its accuracy gate falls back to the grid best."""

from pathlib import Path

path = Path("evals/src/veritrade_evals/freeze.py")
src = path.read_text()

    src[:start]
    + '''def freeze_analyze(model: str, articles: Mapping[str, Any], registry: PromptRegistry) -> Frozen:
    """The revision unless it is clearly less accurate than the grid best, which then stays served."""
    report = grid_report("analyze", model)
    follow_ups = {f["config"]: f for f in report.get("follow_ups", ())}
    revision = follow_ups.get(ANALYZE_VERSION)
    if revision is None:
        raise FreezeError(f"{model}: no dev300 result for analyze {ANALYZE_VERSION}; run the grid follow-ups")
    articles_cmp = _comparison(articles, f"prompt: {ANALYZE_VERSION} - v1", f"{model}/{ANALYZE_VERSION}/")
    why = _gate(revision, articles_cmp)
    if why is None and any(r["clear_failure"] for r in _article_rows(articles, model, ANALYZE_VERSION)):
        why = "clear failure on the articles"
    chosen = revision if why is None else report["best"]
    order = "sentiment-first"
    check = follow_ups.get(FIELD_ORDER_CHECK)
    order_cmp = _comparison(articles, "field order: summary-first - sentiment-first", f"{model}/")
    # Summary-first gives up the early score, so it has to win on dev300 and not lose on the articles.
    if (
        check is not None
        and check["verdict"] == "follow-up"
        and (order_cmp is None or order_cmp["verdict"] != "b")
    ):
        order = "summary-first"
    evidence = {
        "dev300": {
            "config": chosen["config"],
            "threshold": chosen["threshold"],
            "revision_f05": revision["paired_bootstrap"]["follow_up"],
            "revision_gap_vs_v1": revision["paired_bootstrap"]["gap"],
        },
        "articles_dev": [_brief(r) for r in _article_rows(articles, model, chosen["config"])],
        "articles_revision_gap_vs_v1": None if articles_cmp is None else articles_cmp["gap"],
        "revision_rejected": why,
        "field_order": {
            "dev300_gap_summary_first": None if check is None else check["paired_bootstrap"]["gap"],
            "articles_gap_summary_first": None if order_cmp is None else order_cmp["gap"],
            "chosen": order,
        },
    }
    version = version_id(chosen["prompt_version"], "analyze", model, registry)
    values = {"policy": "ordinal", "ordinal_t": int(chosen["threshold"]), "field_order": order}
    return Frozen(model, values, {"analyze": version}, {"analyze": evidence})
```

```python
    assert src.count(old) == 1, old
    src = src.replace(old, new)


sub(
    'FROZEN_KEYS = ("signal_schema", "policy", "min_p", "ordinal_t", "directional_tau", "field_order", "prompt")\n',
    "# The spec keys each endpoint's serving decision reads.\n"
    "ENDPOINT_KEYS: dict[Endpoint, tuple[str, ...]] = {\n"
    '    "signal": ("signal_schema", "policy", "min_p", "directional_tau", "ordinal_t"),\n'
    '    "analyze": ("field_order", "ordinal_t"),\n'
    '    "summary": (),\n'
    "}\n",
)
sub(
    """                **(
                    {k: getattr(spec, k) for k in FROZEN_KEYS if k != "prompt"}
                    if endpoint != "summary"
                    else {}
                ),
""",
    """                **{k: getattr(spec, k) for k in ENDPOINT_KEYS[endpoint]},
""",
)
path.write_text(src)

test = Path("backend/tests/unit/inference/test_prompts.py")
t = test.read_text()
old = """    first = PromptRegistry().get("signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0")
    again = PromptRegistry().get("signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0")
    assert first.version == again.version
"""
assert t.count(old) == 1
t = t.replace(
    old,

    again = PromptRegistry().get("signal", "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", version="v1")

""",
)
test.write_text(t)
print("ok")
```

```python
"""One-off: hand-written notes appended to the articles dev summary, like the grid's."""

from pathlib import Path

path = Path("evals/src/veritrade_evals/finalists.py")

def sub(old: str, new: str) -> None:

    assert src.count(old) == 1, old

sub(
    "    md_path.write_text(render(report, manifest), encoding=\"utf-8\")\n",

)
sub(
    "def render(report: Mapping[str, Any], manifest: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:\n",

path.write_text(src)
```

```markdown
## Notes

Hand-written after reading the tables above; counts and my own descriptions only, no article text. With 10
articles per class, read these as a check that the dev300 operating points transfer, not as a ranking.

**Every served rule holds.** No served rule clearly fails (no inversion CI above the 2% cap, no coverage
collapse), so every dev300 threshold is frozen as tuned and nothing was re-picked on the articles.

**/signal.**
- clef-flash v4 at p >= 0.80 scores F0.5 0.848 on the lede and 0.907 on the full body, close to its dev300
  0.874. It makes one inversion in 20 calls on the lede and none on the full body.
- nimble v1 at p >= 0.97 answers far more articles than tweets (coverage 60-67% against 26% on dev300) at
  F0.5 0.88-0.90: articles state their news more plainly than tweets, so the peaked model is sure more often.
- qwen3.5:0.8b with `directional_tau` 0.28 scores 0.685 on the lede against 0.595 for the plain rule (a tie
  at n=30); on the full body the tau rule wins clearly (+0.229 [+0.022, +0.560]). It still misses about half
  the directional articles, so it remains the fast, low-recall option.
- Lede vs full is a tie for all three models; the lede (the /signal default) is two to three times faster.

**/analyze.**
- Articles are easier than tweets for every generative model: qwen3.5:4b v1 0.880, qwen3-instruct 0.798 and
  ministral 0.741, against 0.75 / 0.66 / 0.66 on dev300.
- The tightened summary rule (v5) changes no ministral call, costs qwen3-instruct one (a tie), and costs
  qwen3.5:4b two bullish articles plus one more false alarm (-0.080 [-0.178, -0.014]). qwen3.5:4b therefore
  keeps v1 for /analyze; its /summary endpoint still gets the tightened summary prompt.
- Summary-first is a tie on the articles (qwen3.5:4b -0.013, ministral +0.058) and never wins on dev300,
  while its time to the score is two to three times longer. Every model stays sentiment-first.
- The wrong calls are mostly neutral articles called directional (3-5 of the 10 per model, mostly bullish).
  Price-move headlines are not the problem they were on tweets (0-1 of the 5 directional ones missed per
  model), so the price-move / analyst-action rubric sentence was not added.
```

```python
"""HTTP routes: thin adapters from request bodies to services.

Stream routes take their events from a dependency, so every failure before the first byte (bad URL, model,
fetch, extraction) still reaches the client as a JSON error with its own HTTP status.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator, AsyncIterator
from contextlib import aclosing
from typing import Annotated, Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request
from fastapi.sse import EventSourceResponse, ServerSentEvent

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ErrorResponse,
    HealthResponse,
    ModelsResponse,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
)
from veritrade.api.sse import event_stream
from veritrade.services.analyze import open_analyze_stream, run_analyze
from veritrade.services.pipeline import StreamPayload
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.services.signal import run_signal
from veritrade.services.summary import open_summary_stream, run_summary
from veritrade.services.system import check_health, list_models
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

ERROR_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    status: {"model": ErrorResponse} for status in (400, 422, 502, 503, 504)
}

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api")


async def request_clock() -> StageTimer:
    return StageTimer()


async def get_runtime(request: Request) -> Runtime:
    runtime: Runtime = request.app.state.runtime
    return runtime


# Declared first in every route so the clock starts before any other dependency or validation runs.
Clock = Annotated[StageTimer, Depends(request_clock)]
RuntimeDep = Annotated[Runtime, Depends(get_runtime)]
Events = AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]


async def summary_events(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: SummaryRequest) -> Events:
    return await open_summary_stream(runtime, body, clock)


async def analyze_events(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: AnalyzeRequest) -> Events:
    return await open_analyze_stream(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/signal", response_model=SignalResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def signal(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: SignalRequest) -> SignalResponse:
    return await run_signal(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/summary", response_model=SummaryResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def summary(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: SummaryRequest) -> SummaryResponse:
    return await run_summary(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/summary/stream", response_class=EventSourceResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def summary_stream(
    events: Annotated[Events, Depends(summary_events)],
) -> AsyncIterator[ServerSentEvent]:
    async with aclosing(event_stream(events)) as stream:
        async for event in stream:
            yield event


@router.post("/analyze", response_model=AnalyzeResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def analyze(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: AnalyzeRequest) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    return await run_analyze(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/analyze/stream", response_class=EventSourceResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def analyze_stream(
    events: Annotated[Events, Depends(analyze_events)],
) -> AsyncIterator[ServerSentEvent]:
    async with aclosing(event_stream(events)) as stream:
        async for event in stream:
            yield event


@router.get("/models", response_model=ModelsResponse)
async def models(runtime: RuntimeDep) -> ModelsResponse:
    return await list_models(runtime)


@router.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse)
async def health(runtime: RuntimeDep) -> HealthResponse:
    return await check_health(runtime)
```

```python
"""Steps every article endpoint shares: resolve, check the result cache, load, describe."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ArticleMeta,
    CacheInfo,
    ErrorEvent,
    InferenceTimings,
    MetaEvent,
    SentimentEvent,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SignalResult,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
    SummaryDoneEvent,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
    Timings,
)
from veritrade.extract.scope import build_input
from veritrade.extract.types import Scope
from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade.services.article import LoadedArticle, load_article
from veritrade.services.cache import ResultKey
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

ArticleRequest = SignalRequest | SummaryRequest | AnalyzeRequest
StreamPayload = (
    MetaEvent | SentimentEvent | SummaryDeltaEvent | SummaryDoneEvent | AnalyzeDoneEvent | ErrorEvent
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Job:
    """A request with its model and prompt resolved; nothing has touched the network yet."""

    runtime: Runtime
    endpoint: Endpoint
    request: ArticleRequest
    url: str
    scope: Scope
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    key: ResultKey | None
    clock: StageTimer

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls, runtime: Runtime, endpoint: Endpoint, request: ArticleRequest, *, scope: Scope, clock: StageTimer
    ) -> Job:
        spec = runtime.registry.resolve(endpoint, request.model)
        prompt = runtime.prompt(endpoint, spec)
        url = str(request.url)
        key = None
        if not request.no_cache:
            key = ResultKey(
                endpoint=endpoint,
                url=normalize_url(url),
                model=spec.name,
                prompt_version=prompt.version,
                parser=request.parser,
                extractor=request.extractor,
                scope=scope,
            )
        return cls(runtime, endpoint, request, url, scope, spec, prompt, key, clock)

    def cached[R: (SignalResponse, SummaryResponse, AnalyzeResponse)](self, kind: type[R]) -> R | None:
        """The stored response marked as cached, with timings that describe this request."""
        hit = self.runtime.results.get(self.key) if self.key is not None else None
        if not isinstance(hit, kind):
            return None
        # A result hit runs no stage, so stage timings are zero and the article counts as a fetch hit.
        timings = Timings(
            total_ms=self.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=0.0,
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch="hit", result="hit"),
        )
        meta = hit.meta.model_copy(update={"cached": True})
        return hit.model_copy(update={"meta": meta, "timings": timings})

    def remember(self, response: SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> None:
        if self.key is not None:
            self.runtime.results.put(self.key, response)

    async def prepare(self) -> Prepared:
        loaded = await load_article(
            self.runtime,
            self.url,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            no_cache=self.request.no_cache,
        )
        text = build_input(loaded.article, self.scope, self.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return Prepared(
            job=self,
            loaded=loaded,
            text=text,
            meta=self._meta(loaded, text),
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch=loaded.fetch_status, result="bypass" if self.key is None else "miss"),
        )

    def _meta(self, loaded: LoadedArticle, text: str) -> ArticleMeta:
        article = loaded.article
        return ArticleMeta(
            url=self.url,
            final_url=loaded.page.final_url,
            title=article.title,
            source=article.source,
            published_at=article.published_at,
            endpoint=self.endpoint,
            model=self.spec.name,
            model_kind=self.spec.kind,
            prompt_version=self.prompt.version,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            extraction_method=article.method,
            scope=self.scope,
            input_chars=len(text),
            word_count=article.word_count,
            field_order=self.spec.field_order if self.endpoint == "analyze" else None,
            cached=False,
            backend=self.runtime.settings.ollama_backend_label,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Prepared:
    """A job with its article loaded and the model input built; only inference is left."""

    job: Job
    loaded: LoadedArticle
    text: str
    meta: ArticleMeta
    cache: CacheInfo

    def timings(self, inference: InferenceTimings | None) -> Timings:
        loaded = self.loaded
        return Timings(
            total_ms=self.job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=loaded.fetch_ms,
            consent_ms=loaded.consent_ms,
            parse_ms=loaded.article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=loaded.article.extract_ms,
            inference=inference,
            cache=self.cache,
        )

    def meta_event(self) -> MetaEvent:
        article = self.loaded.article
        return MetaEvent(
            meta=self.meta,
            fetch_ms=self.loaded.fetch_ms,
            parse_ms=article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=article.extract_ms,
            cache=self.cache,
        )


def cached_meta_event(response: SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> MetaEvent:
    timings = response.timings
    return MetaEvent(
        meta=response.meta,
        fetch_ms=timings.fetch_ms,
        parse_ms=timings.parse_ms,
        extract_ms=timings.extract_ms,
        cache=timings.cache,
    )


def signal_result(verdict: Verdict) -> SignalResult:
    return SignalResult(
        sentiment=verdict.sentiment,
        abstained=verdict.abstained,
        policy=verdict.policy,
        confidence=verdict.confidence,
        score=verdict.score,
        probabilities=verdict.probabilities,
    )


def inference_timings(raw: ChatResult | DecisionResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None = None) -> InferenceTimings:
    """ttft_ms is passed in by streams, which measure it from request receipt to the first summary text."""
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        return InferenceTimings(wall_ms=raw.wall_ms, prompt_tokens=raw.input_tokens)
    t = raw.timings
    return InferenceTimings(
        wall_ms=raw.wall_ms,
        ttft_ms=ttft_ms,
        load_ms=t.load_ms,
        prompt_eval_ms=t.prompt_eval_ms,
        eval_ms=t.eval_ms,
        prompt_tokens=t.prompt_tokens,
        eval_tokens=t.eval_tokens,
    )
```

```python
"""/analyze: sentiment, entity and summary from one generation, as JSON or as streamed events."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    SentimentEvent,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
)
from veritrade.inference.adapters import AnalyzeResult, analyze, analyze_stream, score_verdict
from veritrade.inference.incremental import EntityClosed, ScoreClosed, SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import (
    Job,
    Prepared,
    StreamPayload,
    cached_meta_event,
    inference_timings,
    signal_result,
)
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "analyze", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)


async def run_analyze(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await analyze(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_analyze_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit, clock)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Events follow generation order, so the frozen field order decides where `sentiment` lands."""
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    entity: str | None = None
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = analyze_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case ScoreClosed(score=score):
                    yield SentimentEvent(
                        signal=signal_result(score_verdict(job.spec, score)),
                        entity=entity,
                        elapsed_ms=job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
                    )
                case EntityClosed(entity=name):
                    entity = name.strip() or None
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case AnalyzeResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: AnalyzeResponse, clock: StageTimer) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SentimentEvent(signal=hit.signal, entity=hit.entity, elapsed_ms=clock.elapsed_ms())
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: AnalyzeResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    return AnalyzeResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(result.verdict),
        entity=result.entity,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )
```

#### ✏️  Edit `routes.py`

`14:55:35`

```diff
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@-ERROR_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {
-    status: {"model": ErrorResponse} for status in (400, 422, 502, 503, 504)
+_ERROR_STATUSES = (400, 422, 502, 503, 504)
+ERROR_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {status: {"model": ErrorResponse} for status in _ERROR_STATUSES}
+# A `model` entry would inherit the route's text/event-stream media type; stream errors are sent as JSON.
+STREAM_ERROR_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {
+    status: {
+        "description": "Error raised before the stream opens",
+        "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"}}},
+    }
+    for status in _ERROR_STATUSES
 }
```

Real tiny models in the bundled Ollama container: qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0 for summary/analyze and tev1:0.8b-q8_0 for signal (deploy/ci-models.txt). No network to real publishers in e2e.
> 4. Playwright e2e (frontend/e2e): run against the compose e2e stack: split mode happy path (signal badge + non-empty streamed summary + timings), combined streaming, signal-only with the tev1 decision model, extractor switch, and the /benchmarks/ page. Model-agnostic assertions (any of the 3 labels; non-empty text), generous timeouts for CPU inference.
> 5. CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml): keep the backend and frontend jobs; add an e2e job (needs both): free disk space, docker buildx with GHA cache, actions/cache for the Ollama model dir keyed on deploy/ci-models.txt, compose up --wait with the bundled profile + e2e overlay, warm-up request, `pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium`, run Playwright, upload the Playwright report and compose logs on failure, always tear down.
````markdown
# VeriTrade Analytics prescreen - implementation plan

## Context

VeriTrade's prescreen (`.context/prescreen-brief-kristiyan-dimitrov.md`) asks for a Python API that takes a public
financial-news URL, fetches and extracts the article, and returns an LLM summary + Bullish/Bearish/Neutral sentiment
with low latency, plus a basic frontend, a README (design, latency trade-offs, run/test, AI tools) and the committed AI
conversation log. Kris handpicked the approach from `.context/openai-research.md` in a `/grill-me` interview (Q1-Q20,
R1-R10, 3 follow-ups); every decision below is settled. Guiding principle: this is a PoC, balance rigor per aspect.
Deliverable: public repo `cleverjobs/veritrade-analytics`, everything pushed, transcript + meta under `.context/`.

Greenfield repo: only `.context/` exists, so there is nothing to reuse; evals import the serving code so what is
measured is what is served.

## Settled decisions (copied verbatim into `.context/docs/design/01-decisions.md`)

| Area | Decision |
|---|---|
| Stack | FastAPI + uv (Python 3.13 workspace: `backend`, `evals`); Next.js 16 static export served BY FastAPI (one origin, zero proxy hops, no nginx/Node at runtime); dev = `pnpm dev` + CORS localhost |
| Ollama | Native brew Ollama 0.40.4 (Metal) is the Mac default; compose profile `bundled` (ollama/ollama:0.40.5 + pull init) for Linux/CI; `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` switch; results labelled `native-metal` / `docker-cpu` |
| Split group | `/api/signal`: decision models `clef-flash:9b-q8_0`, `nimble:9b-q4_K_M` (`/v1/systemone`, native probabilities) + generative baseline `qwen3.5:0.8b`; `/api/summary`: `qwen3.5:2b`, `qwen3.5:4b` |
| Combined group | `/api/analyze`: `qwen3.5:4b`, `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507`, `ministral-3:3b`; `qwen3.5:9b` holdout-only quality ceiling |
| Objective | F0.5 macro over {bullish, bearish}; bullish<->bearish inversion cap 2%; winner = best F0.5 within latency budget, else Pareto knee (stated) |
| Confidence | Compare label-token logprob threshold vs ordinal -2..+2 \|score\| threshold for generative models; decision models threshold `probabilities`; API returns `sentiment` + `abstained` (+ confidence/score) |
| Scope | `/signal` `scope=lede` (default) vs `full`, both evaluated |
| Streaming | Both SSE and JSON variants for `/summary` and `/analyze`; SSE events `meta` -> `sentiment` -> `summary_delta*` -> `done` (sentiment exactly once before `done`; position follows frozen field order) |
| Budgets (native, warm, excl. fetch) | `/signal` lede p50 <= 500 ms; `/summary` + `/analyze` TTFT <= 1.5 s, complete p50 <= 4 s; surfaced to Kris (not moved) if unrealistic after baseline |
| Data | Dev: stratified 300 Twitter FNS train; holdout: full Twitter validation + FPB AllAgree (zip, never committed) + FinEntity single-label; 90 Opus-labelled articles (10 sources x 3 classes x 3; 30 dev / 60 test), double label + adjudicator, no human check |
| Prompts | Lean grid per model (2 rubrics x few-shot {0,4} x field order where relevant, <= 8 configs), one error-analysis pass, freeze, holdout once |
| Summaries | <= 3 sentences / 60 words, lead with market-moving fact; eval = deterministic checks + embedding key-fact coverage + Opus-as-judge on finalists |
| Extraction | Matrix: parsers {selectolax, lxml, bs4+html.parser, bs4+lxml} x own {jsonld, profile, density, cascade} + trafilatura {default, precision}, readability-lxml, newspaper4k, justext, strip-tags; Opus gold bodies (gitignored); switchable from UI |
| Sources | Yahoo Finance, CNBC, AP News, Investing.com, Motley Fool, Benzinga, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, SEC EDGAR 8-K EX-99.1, CNN Business; backups Fortune, Business Wire, Guardian, BBC; `probe_sources.py` decides |
| Fetching | Browser header set, no evasion; typed `source_blocked` / `paywalled` / `consent_required` with hints; Yahoo consent = reject-all + cookie cache, fallback `consent_required`; `SEC_USER_AGENT` env |
| Tests/CI | Unit + integration BE/FE, Playwright e2e on compose, all on GitHub Actions; skeleton fixtures (real DOM, synthetic text) + weekly non-blocking live smoke |
| Repo | Milestone commits straight to `main` (no branches); repo-local `Kristiyan Dimitrov <kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com>`; MIT; `.context/` committed; transcript = session `0024648c-...` only, redacted |
| Ops | Stop all other running Docker containers during setup (names recorded); leave them stopped; final message gives the exact `docker start ...` |

## Architecture

```
pyproject.toml uv.lock .python-version(3.13)   # uv workspace root; ruff, mypy, pytest config
backend/src/veritrade/
  config.py errors.py timing.py models_registry.py
  data/{models.toml, sources.toml}              # single serving config + source registry
  fetch/{client,ssrf,headers,consent,detect,cache}.py
  extract/{dom,jsonld,profiles,density,cascade,third_party,registry,scope}.py
  prompts/{registry.py, data/<endpoint>/<model>.toml}
  inference/{schemas,ollama,decision,adapters,confidence,incremental}.py
  services/{article,signal,summary,analyze}.py
  api/{app,routes,contracts,sse}.py  healthcheck.py
backend/tests/{unit,integration,live}/  backend/tests/fixtures/{skeletons/<source>/,ollama/}
evals/src/veritrade_evals/{__main__,datasets,splits,runner,metrics,extraction_bench,latency,opus,select,report}.py
evals/{opus_prompts/, data/{splits,articles,judgements}/, results/}   evals/data/private/ (gitignored)
frontend/{src/app/{page,benchmarks/page}.tsx, src/lib/{api,sse}.ts, src/components/, tests/, e2e/}
docker/app.Dockerfile  docker/ollama-pull.sh  compose.yaml  compose.e2e.yaml  env/{bundled.env,ci-models.txt}
scripts/{check,dev_setup,probe_sources,capture_skeletons,export_openapi,export_transcript}.py
.github/workflows/{ci.yml,live-smoke.yml}
.context/{brief, research, docs/design/{00-overview,01-decisions,02-source-probe,03-extraction,04-evals,05-latency,90-optional-backlog}.md, transcript/}
```

Backend essentials:
- **fetch/**: one `httpx.AsyncClient(http2=True, follow_redirects=False)`; manual redirect loop (max 5) with
  `ssrf.check_target` on every hop (http/https, ports 80/443, all resolved IPs `is_global`); streamed body cap 5 MB,
  HTML content-type gate, 3 s connect / 8 s deadline. `headers.py` Chrome set, `sec.gov` uses `SEC_USER_AGENT`
  (default: public commit contact), EDGAR <= 10 req/s. `consent.py` Yahoo reject-all POST + retry once.
  `detect.classify` maps 401/403/429 + challenge markers (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai) to
  `SourceBlocked`, JSON-LD `isAccessibleForFree:false` to `Paywalled`. `cache.SingleFlightCache` (LRU+TTL,
  in-flight task sharing; typed errors 60 s negative TTL).
- **extract/**: `Dom` protocol over 4 parser backends; own strategies run on `Dom` (16 cells); third-party
  extractors lazy-imported (parser N/A); `registry.extract(html, url, parser, extractor) -> Article`;
  `scope.build_input` lede (~200 tokens) / full, capped by model `max_input_tokens`. Press-release boilerplate
  (forward-looking statements, About, contacts) dropped by profiles.
- **prompts/**: TOML per (endpoint, model) with versions `v1..vN`, `active=`; `prompt_version` includes content
  sha so caches invalidate. Article text fenced as untrusted data.
- **inference/**: `ollama.OllamaClient` (httpx) is the ONLY Ollama path for app and evals: `chat`/`chat_stream`
  (`think:false`, JSON-schema `format`, `temperature:0`, `seed`, `num_ctx`/`num_predict` from `models.toml`,
  `logprobs:true, top_logprobs:20` on non-streaming label calls), `systemone` (criteria order neutral, bullish,
  bearish; client-side timing), `embed`, `ps`, `unload`, `show`, `version`. `confidence.py` policies:
  `ProbabilityPolicy`, `LabelLogprobPolicy` (first-token probs of the 3 labels; score-sign fallback if tokens
  collide), `OrdinalPolicy`; streaming and `/analyze` always use ordinal. `incremental.JsonFieldScanner` emits
  `ScoreClosed` / `SummaryText` from chunk deltas (escape-safe).
- **config**: `models.toml` holds allowlist, per-endpoint defaults, `num_ctx`, `num_predict`, scope default, ordinal
  `t` (always) and `tau` (when knob L wins); `freeze` writes it. Container env: `VT_MODELS`, `VT_PULL_MODELS`
  (host-side compose var `OLLAMA_MODELS` maps to these; never passed raw into the ollama container),
  `VT_OLLAMA_BACKEND_LABEL`, `VT_SSRF_TEST_ALLOW_HOSTS` (refused unless `VT_ENV=test`).
- **API** (`/api`): `POST /signal`, `/summary`, `/summary/stream`, `/analyze`, `/analyze/stream`; `GET /models`
  (allowlist x installed tags x defaults), `GET /health` (Ollama reachable, version >= 0.40.4, backend label).
  Requests carry `url, model?, parser, extractor, scope, no_cache`. Responses carry `meta` (model, prompt_version,
  parser, extractor, scope, cached) and `timings` (fetch, consent, parse, extract, inference wall/ttft/load/
  prompt_eval/eval, cache hit/miss/joined). One error table in `contracts.py`: 400 invalid_url /
  blocked_destination / model_not_allowed; 422 paywalled / consent_required / extraction_empty /
  unsupported_content; 502 source_blocked / upstream_http; 503 model_unavailable / llm_unreachable; 504 timeouts.
  Fetch/extract errors return before a stream opens; mid-stream failures emit `error`. Static export mounted at `/`
  after the routers.
- **Frontend**: Next 16 App Router, strict TS, CSS modules, `output:'export'`. Analyze page: URL, mode
  split|combined, streaming toggle, model/parser/extractor/scope pickers from `/api/models`, SignalCard (abstained
  state), streaming SummaryPanel, ErrorBanner (code + hint), LatencyBar (two lanes in split mode). Split mode fires
  `/signal` + `/summary/stream` concurrently (backend single-flight shares the fetch). `lib/sse.ts` = fetch +
  `TextDecoderStream` frame parser + AbortController. Benchmarks page renders `benchmarks.json` (prebuild copies
  `evals/results/benchmarks.json`, falls back to committed `benchmarks.sample.json`). Types generated from
  `backend/openapi.json` (drift-checked).
- **Docker**: `app.Dockerfile` stages node:24-slim (pnpm build) -> uv python3.13 (`uv sync --frozen --no-dev
  --no-editable --package veritrade-backend`) -> python:3.13-slim runtime, non-root, `veritrade-healthcheck`
  console script, `uvicorn veritrade.api.app:create_app --factory`. `compose.yaml`: `app` (8000, default
  `OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:11434`, `extra_hosts` host-gateway); profile `bundled`: `ollama`
  (named volume, no host port, healthcheck `ollama list`) + `ollama-pull` (`service_completed_successfully`,
  `required:false`), enabled via `--profile bundled --env-file env/bundled.env`. `compose.e2e.yaml`: nginx
  `fixture-site` serving skeletons as `fixtures.local`, test env, model dir bind mount for CI cache.

## Evaluation (`uv run python -m veritrade_evals <cmd>`)

- **Datasets**: Twitter FNS parquet via `hf_hub_download` at pinned revision; FPB zip ->
  `Sentences_AllAgree.txt` (iso-8859-1, `rsplit("@",1)`); FinEntity single-label rows. Committed: revisions lock,
  split ids + text hashes; never dataset text. dev300 balanced 100/100/100 (seed 20261018) with prevalence weights
  applied to metrics and tau selection (flagged in docs).
- **Runner**: async, bounded concurrency (4 for accuracy, 1 for latency), resumable JSONL prediction cache keyed by
  sha(config, model digest, rendered prompt, harness version), one model resident at a time via
  `OllamaClient.ps/unload`. Sentiment-first runs stop after the score closes (later tokens cannot change it).
- **Grid** (lean): decision models: instructions {plain, rubric} x criteria descriptions {none, one-line};
  `qwen3.5:0.8b` signal: rubric {A, B} x k {0, 4} x schema {label, ordinal} (gives both knobs); combined models:
  rubric x k (4) sentiment-first, then best config summary-first (field-order check, only if the M3 probe confirms
  Ollama honours schema property order); scope lede vs full on articles_dev for signal finalists. Few-shot shots
  are synthetic (no dataset leakage). Error pass writes `.temp/eval/error-analysis/*.md`, one revision, then
  `freeze` writes `active=` versions + thresholds into `models.toml`.
- **Metrics**: weighted per-class P/R, F0.5 macro, inversion rate, coverage/signal rate, 3x4 confusion, risk-coverage
  sweep, operating point = max F0.5 under 2% inversion; bootstrap CIs (B=1000) on headline metrics only.
  Holdout-once guard (`evals/results/holdout_runs.json`).
- **Opus pipeline** (Claude Code subagents, every spawn `model: "opus"`, prompts in `evals/opus_prompts/`):
  1. discover per source (RSS/sections, last 60 days, oversample 5/class, keep only URLs our fetcher retrieves;
     HTML saved to `evals/data/private/html/`);
  2. gold body + 3-5 key facts in one pass (gold to `private/gold/`, validated as >= 95% substrings of page text);
  3. labellers A and B in parallel, isolated, see only gold body; 4. adjudicator on disagreement/ambiguity,
     replacements re-run 2-4; 5. finalize 3/3/3 per source (+-1, 30/30/30 overall), seeded 30/60 split,
     agreement + Cohen's kappa; 6. judge finalist summaries anonymised (faithfulness 1-5, coverage 1-5,
     hallucination flags, leads-with-market-moving-fact).
  Committed: `evals/data/articles/articles.jsonl` (url, fetched_at, sha256, label, score, entity, ticker,
  rationale, key_facts, split, agreement), `evals/data/judgements/`. Never committed: HTML, gold bodies.
- **Summary eval**: numeric faithfulness, entity named, length; key-fact coverage via `qwen3-embedding:0.6b`
  (cosine >= 0.75, spot-checked); Opus judge on dev for selection, winner judged on test.
- **Extraction matrix**: 22 combos over 90 local HTML: p50/p95 ms (median of 5), token P/R/F1 vs gold, leakage,
  tokens-to-LLM, failure rate, downstream signal agreement (lede of each extraction vs gold), install MB.
- **Latency**: preflight asserts no running containers + records Ollama env/version/backend; `no_cache=true`;
  cold n=3, warm n=30 over articles_dev; p50/p95, TTFT from request receipt, time-to-signal per field order,
  per-stage timings via in-process app with local fetcher; one `docker-cpu` pass through the bundled app (winners,
  n=10).
- **Select**: filter inversion <= 2% + budgets, max F0.5 (summary: judge faithfulness then coverage, gated on
  deterministic pass >= 0.8), else Pareto knee; `select --write` updates `models.toml` defaults and
  `env/bundled.env` pull list (winners if <= ~10 GB, else best finalist that fits; clef-flash alone never fits).
  Order: freeze -> latency -> select -> holdout once -> report.
- **Report**: `evals/results/benchmarks.json` (canonical), `evals/results/README.md`, README tables between markers.
- **Compute**: ~36 GB of pulls; ~3-4 h machine time on the M4 Pro (resumable, background) + Opus wall time.

## Testing and CI

- **BE unit**: extractors on skeletons (own strategies x 4 parsers: body-marker recall >= 0.9 and zero leakage for
  jsonld/profile/cascade; density recall >= 0.8, leakage <= 10%; third-party smoke), skeleton purity, SSRF (all
  address classes, rebinding via injected resolver, per-hop redirects, caps), detect/consent (respx), prompt goldens,
  confidence policies, stream scanner split at every byte offset (both field orders), schemas + openapi drift,
  every allowlisted model resolves prompt + thresholds.
- **BE integration**: ASGI app + respx (publishers and Ollama, hand-written NDJSON chunk fixtures with delays):
  signal (decision + generative), summary/analyze JSON + SSE event order, single-flight (2 requests, 1 upstream
  hit), result cache, error status table, Ollama down, health, models. Coverage floor 75%.
- **FE**: Vitest + RTL (sse parser chunking, components incl. abstained/errors); MSW 3 integration (sentiment
  renders before summary completes, timings, model list, benchmarks page); prettier/eslint/tsc.
- **E2E** (Playwright, compose stack on CI): analyze happy path, signal-only with `tev1:0.8b-q8_0` (CI-only,
  unevaluated plumbing model, documented), extractor switch, `/benchmarks/`. Models `qwen3.5:0.8b` +
  `tev1:0.8b-q8_0`; model-agnostic assertions.
- **CI** (`ci.yml`, push/PR): `backend` (uv cache, `scripts/check.py --backend --full`, transcript scan-only
  guard), `frontend` (pnpm cache, gen:api check, lint, typecheck, vitest, build), `e2e` (needs both; free disk,
  buildx gha cache, ollama model cache, compose up, wait pull, health, warm-up, playwright, upload logs on failure).
  `live-smoke.yml` weekly + dispatch, informational only.

## Transcript export (`scripts/export_transcript.py`, the very last step)

Collect session `0024648c-2a0d-4dde-9495-8d22e0c9ccaa` main JSONL + `subagents/**` + workflow scripts/journals
(exclude `tool-results/`, other sessions) -> staging in `.temp/transcript/`. Allowlist record types (user,
assistant, system informational, mode, permission-mode, titles) and attachments (plan_mode, ultra_effort_enter,
model, date, skill_mention); drop everything else (api-request*, instructions, session context, credential_org,
hooks, listings). Strip thinking signatures and system reminder blocks. Replace tool_result text and Write/Edit
inputs touching `evals/data/private/**` or dataset text with `[omitted: sha256]`. Redact home path, emails other
than the public commit email and `noreply@anthropic.com`, secret patterns, and a gitignored denylist (work
domain, other org/project/container names). Render with `uvx claude-code-log@1.7.0` (HTML + MD). `meta.json`:
Claude Code 2.1.301, `claude-opus-5-5`, effort xhigh, adaptive thinking, ultracode, plan mode, skills, workflows,
subagents (type/model), deduped token usage, date range, redaction counts. Gate: zero hits for `~`, private
emails, denylist, secret regexes, dropped record markers, and 12-word shingles from gold bodies/FPB; only then move
to `.context/transcript/{raw,rendered,meta.json,README.md}` (README notes the export/push turns themselves are
not included, and carries Kris's note to the reviewers).

## Execution phases (Workflows; every agent `model: 'opus'`; main loop commits after each gate)

| Phase | Work | Gate -> commit to main |
|---|---|---|
| P0 | Main loop: record + `docker stop` running containers; `brew install ollama`, `brew services start`, `launchctl setenv OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS`; background model pulls; `git init`, repo-local identity, `.gitignore`, MIT, `gh repo create cleverjobs/veritrade-analytics --public`, SSH-alias remote; workspace + all deps declared and locked; contracts (`contracts.py`, protocols, `openapi.json`), `models.toml`/`sources.toml` skeletons; `ci.yml` backend + frontend jobs; design docs 00/01 | `check.py --fast`, CI green, M0 push |
| P1 | Probe agent: `probe_sources.py` over 14 sources -> `02-source-probe.md`, final 10 + profile hints | 10 usable sources, M1 |
| P2 | 5 parallel file-disjoint agents: fetch/, extract/ + skeleton capture, inference/ + scanner, frontend (MSW against contract), evals loaders/metrics | `check.py --fast`; M3-style probe on real Ollama (logprobs in stream? schema order honoured? systemone shape?) + baseline dev300 + latency probe; **R7 sanity gate: if budgets look unrealistic, stop and ask Kris** -> M2 |
| P3 | (a) api/services/caches/SSE + integration tests; (b) Opus article sub-workflow: discover -> gold + key facts -> labellers A/B -> adjudicate -> finalize | `check.py --full`; one analyze per source on native Ollama; M3 |
| P4 | (a) Docker, compose, e2e, Playwright (iterate on main); (b) accuracy grid, knobs, scope, field order, error pass, freeze, extraction matrix (background); (c) summary eval + Opus judge on finalists | CI incl. e2e green (`gh run watch`), M4 |
| P5 | Exclusive (no builds/agents): re-stop containers, latency suite, select --write, holdout once, docker-cpu pass, report, design docs 03-05 + 90, README | budgets reported, M5 |
| P6 | Verification checklist, fresh-clone smoke, transcript export + gate | M6 push; final message with `docker start ...` command |

Ad-hoc scripts live in `.temp/<slug>/` and run via `uv run python`; no inline Python; terse WHY-only comments; no
em-dashes; no git stash.

## Verification

1. `uv run python scripts/check.py --full` passes (ruff, format, mypy, BE unit + integration, evals tests, FE lint/
   typecheck/prettier/vitest/build, openapi + type drift).
2. Native path: `brew services list` shows ollama; `docker compose up -d`; `/api/health` reports `native-metal`;
   one `/api/analyze` (JSON + stream) succeeds per source; blocked/paywalled cases return typed errors.
3. Bundled path: `docker compose --profile bundled --env-file env/bundled.env up -d` healthy; one analyze succeeds.
4. UI: split and combined modes, streaming toggle, model/parser/extractor/scope switches, Benchmarks page.
5. Latency report vs R7 budgets printed and committed; holdout run recorded once.
6. GitHub Actions `ci.yml` green on HEAD incl. e2e; `live-smoke.yml` dispatched once and noted.
7. `git ls-files` contains nothing from `evals/data/private/`; skeleton purity test passes; every commit authored by
   Kristiyan Dimitrov with the Co-Authored-By trailer.
8. Fresh clone into `.temp/fresh-clone/` builds and serves one analyze without private data.
9. Transcript gate passes with zero hits; rendered HTML skimmed; README links resolve.

## Risks

- Label-token logprobs may be ambiguous or masked by grammar -> score-sign fallback or ordinal only (probe decides).
- Ollama may ignore schema property order -> field-order dimension dropped, documented.
- 9B decision models may miss the 500 ms lede budget -> Pareto knee, stated.
- 30/60 article sets give wide CIs; Opus-only labels may inflate agreement; thresholds from tweets may not transfer.
- Publisher DOMs, Yahoo consent forms and blocking change; runner IPs get blocked differently than Kris's IP.
- Docker Desktop restart can revive stopped containers -> re-stop before P5.
- Brew Ollama 0.40.4 vs container 0.40.5 version drift -> versions recorded with every benchmark.
````

```
     1	#!/bin/sh
     2	# One-shot init: pull the comma-separated VT_PULL_MODELS into the shared ollama volume.
     3	set -eu
     4	old_ifs=$IFS
     5	IFS=','
     6	for model in $VT_PULL_MODELS; do
     7	  IFS=$old_ifs
     8	  echo "pulling ${model}"
     9	  ollama pull "${model}"
    10	done
    11	echo "models ready"
```

```
     1	# 01 - Design decisions
     2	
     3	Every decision below was settled with Kris in a `/grill-me` interview (2026-10-16 to 2026-10-18) before any code
     4	was written. Background facts came from read-only research agents (local machine, Ollama library, Docker/CI, news
     5	sources, datasets, transcript format) and were re-verified against primary sources where they were surprising
     6	(the Ollama decision-model API). The full conversation is in `.context/transcript/`.
     7	
     8	Guiding principle (Kris, R2): **this is a PoC - balance the level of rigor per aspect**, no exhaustive sweeps.
     9	
    10	## Round 1
    11	
    12	| # | Question | Decision | Why |
    13	|---|---|---|---|
    14	| Q1 | Where does the Ollama server run? | Native Ollama on the host is the documented default on macOS; a `bundled` compose profile runs `ollama/ollama` (CPU) for Linux/CI; `OLLAMA_BASE_URL` switches; benchmarks are labelled `native-metal` / `docker-cpu` | Docker Desktop cannot pass Apple's GPU into Linux containers (~0.2x prompt-eval, ~0.4x generation vs native); reviewers on Macs will have Ollama anyway |
    15	| Q2 | What does "precision" mean, how is a winner picked? | Positives are directional calls (bullish/bearish); neutral is the safe default. Selection metric F0.5 macro over {bullish, bearish}; bullish<->bearish inversions capped at 2%; winner = best F0.5 inside the latency budget, else the Pareto knee | A wrong call costs a trade, a missed call costs little; F0.5 cannot be gamed by "always neutral" |
    16	| Q3 | Sentiment output contract | 3-class `sentiment` + `abstained`; compare two precision knobs for generative models (label-token logprob threshold vs ordinal -2..+2 \|score\| threshold) and keep the better one; decision models threshold their native class probabilities | Ollama emits logprobs, but only for non-streaming calls; the ordinal knob also works when streaming |
    17	| Q4 | What does the quick signal read? | `scope=lede` (headline + opening paragraphs) by default, `scope=full` available; both evaluated for accuracy and speed | Lede matches headline-level datasets and decision-model context limits; prompt length drives latency |
    18	| Q5 | Article-level gold set | 90 real articles (10 sources x 3 classes x 3), labelled by Opus subagents, no human check | Public datasets are sentences/headlines; real requests are full articles |
    19	| Q6 | Public datasets and splits | Dev: stratified 300 from Twitter Financial News train. Holdout: full Twitter validation + Financial PhraseBank AllAgree (downloaded at eval time, never committed, CC BY-NC-SA) + FinEntity single-label paragraphs | Twitter FNS already uses Bearish/Bullish/Neutral and has official splits; FPB is the cleanest cross-domain check |
    20	| Q7 | Prompt tuning method | Automated grid per model, then one manual error-analysis pass, freeze, run holdout once. Optional backlog starts with a DSPy-style optimizer loop | Reproducible and explainable within a PoC budget |
    21	| Q8 | API surface | `/api/signal`, `/api/summary`, `/api/analyze`, `/api/models`, `/api/health`; model allowlist; per-URL fetch cache with single-flight; result cache; timing breakdown in every response; SSE **and** JSON variants for `/summary` and `/analyze` | Streaming improves perceived latency; both variants make the comparison measurable |
    22	| Q9 | How the UI is served | Reopened in round 2 (R1) | - |
    23	| Q10 | Extraction | Full parser x extractor comparison matrix, switchable from the UI, results published | Extraction quality and speed both feed end-to-end latency |
    24	| Q11 | Fixtures and publisher rights | Skeleton fixtures (real DOM structure, synthetic text) + scheduled live smoke; article texts never committed (URL + hash + labels only) | Respect each publisher's content rights in a public repo |
    25	| Q12 | CI | Everything on GitHub Actions, including e2e with a real tiny model | Free for public repos |
    26	| Q13 | Transcript | Redacted raw JSONL + rendered Markdown/HTML + `meta.json` under `.context/transcript/`, stripped of anything not suitable for a public repo | The brief asks for the AI log; Kris wants reviewers to read it |
    27	| Q14 | Git workflow | Milestone commits straight to `main`, no feature branches; repo-local author Kristiyan Dimitrov; public repo `cleverjobs/veritrade-analytics` | Solo PoC |
    28	| Q15 | Tooling | Python 3.13 uv workspace (`backend`, `evals`), ruff + mypy; Node 24 + pnpm, Next.js 16 strict TS, ESLint + Prettier, Vitest + RTL + MSW, Playwright | Conventional, fast |
    29	| Q16 | Native Ollama install | `brew install ollama` + `brew services` | Metal acceleration for evals and the native path |
    30	| Q17 | Model roster | See R2 and the follow-ups | - |
    31	| Q18 | Top-10 sources | Yahoo Finance, CNBC, AP News, Investing.com, Motley Fool, Benzinga, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, SEC EDGAR 8-K EX-99.1, CNN Business; backups Fortune, Business Wire, Guardian, BBC; the live probe decides | Reviewer likelihood x accessibility; the brief names earnings reports, EDGAR is their primary source |
    32	| Q19 | Fetch identity | Standard browser header set, no evasion (no captcha solving, proxies or TLS impersonation); typed `source_blocked` / `paywalled` / `consent_required` errors with hints; `SEC_USER_AGENT` for EDGAR | Neither end of the spectrum |
    33	| Q20 | Yahoo EU consent wall | Submit "reject all" and cache the cookie; fall back to `consent_required` | Gets the article without granting tracking consent on anyone's behalf |
    34	
    35	## Round 2
    36	
    37	| # | Question | Decision | Why |
    38	|---|---|---|---|
    39	| R1 | UI serving topology | FastAPI serves the static Next.js export from the same origin (multi-stage Docker build); dev uses `pnpm dev` + CORS for localhost | No proxy hop on the latency path, no nginx, no Node at runtime; the brief requires a Python backend anyway |
    40	| R2 | Decision models | `clef-flash:9b-q8_0` + `nimble:9b-q4_K_M`, with `qwen3.5:0.8b` as the generative baseline | PoC balance; clef-flash by request, nimble best published accuracy among the rest |
    41	| R3 | Streaming `/analyze` | Typed SSE events `meta` -> `sentiment` -> `summary_delta*` -> `done`; JSON field order (sentiment-first vs summary-first) is an eval dimension | Sentiment arrives after a handful of output tokens when it is generated first |
    42	| R4 | Extraction matrix + reference | 4 parsers x 4 own strategies + trafilatura (default, precision), readability-lxml, newspaper4k, justext, strip-tags; reference bodies produced by Opus, kept local (gitignored) | Comparable quality metric without publishing article text |
    43	| R5 | Article-set procedure | Opus discovery via RSS/sections (last ~60 days, fetchable by our fetcher); two independent Opus labellers + adjudicator, ambiguous articles replaced; agreement reported; split 30 dev / 60 test | Stand-in for a human check |
    44	| R6 | Summary evaluation | Deterministic checks (numbers grounded in source, entity named, length) + key-fact coverage via a local embedding model + Opus-as-judge on finalists | Cheap reproducible signal plus a strong judge where it matters |
    45	| R7 | Latency budgets (native, warm, excl. fetch) | `/signal` lede p50 <= 500 ms; `/summary` and `/analyze` TTFT <= 1.5 s, complete p50 <= 4 s; unrealistic budgets are surfaced, not silently moved | Concrete selection gate |
    46	| R8 | Bundled models | Per-endpoint winners if they total <= ~10 GB, else the best finalist that fits; all other Docker containers stopped during setup | Docker Desktop VM has 15.6 GiB |
    47	| R9 | Transcript scope | Only this build session (main + subagents + workflows) | No other relevant sessions |
    48	| R10 | Docs layout | `.context/docs/design/NN-*.md`, backlog in `90-optional-backlog.md`, eval reports in `evals/results/` | Book-order reading |
    49	
    50	## Follow-ups
    51	
    52	- Generative roster trimmed: summary {`qwen3.5:2b`, `qwen3.5:4b`}; combined {`qwen3.5:4b`, `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507`,
    53	  `ministral-3:3b`}; `qwen3.5:9b` only as a holdout quality ceiling; Gemma 4 dropped (open think+format bug).
    54	- Lean prompt grid: 2 rubric styles x few-shot {0, 4} x field order where relevant (<= 8 configs per model).
    55	- Stopped Docker containers stay stopped; the restart command is handed back at the end.
    56	- `tev1:0.8b-q8_0` is used only in CI to exercise the real decision-model path in containers; it is not evaluated.
    57	
    58	## Build-time findings that adjusted the plan
    59	
    60	Measured during P1/P2, recorded here so the deviations are traceable. Inputs for the Ollama probe were synthetic
    61	(`evals/results/ollama_probe.json`, native Metal, warm, n=5).
    62	
    63	- **Sources** (`02-source-probe.md`): AP News, Investing.com, Benzinga and Business Wire refuse a plain client at
    64	  their CDN (Cloudflare / Akamai), so all four backups were promoted. Final 10: Yahoo Finance, CNBC, Motley Fool,
    65	  PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, SEC EDGAR EX-99.1, CNN Business, Fortune, Guardian Business, BBC Business.
    66	- **R7 sanity gate passed**: each endpoint has at least one candidate inside its budget, so no budget moved.
    67	  - `/signal`: `qwen3.5:0.8b` answers in 190 ms at ~510 prompt tokens. The 9B decision models take 1.3-1.5 s
    68	    at the same size, so they are reported against the budget rather than the budget relaxed for them.
    69	  - `/summary`: `qwen3.5:2b` shows first text at 0.93 s and finishes at 2.2 s on ~1.6k-token articles;
    70	    `qwen3.5:4b` misses the 1.5 s TTFT budget at that size (2.4 s).
    71	  - `/analyze`: `ministral-3:3b` reaches the score at 1.47 s and finishes at 3.5 s on ~1.75k tokens; the 4B
    72	    qwen models miss TTFT at full-article size.
    73	- **Logprobs**: Ollama 0.40.6 also returns logprobs on streamed chunks (undocumented). The knob comparison stays
    74	  on non-streaming `/signal`; `/analyze` keeps the ordinal knob. Logprob-weighted streaming confidence goes to
    75	  the backlog.
    76	- **Field order**: `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507` ignores schema property order (always entity, score, summary) and
    77	  ignores `think:false` when a schema is set, so the field-order dimension runs on `qwen3.5:4b` and
    78	  `ministral-3:3b` only.
    79	- **Fetch cap** raised from 5 MB to 10 MB: CNN article pages are 5.7-6.6 MB decompressed.
```

```
     1	from __future__ import annotations
     2	
     3	from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
     4	from contextlib import AsyncExitStack, asynccontextmanager
     5	
     6	from fastapi import FastAPI, Request
     7	from fastapi.exception_handlers import request_validation_exception_handler
     8	from fastapi.exceptions import RequestValidationError
     9	from fastapi.middleware.cors import CORSMiddleware
    10	from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse, Response
    11	from fastapi.staticfiles import StaticFiles
    12	
    13	from veritrade import __version__
    14	from veritrade.api.contracts import ErrorResponse
    15	from veritrade.api.routes import router
    16	from veritrade.api.sse import error_body
    17	from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
    18	from veritrade.errors import InvalidUrl, VtError
    19	from veritrade.fetch import Fetcher, HttpFetcher
    20	from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
    21	from veritrade.models_registry import Registry
    22	from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
    23	
    24	URL_HINT = "Send the full article address, starting with http:// or https://."
    25	
    26	
    27	def error_response(exc: VtError) -> JSONResponse:
    28	    body = ErrorResponse(error=error_body(exc))
    29	    return JSONResponse(status_code=exc.http_status, content=body.model_dump(mode="json"))
    30	
    31	
    32	def create_app(
    33	    settings: Settings | None = None,
    34	    *,
    35	    fetcher: Fetcher | None = None,
    36	    ollama: OllamaClient | None = None,
    37	    registry: Registry | None = None,
    38	) -> FastAPI:
    39	    """Injected clients stay owned by the caller; the lifespan closes only what it builds."""
    40	    settings = settings or get_settings()
    41	
    42	    @asynccontextmanager
    43	    async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:
    44	        async with AsyncExitStack() as stack:
    45	            page_fetcher = fetcher
    46	            if page_fetcher is None:
    47	                page_fetcher = HttpFetcher(settings)
    48	                stack.push_async_callback(page_fetcher.aclose)
    49	            llm = ollama
    50	            if llm is None:
    51	                llm = OllamaClient.from_settings(settings)
    52	                stack.push_async_callback(llm.aclose)
    53	            app.state.runtime = Runtime.build(settings, fetcher=page_fetcher, ollama=llm, registry=registry)
    54	            yield
    55	
    56	    app = FastAPI(title="VeriTrade Analytics", version=__version__, lifespan=lifespan)
    57	    app.state.settings = settings
    58	
    59	    @app.exception_handler(VtError)
    60	    async def _vt_error(_: Request, exc: VtError) -> JSONResponse:
    61	        return error_response(exc)
    62	
    63	    @app.exception_handler(RequestValidationError)
    64	    async def _invalid_request(request: Request, exc: RequestValidationError) -> Response:
    65	        # A malformed article URL gets the documented invalid_url code; other shape errors keep FastAPI's 422.
    66	        errors = exc.errors()
    67	        if errors and all(tuple(error["loc"][:2]) == ("body", "url") for error in errors):
    68	            return error_response(InvalidUrl(f"url: {errors[0]['msg']}", hint=URL_HINT))
    69	        return await request_validation_exception_handler(request, exc)
    70	
    71	    if settings.cors_origin_list:
    72	        app.add_middleware(
    73	            CORSMiddleware,
    74	            allow_origins=settings.cors_origin_list,
    75	            allow_methods=["GET", "POST"],
    76	            allow_headers=["*"],
    77	        )
    78	    app.include_router(router)
    79	    # Mounted last so /api routes win; html=True serves the static export's index.html files.
    80	    if settings.static_dir and settings.static_dir.is_dir():
    81	        app.mount("/", StaticFiles(directory=settings.static_dir, html=True), name="static")
    82	    return app
```
