```python
"""Async Ollama client on httpx: the only Ollama path for the API, evals and probes."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import json
import time
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator, Mapping, Sequence
from types import TracebackType
from typing import Any, Self

import httpx
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, ValidationError

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import (
    InferenceTimeout,
    LlmUnreachable,
    ModelUnavailable,
    SchemaViolation,
    VtError,
)
from veritrade.inference.schemas import ollama_format
from veritrade.inference.types import (
    SENTIMENTS,
    ChatResult,
    DecisionResult,
    OllamaTimings,
    Sentiment,
    TokenLogprob,
)

Message = Mapping[str, str]
# Greedy and seeded so evals and serving see the same output for the same prompt. Penalties are neutralised
# because Modelfiles set them (qwen3.5: presence_penalty 1.5), which skews outputs away from recent tokens.
FIXED_OPTIONS: dict[str, Any] = {
    "temperature": 0,
    "seed": 0,
    "presence_penalty": 0,
    "frequency_penalty": 0,
    "repeat_penalty": 1,
}
SENTIMENT_QUESTION = "sentiment"


class _ChoiceAnswer(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")

    choice: Sentiment
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float]
    confidence: float


def _ms(value: Any) -> float | None:
    return value / 1e6 if isinstance(value, int | float) else None


def _int(value: Any) -> int | None:
    return value if isinstance(value, int) else None


def parse_timings(body: Mapping[str, Any]) -> OllamaTimings:
    return OllamaTimings(
        load_ms=_ms(body.get("load_duration")),
        prompt_eval_ms=_ms(body.get("prompt_eval_duration")),
        eval_ms=_ms(body.get("eval_duration")),
        prompt_tokens=_int(body.get("prompt_eval_count")),
        eval_tokens=_int(body.get("eval_count")),
        total_ms=_ms(body.get("total_duration")),
    )


def parse_logprobs(raw: Any) -> tuple[TokenLogprob, ...] | None:
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or not raw:
        return None
    return tuple(
        TokenLogprob(
            token=entry["token"],
            logprob=float(entry["logprob"]),
            top=tuple((alt["token"], float(alt["logprob"])) for alt in entry.get("top_logprobs") or ()),
        )
        for entry in raw
    )


def _error_text(response: httpx.Response) -> str:
    try:
        body = response.json()
    except ValueError:
        return response.text[:300]
    error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    return error if isinstance(error, str) else response.text[:300]


def _status_error(status: int, text: str, model: str | None) -> VtError:
    name = model or "?"
    if status == 404 or "not found" in text.lower():
        return ModelUnavailable(
            f"Model {name} is not available in Ollama: {text}",
            hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {name}` or pick an installed model.",
            upstream_status=status,
        )
    return ModelUnavailable(
        f"Ollama rejected the request for {name} ({status}): {text}", upstream_status=status
    )


class OllamaClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        *,
        timeout: float = 90.0,
        keep_alive: str | int = "30m",
        http: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.keep_alive = keep_alive
        self._http = http or httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url, timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout, connect=min(5.0, timeout))
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_settings(cls, settings: Settings | None = None) -> OllamaClient:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        return cls(
            settings.ollama_base_url,
            timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,
            keep_alive=settings.ollama_keep_alive,
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._http.aclose()

    async def __aenter__(self) -> Self:
        return self

    async def __aexit__(
        self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None
    ) -> None:
        await self.aclose()

    # --- transport ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _transport_error(self, exc: httpx.HTTPError, model: str | None) -> VtError:
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.ConnectError | httpx.ConnectTimeout):
            return LlmUnreachable(
                f"Cannot reach Ollama at {self.base_url}: {exc}",
                hint="Start Ollama (`brew services start ollama`) or point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at it.",
            )
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.TimeoutException):
            return InferenceTimeout(f"Ollama did not answer in time for {model or 'request'}: {exc!r}")
        return LlmUnreachable(f"Ollama connection failed: {exc!r}")

    async def request(
        self, method: str, path: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, *, model: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """One JSON round trip with Ollama errors mapped to typed VtErrors."""
        try:
            response = await self._http.request(method, path, json=payload)
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned non-JSON for {path}") from exc
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned an unexpected body for {path}")
        return body

    # --- chat -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _chat_body(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        stream: bool,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        logprobs: bool,
        top_logprobs: int | None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": [dict(m) for m in messages],
            "stream": stream,
            "think": False,
            "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
            "options": {**(options or {}), **FIXED_OPTIONS},
        }
        if format is not None:
            body["format"] = format
        if logprobs:
            body["logprobs"] = True
            if top_logprobs is not None:
                body["top_logprobs"] = top_logprobs
        return body

    async def chat_raw(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[ChatResult, dict[str, Any]]:
        body = self._chat_body(
            model,
            messages,
            stream=False,
            format=format,
            options=options,
            logprobs=logprobs,
            top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
        )
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        raw = await self.request("POST", "/api/chat", body, model=model)
        wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        message = raw.get("message") or {}
        result = ChatResult(
            content=str(message.get("content") or ""),
            wall_ms=wall_ms,
            timings=parse_timings(raw),
            logprobs=parse_logprobs(raw.get("logprobs")),
        )
        return result, raw

    async def chat(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> ChatResult:
        result, _ = await self.chat_raw(
            model, messages, format=format, options=options, logprobs=logprobs, top_logprobs=top_logprobs
        )
        return result

    async def chat_json[T: BaseModel](
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        out_type: type[T],
        *,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[T, ChatResult]:
        """Schema-constrained chat, validated; one retry, with a doubled budget if output was cut."""
        opts = dict(options or {})
        spent_ms = 0.0
        last_error: ValidationError | None = None
        for _attempt in range(2):
            result, raw = await self.chat_raw(
                model,
                messages,
                format=ollama_format(out_type),
                options=opts,
                logprobs=logprobs,
                top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
            )
            spent_ms += result.wall_ms
            try:
                parsed = out_type.model_validate_json(result.content)
            except ValidationError as exc:
                last_error = exc
                if raw.get("done_reason") == "length" and isinstance(opts.get("num_predict"), int):
                    opts["num_predict"] = opts["num_predict"] * 2
                continue
            return parsed, dataclasses.replace(result, wall_ms=spent_ms)
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} returned output that does not match {out_type.__name__} twice",
            hint=str(last_error)[:300] if last_error else None,
        )

    async def chat_stream(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> AsyncGenerator[str | ChatResult]:
        """Yield content deltas, then one final ChatResult; ttft is measured here, not by Ollama."""
        body = self._chat_body(
            model,
            messages,
            stream=True,
            format=format,
            options=options,
            logprobs=logprobs,
            top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
        )
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        ttft_ms: float | None = None
        parts: list[str] = []
        token_logprobs: list[TokenLogprob] = []
        try:
            async with self._http.stream("POST", "/api/chat", json=body) as response:
                if response.status_code >= 400:
                    await response.aread()
                    raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
                async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                    if not line.strip():
                        continue
                    try:
                        chunk = json.loads(line)
                    except ValueError as exc:
                        raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama sent a malformed stream line for {model}") from exc
                    if isinstance(chunk.get("error"), str):
                        raise _status_error(500, chunk["error"], model)
                    if parsed := parse_logprobs(chunk.get("logprobs")):
                        token_logprobs.extend(parsed)
                    delta = str((chunk.get("message") or {}).get("content") or "")
                    if delta:
                        if ttft_ms is None:
                            ttft_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
                        parts.append(delta)
                        yield delta
                    if chunk.get("done"):
                        yield ChatResult(
                            content="".join(parts),
                            wall_ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
                            timings=parse_timings(chunk),
                            logprobs=tuple(token_logprobs) or None,
                            ttft_ms=ttft_ms,
                        )
                        return
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama stream for {model} ended without a done message")

    # --- decision models ------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def systemone(
        self, model: str, state: str, questions: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = {
            "model": model,
            "state": state,
            "questions": {k: dict(v) for k, v in questions.items()},
            "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
        }
        return await self.request("POST", "/v1/systemone", body, model=model)

    async def decide_sentiment(
        self,
        model: str,
        state: str,
        instructions: str,
        criteria: Mapping[Sentiment, str | None],
    ) -> DecisionResult:
        """One `choice` question; criteria order is the tie order, so callers put neutral first."""
        if set(criteria) != set(SENTIMENTS):
            raise ValueError(f"criteria must name exactly {SENTIMENTS}, got {list(criteria)}")
        question = {"type": "choice", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": dict(criteria)}
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        raw = await self.systemone(model, state, {SENTIMENT_QUESTION: question})
        wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        try:
            answer = _ChoiceAnswer.model_validate((raw.get("answers") or {}).get(SENTIMENT_QUESTION))
        except ValidationError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned an unexpected systemone answer") from exc
        if set(answer.probabilities) != set(SENTIMENTS):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned probabilities for {sorted(answer.probabilities)}")
        usage = raw.get("usage") or {}
        return DecisionResult(
            choice=answer.choice,
            probabilities={s: answer.probabilities[s] for s in criteria},
            confidence=answer.confidence,
            wall_ms=wall_ms,
            input_tokens=_int(usage.get("input_tokens")),
        )

    # --- utilities ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def embed(self, model: str, inputs: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        body = {"model": model, "input": list(inputs), "keep_alive": self.keep_alive}
        raw = await self.request("POST", "/api/embed", body, model=model)
        embeddings = raw.get("embeddings")
        if not isinstance(embeddings, list) or len(embeddings) != len(inputs):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned {len(embeddings or [])} embeddings for {len(inputs)}")
        return [[float(x) for x in row] for row in embeddings]

    async def tags(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list((await self.request("GET", "/api/tags")).get("models") or [])

    async def ps(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list((await self.request("GET", "/api/ps")).get("models") or [])

    async def show(self, model: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self.request("POST", "/api/show", {"model": model}, model=model)

    async def version(self) -> str:
        return str((await self.request("GET", "/api/version")).get("version") or "")

    async def unload(self, model: str) -> None:
        await self.request("POST", "/api/generate", {"model": model, "keep_alive": 0}, model=model)
```

```python
"""Thin async adapters from (model spec, prompt, article text) to validated outputs and verdicts."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import SchemaViolation
from veritrade.inference.confidence import (
    LabelLogprobPolicy,
    OrdinalPolicy,
    ProbabilityPolicy,
    policy_for,
)
from veritrade.inference.incremental import JsonFieldScanner, ScanEvent
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.schemas import (
    ANALYZE_MODELS,
    AnalyzeOut,
    LabelOut,
    OrdinalOut,
    SummaryOut,
    ollama_format,
)
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, OllamaTimings, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec, SignalSchema
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
TOP_LOGPROBS = 20


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SummaryResult:
    output: SummaryOut
    chat: ChatResult


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AnalyzeResult:
    output: AnalyzeOut
    verdict: Verdict
    chat: ChatResult

    @property
    def entity(self) -> str | None:
        return self.output.entity.strip() or None


def fit_input(text: str, max_input_tokens: int) -> str:
    """Cap at max_input_tokens (chars/4), cutting at the last whitespace so no word is split."""
    limit = max_input_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    cut = max(text.rfind(" ", 0, limit), text.rfind("\n", 0, limit))
    return text[: cut if cut > limit // 2 else limit].rstrip()


def chat_options(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint) -> dict[str, Any]:
    options: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if spec.num_ctx is not None:
        options["num_ctx"] = spec.num_ctx
    if endpoint in spec.num_predict:
        options["num_predict"] = spec.num_predict[endpoint]
    return options


def score_verdict(spec: ModelSpec, score: int) -> Verdict:
    """Verdict for a streamed or /analyze score; both always use the ordinal policy."""
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(score)


def _sum(a: float | None, b: float | None) -> float | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _sum_int(a: int | None, b: int | None) -> int | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _combine(first: ChatResult, second: ChatResult) -> ChatResult:
    # The fallback call's output decides; the reported cost covers both calls.
    t1, t2 = first.timings, second.timings
    return ChatResult(
        content=second.content,
        wall_ms=first.wall_ms + second.wall_ms,
        timings=OllamaTimings(
            load_ms=_sum(t1.load_ms, t2.load_ms),
            prompt_eval_ms=_sum(t1.prompt_eval_ms, t2.prompt_eval_ms),
            eval_ms=_sum(t1.eval_ms, t2.eval_ms),
            prompt_tokens=_sum_int(t1.prompt_tokens, t2.prompt_tokens),
            eval_tokens=_sum_int(t1.eval_tokens, t2.eval_tokens),
            total_ms=_sum(t1.total_ms, t2.total_ms),
        ),
        logprobs=second.logprobs,
    )


async def _signal_call(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str, schema: SignalSchema
) -> tuple[LabelOut | OrdinalOut, ChatResult]:
    out_type: type[LabelOut] | type[OrdinalOut] = LabelOut if schema == "label" else OrdinalOut
    return await client.chat_json(
        spec.name,
        prompt.messages(text, schema),
        out_type,
        options=chat_options(spec, "signal"),
        logprobs=True,
        top_logprobs=TOP_LOGPROBS,
    )


async def classify_signal(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> tuple[Verdict, ChatResult | DecisionResult]:
    """Label-logprob falls back label -> ordinal call (score sign) -> ordinal policy on the score."""
    text = fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens)
    policy = policy_for(spec, endpoint="signal")
    if isinstance(policy, ProbabilityPolicy):
        decision = await client.decide_sentiment(
            spec.name, prompt.state(text), prompt.instructions, prompt.criteria_map
        )
        return policy.decide(decision.probabilities), decision
    out, chat = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, spec.signal_schema or "ordinal")
    if isinstance(policy, LabelLogprobPolicy):
        verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is None and isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            out, second = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, "ordinal")
            chat = _combine(chat, second)
            verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is not None:
            return verdict, chat
    if not isinstance(out, OrdinalOut):
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name}: a label output needs the label-logprob policy")
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(out.score), chat


def _validate[T: BaseModel](out_type: type[T], content: str, model: str) -> T:
    try:
        return out_type.model_validate_json(content)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} streamed output that does not match {out_type.__name__}", hint=str(exc)[:300]
        ) from exc


async def summarize(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> SummaryResult:
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    out, chat = await client.chat_json(spec.name, messages, SummaryOut, options=chat_options(spec, "summary"))
    return SummaryResult(out, chat)


async def summarize_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | SummaryResult]:
    """Summary text deltas as they decode, then the validated result (no retry once tokens are out)."""
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(SummaryOut), options=chat_options(spec, "summary")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                scanner.close()
                yield SummaryResult(_validate(SummaryOut, item.content, spec.name), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event


async def analyze(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> AnalyzeResult:
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    out, chat = await client.chat_json(
        spec.name, messages, ANALYZE_MODELS[order], options=chat_options(spec, "analyze")
    )
    return AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), chat)


async def analyze_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | AnalyzeResult]:
    """Scanner events in generation order (ScoreClosed first when sentiment-first), then the result."""
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    out_type = ANALYZE_MODELS[order]
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(out_type), options=chat_options(spec, "analyze")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                scanner.close()
                out = _validate(out_type, item.content, spec.name)
                yield AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event
```

```python
"""Incremental scanner for a flat streamed JSON object; emits score/entity/summary as soon as they exist."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

from veritrade.errors import SchemaViolation


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ScoreClosed:
    score: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class EntityClosed:
    entity: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SummaryText:
    delta: str


ScanEvent = ScoreClosed | EntityClosed | SummaryText


class _State(Enum):
    BEGIN = auto()
    KEY_OR_END = auto()
    KEY_REQUIRED = auto()
    KEY = auto()
    COLON = auto()
    VALUE = auto()
    STRING = auto()
    NUMBER = auto()
    LITERAL = auto()
    AFTER_VALUE = auto()
    END = auto()


_WS = frozenset(" \t\n\r")
_PLAIN = re.compile(r'[^"\\\x00-\x1f]+')
_HEX = frozenset("0123456789abcdefABCDEF")
_NUMBER_CHARS = frozenset("0123456789+-.eE")
_JSON_NUMBER = re.compile(r"-?(?:0|[1-9]\d*)(?:\.\d+)?(?:[eE][+-]?\d+)?")
_JSON_INT = re.compile(r"-?(?:0|[1-9]\d*)")
_SIMPLE_ESCAPES = {'"': '"', "\\": "\\", "/": "/", "b": "\b", "f": "\f", "n": "\n", "r": "\r", "t": "\t"}
_KNOWN = frozenset({"score", "entity", "summary"})


class JsonFieldScanner:
    """Feed raw content deltas; `close()` raises unless exactly one complete object was seen. With
    `score_range`, the score is emitted once no further digit could stay in range (a token before
    its delimiter arrives); the delimiter still validates it."""

    def __init__(self, *, score_range: tuple[int, int] | None = (-2, 2)) -> None:
        self._score_range = score_range
        self._state = _State.BEGIN
        self._pos = 0
        self._key: str | None = None
        self._seen: set[str] = set()
        self._buf: list[str] = []
        self._esc: str | None = None
        self._high: int | None = None
        self._num: list[str] = []
        self._score_emitted: int | None = None
        self._pending: list[str] = []

    @property
    def done(self) -> bool:
        return self._state is _State.END

    def _fail(self, why: str) -> SchemaViolation:
        return SchemaViolation(f"Malformed streamed JSON at char {self._pos}: {why}")

    def feed(self, chunk: str) -> list[ScanEvent]:
        events: list[ScanEvent] = []
        i, n = 0, len(chunk)
        while i < n:
            state = self._state
            if state is _State.KEY or state is _State.STRING:
                i = self._scan_string(chunk, i, events)
                continue
            c = chunk[i]
            if state is _State.NUMBER:
                if c in _NUMBER_CHARS:
                    self._num.append(c)
                    self._advance(1)
                    i += 1
                    self._maybe_emit_score_early(events)
                else:
                    self._finish_number(events)
                continue
            if state is _State.LITERAL:
                if c.isalpha():
                    self._num.append(c)
                    self._advance(1)
                    i += 1
                else:
                    self._finish_literal()
                continue
            self._advance(1)
            i += 1
            if c in _WS:
                continue
            self._structural(c)
        self._flush_summary(events)
        return events

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._state is not _State.END:
            raise self._fail("stream ended before the JSON object closed")

    # --- structure ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _advance(self, count: int) -> None:
        self._pos += count

    def _structural(self, c: str) -> None:
        state = self._state
        if state is _State.BEGIN and c == "{":
            self._state = _State.KEY_OR_END
        elif state in (_State.KEY_OR_END, _State.KEY_REQUIRED) and c == '"':
            self._state = _State.KEY
            self._buf = []
        elif state is _State.KEY_OR_END and c == "}":
            self._state = _State.END
        elif state is _State.COLON and c == ":":
            self._state = _State.VALUE
        elif state is _State.VALUE:
            self._start_value(c)
        elif state is _State.AFTER_VALUE and c == ",":
            self._state = _State.KEY_REQUIRED
        elif state is _State.AFTER_VALUE and c == "}":
            self._state = _State.END
        else:
            raise self._fail(f"unexpected {c!r} in state {state.name}")

    def _start_value(self, c: str) -> None:
        if c == '"':
            self._state = _State.STRING
            self._buf = []
        elif c == "-" or c.isdigit():
            self._state = _State.NUMBER
            self._num = [c]
        elif c in "tfn":
            self._state = _State.LITERAL
            self._num = [c]
        elif c in "{[":
            raise self._fail("nested values are not part of any output schema")
        else:
            raise self._fail(f"unexpected {c!r} at the start of a value")

    # --- strings --------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _scan_string(self, chunk: str, i: int, events: list[ScanEvent]) -> int:
        n = len(chunk)
        while i < n:
            if self._esc is not None:
                self._esc += chunk[i]
                self._advance(1)
                i += 1
                self._step_escape()
                continue
            run = _PLAIN.match(chunk, i)
            if run:
                self._append(run.group())
                self._advance(run.end() - i)
                i = run.end()
                continue
            c = chunk[i]
            self._advance(1)
            i += 1
            if c == '"':
                self._close_string(events)
                return i
            if c == "\\":
                self._esc = "\\"
                continue
            raise self._fail("unescaped control character in a string")
        return i

    def _step_escape(self) -> None:
        esc = self._esc or ""
        if len(esc) == 2:
            kind = esc[1]
            if kind in _SIMPLE_ESCAPES:
                self._esc = None
                self._append(_SIMPLE_ESCAPES[kind])
            elif kind != "u":
                raise self._fail(f"invalid escape \\{kind}")
            return
        if esc[-1] not in _HEX:
            raise self._fail(f"invalid \\u escape {esc!r}")
        if len(esc) < 6:
            return
        self._esc = None
        code = int(esc[2:], 16)
        if 0xD800 <= code <= 0xDBFF:
            if self._high is not None:
                raise self._fail("two high surrogates in a row")
            self._high = code
        elif 0xDC00 <= code <= 0xDFFF:
            if self._high is None:
                raise self._fail("low surrogate without a high surrogate")
            high, self._high = self._high, None
            self._emit_text(chr(0x10000 + ((high - 0xD800) << 10) + (code - 0xDC00)))
        else:
            self._append(chr(code))

    def _append(self, text: str) -> None:
        if self._high is not None:
            raise self._fail("high surrogate not followed by a low surrogate")
        self._emit_text(text)

    def _emit_text(self, text: str) -> None:
        self._buf.append(text)
        if self._state is _State.STRING and self._key == "summary":
            self._pending.append(text)

    def _close_string(self, events: list[ScanEvent]) -> None:
        if self._high is not None:
            raise self._fail("string ended inside a surrogate pair")
        text = "".join(self._buf)
        self._buf = []
        if self._state is _State.KEY:
            if text in self._seen:
                raise self._fail(f"duplicate key {text!r}")
            self._seen.add(text)
            self._key = text
            self._state = _State.COLON
            return
        if self._key == "score":
            raise self._fail("score must be an integer, got a string")
        self._flush_summary(events)
        if self._key == "entity":
            events.append(EntityClosed(text))
        self._state = _State.AFTER_VALUE

    def _flush_summary(self, events: list[ScanEvent]) -> None:
        if self._pending:
            events.append(SummaryText("".join(self._pending)))
            self._pending = []

    # --- numbers and literals -------------------------------------------------------------

    def _maybe_emit_score_early(self, events: list[ScanEvent]) -> None:
        if self._key != "score" or self._score_range is None or self._score_emitted is not None:
            return
        text = "".join(self._num)
        if not _JSON_INT.fullmatch(text):
            return
        lo, hi = self._score_range
        value = int(text)
        extendable = text.lstrip("-") != "0" and any(lo <= int(text + d) <= hi for d in "0123456789")
        if lo <= value <= hi and not extendable:
            self._score_emitted = value
            events.append(ScoreClosed(value))

    def _finish_number(self, events: list[ScanEvent]) -> None:
        text = "".join(self._num)
        self._num = []
        self._state = _State.AFTER_VALUE
        if not _JSON_NUMBER.fullmatch(text):
            raise self._fail(f"invalid number {text!r}")
        if self._key in ("entity", "summary"):
            raise self._fail(f"{self._key} must be a string")
        if self._key != "score":
            return
        if not _JSON_INT.fullmatch(text):
            raise self._fail(f"score must be an integer, got {text!r}")
        value = int(text)
        if self._score_range and not self._score_range[0] <= value <= self._score_range[1]:
            raise self._fail(f"score {value} is outside {self._score_range}")
        if self._score_emitted is None:
            events.append(ScoreClosed(value))
        elif self._score_emitted != value:
            raise self._fail("score changed after it was emitted")

    def _finish_literal(self) -> None:
        text = "".join(self._num)
        self._num = []
        self._state = _State.AFTER_VALUE
        if text not in ("true", "false", "null"):
            raise self._fail(f"invalid literal {text!r}")
        if self._key in _KNOWN:
            raise self._fail(f"{self._key} cannot be {text}")
```

```python
"""Structured outputs. Property order is the generation order Ollama's grammar enforces."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from functools import cache
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from veritrade.inference.types import FieldOrder, Sentiment

Score = Literal[-2, -1, 0, 1, 2]


class _Out(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class LabelOut(_Out):
    label: Sentiment


class OrdinalOut(_Out):
    score: Score


class SummaryOut(_Out):
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)


class AnalyzeSentimentFirst(_Out):
    score: Score
    entity: str
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)


class AnalyzeSummaryFirst(_Out):
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)
    entity: str
    score: Score


AnalyzeOut = AnalyzeSentimentFirst | AnalyzeSummaryFirst
StructuredOut = LabelOut | OrdinalOut | SummaryOut | AnalyzeSentimentFirst | AnalyzeSummaryFirst

ANALYZE_MODELS: dict[FieldOrder, type[AnalyzeSentimentFirst] | type[AnalyzeSummaryFirst]] = {
    "sentiment-first": AnalyzeSentimentFirst,
    "summary-first": AnalyzeSummaryFirst,
}


def _strip(node: Any) -> Any:
    # Titles and descriptions only cost grammar states; the prompt carries the semantics.
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        return {k: _strip(v) for k, v in node.items() if k not in ("title", "description")}
    if isinstance(node, list):
        return [_strip(v) for v in node]
    return node


@cache
def _format_cached(model: type[BaseModel]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    schema = _strip(model.model_json_schema())
    schema["additionalProperties"] = False
    schema["required"] = list(model.model_fields)
    return dict(schema)


def ollama_format(model: type[BaseModel]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """JSON schema for Ollama's `format`; `properties` keeps the model's field order."""
    return copy.deepcopy(_format_cached(model))


def score_sentiment(score: int) -> Sentiment:
    return "bullish" if score > 0 else "bearish" if score < 0 else "neutral"
```

```python
"""/summary: a short summary of the full article, as one JSON body or as streamed deltas."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import SummaryDeltaEvent, SummaryDoneEvent, SummaryRequest, SummaryResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import SummaryResult, summarize, summarize_stream
from veritrade.inference.incremental import SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, Prepared, StreamPayload, cached_meta_event, inference_timings
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "summary", request, scope="full", clock=clock)


async def run_summary(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SummaryResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await summarize(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_summary_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = summarize_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case SummaryResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: SummaryResponse) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: SummaryResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> SummaryResponse:
    return SummaryResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )
```

```python
"""/analyze: sentiment, entity and summary from one generation, as JSON or as streamed events."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    SentimentEvent,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
)
from veritrade.inference.adapters import AnalyzeResult, analyze, analyze_stream, score_verdict
from veritrade.inference.incremental import EntityClosed, ScoreClosed, SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import (
    Job,
    Prepared,
    StreamPayload,
    cached_meta_event,
    inference_timings,
    signal_result,
)
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "analyze", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)


async def run_analyze(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await analyze(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_analyze_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit, clock)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Events follow generation order, so the frozen field order decides where `sentiment` lands."""
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    entity: str | None = None
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = analyze_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case ScoreClosed(score=score):
                    yield SentimentEvent(
                        signal=signal_result(score_verdict(job.spec, score)),
                        entity=entity,
                        elapsed_ms=job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
                    )
                case EntityClosed(entity=name):
                    entity = name.strip() or None
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case AnalyzeResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: AnalyzeResponse, clock: StageTimer) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SentimentEvent(signal=hit.signal, entity=hit.entity, elapsed_ms=clock.elapsed_ms())
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: AnalyzeResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    return AnalyzeResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(result.verdict),
        entity=result.entity,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )
```

```python
"""Public API contract: request/response bodies, SSE event payloads and the error envelope."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import AnyHttpUrl, BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from veritrade.errors import ErrorCode
from veritrade.extract.types import ExtractorName, ParserName, Scope
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, FieldOrder, ModelKind, PolicyName, Sentiment


class _Strict(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


# --- requests -------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _ArticleRequest(_Strict):
    url: AnyHttpUrl
    model: str | None = Field(None, description="Allowlisted Ollama tag; endpoint default when omitted.")
    parser: ParserName = "selectolax"
    extractor: ExtractorName = "cascade"
    no_cache: bool = Field(False, description="Bypass fetch and result caches (used by latency benchmarks).")


class SignalRequest(_ArticleRequest):
    scope: Scope = Field("lede", description="lede = headline + opening paragraphs; full = whole article.")


class SummaryRequest(_ArticleRequest):
    pass


class AnalyzeRequest(_ArticleRequest):
    scope: Scope = "full"


# --- shared response parts ------------------------------------------------------------------


class CacheInfo(_Strict):
    fetch: Literal["hit", "miss", "joined", "bypass"]
    result: Literal["hit", "miss", "bypass"]


class InferenceTimings(_Strict):
    wall_ms: float
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    load_ms: float | None = None
    prompt_eval_ms: float | None = None
    eval_ms: float | None = None
    prompt_tokens: int | None = None
    eval_tokens: int | None = None


class Timings(_Strict):
    total_ms: float
    fetch_ms: float
    consent_ms: float | None = None
    parse_ms: float
    extract_ms: float
    inference: InferenceTimings | None = None
    cache: CacheInfo


class ArticleMeta(_Strict):
    url: str
    final_url: str
    title: str
    source: str | None = Field(None, description="Key from sources.toml when the domain is a known source.")
    published_at: str | None = None
    endpoint: Endpoint
    model: str
    model_kind: ModelKind
    prompt_version: str
    parser: ParserName
    extractor: ExtractorName
    extraction_method: str = Field(description="Strategy that produced the body (cascade resolves to one).")
    scope: Scope
    input_chars: int
    word_count: int
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    cached: bool
    backend: str = Field(description="Inference backend label, e.g. native-metal or docker-cpu.")


class SignalResult(_Strict):
    sentiment: Sentiment
    abstained: bool = Field(description="True when the call fell below the frozen confidence threshold.")
    policy: PolicyName
    confidence: float | None = None
    score: int | None = Field(None, ge=-2, le=2)
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float] | None = None


# --- responses ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class SignalResponse(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    signal: SignalResult
    timings: Timings


class SummaryResponse(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    summary: str
    timings: Timings


class AnalyzeResponse(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    signal: SignalResult
    entity: str | None = None
    summary: str
    timings: Timings


class ErrorBody(_Strict):
    code: ErrorCode
    message: str
    hint: str | None = None
    retryable: bool = False
    upstream_status: int | None = None


class ErrorResponse(_Strict):
    error: ErrorBody


class ModelInfo(_Strict):
    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: list[Endpoint]
    installed: bool
    size_bytes: int | None = None
    evaluated: bool = Field(True, description="False for plumbing-only models (e.g. the CI decision model).")


class ModelsResponse(_Strict):
    models: list[ModelInfo]
    defaults: dict[Endpoint, str]
    parsers: list[ParserName]
    extractors: list[ExtractorName]
    scopes: list[Scope]


class HealthResponse(_Strict):
    status: Literal["ok", "degraded"]
    ollama_reachable: bool
    ollama_version: str | None = None
    backend: str
    version: str


# --- SSE event payloads (event name -> data model) ------------------------------------------
# /summary/stream: meta -> summary_delta* -> done
# /analyze/stream: meta -> sentiment (exactly once, position follows field order) + summary_delta* -> done
# Any failure after the stream opens emits a single `error` event and closes.


class MetaEvent(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    fetch_ms: float
    parse_ms: float
    extract_ms: float
    cache: CacheInfo


class SentimentEvent(_Strict):
    signal: SignalResult
    entity: str | None = None
    elapsed_ms: float = Field(description="Milliseconds since the request was received.")


class SummaryDeltaEvent(_Strict):
    text: str


class SummaryDoneEvent(_Strict):
    result: SummaryResponse


class AnalyzeDoneEvent(_Strict):
    result: AnalyzeResponse


class ErrorEvent(_Strict):
    error: ErrorBody


SSE_EVENT_NAMES = ("meta", "sentiment", "summary_delta", "done", "error")
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from enum import StrEnum
from typing import ClassVar


class ErrorCode(StrEnum):
    INVALID_URL = "invalid_url"
    BLOCKED_DESTINATION = "blocked_destination"
    MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED = "model_not_allowed"
    PAYWALLED = "paywalled"
    CONSENT_REQUIRED = "consent_required"
    EXTRACTION_EMPTY = "extraction_empty"
    UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT = "unsupported_content"
    TOO_LARGE = "too_large"
    SOURCE_BLOCKED = "source_blocked"
    UPSTREAM_HTTP = "upstream_http"
    SCHEMA_VIOLATION = "schema_violation"
    MODEL_UNAVAILABLE = "model_unavailable"
    LLM_UNREACHABLE = "llm_unreachable"
    UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT = "upstream_timeout"
    INFERENCE_TIMEOUT = "inference_timeout"


ERROR_STATUS: dict[ErrorCode, int] = {
    ErrorCode.INVALID_URL: 400,
    ErrorCode.BLOCKED_DESTINATION: 400,
    ErrorCode.MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED: 400,
    ErrorCode.PAYWALLED: 422,
    ErrorCode.CONSENT_REQUIRED: 422,
    ErrorCode.EXTRACTION_EMPTY: 422,
    ErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: 422,
    ErrorCode.TOO_LARGE: 422,
    ErrorCode.SOURCE_BLOCKED: 502,
    ErrorCode.UPSTREAM_HTTP: 502,
    ErrorCode.SCHEMA_VIOLATION: 502,
    ErrorCode.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: 503,
    ErrorCode.LLM_UNREACHABLE: 503,
    ErrorCode.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: 504,
    ErrorCode.INFERENCE_TIMEOUT: 504,
}


class VtError(Exception):
    code: ClassVar[ErrorCode]
    retryable_default: ClassVar[bool] = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        hint: str | None = None,
        retryable: bool | None = None,
        upstream_status: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.hint = hint
        self.retryable = self.retryable_default if retryable is None else retryable
        self.upstream_status = upstream_status

    @property
    def http_status(self) -> int:
        return ERROR_STATUS[self.code]


class InvalidUrl(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.INVALID_URL


class BlockedDestination(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.BLOCKED_DESTINATION


class ModelNotAllowed(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.MODEL_NOT_ALLOWED


class Paywalled(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.PAYWALLED


class ConsentRequired(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.CONSENT_REQUIRED


class ExtractionEmpty(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.EXTRACTION_EMPTY


class UnsupportedContent(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT


class TooLarge(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.TOO_LARGE


class SourceBlocked(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.SOURCE_BLOCKED


class UpstreamHttp(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.UPSTREAM_HTTP
    retryable_default = True


class SchemaViolation(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.SCHEMA_VIOLATION
    retryable_default = True


class ModelUnavailable(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.MODEL_UNAVAILABLE


class LlmUnreachable(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.LLM_UNREACHABLE
    retryable_default = True


class UpstreamTimeout(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT
    retryable_default = True


class InferenceTimeout(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.INFERENCE_TIMEOUT
    retryable_default = True
```

```python
"""Network-free stand-ins: publisher pages from the skeleton fixtures and a scripted Ollama on respx."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import math
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from functools import cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import httpx
import respx

PUBLIC_IP = "93.184.215.14"
OLLAMA_URL = "http://ollama.test"
SKELETONS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "fixtures" / "skeletons"
# Synthetic model output; the escaped quote and the non-ASCII sign exercise the stream scanner.
SUMMARY = 'Acme Corp raised its outlook after "record" demand lifted revenue 12% to €3.1 billion.'
ENTITY = "Acme Corp"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Page:
    source: str
    url: str
    html: str
    body_markers: tuple[str, ...]


@cache
def skeleton_pages() -> dict[str, Page]:
    pages = {}
    for path in sorted(SKELETONS.glob("*/*.expected.json")):
        expected = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        html = path.with_name(f"{expected['slug']}.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        source = expected["source"]
        pages[source] = Page(source, expected["fixture_url"], html, tuple(expected["body_markers"]))
    return pages


class FakeResolver:
    """Hosts resolve to one public address unless the table says otherwise; no DNS is used."""

    def __init__(self, table: Mapping[str, list[str]] | None = None) -> None:
        self.table = dict(table or {})

    async def __call__(self, host: str, port: int) -> list[str]:
        return self.table.get(host, [PUBLIC_IP])


class NdjsonStream(httpx.AsyncByteStream):
    """Ollama's NDJSON chat stream, one line per delay; records how far it got and whether it was closed."""

    def __init__(self, lines: list[bytes], delay: float) -> None:
        self.lines = lines
        self.delay = delay
        self.sent = 0
        self.closed = False

    async def __aiter__(self) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        for line in self.lines:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay)
            self.sent += 1
            yield line

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        self.closed = True


def _first_token(field_name: str, value: Any) -> str:
    if field_name == "label":
        return {"bullish": "bull", "bearish": "bear"}.get(value, value)
    return "-" if value < 0 else str(value)


def _logprob(token: str, p: float, alternatives: Mapping[str, float] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    top = [{"token": t, "logprob": math.log(q)} for t, q in (alternatives or {token: p}).items()]
    return {"token": token, "logprob": math.log(p), "top_logprobs": top}


def _done(**extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "model": "m",
        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": ""},
        "done": True,
        "done_reason": "stop",
        "total_duration": 400_000_000,
        "load_duration": 5_000_000,
        "prompt_eval_count": 512,
        "prompt_eval_duration": 120_000_000,
        "eval_count": 40,
        "eval_duration": 260_000_000,
    } | extra


@dataclass
class FakeOllama:
    """Answers follow each request's `format` schema in its property order, as Ollama's grammar does."""

    router: respx.MockRouter
    label: str = "bullish"
    label_alternatives: dict[str, float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: {"bull": 0.9, "neutral": 0.08, "bear": 0.02}
    )
    score: int = 1
    entity: str = ENTITY
    summary: str = SUMMARY
    decision: dict[str, float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: {"neutral": 0.06, "bullish": 0.9, "bearish": 0.04}
    )
    installed: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    version: str = "0.40.6"
    delay: float = 0.001
    chunk_chars: int = 4
    # Raised or returned by every /api/chat call when set.
    chat_failure: Exception | httpx.Response | None = None
    # Emit an Ollama error line after this many content chunks.
    stream_error_after: int | None = None
    down: bool = False
    streams: list[NdjsonStream] = field(default_factory=list)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.chat = self.router.post(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/chat").mock(side_effect=self._chat)
        self.systemone = self.router.post(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/v1/systemone").mock(side_effect=self._systemone)
        self.tags = self.router.get(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/tags").mock(side_effect=self._tags)
        self.version_route = self.router.get(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/version").mock(side_effect=self._version)

    @property
    def inference_calls(self) -> int:
        return self.chat.call_count + self.systemone.call_count

    def _check_up(self, request: httpx.Request) -> None:
        if self.down:
            raise httpx.ConnectError("connection refused", request=request)

    def _value(self, name: str) -> Any:
        return {"label": self.label, "score": self.score, "entity": self.entity, "summary": self.summary}[
            name
        ]

    def _chat(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        if isinstance(self.chat_failure, Exception):
            raise self.chat_failure
        if self.chat_failure is not None:
            return self.chat_failure
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        fields = list(body["format"]["properties"])
        content = json.dumps({name: self._value(name) for name in fields}, ensure_ascii=False)
        if body["stream"]:
            return self._stream(content)
        reply = _done(message={"role": "assistant", "content": content})
        if body.get("logprobs") and fields in (["label"], ["score"]):
            reply["logprobs"] = self._logprobs(content, fields[0])
        return httpx.Response(200, json=reply)

    def _logprobs(self, content: str, name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Three tokens that tile the content: everything up to the value, its first token, the rest."""
        first = _first_token(name, self._value(name))
        # json.dumps writes ": " after the key, then the label's opening quote or the bare score.
        start = content.index(":") + 2 + (name == "label")
        alternatives = self.label_alternatives if name == "label" else {first: 0.9, "0": 0.08, "-": 0.02}
        return [
            _logprob(content[:start], 0.99),
            _logprob(first, alternatives.get(first, 0.9), alternatives),
            _logprob(content[start + len(first) :], 0.99),
        ]

    def _stream(self, content: str) -> httpx.Response:
        pieces = [content[i : i + self.chunk_chars] for i in range(0, len(content), self.chunk_chars)]
        chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
            {"model": "m", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": piece}, "done": False}
            for piece in pieces
        ]
        if self.stream_error_after is not None:
            chunks = [*chunks[: self.stream_error_after], {"error": "llama runner process has terminated"}]
        else:
            chunks.append(_done(eval_count=len(pieces)))
        stream = NdjsonStream([(json.dumps(chunk) + "\n").encode() for chunk in chunks], self.delay)
        self.streams.append(stream)
        return httpx.Response(200, stream=stream, headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})

    def _systemone(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        choice = max(self.decision, key=self.decision.__getitem__)
        answer = {
            "type": "choice",
            "choice": choice,
            "probabilities": self.decision,
            "confidence": self.decision[choice],
        }
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "model": body["model"],
                "answers": {"sentiment": answer},
                "usage": {"input_tokens": 264, "output_tokens": 0},
            },
        )

    def _tags(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        models = [
            {"name": name, "model": name, "size": 1_000_000 * (i + 1)}
            for i, name in enumerate(self.installed)
        ]
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"models": models})

    def _version(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"version": self.version})


def sse_events(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """(event, data) pairs from a text/event-stream body; comments and unnamed frames are skipped."""
    events = []
    for frame in text.split("\n\n"):
        name, data = None, []
        for line in frame.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("event: "):
                name = line.removeprefix("event: ")
            elif line.startswith("data: "):
                data.append(line.removeprefix("data: "))
        if name and data:
            events.append((name, json.loads("\n".join(data))))
    return events
```

```
async def _score_first(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """Stops at the score: later tokens cannot change it, and closing the stream frees Ollama early."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    stream = analyze_stream(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ScoreClosed):
                return {"kind": "analyze", "score": item.score}, {
                    "wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
                }
    raise SchemaViolation(f"{run.model} finished the stream without a score")


async def call_once(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """One example through the serving adapters; returns raw outputs, never the input."""
    if run.variant == "sentiment-first":
        return await _score_first(client, run, text)
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": raw.wall_ms}
        if raw.input_tokens is not None:
            timing["prompt_tokens"] = float(raw.input_tokens)
        pred: Pred = {
            "kind": "decision",
            "choice": raw.choice,
            "probs": dict(verdict.probabilities or {}),
            "model_confidence": raw.confidence,
        }
        return pred, timing
    if run.variant == "label":
        return _label_pred(verdict, raw), _chat_timing(raw)
    pred = {
        "kind": "ordinal",
        "score": verdict.score,
        "sign_probs": score_sign_probabilities(raw.content, raw.logprobs),
    }
    return pred, _chat_timing(raw)


# --- model residency -------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def model_digest(client: OllamaClient, model: str) -> str:
    for entry in await client.tags():
        if model in (entry.get("name"), entry.get("model")) and isinstance(entry.get("digest"), str):
            return str(entry["digest"])
    raise ModelUnavailable(f"{model} is not installed in Ollama", hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {model}`.")


async def make_resident(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, *, log: TextIO = sys.stderr) -> None:
    """Unload every other model, then warm this one so the first timed call is not a cold load."""
    for entry in await client.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != run.model:
            try:
                await client.unload(name)
            except VtError as exc:
                print(f"warning: could not unload {name}: {exc.message}", file=log)
    await call_once(client, run, WARMUP_TEXT)

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)

    async def one_call(
        self, spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        if endpoint == "signal":
            _verdict, raw = await classify_signal(self.client, spec, prompt, text)
            if isinstance(raw, ChatResult):
                return {
                    "wall_ms": raw.wall_ms,
                    "prompt_tokens": raw.timings.prompt_tokens,
                    "eval_tokens": raw.timings.eval_tokens,
                }
            return {"wall_ms": raw.wall_ms, "prompt_tokens": raw.input_tokens}
        stream = (
            summarize_stream(self.client, spec, prompt, text)
            if endpoint == "summary"
            else analyze_stream(self.client, spec, prompt, text)
        )
        score_ms: float | None = None
        summary_ms: float | None = None
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ScoreClosed) and score_ms is None:
                score_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
            if isinstance(item, SummaryText) and summary_ms is None:
                summary_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
            if isinstance(item, SummaryResult | AnalyzeResult):
                chat = item.chat
                return {
                    "wall_ms": chat.wall_ms,
                    "ttft_ms": chat.ttft_ms,
                    "time_to_score_ms": score_ms,
                    "time_to_summary_text_ms": summary_ms,
                    "prompt_eval_ms": chat.timings.prompt_eval_ms,
                    "eval_ms": chat.timings.eval_ms,
                    "prompt_tokens": chat.timings.prompt_tokens,
                    "eval_tokens": chat.timings.eval_tokens,
                    "summary_words": len(item.output.summary.split()),
                }
        raise RuntimeError("stream ended without a result")

    async def model(self, spec: ModelSpec, runs: int, sections: dict[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        name = spec.name
        if spec.kind == "decision":
            if (decision := await self.guard(f"d/{name}", self.systemone(spec))) is not None:
                sections["d_systemone"][name] = decision
```

```python
    )


def lp(token: str, p: float, alternatives: Sequence[tuple[str, float]] = ()) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """One Ollama logprob entry; alternatives are (token, probability) and include the token itself."""
    top = [{"token": t, "logprob": math.log(q), "bytes": list(t.encode())} for t, q in alternatives]
    return {"token": token, "logprob": math.log(p), "bytes": list(token.encode()), "top_logprobs": top}


def plain(tokens: Sequence[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [lp(t, 0.99, [(t, 0.99)]) for t in tokens]


def chat_body(content: str, *, logprobs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": "m",
        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": content},
        "done": True,
        "done_reason": "stop",
        "total_duration": 250_000_000,
        "load_duration": 10_000_000,
        "prompt_eval_count": 120,
        "prompt_eval_duration": 80_000_000,
        "eval_count": 12,
        "eval_duration": 150_000_000,
    }
    if logprobs is not None:
        body["logprobs"] = logprobs
    return body | extra


def stream_response(chunks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], delay: float = 0.0) -> httpx.Response:
    async def lines() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        for chunk in chunks:
            if delay:
                await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            yield (json.dumps(chunk) + "\n").encode()

    return httpx.Response(200, content=lines(), headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})


def content_chunks(pieces: Sequence[str], **final: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        {"model": "m", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": piece}, "done": False} for piece in pieces
    ]
    done = chat_body("", eval_count=len(pieces)) | final
    return [*chunks, done]
```

```
"""Steps every article endpoint shares: resolve, check the result cache, load, describe."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ArticleMeta,
    CacheInfo,
    ErrorEvent,
    InferenceTimings,
    MetaEvent,
    SentimentEvent,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SignalResult,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
    SummaryDoneEvent,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
    Timings,
)
from veritrade.extract.scope import build_input
from veritrade.extract.types import Scope
from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade.services.article import LoadedArticle, load_article
from veritrade.services.cache import ResultKey
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

ArticleRequest = SignalRequest | SummaryRequest | AnalyzeRequest
StreamPayload = (
    MetaEvent | SentimentEvent | SummaryDeltaEvent | SummaryDoneEvent | AnalyzeDoneEvent | ErrorEvent
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Job:
    """A request with its model and prompt resolved; nothing has touched the network yet."""

    runtime: Runtime
    endpoint: Endpoint
    request: ArticleRequest
    url: str
    scope: Scope
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    key: ResultKey | None
    clock: StageTimer

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls, runtime: Runtime, endpoint: Endpoint, request: ArticleRequest, *, scope: Scope, clock: StageTimer
    ) -> Job:
        spec = runtime.registry.resolve(endpoint, request.model)
        prompt = runtime.prompt(endpoint, spec)
        url = str(request.url)
        key = None
        if not request.no_cache:
            key = ResultKey(
                endpoint=endpoint,
                url=normalize_url(url),
                model=spec.name,
                prompt_version=prompt.version,
                parser=request.parser,
                extractor=request.extractor,
                scope=scope,
            )
        return cls(runtime, endpoint, request, url, scope, spec, prompt, key, clock)

    def cached[R: (SignalResponse, SummaryResponse, AnalyzeResponse)](self, kind: type[R]) -> R | None:
        """The stored response marked as cached, with timings that describe this request."""
        hit = self.runtime.results.get(self.key) if self.key is not None else None
        if not isinstance(hit, kind):
            return None
        # A result hit runs no stage, so stage timings are zero and the article counts as a fetch hit.
        timings = Timings(
            total_ms=self.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=0.0,
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch="hit", result="hit"),
        )
        meta = hit.meta.model_copy(update={"cached": True})
        return hit.model_copy(update={"meta": meta, "timings": timings})

    def remember(self, response: SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> None:
        if self.key is not None:
            self.runtime.results.put(self.key, response)

    async def prepare(self) -> Prepared:
        loaded = await load_article(
            self.runtime,
            self.url,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            no_cache=self.request.no_cache,
        )
        text = build_input(loaded.article, self.scope, self.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return Prepared(
            job=self,
            loaded=loaded,
            text=text,
            meta=self._meta(loaded, text),
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch=loaded.fetch_status, result="bypass" if self.key is None else "miss"),
        )

    def _meta(self, loaded: LoadedArticle, text: str) -> ArticleMeta:
        article = loaded.article
        return ArticleMeta(
            url=self.url,
            final_url=loaded.page.final_url,
            title=article.title,
            source=article.source,
```

```
            app.state.runtime = Runtime.build(settings, fetcher=page_fetcher, ollama=llm, registry=registry)
```

```
import {
  ApiError,
  apiFetch,
  jsonPost,
  type AnalyzeBody,
  type AnalyzeResponse,
  type ArticleMeta,
  type CacheInfo,
  type ErrorBody,
  type SignalResult,
  type SummaryBody,
  type SummaryResponse,
} from "./api";

// Payloads mirror backend/src/veritrade/api/contracts.py; OpenAPI cannot describe SSE bodies.
export interface MetaEventData {
  meta: ArticleMeta;
  fetch_ms: number;
  parse_ms: number;
  extract_ms: number;
  cache: CacheInfo;
}

export interface SentimentEventData {
  signal: SignalResult;
  entity?: string | null;
  /** Server-side milliseconds since the request was received. */
  elapsed_ms: number;
}

export interface SummaryDeltaEventData {
  text: string;
}

export interface DoneEventData<R> {
  result: R;
}

export interface ErrorEventData {
  error: ErrorBody;
}

export type StreamEvent<R> =
  | { type: "meta"; data: MetaEventData }
  | { type: "sentiment"; data: SentimentEventData }
  | { type: "summary_delta"; data: SummaryDeltaEventData }
  | { type: "done"; data: DoneEventData<R> }
  | { type: "error"; data: ErrorEventData };

export type StreamEventType = StreamEvent<unknown>["type"];
const EVENT_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<StreamEventType>([
  "meta",
  "sentiment",
  "summary_delta",
  "done",
  "error",
]);

export interface SseFrame {
  event: string;
  data: string;
  id: string | null;
}

// Incremental text/event-stream parser (WHATWG rules): any of CRLF/LF/CR ends a line, a blank
// line dispatches, ":" lines are comments, repeated data lines join with "\n".
export class SseParser {
  private buffer = "";
  private skipLeadingLf = false;
  private eventType = "";
  private dataLines: string[] = [];
  private lastId: string | null = null;

  push(chunk: string): SseFrame[] {
    if (!chunk) return [];
    let text = chunk;
    // A CR that ended the previous chunk may be the first half of a CRLF.
    if (this.skipLeadingLf) {
      this.skipLeadingLf = false;
      if (text.startsWith("\n")) text = text.slice(1);
    }
    this.buffer += text;

    const frames: SseFrame[] = [];
    let start = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.buffer.length; i++) {
      const ch = this.buffer[i];
      if (ch !== "\n" && ch !== "\r") continue;
      const line = this.buffer.slice(start, i);
      if (ch === "\r") {
        if (i + 1 === this.buffer.length) this.skipLeadingLf = true;
        else if (this.buffer[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
      }
      start = i + 1;
      const frame = this.processLine(line);
      if (frame) frames.push(frame);
    }
    this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(start);
    return frames;
  }

  private processLine(line: string): SseFrame | null {
    if (line === "") return this.dispatch();
    if (line.startsWith(":")) return null;

    const colon = line.indexOf(":");
    const field = colon === -1 ? line : line.slice(0, colon);
    let value = colon === -1 ? "" : line.slice(colon + 1);
    if (value.startsWith(" ")) value = value.slice(1);

    if (field === "event") this.eventType = value;
    else if (field === "data") this.dataLines.push(value);
    else if (field === "id" && !value.includes("\0")) this.lastId = value;
    return null;
  }

  private dispatch(): SseFrame | null {
    const lines = this.dataLines;
    const event = this.eventType || "message";
    this.dataLines = [];
    this.eventType = "";
    if (lines.length === 0) return null;
    return { event, data: lines.join("\n"), id: this.lastId };
  }
}

/** Yields parsed frames; an unterminated trailing frame is dropped, as the SSE spec requires. */
export async function* readSseFrames(body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>): AsyncGenerator<SseFrame> {
  // lib.dom types the decoder's input as BufferSource, which TS will not accept for Uint8Array chunks.
  const decoder = new TextDecoderStream() as unknown as TransformStream<Uint8Array, string>;
  const reader = body.pipeThrough(decoder).getReader();
  const parser = new SseParser();
  let finished = false;
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) {
        finished = true;
        return;
      }
      yield* parser.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    // Early exit (consumer break or abort) must release the network stream.
    if (!finished) await reader.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

export function toStreamEvent<R>(frame: SseFrame): StreamEvent<R> | null {
  if (!EVENT_TYPES.has(frame.event)) return null;
  let data: unknown;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(frame.data);
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError({ code: "bad_response", message: `Malformed "${frame.event}" event from the API.` });
  }
  return { type: frame.event, data } as StreamEvent<R>;
}

export interface StreamOptions {
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

// Yields typed events until `done` or `error`. Failures before the stream opens arrive as the
// JSON error envelope and are thrown as ApiError.
export async function* streamEvents<R>(
  path: string,
  body: unknown,
  { signal }: StreamOptions = {},
): AsyncGenerator<StreamEvent<R>> {
  const res = await apiFetch(path, jsonPost(body, signal, "text/event-stream"));
  if (!res.body) throw new ApiError({ code: "bad_response", message: "The API returned an empty stream." });

  for await (const frame of readSseFrames(res.body)) {
    const event = toStreamEvent<R>(frame);
    if (!event) continue;
    yield event;
    if (event.type === "done" || event.type === "error") return;
  }
  throw new ApiError({
    code: "bad_response",
    message: "The stream closed before it finished.",
    retryable: true,
  });
}

export function streamSummary(body: SummaryBody, options?: StreamOptions) {
  return streamEvents<SummaryResponse>("/api/summary/stream", body, options);
}

export function streamAnalyze(body: AnalyzeBody, options?: StreamOptions) {
  return streamEvents<AnalyzeResponse>("/api/analyze/stream", body, options);
}

import type { LaneStatus } from "@/lib/run-state";

import styles from "./SummaryPanel.module.css";

interface SummaryPanelProps {
  status: LaneStatus;
  text: string;
  model?: string | null;
  streaming: boolean;
  /** Client-measured time from submit to the first summary token. */
  firstTokenMs?: number | null;
}

function statusLabel(status: LaneStatus, text: string, streaming: boolean): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return streaming ? "Waiting for the first token..." : "Waiting for the summary...";
    case "streaming":
      return text ? "Streaming..." : "Waiting for the first token...";
    case "done":
      return "Complete";
    case "error":
      return "Failed";
    case "cancelled":
      return "Cancelled";
  }
}

export function SummaryPanel({ status, text, model, streaming, firstTokenMs }: SummaryPanelProps) {
  const active = status === "pending" || status === "streaming";
  return (
    <section className={styles.panel} aria-labelledby="summary-heading" aria-busy={active}>
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <h2 id="summary-heading" className={styles.heading}>
          Summary
        </h2>
        <span className={styles.status} data-status={status} data-testid="summary-status">
          {statusLabel(status, text, streaming)}
        </span>
      </div>
      {text ? (
        <p className={styles.text} data-testid="summary-text">
          {text}
          {active ? <span className={styles.caret} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
        </p>
      ) : status === "done" ? (
        <p className={styles.empty}>The model returned an empty summary.</p>
      ) : null}
      {model || typeof firstTokenMs === "number" ? (
        <p className={styles.footer}>
          {model ? (
            <>
              Model <code>{model}</code>
            </>
          ) : null}
          {model && typeof firstTokenMs === "number" ? " · " : null}
          {typeof firstTokenMs === "number" ? `first token ${formatMs(firstTokenMs)}` : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```
