"""Opus-labelled article set: ids, file layout, agent output schemas, committed rows and the eval loader.

Publisher text (HTML, titles, bodies) only ever lives under evals/data/private/articles; committed rows carry
URLs, hashes, labels and model-written facts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError

from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.paths import ARTICLES_DIR, OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR, PRIVATE_ARTICLES_DIR, REPO_ROOT

REFERENCE_DATE = date(2026, 10, 18)
WINDOW_DAYS = 60
WINDOW_START = REFERENCE_DATE - timedelta(days=WINDOW_DAYS)
SEED = 20261018
PER_CLASS = 3
MIN_BODY_WORDS = 120
KEY_FACTS_MIN = 3
KEY_FACTS_MAX = 5
KEY_FACT_MAX_WORDS = 25
RATIONALE_MAX_WORDS = 50
LABEL_PACKET_WORDS = 1200
SHINGLE_WORDS = 10

Stage = Literal["gold", "label_a", "label_b", "adjudicate"]
STAGES: tuple[Stage, ...] = get_args(Stage)
PacketStage = Literal["gold", "label", "adjudicate"]
PACKET_STAGES: tuple[PacketStage, ...] = get_args(PacketStage)
ArticleSplit = Literal["dev", "test"]
RejectReason = Literal[
    "not_article",
    "live_blog",
    "paywalled_stub",
    "roundup",
    "video_only",
    "too_short",
    "non_english",
    "duplicate",
    "other",
]
REJECT_REASONS: tuple[RejectReason, ...] = get_args(RejectReason)
PROMPTS: dict[PacketStage, Path] = {
    "gold": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "20-gold.md",
    "label": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "30-label.md",
    "adjudicate": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "40-adjudicate.md",
}


class ArticlesError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def article_id(url: str) -> str:
    return "art-" + hashlib.sha1(normalize_url(url).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]


def sha256_bytes(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    return sha256_bytes(path.read_bytes())


def rel(path: Path) -> str:
    """Repo-relative path for messages and packets, absolute when outside the repo (tests)."""
    try:
        return str(path.resolve().relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArticlePaths:
    private: Path = PRIVATE_ARTICLES_DIR
    committed: Path = ARTICLES_DIR

    def candidates(self, source: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "candidates" / f"{source}.jsonl"

    def view(self, source: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "views" / f"{source}.tsv"

    @property
    def cache(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "cache"

    @property
    def discovery_log(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "discovery_log.jsonl"

    def html(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "html" / f"{article}.html"

    def fetched(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "fetched" / f"{article}.json"

    def packet(self, stage: PacketStage, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / stage / f"{article}.md"

    def full_packet(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / "gold" / f"{article}.full.md"

    def lines(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / "gold" / f"{article}.lines.json"

    def out(self, stage: Stage, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "out" / stage / f"{article}.json"

    def out_dir(self, stage: Stage) -> Path:
        return self.private / "out" / stage

    def gold(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "gold" / f"{article}.txt"

    @property
    def adjudicate_ids(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "adjudicate_ids.txt"

    @property
    def rows(self) -> Path:
        return self.committed / "articles.jsonl"

    @property
    def stats(self) -> Path:
        return self.committed / "stats.json"


# --- records ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _Model(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class Candidate(_Model):
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    title: str | None = None
    published_at: str | None = None
    via: str
    via_url: str
    query: str | None = None
    extra: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def published(self) -> date | None:
        return date.fromisoformat(self.published_at) if self.published_at else None


class FetchRecord(_Model):
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    final_url: str | None = None
    fetched_at: str
    status: int | None = None
    error: str | None = None
    html_sha256: str | None = None
    words: int = 0
    method: str | None = None
    published_at: str | None = None
    published_date: str | None = None
    published_from: Literal["page", "candidate"] | None = None
    paywalled: bool = False
    extract_error: str | None = None

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.error is None and self.html_sha256 is not None

    @property
    def published(self) -> date | None:
        return date.fromisoformat(self.published_date) if self.published_date else None


# --- agent outputs (documented in evals/opus_prompts) ---------------------------------------------------


class GoldOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    usable: bool
    reject_reason: RejectReason | None = None
    title_line: int | None = None
    body_ranges: list[tuple[int, int]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    key_facts: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    entity: str | None = None
    ticker: str | None = None
    provisional_label: Sentiment | None = None


class LabelOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: int = Field(ge=-2, le=2)
    entity: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ambiguous: bool
    confidence: int = Field(ge=1, le=5)


class AdjudicateOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    decision: Literal["keep", "replace"]
    label: Sentiment
    score: int = Field(ge=-2, le=2)
    entity: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str = Field(min_length=1)


OUTPUT_MODELS: dict[Stage, type[GoldOutput] | type[LabelOutput] | type[AdjudicateOutput]] = {
    "gold": GoldOutput,
    "label_a": LabelOutput,
    "label_b": LabelOutput,
    "adjudicate": AdjudicateOutput,
}


def schema_codes(exc: ValidationError) -> list[str]:
    """Error locations and types only; messages can echo input text."""
    codes = []
    for error in exc.errors(include_url=False, include_input=False):
        where = ".".join(str(part) for part in error["loc"]) or "model"
        codes.append(f"schema:{where}:{error['type']}")
    return codes


# --- committed rows ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class LabelSummary(_Model):
    label: Sentiment
    score: int
    ambiguous: bool
    confidence: int


class AdjudicationSummary(_Model):
    decision: Literal["keep", "replace"]
    label: Sentiment
    score: int


class ArticleLabels(_Model):
    a: LabelSummary
    b: LabelSummary
    adjudicated: AdjudicationSummary | None = None
    final: Sentiment


class ArticleRow(_Model):
    id: str
    url: str
    source: str
    published_at: str
    fetched_at: str
    html_sha256: str
    gold_sha256: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: float
    entity: str
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str
    key_facts: list[str]
    split: ArticleSplit
    labels: ArticleLabels


def read_jsonl[M: BaseModel](path: Path, model: type[M]) -> list[M]:
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.strip():
            rows.append(model.model_validate_json(line))
    return rows


def write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: Iterable[BaseModel]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    text = "".join(row.model_dump_json(exclude_none=False) + "\n" for row in rows)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def read_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> FetchRecord | None:
    path = paths.fetched(article)
    return FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else None


def iter_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, source: str | None = None) -> Iterator[FetchRecord]:
    folder = paths.private / "fetched"
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("art-*.json")) if folder.exists() else []:
        record = FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if source is None or record.source == source:
            yield record


def in_window(day: date | None, since: date = WINDOW_START, until: date = REFERENCE_DATE) -> bool:
    return day is not None and since <= day <= until


# --- verify + loader --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def row_problems(row: ArticleRow, paths: ArticlePaths) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    for kind, path, expected in (
        ("html", paths.html(row.id), row.html_sha256),
        ("gold", paths.gold(row.id), row.gold_sha256),
    ):
        if not path.exists():
            problems.append(f"{kind}_missing")
        elif sha256_file(path) != expected:
            problems.append(f"{kind}_drifted")
    return problems


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArticleExample:
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: float
    entity: str
    ticker: str | None
    key_facts: tuple[str, ...]
    gold_text: str
    html_path: Path
    split: ArticleSplit


def load_articles(
    split: ArticleSplit | Literal["all"], *, paths: ArticlePaths | None = None
) -> list[ArticleExample]:
    """Committed rows joined with the local gold body and HTML path; missing or drifted files fail loudly."""
    paths = paths or ArticlePaths()
    rows = read_jsonl(paths.rows, ArticleRow)
    if not rows:
        raise ArticlesError(f"no article rows in {rel(paths.rows)}; run `articles finalize` first")
    examples: list[ArticleExample] = []
    problems: list[str] = []
    for row in rows:
        if split != "all" and row.split != split:
            continue
        if found := row_problems(row, paths):
            problems.extend(f"{row.id}:{code}" for code in found)
            continue
        examples.append(
            ArticleExample(
                id=row.id,
                source=row.source,
                url=row.url,
                label=row.label,
                score=row.score,
                entity=row.entity,
                ticker=row.ticker,
                key_facts=tuple(row.key_facts),
                gold_text=paths.gold(row.id).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
                html_path=paths.html(row.id),
                split=row.split,
            )
        )
    if problems:
        raise ArticlesError(
            f"{len(problems)} local article files missing or drifted, e.g. {', '.join(problems[:4])}; "
            "run `articles verify`"
        )
    return examples
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
EVALS_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "evals"
DATA_DIR = EVALS_DIR / "data"
SPLITS_DIR = DATA_DIR / "splits"
DATASETS_LOCK = DATA_DIR / "datasets.lock.json"
RESULTS_DIR = EVALS_DIR / "results"
# Committed article set: URLs, hashes, labels and model-written facts only.
ARTICLES_DIR = DATA_DIR / "articles"
OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR = EVALS_DIR / "opus_prompts"

# Gitignored: dataset files, publisher HTML and prediction caches never leave the machine.
PRIVATE_DIR = DATA_DIR / "private"
HF_CACHE_DIR = PRIVATE_DIR / "hf"
PREDS_DIR = PRIVATE_DIR / "preds"
PRIVATE_ARTICLES_DIR = PRIVATE_DIR / "articles"
"""`uv run python -m veritrade_evals <command>`: dataset, split and (later) evaluation commands."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence

from veritrade_evals import articles_cli
from veritrade_evals.datasets import (
    SPECS,
    DatasetError,
    Example,
    class_counts,
    fetch_all,
    finentity_single,
    fpb_allagree,
    twitter_fns,
)
from veritrade_evals.splits import SPLIT_NAMES, SplitError, load_split, make_splits, read_split_file

PLANNED = {
    "signal": "signal accuracy run over a split",
    "grid": "prompt grid per model",
    "freeze": "write frozen prompt versions and thresholds into models.toml",
    "extraction": "parser x extractor matrix",
    "latency": "latency suite",
    "summary": "summary evaluation",
    "select": "pick per-endpoint winners",
    "holdout": "one-shot holdout run",
    "report": "benchmarks.json and results README",
    "opus": "Opus subagent prompts and judgements",
}


def _balance(examples: Sequence[Example]) -> str:
    counts = class_counts(examples)
    return " ".join(f"{k}={v} ({v / len(examples):.1%})" for k, v in counts.items())


def cmd_datasets_fetch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    lock = fetch_all(update=args.update)
    for name, entry in lock.items():
        print(f"{name}: {SPECS[name].repo_id}@{entry.revision[:12]} ({entry.license})")
    loaded = {
        "tfns train": twitter_fns("train"),
        "tfns validation": twitter_fns("validation"),
        "fpb allagree": fpb_allagree(),
        "finentity single": finentity_single(),
    }
    for label, examples in loaded.items():
        print(f"  {label}: n={len(examples)} {_balance(examples)}")
    return 0


def cmd_splits_make(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    for name, path in make_splits().items():
        payload = read_split_file(name)
        print(f"{name}: n={payload['n']} {payload['class_counts']} -> {path.name}")
        if "class_weights" in payload:
            print(f"  train_prior={payload['train_prior']} weights={payload['class_weights']}")
            print(f"  excluded={payload['excluded']}")
    return 0


def cmd_splits_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    failed = 0
    for name in SPLIT_NAMES:
        try:
            split = load_split(name)
        except (SplitError, DatasetError) as exc:
            failed += 1
            print(f"FAIL {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        print(f"ok {name}: n={len(split.examples)} {_balance(split.examples)}")
    return 1 if failed else 0


def cmd_planned(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    print(f"`{args.command}` is not implemented yet ({PLANNED[args.command]})", file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals", description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    datasets = commands.add_parser("datasets", help="public dataset downloads").add_subparsers(
        dest="action", required=True
    )
    fetch = datasets.add_parser(
        "fetch", help="download pinned revisions and record them in datasets.lock.json"
    )
    fetch.add_argument(
        "--update", action="store_true", help="re-resolve refs instead of reusing locked commits"
    )
    fetch.set_defaults(func=cmd_datasets_fetch)

    splits = commands.add_parser("splits", help="committed split files").add_subparsers(
        dest="action", required=True
    )
    splits.add_parser("make", help="write evals/data/splits/*.json").set_defaults(func=cmd_splits_make)
    splits.add_parser("verify", help="re-read datasets and check split hashes").set_defaults(
        func=cmd_splits_verify
    )

    articles_cli.register(commands)

    for name, help_text in PLANNED.items():
        planned = commands.add_parser(name, help=f"{help_text} (not implemented yet)")
        planned.set_defaults(func=cmd_planned)
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args, extra = parser.parse_known_args(argv)
    # Planned commands accept anything so scripts written against them fail with the clear message below.
    if extra and args.func is not cmd_planned:
        parser.error(f"unrecognized arguments: {' '.join(extra)}")
    code: int = args.func(args)
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

# 20 - Gold body, key facts and a provisional label

You turn fetched pages into reference ("gold") article bodies. The gold body is the yardstick for the
extraction benchmark (which parser and extractor recover the article best) and the text the labellers read.
Read `evals/opus_prompts/00-README.md` first; its rules bind you. In short: read pages only with the Read tool
on the packet files you are given, write only to `evals/data/private/articles/out/gold/`, never quote article
text or headlines in messages or your final report, and run Python only through `uv run`.

## Input

The message that spawned you lists gold packet paths, `evals/data/private/articles/packets/gold/<id>.md`.

A packet shows the page's visible text as numbered lines (`L0001 ...`), one per text block. Lines are
folded into marker rows that keep their numbers, for example `L0012-L0040 [29 lines hidden: short lines
(menus, buttons, tickers)]` or `L0001-L0140 [140 lines hidden: before the located article]`. Folding is only
for compactness: every line number stays valid. If the headline is not visible, the story looks cut off, or a
folded run might be part of the article (a short bulleted list), Read the full packet named in the header
(`<id>.full.md`), which shows every line.

## Decide: usable or not

Usable means one news story, press release or filing exhibit, in English, mainly about **one primary entity**
(a company, or a single asset, commodity, index or national economy), with at least 120 words of body text.
Otherwise set `usable: false` and one `reject_reason`:

| reject_reason | when |
|---|---|
| `not_article` | index or section page, quote page, data-only page, error, consent or login page |
| `live_blog` | rolling live coverage with timestamps |
| `paywalled_stub` | only a teaser; the rest is behind a wall |
| `roundup` | several unrelated items or companies with no primary entity (market wraps, newsletters, lists) |
| `video_only` | the story is a video with a caption |
| `too_short` | under 120 words of body text |
| `non_english` | not in English |
| `duplicate` | the same story as another packet in your batch (keep the better one) |
| `other` | anything else (say why in your final report, in general terms) |

## For usable pages

- `title_line`: the line holding the headline (normally the `h1` just above the story).
- `body_ranges`: inclusive `[start, end]` line ranges that together cover exactly the article body, in order and
  not overlapping. Include: the dateline lede, body paragraphs, in-body subheadings, bulleted or numbered lists
  that belong to the story, quotes. Exclude: the headline, standfirst or dek, editor key-points boxes, bylines,
  dates, image captions and credits, "read more" and related links, ads and their labels, newsletter and app
  promos, share buttons, author bios, comment prompts, financial tables, and press-release boilerplate after
  the story (About the company, forward-looking or safe-harbor statements, contacts, "SOURCE" lines, "View
  original content"). Split a range to skip a promo or a folded run of menu lines in the middle of a story.
  The title line must not fall inside a body range.
- `key_facts`: 3 to 5 statements, at most 25 words each, most market-moving first, in your own words. Copy
  numbers exactly as the body writes them ("$1.25 billion", "28%", "third quarter"), and only use numbers that
  appear in the body: no sums, differences or conversions. Never copy 10 or more consecutive words.
- `entity`: the primary entity as commonly written ("Nvidia", "Brent crude", "UK economy").
- `ticker`: the ticker if the article states it or it is unambiguous, else `null`.
- `provisional_label`: your quick read with the rubric in `30-label.md` (bullish, bearish or neutral). It is
  only used to balance the selection; the real labels come from two independent labellers.

## Output

Write `evals/data/private/articles/out/gold/<id>.json` with exactly these fields:

```json
{
  "id": "art-0123456789ab",
  "usable": true,
  "reject_reason": null,
  "title_line": 41,
  "body_ranges": [[44, 61], [64, 70]],
  "key_facts": [
    "Fact in your own words with numbers copied exactly from the body.",
    "Second fact.",
    "Third fact."
  ],
  "entity": "Example Corp",
  "ticker": "EXMP",
  "provisional_label": "bearish"
}
```

For a rejected page: `{"id": "...", "usable": false, "reject_reason": "live_blog"}` (other fields may be
omitted).

## Validate and fix

After writing all outputs of your batch, run:

```bash
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles ingest --stage gold
```

It prints one line per id: `PASS` (with your provisional label and the body word count, or `rejected:<reason>`)
or `FAIL` with codes. Fix every `FAIL` among your ids and run it again until they all pass.

| Code | Fix |
|---|---|
| `schema:<field>:<type>` | field missing, misspelled, wrong type, or an unknown field |
| `missing:<field>` | usable outputs need `title_line`, `body_ranges`, `entity`, `provisional_label` |
| `range_inverted`, `range_out_of_bounds`, `ranges_overlap` | ranges must be `[start, end]`, start <= end, within the page, disjoint |
| `title_out_of_bounds`, `title_in_body` | the headline line must exist and sit outside the body ranges |
| `body_too_short` | under 120 words: widen the ranges if you cut too much, else reject as `too_short` |
| `key_facts_count`, `key_fact_too_long`, `key_fact_empty` | 3 to 5 facts, each 1 to 25 words |
| `key_fact_number_ungrounded` | a number in a fact does not appear in the body text; copy it exactly |
| `key_fact_verbatim` | a fact shares 10 consecutive words with the body; rephrase |
| `missing_packet_lines` | the packet was not prepared; tell the main loop |

## Final report (counts only)

Usable vs rejected (by reason), provisional labels (bullish / bearish / neutral), any ids that still fail
and their codes. No headlines, quotes or article text.

# Signal grid on dev300

Generated by `uv run python -m veritrade_evals.grid analyze` from the local prediction cache; no dataset text is stored here.

- Data: dev300, 300 Twitter Financial News train tweets, 100 per class; every rate is weighted back to the train prior (bullish 20.2%, bearish 15.1%, neutral 64.7%). Confusion and error counts are raw.
- Selection: F0.5 macro over bullish/bearish; operating point = best F0.5 with bullish<->bearish inversions <= 2% of directional calls; below the threshold the call abstains to neutral.
- Policies: decision models threshold native class probabilities (min_p); generative /signal thresholds first-token label probabilities (label schema) or the |score| of an ordinal -2..2 schema (t in {1, 2}); /analyze is streamed sentiment-first and always uses |score|.
- Decoding: Ollama options temperature=0, seed=0, presence_penalty=0, frequency_penalty=0, repeat_penalty=1 on every generative call (greedy; overrides the penalties some Modelfiles ship).
- CIs: 95% stratified bootstrap (B=1000) at the chosen threshold; the threshold choice itself is not resampled, so these are optimistic.
- Latency: per-call wall ms during the grid run (Ollama 0.40.6 native-metal, warm, client concurrency 1); /analyze is time to the score with the stream stopped there. Indicative only: the latency suite runs separately.

## Not served yet: directional-mass threshold

The serving policies abstain only when the winning class is unsure, so a model that keeps most of its mass on neutral is never pushed into a call. This informational policy calls bullish or bearish whenever that class's probability clears tau, even when neutral is the argmax. It is tuned on the same 300 tweets as everything else here (gap: paired bootstrap against the serving best config).

// Shape of evals/results/benchmarks.json, written by `veritrade_evals report`.

export interface BenchmarkEnvironment {
  chip: string;
  ramGb: number;
  ollamaVersion: string;
  backend: string;
  gitSha: string | null;
}

export interface SignalBenchmark {
  endpoint: "signal" | "analyze";
  model: string;
  kind: "decision" | "generative";
  policy: string;
  scope: "lede" | "full";
  fieldOrder: string | null;
  promptVersion: string;
  dataset: string;
  split: string;
  n: number;
  f05Macro: number;
  precisionBullish: number;
  precisionBearish: number;
  recallBullish: number;
  recallBearish: number;
  inversionRate: number;
  coverage: number;
  ciLow: number | null;
  ciHigh: number | null;
}

export interface LatencyBenchmark {
  endpoint: string;
  model: string;
  scope: "lede" | "full";
  streaming: boolean;
  backend: string;
  n: number;
  p50Ms: number;
  p95Ms: number;
  ttftP50Ms: number | null;
  timeToSignalP50Ms: number | null;
}

export interface SummaryBenchmark {
  endpoint: "summary" | "analyze";
  model: string;
  n: number;
  deterministicPassRate: number;
  keyFactCoverage: number;
  judgeFaithfulness: number | null;
  judgeCoverage: number | null;
  hallucinationRate: number | null;
}

export interface ExtractionBenchmark {
  parser: string | null;
  extractor: string;
  n: number;
  p50Ms: number;
  p95Ms: number;
  precision: number;
  recall: number;
  f1: number;
  leakage: number;
  tokensToLlm: number;
  failureRate: number;
  installMb: number | null;
}

export type SelectionEndpoint = "signal" | "summary" | "analyze";

export interface Selection {
  model: string;
  reason: string;
}

export interface ArticleSetStats {
  n: number;
  perSource: Record<string, { bullish: number; bearish: number; neutral: number }>;
  agreement: number | null;
  kappa: number | null;
}

export interface BenchmarksV1 {
  version: 1;
  sample: boolean;
  generatedAt: string | null;
  environment: BenchmarkEnvironment;
  signal: SignalBenchmark[];
  latency: LatencyBenchmark[];
  summary: SummaryBenchmark[];
  extraction: ExtractionBenchmark[];
  selection: Record<SelectionEndpoint, Selection>;
  articles: ArticleSetStats;
}

function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/** Structural check at the top level only; the eval report owns row-level correctness. */
export function isBenchmarksV1(value: unknown): value is BenchmarksV1 {
  if (!isObject(value) || value.version !== 1 || typeof value.sample !== "boolean") return false;
  const arrays = ["signal", "latency", "summary", "extraction"] as const;
  return (
    isObject(value.environment) &&
    arrays.every((key) => Array.isArray(value[key])) &&
    isObject(value.selection) &&
    isObject(value.articles)
  );
}

export const LATENCY_BUDGETS = {
  signalLedeP50Ms: 500,
  ttftMs: 1500,
  completeP50Ms: 4000,
} as const;

export function withinBudget(row: LatencyBenchmark): boolean | null {
  if (row.endpoint === "signal") {
    return row.scope === "lede" ? row.p50Ms <= LATENCY_BUDGETS.signalLedeP50Ms : null;
  }
  if (row.endpoint === "summary" || row.endpoint === "analyze") {
    const ttftOk = row.ttftP50Ms === null || row.ttftP50Ms <= LATENCY_BUDGETS.ttftMs;
    return ttftOk && row.p50Ms <= LATENCY_BUDGETS.completeP50Ms;
  }
  return null;

"""Resumable JSONL prediction cache, one file per (run config, model digest, prompt, harness) hash."""

from __future__ import annotations

import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from types import TracebackType
from typing import IO, Any, Self

from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR

# Bump when harness changes alter predictions for an unchanged config, so old caches stop matching.
HARNESS_VERSION = "1"
RESERVED_KEYS = frozenset({"id", "gold", "error", "t"})
# Publisher and dataset licences: a record may describe a prediction, never carry its input.
FORBIDDEN_KEYS = frozenset({"text", "input", "input_text", "prompt", "messages", "article"})


class PredCacheError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def canonical_json(obj: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)


def run_hash(
    run_config: Mapping[str, Any], model_digest: str, prompt_sha: str, harness_version: str = HARNESS_VERSION
) -> str:
    payload = {
        "config": run_config,
        "model_digest": model_digest,
        "prompt_sha": prompt_sha,
        "harness_version": harness_version,
    }
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]


def model_slug(model: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", model)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PredError:
    code: str
    message: str
    retryable: bool


def _terminal(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    error = record.get("error")
    return error is None or not error.get("retryable", False)


class PredCache:
    """Single writer per file (flock); every append is flushed so a killed run resumes from the last line."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str,
        run_config: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        model_digest: str,
        prompt_sha: str,
        root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
        harness_version: str = HARNESS_VERSION,
    ) -> None:
        self.key = run_hash(run_config, model_digest, prompt_sha, harness_version)
        self.sidecar = {
            "key": self.key,
            "model": model,
            "model_digest": model_digest,
            "prompt_sha": prompt_sha,
            "harness_version": harness_version,
            "run_config": json.loads(canonical_json(run_config)),
        }
        directory = root / model_slug(model)
        self.path = directory / f"{self.key}.jsonl"
        self.config_path = directory / f"{self.key}.config.json"
        self._fh: IO[str] | None = None

    def __enter__(self) -> Self:
        return self.open()

    def __exit__(
        self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None
    ) -> None:
        self.close()

    def open(self) -> Self:
        if self._fh is not None:
            return self
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._write_or_check_sidecar()
        fh = self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError as exc:
            fh.close()
            raise PredCacheError(f"{self.path} is already open for writing by another process") from exc
        self._drop_partial_tail()
        self._fh = fh
        return self

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._fh is not None:
            self._fh.close()
            self._fh = None

    def append(
        self,
        example_id: str,
        gold: str,
        *,
        pred: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        error: PredError | None = None,
        t: Mapping[str, float] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._fh is None:
            raise PredCacheError("cache is not open; use `with PredCache(...) as cache`")
        fields = dict(pred or {})
        clash = fields.keys() & (RESERVED_KEYS | FORBIDDEN_KEYS)
        if clash:
            raise ValueError(f"prediction fields may not use {sorted(clash)}")
        record = {
            "id": example_id,
            "gold": gold,
            **fields,
            "error": asdict(error) if error else None,
            "t": dict(t or {}),
        }
        self._fh.write(canonical_json(record) + "\n")
        self._fh.flush()
        return record

    def iter_records(self) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
        if not self.path.exists():
            return
        with self.path.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for line in fh:
                if line.endswith("\n"):
                    yield json.loads(line)

    def records(self) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Per id: the last terminal record, else the last (retryable) failure."""
        latest: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for record in self.iter_records():
            current = latest.get(record["id"])
            if current is None or _terminal(record) or not _terminal(current):
                latest[record["id"]] = record
        return latest

    def done_ids(self) -> set[str]:
        """Ids to skip on resume: answered or failed for good; retryable errors run again."""
        return {rid for rid, record in self.records().items() if _terminal(record)}

    def _write_or_check_sidecar(self) -> None:
        if self.config_path.exists():
            existing = json.loads(self.config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            existing.pop("created_at", None)
            if existing != self.sidecar:
                raise PredCacheError(f"{self.config_path} describes a different run for key {self.key}")
            return
        payload = {**self.sidecar, "created_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")}
        tmp = self.config_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        tmp.replace(self.config_path)

    def _drop_partial_tail(self) -> None:
        # A crash mid-write leaves a line without "\n"; cut it so the next append starts a clean line.
        data = self.path.read_bytes()
        if data and not data.endswith(b"\n"):
            os.truncate(self.path, data.rfind(b"\n") + 1)

from veritrade.inference.ollama import FIXED_OPTIONS, OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.schemas import ANALYZE_MODELS, LabelOut, OrdinalOut, ollama_format
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict

# Part of every cache key: bump when the runner changes what it records for an unchanged config.
RUNNER_VERSION = "1"
DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 4
# Rendering the prompt with its own placeholder hashes everything the model sees except the input.
TEXT_SENTINEL = "{text}"
# Synthetic input that loads the model and warms the prompt cache before any timed call.
WARMUP_TEXT = "Ostrava Logistics appoints a new chief financial officer effective January 1."

Variant = Literal["decision", "label", "ordinal", "sentiment-first"]

    "decision": "signal",
    "label": "signal",
    "ordinal": "signal",
    "sentiment-first": "analyze",
}

class RunAborted(RuntimeError):

def serving_spec(base: ModelSpec, variant: Variant) -> ModelSpec:
    """The allowlisted spec switched to the variant under test; thresholds are applied offline."""
    if (variant == "decision") != (base.kind == "decision"):
        raise ValueError(f"{base.name} is a {base.kind} model and cannot run the {variant} variant")
    update: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if variant == "label":
        update = {"signal_schema": "label", "policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": base.min_p or 0.5}
    elif variant == "ordinal":
        update = {"signal_schema": "ordinal", "policy": "ordinal"}
    elif variant == "sentiment-first":
        update = {"field_order": "sentiment-first"}
    return ModelSpec.model_validate({**base.model_dump(), **update})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RunSpec:
    """One grid cell: a model asked for one output variant under one prompt version."""

    name: str
    spec: ModelSpec

    variant: Variant

            config["top_logprobs"] = TOP_LOGPROBS

    def prompt_sha(self) -> str:

def _out_type(variant: Variant) -> type[BaseModel]:
    if variant == "label":
        return LabelOut
    if variant == "ordinal":
        return OrdinalOut
    return ANALYZE_MODELS["sentiment-first"]


# --- one call --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _chat_timing(chat: ChatResult) -> Timing:
    timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": chat.wall_ms}
    timing.update({k: float(v) for k, v in asdict(chat.timings).items() if v is not None})
    return timing


def _parsed_label(content: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        return LabelOut.model_validate_json(content).label
    except ValidationError:
        return None


def _label_pred(verdict: Verdict, chat: ChatResult) -> Pred:
    """Records which branch of the serving fallback chain produced the probabilities, if any did."""
    if verdict.policy == "ordinal":
        fallback = "ordinal"
    elif verdict.score is not None:
        fallback = "score-sign"
    else:
        fallback = "none"
    return {
        "kind": "label",
        "label": _parsed_label(chat.content) if fallback == "none" else None,
        "probs": dict(verdict.probabilities) if verdict.probabilities is not None else None,
        "fallback": fallback,
        "score": verdict.score,
    }


async def _score_first(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """Stops at the score: later tokens cannot change it, and closing the stream frees Ollama early."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    stream = analyze_stream(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ScoreClosed):
                return {"kind": "analyze", "score": item.score}, {
                    "wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
                }
    raise SchemaViolation(f"{run.model} finished the stream without a score")


async def call_once(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """One example through the serving adapters; returns raw outputs, never the input."""
    if run.variant == "sentiment-first":
        return await _score_first(client, run, text)
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": raw.wall_ms}
        if raw.input_tokens is not None:
            timing["prompt_tokens"] = float(raw.input_tokens)
        pred: Pred = {
            "kind": "decision",
            "choice": raw.choice,
            "probs": dict(verdict.probabilities or {}),
            "model_confidence": raw.confidence,
        }
        return pred, timing
    if run.variant == "label":
        return _label_pred(verdict, raw), _chat_timing(raw)
    pred = {
        "kind": "ordinal",
        "score": verdict.score,
        "sign_probs": score_sign_probabilities(raw.content, raw.logprobs),
    }
    return pred, _chat_timing(raw)


# --- model residency -------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def model_digest(client: OllamaClient, model: str) -> str:
    for entry in await client.tags():
        if model in (entry.get("name"), entry.get("model")) and isinstance(entry.get("digest"), str):
            return str(entry["digest"])
    raise ModelUnavailable(f"{model} is not installed in Ollama", hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {model}`.")


async def make_resident(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, *, log: TextIO = sys.stderr) -> None:
    """Unload every other model, then warm this one so the first timed call is not a cold load."""
    for entry in await client.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != run.model:
            try:
                await client.unload(name)
            except VtError as exc:
                print(f"warning: could not unload {name}: {exc.message}", file=log)
    await call_once(client, run, WARMUP_TEXT)


# --- cell run --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RunStats:
    key: str
    path: Path
    total: int
    cached: int
    called: int
    errors: int


class Progress:
    """Counts only: neither inputs nor outputs reach the console."""

    def __init__(self, label: str, total: int, cached: int, *, every_s: float, out: TextIO) -> None:
        self.label, self.total, self.cached = label, total, cached
        self.every_s, self.out = every_s, out
        self.called = self.errors = 0
        self._t0 = self._last = time.monotonic()

    def tick(self, *, error: bool) -> None:
        self.called += 1
        self.errors += error
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - self._last >= self.every_s:
            self._last = now
            self.emit()

    def emit(self, final: bool = False) -> None:
        rate = self.called / max(time.monotonic() - self._t0, 1e-9)
        status = "done" if final else "running"
        print(
            f"[{self.label}] {status} {self.cached + self.called}/{self.total} "
            f"(cached {self.cached}, new {self.called}, errors {self.errors}, {rate:.1f}/s)",
            file=self.out,
            flush=True,
        )


def _pred_error(exc: VtError) -> PredError:
    # Greedy seeded decoding repeats a schema failure, so it is final; transport failures retry on resume.
    retryable = not isinstance(exc, SchemaViolation) and (exc.retryable or isinstance(exc, ModelUnavailable))
    return PredError(exc.code.value, exc.message[:300], retryable)


async def _pool(workers: int, job: Callable[[], Coroutine[Any, Any, None]]) -> None:
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(job()) for _ in range(workers)]
    try:
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    finally:
        for task in tasks:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)


async def run_cell(
    client: OllamaClient,
    run: RunSpec,
    examples: Sequence[Example],
    *,
    split: str,
    model_digest: str,
    concurrency: int = DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
    root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    progress_every_s: float = 30.0,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> RunStats:
    """Run every example not yet in the cache; an unreachable Ollama aborts, other failures are recorded."""
    if concurrency < 1:
        raise ValueError("concurrency must be >= 1")
    with run.cache(split, model_digest, root) as cache:
        done = cache.done_ids()
        todo = deque(e for e in examples if e.id not in done)
        cached = len(examples) - len(todo)
        progress = Progress(
            f"{run.endpoint} {run.model} {run.name}", len(examples), cached, every_s=progress_every_s, out=log
        )

        async def worker() -> None:
            while todo:
                example = todo.popleft()
                t0 = time.perf_counter()
                try:
                    pred, timing = await call_once(client, run, example.text)
                except LlmUnreachable as exc:
                    raise RunAborted(f"{run.model} {run.name}: {exc.message}") from exc
                except VtError as exc:
                    wall = {"wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000}
                    cache.append(example.id, example.label, error=_pred_error(exc), t=wall)
                    progress.tick(error=True)
                else:
                    cache.append(example.id, example.label, pred=pred, t=timing)
                    progress.tick(error=False)

        if todo:
            await _pool(min(concurrency, len(todo)), worker)
        progress.emit(final=True)
        return RunStats(cache.key, cache.path, len(examples), cached, progress.called, progress.errors)

"""Lean prompt x knob grid on dev300: `uv run python -m veritrade_evals.grid {list,run,analyze}`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import itertools
import json
import sys
from collections.abc import Collection, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, TextIO

from veritrade.config import get_settings
from veritrade.inference.ollama import FIXED_OPTIONS, OllamaClient
from veritrade.models_registry import allowlist
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry

from veritrade_evals.splits import HOLDOUT_SPLITS, Split, SplitName, load_split, read_split_file

GRID_SPLIT: SplitName = "dev300"
if GRID_SPLIT in HOLDOUT_SPLITS:
    raise RuntimeError("the grid tunes prompts and thresholds, so it must never read a holdout split")

GRID_DIR = RESULTS_DIR / "grid"
MANIFEST = GRID_DIR / "manifest.json"
NOTES = GRID_DIR / "notes.md"
VERSIONS = ("v1", "v2", "v3", "v4")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ModelPlan:
    model: str
    variants: tuple[Variant, ...]


# Execution order: the fast baseline first so a broken pipeline shows up in minutes.
PLAN: tuple[ModelPlan, ...] = (
    ModelPlan("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", ("label", "ordinal")),
    ModelPlan("clef-flash:9b-q8_0", ("decision",)),
    ModelPlan("nimble:9b-q4_K_M", ("decision",)),
    ModelPlan("ministral-3:3b", ("sentiment-first",)),
    ModelPlan("qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M", ("sentiment-first",)),
    ModelPlan("qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M", ("sentiment-first",)),
)
EXCLUDED = {
    "tev1:0.8b-q8_0": "CI plumbing model, not evaluated",
    "qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M": "holdout-only quality ceiling",
}
# What each prompt version varies; test_grid checks these labels against the prompt files.
DIMS: dict[str, dict[str, dict[str, str]]] = {
    "decision": {
        "v1": {"instructions": "rubric", "criteria": "described"},
        "v2": {"instructions": "rubric", "criteria": "bare"},
        "v3": {"instructions": "plain", "criteria": "described"},
        "v4": {"instructions": "plain", "criteria": "bare"},
    },
    "generative": {
        "v1": {"rubric": "A", "shots": "0"},
        "v2": {"rubric": "A", "shots": "4"},
        "v3": {"rubric": "B", "shots": "0"},
        "v4": {"rubric": "B", "shots": "4"},
    },
}


def cell_name(version: str, variant: Variant) -> str:
    return f"{version}-{variant}" if variant in ("label", "ordinal") else version


def cell_key(cell: RunSpec) -> str:
    return f"{cell.endpoint}/{cell.model}/{cell.name}"


def grid_cells(models: Collection[str] = (), registry: PromptRegistry | None = None) -> list[RunSpec]:
    registry = registry or PromptRegistry()
    roster = allowlist()
    unknown = set(models) - {p.model for p in PLAN}
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"not in the grid: {sorted(unknown)}")
    cells: list[RunSpec] = []
    for plan in PLAN:
        if models and plan.model not in models:
            continue
        base = roster[plan.model]
        for variant in plan.variants:
            spec = serving_spec(base, variant)
            for version in VERSIONS:
                cell = RunSpec(
                    cell_name(version, variant),
                    spec,
                    registry.get(
                        "analyze" if variant == "sentiment-first" else "signal",
                        plan.model,
                        kind=base.kind,
                        version=version,
                    ),
                    variant,
                    DIMS[base.kind][version],
                )
                cells.append(cell)
    return cells


# --- manifest --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def read_manifest(path: Path = MANIFEST) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not path.exists():
        return {"split": GRID_SPLIT, "cells": {}}
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return payload


def write_manifest(manifest: dict[str, Any], path: Path = MANIFEST) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    manifest["cells"] = dict(sorted(manifest["cells"].items()))
    tmp = path.with_suffix(".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(manifest, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    tmp.replace(path)


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


# --- run -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def run_grid(
    client: OllamaClient,
    cells: Sequence[RunSpec],
    examples: Sequence[Example],
    *,
    concurrency: int,
    preds_root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    manifest_path: Path = MANIFEST,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Model by model with only that model resident; the manifest is rewritten after every cell."""
    manifest = read_manifest(manifest_path)
    manifest["split"] = GRID_SPLIT
    manifest["ollama_version"] = await client.version()
    manifest["backend"] = get_settings().ollama_backend_label
    ids = {e.id for e in examples}
    for model, group in itertools.groupby(cells, key=lambda c: c.model):
        model_cells = list(group)
        digest = await model_digest(client, model)
        if any(not ids <= c.cache(GRID_SPLIT, digest, preds_root).done_ids() for c in model_cells):
            print(f"== {model}: unloading others and warming up", file=log, flush=True)
            await make_resident(client, model_cells[0], log=log)
        for cell in model_cells:
            stats = await run_cell(
                client,
                cell,
                examples,
                split=GRID_SPLIT,
                model_digest=digest,
                concurrency=concurrency,
                root=preds_root,
                log=log,
            )
            records = cell.cache(GRID_SPLIT, digest, preds_root).records()
            manifest["cells"][cell_key(cell)] = {
                "endpoint": cell.endpoint,
                "model": cell.model,
                "config": cell.name,
                "variant": cell.variant,

# --- analyze ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def dev_set(split: Split) -> DevSet:
    weights = split.example_weights()
    return DevSet(
        ids=tuple(e.id for e in split.examples),
        gold=tuple(e.label for e in split.examples),
        weights=None if weights is None else tuple(weights),
        buckets=tuple(bucket_of(e.text) for e in split.examples),
    )


def cell_inputs(
    cells: Sequence[RunSpec], manifest: dict[str, Any], dev: DevSet, preds_root: Path, log: TextIO
) -> list[CellInput]:
    """Cached records per cell, aligned to the split; skips cells not run yet or run under other prompts."""
    out: list[CellInput] = []
    for cell in cells:
        entry = manifest.get("cells", {}).get(cell_key(cell))
        if entry is None:
            print(f"skip {cell_key(cell)}: not run yet", file=log)
            continue
        current = json.loads(canonical_json(cell.run_config(GRID_SPLIT)))
        if entry["prompt_sha"] != cell.prompt_sha() or entry["run_config"] != current:
            print(f"skip {cell_key(cell)}: prompt or config changed since the run; re-run it", file=log)
            continue
        records = cell.cache(GRID_SPLIT, entry["model_digest"], preds_root).records()
        aligned = tuple(records.get(i) for i in dev.ids)
        missing = sum(r is None for r in aligned)
        if missing:
            print(f"warning {cell_key(cell)}: {missing} examples missing, scored as abstentions", file=log)
        out.append(
            CellInput(
                endpoint=cell.endpoint,
                model=cell.model,
                name=cell.name,
                variant=cell.variant,
                prompt_version=cell.prompt.version,
                records=aligned,
                dims=dict(cell.dims),
                ordinal_t=cell.spec.ordinal_t,
                meta={"cache_key": entry["cache_key"], "model_digest": entry["model_digest"]},
            )
        )
    return out


def model_report(inputs: Sequence[CellInput], dev: DevSet, class_weights: Any, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cands = candidates(inputs, dev)
    first = inputs[0]
    configs = []
    for cell in inputs:
        own = [c for c in cands if c.cell is cell]
        configs.append(
            {
                "name": cell.name,
                "variant": cell.variant,
                "prompt_version": cell.prompt_version,
                "dims": dict(cell.dims),
                "cache_key": cell.meta.get("cache_key"),
                "counts": counts(cell.records),
                "diagnostics": diagnostics(cell),
                "latency": latency(cell.records),
                "policies": {c.evaluation.policy: policy_report(c.evaluation) for c in own},
            }
        )
    report: dict[str, Any] = {
        "endpoint": first.endpoint,
        "model": first.model,
        "model_digest": first.meta.get("model_digest"),
        "split": GRID_SPLIT,
        "n": len(dev.ids),
        "class_weights": class_weights,
        "inversion_cap": INVERSION_CAP,
        "generated_by": "uv run python -m veritrade_evals.grid analyze",
        "configs": configs,
        "best": best_report(cands, dev, n_boot),
    }
    knob = knob_comparison(cands, dev, n_boot) if first.variant in ("label", "ordinal") else None
    if knob is not None:
        report["knob_comparison"] = knob
    mass = directional_mass_report(inputs, cands, dev, n_boot)
    if mass is not None:
        report["directional_mass"] = mass
    return report


def analyze_grid(
    *,
    n_boot: int = 1000,
    preds_root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    manifest_path: Path = MANIFEST,
    out_dir: Path = GRID_DIR,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> list[Path]:
    split = load_split(GRID_SPLIT)
    payload = read_split_file(GRID_SPLIT)
    manifest = read_manifest(manifest_path)
    dev = dev_set(split)
    inputs = cell_inputs(grid_cells(), manifest, dev, preds_root, log)
    groups = [list(g) for _, g in itertools.groupby(inputs, key=lambda c: (c.endpoint, c.model))]
    out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    written: list[Path] = []
    reports: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    served = []
    for group in groups:
        report = rounded(model_report(group, dev, payload["class_weights"], n_boot))
        reports.append(report)
        served.append(served_calls(*best_candidate(candidates(group, dev))))
        path = out_dir / f"{report['endpoint']}__{model_slug(report['model'])}.json"
        path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        written.append(path)
    if not reports:
        print("nothing to analyze: run the grid first", file=log)
        return written
    patterns = error_patterns(served, dev)
    concurrency = sorted({e.get("concurrency") for e in manifest["cells"].values()} - {None})
    header = {
        "n": len(dev.ids),
        "train_prior": payload["train_prior"],
        "n_boot": n_boot,
        "ollama_version": manifest.get("ollama_version", "?"),
        "backend": manifest.get("backend", "?"),
        "concurrency": ", ".join(str(c) for c in concurrency) or "?",
        "decoding": ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in FIXED_OPTIONS.items()),
    }
    notes = NOTES.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if out_dir == GRID_DIR and NOTES.exists() else None
    summary = out_dir / "summary.md"
    summary.write_text(render_summary(reports, patterns, header=header, notes=notes), encoding="utf-8")
    patterns_path = out_dir / "error_patterns.json"
    patterns_path.write_text(json.dumps(rounded(patterns), indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return [*written, summary, patterns_path]


# --- CLI -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def cmd_list(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    cells = grid_cells(args.model or ())
    for cell in cells:
        dims = " ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in cell.dims.items())
        print(f"{cell_key(cell):55s} {cell.prompt.version:45s} {dims}")
    per_model = {m: sum(c.model == m for c in cells) for m in dict.fromkeys(c.model for c in cells)}
    print(f"{len(cells)} configs: " + ", ".join(f"{m}={n}" for m, n in per_model.items()))
    print("excluded: " + "; ".join(f"{m} ({why})" for m, why in EXCLUDED.items()))
    return 0


async def _run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    cells = grid_cells(args.model or ())
    examples = list(load_split(GRID_SPLIT).examples)
    if args.limit:
        examples = examples[: args.limit]
    settings = get_settings()
    client = OllamaClient(
        args.base_url or settings.ollama_base_url,
        timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,
        keep_alive=settings.ollama_keep_alive,
    )
    async with client:
        manifest = await run_grid(
            client,
            cells,
            examples,
            concurrency=args.concurrency,
            preds_root=args.preds_root,
            manifest_path=args.manifest,
        )
    done = sum(e["done"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    errors = sum(e["errors"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    print(
        f"grid: {len(manifest['cells'])} cells in the manifest, {done} predictions, {errors} errors",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )
    return 0


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    return asyncio.run(_run(args))


def cmd_analyze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = analyze_grid(
        n_boot=args.n_boot, preds_root=args.preds_root, manifest_path=args.manifest, out_dir=args.out_dir
    )
    for path in paths:
        print(path)
    return 0 if paths else 1


def add_parser(subparsers: Any) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Registers `grid` on a parent CLI; dispatch with `run(args)`."""
    grid: argparse.ArgumentParser = subparsers.add_parser("grid", help="lean prompt x knob grid on dev300")
    actions = grid.add_subparsers(dest="grid_action", required=True)

    listing = actions.add_parser("list", help="print the grid configs")
    listing.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    listing.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_list)

    running = actions.add_parser("run", help="run (or resume) the grid against Ollama")
    running.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    running.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY)
    running.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="first N dev300 examples only (smoke runs)")
    running.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="Ollama URL (default from settings)")
    running.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    running.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    running.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_run)

    analyzing = actions.add_parser("analyze", help="score cached predictions and write evals/results/grid")
    analyzing.add_argument("--n-boot", type=int, default=1000)
    analyzing.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    analyzing.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    analyzing.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=GRID_DIR)
    analyzing.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_analyze)
    return grid


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    code: int = args.grid_func(args)
    return code


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals.grid", description=__doc__)
    add_parser(parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    return run(parser.parse_args(["grid", *(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Model allowlist and per-endpoint defaults loaded from `data/models.toml`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tomllib
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from functools import lru_cache
from importlib import resources
from typing import Any, Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import ModelNotAllowed
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, FieldOrder, ModelKind, PolicyName

ENDPOINTS: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = get_args(Endpoint)
SignalSchema = Literal["label", "ordinal"]


class ModelSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    num_ctx: int | None = Field(None, gt=0)
    max_input_tokens: int = Field(gt=0)
    num_predict: dict[Endpoint, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    signal_schema: SignalSchema | None = None
    policy: PolicyName
    min_p: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, le=1)
    ordinal_t: int = Field(1, ge=1, le=2)
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    evaluated: bool = True

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _default_field_order(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict) and "analyze" in data.get("endpoints", ()) and not data.get("field_order"):
            return {**data, "field_order": "sentiment-first"}
        return data

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _check_consistency(self) -> ModelSpec:
        if self.kind == "decision":
            if self.endpoints != ("signal",) or self.policy != "probability":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{self.name}: decision models serve only /signal with the probability policy"
                )
        else:
            if self.policy == "probability":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models have no native class probabilities")
            if self.num_ctx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models need num_ctx")
            missing = [e for e in self.endpoints if e not in self.num_predict]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: num_predict missing for {missing}")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.signal_schema is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative /signal models need signal_schema")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.policy == "ordinal" and self.signal_schema != "ordinal":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: the ordinal policy needs signal_schema = 'ordinal'")
        if self.policy in ("probability", "label-logprob") and self.min_p is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: policy {self.policy} needs min_p")
        return self

    def serves(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> bool:
        return endpoint in self.endpoints


def parse_models_toml(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, ModelSpec], dict[Endpoint, str]]:
    raw = tomllib.loads(text)
    specs = {name: ModelSpec(name=name, **body) for name, body in raw.get("models", {}).items()}
    defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
    for endpoint, name in raw.get("defaults", {}).items():
        if endpoint not in ENDPOINTS:
            raise ValueError(f"models.toml: unknown endpoint in [defaults]: {endpoint}")
        defaults[endpoint] = name
    return specs, defaults


def read_models_toml() -> str:
    return resources.files("veritrade.data").joinpath("models.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def allowlist() -> Mapping[str, ModelSpec]:
    """Every model in models.toml, ignoring VT_MODELS (prompts and evals need the full roster)."""
    return parse_models_toml(read_models_toml())[0]


class Registry:
    def __init__(
        self,
        specs: Mapping[str, ModelSpec],
        defaults: Mapping[Endpoint, str],
        *,
        restriction: Iterable[str] = (),
        overrides: Mapping[Endpoint, str | None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        restricted = list(restriction)
        unknown = [name for name in restricted if name not in specs]
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"VT_MODELS names models outside models.toml: {', '.join(unknown)}")
        keep = set(restricted) if restricted else set(specs)
        self._all = dict(specs)
        self._specs = {name: spec for name, spec in specs.items() if name in keep}
        self._defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
        for endpoint in ENDPOINTS:
            override = (overrides or {}).get(endpoint)
            if override:
                if not self._is_allowed(endpoint, override):
                    raise ValueError(f"default model override {override!r} is not allowed for /{endpoint}")
                self._defaults[endpoint] = override
                continue
            configured = defaults.get(endpoint)
            if configured and self._is_allowed(endpoint, configured):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = configured
            elif fallback := self.allowed(endpoint):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = fallback[0].name

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, settings: Settings | None = None, *, toml_text: str | None = None) -> Registry:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        specs, defaults = parse_models_toml(toml_text if toml_text is not None else read_models_toml())
        overrides: dict[Endpoint, str | None] = {
            "signal": settings.default_model_signal,
            "summary": settings.default_model_summary,
            "analyze": settings.default_model_analyze,
        }
        return cls(specs, defaults, restriction=settings.model_restriction, overrides=overrides)

    def _is_allowed(self, endpoint: Endpoint, name: str) -> bool:
        spec = self._specs.get(name)
        return spec is not None and spec.serves(endpoint)

    @property
    def models(self) -> list[ModelSpec]:
        return list(self._specs.values())

    @property
    def defaults(self) -> dict[Endpoint, str]:
        return dict(self._defaults)

    def allowed(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> list[ModelSpec]:
        return [spec for spec in self._specs.values() if spec.serves(endpoint)]

    def resolve(self, endpoint: Endpoint, model: str | None) -> ModelSpec:
        allowed = ", ".join(spec.name for spec in self.allowed(endpoint)) or "none"
        hint = f"Allowed for /{endpoint}: {allowed}."
        if model is None:
            default = self._defaults.get(endpoint)
            if default is None:
                raise ModelNotAllowed(f"No model is configured for /{endpoint}.", hint=hint)
            return self._specs[default]
        spec = self._specs.get(model)
        if spec is None:
            reason = "is disabled by VT_MODELS" if model in self._all else "is not on the allowlist"
            raise ModelNotAllowed(f"Model {model!r} {reason}.", hint=hint)
        if not spec.serves(endpoint):
            raise ModelNotAllowed(f"Model {model!r} does not serve /{endpoint}.", hint=hint)
        return spec


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_registry() -> Registry:
    return Registry.load()
# Serving config: allowlist, per-endpoint defaults, decoding options and frozen thresholds.
# Provisional values until `veritrade_evals freeze` / `select --write` rewrite them from eval results.
#
# kind        generative (/api/chat) | decision (/v1/systemone)
# endpoints   endpoints the model may serve
# signal_schema   generative signal output: "label" (one of 3 labels) | "ordinal" (score -2..2)
# policy      probability | label-logprob | ordinal  (streaming and /analyze always use ordinal)
# min_p       decision/label-logprob threshold on the winning class probability
# ordinal_t   directional call only when |score| >= ordinal_t (always set: streaming fallback)

"""Thin async adapters from (model spec, prompt, article text) to validated outputs and verdicts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import SchemaViolation
from veritrade.inference.confidence import (
    LabelLogprobPolicy,
    OrdinalPolicy,
    ProbabilityPolicy,
    policy_for,
)
from veritrade.inference.incremental import (
    EntityClosed,
    JsonFieldScanner,
    ScanEvent,
    ScoreClosed,
    SummaryText,
)
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient, OutputTruncated
from veritrade.inference.schemas import (
    ANALYZE_MODELS,
    AnalyzeOut,
    AnalyzeSentimentFirst,
    AnalyzeSummaryFirst,
    LabelOut,
    OrdinalOut,
    SummaryOut,
    ollama_format,
)
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, OllamaTimings, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec, SignalSchema
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
TOP_LOGPROBS = 20
# Terminal punctuation, closing quotes or brackets, then whitespace. The text end is no boundary:
# a cut right after "3." may sit inside "3.5".
_COMPLETE_SENTENCES = re.compile(r"(.*[.!?][\"'”’)\]]*)\s", re.DOTALL)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SummaryResult:
    output: SummaryOut
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AnalyzeResult:
    output: AnalyzeOut
    verdict: Verdict
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False

    @property
    def entity(self) -> str | None:
        return self.output.entity.strip() or None


def fit_input(text: str, max_input_tokens: int) -> str:
    """Cap at max_input_tokens (chars/4), cutting at the last whitespace so no word is split."""
    limit = max_input_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    cut = max(text.rfind(" ", 0, limit), text.rfind("\n", 0, limit))
    return text[: cut if cut > limit // 2 else limit].rstrip()


def chat_options(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint) -> dict[str, Any]:
    options: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if spec.num_ctx is not None:
        options["num_ctx"] = spec.num_ctx
    if endpoint in spec.num_predict:
        options["num_predict"] = spec.num_predict[endpoint]
    return options


def score_verdict(spec: ModelSpec, score: int) -> Verdict:
    """Verdict for a streamed or /analyze score; both always use the ordinal policy."""
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(score)


def _sum(a: float | None, b: float | None) -> float | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _sum_int(a: int | None, b: int | None) -> int | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _combine(first: ChatResult, second: ChatResult) -> ChatResult:
    # The fallback call's output decides; the reported cost covers both calls.
    t1, t2 = first.timings, second.timings
    return ChatResult(
        content=second.content,
        wall_ms=first.wall_ms + second.wall_ms,
        timings=OllamaTimings(
            load_ms=_sum(t1.load_ms, t2.load_ms),
            prompt_eval_ms=_sum(t1.prompt_eval_ms, t2.prompt_eval_ms),
            eval_ms=_sum(t1.eval_ms, t2.eval_ms),
            prompt_tokens=_sum_int(t1.prompt_tokens, t2.prompt_tokens),
            eval_tokens=_sum_int(t1.eval_tokens, t2.eval_tokens),
            total_ms=_sum(t1.total_ms, t2.total_ms),
        ),
        logprobs=second.logprobs,
        done_reason=second.done_reason,
    )


async def _signal_call(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str, schema: SignalSchema
) -> tuple[LabelOut | OrdinalOut, ChatResult]:
    out_type: type[LabelOut] | type[OrdinalOut] = LabelOut if schema == "label" else OrdinalOut
    return await client.chat_json(
        spec.name,
        prompt.messages(text, schema),
        out_type,
        options=chat_options(spec, "signal"),
        logprobs=True,
        top_logprobs=TOP_LOGPROBS,
    )


async def classify_signal(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> tuple[Verdict, ChatResult | DecisionResult]:
    """Label-logprob falls back label -> ordinal call (score sign) -> ordinal policy on the score."""
    text = fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens)
    policy = policy_for(spec, endpoint="signal")
    if isinstance(policy, ProbabilityPolicy):
        decision = await client.decide_sentiment(
            spec.name, prompt.state(text), prompt.instructions, prompt.criteria_map
        )
        return policy.decide(decision.probabilities), decision
    out, chat = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, spec.signal_schema or "ordinal")
    if isinstance(policy, LabelLogprobPolicy):
        verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is None and isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            out, second = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, "ordinal")
            chat = _combine(chat, second)
            verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is not None:
            return verdict, chat
    if not isinstance(out, OrdinalOut):
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name}: a label output needs the label-logprob policy")
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(out.score), chat


def _validate[T: BaseModel](out_type: type[T], content: str, model: str) -> T:
    try:
        return out_type.model_validate_json(content)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} streamed output that does not match {out_type.__name__}", hint=str(exc)[:300]
        ) from exc


def cut_to_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    """The text up to its last complete sentence, or all of it when no sentence has ended."""
    match = _COMPLETE_SENTENCES.match(text)
    return (match.group(1) if match else text).strip()


def _salvage(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint, chat: ChatResult) -> tuple[int | None, str, str]:
    """Score, entity and sentence-cut summary decoded from JSON that num_predict cut off."""
    log.warning(
        "%s output from %s hit num_predict after %s eval tokens; salvaging the partial JSON",
        endpoint,
        spec.name,
        chat.timings.eval_tokens,
    )
    score: int | None = None
    entity = ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for event in JsonFieldScanner().feed(chat.content):
        match event:
            case ScoreClosed(score=value):
                score = value
            case EntityClosed(entity=value):
                entity = value
            case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                parts.append(delta)
    summary = cut_to_sentence("".join(parts))
    if not summary:
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name} reached its output token limit before writing a summary")
    return score, entity, summary


def _salvage_summary(spec: ModelSpec, chat: ChatResult) -> SummaryResult:
"""Confidence policies: raw model output -> Verdict, abstaining to neutral below the frozen threshold."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import ClassVar

from veritrade.inference.schemas import LabelOut, OrdinalOut, score_sentiment
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, Endpoint, PolicyName, Sentiment, TokenLogprob, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec

# Ties resolve to the safe class first; also the criteria order sent to decision models.
TIE_ORDER: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("neutral", "bullish", "bearish")
# Share of first-token mass allowed on tokens that could start several classes before we give up.
AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX = 0.05

_VALUE_START = {
    "label": re.compile(r'"label"\s*:\s*"'),
    "score": re.compile(r'"score"\s*:\s*'),
}
_SCORE_HEAD = re.compile(r"^(?:-|-[12](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?|[012](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?)$")


def winner(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Sentiment:
    best = TIE_ORDER[0]
    for sentiment in TIE_ORDER[1:]:
        if probabilities.get(sentiment, 0.0) > probabilities.get(best, 0.0):
            best = sentiment
    return best


def normalise(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> dict[Sentiment, float]:
    total = sum(max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) for s in TIE_ORDER)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("probabilities sum to zero")
    return {s: max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def _threshold(
    name: PolicyName, probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float], min_p: float, score: int | None = None
) -> Verdict:
    top = winner(probabilities)
    confidence = probabilities[top]
    abstained = confidence < min_p
    return Verdict(
        sentiment="neutral" if abstained else top,
        abstained=abstained,
        policy=name,
        confidence=confidence,
        score=score,
        probabilities=probabilities,
    )


def label_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Labels a token's text could start; empty means the grammar would reject it."""
    return {s for s in TIE_ORDER if s.startswith(rest) or rest.startswith(s + '"')}


def sign_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Class implied by a token that starts an enum score (-2..2); empty when the grammar rejects it."""
    if not rest:
        return set(TIE_ORDER)
    if not _SCORE_HEAD.match(rest):
        return set()
    return {"bearish" if rest[0] == "-" else "neutral" if rest[0] == "0" else "bullish"}


def first_value_token(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob], key: str
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
    """The generated token that starts the value of `key` (minus any text before the value) and its
    alternatives as {text after the same prefix: probability}; None if tokens do not tile the content."""
    match = _VALUE_START[key].search(content)
    if match is None:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end > offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset]
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            return tok.token[len(prefix) :], candidates
        pos = end
    return None


def _first_token_distribution(
    content: str,
    logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None,
    key: str,
    classes: Callable[[str], set[Sentiment]],
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    found = first_value_token(content, logprobs or (), key)
    if found is None:
        return None
    chosen, candidates = found
    if len(classes(chosen)) != 1:
        return None
    mass = dict.fromkeys(TIE_ORDER, 0.0)
    ambiguous = 0.0
    for rest, p in candidates.items():
        # A token ending exactly where the value starts (e.g. a bare space) says nothing about the class.
        if not rest:
            continue
        hit = classes(rest)
        if len(hit) == 1:
            mass[next(iter(hit))] += p
        elif hit:
            ambiguous += p
    total = sum(mass.values())
    if total <= 0 or ambiguous > AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX * (total + ambiguous):
