```
"""Opus-labelled article set: ids, file layout, agent output schemas, committed rows and the eval loader.

Publisher text (HTML, titles, bodies) only ever lives under evals/data/private/articles; committed rows carry
URLs, hashes, labels and model-written facts.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from collections.abc import Iterable, Iterator
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError

from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.paths import ARTICLES_DIR, OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR, PRIVATE_ARTICLES_DIR, REPO_ROOT

REFERENCE_DATE = date(2026, 10, 18)
WINDOW_DAYS = 60
WINDOW_START = REFERENCE_DATE - timedelta(days=WINDOW_DAYS)
SEED = 20261018
PER_CLASS = 3
MIN_BODY_WORDS = 120
KEY_FACTS_MIN = 3
KEY_FACTS_MAX = 5
KEY_FACT_MAX_WORDS = 25
RATIONALE_MAX_WORDS = 50
LABEL_PACKET_WORDS = 1200
SHINGLE_WORDS = 10

Stage = Literal["gold", "label_a", "label_b", "adjudicate"]
STAGES: tuple[Stage, ...] = get_args(Stage)
PacketStage = Literal["gold", "label", "adjudicate"]
PACKET_STAGES: tuple[PacketStage, ...] = get_args(PacketStage)
ArticleSplit = Literal["dev", "test"]
RejectReason = Literal[
    "not_article",
    "live_blog",
    "paywalled_stub",
    "roundup",
    "video_only",
    "too_short",
    "non_english",
    "duplicate",
    "other",
]
REJECT_REASONS: tuple[RejectReason, ...] = get_args(RejectReason)
PROMPTS: dict[PacketStage, Path] = {
    "gold": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "20-gold.md",
    "label": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "30-label.md",
    "adjudicate": OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "40-adjudicate.md",
}


class ArticlesError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def article_id(url: str) -> str:
    return "art-" + hashlib.sha1(normalize_url(url).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:12]


def sha256_bytes(data: bytes) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    return sha256_bytes(path.read_bytes())


def rel(path: Path) -> str:
    """Repo-relative path for messages and packets, absolute when outside the repo (tests)."""
    try:
        return str(path.resolve().relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArticlePaths:
    private: Path = PRIVATE_ARTICLES_DIR
    committed: Path = ARTICLES_DIR

    def candidates(self, source: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "candidates" / f"{source}.jsonl"

    def view(self, source: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "views" / f"{source}.tsv"

    @property
    def cache(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "cache"

    @property
    def discovery_log(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "discovery_log.jsonl"

    def html(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "html" / f"{article}.html"

    def fetched(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "fetched" / f"{article}.json"

    def packet(self, stage: PacketStage, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / stage / f"{article}.md"

    def full_packet(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / "gold" / f"{article}.full.md"

    def lines(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "packets" / "gold" / f"{article}.lines.json"

    def out(self, stage: Stage, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "out" / stage / f"{article}.json"

    def out_dir(self, stage: Stage) -> Path:
        return self.private / "out" / stage

    def gold(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.private / "gold" / f"{article}.txt"

    @property
    def adjudicate_ids(self) -> Path:
        return self.private / "adjudicate_ids.txt"

    @property
    def rows(self) -> Path:
        return self.committed / "articles.jsonl"

    @property
    def stats(self) -> Path:
        return self.committed / "stats.json"


# --- records ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _Model(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class Candidate(_Model):
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    title: str | None = None
    published_at: str | None = None
    via: str
    via_url: str
    query: str | None = None
    extra: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def published(self) -> date | None:
        return date.fromisoformat(self.published_at) if self.published_at else None


class FetchRecord(_Model):
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    final_url: str | None = None
    fetched_at: str
    status: int | None = None
    error: str | None = None
    html_sha256: str | None = None
    words: int = 0
    method: str | None = None
    published_at: str | None = None
    published_date: str | None = None
    published_from: Literal["page", "candidate"] | None = None
    paywalled: bool = False
    extract_error: str | None = None

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.error is None and self.html_sha256 is not None

    @property
    def published(self) -> date | None:
        return date.fromisoformat(self.published_date) if self.published_date else None


# --- agent outputs (documented in evals/opus_prompts) ---------------------------------------------------


class GoldOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    usable: bool
    reject_reason: RejectReason | None = None
    title_line: int | None = None
    body_ranges: list[tuple[int, int]] = Field(default_factory=list)
    key_facts: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    entity: str | None = None
    ticker: str | None = None
    provisional_label: Sentiment | None = None


class LabelOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: int = Field(ge=-2, le=2)
    entity: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ambiguous: bool
    confidence: int = Field(ge=1, le=5)


class AdjudicateOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    decision: Literal["keep", "replace"]
    label: Sentiment
    score: int = Field(ge=-2, le=2)
    entity: str = Field(min_length=1)
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str = Field(min_length=1)


OUTPUT_MODELS: dict[Stage, type[GoldOutput] | type[LabelOutput] | type[AdjudicateOutput]] = {
    "gold": GoldOutput,
    "label_a": LabelOutput,
    "label_b": LabelOutput,
    "adjudicate": AdjudicateOutput,
}


def schema_codes(exc: ValidationError) -> list[str]:
    """Error locations and types only; messages can echo input text."""
    codes = []
    for error in exc.errors(include_url=False, include_input=False):
        where = ".".join(str(part) for part in error["loc"]) or "model"
        codes.append(f"schema:{where}:{error['type']}")
    return codes


# --- committed rows ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class LabelSummary(_Model):
    label: Sentiment
    score: int
    ambiguous: bool
    confidence: int


class AdjudicationSummary(_Model):
    decision: Literal["keep", "replace"]
    label: Sentiment
    score: int


class ArticleLabels(_Model):
    a: LabelSummary
    b: LabelSummary
    adjudicated: AdjudicationSummary | None = None
    final: Sentiment


class ArticleRow(_Model):
    id: str
    url: str
    source: str
    published_at: str
    fetched_at: str
    html_sha256: str
    gold_sha256: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: float
    entity: str
    ticker: str | None = None
    rationale: str
    key_facts: list[str]
    split: ArticleSplit
    labels: ArticleLabels


def read_jsonl[M: BaseModel](path: Path, model: type[M]) -> list[M]:
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    rows = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.strip():
            rows.append(model.model_validate_json(line))
    return rows


def write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: Iterable[BaseModel]) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    text = "".join(row.model_dump_json(exclude_none=False) + "\n" for row in rows)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def read_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> FetchRecord | None:
    path = paths.fetched(article)
    return FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else None


def iter_fetched(paths: ArticlePaths, source: str | None = None) -> Iterator[FetchRecord]:
    folder = paths.private / "fetched"
    for path in sorted(folder.glob("art-*.json")) if folder.exists() else []:
        record = FetchRecord.model_validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if source is None or record.source == source:
            yield record


def in_window(day: date | None, since: date = WINDOW_START, until: date = REFERENCE_DATE) -> bool:
    return day is not None and since <= day <= until


# --- verify + loader --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def row_problems(row: ArticleRow, paths: ArticlePaths) -> list[str]:
    problems = []
    for kind, path, expected in (
        ("html", paths.html(row.id), row.html_sha256),
        ("gold", paths.gold(row.id), row.gold_sha256),
    ):
        if not path.exists():
            problems.append(f"{kind}_missing")
        elif sha256_file(path) != expected:
            problems.append(f"{kind}_drifted")
    return problems


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ArticleExample:
    id: str
    source: str
    url: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: float
    entity: str
    ticker: str | None
    key_facts: tuple[str, ...]
    gold_text: str
    html_path: Path
    split: ArticleSplit


def load_articles(
    split: ArticleSplit | Literal["all"], *, paths: ArticlePaths | None = None
) -> list[ArticleExample]:
    """Committed rows joined with the local gold body and HTML path; missing or drifted files fail loudly."""
    paths = paths or ArticlePaths()
    rows = read_jsonl(paths.rows, ArticleRow)
    if not rows:
        raise ArticlesError(f"no article rows in {rel(paths.rows)}; run `articles finalize` first")
    examples: list[ArticleExample] = []
    problems: list[str] = []
    for row in rows:
        if split != "all" and row.split != split:
            continue
        if found := row_problems(row, paths):
            problems.extend(f"{row.id}:{code}" for code in found)
            continue
        examples.append(
            ArticleExample(
                id=row.id,
                source=row.source,
                url=row.url,
                label=row.label,
                score=row.score,
                entity=row.entity,
                ticker=row.ticker,
                key_facts=tuple(row.key_facts),
                gold_text=paths.gold(row.id).read_text(encoding="utf-8"),
                html_path=paths.html(row.id),
                split=row.split,
            )
        )
    if problems:
        raise ArticlesError(
            f"{len(problems)} local article files missing or drifted, e.g. {', '.join(problems[:4])}; "
            "run `articles verify`"
        )
    return examples
"""Resumable JSONL prediction cache, one file per (run config, model digest, prompt, harness) hash."""

from __future__ import annotations

import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
from collections.abc import Iterator, Mapping
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from types import TracebackType
from typing import IO, Any, Self

from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR

# Bump when harness changes alter predictions for an unchanged config, so old caches stop matching.
HARNESS_VERSION = "1"
RESERVED_KEYS = frozenset({"id", "gold", "error", "t"})
# Publisher and dataset licences: a record may describe a prediction, never carry its input.
FORBIDDEN_KEYS = frozenset({"text", "input", "input_text", "prompt", "messages", "article"})


class PredCacheError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def canonical_json(obj: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)


def run_hash(
    run_config: Mapping[str, Any], model_digest: str, prompt_sha: str, harness_version: str = HARNESS_VERSION
) -> str:
    payload = {
        "config": run_config,
        "model_digest": model_digest,
        "prompt_sha": prompt_sha,
        "harness_version": harness_version,
    }
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]


def model_slug(model: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", model)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PredError:
    code: str
    message: str
    retryable: bool


def _terminal(record: Mapping[str, Any]) -> bool:
    error = record.get("error")
    return error is None or not error.get("retryable", False)


class PredCache:
    """Single writer per file (flock); every append is flushed so a killed run resumes from the last line."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        model: str,
        run_config: Mapping[str, Any],
        *,
        model_digest: str,
        prompt_sha: str,
        root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
        harness_version: str = HARNESS_VERSION,
    ) -> None:
        self.key = run_hash(run_config, model_digest, prompt_sha, harness_version)
        self.sidecar = {
            "key": self.key,
            "model": model,
            "model_digest": model_digest,
            "prompt_sha": prompt_sha,
            "harness_version": harness_version,
            "run_config": json.loads(canonical_json(run_config)),
        }
        directory = root / model_slug(model)
        self.path = directory / f"{self.key}.jsonl"
        self.config_path = directory / f"{self.key}.config.json"
        self._fh: IO[str] | None = None

    def __enter__(self) -> Self:
        return self.open()

    def __exit__(
        self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None
    ) -> None:
        self.close()

    def open(self) -> Self:
        if self._fh is not None:
            return self
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._write_or_check_sidecar()
        fh = self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8")
        try:
            fcntl.flock(fh.fileno(), fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
        except BlockingIOError as exc:
            fh.close()
            raise PredCacheError(f"{self.path} is already open for writing by another process") from exc
        self._drop_partial_tail()
        self._fh = fh
        return self

    def close(self) -> None:
        if self._fh is not None:
            self._fh.close()
            self._fh = None

    def append(
        self,
        example_id: str,
        gold: str,
        *,
        pred: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        error: PredError | None = None,
        t: Mapping[str, float] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if self._fh is None:
            raise PredCacheError("cache is not open; use `with PredCache(...) as cache`")
        fields = dict(pred or {})
        clash = fields.keys() & (RESERVED_KEYS | FORBIDDEN_KEYS)
        if clash:
            raise ValueError(f"prediction fields may not use {sorted(clash)}")
        record = {
            "id": example_id,
            "gold": gold,
            **fields,
            "error": asdict(error) if error else None,
            "t": dict(t or {}),
        }
        self._fh.write(canonical_json(record) + "\n")
        self._fh.flush()
        return record

    def iter_records(self) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
        if not self.path.exists():
            return
        with self.path.open(encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            for line in fh:
                if line.endswith("\n"):
                    yield json.loads(line)

    def records(self) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
        """Per id: the last terminal record, else the last (retryable) failure."""
        latest: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        for record in self.iter_records():
            current = latest.get(record["id"])
            if current is None or _terminal(record) or not _terminal(current):
                latest[record["id"]] = record
        return latest

    def done_ids(self) -> set[str]:
        """Ids to skip on resume: answered or failed for good; retryable errors run again."""
        return {rid for rid, record in self.records().items() if _terminal(record)}

    def _write_or_check_sidecar(self) -> None:
        if self.config_path.exists():
            existing = json.loads(self.config_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            existing.pop("created_at", None)
            if existing != self.sidecar:
                raise PredCacheError(f"{self.config_path} describes a different run for key {self.key}")
            return
        payload = {**self.sidecar, "created_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")}
        tmp = self.config_path.with_suffix(".tmp")
        tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
        tmp.replace(self.config_path)

    def _drop_partial_tail(self) -> None:
        # A crash mid-write leaves a line without "\n"; cut it so the next append starts a clean line.
        data = self.path.read_bytes()
        if data and not data.endswith(b"\n"):
            os.truncate(self.path, data.rfind(b"\n") + 1)
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
EVALS_DIR = REPO_ROOT / "evals"
DATA_DIR = EVALS_DIR / "data"
SPLITS_DIR = DATA_DIR / "splits"
DATASETS_LOCK = DATA_DIR / "datasets.lock.json"

# Gitignored: dataset files, publisher HTML and prediction caches never leave the machine.

"""`uv run python -m veritrade_evals <command>`: dataset, split and (later) evaluation commands."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import sys
from collections.abc import Sequence

from veritrade_evals import articles_cli
from veritrade_evals.datasets import (
    SPECS,
    DatasetError,
    Example,
    class_counts,
    fetch_all,
    finentity_single,
    fpb_allagree,
    twitter_fns,
)
from veritrade_evals.splits import SPLIT_NAMES, SplitError, load_split, make_splits, read_split_file

PLANNED = {
    "signal": "signal accuracy run over a split",
    "grid": "prompt grid per model",
    "freeze": "write frozen prompt versions and thresholds into models.toml",
    "extraction": "parser x extractor matrix",
    "latency": "latency suite",
    "summary": "summary evaluation",
    "select": "pick per-endpoint winners",
    "holdout": "one-shot holdout run",
    "report": "benchmarks.json and results README",
    "opus": "Opus subagent prompts and judgements",
}


def _balance(examples: Sequence[Example]) -> str:
    counts = class_counts(examples)
    return " ".join(f"{k}={v} ({v / len(examples):.1%})" for k, v in counts.items())


def cmd_datasets_fetch(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    lock = fetch_all(update=args.update)
    for name, entry in lock.items():
        print(f"{name}: {SPECS[name].repo_id}@{entry.revision[:12]} ({entry.license})")
    loaded = {
        "tfns train": twitter_fns("train"),
        "tfns validation": twitter_fns("validation"),
        "fpb allagree": fpb_allagree(),
        "finentity single": finentity_single(),
    }
    for label, examples in loaded.items():
        print(f"  {label}: n={len(examples)} {_balance(examples)}")
    return 0


def cmd_splits_make(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    for name, path in make_splits().items():
        payload = read_split_file(name)
        print(f"{name}: n={payload['n']} {payload['class_counts']} -> {path.name}")
        if "class_weights" in payload:
            print(f"  train_prior={payload['train_prior']} weights={payload['class_weights']}")
            print(f"  excluded={payload['excluded']}")
    return 0


def cmd_splits_verify(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    failed = 0
    for name in SPLIT_NAMES:
        try:
            split = load_split(name)
        except (SplitError, DatasetError) as exc:
            failed += 1
            print(f"FAIL {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
            continue
        print(f"ok {name}: n={len(split.examples)} {_balance(split.examples)}")
    return 1 if failed else 0


def cmd_planned(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    print(f"`{args.command}` is not implemented yet ({PLANNED[args.command]})", file=sys.stderr)
    return 2


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals", description=__doc__)
    commands = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    datasets = commands.add_parser("datasets", help="public dataset downloads").add_subparsers(
        dest="action", required=True
    )
    fetch = datasets.add_parser(
        "fetch", help="download pinned revisions and record them in datasets.lock.json"
    )
    fetch.add_argument(
        "--update", action="store_true", help="re-resolve refs instead of reusing locked commits"
    )
    fetch.set_defaults(func=cmd_datasets_fetch)

    splits = commands.add_parser("splits", help="committed split files").add_subparsers(
        dest="action", required=True
    )
    splits.add_parser("make", help="write evals/data/splits/*.json").set_defaults(func=cmd_splits_make)
    splits.add_parser("verify", help="re-read datasets and check split hashes").set_defaults(
        func=cmd_splits_verify
    )

    articles_cli.register(commands)

    for name, help_text in PLANNED.items():
        planned = commands.add_parser(name, help=f"{help_text} (not implemented yet)")
        planned.set_defaults(func=cmd_planned)
    return parser


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    args, extra = parser.parse_known_args(argv)
    # Planned commands accept anything so scripts written against them fail with the clear message below.
    if extra and args.func is not cmd_planned:
        parser.error(f"unrecognized arguments: {' '.join(extra)}")
    code: int = args.func(args)
    return code


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```bash
$ cat evals/opus_prompts/00-README.md evals/opus_prompts/40-adjudicate.md && sed -n 1,400p .context/docs/design/01-decisions.md | grep -n -i -A8 "R6\|Build-time" | head -120
```

````
# Opus prompts: the 90-article evaluation set

Public sentiment datasets are sentences and headlines; the service reads whole articles. This folder holds the
prompts for the Claude Opus subagents that build a set of 90 real articles: 10 primary sources x 3 classes
(bullish, bearish, neutral) x 3 articles, split 30 dev / 60 test. There is no human check: two independent
labellers and an adjudicator stand in for one (decisions Q5 and R5 in `.context/docs/design/01-decisions.md`).

The agents never fetch anything themselves. They drive the deterministic CLI
`uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles <command>` (code in `evals/src/veritrade_evals/articles*.py` and
`discovery.py`), read private packet files, and write JSON outputs that the CLI validates.

## Pipeline

| Step | Who (every spawn `model: "opus"`) | Prompt | Commands | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 discover | one agent per source | `10-discover.md` | `discover`, `candidates`, `fetch` | candidates, raw HTML, fetch records |
| 2 gold | agents over batches of gold packets | `20-gold.md` | `prepare --stage gold`, `ingest --stage gold` | gold body, key facts, provisional label |
| 3 label | labeller A and labeller B, separate agents | `30-label.md` | `prepare --stage label`, `ingest --stage label_a` / `label_b` | labels, agreement, `adjudicate_ids.txt` |
| 4 adjudicate | one agent | `40-adjudicate.md` | `prepare --stage adjudicate`, `ingest --stage adjudicate` | keep or replace |
| 5 refill | main loop | - | `status`, then steps 1-4 for the cells that are short | every cell has enough eligible articles |
| 6 finalize | main loop | - | `finalize`, `verify` | committed `evals/data/articles/{articles.jsonl,stats.json}` |

Only the main loop runs `prepare`, `finalize`, `verify` and `ingest --agreement`. Discovery and gold agents may
run `status`; labellers and the adjudicator do not, so their judgements stay independent.

An article is **eligible** when its gold output is usable, it was published within 60 days before 2026-10-18
(2026-08-19 to 2026-10-18), both labellers produced valid outputs, and either they agree with neither flagging
`ambiguous`, or the adjudicator decided `keep` (its label is then final). `finalize` picks 3/3/3 per source; a
source that cannot fill a class may give up one article there (minimum 2) while other sources take a 4th, so
the set is still 30/30/30. The exact algorithm is printed into `stats.json`.

## Rules for every agent (publisher rights and the public transcript)

This build session's transcript is published, and the repository is public.

1. Article text, headlines, snippets and raw HTML live only under `evals/data/private/` (gitignored).
2. Read article text only with the Read tool, and only from the private files your prompt names (packets, and
   for discovery the candidates view). Do not grep, cat or print article files in a shell.
3. Write your outputs only to `evals/data/private/articles/out/<stage>/<id>.json`.
4. Never quote article text, headlines or snippets in messages, final reports, file names or committed files.
   Refer to articles by id (`art-` + 12 hex characters) and to sources by key. Key facts and rationales are
   written in your own words; the CLI rejects any that share a run of 10 consecutive words with the article.
5. Never use WebFetch, WebSearch or a browser on publisher pages. All fetching goes through the CLI, which uses
   the serving fetcher (SSRF guard, consent handling), honours robots.txt and waits at least 1 s between
   requests to one domain (EDGAR: 5 requests per second with a declared contact user agent).
6. Python only through `uv run ...` from the repository root; no inline Python.

## Private layout (`evals/data/private/articles/`)

| Path | Written by | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| `candidates/<source>.jsonl` | `discover` | id, url, title, published date, how it was found |
| `views/<source>.tsv` | `candidates` | compact id / date / title-or-slug view for an agent to Read |
| `html/<id>.html`, `fetched/<id>.json` | `fetch` | raw page; status, words, extraction method, publish date |
| `packets/gold/<id>.md`, `<id>.full.md`, `<id>.lines.json` | `prepare --stage gold` | numbered page lines |
| `packets/label/<id>.md`, `packets/adjudicate/<id>.md` | `prepare` | headline + gold body (+ both labels) |
| `out/{gold,label_a,label_b,adjudicate}/<id>.json` | agents | outputs, schemas in the stage prompts |
| `gold/<id>.txt` | `ingest --stage gold` | the validated gold body |
| `adjudicate_ids.txt` | `ingest --stage label_*` | ids where the labellers disagree or one is unsure |
| `cache/`, `discovery_log.jsonl` | `discover` | archive responses (6 h), per-run archive counts |

## Main-loop runbook

```bash
# 1. discovery agents (one per source, 10-discover.md), then check the counts
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles status

# 2. gold
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles prepare --stage gold
#    spawn gold agents over batches of packet paths (20-gold.md); they run `ingest --stage gold` themselves

# 3. labels (the two labellers never see each other's outputs or the provisional label)
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles prepare --stage label
#    spawn labeller A and labeller B over the same packet list (30-label.md)
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles ingest --stage label_b --agreement   # writes adjudicate_ids.txt

# 4. adjudication
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles prepare --stage adjudicate
#    spawn the adjudicator (40-adjudicate.md)

# 5. refill short cells, then
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles finalize
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles verify
```
# 40 - Adjudicate disagreements and ambiguous articles

You resolve the articles where the two labellers disagreed or at least one flagged the article as ambiguous.
The message that spawned you lists adjudication packets, `evals/data/private/articles/packets/adjudicate/<id>.md`.
Read `evals/opus_prompts/00-README.md` first; its rules bind you. In short: read articles only with the Read
tool on the packets you were given, write only to `evals/data/private/articles/out/adjudicate/`, never quote
article text or headlines in messages or your final report, and run Python only through `uv run`.

A packet holds both labellers' outputs (label, score, entity, ticker, ambiguous flag, confidence, rationale)
followed by the headline and article body, the same text they read. Do not open other files.

## Rubric

Use exactly the rubric in `evals/opus_prompts/30-label.md`: the economic impact of the news on its primary
entity, not the tone; bullish or bearish only for a clear, material implication; mixed news follows the
dominant material driver, or neutral if balanced. Form your own reading from the article first, then weigh
the two rationales as arguments, not votes.

## Decide

- `keep`: the article has one defensible label under the rubric, and the disagreement came from a misreading,
  a materiality threshold, or a different primary entity that the article settles. Your label, score, entity
  and ticker become final.
- `replace`: the article stays genuinely ambiguous: balanced mixed news, no clear primary entity, materiality
  that depends on facts the article does not give, or a direction a careful analyst could reasonably dispute.
  Replaced articles leave the set and the main loop finds others. The set is only useful if its labels are
  defensible, so do not keep an article just to fill a quota.

## Output

Write `evals/data/private/articles/out/adjudicate/<id>.json`:

```json
{
  "id": "art-0123456789ab",
  "decision": "keep",
  "label": "neutral",
  "score": 0,
  "entity": "Example Corp",
  "ticker": null,
  "rationale": "Your own words, at most 50: why this label, and what settled the disagreement."
}
```

For `replace`, still give your best label and score (their sign must agree) and say in the rationale why the
article is too ambiguous to keep.

## Validate and fix

```bash
uv run python -m veritrade_evals articles ingest --stage adjudicate
```

Fix every `FAIL`: `schema:<field>:<type>`, `score_label_mismatch`, `rationale_too_long`, `rationale_verbatim`
(rephrase), `not_requested` (the id is not in `adjudicate_ids.txt`; tell the main loop), `gold_missing`.
Do not run `articles status`.

## Final report (counts only)

Kept by final label, replaced, and for kept articles whether you sided with labeller A, labeller B or neither.
No headlines, quotes or article text.
````

```
## Follow-ups

- Generative roster trimmed: summary {`qwen3.5:2b`, `qwen3.5:4b`}; combined {`qwen3.5:4b`, `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507`,
  `ministral-3:3b`}; `qwen3.5:9b` only as a holdout quality ceiling; Gemma 4 dropped (open think+format bug).
- Lean prompt grid: 2 rubric styles x few-shot {0, 4} x field order where relevant (<= 8 configs per model).

## Build-time findings that adjusted the plan

Measured during P1/P2, recorded here so the deviations are traceable. Inputs for the Ollama probe were synthetic
(`evals/results/ollama_probe.json`, native Metal, warm, n=5).

- **Sources** (`02-source-probe.md`): AP News, Investing.com, Benzinga and Business Wire refuse a plain client at
  their CDN (Cloudflare / Akamai), so all four backups were promoted. Final 10: Yahoo Finance, CNBC, Motley Fool,
  PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire, SEC EDGAR EX-99.1, CNN Business, Fortune, Guardian Business, BBC Business.
- **R7 sanity gate passed**: each endpoint has at least one candidate inside its budget, so no budget moved.
  - `/signal`: `qwen3.5:0.8b` answers in 190 ms at ~510 prompt tokens. The 9B decision models take 1.3-1.5 s
    at the same size, so they are reported against the budget rather than the budget relaxed for them.
  - `/summary`: `qwen3.5:2b` shows first text at 0.93 s and finishes at 2.2 s on ~1.6k-token articles;
    `qwen3.5:4b` misses the 1.5 s TTFT budget at that size (2.4 s).
  - `/analyze`: `ministral-3:3b` reaches the score at 1.47 s and finishes at 3.5 s on ~1.75k tokens; the 4B
    qwen models miss TTFT at full-article size.
- **Logprobs**: Ollama 0.40.6 also returns logprobs on streamed chunks (undocumented). The knob comparison stays
  on non-streaming `/signal`; `/analyze` keeps the ordinal knob. Logprob-weighted streaming confidence goes to
  the backlog.
- **Field order**: `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507` ignores schema property order (always entity, score, summary) and
  ignores `think:false` when a schema is set, so the field-order dimension runs on `qwen3.5:4b` and
  `ministral-3:3b` only.
- **Fetch cap** raised from 5 MB to 10 MB: CNN article pages are 5.7-6.6 MB decompressed.
- **Sampling penalties zeroed**: the qwen3.5 Modelfiles ship `presence_penalty 1.5`, which still applies under
  greedy decoding. Few-shot answers end in `neutral` / `0`, so the penalty pushed generated labels away from
  neutral (26 of 60 dev tweets disagreed with the logprob argmax; 0 of 60 with the penalty off). Every chat call
  now pins `presence_penalty 0`, `frequency_penalty 0`, `repeat_penalty 1`; `num_predict` still bounds runaway
  output.
```

```
"""Thin async adapters from (model spec, prompt, article text) to validated outputs and verdicts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import SchemaViolation
from veritrade.inference.confidence import (
    LabelLogprobPolicy,
    OrdinalPolicy,
    ProbabilityPolicy,
    policy_for,
)
from veritrade.inference.incremental import (
    EntityClosed,
    JsonFieldScanner,
    ScanEvent,
    ScoreClosed,
    SummaryText,
)
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient, OutputTruncated
from veritrade.inference.schemas import (
    ANALYZE_MODELS,
    AnalyzeOut,
    AnalyzeSentimentFirst,
    AnalyzeSummaryFirst,
    LabelOut,
    OrdinalOut,
    SummaryOut,
    ollama_format,
)
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, OllamaTimings, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec, SignalSchema
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
TOP_LOGPROBS = 20
# Terminal punctuation, closing quotes or brackets, then whitespace. The text end is no boundary:
# a cut right after "3." may sit inside "3.5".
_COMPLETE_SENTENCES = re.compile(r"(.*[.!?][\"'”’)\]]*)\s", re.DOTALL)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SummaryResult:
    output: SummaryOut
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AnalyzeResult:
    output: AnalyzeOut
    verdict: Verdict
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False

    @property
    def entity(self) -> str | None:
        return self.output.entity.strip() or None


def fit_input(text: str, max_input_tokens: int) -> str:
    """Cap at max_input_tokens (chars/4), cutting at the last whitespace so no word is split."""
    limit = max_input_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    cut = max(text.rfind(" ", 0, limit), text.rfind("\n", 0, limit))
    return text[: cut if cut > limit // 2 else limit].rstrip()


def chat_options(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint) -> dict[str, Any]:
    options: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if spec.num_ctx is not None:
        options["num_ctx"] = spec.num_ctx
    if endpoint in spec.num_predict:
        options["num_predict"] = spec.num_predict[endpoint]
    return options


def score_verdict(spec: ModelSpec, score: int) -> Verdict:
    """Verdict for a streamed or /analyze score; both always use the ordinal policy."""
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(score)


def _sum(a: float | None, b: float | None) -> float | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _sum_int(a: int | None, b: int | None) -> int | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _combine(first: ChatResult, second: ChatResult) -> ChatResult:
    # The fallback call's output decides; the reported cost covers both calls.
    t1, t2 = first.timings, second.timings
    return ChatResult(
        content=second.content,
        wall_ms=first.wall_ms + second.wall_ms,
        timings=OllamaTimings(
            load_ms=_sum(t1.load_ms, t2.load_ms),
            prompt_eval_ms=_sum(t1.prompt_eval_ms, t2.prompt_eval_ms),
            eval_ms=_sum(t1.eval_ms, t2.eval_ms),
            prompt_tokens=_sum_int(t1.prompt_tokens, t2.prompt_tokens),
            eval_tokens=_sum_int(t1.eval_tokens, t2.eval_tokens),
            total_ms=_sum(t1.total_ms, t2.total_ms),
        ),
        logprobs=second.logprobs,
        done_reason=second.done_reason,
    )


async def _signal_call(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str, schema: SignalSchema
) -> tuple[LabelOut | OrdinalOut, ChatResult]:
    out_type: type[LabelOut] | type[OrdinalOut] = LabelOut if schema == "label" else OrdinalOut
    return await client.chat_json(
        spec.name,
        prompt.messages(text, schema),
        out_type,
        options=chat_options(spec, "signal"),
        logprobs=True,
        top_logprobs=TOP_LOGPROBS,
    )


async def classify_signal(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> tuple[Verdict, ChatResult | DecisionResult]:
    """Label-logprob falls back label -> ordinal call (score sign) -> ordinal policy on the score."""
    text = fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens)
    policy = policy_for(spec, endpoint="signal")
    if isinstance(policy, ProbabilityPolicy):
        decision = await client.decide_sentiment(
            spec.name, prompt.state(text), prompt.instructions, prompt.criteria_map
        )
        return policy.decide(decision.probabilities), decision
    out, chat = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, spec.signal_schema or "ordinal")
    if isinstance(policy, LabelLogprobPolicy):
        verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is None and isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            out, second = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, "ordinal")
            chat = _combine(chat, second)
            verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is not None:
            return verdict, chat
    if not isinstance(out, OrdinalOut):
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name}: a label output needs the label-logprob policy")
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(out.score), chat


def _validate[T: BaseModel](out_type: type[T], content: str, model: str) -> T:
    try:
        return out_type.model_validate_json(content)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} streamed output that does not match {out_type.__name__}", hint=str(exc)[:300]
        ) from exc


def cut_to_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    """The text up to its last complete sentence, or all of it when no sentence has ended."""
    match = _COMPLETE_SENTENCES.match(text)
    return (match.group(1) if match else text).strip()


def _salvage(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint, chat: ChatResult) -> tuple[int | None, str, str]:
    """Score, entity and sentence-cut summary decoded from JSON that num_predict cut off."""
    log.warning(
        "%s output from %s hit num_predict after %s eval tokens; salvaging the partial JSON",
        endpoint,
        spec.name,
        chat.timings.eval_tokens,
    )
    score: int | None = None
    entity = ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for event in JsonFieldScanner().feed(chat.content):
        match event:
            case ScoreClosed(score=value):
                score = value
            case EntityClosed(entity=value):
                entity = value
            case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                parts.append(delta)
    summary = cut_to_sentence("".join(parts))
    if not summary:
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name} reached its output token limit before writing a summary")
    return score, entity, summary


def _salvage_summary(spec: ModelSpec, chat: ChatResult) -> SummaryResult:
    _, _, summary = _salvage(spec, "summary", chat)
    return SummaryResult(SummaryOut(summary=summary), chat, truncated=True)


def _salvage_analyze(
    spec: ModelSpec, out_type: type[AnalyzeSentimentFirst] | type[AnalyzeSummaryFirst], chat: ChatResult
) -> AnalyzeResult:
    """A cut generation still needs its score; summary-first output cut before it stays a violation."""
    score, entity, summary = _salvage(spec, "analyze", chat)
    if score is None:
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name} reached its output token limit before writing the score")
    out = out_type.model_validate({"score": score, "entity": entity, "summary": summary})
    return AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), chat, truncated=True)


def _was_cut(chat: ChatResult, scanner: JsonFieldScanner) -> bool:
    return chat.done_reason == "length" and not scanner.done


async def summarize(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> SummaryResult:
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    try:
        out, chat = await client.chat_json(
            spec.name, messages, SummaryOut, options=chat_options(spec, "summary"), retry_cut=False
        )
    except OutputTruncated as cut:
        return _salvage_summary(spec, cut.chat)
    return SummaryResult(out, chat)


async def summarize_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | SummaryResult]:
    """Summary text deltas as they decode, then the validated result (no retry once tokens are out)."""
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(SummaryOut), options=chat_options(spec, "summary")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                if _was_cut(item, scanner):
                    yield _salvage_summary(spec, item)
                    return
                scanner.close()
                yield SummaryResult(_validate(SummaryOut, item.content, spec.name), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event


async def analyze(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> AnalyzeResult:
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    out_type = ANALYZE_MODELS[order]
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    try:
        out, chat = await client.chat_json(
            spec.name, messages, out_type, options=chat_options(spec, "analyze"), retry_cut=False
        )
    except OutputTruncated as cut:
        return _salvage_analyze(spec, out_type, cut.chat)
    return AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), chat)


async def analyze_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | AnalyzeResult]:
    """Scanner events in generation order (ScoreClosed first when sentiment-first), then the result."""
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    out_type = ANALYZE_MODELS[order]
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(out_type), options=chat_options(spec, "analyze")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                if _was_cut(item, scanner):
                    yield _salvage_analyze(spec, out_type, item)
                    return
                scanner.close()
                out = _validate(out_type, item.content, spec.name)
                yield AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event
```

```
"""Async Ollama client on httpx: the only Ollama path for the API, evals and probes."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import json
import time
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator, Mapping, Sequence
from types import TracebackType
from typing import Any, Self

import httpx
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, ValidationError

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import (
    InferenceTimeout,
    LlmUnreachable,
    ModelUnavailable,
    SchemaViolation,
    VtError,
)
from veritrade.inference.schemas import ollama_format
from veritrade.inference.types import (
    SENTIMENTS,
    ChatResult,
    DecisionResult,
    OllamaTimings,
    Sentiment,
    TokenLogprob,
)

Message = Mapping[str, str]
# Greedy and seeded so evals and serving see the same output for the same prompt. Penalties are neutralised
# because Modelfiles set them (qwen3.5: presence_penalty 1.5), which skews outputs away from recent tokens.
FIXED_OPTIONS: dict[str, Any] = {
    "temperature": 0,
    "seed": 0,
    "presence_penalty": 0,
    "frequency_penalty": 0,
    "repeat_penalty": 1,
}
SENTIMENT_QUESTION = "sentiment"


class OutputTruncated(SchemaViolation):
    """Generation hit num_predict before the JSON closed; `chat` keeps the partial output."""

    def __init__(self, model: str, chat: ChatResult) -> None:
        super().__init__(f"{model} reached its output token limit before the JSON closed")
        self.chat = chat


class _ChoiceAnswer(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="ignore")

    choice: Sentiment
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float]
    confidence: float


def _ms(value: Any) -> float | None:
    return value / 1e6 if isinstance(value, int | float) else None


def _int(value: Any) -> int | None:
    return value if isinstance(value, int) else None


def _str(value: Any) -> str | None:
    return value if isinstance(value, str) else None


def parse_timings(body: Mapping[str, Any]) -> OllamaTimings:
    return OllamaTimings(
        load_ms=_ms(body.get("load_duration")),
        prompt_eval_ms=_ms(body.get("prompt_eval_duration")),
        eval_ms=_ms(body.get("eval_duration")),
        prompt_tokens=_int(body.get("prompt_eval_count")),
        eval_tokens=_int(body.get("eval_count")),
        total_ms=_ms(body.get("total_duration")),
    )


def parse_logprobs(raw: Any) -> tuple[TokenLogprob, ...] | None:
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or not raw:
        return None
    return tuple(
        TokenLogprob(
            token=entry["token"],
            logprob=float(entry["logprob"]),
            top=tuple((alt["token"], float(alt["logprob"])) for alt in entry.get("top_logprobs") or ()),
        )
        for entry in raw
    )


def _error_text(response: httpx.Response) -> str:
    try:
        body = response.json()
    except ValueError:
        return response.text[:300]
    error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    return error if isinstance(error, str) else response.text[:300]


def _status_error(status: int, text: str, model: str | None) -> VtError:
    name = model or "?"
    if status == 404 or "not found" in text.lower():
        return ModelUnavailable(
            f"Model {name} is not available in Ollama: {text}",
            hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {name}` or pick an installed model.",
            upstream_status=status,
        )
    return ModelUnavailable(
        f"Ollama rejected the request for {name} ({status}): {text}", upstream_status=status
    )


class OllamaClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        *,
        timeout: float = 90.0,
        keep_alive: str | int = "30m",
        http: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.keep_alive = keep_alive
        self._http = http or httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url, timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout, connect=min(5.0, timeout))
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_settings(cls, settings: Settings | None = None) -> OllamaClient:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        return cls(
            settings.ollama_base_url,
            timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,
            keep_alive=settings.ollama_keep_alive,
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._http.aclose()

    async def __aenter__(self) -> Self:
        return self

    async def __aexit__(
        self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None
    ) -> None:
        await self.aclose()

    # --- transport ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _transport_error(self, exc: httpx.HTTPError, model: str | None) -> VtError:
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.ConnectError | httpx.ConnectTimeout):
            return LlmUnreachable(
                f"Cannot reach Ollama at {self.base_url}: {exc}",
                hint="Start Ollama (`brew services start ollama`) or point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at it.",
            )
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.TimeoutException):
            return InferenceTimeout(f"Ollama did not answer in time for {model or 'request'}: {exc!r}")
        return LlmUnreachable(f"Ollama connection failed: {exc!r}")

    async def request(
        self, method: str, path: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, *, model: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """One JSON round trip with Ollama errors mapped to typed VtErrors."""
        try:
            response = await self._http.request(method, path, json=payload)
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned non-JSON for {path}") from exc
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned an unexpected body for {path}")
        return body

    # --- chat -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _chat_body(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        stream: bool,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        logprobs: bool,
        top_logprobs: int | None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": [dict(m) for m in messages],
            "stream": stream,
            "think": False,
            "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
            "options": {**(options or {}), **FIXED_OPTIONS},
        }
        if format is not None:
            body["format"] = format
        if logprobs:
            body["logprobs"] = True
            if top_logprobs is not None:
                body["top_logprobs"] = top_logprobs
        return body

    async def chat_raw(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[ChatResult, dict[str, Any]]:
        body = self._chat_body(
            model,
            messages,
            stream=False,
            format=format,
            options=options,
            logprobs=logprobs,
            top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
        )
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        raw = await self.request("POST", "/api/chat", body, model=model)
        wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        message = raw.get("message") or {}
        result = ChatResult(
            content=str(message.get("content") or ""),
            wall_ms=wall_ms,
            timings=parse_timings(raw),
            logprobs=parse_logprobs(raw.get("logprobs")),
            done_reason=_str(raw.get("done_reason")),
        )
        return result, raw

    async def chat(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> ChatResult:
        result, _ = await self.chat_raw(
            model, messages, format=format, options=options, logprobs=logprobs, top_logprobs=top_logprobs
        )
        return result

    async def chat_json[T: BaseModel](
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        out_type: type[T],
        *,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
        retry_cut: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[T, ChatResult]:
        """Schema-constrained chat, validated, with one retry. Output cut at num_predict is retried with
        a doubled budget, or raised as OutputTruncated when `retry_cut` is off so the caller can salvage."""
        opts = dict(options or {})
        spent_ms = 0.0
        last_error: ValidationError | None = None
        for _attempt in range(2):
            result, _ = await self.chat_raw(
                model,
                messages,
                format=ollama_format(out_type),
                options=opts,
                logprobs=logprobs,
                top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
            )
            spent_ms += result.wall_ms
            try:
                parsed = out_type.model_validate_json(result.content)
            except ValidationError as exc:
                last_error = exc
                if result.done_reason == "length":
                    if not retry_cut:
                        raise OutputTruncated(model, dataclasses.replace(result, wall_ms=spent_ms)) from exc
                    if isinstance(opts.get("num_predict"), int):
                        opts["num_predict"] = opts["num_predict"] * 2
                continue
            return parsed, dataclasses.replace(result, wall_ms=spent_ms)
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} returned output that does not match {out_type.__name__} twice",
            hint=str(last_error)[:300] if last_error else None,
        )

    async def chat_stream(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> AsyncGenerator[str | ChatResult]:
        """Yield content deltas, then one final ChatResult; ttft is measured here, not by Ollama."""
        body = self._chat_body(
            model,
            messages,
            stream=True,
            format=format,
            options=options,
            logprobs=logprobs,
            top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
        )
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        ttft_ms: float | None = None
        parts: list[str] = []
        token_logprobs: list[TokenLogprob] = []
        try:
            async with self._http.stream("POST", "/api/chat", json=body) as response:
                if response.status_code >= 400:
                    await response.aread()
                    raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
                async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                    if not line.strip():
                        continue
                    try:
                        chunk = json.loads(line)
                    except ValueError as exc:
                        raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama sent a malformed stream line for {model}") from exc
                    if isinstance(chunk.get("error"), str):
                        raise _status_error(500, chunk["error"], model)
                    if parsed := parse_logprobs(chunk.get("logprobs")):
                        token_logprobs.extend(parsed)
                    delta = str((chunk.get("message") or {}).get("content") or "")
                    if delta:
                        if ttft_ms is None:
                            ttft_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
                        parts.append(delta)
                        yield delta
                    if chunk.get("done"):
                        yield ChatResult(
                            content="".join(parts),
                            wall_ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
                            timings=parse_timings(chunk),
                            logprobs=tuple(token_logprobs) or None,
                            ttft_ms=ttft_ms,
                            done_reason=_str(chunk.get("done_reason")),
                        )
                        return
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama stream for {model} ended without a done message")

    # --- decision models ------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def systemone(
        self, model: str, state: str, questions: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = {
            "model": model,
            "state": state,
            "questions": {k: dict(v) for k, v in questions.items()},
            "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
        }
        return await self.request("POST", "/v1/systemone", body, model=model)

    async def decide_sentiment(
        self,
        model: str,
        state: str,
        instructions: str,
        criteria: Mapping[Sentiment, str | None],
    ) -> DecisionResult:
        """One `choice` question; criteria order is the tie order, so callers put neutral first."""
        if set(criteria) != set(SENTIMENTS):
            raise ValueError(f"criteria must name exactly {SENTIMENTS}, got {list(criteria)}")
        question = {"type": "choice", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": dict(criteria)}
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        raw = await self.systemone(model, state, {SENTIMENT_QUESTION: question})
        wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        try:
            answer = _ChoiceAnswer.model_validate((raw.get("answers") or {}).get(SENTIMENT_QUESTION))
        except ValidationError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned an unexpected systemone answer") from exc
        if set(answer.probabilities) != set(SENTIMENTS):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned probabilities for {sorted(answer.probabilities)}")
        usage = raw.get("usage") or {}
        return DecisionResult(
            choice=answer.choice,
            probabilities={s: answer.probabilities[s] for s in criteria},
            confidence=answer.confidence,
            wall_ms=wall_ms,
            input_tokens=_int(usage.get("input_tokens")),
        )

    # --- utilities ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def embed(self, model: str, inputs: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        body = {"model": model, "input": list(inputs), "keep_alive": self.keep_alive}
        raw = await self.request("POST", "/api/embed", body, model=model)
        embeddings = raw.get("embeddings")
        if not isinstance(embeddings, list) or len(embeddings) != len(inputs):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned {len(embeddings or [])} embeddings for {len(inputs)}")
        return [[float(x) for x in row] for row in embeddings]

    async def tags(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list((await self.request("GET", "/api/tags")).get("models") or [])

    async def ps(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list((await self.request("GET", "/api/ps")).get("models") or [])

    async def show(self, model: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self.request("POST", "/api/show", {"model": model}, model=model)

    async def version(self) -> str:
        return str((await self.request("GET", "/api/version")).get("version") or "")

    async def unload(self, model: str) -> None:
        await self.request("POST", "/api/generate", {"model": model, "keep_alive": 0}, model=model)
```

```
"""Single entry point from HTML to Article; parse and extract time are measured separately."""

from __future__ import annotations

import html as html_lib
import re
import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from veritrade.errors import ExtractionEmpty
from veritrade.extract import cascade, density, jsonld, profiles, third_party
from veritrade.extract.dom import Dom, head_title, normalize, parse, scan_json_ld
from veritrade.extract.profiles import source_for_url
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS, Article, ExtractorName, ParserName

__all__ = ["MIN_WORDS", "extract", "source_for_url"]

MIN_WORDS = 40

OWN: dict[ExtractorName, Callable[[Dom, str, str | None], list[str]]] = {
    "jsonld": jsonld.extract,
    "profile": profiles.extract,
    "density": density.extract,
}
_PUBLISHED_META = re.compile(
    r"""<meta\b[^>]*?(?:property|name|itemprop)\s*=\s*["']"""
    r"""(?:article:published_time|datePublished|pubdate|publishdate)["'][^>]*>""",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_CONTENT_ATTR = re.compile(r"""\bcontent\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)')""", re.IGNORECASE)


def _published_meta(html: str) -> str | None:
    if (meta := _PUBLISHED_META.search(html)) and (content := _CONTENT_ATTR.search(meta.group(0))):
        return normalize(html_lib.unescape(content.group(1) or content.group(2) or "")) or None
    return None


def _dom_title(dom: Dom, source: str | None) -> str:
    profile = profiles.profile_for(source)
    if profile is not None and profile.title:
        for node in dom.select(profile.title):
            if text := node.text():
                return text
    return dom.title()


def extract(
    html: str,
    url: str,
    *,
    parser: ParserName = "selectolax",
    extractor: ExtractorName = "cascade",
) -> Article:
    """Raises ExtractionEmpty when fewer than MIN_WORDS words come out."""
    source = source_for_url(url)
    start = time.perf_counter()
    dom: Dom | None = None
    if extractor in PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS:
        dom = parse(html, parser)
        if extractor == "cascade":
            method, paragraphs = cascade.run(dom, url, source)
        else:
            method, paragraphs = extractor, OWN[extractor](dom, url, source)
        objects = dom.json_ld()
    else:
        method, paragraphs = extractor, third_party.extract(extractor, html, url)
        objects = scan_json_ld(html)
    words = sum(len(p.split()) for p in paragraphs)
    if words < MIN_WORDS:
        raise ExtractionEmpty(
            f"The {extractor} extractor found {words} words on {urlsplit(url).hostname or url}; "
            f"at least {MIN_WORDS} are needed",
            hint="Try another extractor (for example trafilatura), or check that the URL is a single "
            "article rather than a section or video page.",
        )
    title = jsonld.headline(objects) or (_dom_title(dom, source) if dom is not None else head_title(html))
    published_at = jsonld.date_published(objects) or _published_meta(html)
    total_ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
    parse_ms = dom.parse_ms if dom is not None else 0.0
    return Article(
        url=url,
        title=title,
        paragraphs=tuple(paragraphs),
        published_at=published_at,
        source=source,
        method=method,
        parser=parser if dom is not None else None,
        extractor=extractor,
        parse_ms=parse_ms,
        extract_ms=total_ms - parse_ms,
        paywalled=jsonld.is_paywalled(objects),
    )
"""What the model reads: the headline plus the lede or the whole body, cut to a token budget."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Sequence

from veritrade.extract.dom import split_sentences
from veritrade.extract.profiles import profile_for
from veritrade.extract.types import Article, Scope

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
LEDE_PARAGRAPHS = 2
LEDE_MIN_TOKENS = 60  # a dateline-only first paragraph is topped up with the next one
LEDE_MAX_TOKENS = 200
_SEP = "\n\n"


def estimate_tokens(text: str) -> int:
    return math.ceil(len(text) / CHARS_PER_TOKEN)


def lede_paragraphs(article: Article) -> list[str]:
    profile = profile_for(article.source)
    count = profile.lede_paragraphs if profile else LEDE_PARAGRAPHS
    out = list(article.paragraphs[:count])
    for paragraph in article.paragraphs[count:]:
        if estimate_tokens(_SEP.join(out)) >= LEDE_MIN_TOKENS:
            break
        out.append(paragraph)
    return out


def _cut(paragraph: str, room: int, *, mid_sentence: bool) -> str:
    kept = ""
    for sentence in split_sentences(paragraph):
        candidate = f"{kept} {sentence}" if kept else sentence
        if len(candidate) > room:
            break
        kept = candidate
    if kept or not mid_sentence:
        return kept
    head = paragraph[: room + 1]
    return head[:room] if " " not in head else head.rsplit(" ", 1)[0]


def fit(paragraphs: Sequence[str], budget_chars: int) -> list[str]:
    """Whole paragraphs, then whole sentences; words are cut only when not even one sentence fits."""
    out: list[str] = []
    used = 0
    for paragraph in paragraphs:
        sep = len(_SEP) if out else 0
        if used + sep + len(paragraph) <= budget_chars:
            out.append(paragraph)
            used += sep + len(paragraph)
            continue
        if partial := _cut(paragraph, budget_chars - used - sep, mid_sentence=not out):
            out.append(partial)
        break
    return out


def build_input(article: Article, scope: Scope, max_tokens: int) -> str:
    """'TITLE: ...' then a blank line and the body; the estimate (chars / 4) never exceeds max_tokens."""
    if max_tokens <= 0:
        raise ValueError("max_tokens must be positive")
    budget = max_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    head = f"TITLE: {article.title}" if article.title else ""
    if len(head) > budget:
        return _SEP.join(fit([head], budget))
    room = budget - len(head) - (len(_SEP) if head else 0)
    if scope == "lede":
        body = fit(lede_paragraphs(article), min(room, LEDE_MAX_TOKENS * CHARS_PER_TOKEN))
    else:
        body = fit(article.paragraphs, room)
    return _SEP.join([head, *body] if head else body)
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Literal, get_args

ParserName = Literal["selectolax", "lxml", "bs4", "bs4-lxml"]
ExtractorName = Literal[
    "cascade",
    "jsonld",
    "profile",
    "density",
    "trafilatura",
    "trafilatura-precision",
    "readability",
    "newspaper",
    "justext",
    "strip-tags",
]
Scope = Literal["lede", "full"]

PARSERS: tuple[ParserName, ...] = get_args(ParserName)
EXTRACTORS: tuple[ExtractorName, ...] = get_args(ExtractorName)
# Own strategies run on every parser backend; third-party extractors bring their own parser.
PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS: frozenset[ExtractorName] = frozenset({"cascade", "jsonld", "profile", "density"})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Article:
    url: str
    title: str
    paragraphs: tuple[str, ...]
    published_at: str | None
    source: str | None
    method: str
    parser: ParserName | None
    extractor: ExtractorName
    parse_ms: float
    extract_ms: float
    paywalled: bool = False

    @property
    def text(self) -> str:
        return "\n\n".join(self.paragraphs)

    @property
    def word_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(len(p.split()) for p in self.paragraphs)
```

```
"""Versioned prompts per (endpoint, model) from TOML; the version string carries a content hash."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import re
import tomllib
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from importlib import resources
from importlib.resources.abc import Traversable
from typing import Any

from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, ModelKind, Sentiment
from veritrade.models_registry import allowlist

# Output variants each (endpoint, kind) must define, and the JSON fields each variant emits in order.
REQUIRED_VARIANTS: dict[tuple[Endpoint, ModelKind], tuple[str, ...]] = {
    ("signal", "generative"): ("label", "ordinal"),
    ("signal", "decision"): (),
    ("summary", "generative"): ("default",),
    ("analyze", "generative"): ("sentiment-first", "summary-first"),
}
OUTPUT_FIELDS: dict[str, tuple[str, ...]] = {
    "label": ("label",),
    "ordinal": ("score",),
    "default": ("summary",),
    "sentiment-first": ("score", "entity", "summary"),
    "summary-first": ("summary", "entity", "score"),
}
CRITERIA_ORDER: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("neutral", "bullish", "bearish")
_FENCE_TAG = re.compile(r"<\s*/?\s*article\b[^>]*>", re.IGNORECASE)
_VERSION_KEYS = frozenset(
    {"extends", "shots", "system", "user_template", "output", "instructions", "criteria"}
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class FewShot:
    text: str
    label: Sentiment
    score: int
    entity: str
    summary: str

    def answer(self, fields: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
        return json.dumps({name: getattr(self, name) for name in fields}, ensure_ascii=False)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PromptSpec:
    endpoint: Endpoint
    model: str
    kind: ModelKind
    version_id: str
    version: str
    source: str
    user_template: str
    system: str = ""
    output: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    few_shot: tuple[FewShot, ...] = ()
    instructions: str = ""
    criteria: tuple[tuple[Sentiment, str | None], ...] = ()

    def render_input(self, text: str) -> str:
        # Strip fence tags from the article so it cannot close the untrusted-data block early.
        return self.user_template.replace("{text}", _FENCE_TAG.sub("", text))

    def messages(self, text: str, variant: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
        if variant not in self.output:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.version} has no output variant {variant!r}")
        out: list[dict[str, str]] = [
            {"role": "system", "content": self.system.replace("{output}", self.output[variant])}
        ]
        for shot in self.few_shot:
            out.append({"role": "user", "content": self.render_input(shot.text)})
            out.append({"role": "assistant", "content": shot.answer(OUTPUT_FIELDS[variant])})
        out.append({"role": "user", "content": self.render_input(text)})
        return out

    def state(self, text: str) -> str:
        return self.render_input(text)

    @property
    def criteria_map(self) -> dict[Sentiment, str | None]:
        return dict(self.criteria)


def model_slug(model: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9._-]+", "_", model)


def _content_hash(body: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    canonical = json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]


def _resolve_version(doc: Mapping[str, Any], version_id: str, source: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    chain: list[str] = []
    merged: dict[str, Any] = {}
    current: str | None = version_id
    while current is not None:
        if current in chain:
            raise ValueError(f"{source}: extends cycle {' -> '.join([*chain, current])}")
        table = doc.get(current)
        if not isinstance(table, dict):
            raise ValueError(f"{source}: no version table [{current}]")
        unknown = set(table) - _VERSION_KEYS
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"{source}: [{current}] has unknown keys {sorted(unknown)}")
        chain.append(current)
        merged = {**table, **merged}
        current = table.get("extends")
    merged.pop("extends", None)
    return merged


def _criteria(raw: Any, source: str) -> tuple[tuple[Sentiment, str | None], ...]:
    if not isinstance(raw, dict) or set(raw) != set(CRITERIA_ORDER):
        raise ValueError(f"{source}: criteria must define exactly {CRITERIA_ORDER}")
    # TOML has no null; an empty description sends a bare label.
    return tuple((s, raw[s] or None) for s in CRITERIA_ORDER)


class PromptRegistry:
    def __init__(self, root: Traversable | None = None) -> None:
        self._root = root or resources.files("veritrade.prompts").joinpath("data")
        self._docs: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}

    def _source(self, endpoint: Endpoint, model: str, kind: ModelKind) -> Traversable:
        folder = self._root.joinpath(endpoint)
        for name in (f"{model_slug(model)}.toml", f"default-{kind}.toml", "default.toml"):
            candidate = folder.joinpath(name)
            if candidate.is_file():
                return candidate
        raise LookupError(f"No prompt file for /{endpoint} and {model} under prompts/data/{endpoint}/")

    def _doc(self, source: Traversable, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if label not in self._docs:
            self._docs[label] = tomllib.loads(source.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return self._docs[label]

    def versions(self, endpoint: Endpoint, model: str, *, kind: ModelKind | None = None) -> list[str]:
        kind = kind or _kind_of(model)
        source = self._source(endpoint, model, kind)
        doc = self._doc(source, f"{endpoint}/{source.name}")
        return [key for key, value in doc.items() if isinstance(value, dict)]

    def get(
        self, endpoint: Endpoint, model: str, *, kind: ModelKind | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> PromptSpec:
        kind = kind or _kind_of(model)
        source = self._source(endpoint, model, kind)
        label = f"{endpoint}/{source.name}"
        doc = self._doc(source, label)
        version_id = version or doc.get("active")
        if not isinstance(version_id, str):
            raise ValueError(f"{label}: missing `active` version")
        body = _resolve_version(doc, version_id, label)
        where = f"{label} [{version_id}]"
        user_template = str(body.get("user_template", ""))
        if "{text}" not in user_template:
            raise ValueError(f"{where}: user_template needs a {{text}} placeholder")
        system, instructions = str(body.get("system", "")), str(body.get("instructions", ""))
        output: dict[str, str] = {}
        few_shot: tuple[FewShot, ...] = ()
        criteria: tuple[tuple[Sentiment, str | None], ...] = ()
        if kind == "decision":
            criteria = _criteria(body.get("criteria"), where)
            if not instructions:
                raise ValueError(f"{where}: decision prompts need instructions")
        else:
            output = {str(k): str(v) for k, v in body.get("output", {}).items()}
            missing = [v for v in REQUIRED_VARIANTS[(endpoint, kind)] if v not in output]
            if missing or "{output}" not in system:
                raise ValueError(f"{where}: needs a system with {{output}} and output variants {missing}")
            shots = int(body.get("shots", 0))
            pool = [FewShot(**shot) for shot in doc.get("few_shot", [])]
            if shots > len(pool):
                raise ValueError(f"{where}: shots={shots} but the pool has {len(pool)}")
            few_shot = tuple(pool[:shots])
        digest = _content_hash(
            {
                "kind": kind,
                "user_template": user_template,
                "system": system,
                "output": output,
                "few_shot": [asdict(s) for s in few_shot],
                "instructions": instructions,
                "criteria": criteria,
            }
        )
        return PromptSpec(
            endpoint=endpoint,
            model=model,
            kind=kind,
            version_id=version_id,
            version=f"{endpoint}/{model}/{version_id}@{digest}",
            source=label,
            user_template=user_template,
            system=system,
            output=output,
            few_shot=few_shot,
            instructions=instructions,
            criteria=criteria,
        )


def _kind_of(model: str) -> ModelKind:
    spec = allowlist().get(model)
    return spec.kind if spec else "generative"


_default_registry = PromptRegistry()


def get(
    endpoint: Endpoint, model: str, *, kind: ModelKind | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> PromptSpec:
    return _default_registry.get(endpoint, model, kind=kind, version=version)

# /api/analyze prompts: ordinal score + entity + summary in one structured call.
# Grid seeds: v1 rubric A (definitions), v2 = v1 + 4 shots, v3 rubric B (impact questions), v4 = v3 + 4 shots.
# The output variant follows the model's field order; the JSON schema enforces the same order.
active = "v1"

[v1]
system = """You analyse financial news for traders. Work on the article's primary entity (the company or asset \
```
