"""Model allowlist and per-endpoint defaults loaded from `data/models.toml`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tomllib
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from functools import lru_cache
from importlib import resources
from typing import Any, Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import ModelNotAllowed
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, FieldOrder, ModelKind, PolicyName

ENDPOINTS: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = get_args(Endpoint)
SignalSchema = Literal["label", "ordinal"]


class ModelSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    num_ctx: int | None = Field(None, gt=0)
    max_input_tokens: int = Field(gt=0)
    num_predict: dict[Endpoint, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    signal_schema: SignalSchema | None = None
    policy: PolicyName
    min_p: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, le=1)
    ordinal_t: int = Field(1, ge=1, le=2)
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    evaluated: bool = True

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _default_field_order(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict) and "analyze" in data.get("endpoints", ()) and not data.get("field_order"):
            return {**data, "field_order": "sentiment-first"}
        return data

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _check_consistency(self) -> ModelSpec:
        if self.kind == "decision":
            if self.endpoints != ("signal",) or self.policy != "probability":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{self.name}: decision models serve only /signal with the probability policy"
                )
        else:
            if self.policy == "probability":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models have no native class probabilities")
            if self.num_ctx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models need num_ctx")
            missing = [e for e in self.endpoints if e not in self.num_predict]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: num_predict missing for {missing}")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.signal_schema is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative /signal models need signal_schema")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.policy == "ordinal" and self.signal_schema != "ordinal":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: the ordinal policy needs signal_schema = 'ordinal'")
        if self.policy in ("probability", "label-logprob") and self.min_p is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: policy {self.policy} needs min_p")
        return self

    def serves(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> bool:
        return endpoint in self.endpoints


def parse_models_toml(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, ModelSpec], dict[Endpoint, str]]:
    raw = tomllib.loads(text)
    specs = {name: ModelSpec(name=name, **body) for name, body in raw.get("models", {}).items()}
    defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
    for endpoint, name in raw.get("defaults", {}).items():
        if endpoint not in ENDPOINTS:
            raise ValueError(f"models.toml: unknown endpoint in [defaults]: {endpoint}")
        defaults[endpoint] = name
    return specs, defaults


def read_models_toml() -> str:
    return resources.files("veritrade.data").joinpath("models.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def allowlist() -> Mapping[str, ModelSpec]:
    """Every model in models.toml, ignoring VT_MODELS (prompts and evals need the full roster)."""
    return parse_models_toml(read_models_toml())[0]


class Registry:
    def __init__(
        self,
        specs: Mapping[str, ModelSpec],
        defaults: Mapping[Endpoint, str],
        *,
        restriction: Iterable[str] = (),
        overrides: Mapping[Endpoint, str | None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        restricted = list(restriction)
        unknown = [name for name in restricted if name not in specs]
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"VT_MODELS names models outside models.toml: {', '.join(unknown)}")
        keep = set(restricted) if restricted else set(specs)
        self._all = dict(specs)
        self._specs = {name: spec for name, spec in specs.items() if name in keep}
        self._defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
        for endpoint in ENDPOINTS:
            override = (overrides or {}).get(endpoint)
            if override:
                if not self._is_allowed(endpoint, override):
                    raise ValueError(f"default model override {override!r} is not allowed for /{endpoint}")
                self._defaults[endpoint] = override
                continue
            configured = defaults.get(endpoint)
            if configured and self._is_allowed(endpoint, configured):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = configured
            elif fallback := self.allowed(endpoint):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = fallback[0].name

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, settings: Settings | None = None, *, toml_text: str | None = None) -> Registry:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        specs, defaults = parse_models_toml(toml_text if toml_text is not None else read_models_toml())
        overrides: dict[Endpoint, str | None] = {
            "signal": settings.default_model_signal,
            "summary": settings.default_model_summary,
            "analyze": settings.default_model_analyze,
        }
        return cls(specs, defaults, restriction=settings.model_restriction, overrides=overrides)

    def _is_allowed(self, endpoint: Endpoint, name: str) -> bool:
        spec = self._specs.get(name)
        return spec is not None and spec.serves(endpoint)

    @property
    def models(self) -> list[ModelSpec]:
        return list(self._specs.values())

    @property
    def defaults(self) -> dict[Endpoint, str]:
        return dict(self._defaults)

    def allowed(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> list[ModelSpec]:
        return [spec for spec in self._specs.values() if spec.serves(endpoint)]

    def resolve(self, endpoint: Endpoint, model: str | None) -> ModelSpec:
        allowed = ", ".join(spec.name for spec in self.allowed(endpoint)) or "none"
        hint = f"Allowed for /{endpoint}: {allowed}."
        if model is None:
            default = self._defaults.get(endpoint)
            if default is None:
                raise ModelNotAllowed(f"No model is configured for /{endpoint}.", hint=hint)
            return self._specs[default]
        spec = self._specs.get(model)
        if spec is None:
            reason = "is disabled by VT_MODELS" if model in self._all else "is not on the allowlist"
            raise ModelNotAllowed(f"Model {model!r} {reason}.", hint=hint)
        if not spec.serves(endpoint):
            raise ModelNotAllowed(f"Model {model!r} does not serve /{endpoint}.", hint=hint)
        return spec


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_registry() -> Registry:
    return Registry.load()

"""Eval runner: drives the serving adapters over examples and caches raw outputs for offline thresholds."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import hashlib
import sys
import time
from collections import deque
from collections.abc import Callable, Coroutine, Mapping, Sequence
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal, TextIO, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import LlmUnreachable, ModelUnavailable, SchemaViolation, VtError
from veritrade.inference.adapters import TOP_LOGPROBS, analyze_stream, chat_options, classify_signal
from veritrade.inference.confidence import score_sign_probabilities
from veritrade.inference.incremental import ScoreClosed
from veritrade.inference.ollama import FIXED_OPTIONS, OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.schemas import ANALYZE_MODELS, LabelOut, OrdinalOut, ollama_format
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade_evals.datasets import Example
from veritrade_evals.paths import PREDS_DIR
from veritrade_evals.predcache import PredCache, PredError, canonical_json

# Part of every cache key: bump when the runner changes what it records for an unchanged config.
RUNNER_VERSION = "1"
DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY = 4
# Rendering the prompt with its own placeholder hashes everything the model sees except the input.
TEXT_SENTINEL = "{text}"
# Synthetic input that loads the model and warms the prompt cache before any timed call.
WARMUP_TEXT = "Ostrava Logistics appoints a new chief financial officer effective January 1."

Variant = Literal["decision", "label", "ordinal", "sentiment-first"]
VARIANTS: tuple[Variant, ...] = get_args(Variant)
VARIANT_ENDPOINT: dict[Variant, Endpoint] = {
    "decision": "signal",
    "label": "signal",
    "ordinal": "signal",
    "sentiment-first": "analyze",
}
Pred = dict[str, Any]
Timing = dict[str, float]


class RunAborted(RuntimeError):
    pass


def serving_spec(base: ModelSpec, variant: Variant) -> ModelSpec:
    """The allowlisted spec switched to the variant under test; thresholds are applied offline."""
    if (variant == "decision") != (base.kind == "decision"):
        raise ValueError(f"{base.name} is a {base.kind} model and cannot run the {variant} variant")
    update: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if variant == "label":
        update = {"signal_schema": "label", "policy": "label-logprob", "min_p": base.min_p or 0.5}
    elif variant == "ordinal":
        update = {"signal_schema": "ordinal", "policy": "ordinal"}
    elif variant == "sentiment-first":
        update = {"field_order": "sentiment-first"}
    return ModelSpec.model_validate({**base.model_dump(), **update})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RunSpec:
    """One grid cell: a model asked for one output variant under one prompt version."""

    name: str
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    variant: Variant
    dims: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)

    @property
    def model(self) -> str:
        return self.spec.name

    @property
    def endpoint(self) -> Endpoint:
        return VARIANT_ENDPOINT[self.variant]

    def run_config(self, split: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        config: dict[str, Any] = {
            "runner": RUNNER_VERSION,
            "split": split,
            "endpoint": self.endpoint,
            "variant": self.variant,
            "prompt_version": self.prompt.version,
            "max_input_tokens": self.spec.max_input_tokens,
        }
        if self.variant != "decision":
            # Exactly what the client sends, so a change to the fixed decoding options re-keys the cache.
            config["options"] = {**chat_options(self.spec, self.endpoint), **FIXED_OPTIONS}
        if self.variant in ("label", "ordinal"):
            config["top_logprobs"] = TOP_LOGPROBS
        if self.variant == "sentiment-first":
            config["stop_after_score"] = True
        return config

    def prompt_sha(self) -> str:
        payload: dict[str, Any]
        if self.variant == "decision":
            payload = {
                "state": self.prompt.state(TEXT_SENTINEL),
                "instructions": self.prompt.instructions,
                "criteria": self.prompt.criteria,
            }
        else:
            payload = {
                "messages": self.prompt.messages(TEXT_SENTINEL, self.variant),
                "format": ollama_format(_out_type(self.variant)),
            }
            if self.variant == "label":
                payload["fallback"] = {
                    "messages": self.prompt.messages(TEXT_SENTINEL, "ordinal"),
                    "format": ollama_format(OrdinalOut),
                }
        return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json(payload).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    def cache(self, split: str, model_digest: str, root: Path = PREDS_DIR) -> PredCache:
        return PredCache(
            self.model,
            self.run_config(split),
            model_digest=model_digest,
            prompt_sha=self.prompt_sha(),
            root=root,
        )


def _out_type(variant: Variant) -> type[BaseModel]:
    if variant == "label":
        return LabelOut
    if variant == "ordinal":
        return OrdinalOut
    return ANALYZE_MODELS["sentiment-first"]


# --- one call --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _chat_timing(chat: ChatResult) -> Timing:
    timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": chat.wall_ms}
    timing.update({k: float(v) for k, v in asdict(chat.timings).items() if v is not None})
    return timing


def _parsed_label(content: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        return LabelOut.model_validate_json(content).label
    except ValidationError:
        return None


def _label_pred(verdict: Verdict, chat: ChatResult) -> Pred:
    """Records which branch of the serving fallback chain produced the probabilities, if any did."""
    if verdict.policy == "ordinal":
        fallback = "ordinal"
    elif verdict.score is not None:
        fallback = "score-sign"
    else:
        fallback = "none"
    return {
        "kind": "label",
        "label": _parsed_label(chat.content) if fallback == "none" else None,
        "probs": dict(verdict.probabilities) if verdict.probabilities is not None else None,
        "fallback": fallback,
        "score": verdict.score,
    }


async def _score_first(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """Stops at the score: later tokens cannot change it, and closing the stream frees Ollama early."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    stream = analyze_stream(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ScoreClosed):
                return {"kind": "analyze", "score": item.score}, {
                    "wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
                }
    raise SchemaViolation(f"{run.model} finished the stream without a score")


async def call_once(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, text: str) -> tuple[Pred, Timing]:
    """One example through the serving adapters; returns raw outputs, never the input."""
    if run.variant == "sentiment-first":
        return await _score_first(client, run, text)
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(client, run.spec, run.prompt, text)
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        timing: Timing = {"wall_ms": raw.wall_ms}
        if raw.input_tokens is not None:
            timing["prompt_tokens"] = float(raw.input_tokens)
        pred: Pred = {
            "kind": "decision",
            "choice": raw.choice,
            "probs": dict(verdict.probabilities or {}),
            "model_confidence": raw.confidence,
        }
        return pred, timing
    if run.variant == "label":
        return _label_pred(verdict, raw), _chat_timing(raw)
    pred = {
        "kind": "ordinal",
        "score": verdict.score,
        "sign_probs": score_sign_probabilities(raw.content, raw.logprobs),
    }
    return pred, _chat_timing(raw)


# --- model residency -------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def model_digest(client: OllamaClient, model: str) -> str:
    for entry in await client.tags():
        if model in (entry.get("name"), entry.get("model")) and isinstance(entry.get("digest"), str):
            return str(entry["digest"])
    raise ModelUnavailable(f"{model} is not installed in Ollama", hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {model}`.")


async def make_resident(client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, *, log: TextIO = sys.stderr) -> None:
    """Unload every other model, then warm this one so the first timed call is not a cold load."""
    for entry in await client.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != run.model:
            try:
                await client.unload(name)
            except VtError as exc:
                print(f"warning: could not unload {name}: {exc.message}", file=log)
    await call_once(client, run, WARMUP_TEXT)


# --- cell run --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class RunStats:
    key: str
    path: Path
    total: int
    cached: int
    called: int
    errors: int


class Progress:
    """Counts only: neither inputs nor outputs reach the console."""

    def __init__(self, label: str, total: int, cached: int, *, every_s: float, out: TextIO) -> None:
        self.label, self.total, self.cached = label, total, cached
        self.every_s, self.out = every_s, out
        self.called = self.errors = 0
        self._t0 = self._last = time.monotonic()

    def tick(self, *, error: bool) -> None:
        self.called += 1
        self.errors += error
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - self._last >= self.every_s:
            self._last = now
            self.emit()

    def emit(self, final: bool = False) -> None:
        rate = self.called / max(time.monotonic() - self._t0, 1e-9)
        status = "done" if final else "running"
        print(
            f"[{self.label}] {status} {self.cached + self.called}/{self.total} "
            f"(cached {self.cached}, new {self.called}, errors {self.errors}, {rate:.1f}/s)",
            file=self.out,
            flush=True,
        )


def _pred_error(exc: VtError) -> PredError:
    # Greedy seeded decoding repeats a schema failure, so it is final; transport failures retry on resume.
    retryable = not isinstance(exc, SchemaViolation) and (exc.retryable or isinstance(exc, ModelUnavailable))
    return PredError(exc.code.value, exc.message[:300], retryable)


async def _pool(workers: int, job: Callable[[], Coroutine[Any, Any, None]]) -> None:
    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(job()) for _ in range(workers)]
    try:
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
    finally:
        for task in tasks:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)


async def run_cell(
    client: OllamaClient,
    run: RunSpec,
    examples: Sequence[Example],
    *,
    split: str,
    model_digest: str,
    concurrency: int = DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY,
    root: Path = PREDS_DIR,
    progress_every_s: float = 30.0,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> RunStats:
    """Run every example not yet in the cache; an unreachable Ollama aborts, other failures are recorded."""
    if concurrency < 1:
        raise ValueError("concurrency must be >= 1")
    with run.cache(split, model_digest, root) as cache:
        done = cache.done_ids()
        todo = deque(e for e in examples if e.id not in done)
        cached = len(examples) - len(todo)
        progress = Progress(
            f"{run.endpoint} {run.model} {run.name}", len(examples), cached, every_s=progress_every_s, out=log
        )

        async def worker() -> None:
            while todo:
                example = todo.popleft()
                t0 = time.perf_counter()
                try:
                    pred, timing = await call_once(client, run, example.text)
                except LlmUnreachable as exc:
                    raise RunAborted(f"{run.model} {run.name}: {exc.message}") from exc
                except VtError as exc:
                    wall = {"wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000}
                    cache.append(example.id, example.label, error=_pred_error(exc), t=wall)
                    progress.tick(error=True)
                else:
                    cache.append(example.id, example.label, pred=pred, t=timing)
                    progress.tick(error=False)

        if todo:
            await _pool(min(concurrency, len(todo)), worker)
        progress.emit(final=True)
        return RunStats(cache.key, cache.path, len(examples), cached, progress.called, progress.errors)
"""Signal metrics: bullish/bearish calls are the positives; neutral and abstain are the safe default."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from typing import Any

import numpy as np
from numpy.typing import NDArray

from veritrade.inference.types import SENTIMENTS, Sentiment

DIRECTIONAL: tuple[Sentiment, Sentiment] = ("bullish", "bearish")
CONFUSION_COLUMNS = ("bullish", "bearish", "neutral", "abstain")
BETA = 0.5
INVERSION_CAP = 0.02
HEADLINE = ("f05_macro", "inversion_rate", "coverage", "signal_rate", "accuracy")
BOOTSTRAP_SEED = 20261018

FloatArray = NDArray[np.float64]
IndexArray = NDArray[np.intp]


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ClassScores:
    precision: float
    recall: float
    f05: float
    calls: float
    support: float


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SignalMetrics:
    """Rates are prevalence-weighted when weights are given; `confusion` is raw counts (gold x columns)."""

    n: int
    per_class: dict[str, ClassScores]
    f05_macro: float
    inversion_rate: float
    coverage: float
    signal_rate: float
    accuracy: float
    selective_accuracy: float
    confusion: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return asdict(self)


def _div(num: float, den: float) -> float:
    # Zero calls or zero support score 0 (not NaN): "always neutral" cannot look good and JSON stays strict.
    return float(num / den) if den > 0 else 0.0


def fbeta(precision: float, recall: float, beta: float = BETA) -> float:
    b2 = beta * beta
    den = b2 * precision + recall
    return (1 + b2) * precision * recall / den if den > 0 else 0.0


def _labels(values: Sequence[str], what: str) -> NDArray[np.str_]:
    arr = np.asarray(list(values), dtype=np.str_)
    unknown = set(arr.tolist()) - set(SENTIMENTS)
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown {what} labels: {sorted(unknown)}")
    return arr


def _weights(weights: Sequence[float] | None, n: int) -> FloatArray:
    if weights is None:
        return np.ones(n, dtype=np.float64)
    w = np.asarray(weights, dtype=np.float64)
    if w.shape != (n,) or (w < 0).any() or w.sum() <= 0:
        raise ValueError("weights must be one non-negative value per example with a positive sum")
    return w

            cells,
            examples,
            concurrency=args.concurrency,
            preds_root=args.preds_root,
            manifest_path=args.manifest,
        )
    done = sum(e["done"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    errors = sum(e["errors"] for e in manifest["cells"].values())
    print(
        f"grid: {len(manifest['cells'])} cells in the manifest, {done} predictions, {errors} errors",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )
    return 0


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    return asyncio.run(_run(args))


def cmd_analyze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    paths = analyze_grid(
        n_boot=args.n_boot, preds_root=args.preds_root, manifest_path=args.manifest, out_dir=args.out_dir
    )
    for path in paths:
        print(path)
    return 0 if paths else 1


def add_parser(subparsers: Any) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Registers `grid` on a parent CLI; dispatch with `run(args)`."""
    grid: argparse.ArgumentParser = subparsers.add_parser("grid", help="lean prompt x knob grid on dev300")
    actions = grid.add_subparsers(dest="grid_action", required=True)

    listing = actions.add_parser("list", help="print the grid configs")
    listing.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    listing.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_list)

    running = actions.add_parser("run", help="run (or resume) the grid against Ollama")
    running.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    running.add_argument("--concurrency", type=int, default=DEFAULT_CONCURRENCY)
    running.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="first N dev300 examples only (smoke runs)")
    running.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="Ollama URL (default from settings)")
    running.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    running.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    running.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_run)

    analyzing = actions.add_parser("analyze", help="score cached predictions and write evals/results/grid")
    analyzing.add_argument("--n-boot", type=int, default=1000)
    analyzing.add_argument("--preds-root", type=Path, default=PREDS_DIR)
    analyzing.add_argument("--manifest", type=Path, default=MANIFEST)
    analyzing.add_argument("--out-dir", type=Path, default=GRID_DIR)
    analyzing.set_defaults(grid_func=cmd_analyze)
    return grid


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    code: int = args.grid_func(args)
    return code


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals.grid", description=__doc__)
    add_parser(parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    return run(parser.parse_args(["grid", *(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from functools import cache
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from veritrade.inference.types import FieldOrder, Sentiment

Score = Literal[-2, -1, 0, 1, 2]


class _Out(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class LabelOut(_Out):
    label: Sentiment


class OrdinalOut(_Out):
    score: Score


class SummaryOut(_Out):
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)


class AnalyzeSentimentFirst(_Out):
    score: Score
    entity: str
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)


class AnalyzeSummaryFirst(_Out):
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)
    entity: str
    score: Score


AnalyzeOut = AnalyzeSentimentFirst | AnalyzeSummaryFirst
StructuredOut = LabelOut | OrdinalOut | SummaryOut | AnalyzeSentimentFirst | AnalyzeSummaryFirst

ANALYZE_MODELS: dict[FieldOrder, type[AnalyzeSentimentFirst] | type[AnalyzeSummaryFirst]] = {
    "sentiment-first": AnalyzeSentimentFirst,
    "summary-first": AnalyzeSummaryFirst,
}


def _strip(node: Any) -> Any:
    # Titles and descriptions only cost grammar states; the prompt carries the semantics.
    if isinstance(node, dict):
        return {k: _strip(v) for k, v in node.items() if k not in ("title", "description")}
    if isinstance(node, list):
        return [_strip(v) for v in node]
    return node


@cache
def _format_cached(model: type[BaseModel]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    schema = _strip(model.model_json_schema())
    schema["additionalProperties"] = False
    schema["required"] = list(model.model_fields)
    return dict(schema)


def ollama_format(model: type[BaseModel]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """JSON schema for Ollama's `format`; `properties` keeps the model's field order."""
    return copy.deepcopy(_format_cached(model))


def score_sentiment(score: int) -> Sentiment:
    return "bullish" if score > 0 else "bearish" if score < 0 else "neutral"

"""/summary: a short summary of the full article, as one JSON body or as streamed deltas."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import SummaryDeltaEvent, SummaryDoneEvent, SummaryRequest, SummaryResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import SummaryResult, summarize, summarize_stream
from veritrade.inference.incremental import SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, Prepared, StreamPayload, cached_meta_event, inference_timings
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "summary", request, scope="full", clock=clock)


async def run_summary(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SummaryResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await summarize(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_summary_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = summarize_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case SummaryResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: SummaryResponse) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: SummaryResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> SummaryResponse:
    return SummaryResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        truncated=result.truncated,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ArticleMeta,
    CacheInfo,
    ErrorEvent,
    InferenceTimings,
    MetaEvent,
    SentimentEvent,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SignalResult,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
    SummaryDoneEvent,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
    Timings,
)
from veritrade.extract.scope import build_input
from veritrade.extract.types import Scope
from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade.services.article import LoadedArticle, load_article
from veritrade.services.cache import ResultKey
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

ArticleRequest = SignalRequest | SummaryRequest | AnalyzeRequest
StreamPayload = (
    MetaEvent | SentimentEvent | SummaryDeltaEvent | SummaryDoneEvent | AnalyzeDoneEvent | ErrorEvent
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Job:
    """A request with its model and prompt resolved; nothing has touched the network yet."""

    runtime: Runtime
    endpoint: Endpoint
    request: ArticleRequest
    url: str
    scope: Scope
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    key: ResultKey | None
    clock: StageTimer

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls, runtime: Runtime, endpoint: Endpoint, request: ArticleRequest, *, scope: Scope, clock: StageTimer
    ) -> Job:
        spec = runtime.registry.resolve(endpoint, request.model)
        prompt = runtime.prompt(endpoint, spec)
        url = str(request.url)
        key = None
        if not request.no_cache:
            key = ResultKey(
                endpoint=endpoint,
                url=normalize_url(url),
                model=spec.name,
                prompt_version=prompt.version,
                parser=request.parser,
                extractor=request.extractor,
                scope=scope,
            )
        return cls(runtime, endpoint, request, url, scope, spec, prompt, key, clock)

    def cached[R: (SignalResponse, SummaryResponse, AnalyzeResponse)](self, kind: type[R]) -> R | None:
        """The stored response marked as cached, with timings that describe this request."""
        hit = self.runtime.results.get(self.key) if self.key is not None else None
        if not isinstance(hit, kind):
            return None
        # A result hit runs no stage, so stage timings are zero and the article counts as a fetch hit.
        timings = Timings(
            total_ms=self.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=0.0,
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch="hit", result="hit"),
        )
        meta = hit.meta.model_copy(update={"cached": True})
        return hit.model_copy(update={"meta": meta, "timings": timings})

    def remember(self, response: SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> None:
        if self.key is not None:
            self.runtime.results.put(self.key, response)

    async def prepare(self) -> Prepared:
        loaded = await load_article(
            self.runtime,
            self.url,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            no_cache=self.request.no_cache,
        )
        text = build_input(loaded.article, self.scope, self.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return Prepared(
            job=self,
            loaded=loaded,
            text=text,
            meta=self._meta(loaded, text),
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch=loaded.fetch_status, result="bypass" if self.key is None else "miss"),
        )

    def _meta(self, loaded: LoadedArticle, text: str) -> ArticleMeta:
        article = loaded.article
        return ArticleMeta(
            url=self.url,
            final_url=loaded.page.final_url,
            title=article.title,
            source=article.source,
            published_at=article.published_at,
            endpoint=self.endpoint,
            model=self.spec.name,
            model_kind=self.spec.kind,
            prompt_version=self.prompt.version,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            extraction_method=article.method,
            scope=self.scope,
            input_chars=len(text),
            word_count=article.word_count,
            field_order=self.spec.field_order if self.endpoint == "analyze" else None,
            cached=False,
            backend=self.runtime.settings.ollama_backend_label,
        )

async def load_article(
    runtime: Runtime, url: str, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName, no_cache: bool
) -> LoadedArticle:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    status: FetchStatus
    if no_cache:
        page, status = await runtime.fetcher.get(url), "bypass"
    else:
        fetch = partial(runtime.fetcher.get, url)
        shared = await runtime.fetch_cache.get_or_create(normalize_url(url), fetch)
        page, status = shared.value, shared.status
    if status in ("miss", "bypass"):
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = page.fetch_ms, page.consent_ms
    else:
        # A hit or join reports this request's own wait, not the download it reused.
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, None
    article = await extract_article(page, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    return LoadedArticle(page, article, status, fetch_ms, consent_ms)


async def extract_article(page: FetchResult, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName) -> Article:
    run = partial(extract, page.html, page.final_url, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    if extractor in PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS and parser in INLINE_PARSERS:
        return run()
    return await asyncio.to_thread(run)
    extractor: ExtractorName = "cascade"
    no_cache: bool = Field(False, description="Bypass fetch and result caches (used by latency benchmarks).")

def resolve_ids(candidates: Sequence[Candidate], ids: Sequence[str]) -> list[Candidate]:

def test_finalize_ignores_articles_outside_the_window(paths: ArticlePaths) -> None:
    seed_pool(paths, per_cell=3)

def test_finalize_fails_loudly_with_a_shortfall(paths: ArticlePaths) -> None:
    for source in SOURCES:
        for label in SENTIMENTS:
            seed(paths, f"art-{source}{label}", source, label)
    ingest_all(paths)
    with pytest.raises(ShortfallError, match="eligible, at least 2 needed"):
        finalize(build_ledger(paths), SOURCES)


def test_verify_and_loader_catch_drift(paths: ArticlePaths) -> None:
    seed_pool(paths, per_cell=3)
    write_finalized(finalize(build_ledger(paths), SOURCES), paths)
    assert all(not problems for _, problems in verify(paths))
    dev = load_articles("dev", paths=paths)
    assert len(dev) == 9
    assert dev[0].gold_text == paths.gold(dev[0].id).read_text()
    assert len(load_articles("all", paths=paths)) == 27
    paths.gold(dev[0].id).write_text("edited")
    paths.html(dev[1].id).unlink()
    found = dict(verify(paths))
    assert found[dev[0].id] == ["gold_drifted"]
    assert found[dev[1].id] == ["html_missing"]
    with pytest.raises(ArticlesError, match="missing or drifted"):
        load_articles("dev", paths=paths)

def test_committed_output_carries_no_publisher_text(paths: ArticlePaths) -> None:
    seed_pool(paths, per_cell=3)
    result = finalize(build_ledger(paths), SOURCES)
    write_finalized(result, paths)
    committed = paths.rows.read_text() + paths.stats.read_text()
    for row in result.rows:
        lines = json.loads(paths.lines(row.id).read_text())["lines"]
        assert lines[1] not in committed
        assert all(line not in committed for line in lines[2:])

def _ranges(output: GoldOutput, n_lines: int) -> list[str]:
    codes: list[str] = []
    ranges = sorted(output.body_ranges)
    for start, end in ranges:
        if start > end:
            codes.append("range_inverted")
        elif start < 1 or end > n_lines:
            codes.append("range_out_of_bounds")
    if any(later[0] <= earlier[1] for earlier, later in pairwise(ranges)):
        codes.append("ranges_overlap")
    title = output.title_line
    if title is not None and not 1 <= title <= n_lines:
        codes.append("title_out_of_bounds")
    elif title is not None and any(start <= title <= end for start, end in ranges):
        codes.append("title_in_body")
    return sorted(set(codes))


def _key_facts(facts: Sequence[str], body: str) -> list[str]:
    codes: set[str] = set()
    if not KEY_FACTS_MIN <= len(facts) <= KEY_FACTS_MAX:
        codes.add("key_facts_count")
    grounded = number_set(body)
    body_runs = shingles(body)
    for fact in facts:
        if not fact.strip():
            codes.add("key_fact_empty")
        if word_count(fact) > KEY_FACT_MAX_WORDS:
            codes.add("key_fact_too_long")
        if not number_set(fact) <= grounded:
            codes.add("key_fact_number_ungrounded")
        if shares_run(fact, body_runs):
            codes.add("key_fact_verbatim")
    return sorted(codes)

def ingest(paths: ArticlePaths, stage: Stage, source: str | None = None) -> IngestReport:
    """Validate one stage's outputs; gold writes bodies, label stages refresh the adjudication list."""
    results: list[Ingested] = []
    requested = adjudicate_requested(paths)
    for article in _output_ids(paths, stage, source):
        if stage == "gold":
            check = gold_check(paths, article)
            gold_path = paths.gold(article)
            if check.usable and check.body is not None and check.output is not None:
                gold_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                gold_path.write_text(check.body, encoding="utf-8")
                note = f"usable provisional={check.output.provisional_label} words={word_count(check.body)}"
            else:
                gold_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                reason = check.output.reject_reason if check.output is not None else None
                note = f"rejected:{reason}" if check.ok else ""
            results.append(Ingested(article, check.ok, check.codes, note))
        elif stage == "adjudicate":
            adjudicated = adjudicate_check(paths, article, requested)
            decision = adjudicated.output.decision if adjudicated.output is not None else ""
            results.append(Ingested(article, adjudicated.ok, adjudicated.codes, decision))

"""Checks on agent outputs: schema, line ranges, grounded numbers, no verbatim runs, label agreement."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from itertools import pairwise
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import ValidationError

from veritrade.inference.types import SENTIMENTS, Sentiment
from veritrade_evals.articles import (
    KEY_FACT_MAX_WORDS,
    KEY_FACTS_MAX,
    KEY_FACTS_MIN,
    MIN_BODY_WORDS,
    RATIONALE_MAX_WORDS,
    SHINGLE_WORDS,
    AdjudicateOutput,
    ArticlePaths,
    GoldOutput,
    LabelOutput,
    Stage,
    read_fetched,
    schema_codes,
)

_NUMBER = re.compile(r"\d+(?:[.,]\d+)*")
_WORD = re.compile(r"[a-z0-9]+")


def word_count(text: str) -> int:
    return len(text.split())


def number_set(text: str) -> set[str]:
    """Numbers as canonical decimals: thousands commas dropped, 1.50 == 1.5."""
    out: set[str] = set()
    for match in _NUMBER.finditer(text):
        raw = match.group(0).replace(",", "")
        try:
            out.add(format(Decimal(raw).normalize(), "f"))
        except InvalidOperation:
            out.add(raw)
    return out


def shingles(text: str, n: int = SHINGLE_WORDS) -> set[tuple[str, ...]]:
    tokens = _WORD.findall(text.lower())
    return {tuple(tokens[i : i + n]) for i in range(len(tokens) - n + 1)}


def shares_run(text: str, body_shingles: set[tuple[str, ...]], n: int = SHINGLE_WORDS) -> bool:
    return not shingles(text, n).isdisjoint(body_shingles)


def score_matches(label: Sentiment, score: int) -> bool:
    return (score > 0) if label == "bullish" else (score < 0) if label == "bearish" else score == 0


# --- gold -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class GoldCheck:
    id: str
    output: GoldOutput | None
    codes: tuple[str, ...]
    body: str | None = None
    title: str | None = None

    @property
    def ok(self) -> bool:
        return self.output is not None and not self.codes

    @property
    def usable(self) -> bool:
        return self.ok and self.output is not None and self.output.usable



def check_gold(article: str, raw: str | None, lines: Sequence[str] | None) -> GoldCheck:
    if raw is None:
        return GoldCheck(article, None, ("missing_output",))
    try:
        output = GoldOutput.model_validate_json(raw)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        return GoldCheck(article, None, tuple(schema_codes(exc)))
    codes: list[str] = ["id_mismatch"] if output.id != article else []
    if not output.usable:
        if output.reject_reason is None:
            codes.append("missing:reject_reason")
        return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(codes))
    if lines is None:
        return GoldCheck(article, output, (*codes, "missing_packet_lines"))
    for name in ("title_line", "entity", "provisional_label"):
        value = getattr(output, name)
        if value is None or (isinstance(value, str) and not value.strip()):
            codes.append(f"missing:{name}")
    if not output.body_ranges:
        codes.append("missing:body_ranges")
    if codes:
        return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(codes))
    if range_codes := _ranges(output, len(lines)):
        return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(range_codes))
    body = "\n\n".join(
        lines[i - 1] for start, end in sorted(output.body_ranges) for i in range(start, end + 1)
    )
    if word_count(body) < MIN_BODY_WORDS:
        codes.append("body_too_short")
    codes += _key_facts(output.key_facts, body)
    title = lines[output.title_line - 1] if output.title_line else None
    return GoldCheck(article, output, tuple(codes), body=body, title=title)


def load_lines(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> list[str] | None:
    path = paths.lines(article)
    if not path.exists():
        return None
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return [str(line) for line in payload["lines"]]


def _read(path: Path) -> str | None:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if path.exists() else None


def gold_check(paths: ArticlePaths, article: str) -> GoldCheck:
    return check_gold(article, _read(paths.out("gold", article)), load_lines(paths, article))


# --- labels and adjudication ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
        total += size
    all_words = sum(len(p.split()) for p in paragraphs)
    return kept, all_words - total


def label_body(title: str, body: str) -> list[str]:
    paragraphs = [p for p in body.split("\n\n") if p.strip()]
    kept, omitted = cap_paragraphs(paragraphs)
    lines = ["## Title", "", title, "", "## Article", ""]
    for paragraph in kept:
        lines += [paragraph, ""]
    if omitted:
        lines += [f"[{omitted} more words of the article are not shown]", ""]
    return lines


def render_label(article: str, title: str, body: str, paths: ArticlePaths) -> str:
    header = [
        f"# Label packet {article}",
        "",
        f"- id: {article}",
        f"- follow: {rel(PROMPTS['label'])}",
        f"- labeller A writes: {rel(paths.out('label_a', article))}",
        f"- labeller B writes: {rel(paths.out('label_b', article))}",
        "",
    ]

@pytest.fixture
def paths(tmp_path: Path) -> ArticlePaths:
    return ArticlePaths(private=tmp_path / "private", committed=tmp_path / "committed")


def body_lines(tag: str) -> list[str]:
    return [
        f"{tag} sentence {n} reports that the {tag} unit shipped {n * 11} crates while costs held near "
        f"{n * 3} percent overall"
        for n in range(1, 8)
    ]


def seed(
    paths: ArticlePaths,
    article: str,
    source: str,
    label: Sentiment,
    *,
    b_label: Sentiment | None = None,
    ambiguous: bool = False,
    title: str | None = None,
    published: str = "2026-10-01",
) -> None:
    html = f"<html><body>{article}</body></html>".encode()
    paths.html(article).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    paths.html(article).write_bytes(html)
    from veritrade_evals.articles import sha256_bytes

    record = FetchRecord(
        id=article,
        source=source,
        url=f"https://{source}.example.com/{article}",
        fetched_at="2026-10-18T09:00:00+00:00",
        status=200,
        html_sha256=sha256_bytes(html),
        words=150,
        method="profile",
        published_date=published,
        published_from="page",
    )
    write_json(paths.fetched(article), record.model_dump())
    lines = ["Menu", title or f"{article} headline about {label} news", *body_lines(article)]
    write_json(paths.lines(article), {"id": article, "lines": lines})
    gold = {
        "id": article,
        "usable": True,
        "title_line": 2,
        "body_ranges": [[3, 9]],
        "key_facts": [
            "The unit shipped 77 crates.",
            "Costs held near 21 percent.",
            "Shipments began at 11 crates.",
        ],
        "entity": f"{source} holdings",
        "ticker": None,
        "provisional_label": label,
    }
    write_json(paths.out("gold", article), gold)
    for stage, value, flag in (("label_a", label, False), ("label_b", b_label or label, ambiguous)):
        write_json(
            paths.out(stage, article),  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            {
                "id": article,
                "label": value,
                "score": SCORES[value],
                "entity": f"{source} holdings",
                "ticker": "ABC" if stage == "label_b" else None,
                "rationale": f"The news points {value} for the company in our reading.",
                "ambiguous": flag,
                "confidence": 4,
            },
        )

        "load_duration": 1_000_000,
        "prompt_eval_count": 300,
        "prompt_eval_duration": 80_000_000,
        "eval_count": 7,
        "eval_duration": 40_000_000,
    }
    if logprobs is not None:
        body["logprobs"] = logprobs
    return body


def label_logprobs(first: str, alternatives: Sequence[tuple[str, float]], rest: Sequence[str]) -> list[Any]:
    return [*plain(['{"', "label", '":', ' "']), lp(first, alternatives[0][1], alternatives), *plain(rest)]


def decision_body(probs: dict[Sentiment, float], choice: Sentiment = "bullish") -> dict[str, Any]:
    answer = {"type": "choice", "choice": choice, "probabilities": probs, "confidence": 0.5}
    return {"model": DECISION, "answers": {"sentiment": answer}, "usage": {"input_tokens": 210}}


def ndjson(pieces: Sequence[str], *, hang_after: int | None = None) -> httpx.Response:
    chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        {"model": "m", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": p}, "done": False} for p in pieces
    ]
    chunks.append(chat_body("") | {"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": ""}})

    async def lines() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        for i, chunk in enumerate(chunks):
            if i == hang_after:
                await asyncio.sleep(5)
            yield (json.dumps(chunk) + "\n").encode()

    return httpx.Response(200, content=lines(), headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})


# --- raw outputs per model kind --------------------------------------------------------------


async def test_decision_keeps_normalised_probabilities(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    mock_ollama.post("/v1/systemone").respond(
        json=decision_body({"neutral": 0.2, "bullish": 0.6, "bearish": 0.2}, choice="bullish")
    )
    pred, t = await call_once(client, cell(DECISION, "decision"), "Zentor Mills beats estimates")
    assert pred["kind"] == "decision"
    assert pred["choice"] == "bullish"
    assert pred["probs"] == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.2, "bullish": 0.6, "bearish": 0.2})
    assert pred["model_confidence"] == 0.5
    assert t["prompt_tokens"] == 210
    assert t["wall_ms"] > 0


async def test_label_keeps_first_token_probabilities_and_ollama_timings(
    client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter
) -> None:
    logprobs = label_logprobs("bull", [("bull", 0.6), ("neutral", 0.3), ("bear", 0.1)], ["ish", '"}'])
    route = mock_ollama.post("/api/chat").respond(json=chat_body('{"label": "bullish"}', logprobs))
    pred, t = await call_once(client, cell(SMALL, "label"), "Zentor Mills beats estimates")
    assert route.call_count == 1

class VtError(Exception):
    code: ClassVar[ErrorCode]
    retryable_default: ClassVar[bool] = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        hint: str | None = None,
        retryable: bool | None = None,
        upstream_status: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.hint = hint
        self.retryable = self.retryable_default if retryable is None else retryable
        self.upstream_status = upstream_status

from veritrade_evals.splits import Split, SplitError, SplitName


@pytest.mark.parametrize("command", sorted(cli.PLANNED))
def test_planned_commands_exit_cleanly(command: str, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]) -> None:

    assert "not implemented yet" in capsys.readouterr().err


def test_splits_verify_fails_when_any_split_fails(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str]
) -> None:
    def fake_load(name: SplitName) -> Split:
        if name == "fpb_allagree":
            raise SplitError("fpb_allagree: 1 bad rows")
        return Split(name, (Example("x:0", "t", "bullish", "tfns", "train"),))

    monkeypatch.setattr(cli, "load_split", fake_load)
    assert cli.main(["splits", "verify"]) == 1
    out = capsys.readouterr()

"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    backend_tests = "backend/tests" if full else "backend/tests/unit"
    tests = [backend_tests, "evals/tests", "scripts/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true", help="unit tests only, no build (default)")
    mode.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="integration tests, coverage floor, build")
    parser.add_argument("--backend", action="store_true", help="only backend + evals")
    parser.add_argument("--frontend", action="store_true", help="only frontend")
    args = parser.parse_args()

"""Opus-as-judge for summaries: blind packets, the output contract of 50-judge.md, validation, de-blinding.

Packets, the blinding map and judge outputs derive from publisher text, so they stay under
evals/data/private/summary/judge; only de-blinded numbers flow into the committed metrics.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import random
import re
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, ValidationError

from veritrade_evals.articles import SEED, rel, schema_codes
from veritrade_evals.articles_validate import shares_run, shingles, word_count
from veritrade_evals.paths import OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR

JUDGE_PROMPT = OPUS_PROMPTS_DIR / "50-judge.md"
HALLUCINATION_MAX_WORDS = 25
LABEL = re.compile(r"S[1-9][0-9]*")


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class JudgePaths:
    root: Path

    def packet(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.root / "packets" / f"{article}.md"

    def blinding(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.root / "blinding" / f"{article}.json"

    def out(self, article: str) -> Path:
        return self.root / "out" / f"{article}.json"

    def packet_list(self, split: str) -> Path:
        return self.root / f"packets_{split}.txt"

    def ingested(self, split: str) -> Path:
        return self.root / "ingested" / f"{split}.jsonl"


class _Model(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class JudgedSummary(_Model):
    label: str
    faithfulness: int = Field(ge=1, le=5)
    coverage: int = Field(ge=1, le=5)
    hallucinations: list[str]
    leads_with_market_moving_fact: bool


class JudgeOutput(_Model):
    id: str
    summaries: list[JudgedSummary]


class Blinding(_Model):
    """Which candidate hides behind each label, and a hash of the text the judge saw."""

    id: str
    split: str
    labels: dict[str, str]
    summary_sha: dict[str, str]


class JudgeRow(_Model):
    id: str
    candidate: str
    faithfulness: int
    coverage: int
    hallucinations: int
    leads: bool


def text_sha(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def blind(article: str, candidates: Sequence[str], seed: int = SEED) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Label -> candidate; depends only on the seed, the article and the candidate set, not on their order."""
    keys = sorted(set(candidates))
    digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{seed}:{article}".encode()).digest()
    random.Random(int.from_bytes(digest[:8], "big")).shuffle(keys)
    return {f"S{i}": key for i, key in enumerate(keys, start=1)}


def make_blinding(article: str, split: str, summaries: Mapping[str, str], seed: int = SEED) -> Blinding:
    labels = blind(article, list(summaries), seed)
    shas = {label: text_sha(summaries[key]) for label, key in labels.items()}
    return Blinding(id=article, split=split, labels=labels, summary_sha=shas)


def render_packet(
    blinding: Blinding, title: str, body: str, summaries: Mapping[str, str], out: Path
) -> str:
    """`summaries` is keyed by candidate; the packet shows them only under their labels."""
    labels = list(blinding.labels)
    lines = [
        f"# Judge packet {blinding.id}",
        "",
        f"- id: {blinding.id}",
        f"- follow: {rel(JUDGE_PROMPT)}",
        f"- candidate summaries: {', '.join(labels)}",
        f"- write your output to: {rel(out)}",
        "",
        "## Title",
        "",
        title,
        "",
        "## Article",
        "",
    ]
    for paragraph in body.split("\n\n"):
        if paragraph.strip():
            lines += [paragraph.strip(), ""]
    lines += ["## Candidate summaries", ""]
    for label in labels:
        lines += [f"### {label}", "", summaries[blinding.labels[label]].strip(), ""]
    return "\n".join(lines)


# --- validation ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _label_codes(output: JudgeOutput, expected: Sequence[str]) -> list[str]:
    seen = Counter(s.label for s in output.summaries)
    codes = [f"{label}:duplicate_label" for label, count in seen.items() if count > 1]
    codes += [f"{label}:unknown_label" for label in seen if label not in expected]
    codes += [f"{label}:missing_label" for label in expected if label not in seen]
    return codes


def _summary_codes(judged: JudgedSummary, runs: set[tuple[str, ...]]) -> list[str]:
    codes: list[str] = []
    for note in judged.hallucinations:
        if not note.strip():
            codes.append("hallucination_empty")
        elif word_count(note) > HALLUCINATION_MAX_WORDS:
            codes.append("hallucination_too_long")
        if shares_run(note, runs):
            codes.append("hallucination_verbatim")
    if judged.faithfulness == 5 and judged.hallucinations:
        codes.append("faithfulness_5_with_hallucinations")
    if judged.faithfulness <= 3 and not judged.hallucinations:
        codes.append("low_faithfulness_without_hallucinations")
    return [f"{judged.label}:{code}" for code in sorted(set(codes))]


def check_output(
    raw: str | None,
    blinding: Blinding,
    *,
    article_text: str,
    summaries: Mapping[str, str],
) -> tuple[JudgeOutput | None, tuple[str, ...]]:
    """Schema, label set, own-words notes and score/notes consistency; `summaries` keyed by candidate."""
    if raw is None:
        return None, ("missing_output",)
    try:
        output = JudgeOutput.model_validate_json(raw)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        return None, tuple(schema_codes(exc))
    codes = ["id_mismatch"] if output.id != blinding.id else []
    codes += _label_codes(output, list(blinding.labels))
    for label, key in blinding.labels.items():
        current = summaries.get(key)
        if current is None or text_sha(current) != blinding.summary_sha[label]:
            codes.append(f"{label}:stale_summary")
    runs = shingles(article_text)
    for text in summaries.values():
        runs |= shingles(text)
    for judged in output.summaries:
        if LABEL.fullmatch(judged.label) and judged.label in blinding.labels:
            codes += _summary_codes(judged, runs)
    return output, tuple(codes)


def deblind(output: JudgeOutput, blinding: Blinding) -> list[JudgeRow]:
    return [
        JudgeRow(
            id=output.id,
            candidate=blinding.labels[judged.label],
            faithfulness=judged.faithfulness,
            coverage=judged.coverage,
            hallucinations=len(judged.hallucinations),
            leads=judged.leads_with_market_moving_fact,
        )
        for judged in output.summaries
    ]

"""Summary evaluation (R6) on the Opus article set: `uv run python -m veritrade_evals.summary_eval <cmd>`.

generate -> score -> spot-check -> judge-prepare -> (Opus judges) -> judge-check / judge-ingest -> report.
Summaries are produced by the serving path on the stored HTML. Generated text, judge packets and judge outputs

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse

SummaryEndpoint = Literal["summary", "analyze"]
SUMMARY_ENDPOINTS: tuple[SummaryEndpoint, ...] = get_args(SummaryEndpoint)
SPLITS: tuple[ArticleSplit, ...] = get_args(ArticleSplit)

# Part of every cache key: bump when generation changes what it records for an unchanged config.
HARNESS_VERSION = "1"
PARSER: ParserName = "selectolax"
EXTRACTOR: ExtractorName = "cascade"
SCOPE: Scope = "full"
MAX_WORDS = 60
MAX_SENTENCES = 3
