```
    "decision": ("probability", "probability+tau"),
    "label": ("label-logprob", "label-logprob+tau"),
    "ordinal": ("ordinal",),
    "sentiment-first": ("ordinal",),
    "summary-first": ("ordinal",),
}


def is_tau(policy: EvalPolicy) -> TypeIs[TauPolicy]:
    return policy in TAU_BASE


# Keyword heuristics for error analysis; the first match wins and nothing but the bucket name leaves.
BUCKETS: tuple[tuple[str, re.Pattern[str]], ...] = (
    (
        "analyst action",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(upgrade\w*|downgrade\w*|price target|target price|pt|initiat\w*|reiterat\w*|outperform|"
            r"underperform|overweight|underweight|equal[- ]weight|market perform|sector perform|"
            r"buy rating|sell rating|hold rating|rating)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "earnings / guidance",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(earnings|eps|revenue|revenues|sales|results|quarter\w*|q[1-4]|fy\d*|guidance|forecasts?|"
            r"outlook|profits?|loss(es)?|beats?|miss(es)?|dividend\w*)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "price move",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(ris(e|es|ing)|rose|jump\w*|surg\w*|soar\w*|rall\w*|gain\w*|climb\w*|fall(s|ing)?|fell|"
            r"drop\w*|slump\w*|sink\w*|sank|slid\w*|tumbl\w*|plung\w*|higher|lower|up|down)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
    (
        "macro / markets",
        re.compile(
            r"\b(fed|inflation|rates?|treasur\w*|yields?|gdp|jobs|payrolls|unemployment|oil|dollar|"
            r"econom\w*|recession|cpi|ecb|tariffs?|stocks|markets?|futures|dow|nasdaq|s&p)\b",
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ),
    ),
)
OTHER_BUCKET = "other"
BUCKET_NAMES: tuple[str, ...] = (*(name for name, _ in BUCKETS), OTHER_BUCKET)


def bucket_of(text: str) -> str:
    for name, pattern in BUCKETS:
        if pattern.search(text):
            return name
    return OTHER_BUCKET


# --- policy replay ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _ordinal(score: int) -> tuple[Sentiment, float]:
    # A zero score is a confident neutral, never an abstention.
    label = score_sentiment(score)
    return label, math.inf if label == "neutral" else float(abs(score))


def replay(policy: PolicyName, record: Record | None, *, ordinal_t: int = 1) -> tuple[Sentiment, float]:
    """(raw class, confidence) as the serving policy sees one cached output; the row abstains when the
    confidence is below the threshold, so failed or missing calls (-inf) always abstain."""
    if record is None or record.get("error") is not None:
        return "neutral", -math.inf
    if policy == "ordinal":
        return _ordinal(int(record["score"]))
    probs = record.get("sign_probs") if record.get("kind") == "ordinal" else record.get("probs")
    if probs:
        p = normalise(cast(Mapping[Sentiment, float], probs))
        top = winner(p)
        return top, p[top]
    if policy == "probability" or record.get("score") is None:
        raise ValueError(f"record {record.get('id')!r} has no probabilities for {policy}")
    # Serving ends the fallback chain at the ordinal policy with the model's frozen t.
    label, confidence = _ordinal(int(record["score"]))
    return label, math.inf if confidence >= ordinal_t else -math.inf


def replay_tau(record: Record | None, *, ordinal_t: int = 1) -> tuple[Sentiment, float]:
    """The served directional_tau rule at min_p 0: a leading directional class is always called (inf); while
    neutral leads, the likelier directional class carries its probability and is served neutral below tau.
    Failed calls and ordinal-fallback abstentions (-inf) abstain."""
    if record is None or record.get("error") is not None:
        return "neutral", -math.inf
    if probs := record.get("probs"):
        p = normalise(cast(Mapping[Sentiment, float], probs))
        top = winner(p)
        if top != "neutral":
            return top, math.inf
        side: Sentiment = "bullish" if p["bullish"] >= p["bearish"] else "bearish"
        return side, p[side]
    if record.get("score") is None:
        raise ValueError(f"record {record.get('id')!r} has neither probabilities nor a score")
    label, confidence = _ordinal(int(record["score"]))
    return label, math.inf if confidence >= ordinal_t else -math.inf


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PolicyEval:
    policy: EvalPolicy
    labels: tuple[Sentiment, ...]
    confidences: tuple[float, ...]
    sweep: tuple[SweepPoint, ...] = ()

    @property
    def default(self) -> SweepPoint:
        return self.sweep[0]

    @property
    def operating(self) -> SweepPoint | None:
        return select_operating_point(self.sweep)

    def served(self, threshold: float) -> tuple[list[Sentiment], list[bool]]:
        """(class, abstained) per row; below tau a row is served neutral, below min_p or t it abstains."""
        if not is_tau(self.policy):
            return list(self.labels), [not c >= threshold for c in self.confidences]
        rows = zip(self.labels, self.confidences, strict=True)
        return [label if c >= threshold else "neutral" for label, c in rows], [
            c == -math.inf for c in self.confidences
        ]


def evaluate_policy(
    policy: EvalPolicy,
    records: Sequence[Record | None],
    gold: Sequence[Sentiment],
    weights: Sequence[float] | None,
    *,
    ordinal_t: int = 1,
) -> PolicyEval:
    if is_tau(policy):
        calls = [replay_tau(r, ordinal_t=ordinal_t) for r in records]
        thresholds = TAU_THRESHOLDS
    else:
        calls = [replay(policy, r, ordinal_t=ordinal_t) for r in records]
        thresholds = ORDINAL_THRESHOLDS if policy == "ordinal" else PROB_THRESHOLDS
    ev = PolicyEval(policy, tuple(label for label, _ in calls), tuple(c for _, c in calls))
    sweep = [SweepPoint(t, signal_metrics(gold, *ev.served(t), weights)) for t in sorted(set(thresholds))]
    return replace(ev, sweep=tuple(sweep))


# --- cells and candidates --------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DevSet:
    """Gold side of the split, aligned by position; buckets are keyword classes, never text."""

    ids: tuple[str, ...]
    gold: tuple[Sentiment, ...]
    weights: tuple[float, ...] | None
    buckets: tuple[str, ...] = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CellInput:
    endpoint: str
    model: str
    name: str
    variant: Variant
    prompt_version: str
    records: tuple[Record | None, ...]
    dims: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    ordinal_t: int = 1
    # A follow-up cell names the grid config it is paired against and never competes for the best one.
    against: str | None = None
    meta: Mapping[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Candidate:
    cell: CellInput
    evaluation: PolicyEval
    order: int

    @property
    def reads(self) -> str:
        """What the threshold is applied to."""
        if self.evaluation.policy == "ordinal":
            return "score value"
        if self.cell.variant == "decision":
            return "class probabilities"
        return "label tokens" if self.cell.variant == "label" else "score-sign tokens"


def candidates(cells: Sequence[CellInput], dev: DevSet) -> list[Candidate]:
    out: list[Candidate] = []
    for cell in cells:
        for policy in POLICIES[cell.variant]:
            evaluation = evaluate_policy(
                policy, cell.records, dev.gold, dev.weights, ordinal_t=cell.ordinal_t
            )
            out.append(Candidate(cell, evaluation, len(out)))
    return out


def best_candidate(cands: Sequence[Candidate]) -> tuple[Candidate, bool]:
    """Max F0.5 at each candidate's operating point; earlier (simpler) configs win exact ties. When no
    candidate meets the inversion cap, falls back to the best no-abstention F0.5 and says so."""
    if not cands:
        raise ValueError("no candidates")
    eligible = [(c, op) for c in cands if (op := c.evaluation.operating) is not None]
    if eligible:
        best, _ = max(
            eligible, key=lambda co: (round(co[1].f05_macro, 12), round(co[1].coverage, 12), -co[0].order)
        )
        return best, True
    return max(cands, key=lambda c: (round(c.evaluation.default.f05_macro, 12), -c.order)), False


def chosen_point(candidate: Candidate, cap_met: bool) -> SweepPoint:
    op = candidate.evaluation.operating
    return op if cap_met and op is not None else candidate.evaluation.default


# --- summaries -------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def point_row(point: SweepPoint) -> dict[str, float]:
    m = point.metrics
    return {
        "threshold": point.threshold,
        "f05_macro": m.f05_macro,
        "precision_bullish": m.per_class["bullish"].precision,
        "precision_bearish": m.per_class["bearish"].precision,
        "recall_bullish": m.per_class["bullish"].recall,
        "recall_bearish": m.per_class["bearish"].recall,
        "inversion_rate": m.inversion_rate,
        "coverage": m.coverage,
        "signal_rate": m.signal_rate,
        "risk": point.risk,
    }


def thin_sweep(sweep: Sequence[SweepPoint]) -> list[dict[str, float]]:
    """Drops points whose metrics equal the previous point's, keeping the lowest threshold of each run."""
    rows: list[dict[str, float]] = []
    previous: dict[str, float] | None = None
    for point in sweep:
        row = point_row(point)
        body = {k: v for k, v in row.items() if k != "threshold"}
        if body != previous:
            rows.append(row)
        previous = body
    return rows


def metrics_dict(metrics: SignalMetrics) -> dict[str, Any]:
    out = metrics.to_dict()
    out["confusion"] = {
        "rows_gold": ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral"],
        "columns_pred": ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral", "abstain"],
        "counts": [list(row) for row in metrics.confusion],
    }
    return out


def percentile(values: Sequence[float], q: float) -> float | None:
    return float(np.percentile(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64), q)) if values else None


def latency(records: Sequence[Record | None]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ok = [r for r in records if r is not None and r.get("error") is None]
    wall = [float(r["t"]["wall_ms"]) for r in ok if "wall_ms" in r.get("t", {})]
```

```
def candidate_cis(candidate: Candidate, point: SweepPoint, dev: DevSet, n_boot: int) -> dict[str, Any]:

    return ci_dict(headline_cis(dev.gold, pred, abstained, dev.weights, n_boot=n_boot))


def grid_only(cands: Sequence[Candidate]) -> list[Candidate]:

        "threshold": point.threshold,

KNOB_POLICIES: dict[str, EvalPolicy] = {"logprob": "label-logprob", "ordinal": "ordinal"}


def paired_f05(
    a: tuple[Candidate, SweepPoint], b: tuple[Candidate, SweepPoint], dev: DevSet, n_boot: int
) -> dict[str, ConfidenceInterval]:
    """F0.5 of a, of b and of a - b on shared resamples, so example difficulty cancels in the gap."""
    g = np.asarray(dev.gold, dtype=np.str_)
    w = None if dev.weights is None else np.asarray(dev.weights, dtype=np.float64)
    served = [
        (np.asarray(pred, dtype=np.str_), np.asarray(abstained))
        for pred, abstained in (c.evaluation.served(p.threshold) for c, p in (a, b))
    ]

    def f05(k: int, idx: IndexArray) -> float:
        pred, abstained = served[k]
        weights = None if w is None else w[idx].tolist()
        return signal_metrics(g[idx].tolist(), pred[idx].tolist(), abstained[idx].tolist(), weights).f05_macro

    def fn(idx: IndexArray) -> dict[str, float]:
        fa, fb = f05(0, idx), f05(1, idx)
        return {"a": fa, "b": fb, "gap": fa - fb}

    return bootstrap_cis(fn, dev.gold, n_boot=n_boot)


def _verdict(gap: ConfidenceInterval, a: str, b: str) -> str:
    return a if gap.low > 0 else b if gap.high < 0 else "tie"
```

```
class ManifestEntry(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    key: str
    model_digest: str
    prompt_version: str
    n: int
    done: int
    errors: int
    truncated: int
    updated_at: str


def read_manifest(paths: SummaryPaths) -> dict[str, dict[str, ManifestEntry]]:
    raw = read_json(paths.manifest) or {}
    return {
        split: {k: ManifestEntry.model_validate(v) for k, v in rows.items()} for split, rows in raw.items()
    }


def update_manifest(paths: SummaryPaths, split: str, pair: Pair, entry: ManifestEntry) -> None:
    manifest = read_manifest(paths)
    manifest.setdefault(split, {})[pair.key] = entry
    write_json(
        paths.manifest, {s: {k: e.model_dump() for k, e in rows.items()} for s, rows in manifest.items()}
    )


async def generate(
    client: OllamaClient,
    run: GenRun,
    articles: Sequence[EvalArticle],
    *,
    split: str,
    digest: str,
    paths: SummaryPaths,
    inputs: Callable[[EvalArticle, ModelSpec], str] = model_input,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> ManifestEntry:
    """Resumable and sequential; an unreachable Ollama aborts, other failures are recorded per article."""
    label = f"{run.pair.endpoint} {run.pair.model}"
    with run.cache(split, digest, paths.preds) as cache:
        done = cache.done_ids()
        todo = [a for a in articles if a.id not in done]
        print(f"[{label}] {len(articles) - len(todo)} cached, {len(todo)} to run", file=log, flush=True)
        for i, article in enumerate(todo, start=1):
            t0 = time.perf_counter()
            try:
                pred, timing = await generate_one(client, run, inputs(article, run.spec))
            except LlmUnreachable as exc:
                raise SummaryEvalError(f"{label}: {exc.message}") from exc
            except VtError as exc:
                wall = {"wall_ms": (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000}
                cache.append(article.id, article.example.label, error=_pred_error(exc), t=wall)
            else:
                cache.append(article.id, article.example.label, pred=pred, t=timing)
            if i % 10 == 0 or i == len(todo):
                print(f"[{label}] {i}/{len(todo)} new", file=log, flush=True)
        records = cache.records()
    wanted = [records[a.id] for a in articles if a.id in records]
    entry = ManifestEntry(
        key=cache.key,
        model_digest=digest,
        prompt_version=run.prompt.version,
        n=len(articles),
        done=sum(r["error"] is None for r in wanted),
        errors=sum(r["error"] is not None for r in wanted),
        truncated=sum(bool(r.get("truncated")) for r in wanted),
        updated_at=datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
    )
    update_manifest(paths, split, run.pair, entry)
    return entry


def load_summaries(paths: SummaryPaths, split: str, pair: Pair) -> dict[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Cache records of the generate run in the manifest; a changed prompt or config fails loudly."""
    entry = read_manifest(paths).get(split, {}).get(pair.key)
    if entry is None:
        raise SummaryEvalError(f"no generate run for {pair.key} on {split}; run `generate` first")
    cache = GenRun.resolve(pair).cache(split, entry.model_digest, paths.preds)
    if cache.key != entry.key:
        raise SummaryEvalError(f"{pair.key}: prompt or config changed since `generate`; run it again")
    return cache.records()


def summary_text(record: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> str | None:
    """The served summary: the serving cap applied again, so caches made before it match serving."""
    if record is None or record.get("error") is not None:
        return None
    text = record.get("summary")
    return (cap_summary(text) or None) if isinstance(text, str) else None



async def score_split(
    client: OllamaClient,
    articles: Sequence[EvalArticle],
    summaries: Mapping[Pair, Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]],
    *,
    inputs: Callable[[EvalArticle, ModelSpec], str] = model_input,
    embed_model: str = EMBED_MODEL,
) -> list[ScoreRow]:
    """One embedding call per article: its key facts plus every candidate's summary sentences."""
    specs = {pair: GenRun.resolve(pair).spec for pair in summaries}
    rows: list[ScoreRow] = []
    for article in articles:
        facts = list(article.example.key_facts)
        texts = list(facts)
        pending: list[tuple[Pair, str, Mapping[str, Any], int, int]] = []
        for pair, records in summaries.items():
            record = records.get(article.id)
            text = summary_text(record)
            if record is None or text is None:
                code = str(record["error"]["code"]) if record and record.get("error") else "missing"
                rows.append(ScoreRow(id=article.id, candidate=pair.key, error=code))
                continue
            parts = sentences(text)
            pending.append((pair, text, record, len(texts), len(parts)))
            texts += parts
        if not pending:
            continue
        vectors = unit_rows(await client.embed(embed_model, texts))
        gold = grounding(article.text)
        served: dict[int, Grounding] = {}
        for pair, text, record, start, count in pending:
            cosines, best = best_matches(vectors[: len(facts)], vectors[start : start + count])
            budget = specs[pair].max_input_tokens
            if budget not in served:
                served[budget] = grounding(inputs(article, specs[pair]))
            rows.append(
                check_summary(
                    article,
                    pair.key,
                    text,
                    truncated=bool(record.get("truncated")),
                    capped=was_capped(record),
                    gold=gold,
                    served_input=served[budget],
                    cosines=cosines,
                    best=best,
                )
            )
    return rows


def read_scores(paths: SummaryPaths, split: str) -> list[ScoreRow]:
    path = paths.scores(split)
    if not path.exists():
        return []
    return [
        ScoreRow.model_validate_json(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line
    ]


def write_scores(paths: SummaryPaths, split: str, rows: Iterable[ScoreRow], replaced: set[str]) -> None:
    kept = [r for r in read_scores(paths, split) if r.candidate not in replaced]
    ordered = sorted([*kept, *rows], key=lambda r: (r.candidate, r.id))
    write_text(paths.scores(split), "".join(r.model_dump_json() + "\n" for r in ordered))


# --- aggregation --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _rate(flags: Sequence[bool]) -> float:
    return round(sum(flags) / len(flags), 4) if flags else 0.0


def _mean(values: Sequence[float]) -> float | None:
    return round(statistics.fmean(values), 3) if values else None


def mean_ci(values: Mapping[str, float], strata: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> list[float] | None:
    """95% percentile bootstrap CI of a per-article mean, resampled within article label strata."""
    if len(values) < 2:
        return None
    ids = sorted(values)
    arr = np.asarray([values[i] for i in ids], dtype=np.float64)
    gold = [(strata or {}).get(i, "all") for i in ids]
    ci = bootstrap_ci(lambda idx: float(arr[idx].mean()), gold)
    return [round(ci.low, 3), round(ci.high, 3)]


def paired_gap(
    a: Mapping[str, float], b: Mapping[str, float], strata: Mapping[str, str] | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Mean a - b over articles both candidates were judged on, with a paired bootstrap CI."""
    shared = sorted(a.keys() & b.keys())
    if len(shared) < 2:
        return None
    gaps = {i: a[i] - b[i] for i in shared}
    return {"mean": round(statistics.fmean(gaps.values()), 3), "ci": mean_ci(gaps, strata), "n": len(shared)}


def _coverage(rows: Sequence[ScoreRow], threshold: float) -> float:
    return round(statistics.fmean(coverage(r.fact_cosines, threshold) for r in rows), 4) if rows else 0.0


def aggregate(
    pair: Pair,
    rows: Sequence[ScoreRow],
    ids: Sequence[str],
    judged: Sequence[JudgeRow] = (),
    entry: ManifestEntry | None = None,
    strata: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Rates over all articles in `ids`: a missing or failed summary fails every check and covers nothing."""
    by_id = {r.id: r for r in rows if r.candidate == pair.key}
    padded = [by_id.get(i) or ScoreRow(id=i, candidate=pair.key, error="missing") for i in ids]
    produced = [r for r in padded if r.ok]
    wanted = set(ids)
    mine = [j for j in judged if j.candidate == pair.key and j.id in wanted]
    row: dict[str, Any] = {
        "endpoint": pair.endpoint,
        "model": pair.model,
        "n": len(ids),
        "deterministicPassRate": _rate([r.passed for r in padded]),
        "keyFactCoverage": _coverage(padded, COVERAGE_THRESHOLD),
        "keyFactCoverageStrict": _coverage(padded, STRICT_THRESHOLD),
        "judgeFaithfulness": _mean([j.faithfulness for j in mine]),
        "judgeCoverage": _mean([j.coverage for j in mine]),
        "hallucinationRate": _rate([j.hallucinations > 0 for j in mine]) if mine else None,
        "wordsOkRate": _rate([r.words_ok for r in padded]),
        "sentencesOkRate": _rate([r.sentences_ok for r in padded]),
        "numbersGroundedRate": _rate([r.numbers_ok for r in padded]),
        "entityNamedRate": _rate([r.entity_named for r in padded]),
        "truncatedRate": _rate([r.truncated for r in padded]),
        "cappedRate": _rate([r.capped for r in padded]),
        "errorRate": _rate([not r.ok for r in padded]),
        "medianWords": statistics.median(r.words for r in produced) if produced else None,
        "unsupportedNumbers": sum(len(r.unsupported_numbers) for r in produced),
        "unsupportedNumbersInInput": sum(r.unsupported_in_input for r in produced),
        "keyFactCoverageAt": {f"{t:.2f}": _coverage(padded, t) for t in SENSITIVITY},
        "judgeN": len(mine),
        "judgeLeadsRate": _rate([j.leads for j in mine]) if mine else None,
```

```
#!/bin/sh
# One-shot init for the bundled profile: pulls VT_PULL_MODELS (comma-separated) plus the lines of
# VT_PULL_MODELS_FILE into the ollama service's model store, skipping models it already holds.
set -eu

models=$(printf '%s\n' "${VT_PULL_MODELS:-}" | tr ',' '\n')
if [ -n "${VT_PULL_MODELS_FILE:-}" ]; then
  models="${models}
$(sed 's/#.*//' "${VT_PULL_MODELS_FILE}")"
fi

count=0
for model in $(printf '%s\n' "${models}" | tr -d ' \r' | grep -v '^$' | sort -u); do
  # A model already in the store needs no registry round-trip, so cached re-runs work offline.
  if ollama show "${model}" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "present ${model}"
  else
    echo "pulling ${model}"
    ollama pull "${model}"
  fi
  count=$((count + 1))
done

if [ "${count}" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "no models requested: set VT_PULL_MODELS or VT_PULL_MODELS_FILE" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "models ready (${count})"
[
  "a_logprobs",
  "b_stream_logprobs",
  "backend",
  "c_field_order",
  "d_systemone",
  "e_think_false",
  "errors",
  "f_latency",
  "findings",
  "generated_at",
  "merged_models",
  "method",
  "ollama_version",

]
```

```
    def _value(self, name: str) -> Any:
        return {"label": self.label, "score": self.score, "entity": self.entity, "summary": self.summary}[
            name
        ]

    def _chat(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        if isinstance(self.chat_failure, Exception):
            raise self.chat_failure
        if self.chat_failure is not None:
            return self.chat_failure
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        fields = list(body["format"]["properties"])
        content = json.dumps({name: self._value(name) for name in fields}, ensure_ascii=False)
        done_reason = "stop"
        if self.cut_after and self.cut_after in content:
            content = content[: content.index(self.cut_after) + len(self.cut_after)]
            done_reason = "length"
        if body["stream"]:
            return self._stream(content, done_reason)
        reply = _done(message={"role": "assistant", "content": content}, done_reason=done_reason)
        if body.get("logprobs") and fields in (["label"], ["score"]):
            reply["logprobs"] = self._logprobs(content, fields[0])
        return httpx.Response(200, json=reply)

    def _logprobs(self, content: str, name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Three tokens that tile the content: everything up to the value, its first token, the rest."""
        first = _first_token(name, self._value(name))
        # json.dumps writes ": " after the key, then the label's opening quote or the bare score.
        start = content.index(":") + 2 + (name == "label")
        alternatives = self.label_alternatives if name == "label" else {first: 0.9, "0": 0.08, "-": 0.02}
        return [
            _logprob(content[:start], 0.99),
            _logprob(first, alternatives.get(first, 0.9), alternatives),
            _logprob(content[start + len(first) :], 0.99),
        ]

    def _stream(self, content: str, done_reason: str) -> httpx.Response:
        pieces = [content[i : i + self.chunk_chars] for i in range(0, len(content), self.chunk_chars)]
        chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
            {"model": "m", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": piece}, "done": False}
            for piece in pieces
        ]
        if self.stream_error_after is not None:
            chunks = [*chunks[: self.stream_error_after], {"error": "llama runner process has terminated"}]
        else:
            chunks.append(_done(eval_count=len(pieces), done_reason=done_reason))
        stream = NdjsonStream([(json.dumps(chunk) + "\n").encode() for chunk in chunks], self.delay)
        self.streams.append(stream)
        return httpx.Response(200, stream=stream, headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})

    def _systemone(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        choice = max(self.decision, key=self.decision.__getitem__)
        answer = {
            "type": "choice",
            "choice": choice,
            "probabilities": self.decision,
            "confidence": self.decision[choice],
        }
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "model": body["model"],
                "answers": {"sentiment": answer},
                "usage": {"input_tokens": 264, "output_tokens": 0},
            },
        )

    def _tags(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        models = [
            {"name": name, "model": name, "size": 1_000_000 * (i + 1)}
            for i, name in enumerate(self.installed)
        ]
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"models": models})

    def _version(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"version": self.version})


def sse_events(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """(event, data) pairs from a text/event-stream body; comments and unnamed frames are skipped."""
    events = []
    for frame in text.split("\n\n"):
        name, data = None, []
        for line in frame.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("event: "):
                name = line.removeprefix("event: ")
            elif line.startswith("data: "):
                data.append(line.removeprefix("data: "))
        if name and data:
            events.append((name, json.loads("\n".join(data))))
    return events
```

```
class VtError(Exception):
    code: ClassVar[ErrorCode]
    retryable_default: ClassVar[bool] = False

    def __init__(
        self,
        message: str,
        *,
        hint: str | None = None,
        retryable: bool | None = None,
        upstream_status: int | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message = message
        self.hint = hint
        self.retryable = self.retryable_default if retryable is None else retryable
        self.upstream_status = upstream_status

    @property
    def http_status(self) -> int:
        return ERROR_STATUS[self.code]


class TooLarge(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.TOO_LARGE


class SourceBlocked(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.SOURCE_BLOCKED


class UpstreamHttp(VtError):
    code = ErrorCode.UPSTREAM_HTTP
    retryable_default = True
```

```python
"""Latency suite (R7): `uv run python -m veritrade_evals latency {preflight,run,docker-cpu,report}`.

`preflight` records the machine and fails while any Docker container runs. `run` drives the in-process app
(`create_app`) with a local fetcher that serves the stored HTML of the dev articles, `no_cache=true`, client
concurrency 1: cold samples unload the model first, warm samples follow one warm-up request. `docker-cpu` repeats
the warm pass over HTTP against the bundled app. Every timing is the server's own clock from request receipt;
raw samples hold article ids and numbers only, never text.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import os
import platform
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal, TextIO

import httpx
import numpy as np

from veritrade.api.app import create_app
from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import UpstreamHttp, VtError
from veritrade.extract.types import Scope
from veritrade.fetch import FetchResult, normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint
from veritrade.models_registry import allowlist
from veritrade_evals.articles import ArticleExample, ArticlePaths, load_articles, read_fetched
from veritrade_evals.paths import DATA_DIR, REPO_ROOT, RESULTS_DIR

LATENCY_DIR = RESULTS_DIR / "latency"
RAW_DIR = LATENCY_DIR / "raw"
PREFLIGHT_JSON = LATENCY_DIR / "preflight.json"
LATENCY_JSON = LATENCY_DIR / "latency.json"
LATENCY_MD = LATENCY_DIR / "latency.md"
SOURCE_PROBE = DATA_DIR / "source_probe.json"
BUNDLED_ENV = REPO_ROOT / "deploy" / "bundled.env"

COLD_N = 3
WARM_N = 30
DOCKER_WARM_N = 10
HTTP_TIMEOUT_S = 600.0
UNLOAD_WAIT_S = 30.0
NATIVE_BACKEND = "native-metal"
DOCKER_BACKEND = "docker-cpu"
# Fields a raw sample may carry; anything else (titles, summaries, entities) is dropped before writing.
SAMPLE_FIELDS = (
    "session", "cell", "endpoint", "model", "scope", "streaming", "backend", "phase", "article", "ok", "status",
    "error", "total_ms", "fetch_ms", "consent_ms", "parse_ms", "extract_ms", "wall_ms", "ttft_ms", "signal_ms",
    "load_ms", "prompt_eval_ms", "eval_ms", "prompt_tokens", "eval_tokens", "client_ms", "input_chars",
    "truncated", "deltas", "order_ok", "at",
)  # fmt: skip
STAGES = ("fetch_ms", "parse_ms", "extract_ms", "wall_ms", "load_ms", "prompt_eval_ms", "eval_ms")

Phase = Literal["cold", "warm"]
Sample = dict[str, Any]


class LatencyError(RuntimeError):
    pass


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Budgets:
    """R7: native, warm, excluding fetch."""

    signal_lede_p50_ms: float = 500.0
    ttft_p50_ms: float = 1500.0
    complete_p50_ms: float = 4000.0


BUDGETS = Budgets()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Cell:
    endpoint: Endpoint
    model: str
    scope: Scope
    streaming: bool

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.endpoint}/{self.model}/{self.scope}/{'stream' if self.streaming else 'json'}"

    @property
    def path(self) -> str:
        return f"/api/{self.endpoint}" + ("/stream" if self.streaming else "")

    def body(self, url: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body: dict[str, Any] = {"url": url, "model": self.model, "no_cache": True}
        if self.endpoint != "summary":
            body["scope"] = self.scope
        return body


SIGNAL_MODELS = ("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", "clef-flash:9b-q8_0", "nimble:9b-q4_K_M")
SUMMARY_MODELS = ("qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M", "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M")
ANALYZE_MODELS = ("ministral-3:3b", "qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M", "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M")


def matrix() -> list[Cell]:
    cells = [Cell("signal", m, s, False) for m in SIGNAL_MODELS for s in ("lede", "full")]
    cells += [Cell("summary", m, "full", st) for m in SUMMARY_MODELS for st in (True, False)]
    cells += [Cell("analyze", m, "full", st) for m in ANALYZE_MODELS for st in (True, False)]
    return cells


def by_model(cells: Sequence[Cell]) -> list[tuple[str, list[Cell]]]:
    """Grouped so each model loads once; first-appearance order keeps the fast models first."""
    groups: dict[str, list[Cell]] = {}
    for cell in cells:
        groups.setdefault(cell.model, []).append(cell)
    return list(groups.items())


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _rel(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return str(path.resolve().relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def write_json(path: Path, payload: object) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    tmp.replace(path)


def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else None


# --- preflight -------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _cmd(args: Sequence[str], timeout: float = 20.0) -> str | None:
    try:
        done = subprocess.run(list(args), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout, check=False)
    except (FileNotFoundError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None
    return done.stdout if done.returncode == 0 else None


def running_containers() -> list[str] | None:
    """Names of running containers; None when Docker is absent or its daemon is down (nothing can run)."""
    out = _cmd(["docker", "ps", "--format", "{{.Names}}"])
    return None if out is None else [line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]


_ENV_ASSIGN = re.compile(r"\b(OLLAMA_[A-Z_]+)=\"?([^\"\s]*)\"?")


def ollama_service_env() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """OLLAMA_* settings of the brew service: its launch command, then the live process environment."""
    raw = _cmd(["brew", "services", "info", "ollama", "--json"])
    info: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if raw:
        try:
            entries = json.loads(raw)
            info = entries[0] if isinstance(entries, list) and entries else {}
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            info = {}
    env = dict(_ENV_ASSIGN.findall(str(info.get("command") or "")))
    pid = info.get("pid")
    if isinstance(pid, int):
        proc = _cmd(["ps", "eww", "-o", "command=", "-p", str(pid)]) or ""
        env.update(_ENV_ASSIGN.findall(proc))
    return {
        "service": info.get("service_name"),
        "running": info.get("running"),
        "env": dict(sorted(env.items())),
    }


def _sysctl(key: str) -> str | None:
    out = _cmd(["sysctl", "-n", key])
    return out.strip() if out else None


def memory_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    state: dict[str, Any] = {"freePct": None, "swapUsedMb": None, "swapTotalMb": None}
    if out := _cmd(["memory_pressure", "-Q"]):
        if m := re.search(r"free percentage:\s*(\d+)%", out):
            state["freePct"] = int(m.group(1))
    if swap := _sysctl("vm.swapusage"):
        total = re.search(r"total = ([\d.]+)M", swap)
        used = re.search(r"used = ([\d.]+)M", swap)
        state["swapTotalMb"] = float(total.group(1)) if total else None
        state["swapUsedMb"] = float(used.group(1)) if used else None
    return state


def machine() -> dict[str, Any]:
    mem = _sysctl("hw.memsize")
    return {
        "chip": _sysctl("machdep.cpu.brand_string") or platform.processor() or "unknown",
        "cpus": os.cpu_count(),
        "ramGb": round(int(mem) / 2**30) if mem and mem.isdigit() else None,
        "os": platform.platform(),
        "python": platform.python_version(),
    }


async def ollama_state(base_url: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Version, resident models and installed sizes; names and numbers only."""
    async with OllamaClient(base_url, timeout=10.0) as client:
        try:
            version = await client.version()
            resident = sorted(str(e.get("name") or e.get("model")) for e in await client.ps())
            sizes = {
                str(e.get("name")): int(e["size"]) for e in await client.tags() if isinstance(e.get("size"), int)
            }
        except VtError as exc:
            return {"reachable": False, "error": exc.code.value}
    return {"reachable": True, "version": version, "resident": resident, "modelSizes": dict(sorted(sizes.items()))}


def preflight_checks(
    containers: list[str] | None, ollama: Mapping[str, Any], memory: Mapping[str, Any], load1: float, cpus: int
) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], list[str]]:
    """Hard checks fail the preflight; warnings only go on record."""
    checks = [
        {
            "name": "no running Docker containers",
            "ok": not containers,
            "detail": "docker not reachable" if containers is None else f"{len(containers)} running",
        },
        {
            "name": "Ollama reachable",
            "ok": bool(ollama.get("reachable")),
            "detail": ollama.get("version") or ollama.get("error"),
        },
    ]
    warnings = []
    if load1 > cpus / 2:
        warnings.append(f"1-min load average {load1:.1f} is above half the {cpus} cores")
    if ollama.get("resident"):
        warnings.append(f"{len(ollama['resident'])} model(s) resident before the run; `run` unloads them")
    used, total = memory.get("swapUsedMb"), memory.get("swapTotalMb")
    if used and total and used > 0.25 * total:
        warnings.append(f"swap in use: {used:.0f} of {total:.0f} MB")
    return checks, warnings


def new_session() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")


async def preflight(base_url: str, *, resume: bool, log: TextIO = sys.stderr) -> dict[str, Any]:
    previous = read_json(PREFLIGHT_JSON)
    session = previous["session"] if resume and previous else new_session()
    containers = running_containers()
    if containers:
        # Names go to the terminal only: they belong to other projects and stay out of the results.
        print(f"running containers ({len(containers)}): {', '.join(containers)}", file=log)
    ollama = await ollama_state(base_url)
    memory = memory_state()
    host = machine()
    load = os.getloadavg()
    checks, warnings = preflight_checks(containers, ollama, memory, load[0], host["cpus"] or 1)
    settings = get_settings()
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "session": session,
        "ok": all(c["ok"] for c in checks),
        "at": _now(),
        "checks": checks,
        "warnings": warnings,
        "environment": {
            **host,
            "ollamaVersion": ollama.get("version"),
            "backend": settings.ollama_backend_label,
            "ollamaBaseUrl": base_url,
            "ollamaService": ollama_service_env(),
            "ollamaResident": ollama.get("resident", []),
            "modelSizes": ollama.get("modelSizes", {}),
            "loadAverage": [round(x, 2) for x in load],
            "memory": memory,
            "dockerRunning": None if containers is None else len(containers),
        },
    }


# --- local fetcher ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


class LocalFetcher:
    """Serves stored article HTML from memory, so network variance stays out of the timings."""

    def __init__(self, pages: Mapping[str, tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
        self._pages = {normalize_url(url): page for url, page in pages.items()}

    async def get(self, url: str) -> FetchResult:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        page = self._pages.get(normalize_url(url))
        if page is None:
            raise UpstreamHttp(f"{url} is not in the local latency set", upstream_status=404, retryable=False)
        final_url, html = page
        return FetchResult(
            requested_url=url,
            final_url=final_url,
            status=200,
            html=html,
            content_type="text/html; charset=utf-8",
            fetch_ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        return None


def local_pages(examples: Sequence[ArticleExample], paths: ArticlePaths) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:
    pages = {}
    for example in examples:
        fetched = read_fetched(paths, example.id)
        final_url = fetched.final_url if fetched and fetched.final_url else example.url
        pages[example.url] = (final_url, example.html_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return pages


# --- one request -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def sse_events(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """(event, data) pairs from a text/event-stream body; comments and unnamed frames are skipped."""
    events = []
    for frame in text.replace("\r\n", "\n").split("\n\n"):
        name, data = None, []
        for line in frame.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("event:"):
                name = line.removeprefix("event:").strip()
            elif line.startswith("data:"):
                data.append(line.removeprefix("data:").lstrip())
        if name and data:
            events.append((name, json.loads("\n".join(data))))
    return events


def _error_code(text: str) -> str | None:
    try:
        code = json.loads(text).get("error", {}).get("code")
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, AttributeError):
        return None
    return str(code) if code else None


def _num(value: Any) -> float | None:
    return float(value) if isinstance(value, int | float) else None


def parse_reply(cell: Cell, status: int, text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Server-side timings of one response; streams also yield TTFT, time to signal and event order."""
    if status != 200:
        return {"ok": False, "error": _error_code(text) or f"http_{status}"}
    signal_ms: float | None = None
    order_ok: bool | None = None
    deltas: int | None = None
    try:
        if cell.streaming:
            events = sse_events(text)
            names = [name for name, _ in events]
            if "error" in names:
                payload = events[names.index("error")][1]
                return {"ok": False, "error": str(payload.get("error", {}).get("code") or "stream_error")}
            if names.count("done") != 1:
                return {"ok": False, "error": "no_done_event"}
            result = events[names.index("done")][1]["result"]
            deltas = names.count("summary_delta")
            if cell.endpoint == "analyze":
                order_ok = names.count("sentiment") == 1 and names.index("sentiment") < names.index("done")
                if "sentiment" in names:
                    signal_ms = _num(events[names.index("sentiment")][1].get("elapsed_ms"))
            else:
                order_ok = "sentiment" not in names
            order_ok = order_ok and names[0] == "meta" and names[-1] == "done"
        else:
            result = json.loads(text)
        timings = result["timings"]
    except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError, TypeError, IndexError):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "unparsable_response"}
    inference = timings.get("inference") or {}
    total = _num(timings.get("total_ms"))
    if not cell.streaming and cell.endpoint != "summary":
        signal_ms = total
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "error": None,
        "total_ms": total,
        "fetch_ms": _num(timings.get("fetch_ms")),
        "consent_ms": _num(timings.get("consent_ms")),
        "parse_ms": _num(timings.get("parse_ms")),
        "extract_ms": _num(timings.get("extract_ms")),
        "wall_ms": _num(inference.get("wall_ms")),
        "ttft_ms": _num(inference.get("ttft_ms")),
        "signal_ms": signal_ms,
        "load_ms": _num(inference.get("load_ms")),
        "prompt_eval_ms": _num(inference.get("prompt_eval_ms")),
        "eval_ms": _num(inference.get("eval_ms")),
        "prompt_tokens": inference.get("prompt_tokens"),
        "eval_tokens": inference.get("eval_tokens"),
        "input_chars": (result.get("meta") or {}).get("input_chars"),
        "truncated": result.get("truncated"),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "order_ok": order_ok,
    }


def make_sample(cell: Cell, **values: Any) -> Sample:
    base = {
        "cell": cell.key,
        "endpoint": cell.endpoint,
        "model": cell.model,
        "scope": cell.scope,
        "streaming": cell.streaming,
        "at": _now(),
    }
    merged = {**base, **values}
    return {k: merged.get(k) for k in SAMPLE_FIELDS}


async def measure(
    http: httpx.AsyncClient, cell: Cell, article: ArticleExample, *, phase: Phase, session: str, backend: str
) -> Sample:
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        response = await http.post(cell.path, json=cell.body(article.url))
        status, text = response.status_code, response.text
    except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
        status, text = 0, ""
        parsed: dict[str, Any] = {"ok": False, "error": f"client_{type(exc).__name__}"}
    else:
        parsed = parse_reply(cell, status, text)
    client_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
    return make_sample(
        cell,
        session=session,
        backend=backend,
        phase=phase,
        article=article.id,
        status=status,
        client_ms=client_ms,
        **parsed,
    )


# --- raw store -------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class RawStore:
    """Append-only JSONL per session; a recorded (cell, phase, article) is never measured again."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path) -> None:
        self.path = path
        self._done: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
        for sample in self.samples():
            self._done.add((sample["cell"], sample["phase"], sample["article"]))

    def samples(self) -> list[Sample]:
        if not self.path.exists():
            return []
        lines = self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        return [json.loads(line) for line in lines if line.strip()]

    def has(self, cell: Cell, phase: Phase, article: str) -> bool:
        return (cell.key, phase, article) in self._done

    def append(self, sample: Sample) -> None:
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(json.dumps({k: sample.get(k) for k in SAMPLE_FIELDS}, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
        self._done.add((sample["cell"], sample["phase"], sample["article"]))


def raw_path(session: str, raw_dir: Path = RAW_DIR) -> Path:
    return raw_dir / f"{session}.jsonl"


# --- suite -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def unload(ollama: OllamaClient, model: str, wait_s: float = UNLOAD_WAIT_S) -> None:
    """Returns once Ollama no longer lists the model as resident, so the next call is a true cold load."""
    await ollama.unload(model)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + wait_s
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if model not in {str(e.get("name") or e.get("model")) for e in await ollama.ps()}:
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    raise LatencyError(f"{model} is still resident {wait_s:.0f} s after the unload request")


async def unload_others(ollama: OllamaClient, model: str, log: TextIO) -> None:
    for entry in await ollama.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != model:
            print(f"unloading {name}", file=log, flush=True)
            await unload(ollama, name)


def _p50(samples: Sequence[Sample], key: str) -> str:
    values = [s[key] for s in samples if s.get("ok") and isinstance(s.get(key), int | float)]
    return f"{np.median(values):.0f} ms" if values else "-"


async def run_suite(
    http: httpx.AsyncClient,
    cells: Sequence[Cell],
    articles: Sequence[ArticleExample],
    store: RawStore,
    *,
    session: str,
    backend: str,
    cold_n: int,
    ollama: OllamaClient | None,
    shared: bool,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> int:
    """Cold samples (model unloaded first) then one warm-up and the warm samples, cell by cell; returns the
    number of new samples. An unreachable Ollama aborts so a later run resumes."""
    cold = list(articles[:cold_n]) if ollama is not None else []
    added = 0
    for model, group in by_model(cells):
        if ollama is not None and not shared:
            await unload_others(ollama, model, log)
        for cell in group:
            new: list[Sample] = []
            for article in cold:
                if store.has(cell, "cold", article.id):
                    continue
                assert ollama is not None
                await unload(ollama, model)
                new.append(await measure(http, cell, article, phase="cold", session=session, backend=backend))
                store.append(new[-1])
            todo = [a for a in articles if not store.has(cell, "warm", a.id)]
            if todo:
                await measure(http, cell, articles[0], phase="warm", session=session, backend=backend)
            for article in todo:
                new.append(await measure(http, cell, article, phase="warm", session=session, backend=backend))
                store.append(new[-1])
                if new[-1]["error"] == "llm_unreachable":
                    raise LatencyError(f"{cell.key}: Ollama is unreachable; fix it and re-run to resume")
            added += len(new)
            errors = Counter(str(s["error"]) for s in new if not s["ok"])
            warm = [s for s in new if s["phase"] == "warm"]
            print(
                f"[{cell.key}] new {len(new)} (cold {len(new) - len(warm)}, warm {len(warm)}), "
                f"warm p50 {_p50(warm, 'total_ms')}, errors {dict(errors) or 0}",
                file=log,
                flush=True,
            )
    return added


def select_cells(cells: Sequence[Cell], models: Sequence[str] | None, endpoints: Sequence[str] | None) -> list[Cell]:
    unknown = set(models or ()) - {c.model for c in cells}
    if unknown:
        raise LatencyError(f"not in the latency matrix: {sorted(unknown)}")
    return [
        c for c in cells if (not models or c.model in models) and (not endpoints or c.endpoint in endpoints)
    ]


def serving_settings(base_url: str | None) -> Settings:
    """The full allowlist and no static files, whatever the shell exports."""
    update: dict[str, Any] = {
        "models": "",
        "default_model_signal": None,
        "default_model_summary": None,
        "default_model_analyze": None,
        "static_dir": None,
        "cors_origins": "",
    }
    if base_url:
        update["ollama_base_url"] = base_url
    return get_settings().model_copy(update=update)


async def run_native(
    cells: Sequence[Cell],
    articles: Sequence[ArticleExample],
    pages: Mapping[str, tuple[str, str]],
    *,
    session: str,
    settings: Settings,
    cold_n: int,
    shared: bool,
    raw_dir: Path = RAW_DIR,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> int:
    store = RawStore(raw_path(session, raw_dir))
    ollama = OllamaClient.from_settings(settings)
    app = create_app(settings, fetcher=LocalFetcher(pages), ollama=ollama)
    async with ollama, app.router.lifespan_context(app):
        installed = {str(e.get("name")) for e in await ollama.tags()}
        missing = sorted({c.model for c in cells} - installed)
        if missing:
            print(f"skipping models that are not installed: {', '.join(missing)}", file=log)
        runnable = [c for c in cells if c.model not in missing]
        transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(
            transport=transport, base_url="http://latency.local", timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT_S
        ) as http:
            return await run_suite(
                http,
                runnable,
                articles,
                store,
                session=session,
                backend=settings.ollama_backend_label,
                cold_n=cold_n,
                ollama=ollama,
                shared=shared,
                log=log,
            )


# --- aggregation -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def percentile(values: Sequence[float], q: float) -> float | None:
    return round(float(np.percentile(np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64), q)), 1) if values else None


def _excl(sample: Sample, key: str) -> float | None:
    value = sample.get(key)
    if not isinstance(value, int | float):
        return None
    return float(value) - float(sample.get("fetch_ms") or 0.0) - float(sample.get("consent_ms") or 0.0)


def _dist(values: Iterable[float | None]) -> dict[str, float | None] | None:
    vals = [v for v in values if v is not None]
    return {"p50": percentile(vals, 50), "p95": percentile(vals, 95)} if vals else None


def aggregate(samples: Sequence[Sample]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Totals, TTFT and time to signal exclude fetch and consent (the R7 definition); stages are p50s."""
    ok = [s for s in samples if s.get("ok")]
    return {
        "n": len(ok),
        "errors": len(samples) - len(ok),
        "errorCodes": dict(Counter(str(s.get("error")) for s in samples if not s.get("ok"))),
        "totalMs": _dist(_excl(s, "total_ms") for s in ok),
        "totalInclFetchMs": _dist(_num(s.get("total_ms")) for s in ok),
        "ttftMs": _dist(_excl(s, "ttft_ms") for s in ok),
        "signalMs": _dist(_excl(s, "signal_ms") for s in ok),
        "clientMs": _dist(_num(s.get("client_ms")) for s in ok),
        "stagesP50Ms": {
            k.removesuffix("_ms"): percentile([float(s[k]) for s in ok if _num(s.get(k)) is not None], 50)
            for k in STAGES
        },
        "tokensP50": {
            k: percentile([float(s[f"{k}_tokens"]) for s in ok if _num(s.get(f"{k}_tokens")) is not None], 50)
            for k in ("prompt", "eval")
        },
        "truncated": sum(bool(s.get("truncated")) for s in ok),
        "orderViolations": sum(s.get("order_ok") is False for s in ok),
    }


def budget_status(cell: Cell, warm: Mapping[str, Any], budgets: Budgets = BUDGETS) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """R7 per row: /signal lede p50; /summary and /analyze complete p50, plus TTFT p50 on streams.
    `utilisation` is the worst metric over its limit, the latency axis for a Pareto knee."""
    if not warm.get("n"):
        return {"status": "unmeasured", "checks": [], "utilisation": None}
    checks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    if cell.endpoint == "signal":
        if cell.scope != "lede":
            return {"status": "n/a", "checks": [], "utilisation": None}
        checks.append(_check("p50 excl. fetch", warm["totalMs"], budgets.signal_lede_p50_ms))
    else:
        checks.append(_check("complete p50", warm["totalMs"], budgets.complete_p50_ms))
        if cell.streaming:
            checks.append(_check("TTFT p50", warm["ttftMs"], budgets.ttft_p50_ms))
    if any(c["value"] is None for c in checks):
        return {"status": "unmeasured", "checks": checks, "utilisation": None}
    return {
        "status": "met" if all(c["met"] for c in checks) else "missed",
        "checks": checks,
        "utilisation": round(max(c["value"] / c["limit"] for c in checks), 3),
    }


def _check(metric: str, dist: Mapping[str, Any] | None, limit: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = dist.get("p50") if dist else None
    return {"metric": metric, "value": value, "limit": limit, "met": value is not None and value <= limit}


def fetch_reference(path: Path = SOURCE_PROBE) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
    """Live fetch cost from the source probe, reported beside the suite because the suite fetches locally."""
    probe = read_json(path)
    if not probe:
        return None
    per_source = {
        name: entry["summary"]["fetch_ms_median"]
        for name, entry in probe.get("sources", {}).items()
        if entry.get("summary", {}).get("verdict") == "usable"
        and isinstance(entry["summary"].get("fetch_ms_median"), int | float)
    }
    values = sorted(per_source.values())
    return {
        "source": _rel(path),
        "vantage": probe.get("vantage"),
        "generatedAt": probe.get("generated_at"),
        "perSourceMedianMs": dict(sorted(per_source.items())),
        "medianMs": percentile(values, 50),
        "maxMs": max(values) if values else None,
    }


def cell_report(cell: Cell, samples: Sequence[Sample], backend: str, targets: tuple[int, int]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    mine = [s for s in samples if s["cell"] == cell.key]
    cold = aggregate([s for s in mine if s["phase"] == "cold"])
    warm = aggregate([s for s in mine if s["phase"] == "warm"])
    return {
        "key": cell.key,
        "endpoint": cell.endpoint,
        "model": cell.model,
        "scope": cell.scope,
        "streaming": cell.streaming,
        "backend": backend,
        "targets": {"cold": targets[0], "warm": targets[1]},
        "partial": cold["n"] < targets[0] or warm["n"] < targets[1],
        "cold": cold,
        "warm": warm,
        "budget": budget_status(cell, warm) if backend == NATIVE_BACKEND else {"status": "n/a"},
    }


def docker_sessions(raw_dir: Path = RAW_DIR) -> list[Path]:
    return sorted(raw_dir.glob(f"{DOCKER_BACKEND}-*.jsonl"))


def build_report(
    preflight_payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    native: Sequence[Sample],
    docker: Sequence[Sample],
    *,
    docker_session: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    cells = [cell_report(c, native, NATIVE_BACKEND, (COLD_N, WARM_N)) for c in matrix()]
    docker_keys = list(dict.fromkeys(s["cell"] for s in docker))
    docker_cells = [c for c in matrix() if c.key in docker_keys]
    cells += [cell_report(c, docker, DOCKER_BACKEND, (0, DOCKER_WARM_N)) for c in docker_cells]
    native_cells = [c for c in cells if c["backend"] == NATIVE_BACKEND]
    missing = [c["key"] for c in native_cells if not c["warm"]["n"]]
    partial = [c["key"] for c in native_cells if c["partial"] and c["warm"]["n"]]
    pf = preflight_payload or {}
    return {
        "version": 1,
        "generatedAt": _now(),
        "generatedBy": "uv run python -m veritrade_evals latency report",
        "session": pf.get("session"),
        "clean": bool(pf.get("ok")),
        "complete": not missing and not partial,
        "missing": missing,
        "partial": partial,
        "dockerSession": docker_session,
        "budgets": {
            "signalLedeP50Ms": BUDGETS.signal_lede_p50_ms,
            "ttftP50Ms": BUDGETS.ttft_p50_ms,
            "completeP50Ms": BUDGETS.complete_p50_ms,
        },
        "method": {
            "native": "in-process app (create_app) with a local fetcher serving the stored HTML of the 30 dev "
            "articles; no_cache=true; client concurrency 1; parser selectolax, extractor cascade",
            "cold": f"n={COLD_N} per cell on the first dev articles, the model unloaded before each request",
            "warm": f"n={WARM_N} per cell, one per dev article, after one unrecorded warm-up request",
            "docker": f"warm n={DOCKER_WARM_N} over HTTP against the bundled app; it fetches live, so fetch "
            "and consent time are subtracted from every metric",
            "clock": "server-side from request receipt; totals, TTFT and time to signal exclude fetch and "
            "consent; TTFT = first summary_delta, time to signal = the sentiment event (JSON: total)",
        },
        "environment": pf.get("environment"),
        "preflight": {k: pf.get(k) for k in ("ok", "at", "checks", "warnings")} if pf else None,
        "fetchReference": fetch_reference(),
        "cells": cells,
    }


# --- markdown --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _ms(value: Any) -> str:
    return "-" if value is None else f"{value:,.0f}"


def _p(dist: Mapping[str, Any] | None, key: str = "p50") -> str:
    return _ms(dist.get(key)) if dist else "-"


def render(report: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    env = report.get("environment") or {}
    service = env.get("ollamaService") or {}
    lines = [
        "# Latency suite",
        "",
        f"Generated by `{report['generatedBy']}`; ids and numbers only, no article text.",
        "",
    ]
    if not report["clean"]:
        lines += [
            "> **Not a clean run.** The preflight failed (another workload shared the machine), so these "
            "numbers are indicative only. Re-run in an exclusive window.",
            "",
        ]
    if report["missing"] or report["partial"]:
        lines += [
            f"> **Incomplete.** {len(report['missing'])} cells unmeasured, {len(report['partial'])} below "
            f"their sample targets.",
            "",
        ]
    lines += [
        f"- Session `{report['session']}`; machine {env.get('chip', '?')}, {env.get('ramGb', '?')} GB, "
        f"Ollama {env.get('ollamaVersion', '?')} (`{env.get('backend', '?')}`), service env "
        + (", ".join(f"`{k}={v}`" for k, v in (service.get("env") or {}).items()) or "none")
        + ".",
        f"- Load average at preflight {env.get('loadAverage', '?')}; memory {env.get('memory', '?')}.",
        *(f"- {k}: {v}" for k, v in report["method"].items()),
        "- Budgets (R7, native, warm, excl. fetch): /signal lede p50 <= "
        f"{_ms(report['budgets']['signalLedeP50Ms'])} ms; /summary and /analyze TTFT p50 <= "
        f"{_ms(report['budgets']['ttftP50Ms'])} ms and complete p50 <= "
        f"{_ms(report['budgets']['completeP50Ms'])} ms. A missed budget is reported, never moved.",
        "",
    ]
    for backend in (NATIVE_BACKEND, DOCKER_BACKEND):
        rows = [c for c in report["cells"] if c["backend"] == backend]
        if not rows:
            continue
        lines += [f"## {backend}", ""]
        header = [
            "endpoint", "model", "scope", "transport", "n warm", "p50 ms", "p95 ms", "TTFT p50", "to signal p50",
            "cold p50", "parse", "extract", "inference", "prompt eval", "eval", "budget",
        ]  # fmt: skip
        lines += ["| " + " | ".join(header) + " |", "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in header) + "|"]
        for c in rows:
            warm, cold, stages = c["warm"], c["cold"], c["warm"]["stagesP50Ms"]
            budget = c["budget"]
            mark = budget.get("status", "n/a")
            if budget.get("checks"):
                mark += " (" + ", ".join(
                    f"{k['metric']} {_ms(k['value'])}/{_ms(k['limit'])}" for k in budget["checks"]
                ) + ")"
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"/{c['endpoint']}",
                        f"`{c['model']}`",
                        c["scope"],
                        "SSE" if c["streaming"] else "JSON",
                        f"{warm['n']}" + (f" ({warm['errors']} err)" if warm["errors"] else ""),
                        _p(warm["totalMs"]),
                        _p(warm["totalMs"], "p95"),
                        _p(warm["ttftMs"]),
                        _p(warm["signalMs"]),
                        _p(cold["totalMs"]),
                        _ms(stages.get("parse")),
                        _ms(stages.get("extract")),
                        _ms(stages.get("wall")),
                        _ms(stages.get("prompt_eval")),
                        _ms(stages.get("eval")),
                        mark,
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )
        lines.append("")
    missed = [c for c in report["cells"] if c["budget"].get("status") == "missed"]
    if missed:
        lines += ["## Budgets missed", ""]
        lines += [
            f"- /{c['endpoint']} `{c['model']}` {c['scope']} {'SSE' if c['streaming'] else 'JSON'}: "
            + ", ".join(f"{k['metric']} {_ms(k['value'])} ms > {_ms(k['limit'])} ms" for k in c["budget"]["checks"]
                        if not k["met"])
            for c in missed
        ]
        lines.append("")
    if ref := report.get("fetchReference"):
        lines += [
            "## Live fetch cost (reference)",
            "",
            f"The suite fetches locally, so the network is reported here from `{ref['source']}` "
            f"({ref['vantage']}): median of the per-source medians {_ms(ref['medianMs'])} ms, slowest source "
            f"{_ms(ref['maxMs'])} ms.",
            "",
            "| source | fetch ms (median) |",
            "|---|---|",
            *(f"| {k} | {_ms(v)} |" for k, v in ref["perSourceMedianMs"].items()),
            "",
        ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def write_report(raw_dir: Path = RAW_DIR, out_dir: Path = LATENCY_DIR) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pf = read_json(PREFLIGHT_JSON)
    native = RawStore(raw_path(pf["session"], raw_dir)).samples() if pf else []
    sessions = docker_sessions(raw_dir)
    docker = RawStore(sessions[-1]).samples() if sessions else []
    report = build_report(pf, native, docker, docker_session=sessions[-1].stem if sessions else None)
    write_json(out_dir / LATENCY_JSON.name, report)
    (out_dir / LATENCY_MD.name).write_text(render(report), encoding="utf-8")
    return report


# --- docker-cpu ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def bundled_defaults(path: Path = BUNDLED_ENV) -> dict[Endpoint, str]:
    keys: dict[str, Endpoint] = {
        "VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SIGNAL": "signal",
        "VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SUMMARY": "summary",
        "VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_ANALYZE": "analyze",
    }
    out: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        key, sep, value = line.partition("=")
        if sep and key.strip() in keys and value.strip():
            out[keys[key.strip()]] = value.strip()
    return out


def docker_cells(models: Sequence[str] | None, defaults: Mapping[Endpoint, str]) -> list[Cell]:
    """The bundled default per endpoint (signal at lede), or every matrix cell of the given models."""
    if models:
        return select_cells(matrix(), models, None)
    cells: list[Cell] = []
    for endpoint, model in defaults.items():
        if endpoint == "signal":
            cells.append(Cell("signal", model, "lede", False))
        else:
            cells += [Cell(endpoint, model, "full", True), Cell(endpoint, model, "full", False)]
    return cells


async def run_docker(
    base_url: str, cells: Sequence[Cell], articles: Sequence[ArticleExample], *, session: str, log: TextIO
) -> int:
    async with httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=base_url, timeout=HTTP_TIMEOUT_S) as http:
        health = (await http.get("/api/health")).json()
        print(f"health: backend {health.get('backend')}, Ollama {health.get('ollama_version')}", file=log)
        if health.get("backend") != DOCKER_BACKEND:
            raise LatencyError(f"{base_url} reports backend {health.get('backend')!r}, not {DOCKER_BACKEND!r}")
        store = RawStore(raw_path(f"{DOCKER_BACKEND}-{session}"))
        return await run_suite(
            http, cells, articles, store, session=session, backend=DOCKER_BACKEND, cold_n=0, ollama=None,
            shared=True, log=log,
        )  # fmt: skip


# --- CLI -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _dev_articles(limit: int) -> tuple[list[ArticleExample], ArticlePaths]:
    paths = ArticlePaths()
    articles = load_articles("dev", paths=paths)
    return (articles[:limit] if limit else articles), paths


def cmd_preflight(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    payload = asyncio.run(preflight(args.base_url or get_settings().ollama_base_url, resume=args.resume))
    write_json(PREFLIGHT_JSON, payload)
    for check in payload["checks"]:
        print(f"{'ok  ' if check['ok'] else 'FAIL'} {check['name']}: {check['detail']}")
    for warning in payload["warnings"]:
        print(f"warn {warning}")
    env = payload["environment"]
    print(f"session {payload['session']}; {env['chip']}, {env['ramGb']} GB; Ollama {env['ollamaVersion']}")
    print(f"wrote {_rel(PREFLIGHT_JSON)}")
    return 0 if payload["ok"] else 1


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    pf = read_json(PREFLIGHT_JSON)
    if pf is None:
        raise LatencyError("no preflight on record; run `latency preflight` first")
    if not pf["ok"] and not args.allow_unclean:
        raise LatencyError(
            "the last preflight failed; fix it and re-run `latency preflight`, or pass --allow-unclean for an "
            "indicative (non-exclusive) run"
        )
    articles, paths = _dev_articles(args.limit)
    allowed = allowlist()
    cells = select_cells(matrix(), args.model, args.endpoint)
    for cell in cells:
        if cell.model not in allowed or not allowed[cell.model].serves(cell.endpoint):
            raise LatencyError(f"{cell.key}: {cell.model} is not allowlisted for /{cell.endpoint}")
    n = len(cells) * (min(args.cold, len(articles)) + len(articles) + 1)
    print(f"session {pf['session']}: {len(cells)} cells, up to {n} requests", file=sys.stderr)
    added = asyncio.run(
        run_native(
            cells,
            articles,
            local_pages(articles, paths),
            session=pf["session"],
            settings=serving_settings(args.base_url),
            cold_n=min(args.cold, len(articles)),
            shared=args.shared,
        )
    )
    report = write_report()
    print(f"{added} new samples; wrote {_rel(LATENCY_JSON)} and {_rel(LATENCY_MD)}")
    print(f"clean={report['clean']} missing={len(report['missing'])} partial={len(report['partial'])}")
    return 0


def cmd_docker(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    pf = read_json(PREFLIGHT_JSON)
    session = args.session or (pf["session"] if pf else new_session())
    articles, _ = _dev_articles(args.n)
    cells = docker_cells(args.model, bundled_defaults())
    print(f"{DOCKER_BACKEND} session {session}: {len(cells)} cells x {len(articles)} warm", file=sys.stderr)
    added = asyncio.run(run_docker(args.base_url, cells, articles, session=session, log=sys.stderr))
    write_report()
    print(f"{added} new samples; wrote {_rel(LATENCY_JSON)}")
    return 0


def cmd_report(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    report = write_report()
    print(f"wrote {_rel(LATENCY_JSON)} and {_rel(LATENCY_MD)}; complete={report['complete']}")
    return 0


def add_parser(subparsers: Any) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Registers `latency` on a parent CLI; dispatch with `run(args)`."""
    parser: argparse.ArgumentParser = subparsers.add_parser("latency", help="latency suite (R7 budgets)")
    actions = parser.add_subparsers(dest="latency_action", required=True)

    pre = actions.add_parser("preflight", help="record the machine; fail while Docker containers run")
    pre.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="Ollama URL (default from settings)")
    pre.add_argument("--resume", action="store_true", help="keep the recorded session id (resume a run)")
    pre.set_defaults(latency_func=cmd_preflight)

    run_p = actions.add_parser("run", help="native suite through the in-process app (resumable)")
    run_p.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="restrict to this model (repeatable)")
    run_p.add_argument("--endpoint", action="append", choices=("signal", "summary", "analyze"))
    run_p.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="first N dev articles only (smoke runs)")
    run_p.add_argument("--cold", type=int, default=COLD_N, help="cold samples per cell")
    run_p.add_argument("--shared", action="store_true", help="never unload other models (shared Ollama)")
    run_p.add_argument("--allow-unclean", action="store_true", help="run after a failed preflight")
    run_p.add_argument("--base-url", default=None, help="Ollama URL (default from settings)")
    run_p.set_defaults(latency_func=cmd_run)

    docker = actions.add_parser("docker-cpu", help="warm pass over HTTP against the bundled app")
    docker.add_argument("--base-url", required=True, help="the bundled app, e.g. http://localhost:8000")
    docker.add_argument("--model", action="append", help="models to measure (default: bundled.env defaults)")
    docker.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=DOCKER_WARM_N, help="warm samples per cell")
    docker.add_argument("--session", default=None, help="session id (default: the preflight session)")
    docker.set_defaults(latency_func=cmd_docker)

    rep = actions.add_parser("report", help="re-aggregate raw samples into latency.{json,md}")
    rep.set_defaults(latency_func=cmd_report)
    return parser


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    try:
        code: int = args.latency_func(args)
    except (LatencyError, VtError) as exc:
        print(f"error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return code


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals.latency", description=__doc__)
    add_parser(parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    return run(parser.parse_args(["latency", *(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
# --- markdown --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _ms(value: Any) -> str:
    return "-" if value is None else f"{value:,.0f}"


def _p(dist: Mapping[str, Any] | None, key: str = "p50") -> str:
    return _ms(dist.get(key)) if dist else "-"


def render(report: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    env = report.get("environment") or {}
    service = env.get("ollamaService") or {}
    lines = [
        "# Latency suite",
        "",
        f"Generated by `{report['generatedBy']}`; ids and numbers only, no article text.",
        "",
    ]
    if not report["clean"]:
        lines += [
            "> **Not a clean run.** The preflight failed (another workload shared the machine), so these "
            "numbers are indicative only. Re-run in an exclusive window.",
            "",
        ]
    if report["missing"] or report["partial"]:
        lines += [
            f"> **Incomplete.** {len(report['missing'])} cells unmeasured, {len(report['partial'])} below "
            f"their sample targets.",
            "",
        ]
    lines += [
        f"- Session `{report['session']}`; machine {env.get('chip', '?')}, {env.get('ramGb', '?')} GB, "
        f"Ollama {env.get('ollamaVersion', '?')} (`{env.get('backend', '?')}`), service env "
        + (", ".join(f"`{k}={v}`" for k, v in (service.get("env") or {}).items()) or "none")
        + ".",
        f"- Load average at preflight {env.get('loadAverage', '?')}; memory {env.get('memory', '?')}.",
        *(f"- {k}: {v}" for k, v in report["method"].items()),
        "- Budgets (R7, native, warm, excl. fetch): /signal lede p50 <= "
        f"{_ms(report['budgets']['signalLedeP50Ms'])} ms; /summary and /analyze TTFT p50 <= "
        f"{_ms(report['budgets']['ttftP50Ms'])} ms and complete p50 <= "
        f"{_ms(report['budgets']['completeP50Ms'])} ms. A missed budget is reported, never moved.",
        "",
    ]
    for backend in (NATIVE_BACKEND, DOCKER_BACKEND):
        rows = [c for c in report["cells"] if c["backend"] == backend]
        if not rows:
            continue
        lines += [f"## {backend}", ""]
        header = [
            "endpoint", "model", "scope", "transport", "n warm", "p50 ms", "p95 ms", "TTFT p50", "to signal p50",
            "cold p50", "parse", "extract", "inference", "prompt eval", "eval", "budget",
        ]  # fmt: skip
        lines += ["| " + " | ".join(header) + " |", "|" + "|".join("---" for _ in header) + "|"]
        for c in rows:
            warm, cold, stages = c["warm"], c["cold"], c["warm"]["stagesP50Ms"]
            budget = c["budget"]
            mark = budget.get("status", "n/a")
            if budget.get("checks"):
                mark += (
                    " ("
                    + ", ".join(
                        f"{k['metric']} {_ms(k['value'])}/{_ms(k['limit'])}" for k in budget["checks"]
                    )
                    + ")"
                )
            lines.append(
                "| "
                + " | ".join(
                    [
                        f"/{c['endpoint']}",
                        f"`{c['model']}`",
                        c["scope"],
                        "SSE" if c["streaming"] else "JSON",
                        f"{warm['n']}" + (f" ({warm['errors']} err)" if warm["errors"] else ""),
                        _p(warm["totalMs"]),
                        _p(warm["totalMs"], "p95"),
                        _p(warm["ttftMs"]),
                        _p(warm["signalMs"]),
                        _p(cold["totalMs"]),
                        _ms(stages.get("parse")),
                        _ms(stages.get("extract")),
                        _ms(stages.get("wall")),
                        _ms(stages.get("prompt_eval")),
                        _ms(stages.get("eval")),
                        mark,
                    ]
                )
                + " |"
            )
        lines.append("")
    missed = [c for c in report["cells"] if c["budget"].get("status") == "missed"]
    if missed:
        lines += ["## Budgets missed", ""]
        lines += [
            f"- /{c['endpoint']} `{c['model']}` {c['scope']} {'SSE' if c['streaming'] else 'JSON'}: "
            + ", ".join(
                f"{k['metric']} {_ms(k['value'])} ms > {_ms(k['limit'])} ms"
                for k in c["budget"]["checks"]
                if not k["met"]
            )
            for c in missed
        ]
        lines.append("")
    if ref := report.get("fetchReference"):
        lines += [
            "## Live fetch cost (reference)",
            "",
            f"The suite fetches locally, so the network is reported here from `{ref['source']}` "
            f"({ref['vantage']}): median of the per-source medians {_ms(ref['medianMs'])} ms, slowest source "
            f"{_ms(ref['maxMs'])} ms.",
            "",
            "| source | fetch ms (median) |",
            "|---|---|",
            *(f"| {k} | {_ms(v)} |" for k, v in ref["perSourceMedianMs"].items()),
            "",
        ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


def write_report(raw_dir: Path = RAW_DIR, out_dir: Path = LATENCY_DIR) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pf = read_json(PREFLIGHT_JSON)
    native = RawStore(raw_path(pf["session"], raw_dir)).samples() if pf else []
    sessions = docker_sessions(raw_dir)
    docker = RawStore(sessions[-1]).samples() if sessions else []
    report = build_report(pf, native, docker, docker_session=sessions[-1].stem if sessions else None)
```
