```python
        "extraction": ("ExtractionBenchmark[]",),
        "selection": ("Record<SelectionEndpoint, Selection>",),
        "articles": ("ArticleSetStats",),
    },
}
PER_SOURCE_KEYS = ("bullish", "bearish", "neutral")


def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")


def _rel(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return str(path.resolve().relative_to(REPO_ROOT))
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def read_json(path: Path) -> Any:
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else None


# --- validation ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _kind_ok(value: Any, kind: str) -> bool:
    if kind.startswith("="):
        literal = kind[1:]
        return value == (int(literal) if literal.isdigit() else literal) and not isinstance(value, bool)
    return {
        "string": isinstance(value, str),
        "number": isinstance(value, int | float) and not isinstance(value, bool),
        "boolean": isinstance(value, bool),
        "null": value is None,
    }.get(kind, False)


def _check_object(value: Any, name: str, where: str) -> list[str]:
    spec = INTERFACES[name]
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return [f"{where}: expected a {name} object"]
    problems = [f"{where}: missing key {k!r}" for k in spec if k not in value]
    problems += [f"{where}: unexpected key {k!r}" for k in value if k not in spec]
    for key, kinds in spec.items():
        if key not in value:
            continue
        field = f"{where}.{key}"
        item = value[key]
        nested = [k for k in kinds if k in INTERFACES]
        if nested:
            problems += _check_object(item, nested[0], field)
        elif kinds[0].endswith("[]"):
            if not isinstance(item, list):
                problems.append(f"{field}: expected a list")
            else:
                for i, row in enumerate(item):
                    problems += _check_object(row, kinds[0][:-2], f"{field}[{i}]")
        elif kinds[0].startswith("Record<SelectionEndpoint"):
            problems += _check_selection(item, field)
        elif kinds[0].startswith("Record<string"):
            problems += _check_per_source(item, field)
        elif not any(_kind_ok(item, k) for k in kinds):
            problems.append(f"{field}: {item!r} is not {' | '.join(kinds)}")
    return problems


def _check_selection(value: Any, where: str) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != set(ENDPOINTS):
        return [f"{where}: expected exactly {', '.join(ENDPOINTS)}"]
    return [p for e in ENDPOINTS for p in _check_object(value[e], "Selection", f"{where}.{e}")]


def _check_per_source(value: Any, where: str) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        return [f"{where}: expected an object"]
    problems = []
    for source, row in value.items():
        if not isinstance(row, dict) or set(row) != set(PER_SOURCE_KEYS):
            problems.append(f"{where}.{source}: expected {', '.join(PER_SOURCE_KEYS)}")
        elif not all(_kind_ok(row[k], "number") for k in PER_SOURCE_KEYS):
            problems.append(f"{where}.{source}: counts must be numbers")
    return problems


def validate(payload: Any) -> list[str]:
    """Problems that would break the BenchmarksV1 contract; empty means the page can render it."""
    return _check_object(payload, "BenchmarksV1", "benchmarks")


_INTERFACE = re.compile(r"export interface (\w+) \{\n(.*?)\n\}", re.DOTALL)
_FIELD = re.compile(r"^\s+(\w+)\??: (.+);$")


def ts_interfaces(text: str) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
    """Field name -> TS type text for every exported interface (the drift check's view of the frontend)."""
    out = {}
    for name, body in _INTERFACE.findall(text):
        fields = {}
        for line in body.splitlines():
            if m := _FIELD.match(line):
                fields[m.group(1)] = m.group(2).strip()
        out[name] = fields
    return out


def ts_kinds(type_text: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    """Mirror kinds of a TS field type; unions of literals and primitives only, others pass through."""
    parts = [p.strip() for p in type_text.split("|")]
    if len(parts) > 1 or parts[0] in ("string", "number", "boolean", "null") or parts[0].startswith('"'):
        return tuple(f"={p.strip(chr(34))}" if p.startswith('"') else p for p in parts)
    if parts[0].isdigit():
        return (f"={parts[0]}",)
    return (type_text,)


# --- sections --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _short_prompt(version: str | None) -> str:
    return (version or "-").rsplit("/", 1)[-1]


def _signal_row(
    *,
    endpoint: str,
    model: str,
    policy: str,
    scope: str,
    field_order: str | None,
    prompt_version: str | None,
    dataset: str,
    split: str,
    n: int,
    metrics: Mapping[str, Any],
    ci: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    pc = metrics["per_class"]
    spec = allowlist().get(model)
    return {
        "endpoint": endpoint,
        "model": model,
        "kind": spec.kind if spec else "generative",
        "policy": policy,
        "scope": scope,
        "fieldOrder": field_order,
        "promptVersion": _short_prompt(prompt_version),
        "dataset": dataset,
        "split": split,
        "n": n,
        "f05Macro": metrics["f05_macro"],
        "precisionBullish": pc["bullish"]["precision"],
        "precisionBearish": pc["bearish"]["precision"],
        "recallBullish": pc["bullish"]["recall"],
        "recallBearish": pc["bearish"]["recall"],
        "inversionRate": metrics["inversion_rate"],
        "coverage": metrics["coverage"],
        "ciLow": ci.get("low") if ci else None,
        "ciHigh": ci.get("high") if ci else None,
    }


def signal_rows(missing: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Frozen rules on dev300 and the articles dev set, then the holdout rows when the holdout has run."""
    frozen = read_json(FROZEN_JSON)
    if frozen is None:
        missing.append(_rel(FROZEN_JSON))
        return []
    articles = read_json(ARTICLES_JSON)
    if articles is None:
        missing.append(_rel(ARTICLES_JSON))
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for model, endpoints in frozen["models"].items():
        for endpoint in ("signal", "analyze"):
            entry = endpoints.get(endpoint)
            if entry is None:
                continue
            ev = entry["evidence"]["dev300"]
            policy = ev["policy"] if endpoint == "signal" else "ordinal"
            config = ev["config"]
            field_order = entry.get("field_order") if endpoint == "analyze" else None
            ci = ev["f05_macro"] if endpoint == "signal" else ev["revision_f05"]
            report = read_json(GRID_DIR / f"{endpoint}__{model_slug(model)}.json")
            point = grid_point(report, config, policy)
            common = {"endpoint": endpoint, "model": model, "policy": policy, "field_order": field_order}
            if point is None:
                missing.append(f"dev300 grid point for {endpoint}/{model}/{config}")
            else:
                rows.append(
                    _signal_row(
                        **common,
                        scope="lede" if endpoint == "signal" else "full",
                        prompt_version=entry.get("prompt_version"),
                        dataset="twitter-fns",
                        split="dev300",
                        n=int(point["metrics"]["n"]),
                        metrics=point["metrics"],
                        ci=ci,
                    )
                )
            for scope in ("lede", "full") if endpoint == "signal" else ("full",):
                row = article_row(articles, model, config, scope, policy)
                if row is None:
                    continue
                rows.append(
                    _signal_row(
                        **common,
                        scope=scope,
                        prompt_version=row.get("prompt_version"),
                        dataset="articles",
                        split="dev",
                        n=int(row["articles"]["n"]),
                        metrics=row["articles"],
                        ci=row["articles"]["cis"]["f05_macro"],
                    )
                )
    return rows + holdout_rows(missing)


def holdout_rows(missing: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    holdout = read_json(HOLDOUT_JSON)
    if holdout is None or holdout.get("dryRun"):
        missing.append(f"{_rel(HOLDOUT_JSON)} (the holdout has not run)")
        return []
    rows = []
    for r in holdout["rows"]:
        default_scope = "lede" if r["endpoint"] == "signal" else "full"
        rows.append(
            _signal_row(
                endpoint=r["endpoint"],
                model=r["model"],
                policy=r["policy"],
                scope=r["scope"] or default_scope,
                field_order=r.get("fieldOrder"),
                prompt_version=r.get("promptVersion"),
                dataset=r["dataset"],
                split=r["datasetSplit"],
                n=int(r["n"]),
                metrics=r["metrics"],
                ci=r["cis"].get("f05_macro"),
            )
        )
    return rows


def latency_rows(missing: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    latency = read_json(LATENCY_JSON)
    if latency is None:
        missing.append(_rel(LATENCY_JSON))
        return []
    if not latency.get("clean"):
        missing.append("a clean latency run (the recorded one followed a failed preflight)")
    if latency.get("missing") or latency.get("partial"):
        missing.append(
            f"latency cells: {len(latency.get('missing', []))} unmeasured, {len(latency.get('partial', []))} partial"
        )
    rows = []
    for c in latency["cells"]:
        warm = c["warm"]
        if not warm["n"] or not warm.get("totalMs"):
            continue
        rows.append(
            {
                "endpoint": c["endpoint"],
                "model": c["model"],
                "scope": c["scope"],
                "streaming": c["streaming"],
                "backend": c["backend"],
                "n": warm["n"],
                "p50Ms": warm["totalMs"]["p50"],
                "p95Ms": warm["totalMs"]["p95"],
                "ttftP50Ms": (warm.get("ttftMs") or {}).get("p50") if c["streaming"] else None,
                "timeToSignalP50Ms": (warm.get("signalMs") or {}).get("p50"),
            }
        )
    return rows


def summary_rows(missing: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    summary = read_json(SUMMARY_JSON)
    dev = ((summary or {}).get("splits") or {}).get("dev")
    if dev is None:
        missing.append(f"{_rel(SUMMARY_JSON)} (dev split)")
        return []
    if not dev.get("judged"):
        missing.append("Opus judge scores on the dev summaries")
    keys = INTERFACES["SummaryBenchmark"]
    return [{k: r.get(k) for k in keys} for r in dev["rows"]]


def extraction_rows(missing: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    matrix = read_json(EXTRACTION_JSON)
    if matrix is None:
        missing.append(_rel(EXTRACTION_JSON))
        return []
    keys = INTERFACES["ExtractionBenchmark"]
    return [{k: r.get(k) for k in keys} for r in matrix["rows"]]


def selection_block(missing: list[str]) -> dict[str, dict[str, str]]:
    selection = read_json(SELECTION_JSON)
    if selection is None:
        missing.append(_rel(SELECTION_JSON))
        return {e: {"model": "-", "reason": "Not selected yet: run `select`."} for e in ENDPOINTS}
    if selection.get("provisional"):
        missing.append("a final (non-provisional) selection")
    return frontend_selection(selection)


def article_stats(missing: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    stats = read_json(STATS_JSON)
    if stats is None:
        missing.append(_rel(STATS_JSON))
        return {"n": 0, "perSource": {}, "agreement": None, "kappa": None}
    pool = stats.get("pool") or {}
    return {
        "n": stats["n"],
        "perSource": {s: {k: c.get(k, 0) for k in PER_SOURCE_KEYS} for s, c in stats["per_source"].items()},
        # Agreement of the two independent labellers on the double-labelled pool, before adjudication.
        "agreement": pool.get("raw_agreement"),
        "kappa": pool.get("cohen_kappa"),
    }


def environment(missing: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """From the latency preflight; without one, the extraction bench host and the grid's Ollama, said so."""
    pf = (read_json(PREFLIGHT_JSON) or {}).get("environment")
    if pf:
        return {
            "chip": pf.get("chip") or "unknown",
            "ramGb": pf.get("ramGb") or 0,
            "ollamaVersion": pf.get("ollamaVersion") or "unknown",
            "backend": pf.get("backend") or "native-metal",
            "gitSha": git_sha(),
        }
    missing.append(f"{_rel(PREFLIGHT_JSON)} (environment taken from the extraction bench and grid manifest)")
    host = (read_json(EXTRACTION_JSON) or {}).get("environment") or {}
    grid = read_json(GRID_DIR / "manifest.json") or {}
    return {
        "chip": host.get("chip") or "unknown",
        "ramGb": host.get("ramGb") or 0,
        "ollamaVersion": grid.get("ollama_version") or "unknown",
        "backend": grid.get("backend") or "native-metal",
        "gitSha": git_sha(),
    }


def build_benchmarks() -> tuple[dict[str, Any], list[str]]:
    missing: list[str] = []
    payload = {
        "version": 1,
        "sample": False,
        "generatedAt": _now(),
        "environment": environment(missing),
        "signal": signal_rows(missing),
        "latency": latency_rows(missing),
        "summary": summary_rows(missing),
        "extraction": extraction_rows(missing),
        "selection": selection_block(missing),
        "articles": article_stats(missing),
    }
    return payload, missing


# --- results README --------------------------------------------------------------------------


# First match wins; patterns are posix paths relative to evals/results.
DESCRIPTIONS: tuple[tuple[str, str], ...] = (
    ("README.md", "this index (`report`)"),
    ("benchmarks.json", "BenchmarksV1 payload the frontend Benchmarks page renders (`report`)"),
    ("frozen.json", "frozen prompt versions and thresholds per model, with the evidence for each (`freeze`)"),
    ("holdout_runs.json", "holdout-once guard keyed by the sha256 of frozen.json (`holdout run`)"),
    ("ollama_probe.json", "Ollama capability and latency probe on synthetic inputs (P2 sanity gate)"),
    ("grid/manifest.json", "dev300 grid manifest: prompt versions, cache keys and model digests per cell"),
    ("grid/summary.md", "dev300 grid report: best config per model, knobs, error patterns, notes"),
    ("grid/notes.md", "hand-written error-analysis notes, merged into grid/summary.md"),
    ("grid/error_patterns.json", "error counts per model and keyword bucket on dev300 (counts only)"),
    ("grid/signal__*.json", "per-model /signal grid report on dev300: every config, threshold sweep, CIs"),
    ("grid/analyze__*.json", "per-model /analyze grid report on dev300: every config, threshold sweep, CIs"),
    ("articles_dev/manifest.json", "articles dev finalist run manifest"),
    ("articles_dev/summary.json", "finalists on the 30 dev articles at their dev300 thresholds (`finalists`)"),
    ("articles_dev/summary.md", "readable articles dev finalist report"),
    ("articles_dev/notes.md", "hand-written notes, merged into articles_dev/summary.md"),
    ("summary/summary.json", "summary evaluation per endpoint and model: checks, key facts, judge (`summary`)"),
    ("summary/summary.md", "readable summary evaluation report"),
    ("summary/spotcheck.*.json", "key-fact coverage threshold spot check: ids, cosines and hand labels"),
    ("extraction/matrix.json", "extraction matrix: parser x extractor quality, speed, install size"),
    ("extraction/summary.md", "readable extraction matrix"),
    ("latency/preflight.json", "latency preflight: machine, Ollama version and service env, load, memory"),
    ("latency/latency.json", "latency suite aggregates per cell with R7 budget marks (`latency`)"),
    ("latency/latency.md", "readable latency report"),
    ("latency/raw/docker-cpu-*.jsonl", "raw docker-cpu latency samples, one line per request (ids, numbers)"),
    ("latency/raw/*.jsonl", "raw native latency samples of one preflight session (ids, numbers)"),
    ("selection/selection.json", "per-endpoint winners, every candidate with numbers and verdict, R8 bundle"),
    ("selection/selection.md", "readable selection report (`select`)"),
    ("holdout/manifest.json", "holdout run manifest: cache keys and model digests per cell"),
    ("holdout/holdout.json", "one-time holdout metrics with CIs and dev-vs-holdout gaps (`holdout run`)"),
    ("holdout/holdout.md", "readable holdout report"),
)


def describe(rel_path: str) -> str | None:
    return next((text for pattern, text in DESCRIPTIONS if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_path, pattern)), None)


def results_files(root: Path = RESULTS_DIR) -> list[str]:
    return sorted(
        p.relative_to(root).as_posix() for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file() and not p.name.endswith(".tmp")
    )


def render_readme(files: Sequence[str], missing: Sequence[str], payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
    guard = (read_json(GUARD) or {}).get("runs", {})
    lines = [
        "# Evaluation results",
        "",
        "Everything here is numbers, ids, model names and hand-written notes: no article, summary or dataset "
        "text (publisher and dataset rights). Inputs and caches stay in `evals/data/private/` (gitignored). "
        "Regenerate this index and `benchmarks.json` with `uv run python -m veritrade_evals report`.",
        "",
        "Order of the pipeline: grid -> finalists -> freeze -> summary -> latency -> select -> holdout (once) "
        "-> report.",
        "",
        f"## Status at {payload['generatedAt']}",
        "",
        f"- Selection: {', '.join(f'/{e} `{s['model']}`' for e, s in payload['selection'].items())}.",
        f"- Benchmarks rows: signal {len(payload['signal'])}, latency {len(payload['latency'])}, summary "
        f"{len(payload['summary'])}, extraction {len(payload['extraction'])}.",
        f"- Holdout runs on record: {len(guard)}"
        + "".join(f" (`{sha[:12]}` {e['status']})" for sha, e in guard.items())
        + ".",
        *(["- Missing or incomplete inputs:", *(f"  - {m}" for m in missing)] if missing else ["- Complete."]),
        "",
        "## Files",
        "",
        "| file | what it holds |",
        "|---|---|",
    ]
    for rel_path in files:
        text = describe(rel_path) or "(undocumented: add it to report.DESCRIPTIONS)"
        lines.append(f"| `{rel_path}` | {text} |")
    lines += [
        "",
        "Notes on `benchmarks.json`: dev300 rows carry the endpoint's default scope (tweets are headline-length); "
        "latency rows are warm p50/p95 excluding fetch; `articles.agreement`/`kappa` are the two labellers on "
        "the double-labelled pool before adjudication.",
        "",
    ]
    return "\n".join(lines)


# --- CLI -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def cmd_report(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    if args.check:
        problems = validate(read_json(BENCHMARKS_JSON))
        for problem in problems:
            print(problem, file=sys.stderr)
        print(f"{_rel(BENCHMARKS_JSON)}: {'invalid' if problems else 'valid BenchmarksV1'}")
        return 1 if problems else 0
    payload, missing = build_benchmarks()
    problems = validate(payload)
    if problems:
        for problem in problems[:20]:
            print(f"shape: {problem}", file=sys.stderr)
        print("benchmarks.json NOT written: the payload breaks the BenchmarksV1 contract", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    BENCHMARKS_JSON.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=1) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    files = results_files()
    README.write_text(render_readme(files, missing, payload), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"wrote {_rel(BENCHMARKS_JSON)} (valid BenchmarksV1) and {_rel(README)} ({len(files)} files indexed)")
    for item in missing:
        print(f"missing: {item}", file=sys.stderr)
    undocumented = [f for f in files if describe(f) is None]
    for item in undocumented:
        print(f"undocumented results file: {item}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1 if args.strict and (missing or undocumented) else 0


def add_parser(subparsers: Any) -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    """Registers `report` on a parent CLI; dispatch with `run(args)`."""
    parser: argparse.ArgumentParser = subparsers.add_parser(
        "report", help="benchmarks.json (BenchmarksV1) and the results README"
    )
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--strict", action="store_true", help="exit 1 while any input is missing")
    mode.add_argument("--check", action="store_true", help="only validate the existing benchmarks.json")
    return parser


def run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    return cmd_report(args)


def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="veritrade_evals.report", description=__doc__)
    add_parser(parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True))
    return run(parser.parse_args(["report", *(argv if argv is not None else sys.argv[1:])]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```
# Model selection

Generated by `uv run python -m veritrade_evals select` from committed results; numbers only.

> **Provisional.** Missing input: evals/results/latency/latency.json. Latency.json is missing: budgets are unchecked and every winner is quality-only.

## Rules

- **signal**: Candidates: the frozen /signal configs at the default lede scope. Filters: dev300 inversion rate <= 2% at the frozen operating point (n=300); the articles dev set must not fail the cap, meaning the 95% CI of its inversion rate reaches down to 2% (the freeze's clear-failure rule: at n=30 one inversion is about 5% of the calls); warm native p50 excluding fetch <= 500 ms at lede. Rank: dev300 F0.5 macro (primary, n=300), then articles dev F0.5, then lower latency.
- **analyze**: Candidates: the frozen /analyze configs (full scope, ordinal |score| >= t, sentiment-first). Filters: the same inversion rules as /signal; streamed TTFT p50 <= 1.5 s and complete p50 <= 4 s (warm, native, excluding fetch). Rank: dev300 F0.5 macro, then articles dev F0.5, then lower latency.
- **summary**: Candidates: the frozen /summary models. Filter: deterministic pass rate >= 0.8 on the dev articles; streamed TTFT p50 <= 1.5 s and complete p50 <= 4 s. Rank: Opus judge faithfulness, then judge coverage, then key-fact coverage (key-fact coverage leads while the judge is pending).
- **winner**: The best-ranked candidate inside every filter. When no accuracy-eligible candidate meets its latency budget, the Pareto knee (metrics.knee) of quality against budget utilisation (the worst measured metric divided by its limit) among the measured candidates, with the reason stated.
- **bundle**: R8: the per-endpoint winners when their model files total <= 10 GB (decimal), else the combination of accuracy-eligible candidates that fits with the fewest rank steps away from the winners (ties: signal, then summary, then analyze keeps its better pick; then the smaller total).
```

```
- native: in-process app (create_app) with a local fetcher serving the stored HTML of the 30 dev articles; no_cache=true; client concurrency 1; parser selectolax, extractor cascade
- cold: n=3 per cell on the first dev articles, the model unloaded before each request
- warm: n=30 per cell, one per dev article, after one unrecorded warm-up request
- docker: warm n=10 over HTTP against the bundled app; it fetches live, so fetch and consent time are subtracted from every metric
- clock: server-side from request receipt; totals, TTFT and time to signal exclude fetch and consent; TTFT = first summary_delta, time to signal = the sentiment event (JSON: total)
- Budgets (R7, native, warm, excl. fetch): /signal lede p50 <= 500 ms; /summary and /analyze TTFT p50 <= 1,500 ms and complete p50 <= 4,000 ms. A missed budget is reported, never moved.
```

```bash
    seen: Counter[str] = Counter()
    out = []
    for item in items:

    return out
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import httpx
import pytest
import respx

from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade_evals import latency as lat
from veritrade_evals.articles import ArticleExample
from veritrade_evals.latency import Cell

OLLAMA = "http://ollama.test:11434"
SIGNAL = Cell("signal", "clef-flash:9b-q8_0", "lede", False)
SUMMARY = Cell("summary", "qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M", "full", True)
ANALYZE = Cell("analyze", "ministral-3:3b", "full", True)


def timings(total: float, *, fetch: float = 1.0, ttft: float | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "total_ms": total,
        "fetch_ms": fetch,
        "parse_ms": 2.0,
        "extract_ms": 1.0,
        "inference": {"wall_ms": total - 4, "ttft_ms": ttft, "prompt_eval_ms": 100.0, "eval_ms": 50.0},
        "cache": {"fetch": "bypass", "result": "bypass"},
    }


def sse(*events: tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    return "".join(f"event: {name}\ndata: {json.dumps(data)}\n\n" for name, data in events)


def sample(cell: Cell, phase: lat.Phase, article: str, total: float, **extra: Any) -> lat.Sample:
    return lat.make_sample(
        cell, session="s", backend="native-metal", phase=phase, article=article, ok=True, total_ms=total, **extra
    )


# --- parsing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_json_signal_reply_takes_server_timings_and_signal_time_is_the_total() -> None:
    body = json.dumps({"meta": {"input_chars": 640, "title": "never kept"}, "timings": timings(320.0)})
    parsed = lat.parse_reply(SIGNAL, 200, body)
    assert parsed["ok"] and parsed["total_ms"] == 320.0 and parsed["signal_ms"] == 320.0
    assert parsed["input_chars"] == 640
    assert "title" not in lat.make_sample(SIGNAL, **parsed)


def test_analyze_stream_reply_reads_ttft_signal_time_and_event_order() -> None:
    result = {"timings": timings(2400.0, ttft=900.0), "truncated": False}
    body = sse(
        ("meta", {}),
        ("sentiment", {"elapsed_ms": 610.0}),
        ("summary_delta", {"text": "x"}),
        ("summary_delta", {"text": "y"}),
        ("done", {"result": result}),
    )
    parsed = lat.parse_reply(ANALYZE, 200, body)
    assert parsed["ttft_ms"] == 900.0 and parsed["signal_ms"] == 610.0
    assert parsed["deltas"] == 2 and parsed["order_ok"] is True


def test_stream_order_violations_and_errors_are_recorded() -> None:
    late = sse(("meta", {}), ("done", {"result": {"timings": timings(10.0)}}), ("sentiment", {"elapsed_ms": 5}))
    assert lat.parse_reply(ANALYZE, 200, late)["order_ok"] is False
    failed = sse(("meta", {}), ("error", {"error": {"code": "inference_timeout"}}))
    assert lat.parse_reply(SUMMARY, 200, failed) == {"ok": False, "error": "inference_timeout"}
    assert lat.parse_reply(SUMMARY, 503, json.dumps({"error": {"code": "llm_unreachable"}}))["error"] == (
        "llm_unreachable"
    )
    assert lat.parse_reply(SUMMARY, 200, sse(("meta", {})))["error"] == "no_done_event"


# --- aggregation and budgets -----------------------------------------------------------------


def test_aggregate_excludes_fetch_and_marks_the_signal_lede_budget() -> None:
    warm = [sample(SIGNAL, "warm", f"a{i}", 400.0 + 10 * i, fetch_ms=50.0) for i in range(5)]
    agg = lat.aggregate(warm)
    assert agg["n"] == 5 and agg["totalMs"]["p50"] == 370.0 and agg["totalInclFetchMs"]["p50"] == 420.0
    budget = lat.budget_status(SIGNAL, agg)
    assert budget["status"] == "met" and budget["utilisation"] == pytest.approx(0.74)
    slow = lat.aggregate([sample(SIGNAL, "warm", "a", 700.0)])
    assert lat.budget_status(SIGNAL, slow)["status"] == "missed"
    assert lat.budget_status(Cell("signal", "m", "full", False), slow)["status"] == "n/a"
    assert lat.budget_status(SIGNAL, lat.aggregate([]))["status"] == "unmeasured"


def test_stream_budget_needs_both_ttft_and_complete_p50() -> None:
    fast = lat.aggregate([sample(SUMMARY, "warm", "a", 3000.0, ttft_ms=1200.0)])
    assert lat.budget_status(SUMMARY, fast)["status"] == "met"
    late_first_token = lat.aggregate([sample(SUMMARY, "warm", "a", 3000.0, ttft_ms=1800.0)])
    budget = lat.budget_status(SUMMARY, late_first_token)
    assert budget["status"] == "missed" and budget["utilisation"] == pytest.approx(1.2)
    no_ttft = lat.aggregate([sample(SUMMARY, "warm", "a", 3000.0)])
    assert lat.budget_status(SUMMARY, no_ttft)["status"] == "unmeasured"
    json_cell = Cell("summary", SUMMARY.model, "full", False)
    assert [c["metric"] for c in lat.budget_status(json_cell, fast)["checks"]] == ["complete p50"]


def test_report_flags_unclean_missing_and_partial_cells() -> None:
    samples = [sample(SIGNAL, "warm", f"a{i}", 300.0) for i in range(lat.WARM_N)]
    samples += [sample(SIGNAL, "cold", f"a{i}", 2000.0) for i in range(lat.COLD_N)]
    samples.append(sample(SUMMARY, "warm", "a0", 2000.0, ttft_ms=800.0))
    report = lat.build_report({"session": "s", "ok": False}, samples, [])
    cells = {c["key"]: c for c in report["cells"]}
    assert not report["clean"] and not report["complete"]
    assert not cells[SIGNAL.key]["partial"] and cells[SIGNAL.key]["budget"]["status"] == "met"
    assert SUMMARY.key in report["partial"] and ANALYZE.key in report["missing"]
    assert "Not a clean run" in lat.render(report)


def test_raw_store_resumes_and_keeps_only_known_fields(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    store = lat.RawStore(tmp_path / "s.jsonl")
    store.append({**sample(SIGNAL, "warm", "a1", 300.0), "summary": "never written"})
    again = lat.RawStore(tmp_path / "s.jsonl")
    assert again.has(SIGNAL, "warm", "a1") and not again.has(SIGNAL, "cold", "a1")
    assert set(again.samples()[0]) == set(lat.SAMPLE_FIELDS)


def test_docker_cells_follow_the_bundled_defaults(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    env = tmp_path / "bundled.env"
    env.write_text(
        "# comment\nVT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SIGNAL=qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0\nVT_DEFAULT_MODEL_SUMMARY=qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M\n"
        "VT_DEFAULT_MODEL_ANALYZE=ministral-3:3b\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    keys = [c.key for c in lat.docker_cells(None, lat.bundled_defaults(env))]
    assert keys == [
        "signal/qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0/lede/json",
        "summary/qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M/full/stream",
        "summary/qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M/full/json",
        "analyze/ministral-3:3b/full/stream",
        "analyze/ministral-3:3b/full/json",
    ]
    with pytest.raises(lat.LatencyError):
        lat.select_cells(lat.matrix(), ["not-a-model"], None)


def test_matrix_models_are_allowlisted_for_their_endpoints() -> None:
    from veritrade.models_registry import allowlist

    roster = allowlist()
    assert all(roster[c.model].serves(c.endpoint) for c in lat.matrix())
    assert len(lat.matrix()) == 16


# --- the suite on a mocked Ollama ------------------------------------------------------------


def _done(**extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": ""},
        "done": True,
        "done_reason": "stop",
        "load_duration": 5_000_000,
        "prompt_eval_count": 512,
        "prompt_eval_duration": 120_000_000,
        "eval_count": 12,
        "eval_duration": 60_000_000,
    } | extra


def _chat(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
    body = json.loads(request.content)
    fields = list(body["format"]["properties"])
    content = json.dumps({f: {"summary": "Acme Corp beat estimates.", "score": 1}.get(f, "Acme") for f in fields})
    if not body["stream"]:
        return httpx.Response(200, json=_done(message={"role": "assistant", "content": content}))
    pieces = [content[i : i + 5] for i in range(0, len(content), 5)]
    lines = [{"message": {"role": "assistant", "content": p}, "done": False} for p in pieces] + [_done()]
    return httpx.Response(200, content="".join(json.dumps(x) + "\n" for x in lines).encode())


def _systemone(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
    probs: dict[Sentiment, float] = {"neutral": 0.05, "bullish": 0.9, "bearish": 0.05}
    answer = {"type": "choice", "choice": "bullish", "probabilities": probs, "confidence": 0.9}
    return httpx.Response(200, json={"answers": {"sentiment": answer}, "usage": {"input_tokens": 120}})


@pytest.fixture
def ollama() -> Iterator[respx.MockRouter]:
    with respx.mock(assert_all_called=False) as router:
        tags = [{"name": SIGNAL.model, "size": 1}, {"name": SUMMARY.model, "size": 2}]
        router.get(f"{OLLAMA}/api/tags").respond(200, json={"models": tags})
        router.get(f"{OLLAMA}/api/ps").respond(200, json={"models": []})
        router.post(f"{OLLAMA}/api/generate").respond(200, json={"done": True})
        router.post(f"{OLLAMA}/api/chat").mock(side_effect=_chat)
        router.post(f"{OLLAMA}/v1/systemone").mock(side_effect=_systemone)
        yield router


def _article(i: int) -> ArticleExample:
    return ArticleExample(
        id=f"art-{i}",
        source="synthetic",
        url=f"https://news.example/{i}",
        label="neutral",
        score=0.0,
        entity="Ostrava Logistics",
        ticker=None,
        key_facts=(),
        gold_text="",
        html_path=Path("unused.html"),
        split="dev",
    )


async def test_native_suite_measures_cold_and_warm_through_the_app(
    ollama: respx.MockRouter, tmp_path: Path
) -> None:
    articles = [_article(i) for i in range(2)]
    pages = {a.url: (a.url, lat.WARMUP_HTML) for a in articles}
    added = await lat.run_native(
        [SIGNAL, SUMMARY],
        articles,
        pages,
        session="test",
        settings=lat.serving_settings(OLLAMA),
        cold_n=1,
        shared=False,
        raw_dir=tmp_path,
    )
    samples = lat.RawStore(tmp_path / "test.jsonl").samples()
    assert added == len(samples) == 6
    assert all(s["ok"] for s in samples), [s["error"] for s in samples]
    stream = [s for s in samples if s["cell"] == SUMMARY.key and s["phase"] == "warm"]
    assert all(s["ttft_ms"] is not None and s["order_ok"] for s in stream)
    # Cold samples unload first; every warm phase reloads through the unmeasured warm-up page.
    assert ollama.routes[2].call_count == 4
    assert {s["article"] for s in samples} == {"art-0", "art-1"}
    again = await lat.run_native(
        [SIGNAL, SUMMARY],
        articles,
        pages,
        session="test",
        settings=lat.serving_settings(OLLAMA),
        cold_n=1,
        shared=False,
        raw_dir=tmp_path,
    )
    assert again == 0
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest
import respx

from veritrade_evals import select as sel
from veritrade_evals.select import Cand, Check

MODELS_TOML = """# header comment
[defaults]
signal = "small:1b"
summary = "small:1b"
analyze = "small:1b"

[models."small:1b"]
kind = "generative"
endpoints = ["signal", "summary", "analyze"]
num_ctx = 4096
max_input_tokens = 1000
num_predict = { signal = 16, summary = 160, analyze = 200 }
signal_schema = "label"
policy = "label-logprob"
min_p = 0.5

[models."big:9b"]
kind = "decision"
endpoints = ["signal"]
max_input_tokens = 2000
policy = "probability"
min_p = 0.8
"""


def latency(status: str, utilisation: float | None, value: float = 400.0) -> dict[str, Any]:
    checks = [{"metric": "p50 excl. fetch", "value": value, "limit": 500.0, "met": status == "met"}]
    return {"budget": {"status": status, "utilisation": utilisation, "checks": checks}, "warm": {"n": 30}}


def cand(model: str, quality: float, lat: dict[str, Any] | None, *, ok: bool = True) -> Cand:
    return Cand(
        endpoint="signal",
        model=model,
        config="v1",
        rule="probability @ 0.8",
        quality=quality,
        quality_label="dev300 F0.5",
        secondary=(),
        checks=[Check("dev300 inversion <= 2%", ok, "synthetic")],
        latency=lat,
    )


# --- winner rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_winner_is_the_best_candidate_inside_every_filter() -> None:
    cands = [
        cand("best-but-slow", 0.90, latency("missed", 2.0, 1000.0)),
        cand("good-and-fast", 0.80, latency("met", 0.6, 300.0)),
        cand("worse-and-fast", 0.70, latency("met", 0.3, 150.0)),
        cand("inverts", 0.95, latency("met", 0.2, 100.0), ok=False),
    ]
    choice = sel.choose("signal", cands, provisional=False)
    assert choice.winner is not None and choice.winner.model == "good-and-fast"
    assert choice.how == "inside-budget" and not choice.provisional
    verdicts = {c.model: c.verdict for c in cands}
    assert verdicts["best-but-slow"].startswith("misses the budget")
    assert verdicts["worse-and-fast"].startswith("ranks below")
    assert verdicts["inverts"].startswith("excluded: dev300 inversion")


def test_no_candidate_inside_the_budget_falls_back_to_the_pareto_knee() -> None:
    cands = [
        cand("fast-weak", 0.60, latency("missed", 1.1)),
        cand("knee", 0.85, latency("missed", 1.3)),
        cand("slow-best", 0.87, latency("missed", 3.0)),
    ]
    choice = sel.choose("signal", cands, provisional=False)
    assert choice.how == "knee" and choice.winner is not None and choice.winner.model == "knee"
    assert "Pareto knee" in choice.reason and "1.30x the budget" in choice.reason
    assert cands[2].verdict.startswith("not the knee")


def test_unmeasured_latency_gives_a_provisional_quality_only_pick() -> None:
    cands = [cand("a", 0.7, None), cand("b", 0.8, None)]
    choice = sel.choose("signal", cands, provisional=False)
    assert choice.how == "quality-only" and choice.provisional
    assert choice.winner is not None and choice.winner.model == "b"


def test_no_eligible_candidate_means_no_winner() -> None:
    choice = sel.choose("signal", [cand("a", 0.9, latency("met", 0.5), ok=False)], provisional=False)
    assert choice.winner is None and choice.how == "none"


def test_articles_cap_uses_the_ci_so_one_inversion_in_twenty_calls_is_not_a_failure() -> None:
    def row(inversions: int, calls: int, point: float, low: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
        cis = {"inversion_rate": {"point": point, "low": low, "high": point}}
        articles = {"inversions": inversions, "directional_calls": calls, "inversion_rate": point, "cis": cis}
        return {"articles": articles, "clear_failure": []}

    dev, articles = sel._inversion_checks(0.0, row(1, 20, 0.05, 0.0))
    assert dev.passed and articles.passed
    assert "point estimate alone would fail" in articles.detail
    assert sel._inversion_checks(0.0, row(6, 20, 0.30, 0.10))[1].passed is False
    assert sel._inversion_checks(0.03, None)[0].passed is False


# --- R8 bundle -------------------------------------------------------------------------------

SIZES = {"clef": 10_580_000_000, "nimble": 5_630_000_000, "q08": 1_020_000_000, "q2": 1_950_000_000, "q4": 3_320_000_000}


def test_bundle_keeps_the_winners_when_they_fit_and_counts_a_shared_model_once() -> None:
    plan = sel.bundle_plan({"signal": ["q08"], "summary": ["q4"], "analyze": ["q4"]}, SIZES)
    assert plan["status"] == "winners" and plan["models"] == ["q08", "q4"]
    assert plan["totalBytes"] == SIZES["q08"] + SIZES["q4"]


def test_bundle_swaps_the_fewest_rank_steps_when_the_winners_do_not_fit() -> None:
    prefs = {"signal": ["clef", "nimble", "q08"], "summary": ["q4", "q2"], "analyze": ["q4"]}
    plan = sel.bundle_plan(prefs, SIZES)
    assert plan["status"] == "swapped" and plan["defaults"]["signal"] == "nimble"
    assert plan["swaps"] == {"signal": {"winner": "clef", "bundled": "nimble"}}
    assert plan["totalBytes"] <= sel.SIZE_CAP_BYTES


def test_bundle_tie_on_rank_steps_keeps_the_earlier_endpoint_and_reports_nothing_fitting() -> None:
    prefs = {"signal": ["nimble", "q08"], "summary": ["q4", "q2"], "analyze": ["clef", "q2"]}
    plan = sel.bundle_plan(prefs, SIZES, cap=9_000_000_000)
    assert plan["defaults"] == {"signal": "nimble", "summary": "q2", "analyze": "q2"}
    assert sel.bundle_plan({"signal": ["clef"]}, SIZES)["status"] == "nothing fits"
    assert sel.bundle_plan({"signal": ["q08"]}, None)["status"] == "sizes unknown"


# --- writing ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_write_defaults_touches_only_the_defaults_table() -> None:
    out = sel.write_defaults(MODELS_TOML, {"signal": "big:9b", "summary": "small:1b", "analyze": "small:1b"})
    assert 'signal = "big:9b"' in out
    assert out.replace('signal = "big:9b"', 'signal = "small:1b"') == MODELS_TOML
    with pytest.raises(sel.SelectError):
        sel.write_defaults(MODELS_TOML, {"summary": "big:9b"})


def test_write_env_rewrites_keys_and_keeps_comments() -> None:
    env = "# keep me\nCOMPOSE_PROFILES=bundled\nVT_MODELS=old\n# VT_PULL_MODELS=commented\n"
    out = sel.write_env(env, {"VT_MODELS": "a,b", "VT_PULL_MODELS": "a,b"})
    assert out == "# keep me\nCOMPOSE_PROFILES=bundled\nVT_MODELS=a,b\n# VT_PULL_MODELS=commented\nVT_PULL_MODELS=a,b\n"


def test_write_refuses_a_provisional_selection(tmp_path: Any) -> None:
    selection = {"provisional": True, "notes": ["latency.json is missing"], "endpoints": {}, "bundle": {}}
    with pytest.raises(sel.SelectError, match="provisional"):
        sel.apply_write(selection, tmp_path / "models.toml", tmp_path / "bundled.env")


def test_model_sizes_come_from_ollama_tags() -> None:
    with respx.mock() as router:
        router.get("http://ollama.test:11434/api/tags").respond(
            200, json={"models": [{"name": "q08", "size": 7}, {"name": "odd"}]}
        )
        sizes, source = sel.model_sizes("http://ollama.test:11434")
    assert sizes == {"q08": 7} and source == "ollama /api/tags"


# --- end to end on synthetic results ---------------------------------------------------------


def _grid(config: str, policy: str, inversion: float, f05: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
    point = {"threshold": 0.8, "metrics": {"n": 300, "inversion_rate": inversion, "f05_macro": f05}}
    cis = {"f05_macro": {"point": f05, "low": f05 - 0.05, "high": f05 + 0.05}}
    return {
        "configs": [{"name": config, "policies": {policy: {"operating_point": point}}}],
        "best": {"config": config, "policy": policy, "cis": cis},
    }


def _article_row(model: str, config: str, scope: str, policy: str, inversions: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    rate = inversions / 20
    cis = {"f05_macro": {"point": 0.8, "low": 0.7, "high": 0.9}, "inversion_rate": {"point": rate, "low": 0.0}}
    return {
        "key": f"{model}/{config}/{scope}",
        "policy": policy,
        "articles": {
            "f05_macro": 0.8,
            "inversion_rate": rate,
            "inversions": inversions,
            "directional_calls": 20,
            "coverage": 1.0,
            "cis": cis,
        },
        "clear_failure": [],
        "latency": {"wall_ms_p50": 500.0},
    }


def test_build_selection_on_synthetic_results() -> None:
    def signal_entry(f05: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
        ev = {
            "config": "v1",
            "policy": "probability",
            "threshold": 0.8,
            "f05_macro": {"point": f05, "low": f05 - 0.05, "high": f05 + 0.05},
            "inversion_rate": {"point": 0.0, "low": 0.0, "high": 0.0},
        }
        return {"signal": {"prompt_version": "p", "evidence": {"dev300": ev}}}

    frozen = {
        "models": {
            "fast": signal_entry(0.7),
            "slow": signal_entry(0.9),
            "an": {
                "analyze": {
                    "prompt_version": "p",
                    "ordinal_t": 1,
                    "field_order": "sentiment-first",
                    "evidence": {"dev300": {"config": "v1"}},
                },
                "summary": {"prompt": "v2", "prompt_version": "p"},
            },
        }
    }
    grid = {
        ("signal", "fast"): _grid("v1", "probability", 0.0, 0.7),
        ("signal", "slow"): _grid("v1", "probability", 0.0, 0.9),
        ("analyze", "an"): _grid("v1", "ordinal", 0.01, 0.75),
    }
    articles = {
        "rows": [
            _article_row("fast", "v1", "lede", "probability", 0),
            _article_row("slow", "v1", "lede", "probability", 1),
            _article_row("an", "v1", "full", "ordinal", 0),
        ]
    }
    summary_row = {"endpoint": "summary", "model": "an", "n": 30, "deterministicPassRate": 0.9}
    summary = {
        "config": {"passGate": 0.8},
        "splits": {"dev": {"rows": [summary_row | {"keyFactCoverage": 0.5, "judgeFaithfulness": 4.2}]}},
    }

    def cell(key: str, status: str, utilisation: float) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"key": key, "backend": "native-metal", **latency(status, utilisation)}

    latency_json = {
        "clean": True,
        "missing": [],
        "partial": [],
        "cells": [
            cell("signal/fast/lede/json", "met", 0.4),
            cell("signal/slow/lede/json", "missed", 2.6),
            cell("summary/an/full/stream", "met", 0.7),
            cell("analyze/an/full/stream", "met", 0.9),
        ],
    }
    inputs = sel.Inputs(frozen, grid, articles, summary, latency_json, {"fast": 1, "slow": 2, "an": 3}, "test")
    selection = sel.build_selection(inputs)
    winners = {e: v["winner"] for e, v in selection["endpoints"].items()}
    assert winners == {"signal": "fast", "summary": "an", "analyze": "an"}
    assert not selection["provisional"] and selection["bundle"]["models"] == ["an", "fast"]
    slow = next(c for c in selection["endpoints"]["signal"]["candidates"] if c["model"] == "slow")
    assert slow["verdict"].startswith("misses the budget")
    shown = sel.frontend_selection(selection)
    assert shown["signal"]["model"] == "fast" and "inside every filter" in shown["signal"]["reason"]
    assert "## /signal: `fast` (inside-budget)" in sel.render(selection)
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from collections.abc import Sequence
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade.inference.types import Sentiment
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry
from veritrade_evals import holdout as ho
from veritrade_evals.datasets import Example
from veritrade_evals.holdout import Gold, HCell, Rule


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def frozen() -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(ho.FROZEN_JSON.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return payload


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def rules(frozen: dict[str, Any]) -> list[Rule]:
    return ho.rules_from_frozen(frozen, PromptRegistry())


# --- frozen rules and the plan ---------------------------------------------------------------


def test_rules_reuse_the_frozen_thresholds_and_prompts(frozen: dict[str, Any], rules: Sequence[Rule]) -> None:
    for rule in rules:
        entry = frozen["models"][rule.model][rule.endpoint]
        assert rule.run.prompt.version == entry["prompt_version"]
        if rule.endpoint == "signal":
            assert rule.threshold == entry["evidence"]["dev300"]["threshold"]
            assert rule.policy == entry["evidence"]["dev300"]["policy"]
        else:
            assert (rule.policy, rule.threshold) == ("ordinal", float(entry["ordinal_t"]))
        assert rule.dev["dev300"] > 0


def test_plan_runs_finalists_everywhere_and_winners_plus_the_ceiling_cross_domain(rules: Sequence[Rule]) -> None:
    ceiling = ho.ceiling_rule(PromptRegistry())
    signal_winner = next(r.model for r in rules if r.endpoint == "signal")
    analyze_winner = next(r.model for r in rules if r.endpoint == "analyze")
    cells = ho.plan_cells(rules, ceiling, {"signal": signal_winner, "analyze": analyze_winner})
    keys = {c.key for c in cells}
    for rule in rules:
        assert any(k.startswith(f"tfns_val/{rule.endpoint}/{rule.model}/") for k in keys)
        cross = {c.split for c in cells if c.rule is rule and c.split in ho.CROSS}
        assert cross == (set(ho.CROSS) if rule.model in (signal_winner, analyze_winner) else set())
    assert {c.split for c in cells if c.rule is ceiling} == {ho.ARTICLES, *ho.CROSS}
    signal_scopes = {c.scope for c in cells if c.split == ho.ARTICLES and c.rule.endpoint == "signal"}
    assert signal_scopes == {"lede", "full"}
    assert "dev300" not in {c.split for c in cells}
    # Grouped by model so each model loads once.
    order = [c.model for c in cells]
    assert all(order.index(m) + order.count(m) - 1 == len(order) - 1 - order[::-1].index(m) for m in set(order))


def test_balanced_head_keeps_every_class() -> None:
    labels: list[Sentiment] = ["bearish"] * 5 + ["bullish"] * 5 + ["neutral"] * 5
    items = [Example(f"x:{i}", "t", label, "tfns", "train") for i, label in enumerate(labels)]
    head = ho.balanced_head(items, 6)
    assert [e.label for e in head] == ["bearish", "bearish", "bullish", "bullish", "neutral", "neutral"]


def test_score_cell_applies_the_frozen_threshold_without_retuning(rules: Sequence[Rule]) -> None:
    rule = next(r for r in rules if r.run.variant == "decision")
    gold = Gold(("a", "b", "c", "d"), ("bullish", "bearish", "neutral", "bullish"))

    def record(probs: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {"kind": "decision", "probs": probs, "error": None, "t": {"wall_ms": 5.0}}

    sure = rule.threshold + (1 - rule.threshold) / 2
    records = {
        "a": record({"bullish": sure, "bearish": 0.0, "neutral": 1 - sure}),
        "b": record({"bullish": 0.0, "bearish": sure, "neutral": 1 - sure}),
        "c": record({"bullish": 0.0, "bearish": 0.0, "neutral": 1.0}),
        # Below the frozen min_p: abstains instead of calling bullish.
        "d": record({"bullish": rule.threshold - 0.1, "bearish": 0.0, "neutral": 1.1 - rule.threshold}),
    }
    row = ho.score_cell(HCell(rule, "tfns_val"), records, gold, n_boot=50)
    assert row["metrics"]["coverage"] == 0.75 and row["metrics"]["inversion_rate"] == 0.0
    assert row["dataset"] == "twitter-fns" and row["gap"] == pytest.approx(row["metrics"]["f05_macro"] - row["dev"]["f05Macro"])


# --- the holdout-once guard ------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_guard_refuses_a_second_run_resumes_an_interrupted_one_and_logs_force(
    capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str],
) -> None:
    guard: dict[str, Any] = {"runs": {}}
    assert ho.guard_mode(guard, "sha", force=False) == "fresh"
    ho.guard_start(guard, "sha", mode="fresh", selection_sha="sel", cells=3, reason=None)
    assert ho.guard_mode(guard, "sha", force=False) == "resume"
    ho.guard_complete(guard, "sha")
    with pytest.raises(ho.HoldoutError, match="runs once per frozen config"):
        ho.guard_mode(guard, "sha", force=False)
    assert ho.guard_mode(guard, "other-sha", force=False) == "fresh"
    assert ho.guard_mode(guard, "sha", force=True) == "forced"
    ho.guard_start(guard, "sha", mode="forced", selection_sha="sel", cells=3, reason="threshold bug fixed")
    entry = guard["runs"]["sha"]
    assert entry["status"] == "started" and entry["forced"][0]["reason"] == "threshold bug fixed"
    assert "HOLDOUT FORCED" in capsys.readouterr().err


def _args(**overrides: Any) -> argparse.Namespace:
    base = {
        "dry_run": False,
        "out_dir": None,
        "limit": 0,
        "model": None,
        "force": False,
        "reason": None,
        "allow_provisional": False,
        "skip_summaries": False,
        "concurrency": 1,
        "shared": True,
        "base_url": None,
        "n_boot": 50,
    }
    return argparse.Namespace(**(base | overrides))


def test_dry_run_needs_a_scratch_folder_and_model_filters_only_apply_to_it() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ho.HoldoutError, match="--out-dir"):
        ho.cmd_run(_args(dry_run=True))
    with pytest.raises(ho.HoldoutError, match="--model only narrows"):
        ho.cmd_run(_args(model=["qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0"]))


def test_dry_run_never_reads_the_guard_or_a_holdout_split(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    def forbidden(*_: Any, **__: Any) -> Any:
        raise AssertionError("the dry run touched the guard")

    seen: list[str] = []

    async def fake_run(args: argparse.Namespace, s: ho.Setup, inputs: Any, preds: Path, manifest: Path) -> None:
        seen.extend(c.split for c in s.cells)
        assert preds.parent == tmp_path and inputs.limit == ho.DRY_LIMIT

    monkeypatch.setattr(ho, "read_guard", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ho, "guard_start", forbidden)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ho, "_run", fake_run)
    monkeypatch.setattr(ho, "analyze_cells", lambda *a, **k: ([], []))
    assert ho.cmd_run(_args(dry_run=True, out_dir=tmp_path, model=["ministral-3:3b"])) == 0
    assert seen == [ho.DRY_SPLIT]
    report = json.loads((tmp_path / "holdout.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert report["dryRun"] and report["guard"] is None
    assert "(dry run)" in (tmp_path / "holdout.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_real_run_refuses_without_a_selection(monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    monkeypatch.setattr(ho, "SELECTION_JSON", tmp_path / "missing.json")
    with pytest.raises(ho.HoldoutError, match="run `select` first"):
        ho.cmd_run(_args())


def test_estimate_uses_dev_timings_and_doubles_qwen35_4b_for_the_ceiling(rules: Sequence[Rule]) -> None:
    ceiling = ho.ceiling_rule(PromptRegistry())
    qwen = next(r for r in rules if r.model == "qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M" and r.endpoint == "analyze")
    cells = [HCell(qwen, "tfns_val"), HCell(ceiling, "fpb_allagree")]
    est = ho.estimate(cells, {"tfns_val": 100, "fpb_allagree": 100}, summaries=0)
    per_call = {r["key"]: r["perCallMs"] for r in est["cells"]}
    assert per_call[cells[1].key] == 2 * per_call[cells[0].key]
```

```
def guard_start(
    guard: dict[str, Any],
    frozen_sha: str,
    *,
    mode: str,
    selection_sha: str | None,
    cells: int,
    reason: str | None,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    entry = guard["runs"].setdefault(
        frozen_sha,
        {"status": "started", "startedAt": _now(), "completedAt": None, "resumed": [], "forced": []},
    )
    entry.update({"selectionSha256": selection_sha, "cells": cells, "gitSha": git_sha()})
    if mode == "resume":
        entry["resumed"].append(_now())
    if mode == "forced":
        banner = "!" * 100
        print(
            f"{banner}\nHOLDOUT FORCED: frozen config {frozen_sha[:12]} already completed on "
            f"{entry['completedAt']}. This second run is logged in {_rel(GUARD)} and must be disclosed.\n"
            f"reason: {reason or '(none given)'}\n{banner}",
            file=log,
            flush=True,
        )
        entry["forced"].append({"at": _now(), "reason": reason, "previousCompletedAt": entry["completedAt"]})
        entry["status"] = "started"
    return guard


def guard_complete(guard: dict[str, Any], frozen_sha: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade_evals import report as rep

SAMPLE = rep.REPO_ROOT / "frontend" / "src" / "data" / "benchmarks.sample.json"


def sample() -> dict[str, Any]:
    payload: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(SAMPLE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return payload


# --- the BenchmarksV1 mirror -----------------------------------------------------------------


def test_mirror_matches_the_frontend_interfaces() -> None:
    ts = rep.ts_interfaces(rep.TS_TYPES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert set(ts) == set(rep.INTERFACES)
    for name, fields in ts.items():
        assert set(fields) == set(rep.INTERFACES[name]), name
        for key, type_text in fields.items():
            assert set(rep.ts_kinds(type_text)) == set(rep.INTERFACES[name][key]), f"{name}.{key}"


def test_the_committed_frontend_sample_validates() -> None:
    assert rep.validate(sample()) == []


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("mutate", "problem"),
    [
        (lambda p: p.pop("articles"), "missing key 'articles'"),
        (lambda p: p.update(extra=1), "unexpected key 'extra'"),
        (lambda p: p.update(version=2), "benchmarks.version"),
        (lambda p: p["signal"][0].update(scope="headline"), "benchmarks.signal[0].scope"),
        (lambda p: p["latency"][0].update(streaming="yes"), "benchmarks.latency[0].streaming"),
        (lambda p: p["selection"].pop("summary"), "benchmarks.selection: expected exactly"),
        (lambda p: p["articles"]["perSource"]["bbc"].pop("neutral"), "benchmarks.articles.perSource.bbc"),
        (lambda p: p["environment"].update(ramGb=True), "benchmarks.environment.ramGb"),
    ],
)
def test_validation_catches_shape_breaks(mutate: Any, problem: str) -> None:
    payload = sample()
    mutate(payload)
    assert any(problem in p for p in rep.validate(payload)), rep.validate(payload)


# --- assembly --------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@pytest.fixture
def empty_results(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    """Every input path points into an empty folder."""
    for name in (
        "FROZEN_JSON", "ARTICLES_JSON", "SUMMARY_JSON", "SELECTION_JSON", "LATENCY_JSON", "PREFLIGHT_JSON",
        "HOLDOUT_JSON", "EXTRACTION_JSON", "STATS_JSON", "GUARD",
    ):  # fmt: skip
        monkeypatch.setattr(rep, name, tmp_path / f"{name.lower()}.json")
    monkeypatch.setattr(rep, "GRID_DIR", tmp_path / "grid")
    monkeypatch.setattr(rep, "git_sha", lambda: None)
    return tmp_path


def test_missing_inputs_give_empty_sections_and_are_listed_never_invented(empty_results: Path) -> None:
    payload, missing = rep.build_benchmarks()
    assert rep.validate(payload) == []
    assert payload["sample"] is False
    assert payload["signal"] == payload["latency"] == payload["summary"] == payload["extraction"] == []
    assert {e["model"] for e in payload["selection"].values()} == {"-"}
    assert any("frozen_json" in m for m in missing) and any("select" in m for m in missing)
    assert any("holdout" in m for m in missing)


def test_sections_come_from_their_result_files(empty_results: Path) -> None:
    (empty_results / "latency_json.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "clean": True,
                "missing": [],
                "partial": [],
                "cells": [
                    {
                        "endpoint": "analyze",
                        "model": "m",
                        "scope": "full",
                        "streaming": True,
                        "backend": "native-metal",
                        "warm": {
                            "n": 30,
                            "totalMs": {"p50": 3000.0, "p95": 3900.0},
                            "ttftMs": {"p50": 900.0, "p95": 1200.0},
                            "signalMs": {"p50": 700.0, "p95": 800.0},
                        },
                    },
                    {"endpoint": "signal", "model": "m", "scope": "lede", "streaming": False,
                     "backend": "native-metal", "warm": {"n": 0, "totalMs": None}},
                ],
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )  # fmt: skip
    (empty_results / "stats_json.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(
            {
                "n": 3,
                "per_source": {"bbc": {"bullish": 1, "bearish": 1, "neutral": 1}},
                "pool": {"raw_agreement": 0.96, "cohen_kappa": 0.94},
            }
        ),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    payload, missing = rep.build_benchmarks()
    assert rep.validate(payload) == []
    assert payload["latency"] == [
        {
            "endpoint": "analyze",
            "model": "m",
            "scope": "full",
            "streaming": True,
            "backend": "native-metal",
            "n": 30,
            "p50Ms": 3000.0,
            "p95Ms": 3900.0,

        "n": 3,
        "perSource": {"bbc": {"bullish": 1, "bearish": 1, "neutral": 1}},
        "agreement": 0.96,
        "kappa": 0.94,
    }
    assert not any("latency_json" in m for m in missing)


def test_the_committed_results_assemble_into_a_valid_payload() -> None:
    payload, _ = rep.build_benchmarks()
    assert rep.validate(payload) == []
    assert payload["signal"] and payload["extraction"] and payload["summary"]


def test_readme_indexes_every_file_and_flags_undocumented_ones(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    for rel in ("frozen.json", "grid/signal__m.json", "latency/raw/20261018T000000Z.jsonl", "mystery.csv"):
        path = tmp_path / rel
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text("{}", encoding="utf-8")
    files = rep.results_files(tmp_path)
    assert files == ["frozen.json", "grid/signal__m.json", "latency/raw/20261018T000000Z.jsonl", "mystery.csv"]
    payload = {
        "generatedAt": "t",
        "selection": {e: {"model": "-", "reason": ""} for e in rep.ENDPOINTS},
        "signal": [],
        "latency": [],
        "summary": [],
        "extraction": [],
    }
    readme = rep.render_readme(files, ["latency.json"], payload)
    assert "| `grid/signal__m.json` | per-model /signal grid report" in readme
    assert "| `mystery.csv` | (undocumented" in readme
    assert "  - latency.json" in readme
    assert rep.describe("latency/raw/docker-cpu-20261018T000000Z.jsonl", ).startswith("raw docker-cpu")  # type: ignore[union-attr]
```

```python
def file_sha(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


# --- frozen rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Rule:
    """What one endpoint serves for one model after the freeze, with its threshold."""

    endpoint: Endpoint
    model: str
    run: RunSpec
    policy: EvalPolicy
    threshold: float
    role: Role
    dev: Mapping[str, float]


def _signal_variant(kind: str, schema: str | None) -> Variant:
    if kind == "decision":
        return "decision"
    if schema not in ("label", "ordinal"):
        raise HoldoutError(f"generative /signal schema {schema!r} is not label or ordinal")
    return cast(Variant, schema)


def rules_from_frozen(frozen: Mapping[str, Any], registry: PromptRegistry) -> list[Rule]:
    """Every frozen /signal and /analyze rule; a prompt that drifted since the freeze fails loudly."""
    roster = allowlist()
    rules: list[Rule] = []
    for model, endpoints in frozen["models"].items():
        spec = roster[model]
        for endpoint in ("signal", "analyze"):
            entry = endpoints.get(endpoint)
            if entry is None:
                continue
            ev = entry["evidence"]
            prompt = registry.get(endpoint, model, kind=spec.kind, version=entry["prompt"])
            if prompt.version != entry["prompt_version"]:
                frozen_version = entry["prompt_version"]
                raise HoldoutError(f"{model} /{endpoint}: prompt {prompt.version} != frozen {frozen_version}")
            dev = {f"articles_dev/{a['scope']}": a["f05_macro"]["point"] for a in ev["articles_dev"]}
            if endpoint == "signal":
                variant = _signal_variant(spec.kind, spec.signal_schema)
                policy = cast(EvalPolicy, ev["dev300"]["policy"])
                threshold = float(ev["dev300"]["threshold"])
                dev["dev300"] = ev["dev300"]["f05_macro"]["point"]
            else:
                variant = cast(Variant, entry["field_order"])
                policy, threshold = "ordinal", float(entry["ordinal_t"])
                grid_report = read_json(GRID_DIR / f"analyze__{model_slug(model)}.json")
                f05 = dev300_f05(grid_report, cell_name(entry["prompt"], variant), "ordinal")
                if f05 is not None:
                    dev["dev300"] = f05["point"]
            run = RunSpec(cell_name(entry["prompt"], variant), serving_spec(spec, variant), prompt, variant)
            rules.append(Rule(endpoint, model, run, policy, threshold, "finalist", dev))
    return rules


def ceiling_rule(registry: PromptRegistry, model: str = CEILING) -> Rule:
    spec = allowlist()[model]
    prompt = registry.get("analyze", model, kind=spec.kind)
    variant: Variant = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    run = RunSpec(cell_name(prompt.version_id, variant), serving_spec(spec, variant), prompt, variant)
    return Rule("analyze", model, run, "ordinal", float(spec.ordinal_t), "ceiling", {})


# --- plan ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class HCell:
    rule: Rule
    split: str
    scope: Scope | None = None

    @property
    def key(self) -> str:
        scope = f"/{self.scope}" if self.scope else ""
        return f"{self.split}/{self.rule.endpoint}/{self.rule.model}/{self.rule.run.name}{scope}"

    @property
    def model(self) -> str:
        return self.rule.model


def plan_cells(rules: Sequence[Rule], ceiling: Rule, winners: Mapping[str, str]) -> list[HCell]:
    """Finalists on the test articles and tweets; winners and the ceiling on the cross-domain sets."""
    cells: list[HCell] = []
    for rule in rules:
        scopes: tuple[Scope, ...] = ("lede", "full") if rule.endpoint == "signal" else ("full",)
        cells += [HCell(rule, ARTICLES, s) for s in scopes]
        cells.append(HCell(rule, TWEETS))
        if winners.get(rule.endpoint) == rule.model:
            cells += [HCell(rule, split) for split in CROSS]
    cells += [HCell(ceiling, ARTICLES, "full"), *(HCell(ceiling, split) for split in CROSS)]
    order = {m: i for i, m in enumerate(dict.fromkeys(c.model for c in cells))}
    return sorted(cells, key=lambda c: order[c.model])


def summary_pairs(winners: Mapping[str, str]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    return [(e, winners[e]) for e in ("summary", "analyze") if winners.get(e)]


def per_call_ms(cell: HCell) -> float | None:
    """Measured p50 per call of the same rule: the articles dev run for articles, else the dev300 grid."""
    rule = cell.rule
    if cell.split == ARTICLES:
        rows = (read_json(ARTICLES_JSON) or {}).get("rows", [])
        key = f"{rule.model}/{rule.run.name}/{cell.scope}"
        value = next(((r.get("latency") or {}).get("wall_ms_p50") for r in rows if r["key"] == key), None)
    else:
        report = read_json(GRID_DIR / f"{rule.endpoint}__{model_slug(rule.model)}.json") or {}
        entry: dict[str, Any] = next(
            (c for c in report.get("configs", []) if c.get("name") == rule.run.name), {}
        )
```

```python
def balanced_head(items: Sequence[Item], n: int) -> list[Item]:
    """The first rows of each class in split order, about n in all, so a small slice still has every class."""
    per_class = max(1, n // 3)
    seen: Counter[str] = Counter()
    out = []
    for item in items:
        if seen[item.label] < per_class:
            seen[item.label] += 1
            out.append(item)
    return out


class Inputs:
    """Model inputs per (split, scope, token budget), loaded once; only ids and labels leave this class."""

    def __init__(self, *, limit: int = 0, paths: ArticlePaths | None = None) -> None:
        self.limit = limit
        self.paths = paths or ArticlePaths()
        self._splits: dict[str, list[Item]] = {}
        self._extracted: list[Any] | None = None

    def _split(self, name: str) -> list[Item]:
        if name not in self._splits:
            examples: list[Item] = list(load_split(cast(SplitName, name)).examples)
            self._splits[name] = balanced_head(examples, self.limit) if self.limit else examples
        return self._splits[name]

    def items(self, cell: HCell) -> tuple[list[Item], dict[str, Any] | None]:
        if cell.split != ARTICLES:
            return self._split(cell.split), None
        if self._extracted is None:
            self._extracted = extract_all(load_articles("test", paths=self.paths), self.paths)
        scope = cell.scope or "full"
        items, identity = inputs_for(self._extracted, scope, cell.rule.run.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return list(items), {**identity, "articles": "test"}

    def gold(self, split: str) -> Gold:
        if split == ARTICLES:
            examples = load_articles("test", paths=self.paths)
            return Gold(tuple(e.id for e in examples), tuple(e.label for e in examples))
        rows = self._split(split)
        return Gold(tuple(e.id for e in rows), tuple(cast(Sentiment, e.label) for e in rows))

def read_manifest(path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return read_json(path) or {"cells": {}}


async def run_cells(
    client: OllamaClient,
    cells: Sequence[HCell],
    inputs: Inputs,
    *,
    preds_root: Path,
    manifest_path: Path,
    concurrency: int,
    shared: bool,
    log: TextIO = sys.stderr,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Model by model through the eval runner and its prediction cache; resumable cell by cell."""
    manifest = read_manifest(manifest_path)
    manifest["ollama_version"] = await client.version()
    manifest["backend"] = get_settings().ollama_backend_label
    for model, group in itertools.groupby(cells, key=lambda c: c.model):
        digest = await model_digest(client, model)
        prepared = [(cell, *inputs.items(cell)) for cell in group]
        pending = [
            cell
            for cell, items, identity in prepared
            if not {i.id for i in items}
            <= cell.rule.run.cache(cell.split, digest, preds_root, identity).done_ids()
        ]
        if pending:
            print(f"== {model}: {'' if shared else 'unloading others and '}warming up", file=log, flush=True)
            await make_resident(client, pending[0].rule.run, shared=shared, log=log)
        for cell, items, identity in prepared:
            run = cell.rule.run
            stats = await run_cell(
                client,
                run,
                items,
                split=cell.split,
                model_digest=digest,
                concurrency=concurrency,
                root=preds_root,
                inputs=identity,
                log=log,
            )
            records = run.cache(cell.split, digest, preds_root, identity).records()
            manifest["cells"][cell.key] = {
                "split": cell.split,
                "endpoint": cell.rule.endpoint,
                "model": model,
                "config": run.name,
                "scope": cell.scope,
                "role": cell.rule.role,
                "prompt_version": run.prompt.version,
                "run_config": json.loads(canonical_json(run.run_config(cell.split, identity))),
                "model_digest": digest,
                "cache_key": stats.key,
                "inputs": len(items),
                "done": len(records),
                "errors": sum(1 for r in records.values() if r.get("error") is not None),
                "concurrency": concurrency,
                "updated_at": _now(),
            }
            write_manifest(manifest, manifest_path)
    return manifest


async def run_summaries(
    client: OllamaClient, pairs: Sequence[tuple[str, str]], log: TextIO
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Test-article summaries through summary_eval: generate, score, then blind packets for the Opus judge."""
    from veritrade_evals import summary_eval as se

    paths = se.SummaryPaths()
    articles = se.load_eval_articles("test", ArticlePaths())
    typed = [se.parse_pair(f"{e}/{m}") for e, m in pairs]
    for pair in typed:
        run = se.GenRun.resolve(pair)
        await se.generate(
            client,
            run,
            articles,
            split="test",
            digest=await model_digest(client, pair.model),
            paths=paths,
            log=log,
        )
    summaries = {pair: se.load_summaries(paths, "test", pair) for pair in typed}
    rows = await se.score_split(client, articles, summaries)
    se.write_scores(paths, "test", rows, {p.key for p in typed})
    written = se.prepare_packets("test", articles, summaries, paths.judge)
    return {
        "pairs": [p.key for p in typed],
        "packets": len(written),
        "packetList": _rel(paths.judge.packet_list("test")),
    }
```

```python
def _split_sizes() -> dict[str, int]:
    sizes = {ARTICLES: len(_test_ids())}
    for name in (TWEETS, *CROSS):
        payload = read_json(SPLITS_DIR / f"{name}.json") or {}
        sizes[name] = int(payload.get("n", 0))
    return sizes


def _test_ids() -> list[str]:
    path = ArticlePaths().rows
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
    return [r["id"] for r in rows if r.get("split") == "test"]


def cmd_plan(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    args.dry_run = False
    s = setup(args)
    est = estimate(s.cells, _split_sizes(), len(s.pairs))
    for row in est["cells"]:
        print(
            f"{row['key']:75s} n={row['n']:5d} ~{row['perCallMs']:5d} ms/call ~{row['seconds'] / 60:5.1f} min"
        )
    print(f"summaries: {', '.join(f'{e}/{m}' for e, m in s.pairs)} on the test articles, then judge packets")
    print(
        f"{len(s.cells)} cells; estimated {est['totalSeconds'] / 3600:.1f} h at concurrency 1 "
        "(dev-run timings)"
    )
    return 0


async def _run(args: argparse.Namespace, s: Setup, inputs: Inputs, preds_root: Path, manifest: Path) -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    client = OllamaClient(
        args.base_url or settings.ollama_base_url,
        timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,
        keep_alive=settings.ollama_keep_alive,
    )
    async with client:
        await run_cells(
            client,
            s.cells,
            inputs,
            preds_root=preds_root,
            manifest_path=manifest,
            concurrency=args.concurrency,
            shared=args.shared,
        )
        if s.pairs and not args.skip_summaries:
            info = await run_summaries(client, s.pairs, sys.stderr)
            print(f"summary packets: {info['packets']} ({info['packetList']})", file=sys.stderr)


def _write(report: Mapping[str, Any], out_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
    write_json(out_dir / HOLDOUT_JSON.name, report)
    (out_dir / HOLDOUT_MD.name).write_text(render(report), encoding="utf-8")
    return [out_dir / HOLDOUT_JSON.name, out_dir / HOLDOUT_MD.name]


def cmd_run(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    if args.model and not args.dry_run:
        raise HoldoutError("--model only narrows a --dry-run; the holdout always runs every cell")
    s = setup(args)
    if args.dry_run:
        if args.out_dir is None:
            raise HoldoutError("--dry-run writes to a scratch folder: pass --out-dir")
        inputs = Inputs(limit=args.limit or DRY_LIMIT)
        preds, manifest = args.out_dir / "preds", args.out_dir / "manifest.json"
        asyncio.run(_run(args, s, inputs, preds, manifest))
        rows, missing = analyze_cells(
            s.cells, inputs, read_manifest(manifest), preds, args.n_boot, sys.stderr
        )
        report = build_holdout(
            rows,
            missing,
            frozen_sha=s.frozen_sha,
            selection_sha=None,
            guard_entry=None,
            summaries=None,
            n_boot=args.n_boot,
            dry_run=True,
        )
        for path in _write(report, args.out_dir):
            print(f"dry run: wrote {path}")
        return 0
    guard = read_guard()
    mode = guard_mode(guard, s.frozen_sha, force=args.force)
    write_json(
        GUARD,
        guard_start(
            guard,
            s.frozen_sha,
            mode=mode,
            selection_sha=s.selection_sha,
            cells=len(s.cells),
            reason=args.reason,
        ),
    )
    print(f"holdout {mode}: {len(s.cells)} cells, summaries {s.pairs}", file=sys.stderr)
    inputs = Inputs()
    asyncio.run(_run(args, s, inputs, PREDS_DIR, MANIFEST))
    write_json(GUARD, guard_complete(read_guard(), s.frozen_sha))
    return _analyze(s, inputs, args.n_boot)


def _analyze(s: Setup, inputs: Inputs, n_boot: int) -> int:
    rows, missing = analyze_cells(s.cells, inputs, read_manifest(MANIFEST), PREDS_DIR, n_boot, sys.stderr)
    report = build_holdout(
        rows,
        missing,
        frozen_sha=s.frozen_sha,
        selection_sha=s.selection_sha,
        guard_entry=read_guard()["runs"].get(s.frozen_sha),
        summaries=summary_block(s.pairs),
        n_boot=n_boot,
        dry_run=False,
    )
    for path in _write(report, HOLDOUT_DIR):
        print(f"wrote {_rel(path)}")
    if missing:
        print(f"{len(missing)} cells missing: {', '.join(missing[:5])}", file=sys.stderr)
    return 1 if missing else 0


def cmd_analyze(args: argparse.Namespace) -> int:
    """Scores cached predictions only; never calls a model, so it may run at any time after `run`."""
    args.dry_run = False
    s = setup(args)
    if s.frozen_sha not in read_guard()["runs"]:
        raise HoldoutError("no holdout run is recorded for the current frozen config; nothing to analyze")
    return _analyze(s, Inputs(), args.n_boot)
```

```
def stop_containers() -> None:
    names = run(["docker", "ps", "--format", "{{.Names}}"]).stdout.split()
    if not names:
        print("no running containers")
        return
    STOPPED_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    stamp = dt.datetime.now(dt.UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    with STOPPED_FILE.open("a") as fh:
        fh.write(f"# {stamp}\n" + "\n".join(names) + "\n")
    run(["docker", "stop", *names])
    print(f"stopped {len(names)} containers; restart with:\n  docker start {' '.join(names)}")


def restart_hint() -> None:
```

```
# Extraction matrix

Generated by `uv run python -m veritrade_evals.extraction_bench report` from local measurements; no article text is stored here.

- Data: the 90 committed articles (all splits, none tuned on) from 10 sources; stored HTML through the serving `veritrade.extract.registry.extract`; third-party extractors bring their own parser (parser column `(built-in)`).
- Quality: macro means over articles against the Opus gold body. Tokens are lowercased `\w+` runs; P/R/F1 are bag-of-words with multiplicity; a failed extraction scores 0. Leakage is the share of extracted tokens outside every 5-token window that also occurs in the gold body (successful extractions only). 95% CIs: bootstrap over articles (B=1000).
- Time: wall ms of one `extract` call (parse + extract), median of 5 runs per article after a warm-up, then p50/p95 over articles, failures included.
- Tokens: chars / 4 of the uncapped `full` input (title + body) at p50; lede = the `/signal` lede input at the decision model's budget.
- Install: decimal MB of the RECORD files a row adds to the backend core (its closure without any parser or extractor); own strategies add 0 beyond their parser.
- Signal: `clef-flash:9b-q8_0` v4 (grid best), served sentiment at p >= 0.8; agreement = share of articles whose verdict on the row's lede equals the verdict on the gold lede, title held at the gold headline; a failed extraction is a miss.
- Machine: Apple M4 Pro, 48 GB, Python 3.13.12; Ollama had a model resident in 85/90 per-article samples (another eval was running), mean 1-min load average 24.6.
```
