dark mode; the cards must still fit at phone width. Copy must be plain, precise and free of em-dashes.
Run \`uv run python scripts/check.py --full --frontend\` until it passes (lint, typecheck, prettier, vitest, build, type drift). You cannot run
Playwright e2e locally; just keep analyze.spec.ts consistent. Report exact commands and outcomes.`,
  { label: 'frontend', phase: 'Frontend', schema: IMPL_SCHEMA, model: 'opus' })
log(`frontend: ${fe ? fe.summary.slice(0, 300) : 'agent returned null'}`)

phase('Docs')
const docs = await agent(`${GROUND}\n${CONTRACT}\n
Backend and frontend are implemented in the working tree. Reports:
BACKEND: ${JSON.stringify(be)}
FRONTEND: ${JSON.stringify(fe)}
YOUR TASK: update the docs so a reviewer can find thresholds and understand cold starts. Read README.md and .context/docs/design/
{00-overview,05-latency,90-optional-backlog}.md first and touch only what is needed:
 - README: where per-model thresholds live (backend/src/veritrade/data/models.toml is the served source of truth, written by \`freeze\`
   with the evidence in evals/results/frozen.json; the UI shows each model's rule in the signal/analyze pickers and on every signal card;
   /api/models returns signal_rules), what "No signal"/abstained means (precision over recall: below the frozen threshold the service
   returns neutral with abstained=true), and the API response fields that were added (SignalResult.threshold/directional_tau,
   timings.inference.cold_start, meta event cold_start, ModelInfo.signal_rules) wherever the README documents responses.
 - Cold starts (README latency section and 05-latency.md): models stay resident for OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m; the first request after
   that pays the load, measured in the committed cold cells (generative 0.7 to 1.3 s over warm, nimble 0.9 to 1.2 s, clef-flash 5.4 to
   6.2 s, a 10.58 GB file; quote the numbers already in 05-latency.md, do not invent new ones); a num_ctx mismatch also forces a reload;
   the service now detects a cold start with a /api/ps residency probe that runs concurrently with the article fetch and flags it in
   timings and in the UI. Note that the committed latency numbers predate the probe (on a fetch-cache hit it adds one local /api/ps
   round trip, a few ms) without claiming a measured figure. Keep the existing backlog item about preloading default models at startup.
Keep the existing tone and table formats, no em-dashes, no invented measurements. Run \`uv run python scripts/check.py --fast\` at the end
(docs should not break it). Report what changed.`,
  { label: 'docs', phase: 'Docs', schema: IMPL_SCHEMA, model: 'opus' })
log(`docs: ${docs ? docs.summary.slice(0, 300) : 'agent returned null'}`)

phase('Review')
const LENSES = [
  { key: 'backend-correctness', prompt: `Backend correctness and concurrency. Scrutinise the residency probe in Job.prepare: cancellation when the
fetch raises (no leaked task, original exception type preserved, no ExceptionGroup), timeout handling, exception classes caught (never bare
Exception), tag naming (':latest'), context comparison only for generative models, behaviour on result-cache hits, streams, no_cache,
and that threshold/directional_tau are right for every policy path incl. the label-logprob -> ordinal fallback chain in inference/adapters.py.
Check signal_rules against policy_for for every model in models.toml. Run the relevant pytest files to prove claims.` },
  { key: 'frontend-ux', prompt: `Frontend correctness and UX. For each policy (probability with min_p 0.8; label-logprob with min_p 0 and tau 0.28;
ordinal t=1; ordinal abstention; missing threshold fields), reason through exactly what SignalCard renders (pill, note, Threshold stat,
markers) and whether it is correct and unambiguous. Check the cold-start plumbing for split mode (/signal JSON + /summary/stream) and combined
mode (/analyze/stream meta + done), cancellation/reset between runs (stale cold-start state leaking into the next run), dark mode and phone
width, accessibility (markers aria-hidden, stat text present), option labels in the pickers, MSW fixtures, unit/integration tests and the
e2e regex. Run \`pnpm --dir frontend test\` to back claims.` },
  { key: 'contract-docs', prompt: `Contract, drift and docs consistency. Verify backend/openapi.json and frontend/src/lib/api-schema.d.ts are
regenerated and in sync (run \`uv run python scripts/check.py --full\` and report the result), field names/descriptions match the agreed
contract, README and design-doc claims match the code exactly (thresholds, cold-start detection, numbers quoted only from committed results),
no em-dashes in any changed file (\`git diff\`), comments terse and WHY-only, nothing private or stray (.temp files are gitignored, nothing
else new should be untracked except intended source/test files).` },
]
const reviews = await parallel(LENSES.map(l => () => agent(`${GROUND}\n${CONTRACT}\n
You are an adversarial reviewer with the lens: ${l.key}. The change is in the working tree (\`git diff\`, \`git status\`).
${l.prompt}
Report only REAL defects you can demonstrate (concrete input/state -> wrong behaviour, or failing command output). Do not report style nits
the codebase itself does not follow, and do not edit files. An empty list is a fine answer.`,
  { label: `review:${l.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA, model: 'opus' })))
const findings = reviews.filter(Boolean).flatMap((r, i) => r.findings.map(f => ({ ...f, lens: LENSES[i].key })))
log(`review: ${findings.length} findings (${findings.filter(f => f.severity === 'high').length} high)`)

phase('Fix')
const fix = await agent(`${GROUND}\n${CONTRACT}\n
Reviewers reported these findings on the working-tree change:
${JSON.stringify(findings, null, 1)}
YOUR TASK: verify each finding yourself first (reviewers can be wrong); fix every one that is real, skip the rest with a one-line reason.
Then run \`uv run python scripts/check.py --full\` (backend + frontend + drift) and make it pass. Report per finding: fixed / not real (why),
plus the exact final check command and outcome.`,
  { label: 'fix', phase: 'Fix', schema: {
      type: 'object',
      properties: {
        per_finding: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', properties: { summary: { type: 'string' }, outcome: { type: 'string', enum: ['fixed', 'not-real', 'deferred'] }, why: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['summary', 'outcome', 'why'] } },
        final_check: { type: 'string' },
        files_changed: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
      },
      required: ['per_finding', 'final_check', 'files_changed'],
    }, model: 'opus' })

return { be, fe, docs, findings, fix }

"""Public API contract: request/response bodies, SSE event payloads and the error envelope."""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Literal

from pydantic import AnyHttpUrl, BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from veritrade.errors import ErrorCode
from veritrade.extract.types import ExtractorName, ParserName, Scope
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, FieldOrder, ModelKind, PolicyName, Sentiment


class _Strict(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")


# --- requests -------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class _ArticleRequest(_Strict):
    url: AnyHttpUrl
    model: str | None = Field(None, description="Allowlisted Ollama tag; endpoint default when omitted.")
    parser: ParserName = "selectolax"
    extractor: ExtractorName = "cascade"
    no_cache: bool = Field(False, description="Bypass fetch and result caches (used by latency benchmarks).")


class SignalRequest(_ArticleRequest):
    scope: Scope = Field("lede", description="lede = headline + opening paragraphs; full = whole article.")


class SummaryRequest(_ArticleRequest):
    pass


class AnalyzeRequest(_ArticleRequest):
    scope: Scope = "full"


# --- shared response parts ------------------------------------------------------------------


class CacheInfo(_Strict):
    fetch: Literal["hit", "miss", "joined", "bypass"]
    result: Literal["hit", "miss", "bypass"]


class InferenceTimings(_Strict):
    wall_ms: float
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    load_ms: float | None = None
    prompt_eval_ms: float | None = None
    eval_ms: float | None = None
    prompt_tokens: int | None = None
    eval_tokens: int | None = None


class Timings(_Strict):
    total_ms: float
    fetch_ms: float
    consent_ms: float | None = None
    parse_ms: float
    extract_ms: float
    inference: InferenceTimings | None = None
    cache: CacheInfo


class ArticleMeta(_Strict):
    url: str
    final_url: str
    title: str
    source: str | None = Field(None, description="Key from sources.toml when the domain is a known source.")
    published_at: str | None = None
    endpoint: Endpoint
    model: str
    model_kind: ModelKind
    prompt_version: str
    parser: ParserName
    extractor: ExtractorName
    extraction_method: str = Field(description="Strategy that produced the body (cascade resolves to one).")
    scope: Scope
    input_chars: int
    word_count: int
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    cached: bool
    backend: str = Field(description="Inference backend label, e.g. native-metal or docker-cpu.")


class SignalResult(_Strict):
    sentiment: Sentiment
    abstained: bool = Field(description="True when the call fell below the frozen confidence threshold.")
    policy: PolicyName
    confidence: float | None = None
    score: int | None = Field(None, ge=-2, le=2)
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float] | None = None


# --- responses ------------------------------------------------------------------------------


class SignalResponse(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    signal: SignalResult
    timings: Timings


class SummaryResponse(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    summary: str
    truncated: bool = Field(False, description="True when the summary was cut at the model's output limit.")
    timings: Timings


class AnalyzeResponse(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    signal: SignalResult
    entity: str | None = None
    summary: str
    truncated: bool = Field(False, description="True when the summary was cut at the model's output limit.")
    timings: Timings


class ErrorBody(_Strict):
    code: ErrorCode
    message: str
    hint: str | None = None
    retryable: bool = False
    upstream_status: int | None = None


class ErrorResponse(_Strict):
    error: ErrorBody


class ModelInfo(_Strict):
    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: list[Endpoint]
    installed: bool
    size_bytes: int | None = None
    evaluated: bool = Field(True, description="False for plumbing-only models (e.g. the CI decision model).")


class ModelsResponse(_Strict):
    models: list[ModelInfo]
    defaults: dict[Endpoint, str]
    parsers: list[ParserName]
    extractors: list[ExtractorName]
    scopes: list[Scope]


class HealthResponse(_Strict):
    status: Literal["ok", "degraded"]
    ollama_reachable: bool
    ollama_version: str | None = None
    backend: str
    version: str


# --- SSE event payloads (event name -> data model) ------------------------------------------
# /summary/stream: meta -> summary_delta* -> done
# /analyze/stream: meta -> sentiment (exactly once, position follows field order) + summary_delta* -> done
# Any failure after the stream opens emits a single `error` event and closes.


class MetaEvent(_Strict):
    meta: ArticleMeta
    fetch_ms: float
    parse_ms: float
    extract_ms: float
    cache: CacheInfo


class SentimentEvent(_Strict):
    signal: SignalResult
    entity: str | None = None
    elapsed_ms: float = Field(description="Milliseconds since the request was received.")


class SummaryDeltaEvent(_Strict):
    text: str


class SummaryDoneEvent(_Strict):
    result: SummaryResponse


class AnalyzeDoneEvent(_Strict):
    result: AnalyzeResponse


class ErrorEvent(_Strict):
    error: ErrorBody


SSE_EVENT_NAMES = ("meta", "sentiment", "summary_delta", "done", "error")

"""Steps every article endpoint shares: resolve, check the result cache, load, describe."""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ArticleMeta,
    CacheInfo,
    ErrorEvent,
    InferenceTimings,
    MetaEvent,
    SentimentEvent,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SignalResult,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
    SummaryDoneEvent,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
    Timings,
)
from veritrade.extract.scope import build_input
from veritrade.extract.types import Scope
from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade.services.article import LoadedArticle, load_article
from veritrade.services.cache import ResultKey
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

ArticleRequest = SignalRequest | SummaryRequest | AnalyzeRequest
StreamPayload = (
    MetaEvent | SentimentEvent | SummaryDeltaEvent | SummaryDoneEvent | AnalyzeDoneEvent | ErrorEvent
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Job:
    """A request with its model and prompt resolved; nothing has touched the network yet."""

    runtime: Runtime
    endpoint: Endpoint
    request: ArticleRequest
    url: str
    scope: Scope
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    key: ResultKey | None
    clock: StageTimer

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls, runtime: Runtime, endpoint: Endpoint, request: ArticleRequest, *, scope: Scope, clock: StageTimer
    ) -> Job:
        spec = runtime.registry.resolve(endpoint, request.model)
        prompt = runtime.prompt(endpoint, spec)
        url = str(request.url)
        key = None
        if not request.no_cache:
            key = ResultKey(
                endpoint=endpoint,
                url=normalize_url(url),
                model=spec.name,
                prompt_version=prompt.version,
                parser=request.parser,
                extractor=request.extractor,
                scope=scope,
            )
        return cls(runtime, endpoint, request, url, scope, spec, prompt, key, clock)

    def cached[R: (SignalResponse, SummaryResponse, AnalyzeResponse)](self, kind: type[R]) -> R | None:
        """The stored response marked as cached, with timings that describe this request."""
        hit = self.runtime.results.get(self.key) if self.key is not None else None
        if not isinstance(hit, kind):
            return None
        # A result hit runs no stage, so stage timings are zero and the article counts as a fetch hit.
        timings = Timings(
            total_ms=self.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=0.0,
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch="hit", result="hit"),
        )
        meta = hit.meta.model_copy(update={"cached": True})
        return hit.model_copy(update={"meta": meta, "timings": timings})

    def remember(self, response: SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> None:
        if self.key is not None:
            self.runtime.results.put(self.key, response)

    async def prepare(self) -> Prepared:
        loaded = await load_article(
            self.runtime,
            self.url,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            no_cache=self.request.no_cache,
        )
        text = build_input(loaded.article, self.scope, self.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return Prepared(
            job=self,
            loaded=loaded,
            text=text,
            meta=self._meta(loaded, text),
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch=loaded.fetch_status, result="bypass" if self.key is None else "miss"),
        )

    def _meta(self, loaded: LoadedArticle, text: str) -> ArticleMeta:
        article = loaded.article
        return ArticleMeta(
            url=self.url,
            final_url=loaded.page.final_url,
            title=article.title,
            source=article.source,
            published_at=article.published_at,
            endpoint=self.endpoint,
            model=self.spec.name,
            model_kind=self.spec.kind,
            prompt_version=self.prompt.version,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            extraction_method=article.method,
            scope=self.scope,
            input_chars=len(text),
            word_count=article.word_count,
            field_order=self.spec.field_order if self.endpoint == "analyze" else None,
            cached=False,
            backend=self.runtime.settings.ollama_backend_label,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Prepared:
    """A job with its article loaded and the model input built; only inference is left."""

    job: Job
    loaded: LoadedArticle
    text: str
    meta: ArticleMeta
    cache: CacheInfo

    def timings(self, inference: InferenceTimings | None) -> Timings:
        loaded = self.loaded
        return Timings(
            total_ms=self.job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=loaded.fetch_ms,
            consent_ms=loaded.consent_ms,
            parse_ms=loaded.article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=loaded.article.extract_ms,
            inference=inference,
            cache=self.cache,
        )

    def meta_event(self) -> MetaEvent:
        article = self.loaded.article
        return MetaEvent(
            meta=self.meta,
            fetch_ms=self.loaded.fetch_ms,
            parse_ms=article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=article.extract_ms,
            cache=self.cache,

def cached_meta_event(response: SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> MetaEvent:
    timings = response.timings
    return MetaEvent(
        meta=response.meta,
        fetch_ms=timings.fetch_ms,
        parse_ms=timings.parse_ms,
        extract_ms=timings.extract_ms,
        cache=timings.cache,
    )


def signal_result(verdict: Verdict) -> SignalResult:
    return SignalResult(
        sentiment=verdict.sentiment,
        abstained=verdict.abstained,
        policy=verdict.policy,
        confidence=verdict.confidence,
        score=verdict.score,
        probabilities=verdict.probabilities,
    )


def inference_timings(raw: ChatResult | DecisionResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None = None) -> InferenceTimings:
    """ttft_ms is passed in by streams, which measure it from request receipt to the first summary text."""
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        return InferenceTimings(wall_ms=raw.wall_ms, prompt_tokens=raw.input_tokens)
    t = raw.timings
    return InferenceTimings(
        wall_ms=raw.wall_ms,
        ttft_ms=ttft_ms,
        load_ms=t.load_ms,
        prompt_eval_ms=t.prompt_eval_ms,
        eval_ms=t.eval_ms,
        prompt_tokens=t.prompt_tokens,
        eval_tokens=t.eval_tokens,

"""/models and /health: both answer 200 whatever state Ollama is in."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import re
from typing import get_args

from veritrade import __version__
from veritrade.api.contracts import HealthResponse, ModelInfo, ModelsResponse
from veritrade.errors import VtError
from veritrade.extract.types import EXTRACTORS, PARSERS, Scope
from veritrade.services.runtime import InstalledTags, Runtime, tag_name

MIN_OLLAMA_VERSION = (0, 40, 4)
_VERSION = re.compile(r"(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+)")


def parse_version(text: str) -> tuple[int, ...] | None:
    match = _VERSION.match(text.strip().removeprefix("v"))
    return tuple(int(part) for part in match.groups()) if match else None


async def list_models(runtime: Runtime) -> ModelsResponse:
    installed: InstalledTags | None
    try:
        installed = await runtime.installed_tags()
    except VtError:
        installed = None
    models = []
    for spec in runtime.registry.models:
        tag = tag_name(spec.name)
        models.append(
            ModelInfo(
                name=spec.name,
                kind=spec.kind,
                endpoints=list(spec.endpoints),
                installed=installed is not None and tag in installed,
                size_bytes=installed.get(tag) if installed else None,
                evaluated=spec.evaluated,
            )
        )
    return ModelsResponse(
        models=models,
        defaults=runtime.registry.defaults,
        parsers=list(PARSERS),
        extractors=list(EXTRACTORS),
        scopes=list(get_args(Scope)),
    )


async def check_health(runtime: Runtime) -> HealthResponse:
    version: str | None
    try:
        async with asyncio.timeout(runtime.settings.ollama_probe_timeout_s):
            version = await runtime.ollama.version()
    except (VtError, TimeoutError):
        version = None
    parsed = parse_version(version) if version else None
    return HealthResponse(
        status="ok" if parsed is not None and parsed >= MIN_OLLAMA_VERSION else "degraded",
        ollama_reachable=version is not None,
        ollama_version=version or None,
        backend=runtime.settings.ollama_backend_label,
        version=__version__,
    )

"""Process-wide objects, built once by the app lifespan and shared by every request."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from collections.abc import Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from veritrade.config import Settings
from veritrade.errors import LlmUnreachable
from veritrade.fetch import Fetcher, FetchResult, SingleFlightCache
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec, Registry
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptRegistry, PromptSpec
from veritrade.services.cache import CachedResponse, ResultKey, TtlCache

# Installed Ollama tags -> size in bytes (None when Ollama does not report one).
InstalledTags = dict[str, int | None]
_TAGS_KEY = "tags"


def tag_name(name: str) -> str:
    """Ollama lists an untagged model as name:latest."""
    return name if ":" in name else f"{name}:latest"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Runtime:
    settings: Settings
    fetcher: Fetcher
    ollama: OllamaClient
    registry: Registry
    prompts: Mapping[tuple[Endpoint, str], PromptSpec]
    fetch_cache: SingleFlightCache[str, FetchResult]
    results: TtlCache[ResultKey, CachedResponse]
    tags: SingleFlightCache[str, InstalledTags]

    @classmethod
    def build(
        cls,
        settings: Settings,
        *,
        fetcher: Fetcher,
        ollama: OllamaClient,
        registry: Registry | None = None,
    ) -> Runtime:
        registry = registry or Registry.load(settings)
        prompt_registry = PromptRegistry()
        # Resolved up front so a broken prompt file fails startup instead of a request.
        prompts = {
            (endpoint, spec.name): prompt_registry.get(endpoint, spec.name, kind=spec.kind)
            for spec in registry.models
            for endpoint in spec.endpoints
        }
        return cls(
            settings=settings,
            fetcher=fetcher,
            ollama=ollama,
            registry=registry,
            prompts=prompts,
            fetch_cache=SingleFlightCache(
                max_entries=settings.cache_max_entries,
                ttl_s=settings.fetch_cache_ttl_s,
                error_ttl_s=settings.fetch_error_ttl_s,
                weigh=lambda page: len(page.html),
                max_weight=settings.fetch_cache_max_bytes,
            ),
            results=TtlCache(max_entries=settings.cache_max_entries, ttl_s=settings.result_cache_ttl_s),
            tags=SingleFlightCache(
                max_entries=1, ttl_s=settings.models_cache_ttl_s, error_ttl_s=settings.models_cache_ttl_s
            ),
        )

    def prompt(self, endpoint: Endpoint, spec: ModelSpec) -> PromptSpec:
        return self.prompts[(endpoint, spec.name)]

    async def installed_tags(self) -> InstalledTags:
        """Cached for models_cache_ttl_s, failures included, so a down Ollama is not probed per request."""
        result = await self.tags.get_or_create(_TAGS_KEY, self._list_tags)
        return result.value

    async def _list_tags(self) -> InstalledTags:
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(self.settings.ollama_probe_timeout_s):
                entries = await self.ollama.tags()
        except TimeoutError as exc:
            raise LlmUnreachable("Ollama did not list its models in time") from exc
        return {tag_name(str(entry.get("name", ""))): _size(entry) for entry in entries}


def _size(entry: Mapping[str, Any]) -> int | None:
    size = entry.get("size")
    return size if isinstance(size, int) else None

"""Confidence policies: raw model output -> Verdict, abstaining to neutral below the frozen threshold."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import ClassVar

from veritrade.inference.schemas import LabelOut, OrdinalOut, score_sentiment
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, Endpoint, PolicyName, Sentiment, TokenLogprob, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec

# Ties resolve to the safe class first; also the criteria order sent to decision models.
TIE_ORDER: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("neutral", "bullish", "bearish")
# Share of first-token mass allowed on tokens that could start several classes before we give up.
AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX = 0.05

_VALUE_START = {
    "label": re.compile(r'"label"\s*:\s*"'),
    "score": re.compile(r'"score"\s*:\s*'),
}
_SCORE_HEAD = re.compile(r"^(?:-|-[12](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?|[012](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?)$")
_SCORE_KEY = re.compile(r'"score"\s*:')


def winner(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Sentiment:
    best = TIE_ORDER[0]
    for sentiment in TIE_ORDER[1:]:
        if probabilities.get(sentiment, 0.0) > probabilities.get(best, 0.0):
            best = sentiment
    return best


def normalise(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> dict[Sentiment, float]:
    total = sum(max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) for s in TIE_ORDER)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("probabilities sum to zero")
    return {s: max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def _threshold(
    name: PolicyName,
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float],
    min_p: float,
    score: int | None = None,
    tau: float | None = None,
) -> Verdict:
    top = winner(probabilities)
    if tau is not None and top == "neutral":
        side: Sentiment = "bullish" if probabilities["bullish"] >= probabilities["bearish"] else "bearish"
        if probabilities[side] >= tau:
            return Verdict(
                sentiment=side,
                abstained=False,
                policy=name,
                confidence=probabilities[side],
                score=score,
                probabilities=probabilities,
            )
    confidence = probabilities[top]
    abstained = confidence < min_p
    return Verdict(
        sentiment="neutral" if abstained else top,
        abstained=abstained,
        policy=name,
        confidence=confidence,
        score=score,
        probabilities=probabilities,
    )


def label_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Labels a token's text could start; empty means the grammar would reject it."""
    return {s for s in TIE_ORDER if s.startswith(rest) or rest.startswith(s + '"')}


def sign_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Class implied by a token that starts an enum score (-2..2); empty when the grammar rejects it."""
    if not rest:
        return set(TIE_ORDER)
    if not _SCORE_HEAD.match(rest):
        return set()
    return {"bearish" if rest[0] == "-" else "neutral" if rest[0] == "0" else "bullish"}


def first_value_token(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob], key: str
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
    """The generated token that starts the value of `key` (minus any text before the value) and its
    alternatives as {text after the same prefix: probability}; None if tokens do not tile the content."""
    match = _VALUE_START[key].search(content)
    if match is None:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end > offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset]
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            return tok.token[len(prefix) :], candidates
        pos = end
    return None


def _first_token_distribution(
    content: str,
    logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None,
    key: str,
    classes: Callable[[str], set[Sentiment]],
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    found = first_value_token(content, logprobs or (), key)
    if found is None:
        return None
    chosen, candidates = found
    if len(classes(chosen)) != 1:
        return None
    mass = dict.fromkeys(TIE_ORDER, 0.0)
    ambiguous = 0.0
    for rest, p in candidates.items():
        # A token ending exactly where the value starts (e.g. a bare space) says nothing about the class.
        if not rest:
            continue
        hit = classes(rest)
        if len(hit) == 1:
            mass[next(iter(hit))] += p
        elif hit:
            ambiguous += p
    total = sum(mass.values())
    if total <= 0 or ambiguous > AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX * (total + ambiguous):
        return None
    return {s: mass[s] / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def label_probabilities(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    """First label-token probabilities renormalised over tokens the grammar accepts (Ollama reports
    pre-mask logprobs, so "positive" is dropped). None when the generated first token is shared by
    two labels or ambiguous tokens carry real mass."""
    return _first_token_distribution(content, logprobs, "label", label_classes)


def score_sign_probabilities(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    """Class probabilities of the score's sign ("-" bearish, "0" neutral, "1"/"2" bullish) from the tokens
    after the colon, whitespace-insensitive because tokenizers fuse " -". A generated bare space defers to
    the next token; a bare space that was not generated hides its sign and counts as ambiguous."""
    match = _SCORE_KEY.search(content)
    if match is None or not logprobs:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    mass = dict.fromkeys(TIE_ORDER, 0.0)
    hidden = 0.0
    path = 1.0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end >= offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset] if pos < offset else ""
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            chosen = tok.token[len(prefix) :]
            for rest, p in candidates.items():
                if rest == chosen:
                    continue
                if not rest.strip():
                    hidden += path * p
                elif hit := sign_classes(rest.lstrip()):
                    mass[next(iter(hit))] += path * p
            if chosen.strip():
                hit = sign_classes(chosen.lstrip())
                if len(hit) != 1:
                    return None
                mass[next(iter(hit))] += path * candidates[chosen]
                total = sum(mass.values())
                if total <= 0 or hidden > AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX * (total + hidden):
                    return None
                return {s: mass[s] / total for s in TIE_ORDER}
            path *= candidates[chosen]
        pos = end
    return None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProbabilityPolicy:
    """Argmax unless its probability is below min_p (then neutral, abstained). With directional_tau, a
    neutral argmax still yields the likelier directional class when that class reaches tau: models that
    park most of their mass on neutral are otherwise never pushed into a call."""

    min_p: float
    directional_tau: float | None = None
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "probability"

    def decide(self, probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Verdict:
        return _threshold(self.name, normalise(probabilities), self.min_p, tau=self.directional_tau)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LabelLogprobPolicy:
    """The probability rule (min_p, directional_tau) on first-token label probabilities. On a label
    collision `decide` returns None and the adapter re-asks with the ordinal schema; when its sign is
    unreadable too, the chain ends at the ordinal policy."""

    min_p: float
    directional_tau: float | None = None
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "label-logprob"

    def decide(self, out: LabelOut | OrdinalOut, chat: ChatResult) -> Verdict | None:
        if isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            probabilities = label_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs)
            return None if probabilities is None else self.threshold(probabilities)
        probabilities = score_sign_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs)
        return None if probabilities is None else self.threshold(probabilities, score=out.score)

    def threshold(self, probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float], score: int | None = None) -> Verdict:
        return _threshold(
            self.name, normalise(probabilities), self.min_p, score=score, tau=self.directional_tau
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrdinalPolicy:
    """Directional only when |score| >= t; a zero score is a confident neutral, not an abstention."""

    t: int
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "ordinal"

    def decide(self, score: int) -> Verdict:
        raw = score_sentiment(score)
        abstained = raw != "neutral" and abs(score) < self.t
        return Verdict(
            sentiment="neutral" if abstained else raw, abstained=abstained, policy=self.name, score=score
        )


Policy = ProbabilityPolicy | LabelLogprobPolicy | OrdinalPolicy


def _min_p(spec: ModelSpec) -> float:
    if spec.min_p is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{spec.name}: policy {spec.policy} needs min_p")
    return spec.min_p


def policy_for(spec: ModelSpec, streaming: bool = False, *, endpoint: Endpoint = "signal") -> Policy:
    """Streams and /analyze always threshold the ordinal score: it is read mid-JSON as soon as it
    closes, with no dependency on logprobs or on where the score sits in the output."""
    if spec.kind == "decision":
        return ProbabilityPolicy(_min_p(spec), spec.directional_tau)
    if streaming or endpoint == "analyze" or spec.policy == "ordinal":
        return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t)
    return LabelLogprobPolicy(_min_p(spec), spec.directional_tau)

"""Async Ollama client on httpx: the only Ollama path for the API, evals and probes."""

from __future__ import annotations

import dataclasses
import json
import time
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator, Mapping, Sequence
from types import TracebackType
from typing import Any, Self

import httpx
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, ValidationError

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings

    InferenceTimeout,
    LlmUnreachable,
    ModelUnavailable,
    SchemaViolation,
    VtError,
)
from veritrade.inference.schemas import ollama_format
from veritrade.inference.types import (
    SENTIMENTS,
    ChatResult,
    DecisionResult,

Message = Mapping[str, str]
# Greedy and seeded so evals and serving see the same output for the same prompt. Penalties are neutralised
# because Modelfiles set them (qwen3.5: presence_penalty 1.5), which skews outputs away from recent tokens.
FIXED_OPTIONS: dict[str, Any] = {

    "seed": 0,
    "presence_penalty": 0,
    "frequency_penalty": 0,
    "repeat_penalty": 1,
}

    """Generation hit num_predict before the JSON closed; `chat` keeps the partial output."""

        self.chat = chat


class _ChoiceAnswer(BaseModel):

    confidence: float


def _ms(value: Any) -> float | None:
    return value / 1e6 if isinstance(value, int | float) else None


def _int(value: Any) -> int | None:
    return value if isinstance(value, int) else None


def _str(value: Any) -> str | None:
    return value if isinstance(value, str) else None


def parse_timings(body: Mapping[str, Any]) -> OllamaTimings:
    return OllamaTimings(
        load_ms=_ms(body.get("load_duration")),
        prompt_eval_ms=_ms(body.get("prompt_eval_duration")),
        eval_ms=_ms(body.get("eval_duration")),
        prompt_tokens=_int(body.get("prompt_eval_count")),
        eval_tokens=_int(body.get("eval_count")),
        total_ms=_ms(body.get("total_duration")),
    )


def parse_logprobs(raw: Any) -> tuple[TokenLogprob, ...] | None:
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or not raw:
        return None
    return tuple(
        TokenLogprob(
            token=entry["token"],

def _error_text(response: httpx.Response) -> str:
    try:
        body = response.json()
    except ValueError:
        return response.text[:300]
    error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    return error if isinstance(error, str) else response.text[:300]


def _status_error(status: int, text: str, model: str | None) -> VtError:
    name = model or "?"
    if status == 404 or "not found" in text.lower():
        return ModelUnavailable(
            f"Model {name} is not available in Ollama: {text}",
            hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {name}` or pick an installed model.",

class OllamaClient:

    ) -> None:

        self.keep_alive = keep_alive
        self._http = http or httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url, timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout, connect=min(5.0, timeout))
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_settings(cls, settings: Settings | None = None) -> OllamaClient:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        return cls(
            settings.ollama_base_url,
            timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,
            keep_alive=settings.ollama_keep_alive,
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._http.aclose()

    async def __aenter__(self) -> Self:
        return self

    async def __aexit__(
        self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None
    ) -> None:
        await self.aclose()

    # --- transport ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _transport_error(self, exc: httpx.HTTPError, model: str | None) -> VtError:
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.ConnectError | httpx.ConnectTimeout):
            return LlmUnreachable(
                f"Cannot reach Ollama at {self.base_url}: {exc}",
                hint="Start Ollama (`brew services start ollama`) or point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at it.",
            )
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.TimeoutException):
            return InferenceTimeout(f"Ollama did not answer in time for {model or 'request'}: {exc!r}")
        return LlmUnreachable(f"Ollama connection failed: {exc!r}")

    async def request(
        self, method: str, path: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, *, model: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """One JSON round trip with Ollama errors mapped to typed VtErrors."""
        try:
            response = await self._http.request(method, path, json=payload)
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned non-JSON for {path}") from exc
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned an unexpected body for {path}")
        return body

    # --- chat -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _chat_body(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        stream: bool,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
        logprobs: bool,
        top_logprobs: int | None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": [dict(m) for m in messages],
            "stream": stream,
            "think": False,
            "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
            "options": {**(options or {}), **FIXED_OPTIONS},
        }
        if format is not None:
            body["format"] = format
        if logprobs:
            body["logprobs"] = True
            if top_logprobs is not None:
                body["top_logprobs"] = top_logprobs
        return body

    async def chat_raw(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[ChatResult, dict[str, Any]]:
        body = self._chat_body(
            model,
            messages,
            stream=False,
            format=format,
            options=options,
            logprobs=logprobs,
            top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
        )
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        raw = await self.request("POST", "/api/chat", body, model=model)
        wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        message = raw.get("message") or {}
        result = ChatResult(
            content=str(message.get("content") or ""),
            wall_ms=wall_ms,
            timings=parse_timings(raw),
            logprobs=parse_logprobs(raw.get("logprobs")),
            done_reason=_str(raw.get("done_reason")),
        )
        return result, raw

    async def chat(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> ChatResult:
        result, _ = await self.chat_raw(
            model, messages, format=format, options=options, logprobs=logprobs, top_logprobs=top_logprobs
        )
        return result

    async def chat_json[T: BaseModel](
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        out_type: type[T],
        *,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
        retry_cut: bool = True,
    ) -> tuple[T, ChatResult]:
        """Schema-constrained chat, validated, with one retry. Output cut at num_predict is retried with
        a doubled budget, or raised as OutputTruncated when `retry_cut` is off so the caller can salvage."""
        opts = dict(options or {})
        spent_ms = 0.0
        last_error: ValidationError | None = None
        for _attempt in range(2):
            result, _ = await self.chat_raw(
                model,
                messages,
                format=ollama_format(out_type),
                options=opts,
                logprobs=logprobs,
                top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
            )
            spent_ms += result.wall_ms
            try:
                parsed = out_type.model_validate_json(result.content)
            except ValidationError as exc:
                last_error = exc
                if result.done_reason == "length":
                    if not retry_cut:
                        raise OutputTruncated(model, dataclasses.replace(result, wall_ms=spent_ms)) from exc
                    if isinstance(opts.get("num_predict"), int):
                        opts["num_predict"] = opts["num_predict"] * 2
                continue
            return parsed, dataclasses.replace(result, wall_ms=spent_ms)
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} returned output that does not match {out_type.__name__} twice",
            hint=str(last_error)[:300] if last_error else None,
        )

    async def chat_stream(
        self,
        model: str,
        messages: Sequence[Message],
        *,
        format: Mapping[str, Any] | str | None = None,
        options: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
        logprobs: bool = False,
        top_logprobs: int | None = None,
    ) -> AsyncGenerator[str | ChatResult]:
        """Yield content deltas, then one final ChatResult; ttft is measured here, not by Ollama."""
        body = self._chat_body(
            model,
            messages,
            stream=True,
            format=format,
            options=options,
            logprobs=logprobs,
            top_logprobs=top_logprobs,
        )
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        ttft_ms: float | None = None
        parts: list[str] = []
        token_logprobs: list[TokenLogprob] = []
        try:
            async with self._http.stream("POST", "/api/chat", json=body) as response:
                if response.status_code >= 400:
                    await response.aread()
                    raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
                async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                    if not line.strip():
                        continue
                    try:
                        chunk = json.loads(line)
                    except ValueError as exc:
                        raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama sent a malformed stream line for {model}") from exc
                    if isinstance(chunk.get("error"), str):
                        raise _status_error(500, chunk["error"], model)
                    if parsed := parse_logprobs(chunk.get("logprobs")):
                        token_logprobs.extend(parsed)
                    delta = str((chunk.get("message") or {}).get("content") or "")
                    if delta:
                        if ttft_ms is None:
                            ttft_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
                        parts.append(delta)
                        yield delta
                    if chunk.get("done"):
                        yield ChatResult(
                            content="".join(parts),
                            wall_ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
                            timings=parse_timings(chunk),
                            logprobs=tuple(token_logprobs) or None,
                            ttft_ms=ttft_ms,
                            done_reason=_str(chunk.get("done_reason")),
                        )
                        return
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama stream for {model} ended without a done message")

    # --- decision models ------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def systemone(
        self, model: str, state: str, questions: Mapping[str, Mapping[str, Any]]
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        body = {
            "model": model,
            "state": state,
            "questions": {k: dict(v) for k, v in questions.items()},
            "keep_alive": self.keep_alive,
        }
        return await self.request("POST", "/v1/systemone", body, model=model)

    async def decide_sentiment(
        self,
        model: str,
        state: str,
        instructions: str,
        criteria: Mapping[Sentiment, str | None],
    ) -> DecisionResult:
        """One `choice` question; criteria order is the tie order, so callers put neutral first."""
        if set(criteria) != set(SENTIMENTS):
            raise ValueError(f"criteria must name exactly {SENTIMENTS}, got {list(criteria)}")
        question = {"type": "choice", "instructions": instructions, "criteria": dict(criteria)}
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        raw = await self.systemone(model, state, {SENTIMENT_QUESTION: question})
        wall_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        try:
            answer = _ChoiceAnswer.model_validate((raw.get("answers") or {}).get(SENTIMENT_QUESTION))
        except ValidationError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned an unexpected systemone answer") from exc
        if set(answer.probabilities) != set(SENTIMENTS):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned probabilities for {sorted(answer.probabilities)}")
        usage = raw.get("usage") or {}
        return DecisionResult(
            choice=answer.choice,
            probabilities={s: answer.probabilities[s] for s in criteria},
            confidence=answer.confidence,
            wall_ms=wall_ms,
            input_tokens=_int(usage.get("input_tokens")),
        )

    # --- utilities ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    async def embed(self, model: str, inputs: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        body = {"model": model, "input": list(inputs), "keep_alive": self.keep_alive}
        raw = await self.request("POST", "/api/embed", body, model=model)
        embeddings = raw.get("embeddings")
        if not isinstance(embeddings, list) or len(embeddings) != len(inputs):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"{model} returned {len(embeddings or [])} embeddings for {len(inputs)}")
        return [[float(x) for x in row] for row in embeddings]

    async def tags(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list((await self.request("GET", "/api/tags")).get("models") or [])

    async def ps(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return list((await self.request("GET", "/api/ps")).get("models") or [])

    async def show(self, model: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return await self.request("POST", "/api/show", {"model": model}, model=model)

    async def version(self) -> str:
        return str((await self.request("GET", "/api/version")).get("version") or "")

    async def unload(self, model: str) -> None:
        await self.request("POST", "/api/generate", {"model": model, "keep_alive": 0}, model=model)

def _csv(value: str) -> list[str]:

"""Model allowlist and per-endpoint defaults loaded from `data/models.toml`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tomllib
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from functools import lru_cache
from importlib import resources
from typing import Any, Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import ModelNotAllowed
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, FieldOrder, ModelKind, PolicyName

ENDPOINTS: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = get_args(Endpoint)
SignalSchema = Literal["label", "ordinal"]


class ModelSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    num_ctx: int | None = Field(None, gt=0)
    max_input_tokens: int = Field(gt=0)
    num_predict: dict[Endpoint, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    signal_schema: SignalSchema | None = None
    policy: PolicyName
    # 0 never abstains on the winning class.
    min_p: float | None = Field(None, ge=0, le=1)
    ordinal_t: int = Field(1, ge=1, le=2)
    directional_tau: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, lt=1)
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    # Frozen prompt version per endpoint; an endpoint left out serves the prompt file's `active`.
    prompt: dict[Endpoint, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    evaluated: bool = True

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _default_field_order(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict) and "analyze" in data.get("endpoints", ()) and not data.get("field_order"):
            return {**data, "field_order": "sentiment-first"}
        return data

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _check_consistency(self) -> ModelSpec:
        if self.kind == "decision":
            if self.endpoints != ("signal",) or self.policy != "probability":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{self.name}: decision models serve only /signal with the probability policy"
                )
        else:
            if self.policy == "probability":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models have no native class probabilities")
            if self.num_ctx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models need num_ctx")
            missing = [e for e in self.endpoints if e not in self.num_predict]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: num_predict missing for {missing}")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.signal_schema is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative /signal models need signal_schema")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.policy == "ordinal" and self.signal_schema != "ordinal":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: the ordinal policy needs signal_schema = 'ordinal'")
        if self.policy in ("probability", "label-logprob") and self.min_p is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: policy {self.policy} needs min_p")
        if self.directional_tau is not None and self.policy == "ordinal":
            raise ValueError(
                f"{self.name}: directional_tau needs class probabilities, not the ordinal policy"
            )
        if stray := sorted(set(self.prompt) - set(self.endpoints)):
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: prompt versions for endpoints it does not serve: {stray}")
        return self

    def serves(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> bool:
        return endpoint in self.endpoints


def parse_models_toml(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, ModelSpec], dict[Endpoint, str]]:
    raw = tomllib.loads(text)
    specs = {name: ModelSpec(name=name, **body) for name, body in raw.get("models", {}).items()}
    defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
    for endpoint, name in raw.get("defaults", {}).items():
        if endpoint not in ENDPOINTS:
            raise ValueError(f"models.toml: unknown endpoint in [defaults]: {endpoint}")
        defaults[endpoint] = name
    return specs, defaults


def read_models_toml() -> str:
    return resources.files("veritrade.data").joinpath("models.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def allowlist() -> Mapping[str, ModelSpec]:
    """Every model in models.toml, ignoring VT_MODELS (prompts and evals need the full roster)."""
    return parse_models_toml(read_models_toml())[0]


class Registry:
    def __init__(
        self,
        specs: Mapping[str, ModelSpec],
        defaults: Mapping[Endpoint, str],
        *,
        restriction: Iterable[str] = (),
        overrides: Mapping[Endpoint, str | None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        restricted = list(restriction)
        unknown = [name for name in restricted if name not in specs]
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"VT_MODELS names models outside models.toml: {', '.join(unknown)}")
        keep = set(restricted) if restricted else set(specs)
        self._all = dict(specs)
        self._specs = {name: spec for name, spec in specs.items() if name in keep}
        self._defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
        for endpoint in ENDPOINTS:
            override = (overrides or {}).get(endpoint)
            if override:
                if not self._is_allowed(endpoint, override):
                    raise ValueError(f"default model override {override!r} is not allowed for /{endpoint}")
                self._defaults[endpoint] = override
                continue
            configured = defaults.get(endpoint)
            if configured and self._is_allowed(endpoint, configured):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = configured
            elif fallback := self.allowed(endpoint):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = fallback[0].name

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, settings: Settings | None = None, *, toml_text: str | None = None) -> Registry:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        specs, defaults = parse_models_toml(toml_text if toml_text is not None else read_models_toml())
        overrides: dict[Endpoint, str | None] = {
            "signal": settings.default_model_signal,
            "summary": settings.default_model_summary,
            "analyze": settings.default_model_analyze,
        }
        return cls(specs, defaults, restriction=settings.model_restriction, overrides=overrides)

    def _is_allowed(self, endpoint: Endpoint, name: str) -> bool:
        spec = self._specs.get(name)
        return spec is not None and spec.serves(endpoint)

    @property
    def models(self) -> list[ModelSpec]:
        return list(self._specs.values())

    @property
    def defaults(self) -> dict[Endpoint, str]:
        return dict(self._defaults)

    def allowed(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> list[ModelSpec]:
        return [spec for spec in self._specs.values() if spec.serves(endpoint)]

    def resolve(self, endpoint: Endpoint, model: str | None) -> ModelSpec:
        allowed = ", ".join(spec.name for spec in self.allowed(endpoint)) or "none"
        hint = f"Allowed for /{endpoint}: {allowed}."
        if model is None:
            default = self._defaults.get(endpoint)
            if default is None:
                raise ModelNotAllowed(f"No model is configured for /{endpoint}.", hint=hint)
            return self._specs[default]
        spec = self._specs.get(model)
        if spec is None:
            reason = "is disabled by VT_MODELS" if model in self._all else "is not on the allowlist"
            raise ModelNotAllowed(f"Model {model!r} {reason}.", hint=hint)
        if not spec.serves(endpoint):
            raise ModelNotAllowed(f"Model {model!r} does not serve /{endpoint}.", hint=hint)
        return spec


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def get_registry() -> Registry:
    return Registry.load()

"""/signal: one non-streaming classification of the lede (or the full article)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from veritrade.api.contracts import SignalRequest, SignalResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import classify_signal
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, inference_timings, signal_result
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


async def run_signal(runtime: Runtime, request: SignalRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SignalResponse:
    job = Job.resolve(runtime, "signal", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SignalResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = SignalResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(verdict),
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(raw)),
    )
    job.remember(response)
    return response

"""/summary: a short summary of the full article, as one JSON body or as streamed deltas."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import SummaryDeltaEvent, SummaryDoneEvent, SummaryRequest, SummaryResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import SummaryResult, summarize, summarize_stream
from veritrade.inference.incremental import SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, Prepared, StreamPayload, cached_meta_event, inference_timings
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "summary", request, scope="full", clock=clock)


async def run_summary(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SummaryResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await summarize(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_summary_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = summarize_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case SummaryResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: SummaryResponse) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: SummaryResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> SummaryResponse:
    return SummaryResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        truncated=result.truncated,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),

"""/analyze: sentiment, entity and summary from one generation, as JSON or as streamed events."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    SentimentEvent,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
)
from veritrade.inference.adapters import AnalyzeResult, analyze, analyze_stream, score_verdict
from veritrade.inference.incremental import EntityClosed, ScoreClosed, SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import (
    Job,
    Prepared,
    StreamPayload,
    cached_meta_event,
    inference_timings,
    signal_result,
)
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "analyze", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)


async def run_analyze(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await analyze(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_analyze_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit, clock)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Events follow generation order, so the frozen field order decides where `sentiment` lands."""
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    entity: str | None = None
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = analyze_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case ScoreClosed(score=score):
                    yield SentimentEvent(
                        signal=signal_result(score_verdict(job.spec, score)),
                        entity=entity,
                        elapsed_ms=job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
                    )
                case EntityClosed(entity=name):
                    entity = name.strip() or None
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case AnalyzeResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: AnalyzeResponse, clock: StageTimer) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SentimentEvent(signal=hit.signal, entity=hit.entity, elapsed_ms=clock.elapsed_ms())
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: AnalyzeResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    return AnalyzeResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(result.verdict),
        entity=result.entity,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        truncated=result.truncated,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )

"""Thin async adapters from (model spec, prompt, article text) to validated outputs and verdicts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, overload

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import SchemaViolation
from veritrade.extract.dom import split_sentences
from veritrade.inference.confidence import (
    LabelLogprobPolicy,
    OrdinalPolicy,
    ProbabilityPolicy,
    policy_for,
)
from veritrade.inference.incremental import (
    EntityClosed,
    JsonFieldScanner,
    ScanEvent,
    ScoreClosed,
    SummaryText,
)
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient, OutputTruncated
from veritrade.inference.schemas import (
    ANALYZE_MODELS,
    AnalyzeOut,
    AnalyzeSentimentFirst,
    AnalyzeSummaryFirst,
    LabelOut,
    OrdinalOut,
    SummaryOut,
    ollama_format,
)
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, OllamaTimings, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec, SignalSchema
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
TOP_LOGPROBS = 20
# Product spec for every served summary; models overshoot it, so serving enforces it.
SUMMARY_MAX_SENTENCES = 3
SUMMARY_MAX_WORDS = 60
ELLIPSIS = "…"
# Terminal punctuation, closing quotes or brackets, then whitespace. The text end is no boundary:
# a cut right after "3." may sit inside "3.5".
_COMPLETE_SENTENCES = re.compile(r"(.*[.!?][\"'”’)\]]*)\s", re.DOTALL)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SummaryResult:
    output: SummaryOut
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AnalyzeResult:
    output: AnalyzeOut
    verdict: Verdict
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False

    @property
    def entity(self) -> str | None:
        return self.output.entity.strip() or None


def fit_input(text: str, max_input_tokens: int) -> str:
    """Cap at max_input_tokens (chars/4), cutting at the last whitespace so no word is split."""
    limit = max_input_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    cut = max(text.rfind(" ", 0, limit), text.rfind("\n", 0, limit))
    return text[: cut if cut > limit // 2 else limit].rstrip()


def chat_options(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint) -> dict[str, Any]:
    options: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if spec.num_ctx is not None:
        options["num_ctx"] = spec.num_ctx
    if endpoint in spec.num_predict:
        options["num_predict"] = spec.num_predict[endpoint]
    return options


def score_verdict(spec: ModelSpec, score: int) -> Verdict:
    """Verdict for a streamed or /analyze score; both always use the ordinal policy."""
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(score)


def _sum(a: float | None, b: float | None) -> float | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _sum_int(a: int | None, b: int | None) -> int | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _combine(first: ChatResult, second: ChatResult) -> ChatResult:
    # The fallback call's output decides; the reported cost covers both calls.
    t1, t2 = first.timings, second.timings
    return ChatResult(
        content=second.content,
        wall_ms=first.wall_ms + second.wall_ms,
        timings=OllamaTimings(
            load_ms=_sum(t1.load_ms, t2.load_ms),
            prompt_eval_ms=_sum(t1.prompt_eval_ms, t2.prompt_eval_ms),
            eval_ms=_sum(t1.eval_ms, t2.eval_ms),
            prompt_tokens=_sum_int(t1.prompt_tokens, t2.prompt_tokens),
            eval_tokens=_sum_int(t1.eval_tokens, t2.eval_tokens),
            total_ms=_sum(t1.total_ms, t2.total_ms),
        ),
        logprobs=second.logprobs,
        done_reason=second.done_reason,
    )


async def _signal_call(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str, schema: SignalSchema
) -> tuple[LabelOut | OrdinalOut, ChatResult]:
    out_type: type[LabelOut] | type[OrdinalOut] = LabelOut if schema == "label" else OrdinalOut
    return await client.chat_json(
        spec.name,
        prompt.messages(text, schema),
        out_type,
        options=chat_options(spec, "signal"),
        logprobs=True,
        top_logprobs=TOP_LOGPROBS,
    )


async def classify_signal(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> tuple[Verdict, ChatResult | DecisionResult]:
    """Label-logprob falls back label -> ordinal call (score sign) -> ordinal policy on the score."""
    text = fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens)
    policy = policy_for(spec, endpoint="signal")
    if isinstance(policy, ProbabilityPolicy):
        decision = await client.decide_sentiment(
            spec.name, prompt.state(text), prompt.instructions, prompt.criteria_map
        )
        return policy.decide(decision.probabilities), decision
    out, chat = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, spec.signal_schema or "ordinal")
    if isinstance(policy, LabelLogprobPolicy):
        verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is None and isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            out, second = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, "ordinal")
            chat = _combine(chat, second)
            verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is not None:
            return verdict, chat
    if not isinstance(out, OrdinalOut):
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name}: a label output needs the label-logprob policy")
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(out.score), chat


def _validate[T: BaseModel](out_type: type[T], content: str, model: str) -> T:
    try:
        return out_type.model_validate_json(content)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} streamed output that does not match {out_type.__name__}", hint=str(exc)[:300]
        ) from exc


def cut_to_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    """The text up to its last complete sentence, or all of it when no sentence has ended."""
    match = _COMPLETE_SENTENCES.match(text)
    return (match.group(1) if match else text).strip()


def cap_summary(
    text: str, max_sentences: int = SUMMARY_MAX_SENTENCES, max_words: int = SUMMARY_MAX_WORDS
) -> str:
    """Whole leading sentences within both caps; a first sentence over the word cap is cut at a word
    and ends with an ellipsis. Text already within the caps is returned unchanged."""
    sentences = split_sentences(text)
    kept: list[str] = []
    words = 0
    for sentence in sentences[:max_sentences]:
        count = len(sentence.split())
        if words + count > max_words:
            break
        kept.append(sentence)
        words += count
    if len(kept) == len(sentences):
        return text.strip()
    if kept:
        return " ".join(kept)
    head = " ".join(sentences[0].split()[:max_words]).rstrip(",;:")
    return head + ELLIPSIS


@overload
def _capped(out: SummaryOut) -> SummaryOut: ...
@overload
def _capped(out: AnalyzeOut) -> AnalyzeOut: ...
def _capped(out: SummaryOut | AnalyzeOut) -> SummaryOut | AnalyzeOut:
    summary = cap_summary(out.summary)
    return out if summary == out.summary else out.model_copy(update={"summary": summary})


def _salvage(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint, chat: ChatResult) -> tuple[int | None, str, str]:
    """Score, entity and sentence-cut summary decoded from JSON that num_predict cut off."""
    log.warning(
        "%s output from %s hit num_predict after %s eval tokens; salvaging the partial JSON",
        endpoint,
        spec.name,
        chat.timings.eval_tokens,
    )
    score: int | None = None
    entity = ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for event in JsonFieldScanner().feed(chat.content):
        match event:
            case ScoreClosed(score=value):
                score = value
            case EntityClosed(entity=value):
                entity = value
            case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                parts.append(delta)
    summary = cut_to_sentence("".join(parts))
    if not summary:
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name} reached its output token limit before writing a summary")
    return score, entity, summary


def _salvage_summary(spec: ModelSpec, chat: ChatResult) -> SummaryResult:
    _, _, summary = _salvage(spec, "summary", chat)
    return SummaryResult(_capped(SummaryOut(summary=summary)), chat, truncated=True)


def _salvage_analyze(
    spec: ModelSpec, out_type: type[AnalyzeSentimentFirst] | type[AnalyzeSummaryFirst], chat: ChatResult
) -> AnalyzeResult:
    """A cut generation still needs its score; summary-first output cut before it stays a violation."""
    score, entity, summary = _salvage(spec, "analyze", chat)
    if score is None:
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name} reached its output token limit before writing the score")
    out = _capped(out_type.model_validate({"score": score, "entity": entity, "summary": summary}))
    return AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), chat, truncated=True)


def _was_cut(chat: ChatResult, scanner: JsonFieldScanner) -> bool:
    return chat.done_reason == "length" and not scanner.done


async def summarize(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> SummaryResult:
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    try:
        out, chat = await client.chat_json(
            spec.name, messages, SummaryOut, options=chat_options(spec, "summary"), retry_cut=False
        )
    except OutputTruncated as cut:
        return _salvage_summary(spec, cut.chat)
    return SummaryResult(_capped(out), chat)


async def summarize_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | SummaryResult]:
    """Summary text deltas as they decode, then the validated result (no retry once tokens are out)."""
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(SummaryOut), options=chat_options(spec, "summary")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                if _was_cut(item, scanner):
                    yield _salvage_summary(spec, item)
                    return
                scanner.close()
                yield SummaryResult(_capped(_validate(SummaryOut, item.content, spec.name)), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event


async def analyze(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> AnalyzeResult:
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    out_type = ANALYZE_MODELS[order]
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    try:
        out, chat = await client.chat_json(
            spec.name, messages, out_type, options=chat_options(spec, "analyze"), retry_cut=False
        )
    except OutputTruncated as cut:
        return _salvage_analyze(spec, out_type, cut.chat)
    out = _capped(out)
    return AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), chat)


async def analyze_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | AnalyzeResult]:
    """Scanner events in generation order (ScoreClosed first when sentiment-first), then the result."""
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    out_type = ANALYZE_MODELS[order]
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(out_type), options=chat_options(spec, "analyze")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                if _was_cut(item, scanner):
                    yield _salvage_analyze(spec, out_type, item)
                    return
                scanner.close()
                out = _capped(_validate(out_type, item.content, spec.name))
                yield AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event
