```python
"""URL to Article: single-flight fetch, then extraction (off the event loop when it is slow)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from functools import partial
from typing import Literal

from veritrade.extract.registry import extract
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS, Article, ExtractorName, ParserName
from veritrade.fetch import FetchResult, normalize_url
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime

FetchStatus = Literal["hit", "miss", "joined", "bypass"]
# Own strategies on these parsers take 0.4-4 ms on real pages, less than handing off is worth; bs4 and the
# third-party extractors take 5-60 ms of Python, which a thread lets concurrent streams interleave with.
INLINE_PARSERS: frozenset[ParserName] = frozenset({"selectolax", "lxml"})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LoadedArticle:
    page: FetchResult
    article: Article
    fetch_status: FetchStatus
    fetch_ms: float
    consent_ms: float | None


async def load_article(
    runtime: Runtime, url: str, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName, no_cache: bool
) -> LoadedArticle:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    status: FetchStatus
    if no_cache:
        page, status = await runtime.fetcher.get(url), "bypass"
    else:
        fetch = partial(runtime.fetcher.get, url)
        shared = await runtime.fetch_cache.get_or_create(normalize_url(url), fetch)
        page, status = shared.value, shared.status
    if status in ("miss", "bypass"):
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = page.fetch_ms, page.consent_ms
    else:
        # A hit or join reports this request's own wait, not the download it reused.
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, None
    article = await extract_article(page, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    return LoadedArticle(page, article, status, fetch_ms, consent_ms)


async def extract_article(page: FetchResult, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName) -> Article:
    run = partial(extract, page.html, page.final_url, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    if extractor in PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS and parser in INLINE_PARSERS:
        return run()
    return await asyncio.to_thread(run)
```

```python
"""Network-free stand-ins: publisher pages from the skeleton fixtures and a scripted Ollama on respx."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import math
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from functools import cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import httpx
import respx

PUBLIC_IP = "93.184.215.14"
OLLAMA_URL = "http://ollama.test"
SKELETONS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "fixtures" / "skeletons"
# Synthetic model output; the escaped quote and the non-ASCII sign exercise the stream scanner.
SUMMARY = 'Acme Corp raised its outlook after "record" demand lifted revenue 12% to €3.1 billion.'
ENTITY = "Acme Corp"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Page:
    source: str
    url: str
    html: str
    body_markers: tuple[str, ...]


@cache
def skeleton_pages() -> dict[str, Page]:
    pages = {}
    for path in sorted(SKELETONS.glob("*/*.expected.json")):
        expected = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        html = path.with_name(f"{expected['slug']}.html").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        source = expected["source"]
        pages[source] = Page(source, expected["fixture_url"], html, tuple(expected["body_markers"]))
    return pages


class FakeResolver:
    """Hosts resolve to one public address unless the table says otherwise; no DNS is used."""

    def __init__(self, table: Mapping[str, list[str]] | None = None) -> None:
        self.table = dict(table or {})

    async def __call__(self, host: str, port: int) -> list[str]:
        return self.table.get(host, [PUBLIC_IP])


class NdjsonStream(httpx.AsyncByteStream):
    """Ollama's NDJSON chat stream, one line per delay; records how far it got and whether it was closed."""

    def __init__(self, lines: list[bytes], delay: float) -> None:
        self.lines = lines
        self.delay = delay
        self.sent = 0
        self.closed = False

    async def __aiter__(self) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        for line in self.lines:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.delay)
            self.sent += 1
            yield line

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        self.closed = True


def _first_token(field_name: str, value: Any) -> str:
    if field_name == "label":
        return {"bullish": "bull", "bearish": "bear"}.get(value, value)
    return "-" if value < 0 else str(value)


def _logprob(token: str, p: float, alternatives: Mapping[str, float] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    top = [{"token": t, "logprob": math.log(q)} for t, q in (alternatives or {token: p}).items()]
    return {"token": token, "logprob": math.log(p), "top_logprobs": top}


def _done(**extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "model": "m",
        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": ""},
        "done": True,
        "done_reason": "stop",
        "total_duration": 400_000_000,
        "load_duration": 5_000_000,
        "prompt_eval_count": 512,
        "prompt_eval_duration": 120_000_000,
        "eval_count": 40,
        "eval_duration": 260_000_000,
    } | extra


@dataclass
class FakeOllama:
    """Answers follow each request's `format` schema in its property order, as Ollama's grammar does."""

    router: respx.MockRouter
    label: str = "bullish"
    label_alternatives: dict[str, float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: {"bull": 0.9, "neutral": 0.08, "bear": 0.02}
    )
    score: int = 1
    entity: str = ENTITY
    summary: str = SUMMARY
    decision: dict[str, float] = field(
        default_factory=lambda: {"neutral": 0.06, "bullish": 0.9, "bearish": 0.04}
    )
    installed: tuple[str, ...] = ()
    version: str = "0.40.6"
    delay: float = 0.001
    chunk_chars: int = 4
    # Raised or returned by every /api/chat call when set.
    chat_failure: Exception | httpx.Response | None = None
    # Emit an Ollama error line after this many content chunks.
    stream_error_after: int | None = None
    # End any output that contains this text right after it with done_reason "length", as num_predict does.
    cut_after: str | None = None
    down: bool = False
    streams: list[NdjsonStream] = field(default_factory=list)

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        self.chat = self.router.post(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/chat").mock(side_effect=self._chat)
        self.systemone = self.router.post(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/v1/systemone").mock(side_effect=self._systemone)
        self.tags = self.router.get(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/tags").mock(side_effect=self._tags)
        self.version_route = self.router.get(f"{OLLAMA_URL}/api/version").mock(side_effect=self._version)

    @property
    def inference_calls(self) -> int:
        return self.chat.call_count + self.systemone.call_count

    def _check_up(self, request: httpx.Request) -> None:
        if self.down:
            raise httpx.ConnectError("connection refused", request=request)

    def _value(self, name: str) -> Any:
        return {"label": self.label, "score": self.score, "entity": self.entity, "summary": self.summary}[
            name
        ]

    def _chat(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        if isinstance(self.chat_failure, Exception):
            raise self.chat_failure
        if self.chat_failure is not None:
            return self.chat_failure
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        fields = list(body["format"]["properties"])
        content = json.dumps({name: self._value(name) for name in fields}, ensure_ascii=False)
        done_reason = "stop"
        if self.cut_after and self.cut_after in content:
            content = content[: content.index(self.cut_after) + len(self.cut_after)]
            done_reason = "length"
        if body["stream"]:
            return self._stream(content, done_reason)
        reply = _done(message={"role": "assistant", "content": content}, done_reason=done_reason)
        if body.get("logprobs") and fields in (["label"], ["score"]):
            reply["logprobs"] = self._logprobs(content, fields[0])
        return httpx.Response(200, json=reply)

    def _logprobs(self, content: str, name: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Three tokens that tile the content: everything up to the value, its first token, the rest."""
        first = _first_token(name, self._value(name))
        # json.dumps writes ": " after the key, then the label's opening quote or the bare score.
        start = content.index(":") + 2 + (name == "label")
        alternatives = self.label_alternatives if name == "label" else {first: 0.9, "0": 0.08, "-": 0.02}
        return [
            _logprob(content[:start], 0.99),
            _logprob(first, alternatives.get(first, 0.9), alternatives),
            _logprob(content[start + len(first) :], 0.99),
        ]

    def _stream(self, content: str, done_reason: str) -> httpx.Response:
        pieces = [content[i : i + self.chunk_chars] for i in range(0, len(content), self.chunk_chars)]
        chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
            {"model": "m", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": piece}, "done": False}
            for piece in pieces
        ]
        if self.stream_error_after is not None:
            chunks = [*chunks[: self.stream_error_after], {"error": "llama runner process has terminated"}]
        else:
            chunks.append(_done(eval_count=len(pieces), done_reason=done_reason))
        stream = NdjsonStream([(json.dumps(chunk) + "\n").encode() for chunk in chunks], self.delay)
        self.streams.append(stream)
        return httpx.Response(200, stream=stream, headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})

    def _systemone(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        body = json.loads(request.content)
        choice = max(self.decision, key=self.decision.__getitem__)
        answer = {
            "type": "choice",
            "choice": choice,
            "probabilities": self.decision,
            "confidence": self.decision[choice],
        }
        return httpx.Response(
            200,
            json={
                "model": body["model"],
                "answers": {"sentiment": answer},
                "usage": {"input_tokens": 264, "output_tokens": 0},
            },
        )

    def _tags(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        models = [
            {"name": name, "model": name, "size": 1_000_000 * (i + 1)}
            for i, name in enumerate(self.installed)
        ]
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"models": models})

    def _version(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        self._check_up(request)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"version": self.version})


def sse_events(text: str) -> list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]]:
    """(event, data) pairs from a text/event-stream body; comments and unnamed frames are skipped."""
    events = []
    for frame in text.split("\n\n"):
        name, data = None, []
        for line in frame.splitlines():
            if line.startswith("event: "):
                name = line.removeprefix("event: ")
            elif line.startswith("data: "):
                data.append(line.removeprefix("data: "))
        if name and data:
            events.append((name, json.loads("\n".join(data))))
    return events
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from typing import Any

import httpx
import pytest

from veritrade.api.contracts import CacheInfo, SignalResponse

from .fakes import FakeOllama, Page, skeleton_pages


def _sent(route: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body: dict[str, Any] = json.loads(route.calls.last.request.content)
    return body


@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", sorted(skeleton_pages()))
async def test_decision_model_reads_the_lede_of_every_source(
    api: httpx.AsyncClient, ollama: FakeOllama, pages: dict[str, Page], source: str
) -> None:
    page = pages[source]
    response = await api.post("/api/signal", json={"url": page.url, "model": "fake-decision:1b"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    body = SignalResponse.model_validate(response.json())
    assert (body.signal.sentiment, body.signal.abstained, body.signal.policy) == (
        "bullish",
        False,
        "probability",
    )
    assert body.signal.probabilities == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.06, "bullish": 0.9, "bearish": 0.04})
    meta = body.meta
    assert (meta.source, meta.endpoint, meta.model_kind, meta.scope) == (source, "signal", "decision", "lede")
    assert (meta.url, meta.final_url, meta.cached, meta.backend) == (
        page.url,
        page.url,
        False,
        "test-backend",
    )
    assert meta.prompt_version.startswith("signal/fake-decision:1b/")
    assert meta.word_count > 0
    assert body.timings.cache == CacheInfo(fetch="miss", result="miss")
    assert body.timings.inference is not None
    assert body.timings.inference.prompt_tokens == 264
    assert body.timings.total_ms >= body.timings.fetch_ms + body.timings.inference.wall_ms
    state = _sent(ollama.systemone)["state"]
    # The lede is the headline plus the opening paragraphs, never the end of the article.
    assert page.body_markers[0] in state
    assert page.body_markers[-1] not in state


async def test_generative_model_thresholds_label_logprobs(
    api: httpx.AsyncClient, ollama: FakeOllama, page: Page
) -> None:
    response = await api.post("/api/signal", json={"url": page.url, "model": "fake-label:1b"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    signal = SignalResponse.model_validate(response.json()).signal
    assert (signal.sentiment, signal.abstained, signal.policy) == ("bullish", False, "label-logprob")
    assert signal.confidence == pytest.approx(0.9)
    sent = _sent(ollama.chat)
    assert list(sent["format"]["properties"]) == ["label"]
    assert sent["logprobs"] is True
    assert sent["options"]["num_predict"] == 16
    assert sent["stream"] is False


async def test_generative_model_abstains_below_the_threshold(
    api: httpx.AsyncClient, ollama: FakeOllama, page: Page
) -> None:
    ollama.label_alternatives = {"bull": 0.45, "neutral": 0.4, "bear": 0.15}

    signal = SignalResponse.model_validate(response.json()).signal
```

```python
    route = router.routes[page.source]
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from typing import Any

import httpx
import pytest
import respx
from asgi_lifespan import LifespanManager
from starlette.types import Message

from veritrade.api.app import create_app
from veritrade.api.contracts import ErrorEvent, ErrorResponse, SummaryResponse
from veritrade.config import Settings
from veritrade.fetch import HttpFetcher
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
from veritrade.models_registry import Registry

from .fakes import FakeOllama, Page, sse_events

BLOCKED_URL = "https://apnews.com/article/vt-blocked"
PAYWALLED_URL = "https://www.wsj.com/articles/vt-paywalled"
STUB_URL = "https://www.cnbc.com/vt-skeleton/stub"
# Synthetic pages; no publisher text.
CHALLENGE_HTML = "<!doctype html><html><head><title>Just a moment...</title></head><body></body></html>"
PAYWALL_HTML = (
    '<!doctype html><html><head><script type="application/ld+json">'
    '{"@type": "NewsArticle", "headline": "Teaser", "isAccessibleForFree": false, "articleBody": "Teaser."}'
    "</script></head><body><p>Subscribe to read the rest.</p></body></html>"
)
STUB_HTML = "<!doctype html><html><body><article><p>Only a caption.</p></article></body></html>"

Setup = Callable[[respx.MockRouter, FakeOllama], None]


def _publisher(url: str, answer: httpx.Response | Exception) -> Setup:
    def setup(router: respx.MockRouter, _: FakeOllama) -> None:
        route = router.get(url)
        if isinstance(answer, Exception):
            route.side_effect = answer
        else:
            route.return_value = answer

    return setup


def _chat_fails(failure: httpx.Response | Exception) -> Setup:
    def setup(_: respx.MockRouter, ollama: FakeOllama) -> None:
        ollama.chat_failure = failure

    return setup


def _nothing(router: respx.MockRouter, ollama: FakeOllama) -> None:
    return None


ERROR_TABLE: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any], Setup, int, str]] = [
    ("/api/signal", {"url": "not a url"}, _nothing, 400, "invalid_url"),
    ("/api/signal", {"url": "ftp://files.example.com/a.html"}, _nothing, 400, "invalid_url"),
    ("/api/signal", {"url": "http://10.0.0.7/news/a.html"}, _nothing, 400, "blocked_destination"),
    ("/api/signal", {"url": "https://intranet.test/news/a.html"}, _nothing, 400, "blocked_destination"),
    ("/api/signal", {"url": "https://www.cnbc.com:8443/a.html"}, _nothing, 400, "blocked_destination"),
    ("/api/summary", {"url": "https://www.cnbc.com/a", "model": "gpt-9"}, _nothing, 400, "model_not_allowed"),
    (
        "/api/summary",
        {"url": "https://www.cnbc.com/a", "model": "fake-decision:1b"},
        _nothing,
        400,
        "model_not_allowed",
    ),
    (
        "/api/signal",
        {"url": PAYWALLED_URL},
        _publisher(PAYWALLED_URL, httpx.Response(200, html=PAYWALL_HTML)),
        422,
        "paywalled",
    ),
    (
        "/api/signal",
        {"url": STUB_URL},
        _publisher(STUB_URL, httpx.Response(200, html=STUB_HTML)),
        422,
        "extraction_empty",
    ),
    (
        "/api/signal",
        {"url": BLOCKED_URL},
        _publisher(
            BLOCKED_URL, httpx.Response(403, html=CHALLENGE_HTML, headers={"cf-mitigated": "challenge"})
        ),
        502,
        "source_blocked",
    ),
    (
        "/api/signal",
        {"url": BLOCKED_URL},
        _publisher(BLOCKED_URL, httpx.ConnectTimeout("slow")),
        504,
        "upstream_timeout",
    ),
]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("path", "body", "setup", "status", "code"), ERROR_TABLE)

    names = [name for name, _ in events]

    assert "summary_delta" in names
    assert names[-1] == "error"
    assert "done" not in names
    error = ErrorEvent.model_validate(events[-1][1]).error
    assert error.code == "model_unavailable"

    # A failed generation is never cached.
    ollama.stream_error_after = None
    retry = SummaryResponse.model_validate((await api.post("/api/summary", json={"url": page.url})).json())
    assert retry.timings.cache.result == "miss"


async def test_client_disconnect_closes_the_ollama_stream(
    settings: Settings,
    fetcher: HttpFetcher,
    ollama_client: OllamaClient,
    registry: Registry,
    ollama: FakeOllama,
    page: Page,
) -> None:
    ollama.delay = 0.02
    payload = json.dumps({"url": page.url}).encode()
    first_delta = asyncio.Event()
    request_sent = False

    async def receive() -> Message:
        nonlocal request_sent
        if not request_sent:
            request_sent = True
            return {"type": "http.request", "body": payload, "more_body": False}
        await first_delta.wait()
        return {"type": "http.disconnect"}

    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
        if message["type"] == "http.response.body" and b"event: summary_delta" in message.get("body", b""):
            first_delta.set()

    scope = {
        "type": "http",
        "asgi": {"version": "3.0", "spec_version": "2.3"},
        "http_version": "1.1",
        "method": "POST",
        "scheme": "http",
        "path": "/api/summary/stream",
        "raw_path": b"/api/summary/stream",
        "root_path": "",
        "query_string": b"",
        "headers": [(b"content-type", b"application/json"), (b"host", b"testserver")],
        "client": ("127.0.0.1", 50000),
        "server": ("testserver", 80),
    }
    app = create_app(settings, fetcher=fetcher, ollama=ollama_client, registry=registry)
    async with LifespanManager(app) as manager:
        await asyncio.wait_for(manager.app(scope, receive, send), timeout=5)
        # Checked as soon as the request cycle ends: the close must not wait for garbage collection.
        [stream] = ollama.streams
        assert stream.closed
    assert first_delta.is_set()
    assert stream.sent < len(stream.lines)
```

```python
    winner,
)
from veritrade.inference.ollama import parse_logprobs
from veritrade.inference.schemas import LabelOut, OrdinalOut
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, Sentiment, TokenLogprob
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec

from .conftest import lp, plain


def _chat(content: str, entries: Sequence[dict[str, object]]) -> ChatResult:
    return ChatResult(content=content, wall_ms=1.0, logprobs=parse_logprobs(list(entries)))


def _label_chat(first: str, rest: Sequence[str], alternatives: Sequence[tuple[str, float]]) -> ChatResult:
    head = ['{"', "label", '":', ' "']
    content = "".join([*head, first, *rest])
    p = dict(alternatives)[first]
    return _chat(content, [*plain(head), lp(first, p, alternatives), *plain(rest)])


# --- probability policy ---------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_probability_policy_calls_above_threshold() -> None:
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float] = {"bullish": 0.7, "neutral": 0.2, "bearish": 0.1}
    verdict = ProbabilityPolicy(0.6).decide(probabilities)
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained, verdict.policy) == ("bullish", False, "probability")
    assert verdict.confidence == pytest.approx(0.7)


def test_probability_policy_abstains_to_neutral_but_keeps_the_distribution() -> None:
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float] = {"bullish": 0.45, "neutral": 0.35, "bearish": 0.2}
    verdict = ProbabilityPolicy(0.5).decide(probabilities)
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained) == ("neutral", True)
    assert verdict.probabilities == pytest.approx(probabilities)
    assert winner(verdict.probabilities or {}) == "bullish"


def test_threshold_is_inclusive() -> None:
    assert not ProbabilityPolicy(0.5).decide({"bearish": 0.5, "neutral": 0.3, "bullish": 0.2}).abstained


def test_min_p_zero_never_abstains() -> None:
    verdict = ProbabilityPolicy(0.0).decide({"bullish": 0.34, "neutral": 0.33, "bearish": 0.33})
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained) == ("bullish", False)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("probabilities", "expected", "abstained"),
    [
        # Neutral argmax, directional class at or above tau: the directional class is called.
        ({"neutral": 0.6, "bullish": 0.3, "bearish": 0.1}, "bullish", False),
        ({"neutral": 0.55, "bullish": 0.1, "bearish": 0.35}, "bearish", False),
        # Below tau the argmax + min_p rule stands.
        ({"neutral": 0.7, "bullish": 0.2, "bearish": 0.1}, "neutral", False),
        ({"neutral": 0.4, "bullish": 0.29, "bearish": 0.31}, "bearish", False),
        ({"neutral": 0.45, "bullish": 0.28, "bearish": 0.27}, "neutral", True),
        # A directional argmax is never touched by tau, even under min_p.
        ({"bullish": 0.45, "neutral": 0.4, "bearish": 0.15}, "neutral", True),
    ],
)
def test_directional_tau_only_overrides_a_neutral_argmax(
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float], expected: str, abstained: bool
) -> None:
    verdict = ProbabilityPolicy(0.5, directional_tau=0.3).decide(probabilities)
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained, verdict.policy) == (expected, abstained, "probability")
    assert verdict.probabilities == pytest.approx(probabilities)


def test_directional_tau_ties_between_directions_go_bullish() -> None:
    verdict = ProbabilityPolicy(0.5, directional_tau=0.3).decide(
        {"neutral": 0.4, "bullish": 0.3, "bearish": 0.3}
    )
    assert verdict.sentiment == "bullish"


def test_policy_for_carries_tau_and_leaves_decision_models_alone_when_unset(
    decision_spec: ModelSpec, label_spec: ModelSpec
) -> None:
    neutral_lean: dict[Sentiment, float] = {"neutral": 0.62, "bullish": 0.33, "bearish": 0.05}
    plain = policy_for(decision_spec)
    assert plain == ProbabilityPolicy(0.5, None)
    assert isinstance(plain, ProbabilityPolicy)
    assert plain.decide(neutral_lean).sentiment == "neutral"
    with_tau = policy_for(decision_spec.model_copy(update={"directional_tau": 0.3}))
    assert isinstance(with_tau, ProbabilityPolicy)
    assert with_tau.decide(neutral_lean).sentiment == "bullish"
    label = policy_for(label_spec.model_copy(update={"directional_tau": 0.3, "min_p": 0.0}))
    assert label == LabelLogprobPolicy(0.0, 0.3)
    assert isinstance(label, LabelLogprobPolicy)
    chat = _label_chat("neutral", ['"}'], [("neutral", 0.62), ("bull", 0.33), ("bear", 0.05)])
    verdict = label.decide(LabelOut(label="neutral"), chat)
    assert verdict is not None
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained, verdict.policy) == ("bullish", False, "label-logprob")


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("probabilities", "expected"),
    [
        ({"bullish": 0.4, "neutral": 0.4, "bearish": 0.2}, "neutral"),
        ({"bearish": 0.4, "neutral": 0.4, "bullish": 0.2}, "neutral"),
        ({"bullish": 0.45, "bearish": 0.45, "neutral": 0.1}, "bullish"),
        ({"bullish": 1 / 3, "bearish": 1 / 3, "neutral": 1 / 3}, "neutral"),
    ],
)
def test_ties_resolve_neutral_first(probabilities: dict[str, float], expected: str) -> None:
    assert winner(probabilities) == expected  # type: ignore[arg-type]


def test_normalise() -> None:
    assert normalise({"bullish": 2.0, "neutral": 1.0, "bearish": 1.0}) == {
        "neutral": 0.25,
        "bullish": 0.5,
        "bearish": 0.25,
    }
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="zero"):
        normalise({"bullish": 0.0})


# --- ordinal policy -------------------------------------------------------------------------


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("t", "score", "sentiment", "abstained"),
    [
        (1, 2, "bullish", False),
        (1, 1, "bullish", False),
        (1, 0, "neutral", False),
        (1, -1, "bearish", False),
        (2, 1, "neutral", True),
        (2, -1, "neutral", True),
        (2, -2, "bearish", False),
        (2, 0, "neutral", False),
    ],
)
def test_ordinal_policy(t: int, score: int, sentiment: str, abstained: bool) -> None:
    verdict = OrdinalPolicy(t).decide(score)
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained, verdict.score) == (sentiment, abstained, score)
    assert verdict.policy == "ordinal"
    assert verdict.probabilities is None


# --- label-logprob policy ------------------------------------------------------------------


def test_label_probabilities_drop_grammar_invalid_tokens_and_renormalise() -> None:
    chat = _label_chat(
        "bull",
        ["ish", '"}'],
        [("bull", 0.5), ("neutral", 0.3), ("bear", 0.1), ("positive", 0.1)],
    )
    probabilities = label_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs)
    assert probabilities == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.3 / 0.9, "bullish": 0.5 / 0.9, "bearish": 0.1 / 0.9})


def test_alternatives_for_the_same_label_add_up() -> None:
    chat = _label_chat("neutral", ['"}'], [("neutral", 0.3), ("ne", 0.2), ("bull", 0.4), ("bear", 0.1)])
    probabilities = label_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs) or {}
    assert probabilities["neutral"] == pytest.approx(0.5)


def test_reported_argmax_wins_over_the_generated_label() -> None:
    # Seen live on qwen3.5:0.8b: greedy emitted "neutral" while the reported distribution favoured "bear".
    chat = _label_chat("neutral", ['"}'], [("bear", 0.59), ("neutral", 0.35), ("bull", 0.06)])
    verdict = LabelLogprobPolicy(0.5).decide(LabelOut(label="neutral"), chat)
    assert verdict is not None
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained) == ("bearish", False)


def test_value_token_that_also_carries_the_opening_quote() -> None:
    content = '{"label": "bearish"}'
    tokens = [
        *plain(['{"', "label", '":']),
        lp(' "bear', 0.7, [(' "bear', 0.7), (' "neutral', 0.2), (' "bull', 0.05), ('"bull', 0.05)]),
        *plain(['ish"}']),
    ]
    probabilities = label_probabilities(content, parse_logprobs(tokens))
    # '"bull' lacks the leading space the chosen token carries, so it is a different path and dropped.
    assert probabilities == pytest.approx(
        {"neutral": 0.2 / 0.95, "bullish": 0.05 / 0.95, "bearish": 0.7 / 0.95}
    )


def test_label_verdict_abstains_below_min_p() -> None:
    chat = _label_chat("bull", ["ish", '"}'], [("bull", 0.45), ("neutral", 0.35), ("bear", 0.2)])
    verdict = LabelLogprobPolicy(0.5).decide(LabelOut(label="bullish"), chat)
    assert verdict is not None
    assert (verdict.sentiment, verdict.abstained, verdict.policy) == ("neutral", True, "label-logprob")
    assert verdict.probabilities
    assert verdict.probabilities["bullish"] == pytest.approx(0.45)


def test_colliding_first_token_returns_none() -> None:
    chat = _label_chat("b", ["ullish", '"}'], [("b", 0.8), ("neutral", 0.2)])
    assert label_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs) is None
    assert LabelLogprobPolicy(0.5).decide(LabelOut(label="bullish"), chat) is None


def test_ambiguous_alternatives_with_real_mass_return_none() -> None:
    heavy = _label_chat("bull", ["ish", '"}'], [("bull", 0.6), ("b", 0.3), ("neutral", 0.1)])
    assert label_probabilities(heavy.content, heavy.logprobs) is None
    light = _label_chat("bull", ["ish", '"}'], [("bull", 0.6), ("b", 0.01), ("neutral", 0.39)])
    assert label_probabilities(light.content, light.logprobs) == pytest.approx(
        {"neutral": 0.39 / 0.99, "bullish": 0.6 / 0.99, "bearish": 0.0}
    )


def _score(content: str, tokens: Sequence[dict[str, object]]) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    return score_sign_probabilities(content, parse_logprobs(list(tokens)))


def test_fused_space_minus_with_a_heavy_bare_space_alternative_hides_the_sign() -> None:
    # Seen live on qwen3.5:0.8b: " -" 0.70 next to a bare " " 0.28, whose continuation is never observed.
    tokens = [*plain(['{"', "score", '":']), lp(" -", 0.7, [(" -", 0.7), (" ", 0.27), (" 0", 0.03)])]
    assert _score('{"score": -2}', [*tokens, *plain(["2}"])]) is None


def test_fused_space_minus_counts_as_negative() -> None:
    first = lp(" -", 0.95, [(" -", 0.95), (" 0", 0.03), (" ", 0.02)])
    probabilities = _score('{"score": -1}', [*plain(['{"', "score", '":']), first, *plain(["1", "}"])])
    assert probabilities == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.03 / 0.98, "bullish": 0.0, "bearish": 0.95 / 0.98})


def test_a_generated_bare_space_defers_to_the_digit_and_keeps_its_signed_alternatives() -> None:
    # The bearish mass sits on " -" one token before the digit that decides the other classes.
    space = lp(" ", 0.9, [(" ", 0.9), (" -", 0.08), (' "', 0.02)])
    digit = lp("1", 0.6, [("1", 0.6), ("2", 0.3), ("0", 0.1)])
    probabilities = _score(
        '{"score": 1}', [*plain(['{"', "score"]), lp('":', 1.0), space, digit, *plain(["}"])]
    )
    total = 0.08 + 0.9 * 0.9 + 0.9 * 0.1
    assert probabilities == pytest.approx(
        {"neutral": 0.9 * 0.1 / total, "bullish": 0.9 * 0.9 / total, "bearish": 0.08 / total}
    )


def test_sign_fused_into_the_colon_token() -> None:
    colon = lp('":-', 0.9, [('":-', 0.9), ('":0', 0.06), ('": ', 0.04)])
    probabilities = _score('{"score":-2}', [*plain(['{"', "score"]), colon, *plain(["2", "}"])])
    assert probabilities == pytest.approx({"neutral": 0.06 / 0.96, "bullish": 0.0, "bearish": 0.9 / 0.96})


def test_colon_step_alternatives_that_already_carry_the_sign_count() -> None:
    colon = lp('":', 0.95, [('":', 0.95), ('":-', 0.05)])
    first = lp("0", 0.8, [("0", 0.8), ("1", 0.2)])
    probabilities = _score('{"score":0}', [*plain(['{"', "score"]), colon, first, *plain(["}"])])
    total = 0.05 + 0.95
    assert probabilities == pytest.approx(
        {"neutral": 0.95 * 0.8 / total, "bullish": 0.95 * 0.2 / total, "bearish": 0.05 / total}
    )


def test_tokens_that_do_not_tile_the_content_return_none() -> None:
    chat = _chat('{"label": "bullish"}', plain(['{"', "lab", '": "', "bullish", '"}']))
    assert label_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs) is None
    assert label_probabilities('{"label": "bullish"}', None) is None


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("score", "first", "alternatives", "expected"),
    [
        (-1, "-", [("-", 0.6), ("0", 0.3), ("1", 0.05), ("2", 0.05)], {"bearish": 0.6, "neutral": 0.3}),
        (2, "2", [("2", 0.5), ("1", 0.3), ("-", 0.1), ("3", 0.1)], {"bullish": 0.8 / 0.9}),
        (0, "0", [("0", 0.5), ("-1", 0.25), ("1", 0.25)], {"neutral": 0.5, "bearish": 0.25}),
    ],
)
def test_score_sign_probabilities(
    score: int, first: str, alternatives: list[tuple[str, float]], expected: dict[Sentiment, float]
) -> None:
    head = ['{"', "score", '":', " "]
    rest = [str(score)[len(first) :], "}"] if len(str(score)) > len(first) else ["}"]
    content = "".join([*head, first, *rest])
    chat = _chat(content, [*plain(head), lp(first, dict(alternatives)[first], alternatives), *plain(rest)])
    probabilities = score_sign_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs) or {}
    for sentiment, p in expected.items():
        assert probabilities[sentiment] == pytest.approx(p)
    verdict = LabelLogprobPolicy(0.5).decide(OrdinalOut(score=score), chat)
    assert verdict is not None
    assert verdict.score == score


def test_policy_for(label_spec: ModelSpec, decision_spec: ModelSpec, ordinal_spec: ModelSpec) -> None:
    assert isinstance(policy_for(decision_spec), ProbabilityPolicy)
    assert isinstance(policy_for(decision_spec, True), ProbabilityPolicy)
    assert isinstance(policy_for(label_spec), LabelLogprobPolicy)
    assert policy_for(label_spec, True) == OrdinalPolicy(1)
    assert policy_for(label_spec, endpoint="analyze") == OrdinalPolicy(1)
    assert policy_for(ordinal_spec, endpoint="analyze") == OrdinalPolicy(2)


def test_parse_logprobs_keeps_alternatives() -> None:
    parsed = parse_logprobs([lp("bull", 0.5, [("bull", 0.5), ("bear", 0.25)])])
    assert parsed == (
        TokenLogprob("bull", math.log(0.5), (("bull", math.log(0.5)), ("bear", math.log(0.25)))),
    )
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json
import math
from collections.abc import AsyncIterator, Iterator, Sequence
from typing import Any

import httpx
import pytest
import respx

from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec

BASE_URL = "http://ollama.test"


@pytest.fixture
def mock_ollama() -> Iterator[respx.MockRouter]:
    with respx.mock(base_url=BASE_URL, assert_all_called=False) as router:
        yield router

async def client() -> AsyncIterator[OllamaClient]:
    ollama = OllamaClient(BASE_URL, timeout=2.0, keep_alive="5m")

    await ollama.aclose()

@pytest.fixture

        name="qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M",
        kind="generative",
        endpoints=("summary", "analyze"),
        num_ctx=8192,
        max_input_tokens=3000,
        num_predict={"summary": 160, "analyze": 200},
        policy="ordinal",
        ordinal_t=2,
        field_order="sentiment-first",
    )


def lp(token: str, p: float, alternatives: Sequence[tuple[str, float]] = ()) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """One Ollama logprob entry; alternatives are (token, probability) and include the token itself."""
    top = [{"token": t, "logprob": math.log(q), "bytes": list(t.encode())} for t, q in alternatives]
    return {"token": token, "logprob": math.log(p), "bytes": list(token.encode()), "top_logprobs": top}


def plain(tokens: Sequence[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [lp(t, 0.99, [(t, 0.99)]) for t in tokens]


def chat_body(content: str, *, logprobs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None, **extra: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body: dict[str, Any] = {
        "model": "m",
        "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": content},
        "done": True,
        "done_reason": "stop",
        "total_duration": 250_000_000,
        "load_duration": 10_000_000,
        "prompt_eval_count": 120,
        "prompt_eval_duration": 80_000_000,
        "eval_count": 12,
        "eval_duration": 150_000_000,
    }
    if logprobs is not None:
        body["logprobs"] = logprobs
    return body | extra


def stream_response(chunks: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], delay: float = 0.0) -> httpx.Response:
    async def lines() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
        for chunk in chunks:
            if delay:
                await asyncio.sleep(delay)
            yield (json.dumps(chunk) + "\n").encode()

    return httpx.Response(200, content=lines(), headers={"content-type": "application/x-ndjson"})


def content_chunks(pieces: Sequence[str], **final: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    chunks: list[dict[str, Any]] = [
        {"model": "m", "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": piece}, "done": False} for piece in pieces
    ]
    done = chat_body("", eval_count=len(pieces)) | final
    return [*chunks, done]
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from veritrade.services.cache import TtlCache


class Clock:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.now = 100.0

    def __call__(self) -> float:
        return self.now


def test_entries_expire_after_the_ttl() -> None:
    clock = Clock()
    cache: TtlCache[str, int] = TtlCache(max_entries=4, ttl_s=10, clock=clock)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    clock.now += 9.9
    assert cache.get("a") == 1
    clock.now += 0.1
    assert cache.get("a") is None
    assert len(cache) == 0


def test_least_recently_used_entry_is_evicted() -> None:
    cache: TtlCache[str, int] = TtlCache(max_entries=2, ttl_s=10, clock=Clock())
    cache.put("a", 1)
    cache.put("b", 2)
    assert cache.get("a") == 1
    cache.put("c", 3)
    assert (cache.get("a"), cache.get("b"), cache.get("c")) == (1, None, 3)


def test_put_refreshes_an_existing_key() -> None:
    clock = Clock()
    cache: TtlCache[str, int] = TtlCache(max_entries=2, ttl_s=10, clock=clock)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    clock.now += 8
    cache.put("a", 2)
    clock.now += 8
    assert cache.get("a") == 2


def test_zero_ttl_disables_the_cache() -> None:
    cache: TtlCache[str, int] = TtlCache(max_entries=2, ttl_s=0)
    cache.put("a", 1)
    assert cache.get("a") is None


def test_needs_room_for_one_entry() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="max_entries"):
        TtlCache(max_entries=0, ttl_s=1)
```

```python
from typing import Any

PAGE = FetchResult(
    requested_url="https://news.test/a",
    final_url="https://news.test/a",
    status=200,
    html="<html></html>",
    content_type="text/html",
    fetch_ms=1.0,
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("parser", "extractor", "inline"),
    [
        ("selectolax", "cascade", True),
        ("lxml", "density", True),
        ("bs4", "cascade", False),
        ("bs4-lxml", "jsonld", False),
        ("selectolax", "trafilatura", False),
    ],
)
async def test_slow_extractors_run_off_the_event_loop(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName, inline: bool
) -> None:
    threads: list[threading.Thread] = []

    def fake_extract(*_: Any, **__: Any) -> str:
        threads.append(threading.current_thread())
        return "article"

    monkeypatch.setattr(article_service, "extract", fake_extract)
    loop_thread = threading.current_thread()
    result = await article_service.extract_article(PAGE, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    assert result == "article"
    assert (threads == [loop_thread]) is inline
```

```
"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    backend_tests = "backend/tests" if full else "backend/tests/unit"
    tests = [backend_tests, "evals/tests", "scripts/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true", help="unit tests only, no build (default)")
    mode.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="integration tests, coverage floor, build")
    parser.add_argument("--backend", action="store_true", help="only backend + evals")
    parser.add_argument("--frontend", action="store_true", help="only frontend")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_be = not args.frontend or args.backend
    run_fe = not args.backend or args.frontend
    steps = (backend_steps(args.full) if run_be else []) + (frontend_steps(args.full) if run_fe else [])

    failed = []
    for name, cmd, cwd in steps:
        print(f"\n== {name}: {' '.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
        if subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd).returncode != 0:
            failed.append(name)
    if failed:
        sys.exit(f"\nFAILED: {', '.join(failed)}")
    print("\nall checks passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
"""Write backend/openapi.json from the FastAPI app; --check fails on drift (CI contract gate)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from veritrade.api.app import create_app
from veritrade.config import Settings

TARGET = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "backend" / "openapi.json"


def render() -> str:
    app = create_app(Settings(static_dir=None))
    return json.dumps(app.openapi(), indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rendered = render()
    if args.check:
        if not TARGET.exists() or TARGET.read_text() != rendered:
            sys.exit("backend/openapi.json is stale: run `uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py`")
        print("openapi.json up to date")
        return
    TARGET.write_text(rendered)
    print(f"wrote {TARGET}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
[project]
name = "veritrade-backend"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Low-latency financial news summary and sentiment API"
requires-python = ">=3.13,<3.14"
license = "MIT"
dependencies = [
    "fastapi>=0.143",
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.34",
    "httpx[http2]>=0.28",
    "pydantic>=2.10",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.7",
    "selectolax>=1.0",
    "lxml>=5.3",

    "cssselect>=1.2",
    "beautifulsoup4>=4.12",
    "trafilatura>=2.3",
    "readability-lxml>=0.8",
    "newspaper4k>=0.9",
    "justext>=3.0",
    "brotli>=1.2.0",
    "httpcore>=1.0.9",
]

[project.scripts]
veritrade-healthcheck = "veritrade.healthcheck:main"

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.26"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/veritrade"]
[tool.uv.workspace]
members = ["backend", "evals"]

[tool.uv.sources]
veritrade-backend = { workspace = true }

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "asgi-lifespan>=2.1",
    "mypy>=1.13",
    "pytest>=8.3",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.25",
    "pytest-cov>=6.0",
    "respx>=0.22",
    "ruff>=0.8",
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 110
target-version = "py313"
# The transcript is a verbatim log: its Markdown code blocks quote code as it was, never reformatted.

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "W", "I", "B", "UP", "SIM", "RUF", "ASYNC", "PT"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["veritrade", "veritrade_evals"]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.13"
strict = true
warn_unused_ignores = true
mypy_path = ["backend/src", "evals/src"]

plugins = ["pydantic.mypy"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]

markers = ["live: hits real publisher sites (excluded by default)"]
addopts = "-m 'not live'"

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["veritrade"]
branch = true
```

```
def raw_path(session: str, raw_dir: Path = RAW_DIR) -> Path:
    return raw_dir / f"{session}.jsonl"


# --- suite -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def unload(ollama: OllamaClient, model: str, wait_s: float = UNLOAD_WAIT_S) -> None:
    """Returns once Ollama no longer lists the model as resident, so the next call is a true cold load."""
    await ollama.unload(model)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + wait_s
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if model not in {str(e.get("name") or e.get("model")) for e in await ollama.ps()}:
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    raise LatencyError(f"{model} is still resident {wait_s:.0f} s after the unload request")


async def unload_others(ollama: OllamaClient, model: str, log: TextIO) -> None:
    for entry in await ollama.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != model:
            print(f"unloading {name}", file=log, flush=True)
            await unload(ollama, name)


def _p50(samples: Sequence[Sample], key: str) -> str:
    values = [s[key] for s in samples if s.get("ok") and isinstance(s.get(key), int | float)]
    return f"{np.median(values):.0f} ms" if values else "-"


async def run_suite(
    http: httpx.AsyncClient,
    cells: Sequence[Cell],
    articles: Sequence[ArticleExample],
    store: RawStore,
    *,
        cold_ms = (time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000
        warm: list[float] = []
        choices: dict[str, Any] = {}
        for name, headline in HEADLINES.items():
            for _ in range(3):
                decision = await self.client.decide_sentiment(
                    spec.name, prompt.state(headline), prompt.instructions, prompt.criteria_map
                )
                warm.append(decision.wall_ms)
            choices[name] = {
                "choice": decision.choice,
                "probabilities": {k: round(v, 4) for k, v in decision.probabilities.items()},
                "confidence": round(decision.confidence, 4),
                "input_tokens": decision.input_tokens,
            }
        loaded = [m for m in await self.client.ps() if m["name"] == spec.name]
        return {
            "response_keys": sorted(raw),
            "answer_keys": sorted((raw.get("answers") or {}).get("sentiment") or {}),
            "usage": raw.get("usage"),
            "raw_example": raw,
            "cold_wall_ms": ms(cold_ms),
            "warm_wall_ms_p50": p50(warm),
            "warm_wall_ms_min": ms(min(warm)),
            "warm_wall_ms_max": ms(max(warm)),
            "per_headline": choices,
            "loaded_context_length": loaded[0].get("context_length") if loaded else None,
        }

    async def think_false(self, spec: ModelSpec) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """(e) think=false leaves no thinking text, with and without a JSON-schema format."""
```

```
async def test_systemone_on_a_generative_model(client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter) -> None:
    error = {"error": 'model "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0" is not a llama.cpp decision model'}

    with pytest.raises(ModelUnavailable, match=r"not a llama\.cpp decision model"):
        await client.systemone("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", "x", {})


async def test_utilities(client: OllamaClient, mock_ollama: respx.MockRouter) -> None:
    mock_ollama.post("/api/embed").respond(json={"embeddings": [[0.1, 0.2], [0.3, 0.4]]})
    mock_ollama.get("/api/tags").respond(json={"models": [{"name": "a"}]})
    mock_ollama.get("/api/ps").respond(json={"models": []})
    mock_ollama.post("/api/show").respond(json={"capabilities": ["completion"]})
    mock_ollama.get("/api/version").respond(json={"version": "0.40.6"})
    unload = mock_ollama.post("/api/generate").respond(json={"done": True, "done_reason": "unload"})
    assert await client.embed("e", ["a", "b"]) == [[0.1, 0.2], [0.3, 0.4]]
    assert await client.tags() == [{"name": "a"}]
    assert await client.ps() == []
    assert (await client.show("a"))["capabilities"] == ["completion"]
    assert await client.version() == "0.40.6"
    await client.unload("a")
    assert _sent(unload) == {"model": "a", "keep_alive": 0}
```

```
"""HTTP routes: thin adapters from request bodies to services.

Stream routes take their events from a dependency, so every failure before the first byte (bad URL, model,
fetch, extraction) still reaches the client as a JSON error with its own HTTP status.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator, AsyncIterator
from contextlib import aclosing
from typing import Annotated, Any

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request
from fastapi.sse import EventSourceResponse, ServerSentEvent

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ErrorResponse,
    HealthResponse,
    ModelsResponse,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
)
from veritrade.api.sse import event_stream
from veritrade.services.analyze import open_analyze_stream, run_analyze
from veritrade.services.pipeline import StreamPayload
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.services.signal import run_signal
from veritrade.services.summary import open_summary_stream, run_summary
from veritrade.services.system import check_health, list_models
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

_ERROR_STATUSES = (400, 422, 502, 503, 504)
ERROR_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    status: {"model": ErrorResponse} for status in _ERROR_STATUSES
}
# A `model` entry would inherit the route's text/event-stream media type; stream errors are sent as JSON.
STREAM_ERROR_RESPONSES: dict[int | str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    status: {
        "description": "Error raised before the stream opens",
        "content": {"application/json": {"schema": {"$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"}}},
    }
    for status in _ERROR_STATUSES
}

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api")


async def request_clock() -> StageTimer:
    return StageTimer()


async def get_runtime(request: Request) -> Runtime:
    runtime: Runtime = request.app.state.runtime
    return runtime


# Declared first in every route so the clock starts before any other dependency or validation runs.
Clock = Annotated[StageTimer, Depends(request_clock)]
RuntimeDep = Annotated[Runtime, Depends(get_runtime)]
Events = AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]


async def summary_events(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: SummaryRequest) -> Events:
    return await open_summary_stream(runtime, body, clock)


async def analyze_events(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: AnalyzeRequest) -> Events:
    return await open_analyze_stream(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/signal", response_model=SignalResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def signal(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: SignalRequest) -> SignalResponse:
    return await run_signal(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/summary", response_model=SummaryResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def summary(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: SummaryRequest) -> SummaryResponse:
    return await run_summary(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/summary/stream", response_class=EventSourceResponse, responses=STREAM_ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def summary_stream(
    events: Annotated[Events, Depends(summary_events)],
) -> AsyncIterator[ServerSentEvent]:
    async with aclosing(event_stream(events)) as stream:
        async for event in stream:
            yield event


@router.post("/analyze", response_model=AnalyzeResponse, responses=ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def analyze(clock: Clock, runtime: RuntimeDep, body: AnalyzeRequest) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    return await run_analyze(runtime, body, clock)


@router.post("/analyze/stream", response_class=EventSourceResponse, responses=STREAM_ERROR_RESPONSES)
async def analyze_stream(
    events: Annotated[Events, Depends(analyze_events)],
) -> AsyncIterator[ServerSentEvent]:
    async with aclosing(event_stream(events)) as stream:
        async for event in stream:
            yield event


@router.get("/models", response_model=ModelsResponse)
async def models(runtime: RuntimeDep) -> ModelsResponse:
    return await list_models(runtime)


@router.get("/health", response_model=HealthResponse)
async def health(runtime: RuntimeDep) -> HealthResponse:
    return await check_health(runtime)
```

```diff
+def needs_load(spec: ModelSpec, entries: Iterable[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> bool:
+    """Whether Ollama must load the model before answering, given its /api/ps entries. Ollama reloads a
+    generative model on a num_ctx change; decision models pick their own context size."""
+    tag = tag_name(spec.name)
+    for entry in entries:
+        if tag not in {tag_name(str(entry.get(key) or "")) for key in ("name", "model")}:
+            continue
+        context = entry.get("context_length")
+        if spec.kind == "decision" or not isinstance(context, int) or context == spec.num_ctx:
+            return False
+    return True
+
+
 @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
```

```diff
+    ollama.ps.side_effect = hang
```

```python
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

import pytest

from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.services.runtime import needs_load

GENERATIVE = ModelSpec(
    name="qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0",
    kind="generative",
    endpoints=("summary",),
    num_ctx=8192,
    max_input_tokens=100,
    num_predict={"summary": 160},
    policy="ordinal",
)
DECISION = ModelSpec(
    name="clef-flash:9b-q8_0",
    kind="decision",
    endpoints=("signal",),
    max_input_tokens=100,
    policy="probability",
    min_p=0.8,
)


def _entry(name: str, context: int = 8192) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {"name": name, "model": name, "context_length": context}


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("spec", "entries", "cold"),
    [
        pytest.param(GENERATIVE, [], True, id="nothing-loaded"),
        pytest.param(GENERATIVE, [_entry("qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M")], True, id="another-model-loaded"),
        pytest.param(GENERATIVE, [_entry("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0")], False, id="resident-same-context"),
        pytest.param(GENERATIVE, [_entry("qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0", 4096)], True, id="resident-other-context"),
        pytest.param(GENERATIVE, [{"model": "qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0"}], False, id="context-unreported"),
        pytest.param(DECISION, [_entry("clef-flash:9b-q8_0", 16384)], False, id="decision-any-context"),
        pytest.param(DECISION, [], True, id="decision-not-loaded"),
        pytest.param(
            GENERATIVE.model_copy(update={"name": "llama3"}),
            [_entry("llama3:latest")],
            False,
            id="untagged-is-latest",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_needs_load(spec: ModelSpec, entries: list[dict[str, Any]], cold: bool) -> None:
    assert needs_load(spec, entries) is cold
```

```
        return {tag_name(str(entry.get("name", ""))): _size(entry) for entry in entries}

    async def cold_start(self, spec: ModelSpec) -> bool | None:
        """None when Ollama cannot say in time; the request goes ahead either way."""
        try:
            async with asyncio.timeout(self.settings.ollama_probe_timeout_s):
                entries = await self.ollama.ps()
        except (TimeoutError, VtError, httpx.HTTPError):
            return None
        return needs_load(spec, entries)
```

```
// Payloads mirror backend/src/veritrade/api/contracts.py; OpenAPI cannot describe SSE bodies.

  fetch_ms: number;

  extract_ms: number;

export interface SentimentEventData {
  signal: SignalResult;
  entity?: string | null;
  /** Server-side milliseconds since the request was received. */
  elapsed_ms: number;
}

export interface SummaryDeltaEventData {
  text: string;
}

export interface DoneEventData<R> {
  result: R;
}

export interface ErrorEventData {
  error: ErrorBody;
}

export type StreamEvent<R> =
  | { type: "meta"; data: MetaEventData }
  | { type: "sentiment"; data: SentimentEventData }
  | { type: "summary_delta"; data: SummaryDeltaEventData }
  | { type: "done"; data: DoneEventData<R> }
  | { type: "error"; data: ErrorEventData };

export type StreamEventType = StreamEvent<unknown>["type"];
const EVENT_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<StreamEventType>([
  "meta",
  "sentiment",
  "summary_delta",
  "done",
  "error",
]);

export interface SseFrame {
  event: string;
```

**summary:**

```
I've finished the backend half (parts A to D) as the contract specifies, and the full backend gate passes. No commits; everything is in the working tree.

- **A. Thresholds on every verdict:** `Verdict` has two new fields, `threshold` and `directional_tau`. `confidence._threshold` sets them to `min_p` and `tau` on both the early tau return and the argmax path. `OrdinalPolicy.decide` sets `threshold=float(self.t)` and leaves `directional_tau` as None. `SignalResult` has both fields with the agreed descriptions, and `pipeline.signal_result` passes them through.
- **B. Per-model rules on /api/models:** there is a new `SignalRule` model (policy, threshold, optional directional_tau), and `ModelInfo.signal_rules` holds one per endpoint. They are built by `services/system.py signal_rules(spec)` for the endpoints in `SIGNAL_ENDPOINTS = ("signal", "analyze")` that the model serves, using `policy_for(spec, endpoint=e)`. An ordinal policy gives `threshold=float(t)`; the others give `min_p` and `directional_tau`.
- **C. Cold start:**
  - `InferenceTimings.cold_start` and `MetaEvent.cold_start` are new. I added a short description to the `MetaEvent` field as well; the type and default are as agreed.
  - Detection lives next to `Runtime` rather than in a new `inference/residency.py`, because `tag_name` is in services and inference should not import from services. The pure function is `needs_load(spec, entries)` in `services/runtime.py`. It normalises both sides with `tag_name` and checks the context length only for generative models. If no context length is reported, a matching name counts as loaded.
  - `Runtime.cold_start(spec)` calls `ollama.ps()` within `ollama_probe_timeout_s`. On `TimeoutError`, `VtError` or `httpx.HTTPError` it returns None.
  - `Job.prepare` starts the probe as a plain task, awaits `load_article`, then awaits the probe. If the fetch raises, it cancels the probe and re-raises the original exception, so it is never wrapped in an ExceptionGroup.
  - `Prepared` now carries `cold_start`. `timings()` copies it into `InferenceTimings` when there is one, and `meta_event()` includes it.
  - Result-cache hits never run `prepare`, so they make no probe, have no inference timings, and their replayed meta event has `cold_start` null.
- **D.** `backend/openapi.json` is regenerated. I did not touch `frontend/`.

**Tests:**
- Unit: verdict thresholds for probability with and without tau, label-logprob and ordinal; 8 `needs_load` cases (nothing loaded, another model loaded, same context, other context, no context reported, decision model at 16384, decision model not loaded, untagged name read as `:latest`); `signal_rules` for label-logprob, ordinal, decision and summary-only models.
- Integration: the fake Ollama now answers `/api/ps`. By default the conftest marks the whole test roster as loaded at its own context size, and `ps_failure` makes the probe fail. New tests cover:
  - threshold values on decision, label and ordinal `/api/signal` responses
  - warm requests report `cold_start` false
  - an unloaded model reports true, with `load_ms` 5 ms
  - a 500 or connection-error probe gives null and still returns 200
  - a hanging probe gives up at the timeout and gives null
  - a stream's meta event says `cold_start` true before the first delta, and so do the done timings
  - a result-cache hit makes no probe call and its replayed meta event has `cold_start` null
  - `/api/models` returns `signal_rules`

Coverage stays at 97.39% against the 75% floor. I also ran the error and signal tests with `-W error` and error-level logging, and nothing was logged about orphaned or destroyed tasks.
```

```
import type { PolicyName, Sentiment, SignalResult } from "@/lib/api";
import { capitalize, formatMs, formatPct } from "@/lib/format";
import type { LaneStatus } from "@/lib/run-state";

import styles from "./SignalCard.module.css";

const POLICY_NOTES: Record<PolicyName, string> = {
  probability: "threshold on the decision model's class probability",
  "label-logprob": "threshold on the label token probability",
  ordinal: "threshold on |score| of the -2..+2 scale",
};

const ORDER: readonly Sentiment[] = ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral"];

/** Direction the model leaned before the threshold turned it into an abstention. */
export function leaning(signal: SignalResult): Sentiment {
  if (signal.probabilities) {
    let best: Sentiment = signal.sentiment;
    for (const s of ORDER) {
      if ((signal.probabilities[s] ?? 0) > (signal.probabilities[best] ?? 0)) best = s;
    }
    return best;
  }
  if (typeof signal.score === "number" && signal.score !== 0) return signal.score > 0 ? "bullish" : "bearish";
  return signal.sentiment;
}

function formatScore(score: number): string {
  return score > 0 ? `+${score}` : String(score);
}

interface SignalCardProps {
  status: LaneStatus;
  signal: SignalResult | null;
  entity?: string | null;
  model?: string | null;
  /** Client-measured time from submit to the signal arriving. */
  timeToSignalMs?: number | null;
  /** Server-reported time to sentiment on a combined stream. */
  serverMs?: number | null;
}

export function SignalCard({ status, signal, entity, model, timeToSignalMs, serverMs }: SignalCardProps) {
  const busy = !signal && (status === "pending" || status === "streaming");
  return (
    <section className={styles.card} aria-labelledby="signal-heading" aria-busy={busy}>
      <h2 id="signal-heading" className={styles.heading}>
        Signal
      </h2>
      {signal ? (
        <SignalBody
          signal={signal}
          entity={entity}
          model={model}
          timeToSignalMs={timeToSignalMs}
          serverMs={serverMs}
        />
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.placeholder}>
          {busy
            ? "Waiting for the signal..."
            : status === "cancelled"
              ? "Cancelled."
              : "No signal: the request failed."}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

type SignalBodyProps = Omit<SignalCardProps, "status" | "signal"> & { signal: SignalResult };

function SignalBody({ signal, entity, model, timeToSignalMs, serverMs }: SignalBodyProps) {
  const lean = leaning(signal);
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <span
          className={styles.badge}
          data-sentiment={signal.sentiment}
          data-abstained={signal.abstained || undefined}
          data-testid="signal-badge"
        >
          {capitalize(signal.sentiment)}
        </span>
        {signal.abstained ? <span className={styles.abstainTag}>Abstained</span> : null}
        {entity ? <span className={styles.entity}>{entity}</span> : null}
      </div>
      {signal.abstained ? (
        <p className={styles.abstainNote}>
          Below confidence threshold: the call is not confident enough to trade on, so treat it as no
          directional signal.
          {lean !== signal.sentiment ? ` The model leaned ${capitalize(lean)}.` : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <dl className={styles.stats}>
        {typeof signal.confidence === "number" ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Confidence</dt>
            <dd>{formatPct(signal.confidence)}</dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {typeof signal.score === "number" ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Score</dt>
            <dd>{formatScore(signal.score)} on -2..+2</dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div>
          <dt>Policy</dt>
          <dd>
            <code>{signal.policy}</code> <span className={styles.note}>({POLICY_NOTES[signal.policy]})</span>
          </dd>
        </div>
        {model ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Model</dt>
            <dd>
              <code>{model}</code>
            </dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {typeof timeToSignalMs === "number" ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Time to signal</dt>
            <dd>
              {formatMs(timeToSignalMs)}
              {typeof serverMs === "number" ? (
                <span className={styles.note}> (server {formatMs(serverMs)})</span>
              ) : null}
            </dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </dl>
      {signal.probabilities ? (
        <ul className={styles.probs} aria-label="Class probabilities">
          {ORDER.map((s) => {
            const p = signal.probabilities?.[s] ?? 0;
            return (
              <li key={s} className={styles.prob}>
                <span className={styles.probLabel}>{capitalize(s)}</span>
                <span className={styles.probTrack} aria-hidden="true">
                  <span
                    className={styles.probFill}
                    data-sentiment={s}
                    style={{ width: `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, p)) * 100}%` }}
                  />
                </span>
                <span className={styles.probValue}>{formatPct(p)}</span>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```

```
"use client";

import { useAnalysis } from "@/hooks/useAnalysis";
import { useModels } from "@/hooks/useModels";
import { capitalize } from "@/lib/format";
import {
  articleMeta,
  distinctErrors,
  laneById,
  type Lane,
  type LaneId,
  type RunState,
} from "@/lib/run-state";

import { AnalyzeForm } from "./AnalyzeForm";
import styles from "./AnalyzeApp.module.css";
import { ArticleMetaLine } from "./ArticleMetaLine";
import { ErrorBanner } from "./ErrorBanner";
import { LatencyBar, type LaneMark, type LatencyLane } from "./LatencyBar";
import { SignalCard } from "./SignalCard";
import { SummaryPanel } from "./SummaryPanel";

const LANE_LABELS: Record<LaneId, string> = { signal: "Signal", summary: "Summary", analyze: "Analyze" };

function toLatencyLane(lane: Lane): LatencyLane {
  const marks: LaneMark[] = [];
  if (lane.signalAtMs !== null) {
    marks.push({ kind: "signal", label: "time to signal", atMs: lane.signalAtMs });
  }
  if (lane.firstTokenAtMs !== null) {
    marks.push({ kind: "token", label: "time to first token", atMs: lane.firstTokenAtMs });
  }
  return {
    id: lane.id,
    label: LANE_LABELS[lane.id],
    status: lane.status,
    timings: lane.timings,
    endMs: lane.endAtMs,
    marks,
  };
}

function announcement(state: RunState): string {
  if (state.running && !state.signal) return "Analyzing...";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (state.signal) {
    parts.push(`Signal ${capitalize(state.signal.sentiment)}${state.signal.abstained ? ", abstained" : ""}.`);
  }
  if (!state.running && state.summary) parts.push("Summary complete.");
  return parts.join(" ");
}

export function AnalyzeApp() {
  const models = useModels();
  const { state, start, cancel } = useAnalysis();

  const split = state.mode === "split";
  const signalLane = laneById(state, split ? "signal" : "analyze");
  const summaryLane = laneById(state, split ? "summary" : "analyze");
  const meta = articleMeta(state);
  const errors = distinctErrors(state);
  const showLatency = state.lanes.some(
    (l) => l.timings || l.signalAtMs !== null || l.firstTokenAtMs !== null,
  );

  return (
    <>
      <AnalyzeForm models={models} running={state.running} onSubmit={start} onCancel={cancel} />

      <p role="status" className="visually-hidden">
        {announcement(state)}
      </p>

      {models.status === "error" ? <ErrorBanner error={models.error} context="Model list" /> : null}
      {errors.map(({ lanes, error }) => (
        <ErrorBanner
          key={`${error.code}-${lanes.join("-")}`}
          error={error}
          context={lanes.map((id) => LANE_LABELS[id]).join(" and ")}
        />
      ))}

      {state.lanes.length ? (
        <div className={styles.results}>
          {meta ? <ArticleMetaLine meta={meta} /> : null}
          <div className={styles.cards}>
            {signalLane ? (
              <SignalCard
                status={signalLane.status}
                signal={state.signal}
                entity={state.entity}
                model={signalLane.meta?.model}
                timeToSignalMs={signalLane.signalAtMs}
                serverMs={state.serverSignalMs}
              />
            ) : null}
            {summaryLane ? (
              <SummaryPanel
                status={summaryLane.status}
                text={state.summary}
                truncated={state.summaryTruncated}
                model={summaryLane.meta?.model}
                streaming={state.streaming}
                firstTokenMs={summaryLane.firstTokenAtMs}
              />
            ) : null}
          </div>
          {showLatency ? <LatencyBar lanes={state.lanes.map(toLatencyLane)} /> : null}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.empty}>
          Results appear here. Split mode shows the signal as soon as /api/signal answers while the summary
          keeps streaming; combined mode gets both from one generation.
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
"use client";

import { useId, useState, type SubmitEvent } from "react";

import type { ModelsState } from "@/hooks/useModels";
import type { RunParams } from "@/hooks/useAnalysis";
import {
  EXTRACTORS,
  PARSERS,
  SCOPES,
  type Endpoint,
  type ExtractorName,
  type ModelInfo,
  type ParserName,
  type Scope,
} from "@/lib/api";
import type { Mode } from "@/lib/run-state";
import { SOURCES } from "@/lib/sources";

import styles from "./AnalyzeForm.module.css";

// Third-party extractors bring their own HTML parser, so the parser picker does not apply.
const PARSER_AWARE: ReadonlySet<ExtractorName> = new Set(["cascade", "jsonld", "profile", "density"]);

export function isHttpUrl(value: string): boolean {
  try {
    const url = new URL(value);
    return url.protocol === "http:" || url.protocol === "https:";
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function modelLabel(model: ModelInfo, isDefault: boolean): string {
  const notes = [
    isDefault ? "default" : null,
    model.installed ? null : "not installed",
    model.evaluated ? null : "CI plumbing, unevaluated",
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return notes.length ? `${model.name} (${notes.join(", ")})` : model.name;
}

interface ModelSelectProps {
  label: string;
  endpoint: Endpoint;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
  models: ModelsState;
}

function ModelSelect({ label, endpoint, value, onChange, models }: ModelSelectProps) {
  const id = useId();
  const ready = models.status === "ready" ? models.data : null;
  const fallback = ready?.defaults[endpoint];
  const options = ready ? ready.models.filter((m) => m.endpoints.includes(endpoint)) : [];
  return (
    <div className={styles.field}>
      <label htmlFor={id}>{label}</label>
      <select id={id} value={value} onChange={(e) => onChange(e.target.value)}>
        <option value="">{fallback ? `Server default (${fallback})` : "Server default"}</option>
        {options.map((m) => (
          <option key={m.name} value={m.name} disabled={!m.installed}>
            {modelLabel(m, m.name === fallback)}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

interface AnalyzeFormProps {
  models: ModelsState;
  running: boolean;
  onSubmit: (params: RunParams) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function AnalyzeForm({ models, running, onSubmit, onCancel }: AnalyzeFormProps) {
  const [url, setUrl] = useState("");
  const [urlError, setUrlError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>("split");
  const [streaming, setStreaming] = useState(true);
  const [signalModel, setSignalModel] = useState("");
  const [summaryModel, setSummaryModel] = useState("");
  const [analyzeModel, setAnalyzeModel] = useState("");
  const [parser, setParser] = useState<ParserName>("selectolax");
  const [extractor, setExtractor] = useState<ExtractorName>("cascade");
  const [scope, setScope] = useState<Scope>("lede");

  const ids = { url: useId(), urlHelp: useId(), parser: useId(), extractor: useId(), scope: useId() };
  const ready = models.status === "ready" ? models.data : null;
  const parsers = ready?.parsers.length ? ready.parsers : PARSERS;
  const extractors = ready?.extractors.length ? ready.extractors : EXTRACTORS;
  const scopes = ready?.scopes.length ? ready.scopes : SCOPES;
  const parserApplies = PARSER_AWARE.has(extractor);

  function handleSubmit(event: SubmitEvent<HTMLFormElement>) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const trimmed = url.trim();
    if (!isHttpUrl(trimmed)) {
      setUrlError("Enter a full http(s) URL, for example https://www.cnbc.com/2026/...");
      return;
    }
    setUrlError(null);
    onSubmit({
      url: trimmed,
      mode,
      streaming,
      parser,
      extractor,
      scope,
      signalModel,
      summaryModel,
      analyzeModel,
    });
  }

  const examples = SOURCES.filter((s) => s.exampleUrl);

  return (
    <form className={styles.form} onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate aria-label="Analyze an article">
      <div className={styles.urlRow}>
        <div className={styles.urlField}>
          <label htmlFor={ids.url}>Article URL</label>
          <input
            id={ids.url}
            name="url"
            type="url"
            inputMode="url"
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            placeholder="https://..."
            value={url}
            onChange={(e) => setUrl(e.target.value)}
            aria-invalid={urlError ? true : undefined}
            aria-describedby={ids.urlHelp}
            required
          />
        </div>
        <div className={styles.actions}>
          <button type="submit" className={styles.primary}>
            {running ? "Restart" : "Analyze"}
          </button>
          {running ? (
            <button type="button" className={styles.secondary} onClick={onCancel}>
              Cancel
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      </div>
      <p id={ids.urlHelp} className={urlError ? styles.error : styles.help}>
        {urlError ?? "A public news article, press release or SEC 8-K exhibit."}
      </p>

      <div className={styles.sources}>
        <span className={styles.sourcesLabel}>Tested sources:</span>
        <ul className={styles.chips}>
          {SOURCES.map((s) => (
            <li key={s.key} className={styles.chip}>
              {s.name}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
        {examples.length ? (
          <div className={styles.examples}>
            {examples.map((s) => (
              <button
                key={s.key}
                type="button"
                className={styles.secondary}
                onClick={() => setUrl(s.exampleUrl ?? "")}
              >
                Example: {s.name}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className={styles.groups}>
        <fieldset className={styles.group}>
          <legend>Mode</legend>
          <label className={styles.choice}>
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="mode"
              value="split"
              checked={mode === "split"}
              onChange={() => setMode("split")}
            />
            <span>
              Split
              <small>/api/signal and /api/summary fire together; the signal lands first.</small>
            </span>
          </label>
          <label className={styles.choice}>
            <input
              type="radio"
              name="mode"
              value="combined"
              checked={mode === "combined"}
              onChange={() => setMode("combined")}
            />
            <span>
              Combined
              <small>One /api/analyze call generates sentiment and summary together.</small>
            </span>
          </label>
          <label className={styles.choice}>
            <input type="checkbox" checked={streaming} onChange={(e) => setStreaming(e.target.checked)} />
            <span>
              Streaming
              <small>Server-sent events; off uses the JSON endpoints.</small>
            </span>
          </label>
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className={styles.group}>
          <legend>Models</legend>
          {mode === "split" ? (
            <>
              <ModelSelect
                label="Signal model"
                endpoint="signal"
                value={signalModel}
                onChange={setSignalModel}
                models={models}
              />
              <ModelSelect
                label="Summary model"
                endpoint="summary"
                value={summaryModel}
                onChange={setSummaryModel}
                models={models}
              />
            </>
          ) : (
            <ModelSelect
              label="Analyze model"
              endpoint="analyze"
              value={analyzeModel}
              onChange={setAnalyzeModel}
              models={models}
            />
          )}
          {models.status === "loading" ? <p className={styles.help}>Loading models...</p> : null}
        </fieldset>

        <fieldset className={styles.group}>
          <legend>Extraction</legend>
          <div className={styles.field}>
            <label htmlFor={ids.extractor}>Extractor</label>
            <select
              id={ids.extractor}
              value={extractor}
              onChange={(e) => setExtractor(e.target.value as ExtractorName)}
            >
              {extractors.map((name) => (
                <option key={name} value={name}>
                  {name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.field}>
            <label htmlFor={ids.parser}>Parser</label>
            <select
              id={ids.parser}
              value={parser}
              onChange={(e) => setParser(e.target.value as ParserName)}
              disabled={!parserApplies}
            >
              {parsers.map((name) => (
                <option key={name} value={name}>
                  {name}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
            {!parserApplies ? <small className={styles.help}>{extractor} uses its own parser.</small> : null}
          </div>
          {mode === "split" ? (
            <div className={styles.field}>
              <label htmlFor={ids.scope}>Signal scope</label>
              <select id={ids.scope} value={scope} onChange={(e) => setScope(e.target.value as Scope)}>
                {scopes.map((name) => (
                  <option key={name} value={name}>
                    {name === "lede" ? "lede (headline + opening paragraphs)" : "full article"}
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>
          ) : null}
        </fieldset>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```
