```
import { formatMs } from "@/lib/format";
import type { LaneStatus } from "@/lib/run-state";

import styles from "./SummaryPanel.module.css";

interface SummaryPanelProps {
  status: LaneStatus;
  text: string;
  /** The server cut the summary at the model's output limit. */
  truncated?: boolean;
  model?: string | null;
  streaming: boolean;
  /** Client-measured time from submit to the first summary token. */
  firstTokenMs?: number | null;
}

function statusLabel(status: LaneStatus, text: string, streaming: boolean): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return streaming ? "Waiting for the first token..." : "Waiting for the summary...";
    case "streaming":
      return text ? "Streaming..." : "Waiting for the first token...";
    case "done":
      return "Complete";
    case "error":
      return "Failed";
    case "cancelled":
      return "Cancelled";
  }
}

export function SummaryPanel({ status, text, truncated, model, streaming, firstTokenMs }: SummaryPanelProps) {
  const active = status === "pending" || status === "streaming";
  return (
    <section className={styles.panel} aria-labelledby="summary-heading" aria-busy={active}>
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <h2 id="summary-heading" className={styles.heading}>
          Summary
        </h2>
        <span className={styles.status} data-status={status} data-testid="summary-status">
          {statusLabel(status, text, streaming)}
        </span>
      </div>
      {text ? (
        <p className={styles.text} data-testid="summary-text">
          {text}
          {active ? <span className={styles.caret} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
        </p>
      ) : status === "done" ? (
        <p className={styles.empty}>The model returned an empty summary.</p>
      ) : null}
      {truncated && text ? (
        <p className={styles.note} data-testid="summary-truncated">
          The model hit its output limit, so this summary was cut short.
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {model || typeof firstTokenMs === "number" ? (
        <p className={styles.footer}>
          {model ? (
            <>
              Model <code>{model}</code>
            </>
          ) : null}
          {model && typeof firstTokenMs === "number" ? " · " : null}
          {typeof firstTokenMs === "number" ? `first token ${formatMs(firstTokenMs)}` : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}

import type { Timings } from "@/lib/api";
import { formatMs } from "@/lib/format";
import type { LaneStatus } from "@/lib/run-state";

import styles from "./LatencyBar.module.css";

export type StageKey =
  "fetch" | "consent" | "parse" | "extract" | "load" | "prompt" | "generation" | "inference" | "other";

export const STAGE_LABELS: Record<StageKey, string> = {
  fetch: "fetch",
  consent: "consent",
  parse: "parse",
  extract: "extract",
  load: "model load",
  prompt: "prompt eval",
  generation: "generation",
  inference: "inference",
  other: "network + overhead",
};

export interface Segment {
  key: StageKey;
  ms: number;
  startMs: number;
}

// Server stages laid end to end; whatever the client waited beyond them is "other". Decision
// models report only wall time, so they get a single inference segment.
export function stageSegments(timings: Timings, clientTotalMs: number | null): Segment[] {
  const segments: Segment[] = [];
  let cursor = 0;
  const push = (key: StageKey, ms: number | null | undefined) => {
    if (typeof ms !== "number" || ms <= 0) return;
    segments.push({ key, ms, startMs: cursor });
    cursor += ms;
  };
  push("fetch", timings.fetch_ms);
  push("consent", timings.consent_ms);
  push("parse", timings.parse_ms);
  push("extract", timings.extract_ms);
  const inference = timings.inference;
  if (inference) {
    const { load_ms, prompt_eval_ms, eval_ms } = inference;
    const split = [load_ms, prompt_eval_ms, eval_ms].some((ms) => typeof ms === "number");
    if (split) {
      push("load", load_ms);
      push("prompt", prompt_eval_ms);
      push("generation", eval_ms);
    } else {
      push("inference", inference.wall_ms);
    }
  }
  push("other", (clientTotalMs ?? timings.total_ms) - cursor);
  return segments;
}

export function niceStep(raw: number): number {
  if (raw <= 0) return 1;
  const pow = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw));
  const n = raw / pow;
  const mult = n <= 1 ? 1 : n <= 2 ? 2 : n <= 2.5 ? 2.5 : n <= 5 ? 5 : 10;
  return mult * pow;
}

export interface LaneMark {
  kind: "signal" | "token";
  label: string;
  atMs: number;
}

export interface LatencyLane {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  status: LaneStatus;
  timings: Timings | null;
  /** Client-observed completion, ms since submit. */
  endMs: number | null;
  marks: LaneMark[];
}

function laneExtent(lane: LatencyLane): number {
  const markMax = Math.max(0, ...lane.marks.map((m) => m.atMs));
  return Math.max(lane.endMs ?? lane.timings?.total_ms ?? 0, markMax);
}

const pct = (ms: number, axis: number) => `${Math.min(100, (ms / axis) * 100)}%`;

export function LatencyBar({ lanes }: { lanes: LatencyLane[] }) {
  const axis = Math.max(1, ...lanes.map(laneExtent));
  const step = niceStep(axis / 4);
  const ticks = Array.from({ length: Math.floor(axis / step) + 1 }, (_, i) => i * step);
  const laneSegments = lanes.map((lane) => (lane.timings ? stageSegments(lane.timings, lane.endMs) : []));
  const usedKeys = new Set(laneSegments.flat().map((s) => s.key));

  return (
    <section className={styles.wrap} aria-labelledby="latency-heading" data-testid="latency">
      <h2 id="latency-heading" className={styles.heading}>
        Latency
      </h2>
      <p className={styles.caption}>
        Server stage timings placed on one client time axis, measured from submit with performance.now().
      </p>
      <div className={styles.chart}>
        {lanes.map((lane, i) => (
          <div key={lane.id} className={styles.lane} data-testid={`lane-${lane.id}`}>
            <div className={styles.laneLabel}>{lane.label}</div>
            <div className={styles.track} aria-hidden="true">
              {laneSegments[i].map((segment) => (
                <span
                  key={segment.key}
                  className={styles.segment}
                  data-stage={segment.key}
                  data-testid={`segment-${lane.id}-${segment.key}`}
                  style={{ left: pct(segment.startMs, axis), width: pct(segment.ms, axis) }}
                  title={`${STAGE_LABELS[segment.key]} ${formatMs(segment.ms)}`}
                />
              ))}
              {lane.marks.map((mark) => (
                <span
                  key={mark.kind}
                  className={styles.mark}
                  data-kind={mark.kind}
                  data-testid={`mark-${lane.id}-${mark.kind}`}
                  style={{ left: pct(mark.atMs, axis) }}
                  title={`${mark.label} ${formatMs(mark.atMs)}`}
                />
              ))}
              {!lane.timings && (lane.status === "pending" || lane.status === "streaming") ? (
                <span className={styles.running}>running...</span>
              ) : null}
            </div>
          </div>
        ))}
        <div className={styles.axis} aria-hidden="true">
          <div />
          <div className={styles.ticks}>
            {ticks.map((t) => (
              <span key={t} className={styles.tick} style={{ left: pct(t, axis) }}>
                {formatMs(t)}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <ul className={styles.legend} aria-hidden="true">
        {[...usedKeys].map((key) => (
          <li key={key}>
            <span className={styles.swatch} data-stage={key} />
            {STAGE_LABELS[key]}
          </li>
        ))}
        {lanes.some((l) => l.marks.some((m) => m.kind === "signal")) ? (
          <li>
            <span className={styles.markSwatch} data-kind="signal" />
            signal arrived
          </li>
        ) : null}
        {lanes.some((l) => l.marks.some((m) => m.kind === "token")) ? (
          <li>
            <span className={styles.markSwatch} data-kind="token" />
            first token
          </li>
        ) : null}
      </ul>

      <div className={styles.details}>
        {lanes.map((lane, i) => (
          <div key={lane.id} className={styles.detail}>
            <h3 className={styles.detailHeading}>{lane.label}</h3>
            <dl className={styles.values}>
              {lane.marks.map((mark) => (
                <div key={mark.kind}>
                  <dt>{mark.label}</dt>
                  <dd>{formatMs(mark.atMs)}</dd>
                </div>
              ))}
              {lane.endMs !== null ? (
                <div>
                  <dt>complete (client)</dt>
                  <dd>{formatMs(lane.endMs)}</dd>
                </div>
              ) : null}
              {lane.timings ? (
                <div>
                  <dt>server total</dt>
                  <dd>{formatMs(lane.timings.total_ms)}</dd>
                </div>
              ) : null}
              {typeof lane.timings?.inference?.ttft_ms === "number" ? (
                <div>
                  <dt>TTFT (server)</dt>
                  <dd>{formatMs(lane.timings.inference.ttft_ms)}</dd>
                </div>
              ) : null}
              {laneSegments[i].map((segment) => (
                <div key={segment.key}>
                  <dt>{STAGE_LABELS[segment.key]}</dt>
                  <dd>{formatMs(segment.ms)}</dd>
                </div>
              ))}
              {lane.timings ? (
                <div>
                  <dt>cache</dt>
                  <dd>
                    fetch {lane.timings.cache.fetch}, result {lane.timings.cache.result}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              ) : null}
            </dl>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```
import type { components } from "./api-schema";

type Schemas = components["schemas"];

export type SignalRequest = Schemas["SignalRequest"];
export type SummaryRequest = Schemas["SummaryRequest"];
export type AnalyzeRequest = Schemas["AnalyzeRequest"];
export type SignalResponse = Schemas["SignalResponse"];
export type SummaryResponse = Schemas["SummaryResponse"];
export type AnalyzeResponse = Schemas["AnalyzeResponse"];
export type ModelsResponse = Schemas["ModelsResponse"];
export type HealthResponse = Schemas["HealthResponse"];
export type ModelInfo = Schemas["ModelInfo"];
export type ArticleMeta = Schemas["ArticleMeta"];
export type SignalResult = Schemas["SignalResult"];
export type Timings = Schemas["Timings"];
export type InferenceTimings = Schemas["InferenceTimings"];
export type CacheInfo = Schemas["CacheInfo"];
export type ErrorBody = Schemas["ErrorBody"];
export type ErrorCode = Schemas["ErrorCode"];

export type ParserName = SignalRequest["parser"];
export type ExtractorName = SignalRequest["extractor"];
export type Scope = SignalRequest["scope"];
export type Endpoint = ArticleMeta["endpoint"];
export type Sentiment = SignalResult["sentiment"];
export type PolicyName = SignalResult["policy"];

// The generated request types mark defaulted fields as required; callers only need the url.
type Body<T extends { url: string }> = Pick<T, "url"> & Partial<Omit<T, "url">>;
export type SignalBody = Body<SignalRequest>;
export type SummaryBody = Body<SummaryRequest>;
export type AnalyzeBody = Body<AnalyzeRequest>;

export const PARSERS: readonly ParserName[] = ["selectolax", "lxml", "bs4", "bs4-lxml"];
export const EXTRACTORS: readonly ExtractorName[] = [
  "cascade",
  "jsonld",
  "profile",
  "density",
  "trafilatura",
  "trafilatura-precision",
  "readability",
  "newspaper",
  "justext",
  "strip-tags",
];
export const SCOPES: readonly Scope[] = ["lede", "full"];

const SERVER_ERROR_CODES: Record<ErrorCode, true> = {
  invalid_url: true,
  blocked_destination: true,
  model_not_allowed: true,
  paywalled: true,
  consent_required: true,
  extraction_empty: true,
  unsupported_content: true,
  too_large: true,
  source_blocked: true,
  upstream_http: true,
  schema_violation: true,
  model_unavailable: true,
  llm_unreachable: true,
  upstream_timeout: true,
  inference_timeout: true,
};
export const ERROR_CODES = Object.keys(SERVER_ERROR_CODES) as ErrorCode[];

/** Failures detected in the browser rather than reported by the API envelope. */
export type ClientErrorCode = "network_error" | "invalid_request" | "http_error" | "bad_response";
export type ApiErrorCode = ErrorCode | ClientErrorCode;

export function isErrorCode(value: unknown): value is ErrorCode {
  return typeof value === "string" && Object.hasOwn(SERVER_ERROR_CODES, value);
}

export interface ApiErrorInit {
  code: ApiErrorCode;
  message: string;
  hint?: string | null;
  status?: number | null;
  retryable?: boolean;
  upstreamStatus?: number | null;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  readonly code: ApiErrorCode;
  readonly hint: string | null;
  readonly status: number | null;
  readonly retryable: boolean;
  readonly upstreamStatus: number | null;

  constructor(init: ApiErrorInit) {
    super(init.message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
    this.code = init.code;
    this.hint = init.hint ?? null;
    this.status = init.status ?? null;
    this.retryable = init.retryable ?? false;
    this.upstreamStatus = init.upstreamStatus ?? null;
  }

  static fromBody(body: ErrorBody, status: number | null = null): ApiError {
    return new ApiError({
      code: body.code,
      message: body.message,
      hint: body.hint,
      status,
      retryable: body.retryable,
      upstreamStatus: body.upstream_status,
    });
  }
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function asErrorBody(value: unknown): ErrorBody | null {
  if (!isRecord(value) || !isErrorCode(value.code) || typeof value.message !== "string") return null;
  return {
    code: value.code,
    message: value.message,
    hint: typeof value.hint === "string" ? value.hint : null,
    retryable: value.retryable === true,
    upstream_status: typeof value.upstream_status === "number" ? value.upstream_status : null,
  };
}

/** Maps any error payload (our envelope, FastAPI validation detail, or junk) to an ApiError. */
export function errorFromPayload(status: number, payload: unknown): ApiError {
  const envelope = isRecord(payload) ? asErrorBody(payload.error) : null;
  if (envelope) return ApiError.fromBody(envelope, status);

  // FastAPI request validation runs before our handlers and answers {"detail": [...]}.
  if (isRecord(payload) && Array.isArray(payload.detail)) {
    const first: unknown = payload.detail[0];
    const msg = isRecord(first) && typeof first.msg === "string" ? first.msg : "Request validation failed.";
    const loc = isRecord(first) && Array.isArray(first.loc) ? first.loc.slice(1).join(".") : "";
    return new ApiError({
      code: "invalid_request",
      message: loc ? `${loc}: ${msg}` : msg,
      status,
    });
  }

  return new ApiError({
    code: "http_error",
    message: `The API answered with HTTP ${status}.`,
    status,
    retryable: status >= 500,
  });
}

export async function readError(res: Response): Promise<ApiError> {
  let text = "";
  try {
    text = await res.text();
  } catch (err) {
    if (isAbortError(err)) throw err;
  }
  let payload: unknown = null;
  try {
    payload = text ? JSON.parse(text) : null;
  } catch {
    payload = null;
  }
  return errorFromPayload(res.status, payload);
}

export function isAbortError(err: unknown): boolean {
  return typeof err === "object" && err !== null && (err as { name?: unknown }).name === "AbortError";
}

export function toApiError(err: unknown): ApiError {
  if (err instanceof ApiError) return err;
  const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
  return new ApiError({ code: "bad_response", message });
}

/** Empty base means same origin, which is how FastAPI serves the static export in production. */
export function apiUrl(path: string): string {
  const base = (process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE ?? "").replace(/\/+$/, "");
  if (base) return `${base}${path}`;
  return typeof window === "undefined" ? path : new URL(path, window.location.origin).toString();
}

/** fetch() that turns network failures and non-2xx answers into ApiError; aborts pass through. */
export async function apiFetch(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(apiUrl(path), init);
  } catch (err) {
    if (isAbortError(err)) throw err;
    throw new ApiError({
      code: "network_error",
      message: "Could not reach the API.",
      retryable: true,
    });
  }
  if (!res.ok) throw await readError(res);
  return res;
}

async function readJson<T>(res: Response): Promise<T> {
  try {
    return (await res.json()) as T;
  } catch (err) {
    if (isAbortError(err)) throw err;
    throw new ApiError({
      code: "bad_response",
      message: "The API returned invalid JSON.",
      status: res.status,
    });
  }
}

export function jsonPost(body: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal, accept = "application/json"): RequestInit {
  return {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", Accept: accept },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    signal,
  };
}

async function postJson<T>(path: string, body: unknown, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<T> {
  return readJson<T>(await apiFetch(path, jsonPost(body, signal)));
}

export async function getHealth(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<HealthResponse> {
  return readJson<HealthResponse>(await apiFetch("/api/health", { signal }));
}

export async function getModels(signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<ModelsResponse> {
  return readJson<ModelsResponse>(await apiFetch("/api/models", { signal }));
}

export function postSignal(body: SignalBody, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SignalResponse> {
  return postJson<SignalResponse>("/api/signal", body, signal);
}

export function postSummary(body: SummaryBody, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<SummaryResponse> {
  return postJson<SummaryResponse>("/api/summary", body, signal);
}

export function postAnalyze(body: AnalyzeBody, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<AnalyzeResponse> {
  return postJson<AnalyzeResponse>("/api/analyze", body, signal);
}
import type { ApiError, ArticleMeta, SignalResult, Timings } from "./api";

export type Mode = "split" | "combined";
export type LaneId = "signal" | "summary" | "analyze";
export type LaneStatus = "pending" | "streaming" | "done" | "error" | "cancelled";

export interface Lane {
  id: LaneId;
  status: LaneStatus;
  meta: ArticleMeta | null;
  timings: Timings | null;
  error: ApiError | null;
  // Client clock: milliseconds since the run started, from performance.now().
  signalAtMs: number | null;
  firstTokenAtMs: number | null;
  endAtMs: number | null;
}

export interface RunState {
  runId: number;
  mode: Mode;
  streaming: boolean;
  running: boolean;
  lanes: Lane[];
  signal: SignalResult | null;
  entity: string | null;
  /** Server-reported time to sentiment on the combined stream. */
  serverSignalMs: number | null;
  summary: string;
  /** The server cut the summary at the model's output limit. */
  summaryTruncated: boolean;
}

interface Tagged {
  runId: number;
  lane: LaneId;
  atMs: number;
}

export type RunAction =
  | { type: "start"; runId: number; mode: Mode; streaming: boolean; lanes: LaneId[] }
  | ({ type: "meta"; meta: ArticleMeta } & Tagged)
  | ({ type: "signal"; signal: SignalResult; entity: string | null; serverMs: number | null } & Tagged)
  | ({ type: "delta"; text: string } & Tagged)
  | ({
      type: "done";
      meta: ArticleMeta;
      timings: Timings;
      summary?: string;
      truncated?: boolean;
      signal?: SignalResult;
      entity?: string | null;
    } & Tagged)
  | ({ type: "error"; error: ApiError } & Tagged)
  | { type: "cancel"; runId: number; atMs: number };

export const initialRunState: RunState = {
  runId: 0,
  mode: "split",
  streaming: true,
  running: false,
  lanes: [],
  signal: null,
  entity: null,
  serverSignalMs: null,
  summary: "",
  summaryTruncated: false,
};

function newLane(id: LaneId): Lane {
  return {
    id,
    status: "pending",
    meta: null,
    timings: null,
    error: null,
    signalAtMs: null,
    firstTokenAtMs: null,
    endAtMs: null,
  };
}

const isActive = (lane: Lane) => lane.status === "pending" || lane.status === "streaming";

function patchLane(state: RunState, id: LaneId, patch: (lane: Lane) => Partial<Lane>): RunState {
  const lanes = state.lanes.map((lane) => (lane.id === id ? { ...lane, ...patch(lane) } : lane));
  return { ...state, lanes, running: lanes.some(isActive) };
}

export function runReducer(state: RunState, action: RunAction): RunState {
  if (action.type === "start") {
    return {
      ...initialRunState,
      runId: action.runId,
      mode: action.mode,
      streaming: action.streaming,
      running: true,
      lanes: action.lanes.map(newLane),
    };
  }
  // Late events from a superseded run must not leak into the current one.
  if (action.runId !== state.runId) return state;

  switch (action.type) {
    case "meta":
      return patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({
        meta: lane.meta ?? action.meta,
        status: lane.status === "pending" ? "streaming" : lane.status,
      }));
    case "signal":
      return {
        ...patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({ signalAtMs: lane.signalAtMs ?? action.atMs })),
        signal: action.signal,
        entity: action.entity,
        serverSignalMs: action.serverMs,
      };
    case "delta":
      return {
        ...patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({
          firstTokenAtMs: lane.firstTokenAtMs ?? action.atMs,
          status: "streaming",
        })),
        summary: state.summary + action.text,
      };
    case "done": {
      const next = patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({
        status: "done",
        meta: action.meta,
        timings: action.timings,
        endAtMs: action.atMs,
        signalAtMs: action.signal ? (lane.signalAtMs ?? action.atMs) : lane.signalAtMs,
      }));
      return {
        ...next,
        // The final payload is authoritative over the concatenated deltas.
        summary: action.summary ?? next.summary,
        summaryTruncated: action.truncated ?? next.summaryTruncated,
        signal: action.signal ?? next.signal,
        entity: action.entity !== undefined ? action.entity : next.entity,
      };
    }
    case "error":
      return patchLane(state, action.lane, () => ({
        status: "error",
        error: action.error,
        endAtMs: action.atMs,
      }));
    case "cancel": {
      const lanes = state.lanes.map((lane) =>
        isActive(lane) ? { ...lane, status: "cancelled" as const, endAtMs: action.atMs } : lane,
      );
      return { ...state, lanes, running: false };
    }
  }
}

export function laneById(state: RunState, id: LaneId): Lane | undefined {
  return state.lanes.find((lane) => lane.id === id);
}

/** Article-level meta from whichever lane reported first. */
export function articleMeta(state: RunState): ArticleMeta | null {
  return state.lanes.find((lane) => lane.meta)?.meta ?? null;
}

/** One banner per distinct failure; split lanes often fail identically on a shared fetch. */
export function distinctErrors(state: RunState): { lanes: LaneId[]; error: ApiError }[] {
  const out: { lanes: LaneId[]; error: ApiError }[] = [];
  for (const lane of state.lanes) {
    if (!lane.error) continue;
    const same = out.find((e) => e.error.code === lane.error?.code && e.error.message === lane.error.message);
    if (same) same.lanes.push(lane.id);
    else out.push({ lanes: [lane.id], error: lane.error });
  }
  return out;
}
export function formatMs(ms: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !Number.isFinite(ms)) return "-";
  if (ms >= 10_000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`;
  if (ms >= 1000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`;
  return `${Math.round(ms)} ms`;
}

export function formatPct(value: number | null | undefined, digits = 1): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  return `${(value * 100).toFixed(digits)}%`;
}

export function formatNum(value: number | null | undefined, digits = 3): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  return value.toFixed(digits);
}

export function formatInt(value: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  return Math.round(value).toLocaleString("en-US");
}

export function capitalize(value: string): string {
  return value ? value[0].toUpperCase() + value.slice(1) : value;
}
import {
  ApiError,
  apiFetch,
  jsonPost,
  type AnalyzeBody,
  type AnalyzeResponse,
  type ArticleMeta,
  type CacheInfo,
  type ErrorBody,
  type SignalResult,
  type SummaryBody,
  type SummaryResponse,
} from "./api";

// Payloads mirror backend/src/veritrade/api/contracts.py; OpenAPI cannot describe SSE bodies.
export interface MetaEventData {
  meta: ArticleMeta;
  fetch_ms: number;
  parse_ms: number;
  extract_ms: number;
  cache: CacheInfo;
}

export interface SentimentEventData {
  signal: SignalResult;
  entity?: string | null;
  /** Server-side milliseconds since the request was received. */
  elapsed_ms: number;
}

export interface SummaryDeltaEventData {
  text: string;
}

export interface DoneEventData<R> {
  result: R;
}

export interface ErrorEventData {
  error: ErrorBody;
}

export type StreamEvent<R> =
  | { type: "meta"; data: MetaEventData }
  | { type: "sentiment"; data: SentimentEventData }
  | { type: "summary_delta"; data: SummaryDeltaEventData }
  | { type: "done"; data: DoneEventData<R> }
  | { type: "error"; data: ErrorEventData };

export type StreamEventType = StreamEvent<unknown>["type"];
const EVENT_TYPES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set<StreamEventType>([
  "meta",
  "sentiment",
  "summary_delta",
  "done",
  "error",
]);

export interface SseFrame {
  event: string;
  data: string;
  id: string | null;
}

// Incremental text/event-stream parser (WHATWG rules): any of CRLF/LF/CR ends a line, a blank
// line dispatches, ":" lines are comments, repeated data lines join with "\n".
export class SseParser {
  private buffer = "";
  private skipLeadingLf = false;
  private eventType = "";
  private dataLines: string[] = [];
  private lastId: string | null = null;

  push(chunk: string): SseFrame[] {
    if (!chunk) return [];
    let text = chunk;
    // A CR that ended the previous chunk may be the first half of a CRLF.
    if (this.skipLeadingLf) {
      this.skipLeadingLf = false;
      if (text.startsWith("\n")) text = text.slice(1);
    }
    this.buffer += text;

    const frames: SseFrame[] = [];
    let start = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < this.buffer.length; i++) {
      const ch = this.buffer[i];
      if (ch !== "\n" && ch !== "\r") continue;
      const line = this.buffer.slice(start, i);
      if (ch === "\r") {
        if (i + 1 === this.buffer.length) this.skipLeadingLf = true;
        else if (this.buffer[i + 1] === "\n") i++;
      }
      start = i + 1;
      const frame = this.processLine(line);
      if (frame) frames.push(frame);
    }
    this.buffer = this.buffer.slice(start);
    return frames;
  }

  private processLine(line: string): SseFrame | null {
    if (line === "") return this.dispatch();
    if (line.startsWith(":")) return null;

    const colon = line.indexOf(":");
    const field = colon === -1 ? line : line.slice(0, colon);
    let value = colon === -1 ? "" : line.slice(colon + 1);
    if (value.startsWith(" ")) value = value.slice(1);

    if (field === "event") this.eventType = value;
    else if (field === "data") this.dataLines.push(value);
    else if (field === "id" && !value.includes("\0")) this.lastId = value;
    return null;
  }

  private dispatch(): SseFrame | null {
    const lines = this.dataLines;
    const event = this.eventType || "message";
    this.dataLines = [];
    this.eventType = "";
    if (lines.length === 0) return null;
    return { event, data: lines.join("\n"), id: this.lastId };
  }
}

/** Yields parsed frames; an unterminated trailing frame is dropped, as the SSE spec requires. */
export async function* readSseFrames(body: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>): AsyncGenerator<SseFrame> {
  // lib.dom types the decoder's input as BufferSource, which TS will not accept for Uint8Array chunks.
  const decoder = new TextDecoderStream() as unknown as TransformStream<Uint8Array, string>;
  const reader = body.pipeThrough(decoder).getReader();
  const parser = new SseParser();
  let finished = false;
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) {
        finished = true;
        return;
      }
      yield* parser.push(value);
    }
  } finally {
    // Early exit (consumer break or abort) must release the network stream.
    if (!finished) await reader.cancel().catch(() => undefined);
  }
}

export function toStreamEvent<R>(frame: SseFrame): StreamEvent<R> | null {
  if (!EVENT_TYPES.has(frame.event)) return null;
  let data: unknown;
  try {
    data = JSON.parse(frame.data);
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError({ code: "bad_response", message: `Malformed "${frame.event}" event from the API.` });
  }
  return { type: frame.event, data } as StreamEvent<R>;
}

export interface StreamOptions {
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}

// Yields typed events until `done` or `error`. Failures before the stream opens arrive as the
// JSON error envelope and are thrown as ApiError.
export async function* streamEvents<R>(
  path: string,
  body: unknown,
  { signal }: StreamOptions = {},
): AsyncGenerator<StreamEvent<R>> {
  const res = await apiFetch(path, jsonPost(body, signal, "text/event-stream"));
  if (!res.body) throw new ApiError({ code: "bad_response", message: "The API returned an empty stream." });

  for await (const frame of readSseFrames(res.body)) {
    const event = toStreamEvent<R>(frame);
    if (!event) continue;
    yield event;
    if (event.type === "done" || event.type === "error") return;
  }
  throw new ApiError({
    code: "bad_response",
    message: "The stream closed before it finished.",
    retryable: true,
  });
}

export function streamSummary(body: SummaryBody, options?: StreamOptions) {
  return streamEvents<SummaryResponse>("/api/summary/stream", body, options);
}

export function streamAnalyze(body: AnalyzeBody, options?: StreamOptions) {
  return streamEvents<AnalyzeResponse>("/api/analyze/stream", body, options);
}
```

```
import { useCallback, useEffect, useReducer, useRef, type Dispatch } from "react";

import {
  ApiError,
  isAbortError,
  postAnalyze,
  postSignal,
  postSummary,
  toApiError,
  type AnalyzeBody,
  type AnalyzeResponse,
  type ExtractorName,
  type ParserName,
  type Scope,
  type SignalBody,
  type SummaryBody,
  type SummaryResponse,
} from "@/lib/api";
import { initialRunState, runReducer, type LaneId, type Mode, type RunAction } from "@/lib/run-state";
import { streamAnalyze, streamSummary, type StreamEvent } from "@/lib/sse";

export interface RunParams {
  url: string;
  mode: Mode;
  streaming: boolean;
  parser: ParserName;
  extractor: ExtractorName;
  /** Signal scope in split mode; /analyze keeps its server default. */
  scope: Scope;
  /** Empty string lets the server pick the endpoint default. */
  signalModel: string;
  summaryModel: string;
  analyzeModel: string;
}

interface LaneContext {
  runId: number;
  dispatch: Dispatch<RunAction>;
  signal: AbortSignal;
  at: () => number;
}

const withModel = (model: string) => (model ? { model } : {});

async function guarded(ctx: LaneContext, lane: LaneId, work: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await work();
  } catch (err) {
    if (ctx.signal.aborted || isAbortError(err)) return;
    ctx.dispatch({ type: "error", runId: ctx.runId, lane, atMs: ctx.at(), error: toApiError(err) });
  }
}

function handleEvent(
  ctx: LaneContext,
  lane: LaneId,
  event: StreamEvent<SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse>,
): void {
  const tag = { runId: ctx.runId, lane, atMs: ctx.at() };
  switch (event.type) {
    case "meta":
      ctx.dispatch({ type: "meta", ...tag, meta: event.data.meta });
      return;
    case "sentiment":
      ctx.dispatch({
        type: "signal",
        ...tag,
        signal: event.data.signal,
        entity: event.data.entity ?? null,
        serverMs: event.data.elapsed_ms,
      });
      return;
    case "summary_delta":
      ctx.dispatch({ type: "delta", ...tag, text: event.data.text });
      return;
    case "done": {
      const result = event.data.result;
      const combined = "signal" in result ? result : null;
      ctx.dispatch({
        type: "done",
        ...tag,
        meta: result.meta,
        timings: result.timings,
        summary: result.summary,
        truncated: result.truncated,
        signal: combined?.signal,
        entity: combined ? (combined.entity ?? null) : undefined,
      });
      return;
    }
    case "error":
      ctx.dispatch({ type: "error", ...tag, error: ApiError.fromBody(event.data.error) });
      return;
  }
}

function runSignal(ctx: LaneContext, body: SignalBody) {
  return guarded(ctx, "signal", async () => {
    const res = await postSignal(body, ctx.signal);
    ctx.dispatch({
      type: "done",
      runId: ctx.runId,
      lane: "signal",
      atMs: ctx.at(),
      meta: res.meta,
      timings: res.timings,
      signal: res.signal,
    });
  });
}

function runSummary(ctx: LaneContext, body: SummaryBody, streaming: boolean) {
  return guarded(ctx, "summary", async () => {
    if (streaming) {
      for await (const event of streamSummary(body, { signal: ctx.signal }))
        handleEvent(ctx, "summary", event);
      return;
    }
    const res = await postSummary(body, ctx.signal);
    handleEvent(ctx, "summary", { type: "done", data: { result: res } });
  });
}

function runAnalyze(ctx: LaneContext, body: AnalyzeBody, streaming: boolean) {
  return guarded(ctx, "analyze", async () => {
    if (streaming) {
      for await (const event of streamAnalyze(body, { signal: ctx.signal }))
        handleEvent(ctx, "analyze", event);
      return;
    }
    const res = await postAnalyze(body, ctx.signal);
    handleEvent(ctx, "analyze", { type: "done", data: { result: res } });
  });
}

/** Owns one in-flight run; starting a new run aborts the previous one. */
export function useAnalysis() {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(runReducer, initialRunState);
  const controllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const runIdRef = useRef(0);
  const startedAtRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => () => controllerRef.current?.abort(), []);

  const start = useCallback((params: RunParams) => {
    controllerRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    controllerRef.current = controller;
    const runId = ++runIdRef.current;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    startedAtRef.current = t0;
    const ctx: LaneContext = { runId, dispatch, signal: controller.signal, at: () => performance.now() - t0 };
    const base = { url: params.url, parser: params.parser, extractor: params.extractor };

    if (params.mode === "split") {
      dispatch({
        type: "start",
        runId,
        mode: "split",
        streaming: params.streaming,
        lanes: ["signal", "summary"],
      });
      // Fired together on purpose: the backend single-flight shares one fetch between them.
      void runSignal(ctx, { ...base, scope: params.scope, ...withModel(params.signalModel) });
      void runSummary(ctx, { ...base, ...withModel(params.summaryModel) }, params.streaming);
    } else {
      dispatch({ type: "start", runId, mode: "combined", streaming: params.streaming, lanes: ["analyze"] });
      void runAnalyze(ctx, { ...base, ...withModel(params.analyzeModel) }, params.streaming);
    }
  }, []);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    controllerRef.current?.abort();
    controllerRef.current = null;
    dispatch({ type: "cancel", runId: runIdRef.current, atMs: performance.now() - startedAtRef.current });
  }, []);

  return { state, start, cancel };
}
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import { getModels, isAbortError, toApiError, type ApiError, type ModelsResponse } from "@/lib/api";

export type ModelsState =
  { status: "loading" } | { status: "ready"; data: ModelsResponse } | { status: "error"; error: ApiError };

export function useModels(): ModelsState {
  const [state, setState] = useState<ModelsState>({ status: "loading" });

  useEffect(() => {
    const controller = new AbortController();
    getModels(controller.signal).then(
      (data) => setState({ status: "ready", data }),
      (err: unknown) => {
        if (!isAbortError(err)) setState({ status: "error", error: toApiError(err) });
      },
    );
    return () => controller.abort();
  }, []);

  return state;
}
```

```
  const done = summaryResponse(body);
  return [
    sseFrame("meta", metaEvent(done.meta)),
    SSE_PING,
    ...SUMMARY_CHUNKS.map((text) => sseFrame("summary_delta", { text })),
    sseFrame("done", { result: done }),
  ];
}

export function analyzeStreamChunks(body: AnalyzeBody): string[] {
  const done = analyzeResponse(body);
  return [
    sseFrame("meta", metaEvent(articleMeta({ endpoint: "analyze", ...body }))),
    sseFrame("sentiment", sentimentEvent),
    ...SUMMARY_CHUNKS.map((text) => sseFrame("summary_delta", { text })),
    sseFrame("done", { result: done }),
  ];
}

export function errorResponse(status: number, error: ErrorBody): HttpResponse<{ error: ErrorBody }> {
  return HttpResponse.json({ error }, { status });
}

export const handlers: HttpHandler[] = [
  http.get(`${API}/health`, () => HttpResponse.json(health)),
  http.get(`${API}/models`, () => HttpResponse.json(models)),
  http.post(`${API}/signal`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(signalResponse((await request.json()) as SignalBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/summary`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(summaryResponse((await request.json()) as SummaryBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, async ({ request }) =>
    sseResponse(summaryStreamChunks((await request.json()) as SummaryBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/analyze`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(analyzeResponse((await request.json()) as AnalyzeBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/analyze/stream`, async ({ request }) =>
    sseResponse(analyzeStreamChunks((await request.json()) as AnalyzeBody)),
  ),
];
import { HttpResponse } from "msw";

import type { StreamEventType } from "@/lib/sse";

export function sseFrame(event: StreamEventType, data: unknown): string {
  return `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
}

export const SSE_PING = ": ping\n\n";

/** Pull-based so a test can hold the stream open between chunks (e.g. awaiting a gate). */
export function sseStream(chunks: AsyncIterable<string> | Iterable<string>): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const iterator =
    Symbol.asyncIterator in chunks ? chunks[Symbol.asyncIterator]() : toAsync(chunks[Symbol.iterator]());
  return new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    async pull(controller) {
      const { value, done } = await iterator.next();
      if (done) controller.close();
      else controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(value));
    },
    async cancel() {
      await iterator.return?.();
    },
  });
}

function toAsync(iterator: Iterator<string>): AsyncIterator<string> {
  return { next: async () => iterator.next() };
}

export function sseResponse(chunks: AsyncIterable<string> | Iterable<string>): HttpResponse<ReadableStream> {
  return new HttpResponse(sseStream(chunks), {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "text/event-stream", "Cache-Control": "no-cache" },
  });
}

export interface Gate {
  promise: Promise<void>;
  open: () => void;
}

export function gate(): Gate {
  let open: () => void = () => undefined;
  const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    open = resolve;
  });
  return { promise, open };
}
import { setupServer } from "msw/node";

import { handlers } from "./handlers";

export const server = setupServer(...handlers);
```

```
import { render, screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";

const base: Omit<Timings, "inference" | "total_ms"> = {
  fetch_ms: 200,

  extract_ms: 5,

};

const generative: Timings = {
  ...base,
  total_ms: 1900,
  inference: { wall_ms: 1680, ttft_ms: 400, load_ms: 20, prompt_eval_ms: 360, eval_ms: 1280 },
};

const decision: Timings = { ...base, total_ms: 560, inference: { wall_ms: 340 } };

describe("stageSegments", () => {
  it("lays stages end to end and fills the client remainder with other", () => {
    const segments = stageSegments(generative, 2000);
    expect(segments.map((s) => [s.key, s.startMs, s.ms])).toEqual([
      ["fetch", 0, 200],
      ["parse", 200, 10],
      ["extract", 210, 5],
      ["load", 215, 20],
      ["prompt", 235, 360],
      ["generation", 595, 1280],
      ["other", 1875, 125],
    ]);
  });

});
```

```
const server = setupMswServer();

async function submit(user: UserEvent, url = FIXTURE_URL) {
  const input = screen.getByLabelText("Article URL");
  await user.clear(input);
  await user.click(input);
  await user.paste(url);
  await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: /^(Analyze|Restart)$/ }));
}

const optionLabels = (select: HTMLElement) =>

    .getAllByRole("option")
    .map((o) => o.textContent);

const tick = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));

describe("Analyze page", () => {

    const bodies: { signal?: SignalBody; summary?: SummaryBody } = {};

        bodies.signal = (await request.json()) as SignalBody;

      expect(screen.getByTestId("mark-analyze-signal")).toBeInTheDocument();
      expect(screen.queryByText("server total")).not.toBeInTheDocument();

      afterSentiment.open();

      expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Streaming...");
      expect(screen.getByTestId("mark-analyze-token")).toBeInTheDocument();

      expect(await screen.findByText("server total")).toBeInTheDocument();

  it("uses the JSON endpoints when streaming is off", async () => {
    const streamed = vi.fn();

      http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, () => {
        streamed();
        return HttpResponse.error();
      }),
      http.post(`${API}/analyze/stream`, () => {
        streamed();
        return HttpResponse.error();
      }),
    );
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Streaming/ }));

    await submit(user);
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete"));
    expect(screen.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveTextContent("Bullish");
    expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-text")).toHaveTextContent(SUMMARY_TEXT);
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("mark-summary-token")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByTestId("segment-summary-generation")).toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: /Combined/ }));
    await submit(user);
    expect(await screen.findByText(ENTITY)).toBeInTheDocument();
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveTextContent("Complete"));
    expect(screen.getByTestId("lane-analyze")).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(streamed).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

  it("shows one error banner with code and hint when both requests hit a paywall", async () => {
    const paywalled = () =>

      }),
    );
    try {
      await submit(user);
      await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Cancel" }));
      expect(screen.getByText("Cancelled.")).toBeInTheDocument();
      stuck.open();
      await tick();
      expect(screen.queryByTestId("signal-badge")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    } finally {
      stuck.open();
    }
  });

  it("rejects a non-http URL without calling the API", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(<AnalyzeApp />);
    await submit(user, "ftp://example.com/file");
    expect(screen.getByText(/Enter a full http\(s\) URL/)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Article URL")).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    expect(screen.queryByTestId("summary-status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll } from "vitest";

import { server } from "@/mocks/node";

/** Registers the shared MSW server for the calling test file. */
export function setupMswServer() {
  beforeAll(() => server.listen({ onUnhandledFrame: "error" }));
  afterEach(() => server.resetHandlers());
  afterAll(() => server.close());
  return server;
}
import "@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest";

import { cleanup } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach } from "vitest";

// RTL only auto-cleans when test globals are enabled; this suite imports them explicitly.
afterEach(() => cleanup());
import { expect, test, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

// Source key -> hostname the fixture site answers for inside the stack (compose.e2e.yaml).
const FIXTURE_HOSTS: Record<string, string> = {
  yahoo: "finance.yahoo.com",
  cnbc: "www.cnbc.com",
  fool: "www.fool.com",
  prnewswire: "www.prnewswire.com",
  globenewswire: "www.globenewswire.com",
  sec: "www.sec.gov",
  cnn: "www.cnn.com",
  fortune: "fortune.com",
  guardian: "www.theguardian.com",
  bbc: "www.bbc.com",
};
const fixtureUrl = (host: string) => `http://${host}/vt-skeleton/article-1`;

const ARTICLE_URL = process.env.E2E_ARTICLE_URL ?? fixtureUrl(FIXTURE_HOSTS.cnbc);
const DECISION_MODEL = process.env.E2E_DECISION_MODEL ?? "tev1:0.8b-q8_0";
const EXTRACTOR = process.env.E2E_EXTRACTOR ?? "trafilatura";

// Model-agnostic: any valid label passes, the point is the plumbing.
const SENTIMENT = /^(Bullish|Bearish|Neutral)$/;
const LABELS = ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral"];

async function open(page: Page, mode: "Split" | "Combined", streaming: boolean) {
  await page.goto("/");
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeVisible();
  // Pickers fill from /api/models; waiting here keeps selectOption from racing the fetch.
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Signal model")).toContainText("(default)");
  await page.getByRole("radio", { name: new RegExp(mode) }).check();
  const toggle = page.getByRole("checkbox", { name: /Streaming/ });
  if (streaming) await toggle.check();
  else await toggle.uncheck();
}

async function analyze(page: Page) {
  await page.getByLabel("Article URL").fill(ARTICLE_URL);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Analyze" }).click();
}

async function expectNoError(page: Page) {
  // Not getByRole("alert"): Next's route announcer also carries that role.
  await expect(page.getByTestId("error-banner")).toHaveCount(0);
}

test.describe("analyze page", () => {
  test("split mode streams a summary next to the signal, with timings", async ({ page }) => {
    await open(page, "Split", true);
    await analyze(page);

    await expect(page.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveText(SENTIMENT);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveText("Complete");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-text")).not.toBeEmpty();
    await expectNoError(page);

    const latency = page.getByTestId("latency");
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-signal")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-summary")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-signal-signal")).toBeAttached();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-summary-token")).toBeAttached();
    await expect(latency.getByText("server total")).toHaveCount(2);
  });

  test("combined streaming delivers sentiment, summary and timings in one call", async ({ page }) => {
    await open(page, "Combined", true);
    await analyze(page);

    await expect(page.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveText(SENTIMENT);
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveText("Complete");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-text")).not.toBeEmpty();
    await expectNoError(page);

    const latency = page.getByTestId("latency");
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("lane-analyze")).toBeVisible();
    await expect(latency.getByTestId("mark-analyze-signal")).toBeAttached();
    await expect(latency.getByText("server total")).toHaveCount(1);
  });

  test("decision model and extractor switch flow through the JSON endpoints", async ({ page }) => {
    await open(page, "Split", false);
    await page.getByLabel("Signal model").selectOption(DECISION_MODEL);
    await page.getByLabel("Extractor").selectOption(EXTRACTOR);
    await expect(page.getByLabel("Parser")).toBeDisabled();
    await analyze(page);

    await expect(page.getByTestId("signal-badge")).toHaveText(SENTIMENT);
    const signal = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Signal", exact: true });
    await expect(signal).toContainText(DECISION_MODEL);
    await expect(signal).toContainText("probability");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("summary-status")).toHaveText("Complete");
    await expect(page.getByTestId("article-extraction")).toContainText(EXTRACTOR);
    await expectNoError(page);
  });
});

test.describe("signal-only API with the decision model", () => {
  for (const [source, host] of Object.entries(FIXTURE_HOSTS)) {
    test(`${source}: label, source profile and stage timings`, async ({ request }) => {
      // no_cache: earlier tests and the CI warm-up may have cached this exact request.
      const resp = await request.post("/api/signal", {
        data: { url: fixtureUrl(host), model: DECISION_MODEL, no_cache: true },
      });
      expect(resp.status()).toBe(200);
      const body = await resp.json();

      expect(LABELS).toContain(body.signal.sentiment);
      expect(body.signal.policy).toBe("probability");
      expect(Object.keys(body.signal.probabilities).sort()).toEqual([...LABELS].sort());
      expect(body.meta).toMatchObject({
        source,
        model: DECISION_MODEL,
        model_kind: "decision",
        endpoint: "signal",
        cached: false,
      });
      expect(body.timings.inference.wall_ms).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });
  }
});
```

```
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { ApiError } from "@/lib/api";
import { articleMeta, distinctErrors, initialRunState, runReducer, type RunAction } from "@/lib/run-state";
import { articleMeta as metaFixture, bullishDecision, summaryResponse } from "@/mocks/fixtures";

const start: RunAction = {
  type: "start",
  runId: 1,
  mode: "split",
  streaming: true,
  lanes: ["signal", "summary"],
};

function play(actions: RunAction[]) {
  return actions.reduce(runReducer, initialRunState);
}

describe("runReducer", () => {
  it("tracks deltas, first token and the authoritative final summary", () => {
    const done = summaryResponse();
    const state = play([
      start,
      { type: "meta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 50, meta: done.meta },
      { type: "delta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 300, text: "Acme " },
      { type: "delta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 340, text: "beat" },
      {
        type: "done",
        runId: 1,
        lane: "summary",
        atMs: 900,
        meta: done.meta,
        timings: done.timings,
        summary: "Final.",
      },
    ]);
    const lane = state.lanes.find((l) => l.id === "summary");
    expect(lane).toMatchObject({ status: "done", firstTokenAtMs: 300, endAtMs: 900 });
    expect(state.summary).toBe("Final.");
    expect(state.summaryTruncated).toBe(false);
    expect(state.running).toBe(true);
    expect(articleMeta(state)?.title).toBe(done.meta.title);
  });

  it("keeps the truncation flag from the final summary until the next run", () => {
    const done = summaryResponse();
    const truncated = play([
      start,
      {
        type: "done",
        runId: 1,
        lane: "summary",
        atMs: 900,
        meta: done.meta,
        timings: done.timings,
        summary: "Cut.",
        truncated: true,
      },
      { type: "done", runId: 1, lane: "signal", atMs: 950, meta: done.meta, timings: done.timings },
    ]);
    expect(truncated.summaryTruncated).toBe(true);
    expect(runReducer(truncated, { ...start, runId: 2 }).summaryTruncated).toBe(false);
  });

  it("records time to signal from a JSON signal response and finishes the run", () => {
    const state = play([
      start,
      {
        type: "done",
        runId: 1,
        lane: "signal",
        atMs: 420,
        meta: metaFixture({ endpoint: "signal" }),
        timings: summaryResponse().timings,
        signal: bullishDecision,
      },
      {
        type: "error",
        runId: 1,
        lane: "summary",
        atMs: 500,
        error: new ApiError({ code: "llm_unreachable", message: "x" }),
      },
    ]);
    expect(state.signal).toEqual(bullishDecision);
    expect(state.lanes.find((l) => l.id === "signal")?.signalAtMs).toBe(420);
    expect(state.running).toBe(false);
  });

  it("ignores events from a superseded run", () => {
    const state = play([
      start,
      { ...start, runId: 2 },
      { type: "delta", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 10, text: "stale" },
    ]);
    expect(state.summary).toBe("");
    expect(state.runId).toBe(2);
  });

  it("marks active lanes cancelled", () => {
    const state = play([start, { type: "cancel", runId: 1, atMs: 120 }]);
    expect(state.lanes.map((l) => l.status)).toEqual(["cancelled", "cancelled"]);
    expect(state.running).toBe(false);
  });

  it("merges identical failures across lanes", () => {
    const err = () => new ApiError({ code: "paywalled", message: "Paywall" });
    const state = play([
      start,
      { type: "error", runId: 1, lane: "signal", atMs: 1, error: err() },
      { type: "error", runId: 1, lane: "summary", atMs: 2, error: err() },
    ]);
    expect(distinctErrors(state).map((e) => e.lanes)).toEqual([["signal", "summary"]]);
  });
});
```

```
"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    backend_tests = "backend/tests" if full else "backend/tests/unit"
    tests = [backend_tests, "evals/tests", "scripts/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true", help="unit tests only, no build (default)")
    mode.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="integration tests, coverage floor, build")
    parser.add_argument("--backend", action="store_true", help="only backend + evals")
    parser.add_argument("--frontend", action="store_true", help="only frontend")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_be = not args.frontend or args.backend
    run_fe = not args.backend or args.frontend
    steps = (backend_steps(args.full) if run_be else []) + (frontend_steps(args.full) if run_fe else [])

    failed = []
    for name, cmd, cwd in steps:
        print(f"\n== {name}: {' '.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
        if subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd).returncode != 0:
            failed.append(name)
    if failed:
        sys.exit(f"\nFAILED: {', '.join(failed)}")
    print("\nall checks passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```
"""Confidence policies: raw model output -> Verdict, abstaining to neutral below the frozen threshold."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import ClassVar

from veritrade.inference.schemas import LabelOut, OrdinalOut, score_sentiment
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, Endpoint, PolicyName, Sentiment, TokenLogprob, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec

# Ties resolve to the safe class first; also the criteria order sent to decision models.
TIE_ORDER: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("neutral", "bullish", "bearish")
# Share of first-token mass allowed on tokens that could start several classes before we give up.
AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX = 0.05

_VALUE_START = {
    "label": re.compile(r'"label"\s*:\s*"'),
    "score": re.compile(r'"score"\s*:\s*'),
}
_SCORE_HEAD = re.compile(r"^(?:-|-[12](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?|[012](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?)$")
_SCORE_KEY = re.compile(r'"score"\s*:')


def winner(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Sentiment:
    best = TIE_ORDER[0]
    for sentiment in TIE_ORDER[1:]:
        if probabilities.get(sentiment, 0.0) > probabilities.get(best, 0.0):
            best = sentiment
    return best


def normalise(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> dict[Sentiment, float]:
    total = sum(max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) for s in TIE_ORDER)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("probabilities sum to zero")
    return {s: max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def _threshold(
    name: PolicyName,
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float],
    min_p: float,
    score: int | None = None,
    tau: float | None = None,
) -> Verdict:
    top = winner(probabilities)
    if tau is not None and top == "neutral":
        side: Sentiment = "bullish" if probabilities["bullish"] >= probabilities["bearish"] else "bearish"
        if probabilities[side] >= tau:
            return Verdict(
                sentiment=side,
                abstained=False,
                policy=name,
                confidence=probabilities[side],
                score=score,
                probabilities=probabilities,
                threshold=min_p,
                directional_tau=tau,
            )
    confidence = probabilities[top]
    abstained = confidence < min_p
    return Verdict(
        sentiment="neutral" if abstained else top,
        abstained=abstained,
        policy=name,
        confidence=confidence,
        score=score,
        probabilities=probabilities,
        threshold=min_p,
        directional_tau=tau,
    )


def label_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Labels a token's text could start; empty means the grammar would reject it."""
    return {s for s in TIE_ORDER if s.startswith(rest) or rest.startswith(s + '"')}


def sign_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Class implied by a token that starts an enum score (-2..2); empty when the grammar rejects it."""
    if not rest:
        return set(TIE_ORDER)
    if not _SCORE_HEAD.match(rest):
        return set()
    return {"bearish" if rest[0] == "-" else "neutral" if rest[0] == "0" else "bullish"}


def first_value_token(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob], key: str
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
    """The generated token that starts the value of `key` (minus any text before the value) and its
    alternatives as {text after the same prefix: probability}; None if tokens do not tile the content."""
    match = _VALUE_START[key].search(content)
    if match is None:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end > offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset]
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            return tok.token[len(prefix) :], candidates
        pos = end
    return None


def _first_token_distribution(
    content: str,
    logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None,
    key: str,
    classes: Callable[[str], set[Sentiment]],
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    found = first_value_token(content, logprobs or (), key)
    if found is None:
        return None
    chosen, candidates = found
    if len(classes(chosen)) != 1:
        return None
    mass = dict.fromkeys(TIE_ORDER, 0.0)
    ambiguous = 0.0
    for rest, p in candidates.items():
        # A token ending exactly where the value starts (e.g. a bare space) says nothing about the class.
        if not rest:
            continue
        hit = classes(rest)
        if len(hit) == 1:
            mass[next(iter(hit))] += p
        elif hit:
            ambiguous += p
    total = sum(mass.values())
    if total <= 0 or ambiguous > AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX * (total + ambiguous):
        return None
    return {s: mass[s] / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def label_probabilities(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    """First label-token probabilities renormalised over tokens the grammar accepts (Ollama reports
    pre-mask logprobs, so "positive" is dropped). None when the generated first token is shared by
    two labels or ambiguous tokens carry real mass."""
    return _first_token_distribution(content, logprobs, "label", label_classes)


def score_sign_probabilities(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    """Class probabilities of the score's sign ("-" bearish, "0" neutral, "1"/"2" bullish) from the tokens
    after the colon, whitespace-insensitive because tokenizers fuse " -". A generated bare space defers to
    the next token; a bare space that was not generated hides its sign and counts as ambiguous."""
    match = _SCORE_KEY.search(content)
    if match is None or not logprobs:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    mass = dict.fromkeys(TIE_ORDER, 0.0)
    hidden = 0.0
    path = 1.0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end >= offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset] if pos < offset else ""
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            chosen = tok.token[len(prefix) :]
            for rest, p in candidates.items():
                if rest == chosen:
                    continue
                if not rest.strip():
                    hidden += path * p
                elif hit := sign_classes(rest.lstrip()):
                    mass[next(iter(hit))] += path * p
            if chosen.strip():
                hit = sign_classes(chosen.lstrip())
                if len(hit) != 1:
                    return None
                mass[next(iter(hit))] += path * candidates[chosen]
                total = sum(mass.values())
                if total <= 0 or hidden > AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX * (total + hidden):
                    return None
                return {s: mass[s] / total for s in TIE_ORDER}
            path *= candidates[chosen]
        pos = end
    return None
```

```
class ProbabilityPolicy:
    """Argmax unless its probability is below min_p (then neutral, abstained). With directional_tau, a
    neutral argmax still yields the likelier directional class when that class reaches tau: models that
    park most of their mass on neutral are otherwise never pushed into a call."""

    min_p: float
    directional_tau: float | None = None
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "probability"

    def decide(self, probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Verdict:
        return _threshold(self.name, normalise(probabilities), self.min_p, tau=self.directional_tau)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LabelLogprobPolicy:
    """The probability rule (min_p, directional_tau) on first-token label probabilities. On a label
    collision `decide` returns None and the adapter re-asks with the ordinal schema; when its sign is
    unreadable too, the chain ends at the ordinal policy."""

    min_p: float
    directional_tau: float | None = None
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "label-logprob"

    def decide(self, out: LabelOut | OrdinalOut, chat: ChatResult) -> Verdict | None:
        if isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            probabilities = label_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs)
            return None if probabilities is None else self.threshold(probabilities)
        probabilities = score_sign_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs)
        return None if probabilities is None else self.threshold(probabilities, score=out.score)

    def threshold(self, probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float], score: int | None = None) -> Verdict:
        return _threshold(
            self.name, normalise(probabilities), self.min_p, score=score, tau=self.directional_tau
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrdinalPolicy:
    """Directional only when |score| >= t; a zero score is a confident neutral, not an abstention."""

    t: int
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "ordinal"

    def decide(self, score: int) -> Verdict:
        raw = score_sentiment(score)
        abstained = raw != "neutral" and abs(score) < self.t
        return Verdict(
            sentiment="neutral" if abstained else raw,
            abstained=abstained,
            policy=self.name,
            score=score,
            threshold=float(self.t),
        )


Policy = ProbabilityPolicy | LabelLogprobPolicy | OrdinalPolicy


def _min_p(spec: ModelSpec) -> float:
    if spec.min_p is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{spec.name}: policy {spec.policy} needs min_p")
    return spec.min_p


def policy_for(spec: ModelSpec, streaming: bool = False, *, endpoint: Endpoint = "signal") -> Policy:
    """Streams and /analyze always threshold the ordinal score: it is read mid-JSON as soon as it
    closes, with no dependency on logprobs or on where the score sits in the output."""
    if spec.kind == "decision":
        return ProbabilityPolicy(_min_p(spec), spec.directional_tau)
    if streaming or endpoint == "analyze" or spec.policy == "ordinal":
        return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t)
    return LabelLogprobPolicy(_min_p(spec), spec.directional_tau)
```

```
{
  "printWidth": 110
}
name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  backend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          cache-dependency-glob: uv.lock
      - run: uv sync --all-packages --frozen
      - run: uv run python scripts/check.py --backend --full

  frontend:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: frontend
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          package_json_file: frontend/package.json
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version-file: frontend/.nvmrc
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: frontend/pnpm-lock.yaml
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: API types match backend/openapi.json
        run: pnpm gen:api && git diff --exit-code -- src/lib/api-schema.d.ts
      - run: pnpm lint
      - run: pnpm format:check
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm test
      - run: pnpm build

  # Full stack in containers: app image, CPU Ollama with the tiny CI models, fixture site, Playwright.
  e2e:
    needs: [backend, frontend]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      COMPOSE_FILE: compose.yaml:compose.e2e.yaml
      E2E_BASE_URL: http://localhost:8000
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      # The stack needs ~10 GB (Ollama image, models, app image, browser); deleting preinstalled SDKs
      # costs ~3 minutes, so it only runs when the runner image is short on space.
      - name: Free disk space
        run: |
          avail_gb=$(df --output=avail -BG / | tail -1 | tr -dc '0-9')
          if [ "$avail_gb" -lt 25 ]; then
            sudo rm -rf /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android /opt/ghc /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          fi
          df -h /

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: Build app image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: docker/app.Dockerfile
```

```typescript
import type { PolicyName, Sentiment, SignalResult } from "@/lib/api";
import { capitalize, coldStartNote, formatMs, formatPct } from "@/lib/format";
import type { LaneStatus } from "@/lib/run-state";

import styles from "./SignalCard.module.css";

const POLICY_NOTES: Record<PolicyName, string> = {
  probability: "threshold on the decision model's class probability",
  "label-logprob": "threshold on the label token probability",
  ordinal: "threshold on |score| of the -2..+2 scale",
};

const ORDER: readonly Sentiment[] = ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral"];

/** Direction the model leaned before the threshold turned it into an abstention. */
export function leaning(signal: SignalResult): Sentiment {
  if (signal.probabilities) {
    let best: Sentiment = signal.sentiment;
    for (const s of ORDER) {
      if ((signal.probabilities[s] ?? 0) > (signal.probabilities[best] ?? 0)) best = s;
    }
    return best;
  }
  if (typeof signal.score === "number" && signal.score !== 0) return signal.score > 0 ? "bullish" : "bearish";
  return signal.sentiment;
}

/** The frozen rule this call was held to, in words; null for payloads that predate thresholds. */
export function thresholdText(signal: SignalResult): string | null {
  const { threshold, directional_tau: tau } = signal;
  if (typeof threshold !== "number") return null;
  if (signal.policy === "ordinal") return `|score| ≥ ${threshold}`;
  const hasTau = typeof tau === "number";
  if (threshold <= 0 && !hasTau) return "none (top class wins)";
  const base = threshold > 0 ? `call needs ≥ ${formatPct(threshold)}` : "top class wins";
  return hasTau ? `${base}; bullish/bearish called at ≥ ${formatPct(tau)} even when neutral leads` : base;
}

/** Why the call abstained, with the numbers when the payload carries the threshold. */
export function abstainReason(signal: SignalResult): string {
  const { threshold, directional_tau: tau } = signal;
  const lean = leaning(signal);
  if (typeof threshold === "number") {
    if (signal.policy === "ordinal" && typeof signal.score === "number") {
      return `|score| ${Math.abs(signal.score)} (leaning ${capitalize(lean)}) is below this model's threshold of ${threshold}`;
    }
    const p = signal.probabilities?.[lean];
    if (typeof p === "number") {
      const reason = `the top class (${capitalize(lean)}, ${formatPct(p)}) is below this model's ${formatPct(threshold)} threshold`;
      // tau only rescues a neutral lead, so it is part of the reason only then.
      return lean === "neutral" && typeof tau === "number"
        ? `${reason}, and neither Bullish nor Bearish reached ${formatPct(tau)}`
        : reason;
    }
  }
  const leaned = lean === "neutral" ? "" : ` (it leaned ${capitalize(lean)})`;
  return `the call is below this model's confidence threshold${leaned}`;
}

function formatScore(score: number): string {
  return score > 0 ? `+${score}` : String(score);
}

const share = (value: number) => `${Math.max(0, Math.min(1, value)) * 100}%`;

interface SignalCardProps {
  status: LaneStatus;
  signal: SignalResult | null;
  entity?: string | null;
  model?: string | null;
  /** Client-measured time from submit to the signal arriving. */
  timeToSignalMs?: number | null;
  /** Server-reported time to sentiment on a combined stream. */
  serverMs?: number | null;
  /** The model had to be loaded for this request. */
  coldStart?: boolean | null;
  /** Ollama's model load time; decision models report none. */
  loadMs?: number | null;
}

export function SignalCard({ status, signal, coldStart, ...rest }: SignalCardProps) {
  const busy = !signal && (status === "pending" || status === "streaming");
  return (
    <section className={styles.card} aria-labelledby="signal-heading" aria-busy={busy}>
      <h2 id="signal-heading" className={styles.heading}>
        Signal
      </h2>
      {signal ? (
        <SignalBody signal={signal} coldStart={coldStart} {...rest} />
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.placeholder}>
          {busy
            ? coldStart
              ? "Waiting for the signal while the model loads into memory (cold start)..."
              : "Waiting for the signal..."
            : status === "cancelled"
              ? "Cancelled."
              : "No signal: the request failed."}
        </p>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

type SignalBodyProps = Omit<SignalCardProps, "status" | "signal"> & { signal: SignalResult };

function SignalBody({ signal, entity, model, timeToSignalMs, serverMs, coldStart, loadMs }: SignalBodyProps) {
  const rule = thresholdText(signal);
  const thresholdMark =
    signal.policy !== "ordinal" && typeof signal.threshold === "number" && signal.threshold > 0
      ? signal.threshold
      : null;
  const tauMark = typeof signal.directional_tau === "number" ? signal.directional_tau : null;
  return (
    <>
      <div className={styles.row}>
        <span
          className={styles.badge}
          data-sentiment={signal.sentiment}
          data-abstained={signal.abstained || undefined}
          data-testid="signal-badge"
        >
          {signal.abstained ? "No signal" : capitalize(signal.sentiment)}
        </span>
        {entity ? <span className={styles.entity}>{entity}</span> : null}
      </div>
      {signal.abstained ? (
        <p className={styles.abstainNote} data-testid="abstain-note">
          Abstained: {abstainReason(signal)}, so there is no directional call.
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <dl className={styles.stats}>
        {typeof signal.confidence === "number" ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Confidence</dt>
            <dd>{formatPct(signal.confidence)}</dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {typeof signal.score === "number" ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Score</dt>
            <dd>{formatScore(signal.score)} on -2..+2</dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        <div>
          <dt>Policy</dt>
          <dd>
            <code>{signal.policy}</code> <span className={styles.note}>({POLICY_NOTES[signal.policy]})</span>
          </dd>
        </div>
        {rule ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Threshold</dt>
            <dd data-testid="signal-threshold">{rule}</dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {model ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Model</dt>
            <dd>
              <code>{model}</code>
            </dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
        {typeof timeToSignalMs === "number" ? (
          <div>
            <dt>Time to signal</dt>
            <dd>
              {formatMs(timeToSignalMs)}
              {typeof serverMs === "number" ? (
                <span className={styles.note}> (server {formatMs(serverMs)})</span>
              ) : null}
              {coldStart ? (
                <span className={styles.cold} data-testid="signal-cold-start">
                  <span className={styles.tag}>Cold start</span> {coldStartNote(loadMs)}
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </dd>
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </dl>
      {signal.probabilities ? (
        <>
          <ul className={styles.probs} aria-label="Class probabilities">
            {ORDER.map((s) => {
              const p = signal.probabilities?.[s] ?? 0;
              return (
                <li key={s} className={styles.prob}>
                  <span className={styles.probLabel}>{capitalize(s)}</span>
                  <span className={styles.probTrack} aria-hidden="true">
                    <span className={styles.probFill} data-sentiment={s} style={{ width: share(p) }} />
                    {thresholdMark !== null ? (
                      <span
                        className={styles.probMark}
                        data-kind="threshold"
                        data-testid={`mark-threshold-${s}`}
                        style={{ left: share(thresholdMark) }}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                    {tauMark !== null && s !== "neutral" ? (
                      <span
                        className={styles.probMark}
                        data-kind="tau"
                        data-testid={`mark-tau-${s}`}
                        style={{ left: share(tauMark) }}
                      />
                    ) : null}
                  </span>
                  <span className={styles.probValue}>{formatPct(p)}</span>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ul>
          {thresholdMark !== null || tauMark !== null ? (
            <p className={styles.markLegend} aria-hidden="true">
              {thresholdMark !== null ? (
                <span>
                  <span className={styles.markSwatch} data-kind="threshold" />
                  threshold {formatPct(thresholdMark)}
                </span>
              ) : null}
              {tauMark !== null ? (
                <span>
                  <span className={styles.markSwatch} data-kind="tau" />
                  tau {formatPct(tauMark)} (bullish/bearish)
                </span>
              ) : null}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </>
      ) : null}
    </>
  );
}
```
