"""Thin async adapters from (model spec, prompt, article text) to validated outputs and verdicts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import logging
import re
from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any, overload

from pydantic import BaseModel, ValidationError

from veritrade.errors import SchemaViolation
from veritrade.extract.dom import split_sentences
from veritrade.inference.confidence import (
    LabelLogprobPolicy,
    OrdinalPolicy,
    ProbabilityPolicy,
    policy_for,
)
from veritrade.inference.incremental import (
    EntityClosed,
    JsonFieldScanner,
    ScanEvent,
    ScoreClosed,
    SummaryText,
)
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient, OutputTruncated
from veritrade.inference.schemas import (
    ANALYZE_MODELS,
    AnalyzeOut,
    AnalyzeSentimentFirst,
    AnalyzeSummaryFirst,
    LabelOut,
    OrdinalOut,
    SummaryOut,
    ollama_format,
)
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, OllamaTimings, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec, SignalSchema
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec

CHARS_PER_TOKEN = 4
TOP_LOGPROBS = 20
# Product spec for every served summary; models overshoot it, so serving enforces it.
SUMMARY_MAX_SENTENCES = 3
SUMMARY_MAX_WORDS = 60
ELLIPSIS = "…"
# Terminal punctuation, closing quotes or brackets, then whitespace. The text end is no boundary:
# a cut right after "3." may sit inside "3.5".
_COMPLETE_SENTENCES = re.compile(r"(.*[.!?][\"'”’)\]]*)\s", re.DOTALL)

log = logging.getLogger(__name__)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SummaryResult:
    output: SummaryOut
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class AnalyzeResult:
    output: AnalyzeOut
    verdict: Verdict
    chat: ChatResult
    truncated: bool = False

    @property
    def entity(self) -> str | None:
        return self.output.entity.strip() or None


def fit_input(text: str, max_input_tokens: int) -> str:
    """Cap at max_input_tokens (chars/4), cutting at the last whitespace so no word is split."""
    limit = max_input_tokens * CHARS_PER_TOKEN
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    cut = max(text.rfind(" ", 0, limit), text.rfind("\n", 0, limit))
    return text[: cut if cut > limit // 2 else limit].rstrip()


def chat_options(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint) -> dict[str, Any]:
    options: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if spec.num_ctx is not None:
        options["num_ctx"] = spec.num_ctx
    if endpoint in spec.num_predict:
        options["num_predict"] = spec.num_predict[endpoint]
    return options


def score_verdict(spec: ModelSpec, score: int) -> Verdict:
    """Verdict for a streamed or /analyze score; both always use the ordinal policy."""
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(score)


def _sum(a: float | None, b: float | None) -> float | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _sum_int(a: int | None, b: int | None) -> int | None:
    return None if a is None and b is None else (a or 0) + (b or 0)


def _combine(first: ChatResult, second: ChatResult) -> ChatResult:
    # The fallback call's output decides; the reported cost covers both calls.
    t1, t2 = first.timings, second.timings
    return ChatResult(
        content=second.content,
        wall_ms=first.wall_ms + second.wall_ms,
        timings=OllamaTimings(
            load_ms=_sum(t1.load_ms, t2.load_ms),
            prompt_eval_ms=_sum(t1.prompt_eval_ms, t2.prompt_eval_ms),
            eval_ms=_sum(t1.eval_ms, t2.eval_ms),
            prompt_tokens=_sum_int(t1.prompt_tokens, t2.prompt_tokens),
            eval_tokens=_sum_int(t1.eval_tokens, t2.eval_tokens),
            total_ms=_sum(t1.total_ms, t2.total_ms),
        ),
        logprobs=second.logprobs,
        done_reason=second.done_reason,
    )


async def _signal_call(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str, schema: SignalSchema
) -> tuple[LabelOut | OrdinalOut, ChatResult]:
    out_type: type[LabelOut] | type[OrdinalOut] = LabelOut if schema == "label" else OrdinalOut
    return await client.chat_json(
        spec.name,
        prompt.messages(text, schema),
        out_type,
        options=chat_options(spec, "signal"),
        logprobs=True,
        top_logprobs=TOP_LOGPROBS,
    )


async def classify_signal(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> tuple[Verdict, ChatResult | DecisionResult]:
    """Label-logprob falls back label -> ordinal call (score sign) -> ordinal policy on the score."""
    text = fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens)
    policy = policy_for(spec, endpoint="signal")
    if isinstance(policy, ProbabilityPolicy):
        decision = await client.decide_sentiment(
            spec.name, prompt.state(text), prompt.instructions, prompt.criteria_map
        )
        return policy.decide(decision.probabilities), decision
    out, chat = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, spec.signal_schema or "ordinal")
    if isinstance(policy, LabelLogprobPolicy):
        verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is None and isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            out, second = await _signal_call(client, spec, prompt, text, "ordinal")
            chat = _combine(chat, second)
            verdict = policy.decide(out, chat)
        if verdict is not None:
            return verdict, chat
    if not isinstance(out, OrdinalOut):
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name}: a label output needs the label-logprob policy")
    return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t).decide(out.score), chat


def _validate[T: BaseModel](out_type: type[T], content: str, model: str) -> T:
    try:
        return out_type.model_validate_json(content)
    except ValidationError as exc:
        raise SchemaViolation(
            f"{model} streamed output that does not match {out_type.__name__}", hint=str(exc)[:300]
        ) from exc


def cut_to_sentence(text: str) -> str:
    """The text up to its last complete sentence, or all of it when no sentence has ended."""
    match = _COMPLETE_SENTENCES.match(text)
    return (match.group(1) if match else text).strip()


def cap_summary(
    text: str, max_sentences: int = SUMMARY_MAX_SENTENCES, max_words: int = SUMMARY_MAX_WORDS
) -> str:
    """Whole leading sentences within both caps; a first sentence over the word cap is cut at a word
    and ends with an ellipsis. Text already within the caps is returned unchanged."""
    sentences = split_sentences(text)
    kept: list[str] = []
    words = 0
    for sentence in sentences[:max_sentences]:
        count = len(sentence.split())
        if words + count > max_words:
            break
        kept.append(sentence)
        words += count
    if len(kept) == len(sentences):
        return text.strip()
    if kept:
        return " ".join(kept)
    head = " ".join(sentences[0].split()[:max_words]).rstrip(",;:")
    return head + ELLIPSIS


@overload
def _capped(out: SummaryOut) -> SummaryOut: ...
@overload
def _capped(out: AnalyzeOut) -> AnalyzeOut: ...
def _capped(out: SummaryOut | AnalyzeOut) -> SummaryOut | AnalyzeOut:
    summary = cap_summary(out.summary)
    return out if summary == out.summary else out.model_copy(update={"summary": summary})


def _salvage(spec: ModelSpec, endpoint: Endpoint, chat: ChatResult) -> tuple[int | None, str, str]:
    """Score, entity and sentence-cut summary decoded from JSON that num_predict cut off."""
    log.warning(
        "%s output from %s hit num_predict after %s eval tokens; salvaging the partial JSON",
        endpoint,
        spec.name,
        chat.timings.eval_tokens,
    )
    score: int | None = None
    entity = ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for event in JsonFieldScanner().feed(chat.content):
        match event:
            case ScoreClosed(score=value):
                score = value
            case EntityClosed(entity=value):
                entity = value
            case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                parts.append(delta)
    summary = cut_to_sentence("".join(parts))
    if not summary:
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name} reached its output token limit before writing a summary")
    return score, entity, summary


def _salvage_summary(spec: ModelSpec, chat: ChatResult) -> SummaryResult:
    _, _, summary = _salvage(spec, "summary", chat)
    return SummaryResult(_capped(SummaryOut(summary=summary)), chat, truncated=True)


def _salvage_analyze(
    spec: ModelSpec, out_type: type[AnalyzeSentimentFirst] | type[AnalyzeSummaryFirst], chat: ChatResult
) -> AnalyzeResult:
    """A cut generation still needs its score; summary-first output cut before it stays a violation."""
    score, entity, summary = _salvage(spec, "analyze", chat)
    if score is None:
        raise SchemaViolation(f"{spec.name} reached its output token limit before writing the score")
    out = _capped(out_type.model_validate({"score": score, "entity": entity, "summary": summary}))
    return AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), chat, truncated=True)


def _was_cut(chat: ChatResult, scanner: JsonFieldScanner) -> bool:
    return chat.done_reason == "length" and not scanner.done


async def summarize(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> SummaryResult:
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    try:
        out, chat = await client.chat_json(
            spec.name, messages, SummaryOut, options=chat_options(spec, "summary"), retry_cut=False
        )
    except OutputTruncated as cut:
        return _salvage_summary(spec, cut.chat)
    return SummaryResult(_capped(out), chat)


async def summarize_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | SummaryResult]:
    """Summary text deltas as they decode, then the validated result (no retry once tokens are out)."""
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), "default")
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(SummaryOut), options=chat_options(spec, "summary")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                if _was_cut(item, scanner):
                    yield _salvage_summary(spec, item)
                    return
                scanner.close()
                yield SummaryResult(_capped(_validate(SummaryOut, item.content, spec.name)), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event


async def analyze(client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str) -> AnalyzeResult:
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    out_type = ANALYZE_MODELS[order]
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    try:
        out, chat = await client.chat_json(
            spec.name, messages, out_type, options=chat_options(spec, "analyze"), retry_cut=False
        )
    except OutputTruncated as cut:
        return _salvage_analyze(spec, out_type, cut.chat)
    out = _capped(out)
    return AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), chat)


async def analyze_stream(
    client: OllamaClient, spec: ModelSpec, prompt: PromptSpec, text: str
) -> AsyncGenerator[ScanEvent | AnalyzeResult]:
    """Scanner events in generation order (ScoreClosed first when sentiment-first), then the result."""
    order = spec.field_order or "sentiment-first"
    out_type = ANALYZE_MODELS[order]
    messages = prompt.messages(fit_input(text, spec.max_input_tokens), order)
    scanner = JsonFieldScanner()
    stream = client.chat_stream(
        spec.name, messages, format=ollama_format(out_type), options=chat_options(spec, "analyze")
    )
    async with aclosing(stream):
        async for item in stream:
            if isinstance(item, ChatResult):
                if _was_cut(item, scanner):
                    yield _salvage_analyze(spec, out_type, item)
                    return
                scanner.close()
                out = _capped(_validate(out_type, item.content, spec.name))
                yield AnalyzeResult(out, score_verdict(spec, out.score), item)
                return
            for event in scanner.feed(item):
                yield event

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        await self._http.aclose()

    async def __aenter__(self) -> Self:
        return self

    async def __aexit__(
        self, exc_type: type[BaseException] | None, exc: BaseException | None, tb: TracebackType | None
    ) -> None:
        await self.aclose()

    # --- transport ------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def _transport_error(self, exc: httpx.HTTPError, model: str | None) -> VtError:
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.ConnectError | httpx.ConnectTimeout):
            return LlmUnreachable(
                f"Cannot reach Ollama at {self.base_url}: {exc}",
                hint="Start Ollama (`brew services start ollama`) or point OLLAMA_BASE_URL at it.",
            )
        if isinstance(exc, httpx.TimeoutException):
            return InferenceTimeout(f"Ollama did not answer in time for {model or 'request'}: {exc!r}")
        return LlmUnreachable(f"Ollama connection failed: {exc!r}")

    async def request(
        self, method: str, path: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, *, model: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """One JSON round trip with Ollama errors mapped to typed VtErrors."""
        try:
            response = await self._http.request(method, path, json=payload)
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned non-JSON for {path}") from exc
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned an unexpected body for {path}")
        return body

    async def embed(self, model: str, inputs: Sequence[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        body = {"model": model, "input": list(inputs), "keep_alive": self.keep_alive}
        raw = await self.request("POST", "/api/embed", body, model=model)
        embeddings = raw.get("embeddings")

"""/signal: one non-streaming classification of the lede (or the full article)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from veritrade.api.contracts import SignalRequest, SignalResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import classify_signal
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, inference_timings, signal_result
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


async def run_signal(runtime: Runtime, request: SignalRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SignalResponse:
    job = Job.resolve(runtime, "signal", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SignalResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = SignalResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(verdict),
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(raw)),
    )
    job.remember(response)
    return response
"""/summary: a short summary of the full article, as one JSON body or as streamed deltas."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import SummaryDeltaEvent, SummaryDoneEvent, SummaryRequest, SummaryResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import SummaryResult, summarize, summarize_stream
from veritrade.inference.incremental import SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, Prepared, StreamPayload, cached_meta_event, inference_timings
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "summary", request, scope="full", clock=clock)


async def run_summary(runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SummaryResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await summarize(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_summary_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: SummaryRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SummaryResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = summarize_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case SummaryResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: SummaryResponse) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield SummaryDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: SummaryResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> SummaryResponse:
    return SummaryResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        truncated=result.truncated,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )
"""/analyze: sentiment, entity and summary from one generation, as JSON or as streamed events."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    SentimentEvent,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
)
from veritrade.inference.adapters import AnalyzeResult, analyze, analyze_stream, score_verdict
from veritrade.inference.incremental import EntityClosed, ScoreClosed, SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import (
    Job,
    Prepared,
    StreamPayload,
    cached_meta_event,
    inference_timings,
    signal_result,
)
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "analyze", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)


async def run_analyze(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await analyze(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_analyze_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit, clock)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Events follow generation order, so the frozen field order decides where `sentiment` lands."""
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    entity: str | None = None
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = analyze_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case ScoreClosed(score=score):
                    yield SentimentEvent(
                        signal=signal_result(score_verdict(job.spec, score)),
                        entity=entity,
                        elapsed_ms=job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
                    )
                case EntityClosed(entity=name):
                    entity = name.strip() or None
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case AnalyzeResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: AnalyzeResponse, clock: StageTimer) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SentimentEvent(signal=hit.signal, entity=hit.entity, elapsed_ms=clock.elapsed_ms())
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: AnalyzeResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    return AnalyzeResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(result.verdict),
        entity=result.entity,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        truncated=result.truncated,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )

"""Model allowlist and per-endpoint defaults loaded from `data/models.toml`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tomllib
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from functools import lru_cache
from importlib import resources
from typing import Any, Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import ModelNotAllowed
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, FieldOrder, ModelKind, PolicyName

ENDPOINTS: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = get_args(Endpoint)
SignalSchema = Literal["label", "ordinal"]


class ModelSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    num_ctx: int | None = Field(None, gt=0)
    max_input_tokens: int = Field(gt=0)
    num_predict: dict[Endpoint, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    signal_schema: SignalSchema | None = None
    policy: PolicyName
    # 0 never abstains on the winning class.
    min_p: float | None = Field(None, ge=0, le=1)
    ordinal_t: int = Field(1, ge=1, le=2)
    directional_tau: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, lt=1)
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    # Frozen prompt version per endpoint; an endpoint left out serves the prompt file's `active`.
    prompt: dict[Endpoint, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    evaluated: bool = True

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _default_field_order(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict) and "analyze" in data.get("endpoints", ()) and not data.get("field_order"):
            return {**data, "field_order": "sentiment-first"}
        return data

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _check_consistency(self) -> ModelSpec:
        if self.kind == "decision":
            if self.endpoints != ("signal",) or self.policy != "probability":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{self.name}: decision models serve only /signal with the probability policy"
                )
        else:
            if self.policy == "probability":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models have no native class probabilities")
            if self.num_ctx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models need num_ctx")
            missing = [e for e in self.endpoints if e not in self.num_predict]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: num_predict missing for {missing}")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.signal_schema is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative /signal models need signal_schema")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.policy == "ordinal" and self.signal_schema != "ordinal":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: the ordinal policy needs signal_schema = 'ordinal'")
        if self.policy in ("probability", "label-logprob") and self.min_p is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: policy {self.policy} needs min_p")
        if self.directional_tau is not None and self.policy == "ordinal":
            raise ValueError(
                f"{self.name}: directional_tau needs class probabilities, not the ordinal policy"
            )
        if stray := sorted(set(self.prompt) - set(self.endpoints)):
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: prompt versions for endpoints it does not serve: {stray}")
        return self

    def serves(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> bool:
        return endpoint in self.endpoints


def parse_models_toml(text: str) -> tuple[dict[str, ModelSpec], dict[Endpoint, str]]:
    raw = tomllib.loads(text)
    specs = {name: ModelSpec(name=name, **body) for name, body in raw.get("models", {}).items()}
    defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
    for endpoint, name in raw.get("defaults", {}).items():
        if endpoint not in ENDPOINTS:
            raise ValueError(f"models.toml: unknown endpoint in [defaults]: {endpoint}")
        defaults[endpoint] = name
    return specs, defaults


def read_models_toml() -> str:
    return resources.files("veritrade.data").joinpath("models.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def allowlist() -> Mapping[str, ModelSpec]:
    """Every model in models.toml, ignoring VT_MODELS (prompts and evals need the full roster)."""
    return parse_models_toml(read_models_toml())[0]


class Registry:
    def __init__(
        self,
        specs: Mapping[str, ModelSpec],
        defaults: Mapping[Endpoint, str],
        *,
        restriction: Iterable[str] = (),
        overrides: Mapping[Endpoint, str | None] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        restricted = list(restriction)
        unknown = [name for name in restricted if name not in specs]
        if unknown:
            raise ValueError(f"VT_MODELS names models outside models.toml: {', '.join(unknown)}")
        keep = set(restricted) if restricted else set(specs)
        self._all = dict(specs)
        self._specs = {name: spec for name, spec in specs.items() if name in keep}
        self._defaults: dict[Endpoint, str] = {}
        for endpoint in ENDPOINTS:
            override = (overrides or {}).get(endpoint)
            if override:
                if not self._is_allowed(endpoint, override):
                    raise ValueError(f"default model override {override!r} is not allowed for /{endpoint}")
                self._defaults[endpoint] = override
                continue
            configured = defaults.get(endpoint)
            if configured and self._is_allowed(endpoint, configured):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = configured
            elif fallback := self.allowed(endpoint):
                self._defaults[endpoint] = fallback[0].name

    @classmethod
    def load(cls, settings: Settings | None = None, *, toml_text: str | None = None) -> Registry:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        specs, defaults = parse_models_toml(toml_text if toml_text is not None else read_models_toml())
        overrides: dict[Endpoint, str | None] = {
            "signal": settings.default_model_signal,
            "summary": settings.default_model_summary,
            "analyze": settings.default_model_analyze,
        }
        return cls(specs, defaults, restriction=settings.model_restriction, overrides=overrides)

    def _is_allowed(self, endpoint: Endpoint, name: str) -> bool:
        spec = self._specs.get(name)
        return spec is not None and spec.serves(endpoint)

    @property
    def models(self) -> list[ModelSpec]:
        return list(self._specs.values())

def _status_error(status: int, text: str, model: str | None) -> VtError:
    name = model or "?"
    if status == 404 or "not found" in text.lower():
        return ModelUnavailable(
            f"Model {name} is not available in Ollama: {text}",
            hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {name}` or pick an installed model.",
            upstream_status=status,
        )
    return ModelUnavailable(
        f"Ollama rejected the request for {name} ({status}): {text}", upstream_status=status
    )


class OllamaClient:
    def __init__(
        self,
        base_url: str,
        *,
        timeout: float = 90.0,
        keep_alive: str | int = "30m",
        http: httpx.AsyncClient | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.base_url = base_url.rstrip("/")
        self.keep_alive = keep_alive
        self._http = http or httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url, timeout=httpx.Timeout(timeout, connect=min(5.0, timeout))
        )

    @classmethod
    def from_settings(cls, settings: Settings | None = None) -> OllamaClient:
        settings = settings or get_settings()
        return cls(
            settings.ollama_base_url,
            timeout=settings.inference_timeout_s,

"""URL to Article: single-flight fetch, then extraction (off the event loop when it is slow)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from functools import partial
from typing import Literal

from veritrade.extract.registry import extract
from veritrade.extract.types import PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS, Article, ExtractorName, ParserName
from veritrade.fetch import FetchResult, normalize_url
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime

FetchStatus = Literal["hit", "miss", "joined", "bypass"]
# Own strategies on these parsers take 0.4-4 ms on real pages, less than handing off is worth; bs4 and the
# third-party extractors take 5-60 ms of Python, which a thread lets concurrent streams interleave with.
INLINE_PARSERS: frozenset[ParserName] = frozenset({"selectolax", "lxml"})


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LoadedArticle:
    page: FetchResult
    article: Article
    fetch_status: FetchStatus
    fetch_ms: float
    consent_ms: float | None


async def load_article(
    runtime: Runtime, url: str, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName, no_cache: bool
) -> LoadedArticle:
    started = time.perf_counter()
    status: FetchStatus
    if no_cache:
        page, status = await runtime.fetcher.get(url), "bypass"
    else:
        fetch = partial(runtime.fetcher.get, url)
        shared = await runtime.fetch_cache.get_or_create(normalize_url(url), fetch)
        page, status = shared.value, shared.status
    if status in ("miss", "bypass"):
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = page.fetch_ms, page.consent_ms
    else:
        # A hit or join reports this request's own wait, not the download it reused.
        fetch_ms, consent_ms = (time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000, None
    article = await extract_article(page, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    return LoadedArticle(page, article, status, fetch_ms, consent_ms)


async def extract_article(page: FetchResult, *, parser: ParserName, extractor: ExtractorName) -> Article:
    run = partial(extract, page.html, page.final_url, parser=parser, extractor=extractor)
    if extractor in PARSER_AWARE_EXTRACTORS and parser in INLINE_PARSERS:
        return run()
    return await asyncio.to_thread(run)

"""Adversarial checks of Job.prepare's residency probe: cancellation, exception identity, timeouts."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import gc
import warnings
from types import SimpleNamespace
from typing import Any

import httpx

from veritrade.api.contracts import SignalRequest
from veritrade.config import Settings
from veritrade.errors import SourceBlocked
from veritrade.inference.ollama import OllamaClient
from veritrade.models_registry import allowlist
from veritrade.services import pipeline
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime, needs_load
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

SPEC = allowlist()["clef-flash:9b-q8_0"]
STATE: dict[str, Any] = {}


class StubRuntime:
    def __init__(self, probe_delay: float, probe_result: bool | None = True) -> None:
        self.probe_delay = probe_delay
        self.probe_result = probe_result
        self.settings = SimpleNamespace(ollama_backend_label="x")

    async def cold_start(self, spec: Any) -> bool | None:
        STATE["probe_started"] = True
        try:
            await asyncio.sleep(self.probe_delay)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            STATE["probe_cancelled"] = True
            raise
        return self.probe_result


def make_job(runtime: Any) -> pipeline.Job:
    request = SignalRequest(url="https://example.com/a")  # type: ignore[arg-type]
    return pipeline.Job(
        runtime=runtime,
        endpoint="signal",
        request=request,
        url="https://example.com/a",
        scope="lede",
        spec=SPEC,
        prompt=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        key=None,
        clock=StageTimer(),
    )


async def failing_load(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
    await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
    raise SourceBlocked("blocked by source")


async def scenario_fetch_raises_while_probe_pending() -> None:
    STATE.clear()
    pipeline.load_article = failing_load  # type: ignore[assignment]
    job = make_job(StubRuntime(probe_delay=5.0))
    try:
        await job.prepare()
    except BaseException as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print("A raised:", type(exc).__name__, "| is SourceBlocked:", isinstance(exc, SourceBlocked))
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    print("A probe cancelled:", STATE.get("probe_cancelled"))
    pending = [t for t in asyncio.all_tasks() if t is not asyncio.current_task()]
    print("A leftover tasks:", pending)


async def scenario_outer_cancel_while_awaiting_probe() -> None:
    STATE.clear()

    async def ok_load(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        return None

    pipeline.load_article = ok_load  # type: ignore[assignment]
    job = make_job(StubRuntime(probe_delay=5.0))
    task = asyncio.create_task(job.prepare())
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    task.cancel()
    try:
        await task
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        print("B outer cancelled")
    await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
    print("B probe cancelled:", STATE.get("probe_cancelled"))


async def scenario_real_runtime_cold_start_timeout() -> None:
    async def hang(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"models": []})

    async def malformed(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"models": {"oops": 1}})

    for name, handler in (("hang", hang), ("malformed", malformed)):
        http = httpx.AsyncClient(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler), base_url="http://ollama")
        client = OllamaClient("http://ollama", http=http)
        runtime = SimpleNamespace(settings=Settings(env="test", ollama_probe_timeout_s=0.05), ollama=client)
        try:
            result = await Runtime.cold_start(runtime, SPEC)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            print(f"C {name}:", result)
        except BaseException as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print(f"C {name} raised:", type(exc).__name__, exc)
        await http.aclose()


def scenario_needs_load() -> None:
    gen = allowlist()["qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0"]
    cases = {
        "two entries, first other ctx then same": [
            {"name": gen.name, "model": gen.name, "context_length": 4096},
            {"name": gen.name, "model": gen.name, "context_length": 8192},
        ],
        "model key only": [{"model": gen.name, "context_length": 8192}],
        "name None": [{"name": None, "model": gen.name, "context_length": 8192}],
        "ctx as float": [{"name": gen.name, "model": gen.name, "context_length": 8192.0}],
    }
    for label, entries in cases.items():
        print("D", label, "->", needs_load(gen, entries))


async def main() -> None:
    await scenario_fetch_raises_while_probe_pending()
    await scenario_outer_cancel_while_awaiting_probe()
    await scenario_real_runtime_cold_start_timeout()
    scenario_needs_load()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        asyncio.run(main(), debug=True)
        gc.collect()

"""Write backend/openapi.json from the FastAPI app; --check fails on drift (CI contract gate)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from veritrade.api.app import create_app
from veritrade.config import Settings

TARGET = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "backend" / "openapi.json"


def render() -> str:
    app = create_app(Settings(static_dir=None))
    return json.dumps(app.openapi(), indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n"


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    rendered = render()
    if args.check:
        if not TARGET.exists() or TARGET.read_text() != rendered:
            sys.exit("backend/openapi.json is stale: run `uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py`")
        print("openapi.json up to date")
        return
    TARGET.write_text(rendered)
    print(f"wrote {TARGET}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    backend_tests = "backend/tests" if full else "backend/tests/unit"
    tests = [backend_tests, "evals/tests", "scripts/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true", help="unit tests only, no build (default)")
    mode.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="integration tests, coverage floor, build")
    parser.add_argument("--backend", action="store_true", help="only backend + evals")
    parser.add_argument("--frontend", action="store_true", help="only frontend")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_be = not args.frontend or args.backend
    run_fe = not args.backend or args.frontend
    steps = (backend_steps(args.full) if run_be else []) + (frontend_steps(args.full) if run_fe else [])

    failed = []
    for name, cmd, cwd in steps:
        print(f"\n== {name}: {' '.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
        if subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd).returncode != 0:
            failed.append(name)
    if failed:

async def ollama_state(base_url: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Version, resident models and installed sizes; names and numbers only."""
    async with OllamaClient(base_url, timeout=10.0) as client:
        try:
            version = await client.version()
            resident = sorted(str(e.get("name") or e.get("model")) for e in await client.ps())
            sizes = {
                str(e.get("name")): int(e["size"])
                for e in await client.tags()
                if isinstance(e.get("size"), int)
            }
        except VtError as exc:
            return {"reachable": False, "error": exc.code.value}
    return {
        "reachable": True,
    return raw_dir / f"{session}.jsonl"


# --- suite -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


async def unload(ollama: OllamaClient, model: str, wait_s: float = UNLOAD_WAIT_S) -> None:
    """Returns once Ollama no longer lists the model as resident, so the next call is a true cold load."""
    await ollama.unload(model)
    deadline = time.monotonic() + wait_s
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if model not in {str(e.get("name") or e.get("model")) for e in await ollama.ps()}:
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    raise LatencyError(f"{model} is still resident {wait_s:.0f} s after the unload request")


async def unload_others(ollama: OllamaClient, model: str, log: TextIO) -> None:
    for entry in await ollama.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != model:
            print(f"unloading {name}", file=log, flush=True)
            await unload(ollama, name)

async def make_resident(
    client: OllamaClient, run: RunSpec, *, shared: bool = False, log: TextIO = sys.stderr
) -> None:
    """Unload every other model, then warm this one so the first timed call is not a cold load. On an
    Ollama shared with other runs, only warm up: their models stay loaded."""
    for entry in [] if shared else await client.ps():
        name = str(entry.get("name") or entry.get("model") or "")
        if name and name != run.model:
            try:
                await client.unload(name)
            except VtError as exc:
                print(f"warning: could not unload {name}: {exc.message}", file=log)
    await call_once(client, run, WARMUP_TEXT)

    )


async def event_stream(events: AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]) -> AsyncGenerator[ServerSentEvent]:
    """Closing the payload generator on any exit is what stops the upstream Ollama stream on disconnect."""
    async with aclosing(events):
        try:
            async for payload in events:
                yield ServerSentEvent(event=EVENT_NAMES[type(payload)], data=payload)
        except VtError as exc:
            yield ServerSentEvent(event="error", data=ErrorEvent(error=error_body(exc)))

# --- shared response parts ------------------------------------------------------------------


class CacheInfo(_Strict):
    fetch: Literal["hit", "miss", "joined", "bypass"]
    result: Literal["hit", "miss", "bypass"]


class InferenceTimings(_Strict):
    wall_ms: float
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    load_ms: float | None = None
    prompt_eval_ms: float | None = None
    eval_ms: float | None = None
    prompt_tokens: int | None = None
    eval_tokens: int | None = None
    cold_start: bool | None = Field(
        None,
        description="True when the model was not loaded in Ollama (or was loaded with another context size) "
        "as the request arrived, so the inference time includes loading it; null when unknown.",
    )


class Timings(_Strict):
    total_ms: float
    fetch_ms: float
    consent_ms: float | None = None
    parse_ms: float
    extract_ms: float
    inference: InferenceTimings | None = None
    cache: CacheInfo


class ArticleMeta(_Strict):
    url: str
    final_url: str
    title: str
    source: str | None = Field(None, description="Key from sources.toml when the domain is a known source.")
    published_at: str | None = None

+++ b/README.md
+  (10), the parser (4) and, in split mode, the scope. The signal and analyze pickers append each model's frozen
+  rule to its name, e.g. `clef-flash:9b-q8_0 (p ≥ 0.80)`, `qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0 (tau 0.28)` or
+  `qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M (|score| ≥ 1)` ([thresholds](#thresholds-and-no-signal)).
+- Results: the signal card (the label, or **No signal** with the numbers behind the abstention; policy, the
+  threshold the call was held to, confidence, and probability bars marked at the threshold and tau), the streamed
+  summary, the article line (source, extraction method) and a latency bar that puts each request's server stage
+  timings on one client time axis, with time-to-signal and first-token marks. A request that had to load its model
+  first is marked as a **cold start** on the time to signal, the summary and the latency bar, with the load time
+  when Ollama reports one ([cold starts](#latency-trade-offs)).
+| `GET /api/models` | - | Allowlist (kind, endpoints, installed, size, `signal_rules`), per-endpoint defaults, parsers, extractors, scopes |
+`signal` holds `sentiment`, `abstained`, `policy`, the frozen `threshold` (and `directional_tau`) the call was held
+to and, by policy, `confidence`, `score` (-2..2) or `probabilities`. `timings` splits each request into fetch,
+consent, parse, extract and inference (wall, TTFT, load, prompt eval, eval, tokens, `cold_start`) and reports both
+cache outcomes.
+**SSE order.** `meta` (article meta, fetch / parse / extract timings, `cold_start`) once extraction is done, so a
+stream can say the model is loading before its first token; on `/analyze/stream` one `sentiment` event as soon as
+the score closes (served field order: sentiment-first); `summary_delta` text chunks; `done` with the full JSON
+response. A failure before the stream opens is a JSON error with its HTTP status, after that one `error` event; a
+closed connection stops the upstream generation.
+### Thresholds and "No signal"
+
+Confidence rules are frozen per model and endpoint. The served source of truth is
+[`models.toml`](backend/src/veritrade/data/models.toml) (`policy`, `min_p`, `directional_tau`, `ordinal_t`),
+written by `veritrade_evals freeze`, with the evidence behind each value (dev300 and dev-article F0.5, inversions and
+coverage at that threshold) in [`frozen.json`](evals/results/frozen.json); the policies are explained in
+[04](.context/docs/design/04-evals.md#4-models-prompts-and-confidence-policies). As frozen:
+
+| Model | `/signal` rule | `/analyze` rule |
+|---|---|---|
+| `qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0` (`/signal` default) | label-logprob, `min_p` 0, tau 0.28 | ordinal, \|score\| >= 1 |
+| `clef-flash:9b-q8_0` | probability, `min_p` 0.80 | - |
+| `nimble:9b-q4_K_M` | probability, `min_p` 0.97 | - |
+| `qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M` (`/analyze` default), `ministral-3:3b`, `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M`, `qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M` | - | ordinal, \|score\| >= 1 |
+| `tev1:0.8b-q8_0` (CI plumbing, never evaluated) | probability, `min_p` 0.50 (provisional) | - |
+
+- **Where to see them**: the signal and analyze pickers in the UI; the **Threshold** row and the threshold and tau
+  marks on every signal card; `GET /api/models`, whose `signal_rules` maps each signal endpoint of a model to its
+  `policy`, `threshold` and `directional_tau`; and every `signal` in a response, which carries the `threshold` and
+  `directional_tau` it was held to. A label-logprob rule falls back to ordinal \|score\| >= 1 on a first-token label
+  collision; `signal_rules` lists the primary rule.
+- **"No signal" is an abstention, by design** (precision over recall, Q2 and Q3): when the winning class is below
+  the model's frozen threshold, the service returns `sentiment: "neutral"` with `abstained: true` instead of a
+  directional call it is not confident in. The UI shows **No signal** and says why, e.g. "Abstained: the top class
+  (Bullish, 73.0%) is below this model's 80.0% threshold, so there is no directional call." A neutral with
+  `abstained: false` is a neutral verdict. With these rules only the 9B decision models abstain (dev300 coverage
+  72.9% for clef-flash, 26.3% for nimble); the defaults hold back by answering neutral
+  ([design decisions](#design-decisions)).
+
+model's confidence policy turns the answer into a label or an abstention against its frozen threshold
+(`backend/src/veritrade/`). While the page downloads, a `/api/ps` probe asks Ollama whether the model is already
+resident, so the response can flag a cold start.
+  reports `abstained` and the threshold it was held to ([per model](#thresholds-and-no-signal)). The frozen
+  defaults never abstain (dev300 coverage 100%): the 0.8B runs at `min_p` 0 with tau 0.28 and `/analyze` at
+  \|s\| >= 1 on integer scores, so they hold back by answering neutral; only the 9B decision models abstain (dev300
+  coverage 72.9% and 26.3%).
+  instead (704-822 `full` tokens for competent extractors, 2,116 for `strip-tags`).
+- **Cold starts.** A model stays resident for 30 minutes after its last request (`keep_alive` 30m on every call,
+  `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m`), so only the first request after a start, 30 idle minutes, or Ollama unloading it to make
+  room for other models pays the load. The committed cold cells (n=3, so indicative) put it at 0.7-1.3 s over warm
+  for the generative models, 0.9-1.2 s for `nimble` and 5.4-6.2 s for `clef-flash`, a 10.58 GB file. A generative
+  model resident with another `num_ctx` is reloaded as well. The service detects both: a `/api/ps` residency
+  probe runs alongside the article fetch and sets `timings.inference.cold_start` and the SSE `meta` event's
+  `cold_start`, and the UI marks the request as a cold start, with Ollama's load time when it reports one (decision
+  models report none). The committed latency numbers predate the probe: on a fetch miss it overlaps the download,
+  but when the page is already in memory (a fetch-cache hit) it adds one local `/api/ps` round trip, expected to
+  be a few ms but not measured; it gives up after 2 s and leaves `cold_start` null
+  ([05](.context/docs/design/05-latency.md#cold-start-parse-and-extract)).
+| Backend integration | `backend/tests/integration` | The ASGI app against fake publishers (skeleton pages) and a scripted Ollama: every endpoint in JSON and SSE, event order, single-flight and result caches, the error table, failures mid-stream, client disconnects, the cold-start probe (warm, cold, failing, hanging) |

+/** The frozen rule this call was held to, in words; null for payloads that predate thresholds. */
+export function thresholdText(signal: SignalResult): string | null {
+  const { threshold, directional_tau: tau } = signal;
+  if (typeof threshold !== "number") return null;
+  if (signal.policy === "ordinal") return `|score| ${AT_LEAST}${threshold}`;
+  const hasTau = typeof tau === "number";
+  if (threshold <= 0 && !hasTau) return "none (top class wins)";
+  const base = threshold > 0 ? `call needs ${AT_LEAST}${formatPct(threshold)}` : "top class wins";
+  return hasTau
+    ? `${base}; bullish/bearish called at ${AT_LEAST}${formatPct(tau)} even when neutral leads`
+    : base;
+}
+
+/** Why the call abstained, with the numbers when the payload carries the threshold. */
+export function abstainReason(signal: SignalResult): string {
+  const { threshold, directional_tau: tau } = signal;
+  const lean = leaning(signal);
+  if (typeof threshold === "number") {
+    if (signal.policy === "ordinal" && typeof signal.score === "number") {
+      return `|score| ${Math.abs(signal.score)} (leaning ${capitalize(lean)}) is below this model's threshold of ${threshold}`;
+    }
+    const p = signal.probabilities?.[lean];
+    if (typeof p === "number") {
+      const reason = `the top class (${capitalize(lean)}, ${formatPct(p)}) is below this model's ${formatPct(threshold)} threshold`;
+      // tau only rescues a neutral lead, so it is part of the reason only then.
+      return lean === "neutral" && typeof tau === "number"
+        ? `${reason}, and neither Bullish nor Bearish reached ${formatPct(tau)}`
+        : reason;
+    }
+  }
+  const leaned = lean === "neutral" ? "" : ` (it leaned ${capitalize(lean)})`;
+  return `the call is below this model's confidence threshold${leaned}`;
+}

 function formatScore(score: number): string {

+export function ruleLabel(rule: SignalRule | undefined): string | null {
+  if (!rule) return null;
+  if (rule.policy === "ordinal") return `|score| ≥ ${rule.threshold}`;
+  const parts: string[] = [];
+  if (rule.threshold > 0) parts.push(`p ≥ ${rule.threshold.toFixed(2)}`);
+  if (typeof rule.directional_tau === "number") parts.push(`tau ${rule.directional_tau.toFixed(2)}`);

+  const parts: string[] = [];
+  if (rules.some((r) => r.policy !== "ordinal" && r.threshold > 0)) {
+    parts.push("p ≥ x means the top class needs probability x or more");
+  }
+  if (rules.some((r) => typeof r.directional_tau === "number")) {
+    parts.push("tau x means bullish or bearish is called at x even when neutral leads");
+  }
+  if (rules.some((r) => r.policy === "ordinal")) {
+    parts.push("|score| ≥ n means the -2..+2 score needs magnitude n or more");
+  }
+  return parts.length
+    ? `In brackets, each model's frozen rule for a directional call. ${parts.join("; ")}.`
+    : null;

import type { ApiError, ArticleMeta, SignalResult, Timings } from "./api";

export type Mode = "split" | "combined";
export type LaneId = "signal" | "summary" | "analyze";
export type LaneStatus = "pending" | "streaming" | "done" | "error" | "cancelled";

export interface Lane {
  id: LaneId;
  status: LaneStatus;
  meta: ArticleMeta | null;
  timings: Timings | null;
  error: ApiError | null;
  /** The model had to be loaded for this request; null when unknown or served from the result cache. */
  coldStart: boolean | null;
  // Client clock: milliseconds since the run started, from performance.now().
  signalAtMs: number | null;
  firstTokenAtMs: number | null;
  endAtMs: number | null;
}

export interface RunState {
  runId: number;
  mode: Mode;
  streaming: boolean;
  running: boolean;
  lanes: Lane[];
  signal: SignalResult | null;
  entity: string | null;
  /** Server-reported time to sentiment on the combined stream. */
  serverSignalMs: number | null;
  summary: string;
  /** The server cut the summary at the model's output limit. */
  summaryTruncated: boolean;
}

interface Tagged {
  runId: number;
  lane: LaneId;
  atMs: number;
}

export type RunAction =
  | { type: "start"; runId: number; mode: Mode; streaming: boolean; lanes: LaneId[] }
  | ({ type: "meta"; meta: ArticleMeta; coldStart?: boolean | null } & Tagged)
  | ({ type: "signal"; signal: SignalResult; entity: string | null; serverMs: number | null } & Tagged)
  | ({ type: "delta"; text: string } & Tagged)
  | ({
      type: "done";
      meta: ArticleMeta;
      timings: Timings;
      summary?: string;
      truncated?: boolean;
      signal?: SignalResult;
      entity?: string | null;
    } & Tagged)
  | ({ type: "error"; error: ApiError } & Tagged)
  | { type: "cancel"; runId: number; atMs: number };

export const initialRunState: RunState = {
  runId: 0,
  mode: "split",
  streaming: true,
  running: false,
  lanes: [],
  signal: null,
  entity: null,
  serverSignalMs: null,
  summary: "",
  summaryTruncated: false,
};

function newLane(id: LaneId): Lane {
  return {
    id,
    status: "pending",
    meta: null,
    timings: null,
    error: null,
    coldStart: null,
    signalAtMs: null,
    firstTokenAtMs: null,
    endAtMs: null,
  };
}

const isActive = (lane: Lane) => lane.status === "pending" || lane.status === "streaming";

function patchLane(state: RunState, id: LaneId, patch: (lane: Lane) => Partial<Lane>): RunState {
  const lanes = state.lanes.map((lane) => (lane.id === id ? { ...lane, ...patch(lane) } : lane));
  return { ...state, lanes, running: lanes.some(isActive) };
}

export function runReducer(state: RunState, action: RunAction): RunState {
  if (action.type === "start") {
    return {
      ...initialRunState,
      runId: action.runId,
      mode: action.mode,
      streaming: action.streaming,
      running: true,
      lanes: action.lanes.map(newLane),
    };
  }
  // Late events from a superseded run must not leak into the current one.
  if (action.runId !== state.runId) return state;

  switch (action.type) {
    case "meta":
      return patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({
        meta: lane.meta ?? action.meta,
        coldStart: action.coldStart ?? lane.coldStart,
        status: lane.status === "pending" ? "streaming" : lane.status,
      }));
    case "signal":
      return {
        ...patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({ signalAtMs: lane.signalAtMs ?? action.atMs })),
        signal: action.signal,
        entity: action.entity,
        serverSignalMs: action.serverMs,
      };
    case "delta":
      return {
        ...patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({
          firstTokenAtMs: lane.firstTokenAtMs ?? action.atMs,
          status: "streaming",
        })),
        summary: state.summary + action.text,
      };
    case "done": {
      const next = patchLane(state, action.lane, (lane) => ({
        status: "done",
        meta: action.meta,
        timings: action.timings,
        coldStart: action.timings.inference?.cold_start ?? lane.coldStart,
        endAtMs: action.atMs,
        signalAtMs: action.signal ? (lane.signalAtMs ?? action.atMs) : lane.signalAtMs,
      }));
      return {
        ...next,
        // The final payload is authoritative over the concatenated deltas.
        summary: action.summary ?? next.summary,
        summaryTruncated: action.truncated ?? next.summaryTruncated,
        signal: action.signal ?? next.signal,
        entity: action.entity !== undefined ? action.entity : next.entity,
      };
    }
    case "error":
      return patchLane(state, action.lane, () => ({
        status: "error",
        error: action.error,
        endAtMs: action.atMs,
      }));
    case "cancel": {
      const lanes = state.lanes.map((lane) =>
        isActive(lane) ? { ...lane, status: "cancelled" as const, endAtMs: action.atMs } : lane,
      );
      return { ...state, lanes, running: false };
    }
  }
}

export function laneById(state: RunState, id: LaneId): Lane | undefined {
  return state.lanes.find((lane) => lane.id === id);
}

/** Article-level meta from whichever lane reported first. */
export function articleMeta(state: RunState): ArticleMeta | null {
  return state.lanes.find((lane) => lane.meta)?.meta ?? null;
}

/** One banner per distinct failure; split lanes often fail identically on a shared fetch. */
export function distinctErrors(state: RunState): { lanes: LaneId[]; error: ApiError }[] {
  const out: { lanes: LaneId[]; error: ApiError }[] = [];
  for (const lane of state.lanes) {
    if (!lane.error) continue;
    const same = out.find((e) => e.error.code === lane.error?.code && e.error.message === lane.error.message);
    if (same) same.lanes.push(lane.id);
    else out.push({ lanes: [lane.id], error: lane.error });
  }
  return out;
}
import { useCallback, useEffect, useReducer, useRef, type Dispatch } from "react";

import {
  ApiError,
  isAbortError,
  postAnalyze,
  postSignal,
  postSummary,
  toApiError,
  type AnalyzeBody,
  type AnalyzeResponse,
  type ExtractorName,
  type ParserName,
  type Scope,
  type SignalBody,
  type SummaryBody,
  type SummaryResponse,
} from "@/lib/api";
import { initialRunState, runReducer, type LaneId, type Mode, type RunAction } from "@/lib/run-state";
import { streamAnalyze, streamSummary, type StreamEvent } from "@/lib/sse";

export interface RunParams {
  url: string;
  mode: Mode;
  streaming: boolean;
  parser: ParserName;
  extractor: ExtractorName;
  /** Signal scope in split mode; /analyze keeps its server default. */
  scope: Scope;
  /** Empty string lets the server pick the endpoint default. */
  signalModel: string;
  summaryModel: string;
  analyzeModel: string;
}

interface LaneContext {
  runId: number;
  dispatch: Dispatch<RunAction>;
  signal: AbortSignal;
  at: () => number;
}

const withModel = (model: string) => (model ? { model } : {});

async function guarded(ctx: LaneContext, lane: LaneId, work: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  try {
    await work();
  } catch (err) {
    if (ctx.signal.aborted || isAbortError(err)) return;
    ctx.dispatch({ type: "error", runId: ctx.runId, lane, atMs: ctx.at(), error: toApiError(err) });
  }
}

function handleEvent(
  ctx: LaneContext,
  lane: LaneId,
  event: StreamEvent<SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse>,
): void {
  const tag = { runId: ctx.runId, lane, atMs: ctx.at() };
  switch (event.type) {
    case "meta":
      ctx.dispatch({ type: "meta", ...tag, meta: event.data.meta, coldStart: event.data.cold_start ?? null });
      return;
    case "sentiment":
      ctx.dispatch({
        type: "signal",
        ...tag,
        signal: event.data.signal,
        entity: event.data.entity ?? null,
        serverMs: event.data.elapsed_ms,
      });
      return;
    case "summary_delta":
      ctx.dispatch({ type: "delta", ...tag, text: event.data.text });
      return;
    case "done": {
      const result = event.data.result;
      const combined = "signal" in result ? result : null;
      ctx.dispatch({
        type: "done",
        ...tag,
        meta: result.meta,
        timings: result.timings,
        summary: result.summary,
        truncated: result.truncated,
        signal: combined?.signal,
        entity: combined ? (combined.entity ?? null) : undefined,
      });
      return;
    }
    case "error":
      ctx.dispatch({ type: "error", ...tag, error: ApiError.fromBody(event.data.error) });
      return;
  }
}

function runSignal(ctx: LaneContext, body: SignalBody) {
  return guarded(ctx, "signal", async () => {
    const res = await postSignal(body, ctx.signal);
    ctx.dispatch({
      type: "done",
      runId: ctx.runId,
      lane: "signal",
      atMs: ctx.at(),
      meta: res.meta,
      timings: res.timings,
      signal: res.signal,
    });
  });
}

function runSummary(ctx: LaneContext, body: SummaryBody, streaming: boolean) {
  return guarded(ctx, "summary", async () => {
    if (streaming) {
      for await (const event of streamSummary(body, { signal: ctx.signal }))
        handleEvent(ctx, "summary", event);
      return;
    }
    const res = await postSummary(body, ctx.signal);
    handleEvent(ctx, "summary", { type: "done", data: { result: res } });
  });
}

function runAnalyze(ctx: LaneContext, body: AnalyzeBody, streaming: boolean) {
  return guarded(ctx, "analyze", async () => {
    if (streaming) {
      for await (const event of streamAnalyze(body, { signal: ctx.signal }))
        handleEvent(ctx, "analyze", event);
      return;
    }
    const res = await postAnalyze(body, ctx.signal);
    handleEvent(ctx, "analyze", { type: "done", data: { result: res } });
  });
}

/** Owns one in-flight run; starting a new run aborts the previous one. */
export function useAnalysis() {
  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(runReducer, initialRunState);
  const controllerRef = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const runIdRef = useRef(0);
  const startedAtRef = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => () => controllerRef.current?.abort(), []);

  const start = useCallback((params: RunParams) => {
    controllerRef.current?.abort();
    const controller = new AbortController();
    controllerRef.current = controller;
    const runId = ++runIdRef.current;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    startedAtRef.current = t0;
    const ctx: LaneContext = { runId, dispatch, signal: controller.signal, at: () => performance.now() - t0 };
    const base = { url: params.url, parser: params.parser, extractor: params.extractor };

    if (params.mode === "split") {
      dispatch({
        type: "start",
        runId,
        mode: "split",
        streaming: params.streaming,
        lanes: ["signal", "summary"],
      });
      // Fired together on purpose: the backend single-flight shares one fetch between them.
      void runSignal(ctx, { ...base, scope: params.scope, ...withModel(params.signalModel) });
      void runSummary(ctx, { ...base, ...withModel(params.summaryModel) }, params.streaming);
    } else {
      dispatch({ type: "start", runId, mode: "combined", streaming: params.streaming, lanes: ["analyze"] });
      void runAnalyze(ctx, { ...base, ...withModel(params.analyzeModel) }, params.streaming);
    }
  }, []);

  const cancel = useCallback(() => {
    controllerRef.current?.abort();
    controllerRef.current = null;
    dispatch({ type: "cancel", runId: runIdRef.current, atMs: performance.now() - startedAtRef.current });
  }, []);

  return { state, start, cancel };
}

"use client";

import { useAnalysis } from "@/hooks/useAnalysis";
import { useModels } from "@/hooks/useModels";
import { capitalize } from "@/lib/format";
import {
  articleMeta,
  distinctErrors,
  laneById,
  type Lane,
  type LaneId,
  type RunState,
} from "@/lib/run-state";

import { AnalyzeForm } from "./AnalyzeForm";
import styles from "./AnalyzeApp.module.css";
import { ArticleMetaLine } from "./ArticleMetaLine";
import { ErrorBanner } from "./ErrorBanner";
import { LatencyBar, type LaneMark, type LatencyLane } from "./LatencyBar";
import { SignalCard } from "./SignalCard";
import { SummaryPanel } from "./SummaryPanel";

const LANE_LABELS: Record<LaneId, string> = { signal: "Signal", summary: "Summary", analyze: "Analyze" };

function toLatencyLane(lane: Lane): LatencyLane {
  const marks: LaneMark[] = [];
  if (lane.signalAtMs !== null) {
    marks.push({ kind: "signal", label: "time to signal", atMs: lane.signalAtMs });
  }
  if (lane.firstTokenAtMs !== null) {
    marks.push({ kind: "token", label: "time to first token", atMs: lane.firstTokenAtMs });
  }
  return {
    id: lane.id,
    label: LANE_LABELS[lane.id],
    status: lane.status,
    timings: lane.timings,
    endMs: lane.endAtMs,
    marks,
  };
}

function announcement(state: RunState): string {
  if (state.running && !state.signal) return "Analyzing...";
  const parts: string[] = [];
  if (state.signal) {
    parts.push(
      state.signal.abstained
        ? "No signal: below this model's threshold."
        : `Signal ${capitalize(state.signal.sentiment)}.`,
    );
  }
  if (!state.running && state.summary) parts.push("Summary complete.");
  return parts.join(" ");
}

export function AnalyzeApp() {
  const models = useModels();
  const { state, start, cancel } = useAnalysis();

  const split = state.mode === "split";
  const signalLane = laneById(state, split ? "signal" : "analyze");
  const summaryLane = laneById(state, split ? "summary" : "analyze");
  const meta = articleMeta(state);
  const errors = distinctErrors(state);
  const showLatency = state.lanes.some(
    (l) => l.timings || l.signalAtMs !== null || l.firstTokenAtMs !== null,
  );

  return (
    <>
      <AnalyzeForm models={models} running={state.running} onSubmit={start} onCancel={cancel} />

      <p role="status" className="visually-hidden">
        {announcement(state)}
      </p>

      {models.status === "error" ? <ErrorBanner error={models.error} context="Model list" /> : null}
      {errors.map(({ lanes, error }) => (
        <ErrorBanner
          key={`${error.code}-${lanes.join("-")}`}
          error={error}
          context={lanes.map((id) => LANE_LABELS[id]).join(" and ")}
        />
      ))}

      {state.lanes.length ? (
        <div className={styles.results}>
          {meta ? <ArticleMetaLine meta={meta} /> : null}
          <div className={styles.cards}>
            {signalLane ? (
              <SignalCard
                status={signalLane.status}
                signal={state.signal}
                entity={state.entity}
                model={signalLane.meta?.model}
                timeToSignalMs={signalLane.signalAtMs}
                serverMs={state.serverSignalMs}
                coldStart={signalLane.coldStart}
                loadMs={signalLane.timings?.inference?.load_ms}
              />
            ) : null}
            {summaryLane ? (
              <SummaryPanel
                status={summaryLane.status}
                text={state.summary}
                truncated={state.summaryTruncated}
                model={summaryLane.meta?.model}
                streaming={state.streaming}
                firstTokenMs={summaryLane.firstTokenAtMs}
                coldStart={summaryLane.coldStart}
                loadMs={summaryLane.timings?.inference?.load_ms}
              />
            ) : null}
          </div>
          {showLatency ? <LatencyBar lanes={state.lanes.map(toLatencyLane)} /> : null}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className={styles.empty}>
          Results appear here. Split mode shows the signal as soon as /api/signal answers while the summary
          keeps streaming; combined mode gets both from one generation.
        </p>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
import type { PolicyName, Sentiment, SignalResult } from "@/lib/api";
import { capitalize, coldStartNote, formatMs, formatPct } from "@/lib/format";
import type { LaneStatus } from "@/lib/run-state";

import styles from "./SignalCard.module.css";

const POLICY_NOTES: Record<PolicyName, string> = {
  probability: "threshold on the decision model's class probability",
  "label-logprob": "threshold on the label token probability",
  ordinal: "threshold on |score| of the -2..+2 scale",
};

const ORDER: readonly Sentiment[] = ["bullish", "bearish", "neutral"];

/** Direction the model leaned before the threshold turned it into an abstention. */
export function leaning(signal: SignalResult): Sentiment {
  if (signal.probabilities) {
    let best: Sentiment = signal.sentiment;
    for (const s of ORDER) {
      if ((signal.probabilities[s] ?? 0) > (signal.probabilities[best] ?? 0)) best = s;
    }
    return best;
  }
  if (typeof signal.score === "number" && signal.score !== 0) return signal.score > 0 ? "bullish" : "bearish";
  return signal.sentiment;
}

// Non-breaking, so a wrapped line never strands the sign away from its number.
