"""Confidence policies: raw model output -> Verdict, abstaining to neutral below the frozen threshold."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import ClassVar

from veritrade.inference.schemas import LabelOut, OrdinalOut, score_sentiment
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, Endpoint, PolicyName, Sentiment, TokenLogprob, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec

# Ties resolve to the safe class first; also the criteria order sent to decision models.
TIE_ORDER: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("neutral", "bullish", "bearish")
# Share of first-token mass allowed on tokens that could start several classes before we give up.
AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX = 0.05

_VALUE_START = {
    "label": re.compile(r'"label"\s*:\s*"'),
    "score": re.compile(r'"score"\s*:\s*'),
}
_SCORE_HEAD = re.compile(r"^(?:-|-[12](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?|[012](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?)$")
_SCORE_KEY = re.compile(r'"score"\s*:')


def winner(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Sentiment:
    best = TIE_ORDER[0]
    for sentiment in TIE_ORDER[1:]:
        if probabilities.get(sentiment, 0.0) > probabilities.get(best, 0.0):
            best = sentiment
    return best


def normalise(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> dict[Sentiment, float]:
    total = sum(max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) for s in TIE_ORDER)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("probabilities sum to zero")
    return {s: max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def _threshold(
    name: PolicyName,
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float],
    min_p: float,
    score: int | None = None,
    tau: float | None = None,
) -> Verdict:
    top = winner(probabilities)
    if tau is not None and top == "neutral":
        side: Sentiment = "bullish" if probabilities["bullish"] >= probabilities["bearish"] else "bearish"
        if probabilities[side] >= tau:
            return Verdict(
                sentiment=side,
                abstained=False,
                policy=name,
                confidence=probabilities[side],
                score=score,
                probabilities=probabilities,
                threshold=min_p,
                directional_tau=tau,
            )
    confidence = probabilities[top]
    abstained = confidence < min_p
    return Verdict(
        sentiment="neutral" if abstained else top,
        abstained=abstained,
        policy=name,
        confidence=confidence,
        score=score,
        probabilities=probabilities,
        threshold=min_p,
        directional_tau=tau,
    )


def label_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Labels a token's text could start; empty means the grammar would reject it."""
    return {s for s in TIE_ORDER if s.startswith(rest) or rest.startswith(s + '"')}


def sign_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Class implied by a token that starts an enum score (-2..2); empty when the grammar rejects it."""
    if not rest:
        return set(TIE_ORDER)
    if not _SCORE_HEAD.match(rest):
        return set()
    return {"bearish" if rest[0] == "-" else "neutral" if rest[0] == "0" else "bullish"}


def first_value_token(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob], key: str
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
    """The generated token that starts the value of `key` (minus any text before the value) and its
    alternatives as {text after the same prefix: probability}; None if tokens do not tile the content."""
    match = _VALUE_START[key].search(content)
    if match is None:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end > offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset]
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            return tok.token[len(prefix) :], candidates
        pos = end
    return None


def _first_token_distribution(
    content: str,
    logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None,
    key: str,
    classes: Callable[[str], set[Sentiment]],
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    found = first_value_token(content, logprobs or (), key)
    if found is None:
        return None
    chosen, candidates = found
    if len(classes(chosen)) != 1:
        return None
    mass = dict.fromkeys(TIE_ORDER, 0.0)
    ambiguous = 0.0
    for rest, p in candidates.items():
        # A token ending exactly where the value starts (e.g. a bare space) says nothing about the class.
        if not rest:
            continue
        hit = classes(rest)
        if len(hit) == 1:
            mass[next(iter(hit))] += p
        elif hit:
            ambiguous += p
    total = sum(mass.values())
    if total <= 0 or ambiguous > AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX * (total + ambiguous):
        return None
    return {s: mass[s] / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def label_probabilities(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    """First label-token probabilities renormalised over tokens the grammar accepts (Ollama reports
    pre-mask logprobs, so "positive" is dropped). None when the generated first token is shared by
    two labels or ambiguous tokens carry real mass."""
    return _first_token_distribution(content, logprobs, "label", label_classes)


def score_sign_probabilities(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob] | None
) -> dict[Sentiment, float] | None:
    """Class probabilities of the score's sign ("-" bearish, "0" neutral, "1"/"2" bullish) from the tokens
    after the colon, whitespace-insensitive because tokenizers fuse " -". A generated bare space defers to
    the next token; a bare space that was not generated hides its sign and counts as ambiguous."""
    match = _SCORE_KEY.search(content)
    if match is None or not logprobs:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    mass = dict.fromkeys(TIE_ORDER, 0.0)
    hidden = 0.0
    path = 1.0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end >= offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset] if pos < offset else ""
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            chosen = tok.token[len(prefix) :]
            for rest, p in candidates.items():
                if rest == chosen:
                    continue
                if not rest.strip():
                    hidden += path * p
                elif hit := sign_classes(rest.lstrip()):
                    mass[next(iter(hit))] += path * p
            if chosen.strip():
                hit = sign_classes(chosen.lstrip())
                if len(hit) != 1:
                    return None
                mass[next(iter(hit))] += path * candidates[chosen]
                total = sum(mass.values())
                if total <= 0 or hidden > AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX * (total + hidden):
                    return None
                return {s: mass[s] / total for s in TIE_ORDER}
            path *= candidates[chosen]
        pos = end
    return None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ProbabilityPolicy:
    """Argmax unless its probability is below min_p (then neutral, abstained). With directional_tau, a
    neutral argmax still yields the likelier directional class when that class reaches tau: models that
    park most of their mass on neutral are otherwise never pushed into a call."""

    min_p: float
    directional_tau: float | None = None
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "probability"

    def decide(self, probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Verdict:
        return _threshold(self.name, normalise(probabilities), self.min_p, tau=self.directional_tau)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class LabelLogprobPolicy:
    """The probability rule (min_p, directional_tau) on first-token label probabilities. On a label
    collision `decide` returns None and the adapter re-asks with the ordinal schema; when its sign is
    unreadable too, the chain ends at the ordinal policy."""

    min_p: float
    directional_tau: float | None = None
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "label-logprob"

    def decide(self, out: LabelOut | OrdinalOut, chat: ChatResult) -> Verdict | None:
        if isinstance(out, LabelOut):
            probabilities = label_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs)
            return None if probabilities is None else self.threshold(probabilities)
        probabilities = score_sign_probabilities(chat.content, chat.logprobs)
        return None if probabilities is None else self.threshold(probabilities, score=out.score)

    def threshold(self, probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float], score: int | None = None) -> Verdict:
        return _threshold(
            self.name, normalise(probabilities), self.min_p, score=score, tau=self.directional_tau
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrdinalPolicy:
    """Directional only when |score| >= t; a zero score is a confident neutral, not an abstention."""

    t: int
    name: ClassVar[PolicyName] = "ordinal"

    def decide(self, score: int) -> Verdict:
        raw = score_sentiment(score)
        abstained = raw != "neutral" and abs(score) < self.t
        return Verdict(
            sentiment="neutral" if abstained else raw,
            abstained=abstained,
            policy=self.name,
            score=score,
            threshold=float(self.t),
        )


Policy = ProbabilityPolicy | LabelLogprobPolicy | OrdinalPolicy


def _min_p(spec: ModelSpec) -> float:
    if spec.min_p is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{spec.name}: policy {spec.policy} needs min_p")
    return spec.min_p


def policy_for(spec: ModelSpec, streaming: bool = False, *, endpoint: Endpoint = "signal") -> Policy:
    """Streams and /analyze always threshold the ordinal score: it is read mid-JSON as soon as it
    closes, with no dependency on logprobs or on where the score sits in the output."""
    if spec.kind == "decision":
        return ProbabilityPolicy(_min_p(spec), spec.directional_tau)
    if streaming or endpoint == "analyze" or spec.policy == "ordinal":
        return OrdinalPolicy(spec.ordinal_t)
    return LabelLogprobPolicy(_min_p(spec), spec.directional_tau)

"""Steps every article endpoint shares: resolve, check the result cache, load, describe."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ArticleMeta,
    CacheInfo,
    ErrorEvent,
    InferenceTimings,
    MetaEvent,
    SentimentEvent,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SignalResult,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
    SummaryDoneEvent,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
    Timings,
)
from veritrade.extract.scope import build_input
from veritrade.extract.types import Scope
from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade.services.article import LoadedArticle, load_article
from veritrade.services.cache import ResultKey
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

ArticleRequest = SignalRequest | SummaryRequest | AnalyzeRequest
StreamPayload = (
    MetaEvent | SentimentEvent | SummaryDeltaEvent | SummaryDoneEvent | AnalyzeDoneEvent | ErrorEvent
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Job:
    """A request with its model and prompt resolved; nothing has touched the network yet."""

    runtime: Runtime
    endpoint: Endpoint
    request: ArticleRequest
    url: str
    scope: Scope
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    key: ResultKey | None
    clock: StageTimer

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls, runtime: Runtime, endpoint: Endpoint, request: ArticleRequest, *, scope: Scope, clock: StageTimer
    ) -> Job:
        spec = runtime.registry.resolve(endpoint, request.model)
        prompt = runtime.prompt(endpoint, spec)
        url = str(request.url)
        key = None
        if not request.no_cache:
            key = ResultKey(
                endpoint=endpoint,
                url=normalize_url(url),
                model=spec.name,
                prompt_version=prompt.version,
                parser=request.parser,
                extractor=request.extractor,
                scope=scope,
            )
        return cls(runtime, endpoint, request, url, scope, spec, prompt, key, clock)

    def cached[R: (SignalResponse, SummaryResponse, AnalyzeResponse)](self, kind: type[R]) -> R | None:
        """The stored response marked as cached, with timings that describe this request."""
        hit = self.runtime.results.get(self.key) if self.key is not None else None
        if not isinstance(hit, kind):
            return None
        # A result hit runs no stage, so stage timings are zero and the article counts as a fetch hit.
        timings = Timings(
            total_ms=self.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=0.0,
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch="hit", result="hit"),
        )
        meta = hit.meta.model_copy(update={"cached": True})
        return hit.model_copy(update={"meta": meta, "timings": timings})

    def remember(self, response: SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> None:
        if self.key is not None:
            self.runtime.results.put(self.key, response)

    async def prepare(self) -> Prepared:
        # The residency probe runs alongside the fetch; a fetch error still propagates as itself, unwrapped.
        probe = asyncio.create_task(self.runtime.cold_start(self.spec))
        try:
            loaded = await load_article(
                self.runtime,
                self.url,
                parser=self.request.parser,
                extractor=self.request.extractor,
                no_cache=self.request.no_cache,
            )
        except BaseException:
            probe.cancel()
            raise
        cold_start = await probe
        text = build_input(loaded.article, self.scope, self.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return Prepared(
            job=self,
            loaded=loaded,
            text=text,
            meta=self._meta(loaded, text),
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch=loaded.fetch_status, result="bypass" if self.key is None else "miss"),
            cold_start=cold_start,
        )

    def _meta(self, loaded: LoadedArticle, text: str) -> ArticleMeta:
        article = loaded.article
        return ArticleMeta(
            url=self.url,
            final_url=loaded.page.final_url,
            title=article.title,
            source=article.source,
            published_at=article.published_at,
            endpoint=self.endpoint,
            model=self.spec.name,
            model_kind=self.spec.kind,
            prompt_version=self.prompt.version,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            extraction_method=article.method,
            scope=self.scope,
            input_chars=len(text),
            word_count=article.word_count,
            field_order=self.spec.field_order if self.endpoint == "analyze" else None,
            cached=False,
            backend=self.runtime.settings.ollama_backend_label,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Prepared:
    """A job with its article loaded and the model input built; only inference is left."""

    job: Job
    loaded: LoadedArticle
    text: str
    meta: ArticleMeta
    cache: CacheInfo
    cold_start: bool | None

    def timings(self, inference: InferenceTimings | None) -> Timings:
        loaded = self.loaded
        if inference is not None:
            inference = inference.model_copy(update={"cold_start": self.cold_start})
        return Timings(
            total_ms=self.job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=loaded.fetch_ms,
            consent_ms=loaded.consent_ms,
            parse_ms=loaded.article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=loaded.article.extract_ms,
            inference=inference,
            cache=self.cache,
        )

    def meta_event(self) -> MetaEvent:
        article = self.loaded.article
        return MetaEvent(
            meta=self.meta,
            fetch_ms=self.loaded.fetch_ms,
            parse_ms=article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=article.extract_ms,
            cache=self.cache,
            cold_start=self.cold_start,
        )


def cached_meta_event(response: SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> MetaEvent:
    timings = response.timings
    return MetaEvent(
        meta=response.meta,
        fetch_ms=timings.fetch_ms,
        parse_ms=timings.parse_ms,
        extract_ms=timings.extract_ms,
        cache=timings.cache,
    )


def signal_result(verdict: Verdict) -> SignalResult:
    return SignalResult(
        sentiment=verdict.sentiment,
        abstained=verdict.abstained,
        policy=verdict.policy,
        confidence=verdict.confidence,
        score=verdict.score,
        probabilities=verdict.probabilities,
        threshold=verdict.threshold,
        directional_tau=verdict.directional_tau,
    )


def inference_timings(raw: ChatResult | DecisionResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None = None) -> InferenceTimings:
    """ttft_ms is passed in by streams, which measure it from request receipt to the first summary text."""
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        return InferenceTimings(wall_ms=raw.wall_ms, prompt_tokens=raw.input_tokens)
    t = raw.timings
    return InferenceTimings(
        wall_ms=raw.wall_ms,
        ttft_ms=ttft_ms,
        load_ms=t.load_ms,
        prompt_eval_ms=t.prompt_eval_ms,
        eval_ms=t.eval_ms,
        prompt_tokens=t.prompt_tokens,
        eval_tokens=t.eval_tokens,
    )

```
"""/analyze: sentiment, entity and summary from one generation, as JSON or as streamed events."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator
from contextlib import aclosing

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    SentimentEvent,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
)
from veritrade.inference.adapters import AnalyzeResult, analyze, analyze_stream, score_verdict
from veritrade.inference.incremental import EntityClosed, ScoreClosed, SummaryText
from veritrade.services.pipeline import (
    Job,
    Prepared,
    StreamPayload,
    cached_meta_event,
    inference_timings,
    signal_result,
)
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


def _job(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> Job:
    return Job.resolve(runtime, "analyze", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)


async def run_analyze(runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    result = await analyze(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = _response(prepared, result, ttft_ms=None)
    job.remember(response)
    return response


async def open_analyze_stream(
    runtime: Runtime, request: AnalyzeRequest, clock: StageTimer
) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Runs every step that can fail before the stream opens; the returned events only do inference."""
    job = _job(runtime, request, clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(AnalyzeResponse)) is not None:
        return _replay(hit, clock)
    return _stream(await job.prepare())


async def _stream(prepared: Prepared) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    """Events follow generation order, so the frozen field order decides where `sentiment` lands."""
    job = prepared.job
    yield prepared.meta_event()
    entity: str | None = None
    ttft_ms: float | None = None
    events = analyze_stream(job.runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    async with aclosing(events):
        async for event in events:
            match event:
                case ScoreClosed(score=score):
                    yield SentimentEvent(
                        signal=signal_result(score_verdict(job.spec, score)),
                        entity=entity,
                        elapsed_ms=job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
                    )
                case EntityClosed(entity=name):
                    entity = name.strip() or None
                case SummaryText(delta=delta):
                    if ttft_ms is None:
                        ttft_ms = job.clock.elapsed_ms()
                    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=delta)
                case AnalyzeResult():
                    response = _response(prepared, event, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)
                    job.remember(response)
                    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=response)


async def _replay(hit: AnalyzeResponse, clock: StageTimer) -> AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]:
    yield cached_meta_event(hit)
    yield SentimentEvent(signal=hit.signal, entity=hit.entity, elapsed_ms=clock.elapsed_ms())
    yield SummaryDeltaEvent(text=hit.summary)
    yield AnalyzeDoneEvent(result=hit)


def _response(prepared: Prepared, result: AnalyzeResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None) -> AnalyzeResponse:
    return AnalyzeResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(result.verdict),
        entity=result.entity,
        summary=result.output.summary,
        truncated=result.truncated,
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(result.chat, ttft_ms=ttft_ms)),
    )

"""Model allowlist and per-endpoint defaults loaded from `data/models.toml`."""

from __future__ import annotations

import tomllib
from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
from functools import lru_cache
from importlib import resources
from typing import Any, Literal, get_args

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, model_validator

from veritrade.config import Settings, get_settings
from veritrade.errors import ModelNotAllowed
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint, FieldOrder, ModelKind, PolicyName

ENDPOINTS: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = get_args(Endpoint)
SignalSchema = Literal["label", "ordinal"]


class ModelSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(frozen=True, extra="forbid")

    name: str
    kind: ModelKind
    endpoints: tuple[Endpoint, ...] = Field(min_length=1)
    num_ctx: int | None = Field(None, gt=0)
    max_input_tokens: int = Field(gt=0)
    num_predict: dict[Endpoint, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    signal_schema: SignalSchema | None = None
    policy: PolicyName
    # 0 never abstains on the winning class.
    min_p: float | None = Field(None, ge=0, le=1)
    ordinal_t: int = Field(1, ge=1, le=2)
    directional_tau: float | None = Field(None, gt=0, lt=1)
    field_order: FieldOrder | None = None
    # Frozen prompt version per endpoint; an endpoint left out serves the prompt file's `active`.
    prompt: dict[Endpoint, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    evaluated: bool = True

    @model_validator(mode="before")
    @classmethod
    def _default_field_order(cls, data: Any) -> Any:
        if isinstance(data, dict) and "analyze" in data.get("endpoints", ()) and not data.get("field_order"):
            return {**data, "field_order": "sentiment-first"}
        return data

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _check_consistency(self) -> ModelSpec:
        if self.kind == "decision":
            if self.endpoints != ("signal",) or self.policy != "probability":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{self.name}: decision models serve only /signal with the probability policy"
                )
        else:
            if self.policy == "probability":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models have no native class probabilities")
            if self.num_ctx is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative models need num_ctx")
            missing = [e for e in self.endpoints if e not in self.num_predict]
            if missing:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: num_predict missing for {missing}")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.signal_schema is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: generative /signal models need signal_schema")
            if "signal" in self.endpoints and self.policy == "ordinal" and self.signal_schema != "ordinal":
                raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: the ordinal policy needs signal_schema = 'ordinal'")
        if self.policy in ("probability", "label-logprob") and self.min_p is None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: policy {self.policy} needs min_p")
        if self.directional_tau is not None and self.policy == "ordinal":
            raise ValueError(
                f"{self.name}: directional_tau needs class probabilities, not the ordinal policy"
            )
        if stray := sorted(set(self.prompt) - set(self.endpoints)):
            raise ValueError(f"{self.name}: prompt versions for endpoints it does not serve: {stray}")
        return self

    def serves(self, endpoint: Endpoint) -> bool:
        return endpoint in self.endpoints

# Serving config: allowlist, per-endpoint defaults, decoding options and frozen thresholds.
# `veritrade_evals freeze` writes the per-model thresholds and prompt versions from the eval results
# (evals/results/frozen.json); `select --write` owns [defaults]. Models it has not frozen keep provisional values.
#
# kind        generative (/api/chat) | decision (/v1/systemone)
# endpoints   endpoints the model may serve
# signal_schema   generative signal output: "label" (one of 3 labels) | "ordinal" (score -2..2)
# policy      probability | label-logprob | ordinal  (streaming and /analyze always use ordinal)
# min_p       decision/label-logprob threshold on the winning class probability; 0 never abstains
# directional_tau   optional, probability policies only: when neutral wins the argmax and the likelier
#             directional class has p >= tau, call that class; otherwise argmax + min_p applies
# ordinal_t   directional call only when |score| >= ordinal_t (always set: streaming fallback)
# field_order /analyze JSON order: sentiment-first (streams the score early) | summary-first
# prompt      frozen prompt version per endpoint, e.g. { signal = "v4" }; an endpoint left out serves
#             the prompt file's `active` version

.card {

```
"""Server-sent event framing: service payloads become named events, late failures one `error` event."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import AsyncGenerator, Mapping
from contextlib import aclosing

from fastapi.sse import ServerSentEvent
from pydantic import BaseModel

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    ErrorBody,
    ErrorEvent,
    MetaEvent,
    SentimentEvent,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
    SummaryDoneEvent,
)
from veritrade.errors import VtError
from veritrade.services.pipeline import StreamPayload

EVENT_NAMES: Mapping[type[BaseModel], str] = {
    MetaEvent: "meta",
    SentimentEvent: "sentiment",
    SummaryDeltaEvent: "summary_delta",
    SummaryDoneEvent: "done",
    AnalyzeDoneEvent: "done",
    ErrorEvent: "error",
}


def error_body(exc: VtError) -> ErrorBody:
    return ErrorBody(
        code=exc.code,
        message=exc.message,
        hint=exc.hint,
        retryable=exc.retryable,
        upstream_status=exc.upstream_status,
    )


async def event_stream(events: AsyncGenerator[StreamPayload]) -> AsyncGenerator[ServerSentEvent]:
    """Closing the payload generator on any exit is what stops the upstream Ollama stream on disconnect."""
    async with aclosing(events):
        try:
            async for payload in events:
                yield ServerSentEvent(event=EVENT_NAMES[type(payload)], data=payload)
        except VtError as exc:
            yield ServerSentEvent(event="error", data=ErrorEvent(error=error_body(exc)))
```

export function formatMs(ms: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !Number.isFinite(ms)) return "-";
  if (ms >= 10_000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`;
  if (ms >= 1000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`;
  return `${Math.round(ms)} ms`;
}

export function formatPct(value: number | null | undefined, digits = 1): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  return `${(value * 100).toFixed(digits)}%`;
}

export function formatNum(value: number | null | undefined, digits = 3): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  return value.toFixed(digits);
}

export function formatInt(value: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  return Math.round(value).toLocaleString("en-US");
}

/** Why a cold request was slow; decision models report no separate load time. */
export function coldStartNote(loadMs: number | null | undefined): string {
  return typeof loadMs === "number" && loadMs > 0
    ? `model loaded for this request (${formatMs(loadMs)})`
    : "includes loading the model into memory";
}

export function capitalize(value: string): string {
  return value ? value[0].toUpperCase() + value.slice(1) : value;
}

import { http, HttpResponse, type HttpHandler } from "msw";

import type { AnalyzeBody, ErrorBody, SignalBody, SummaryBody } from "@/lib/api";

import {
  SUMMARY_CHUNKS,
  analyzeResponse,
  articleMeta,
  health,
  metaEvent,
  models,
  sentimentEvent,
  signalResponse,
  summaryResponse,
} from "./fixtures";
import { SSE_PING, sseFrame, sseResponse } from "./sse";

// "*/api" matches any origin, so the same handlers serve jsdom, next dev and Playwright.
export const API = "*/api";

export function summaryStreamChunks(body: SummaryBody): string[] {
  const done = summaryResponse(body);
  return [
    sseFrame("meta", metaEvent(done.meta)),
    SSE_PING,
    ...SUMMARY_CHUNKS.map((text) => sseFrame("summary_delta", { text })),
    sseFrame("done", { result: done }),
  ];
}

export function analyzeStreamChunks(body: AnalyzeBody): string[] {
  const done = analyzeResponse(body);
  return [
    sseFrame("meta", metaEvent(articleMeta({ endpoint: "analyze", ...body }))),
    sseFrame("sentiment", sentimentEvent),
    ...SUMMARY_CHUNKS.map((text) => sseFrame("summary_delta", { text })),
    sseFrame("done", { result: done }),
  ];
}

export function errorResponse(status: number, error: ErrorBody): HttpResponse<{ error: ErrorBody }> {
  return HttpResponse.json({ error }, { status });
}

export const handlers: HttpHandler[] = [
  http.get(`${API}/health`, () => HttpResponse.json(health)),
  http.get(`${API}/models`, () => HttpResponse.json(models)),
  http.post(`${API}/signal`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(signalResponse((await request.json()) as SignalBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/summary`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(summaryResponse((await request.json()) as SummaryBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/summary/stream`, async ({ request }) =>
    sseResponse(summaryStreamChunks((await request.json()) as SummaryBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/analyze`, async ({ request }) =>
    HttpResponse.json(analyzeResponse((await request.json()) as AnalyzeBody)),
  ),
  http.post(`${API}/analyze/stream`, async ({ request }) =>
    sseResponse(analyzeStreamChunks((await request.json()) as AnalyzeBody)),
  ),
];

import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
import { configDefaults, defineConfig } from "vitest/config";

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: { tsconfigPaths: true },
  test: {
    environment: "jsdom",
    include: ["tests/**/*.test.{ts,tsx}"],
    // Playwright specs run against the compose stack, never under Vitest.
    exclude: [...configDefaults.exclude, "e2e/**"],
    setupFiles: ["tests/setup.ts"],
  },
});
import { HttpResponse } from "msw";

import type { StreamEventType } from "@/lib/sse";

export function sseFrame(event: StreamEventType, data: unknown): string {
  return `event: ${event}\ndata: ${JSON.stringify(data)}\n\n`;
}

export const SSE_PING = ": ping\n\n";

/** Pull-based so a test can hold the stream open between chunks (e.g. awaiting a gate). */
export function sseStream(chunks: AsyncIterable<string> | Iterable<string>): ReadableStream<Uint8Array> {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const iterator =
    Symbol.asyncIterator in chunks ? chunks[Symbol.asyncIterator]() : toAsync(chunks[Symbol.iterator]());
  return new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({
    async pull(controller) {
      const { value, done } = await iterator.next();
      if (done) controller.close();
      else controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(value));
    },
    async cancel() {
      await iterator.return?.();
    },
  });
}

function toAsync(iterator: Iterator<string>): AsyncIterator<string> {
  return { next: async () => iterator.next() };
}

export function sseResponse(chunks: AsyncIterable<string> | Iterable<string>): HttpResponse<ReadableStream> {
  return new HttpResponse(sseStream(chunks), {
    headers: { "Content-Type": "text/event-stream", "Cache-Control": "no-cache" },
  });
}

export interface Gate {
  promise: Promise<void>;
  open: () => void;
}

export function gate(): Gate {
  let open: () => void = () => undefined;
  const promise = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    open = resolve;
  });
  return { promise, open };
}

```
"""Result cache: finished responses keyed by everything that can change them."""

from __future__ import annotations

import time
from collections import OrderedDict
from collections.abc import Callable, Hashable
from dataclasses import dataclass

from veritrade.api.contracts import AnalyzeResponse, SignalResponse, SummaryResponse
from veritrade.extract.types import ExtractorName, ParserName, Scope
from veritrade.inference.types import Endpoint

CachedResponse = SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ResultKey:
    endpoint: Endpoint
    url: str
    model: str
    prompt_version: str
    parser: ParserName
    extractor: ExtractorName
    scope: Scope


class TtlCache[K: Hashable, V]:
    """LRU with a fixed time to live; no single-flight, since a stream cannot be shared mid-generation."""

    def __init__(
        self, *, max_entries: int, ttl_s: float, clock: Callable[[], float] = time.monotonic
    ) -> None:
        if max_entries < 1:
            raise ValueError("max_entries must be at least 1")
        self._max_entries = max_entries
        self._ttl_s = ttl_s
        self._clock = clock
        self._entries: OrderedDict[K, tuple[float, V]] = OrderedDict()

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entries)

    def get(self, key: K) -> V | None:
        entry = self._entries.get(key)
        if entry is None:
            return None
        expires_at, value = entry
        if expires_at <= self._clock():
            del self._entries[key]
            return None
        self._entries.move_to_end(key)
        return value

    def put(self, key: K, value: V) -> None:
        if self._ttl_s <= 0:
            return
        self._entries[key] = (self._clock() + self._ttl_s, value)
        self._entries.move_to_end(key)
        while len(self._entries) > self._max_entries:

"""/signal: one non-streaming classification of the lede (or the full article)."""

from __future__ import annotations

from veritrade.api.contracts import SignalRequest, SignalResponse
from veritrade.inference.adapters import classify_signal
from veritrade.services.pipeline import Job, inference_timings, signal_result
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer


async def run_signal(runtime: Runtime, request: SignalRequest, clock: StageTimer) -> SignalResponse:
    job = Job.resolve(runtime, "signal", request, scope=request.scope, clock=clock)
    if (hit := job.cached(SignalResponse)) is not None:
        return hit
    prepared = await job.prepare()
    verdict, raw = await classify_signal(runtime.ollama, job.spec, job.prompt, prepared.text)
    response = SignalResponse(
        meta=prepared.meta,
        signal=signal_result(verdict),
        timings=prepared.timings(inference_timings(raw)),
    )
    job.remember(response)
    return response

def freeze_signal(model: str, articles: Mapping[str, Any], registry: PromptRegistry) -> Frozen:
    best = grid_report("signal", model)["best"]
    policy, threshold, variant = best["policy"], float(best["threshold"]), best["variant"]
    rows = [r for r in _article_rows(articles, model, best["config"]) if r["policy"] == policy]
    served = next((r for r in rows if r["scope"] == "lede"), None)
    evidence: dict[str, Any] = {
        "dev300": {"config": best["config"], "policy": policy, "threshold": threshold, **best["cis"]},
        "articles_dev": [_brief(r) for r in rows],
    }
    if served is not None and served["clear_failure"]:
        repick = served.get("repick")
        if repick is None:
            raise FreezeError(
                f"{model}: the dev300 rule clearly fails on the articles and no re-pick meets the cap"
            )
        threshold = float(repick["threshold"])
        evidence["repicked_on_articles"] = {"threshold": threshold, "because": served["clear_failure"]}
    base = TAU_BASE[policy] if is_tau(policy) else policy
    values: dict[str, Any] = {
        "signal_schema": {"label": "label", "ordinal": "ordinal"}.get(variant),
        "policy": base,
        "min_p": None,
        "directional_tau": None,
    }
    if base == "ordinal":
        values["ordinal_t"] = int(threshold)
    elif is_tau(policy):
        values |= {"min_p": 0.0, "directional_tau": threshold}
    else:
        values["min_p"] = threshold
    version = version_id(best["prompt_version"], "signal", model, registry)
    return Frozen(model, values, {"signal": version}, {"signal": evidence})


def _gate(follow_up: Mapping[str, Any], articles_cmp: Mapping[str, Any] | None) -> str | None:
    """Why a follow-up may not be frozen: significantly worse on dev300 or on the articles."""
    if follow_up["verdict"] == "against":
        gap = follow_up["paired_bootstrap"]["gap"]
        return f"dev300 F0.5 gap {gap['point']:+.3f} [{gap['low']:+.3f}, {gap['high']:+.3f}]"

```
"""Structured outputs. Property order is the generation order Ollama's grammar enforces."""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from functools import cache
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from veritrade.inference.types import FieldOrder, Sentiment

Score = Literal[-2, -1, 0, 1, 2]


class _Out(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid", frozen=True)


class LabelOut(_Out):
    label: Sentiment


class OrdinalOut(_Out):
    score: Score


class SummaryOut(_Out):
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)


class AnalyzeSentimentFirst(_Out):
    score: Score
    entity: str
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)


class AnalyzeSummaryFirst(_Out):
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1)
    entity: str
    score: Score


AnalyzeOut = AnalyzeSentimentFirst | AnalyzeSummaryFirst
StructuredOut = LabelOut | OrdinalOut | SummaryOut | AnalyzeSentimentFirst | AnalyzeSummaryFirst

ANALYZE_MODELS: dict[FieldOrder, type[AnalyzeSentimentFirst] | type[AnalyzeSummaryFirst]] = {
    "sentiment-first": AnalyzeSentimentFirst,
    "summary-first": AnalyzeSummaryFirst,
}

    void done;
    expect(true).toBe(true);

});

+### Thresholds and "No signal"
+
+Confidence rules are frozen per model and endpoint. The served source of truth is
+[`models.toml`](backend/src/veritrade/data/models.toml) (`policy`, `min_p`, `directional_tau`, `ordinal_t`),
+written by `veritrade_evals freeze`, with the evidence behind each value (dev300 and dev-article F0.5, inversions and
+coverage at that threshold) in [`frozen.json`](evals/results/frozen.json); the policies are explained in
+[04](.context/docs/design/04-evals.md#4-models-prompts-and-confidence-policies). As frozen:
+
+| Model | `/signal` rule | `/analyze` rule |
+|---|---|---|
+| `qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0` (`/signal` default) | label-logprob, `min_p` 0, tau 0.28 | ordinal, \|score\| >= 1 |
+| `clef-flash:9b-q8_0` | probability, `min_p` 0.80 | - |
+| `nimble:9b-q4_K_M` | probability, `min_p` 0.97 | - |
+| `qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M` (`/analyze` default), `ministral-3:3b`, `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M`, `qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M` | - | ordinal, \|score\| >= 1 |
+| `tev1:0.8b-q8_0` (CI plumbing, never evaluated) | probability, `min_p` 0.50 (provisional) | - |
+
+- **Where to see them**: the signal and analyze pickers in the UI; the **Threshold** row and the threshold and tau
+  marks on every signal card; `GET /api/models`, whose `signal_rules` maps each signal endpoint of a model to its
+  `policy`, `threshold` and `directional_tau`; and every `signal` in a response, which carries the `threshold` and
+  `directional_tau` it was held to. A label-logprob rule falls back to ordinal \|score\| >= 1 on a first-token label
+  collision; `signal_rules` lists the primary rule.
+- **"No signal" is an abstention, by design** (precision over recall, Q2 and Q3): when the winning class is below
+  the model's frozen threshold, the service returns `sentiment: "neutral"` with `abstained: true` instead of a
+  directional call it is not confident in. The UI shows **No signal** and says why, e.g. "Abstained: the top class
+  (Bullish, 73.0%) is below this model's 80.0% threshold, so there is no directional call." A neutral with
+  `abstained: false` is a neutral verdict. With these rules only the 9B decision models abstain (dev300 coverage
+  72.9% for clef-flash, 26.3% for nimble); the defaults hold back by answering neutral
+  ([design decisions](#design-decisions)).

# Serving config: allowlist, per-endpoint defaults, decoding options and frozen thresholds.
# `veritrade_evals freeze` writes the per-model thresholds and prompt versions from the eval results
# (evals/results/frozen.json); `select --write` owns [defaults]. Models it has not frozen keep provisional values.
#
# kind        generative (/api/chat) | decision (/v1/systemone)
# endpoints   endpoints the model may serve
# signal_schema   generative signal output: "label" (one of 3 labels) | "ordinal" (score -2..2)
# policy      probability | label-logprob | ordinal  (streaming and /analyze always use ordinal)
# min_p       decision/label-logprob threshold on the winning class probability; 0 never abstains
# directional_tau   optional, probability policies only: when neutral wins the argmax and the likelier
#             directional class has p >= tau, call that class; otherwise argmax + min_p applies
# ordinal_t   directional call only when |score| >= ordinal_t (always set: streaming fallback)
# field_order /analyze JSON order: sentiment-first (streams the score early) | summary-first
# prompt      frozen prompt version per endpoint, e.g. { signal = "v4" }; an endpoint left out serves
#             the prompt file's `active` version

```
"""Single quality gate for local runs and CI: lint, types, tests, build and contract drift."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONTEND = ROOT / "frontend"


def backend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    backend_tests = "backend/tests" if full else "backend/tests/unit"
    tests = [backend_tests, "evals/tests", "scripts/tests"]
    steps = [
        ("ruff", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "check", "."], ROOT),
        ("ruff-format", ["uv", "run", "ruff", "format", "--check", "."], ROOT),
        ("mypy", ["uv", "run", "mypy"], ROOT),
        ("openapi-drift", ["uv", "run", "python", "scripts/export_openapi.py", "--check"], ROOT),
        ("pytest", ["uv", "run", "pytest", "-q", *[t for t in tests if (ROOT / t).exists()]], ROOT),
    ]
    # The floor only means something once the API is wired and integration tests exist.
    if full and (ROOT / "backend" / "tests" / "integration").exists():
        steps[-1][1].extend(["--cov", "--cov-report=term-missing:skip-covered", "--cov-fail-under=75"])
    return steps


def frontend_steps(full: bool) -> list[tuple[str, list[str], Path]]:
    steps = [
        ("fe-lint", ["pnpm", "lint"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-format", ["pnpm", "format:check"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-typecheck", ["pnpm", "typecheck"], FRONTEND),
        ("fe-test", ["pnpm", "test"], FRONTEND),
    ]
    if full:
        steps.append(("fe-build", ["pnpm", "build"], FRONTEND))
    return steps


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    mode.add_argument("--fast", action="store_true", help="unit tests only, no build (default)")
    mode.add_argument("--full", action="store_true", help="integration tests, coverage floor, build")
    parser.add_argument("--backend", action="store_true", help="only backend + evals")
    parser.add_argument("--frontend", action="store_true", help="only frontend")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    run_be = not args.frontend or args.backend
    run_fe = not args.backend or args.frontend
    steps = (backend_steps(args.full) if run_be else []) + (frontend_steps(args.full) if run_fe else [])

    failed = []
    for name, cmd, cwd in steps:
        print(f"\n== {name}: {' '.join(cmd)}", flush=True)
        if subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd).returncode != 0:
            failed.append(name)
    if failed:
        sys.exit(f"\nFAILED: {', '.join(failed)}")
    print("\nall checks passed")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

+  const hasTau = typeof tau === "number";

```
"""Steps every article endpoint shares: resolve, check the result cache, load, describe."""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass

from veritrade.api.contracts import (
    AnalyzeDoneEvent,
    AnalyzeRequest,
    AnalyzeResponse,
    ArticleMeta,
    CacheInfo,
    ErrorEvent,
    InferenceTimings,
    MetaEvent,
    SentimentEvent,
    SignalRequest,
    SignalResponse,
    SignalResult,
    SummaryDeltaEvent,
    SummaryDoneEvent,
    SummaryRequest,
    SummaryResponse,
    Timings,
)
from veritrade.extract.scope import build_input
from veritrade.extract.types import Scope
from veritrade.fetch import normalize_url
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, DecisionResult, Endpoint, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec
from veritrade.prompts.registry import PromptSpec
from veritrade.services.article import LoadedArticle, load_article
from veritrade.services.cache import ResultKey
from veritrade.services.runtime import Runtime
from veritrade.timing import StageTimer

ArticleRequest = SignalRequest | SummaryRequest | AnalyzeRequest
StreamPayload = (
    MetaEvent | SentimentEvent | SummaryDeltaEvent | SummaryDoneEvent | AnalyzeDoneEvent | ErrorEvent
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Job:
    """A request with its model and prompt resolved; nothing has touched the network yet."""

    runtime: Runtime
    endpoint: Endpoint
    request: ArticleRequest
    url: str
    scope: Scope
    spec: ModelSpec
    prompt: PromptSpec
    key: ResultKey | None
    clock: StageTimer

    @classmethod
    def resolve(
        cls, runtime: Runtime, endpoint: Endpoint, request: ArticleRequest, *, scope: Scope, clock: StageTimer
    ) -> Job:
        spec = runtime.registry.resolve(endpoint, request.model)
        prompt = runtime.prompt(endpoint, spec)
        url = str(request.url)
        key = None
        if not request.no_cache:
            key = ResultKey(
                endpoint=endpoint,
                url=normalize_url(url),
                model=spec.name,
                prompt_version=prompt.version,
                parser=request.parser,
                extractor=request.extractor,
                scope=scope,
            )
        return cls(runtime, endpoint, request, url, scope, spec, prompt, key, clock)

    def cached[R: (SignalResponse, SummaryResponse, AnalyzeResponse)](self, kind: type[R]) -> R | None:
        """The stored response marked as cached, with timings that describe this request."""
        hit = self.runtime.results.get(self.key) if self.key is not None else None
        if not isinstance(hit, kind):
            return None
        # A result hit runs no stage, so stage timings are zero and the article counts as a fetch hit.
        timings = Timings(
            total_ms=self.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=0.0,
            parse_ms=0.0,
            extract_ms=0.0,
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch="hit", result="hit"),
        )
        meta = hit.meta.model_copy(update={"cached": True})
        return hit.model_copy(update={"meta": meta, "timings": timings})

    def remember(self, response: SignalResponse | SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> None:
        if self.key is not None:
            self.runtime.results.put(self.key, response)

    async def prepare(self) -> Prepared:
        # The residency probe runs alongside the fetch; a fetch error still propagates as itself, unwrapped.
        probe = asyncio.create_task(self.runtime.cold_start(self.spec))
        try:
            loaded = await load_article(
                self.runtime,
                self.url,
                parser=self.request.parser,
                extractor=self.request.extractor,
                no_cache=self.request.no_cache,
            )
        except BaseException:
            probe.cancel()
            raise
        cold_start = await probe
        text = build_input(loaded.article, self.scope, self.spec.max_input_tokens)
        return Prepared(
            job=self,
            loaded=loaded,
            text=text,
            meta=self._meta(loaded, text),
            cache=CacheInfo(fetch=loaded.fetch_status, result="bypass" if self.key is None else "miss"),
            cold_start=cold_start,
        )

    def _meta(self, loaded: LoadedArticle, text: str) -> ArticleMeta:
        article = loaded.article
        return ArticleMeta(
            url=self.url,
            final_url=loaded.page.final_url,
            title=article.title,
            source=article.source,
            published_at=article.published_at,
            endpoint=self.endpoint,
            model=self.spec.name,
            model_kind=self.spec.kind,
            prompt_version=self.prompt.version,
            parser=self.request.parser,
            extractor=self.request.extractor,
            extraction_method=article.method,
            scope=self.scope,
            input_chars=len(text),
            word_count=article.word_count,
            field_order=self.spec.field_order if self.endpoint == "analyze" else None,
            cached=False,
            backend=self.runtime.settings.ollama_backend_label,
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Prepared:
    """A job with its article loaded and the model input built; only inference is left."""

    job: Job
    loaded: LoadedArticle
    text: str
    meta: ArticleMeta
    cache: CacheInfo
    cold_start: bool | None

    def timings(self, inference: InferenceTimings | None) -> Timings:
        loaded = self.loaded
        if inference is not None:
            inference = inference.model_copy(update={"cold_start": self.cold_start})
        return Timings(
            total_ms=self.job.clock.elapsed_ms(),
            fetch_ms=loaded.fetch_ms,
            consent_ms=loaded.consent_ms,
            parse_ms=loaded.article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=loaded.article.extract_ms,
            inference=inference,
            cache=self.cache,
        )

    def meta_event(self) -> MetaEvent:
        article = self.loaded.article
        return MetaEvent(
            meta=self.meta,
            fetch_ms=self.loaded.fetch_ms,
            parse_ms=article.parse_ms,
            extract_ms=article.extract_ms,
            cache=self.cache,
            cold_start=self.cold_start,
        )


def cached_meta_event(response: SummaryResponse | AnalyzeResponse) -> MetaEvent:
    timings = response.timings
    return MetaEvent(
        meta=response.meta,
        fetch_ms=timings.fetch_ms,
        parse_ms=timings.parse_ms,
        extract_ms=timings.extract_ms,
        cache=timings.cache,
    )


def signal_result(verdict: Verdict) -> SignalResult:
    return SignalResult(
        sentiment=verdict.sentiment,
        abstained=verdict.abstained,
        policy=verdict.policy,
        confidence=verdict.confidence,
        score=verdict.score,
        probabilities=verdict.probabilities,
        threshold=verdict.threshold,
        directional_tau=verdict.directional_tau,
    )


def inference_timings(raw: ChatResult | DecisionResult, *, ttft_ms: float | None = None) -> InferenceTimings:
    """ttft_ms is passed in by streams, which measure it from request receipt to the first summary text."""
    if isinstance(raw, DecisionResult):
        return InferenceTimings(wall_ms=raw.wall_ms, prompt_tokens=raw.input_tokens)
    t = raw.timings
    return InferenceTimings(
        wall_ms=raw.wall_ms,
        ttft_ms=ttft_ms,
        load_ms=t.load_ms,
        prompt_eval_ms=t.prompt_eval_ms,
        eval_ms=t.eval_ms,
        prompt_tokens=t.prompt_tokens,
        eval_tokens=t.eval_tokens,
    )
```

from __future__ import annotations

from functools import lru_cache
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Literal

from pydantic import AliasChoices, Field, model_validator
from pydantic_settings import BaseSettings, SettingsConfigDict


def _csv(value: str) -> list[str]:
    return [item.strip() for item in value.split(",") if item.strip()]


class Settings(BaseSettings):
    model_config = SettingsConfigDict(env_prefix="VT_", extra="ignore")

    env: Literal["dev", "test", "prod"] = "dev"

    ollama_base_url: str = Field(
        "http://localhost:11434",
        validation_alias=AliasChoices("VT_OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "OLLAMA_BASE_URL"),
    )
    ollama_backend_label: str = "native-metal"
    ollama_keep_alive: str = "30m"
    inference_timeout_s: float = 90.0
    # Comma-separated restriction of the models.toml allowlist; empty keeps the full allowlist.
    models: str = ""
    default_model_signal: str | None = None
    default_model_summary: str | None = None
    default_model_analyze: str | None = None

    sec_user_agent: str = Field(
        "VeriTrade Analytics PoC kris.dimitrov92@gmail.com",
        validation_alias=AliasChoices("VT_SEC_USER_AGENT", "SEC_USER_AGENT"),
    )
    fetch_connect_timeout_s: float = 3.0
    fetch_deadline_s: float = 8.0
    fetch_max_bytes: int = 10_000_000
    fetch_max_redirects: int = 5
    fetch_cache_ttl_s: float = 600.0
    fetch_error_ttl_s: float = 60.0
    # Pages are up to fetch_max_bytes each, so the fetch cache is bounded by size as well as count.
    fetch_cache_max_bytes: int = 200_000_000
    result_cache_ttl_s: float = 3600.0
    cache_max_entries: int = 512
    models_cache_ttl_s: float = 10.0
    # /health and /models answer even when Ollama hangs, so the container healthcheck stays meaningful.
    ollama_probe_timeout_s: float = 2.0

    cors_origins: str = ""
    static_dir: Path | None = None
    # Lets e2e reach the fixture container; refused outside VT_ENV=test so prod keeps the full SSRF guard.
    ssrf_test_allow_hosts: str = ""

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _guard_test_only_settings(self) -> Settings:
        if self.ssrf_test_allow_hosts and self.env != "test":
            raise ValueError("VT_SSRF_TEST_ALLOW_HOSTS is only allowed when VT_ENV=test")
        return self

Docker Desktop cannot pass the Apple GPU into a Linux container, so Ollama runs on the host with Metal.

```bash
brew install ollama && brew services start ollama
ollama pull qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0 && ollama pull qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M   # the two defaults, 4.34 GB
docker compose up -d                                              # builds the app image on the first run
open http://localhost:8000
```

- `scripts/dev_setup.py native` installs Ollama and sets the measured service env (`OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1`,
  `OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0`, `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=30m`, `OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=3`; see
  [`preflight.json`](evals/results/latency/preflight.json)); `scripts/dev_setup.py pull --set eval` pulls the whole
  eval roster ([`models-eval.txt`](deploy/models-eval.txt), about 36 GB). Run both with `uv run python`.
- On Linux with a native Ollama, start it with `OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0` so the container reaches it through
  `host.docker.internal`.

### 2. Bundled CPU Ollama (Linux, CI, no native install)

docker compose --profile bundled --env-file deploy/bundled.env up -d

## 4. Models, prompts and confidence policies

**Roster** (R2 and its follow-ups). The split architecture serves `/signal` + `/summary`; the combined one `/analyze`.

| endpoint | models | kind |
|---|---|---|
| `/signal` | `clef-flash:9b-q8_0`, `nimble:9b-q4_K_M` | decision models (native class probabilities) |
| `/signal` | `qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0` | generative baseline (label and ordinal schemas) |
| `/summary` | `qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M`, `qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M` | generative |
| `/analyze` | `qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M`, `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M`, `ministral-3:3b` | generative, one call -> score + entity + summary |
| `/analyze` (holdout only) | `qwen3.5:9b-q4_K_M` | quality ceiling, untuned (prompt v1, \|s\| >= 1) |

**Lean prompt grid** on dev300: 33 cells ([`grid/manifest.json`](../../../evals/results/grid/manifest.json)), all on
native Metal, Ollama 0.40.6, greedy (temperature 0, seed 0, sampling penalties neutralised; see the build-time
findings in `01-decisions.md`).

```
"""Confidence policies: raw model output -> Verdict, abstaining to neutral below the frozen threshold."""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping, Sequence
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import ClassVar

from veritrade.inference.schemas import LabelOut, OrdinalOut, score_sentiment
from veritrade.inference.types import ChatResult, Endpoint, PolicyName, Sentiment, TokenLogprob, Verdict
from veritrade.models_registry import ModelSpec

# Ties resolve to the safe class first; also the criteria order sent to decision models.
TIE_ORDER: tuple[Sentiment, ...] = ("neutral", "bullish", "bearish")
# Share of first-token mass allowed on tokens that could start several classes before we give up.
AMBIGUOUS_MASS_MAX = 0.05

_VALUE_START = {
    "label": re.compile(r'"label"\s*:\s*"'),
    "score": re.compile(r'"score"\s*:\s*'),
}
_SCORE_HEAD = re.compile(r"^(?:-|-[12](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?|[012](?:[\s,}][\s\S]*)?)$")
_SCORE_KEY = re.compile(r'"score"\s*:')


def winner(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> Sentiment:
    best = TIE_ORDER[0]
    for sentiment in TIE_ORDER[1:]:
        if probabilities.get(sentiment, 0.0) > probabilities.get(best, 0.0):
            best = sentiment
    return best


def normalise(probabilities: Mapping[Sentiment, float]) -> dict[Sentiment, float]:
    total = sum(max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) for s in TIE_ORDER)
    if total <= 0:
        raise ValueError("probabilities sum to zero")
    return {s: max(0.0, probabilities.get(s, 0.0)) / total for s in TIE_ORDER}


def _threshold(
    name: PolicyName,
    probabilities: dict[Sentiment, float],
    min_p: float,
    score: int | None = None,
    tau: float | None = None,
) -> Verdict:
    top = winner(probabilities)
    if tau is not None and top == "neutral":
        side: Sentiment = "bullish" if probabilities["bullish"] >= probabilities["bearish"] else "bearish"
        if probabilities[side] >= tau:
            return Verdict(
                sentiment=side,
                abstained=False,
                policy=name,
                confidence=probabilities[side],
                score=score,
                probabilities=probabilities,
                threshold=min_p,
                directional_tau=tau,
            )
    confidence = probabilities[top]
    abstained = confidence < min_p
    return Verdict(
        sentiment="neutral" if abstained else top,
        abstained=abstained,
        policy=name,
        confidence=confidence,
        score=score,
        probabilities=probabilities,
        threshold=min_p,
        directional_tau=tau,
    )


def label_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Labels a token's text could start; empty means the grammar would reject it."""
    return {s for s in TIE_ORDER if s.startswith(rest) or rest.startswith(s + '"')}


def sign_classes(rest: str) -> set[Sentiment]:
    """Class implied by a token that starts an enum score (-2..2); empty when the grammar rejects it."""
    if not rest:
        return set(TIE_ORDER)
    if not _SCORE_HEAD.match(rest):
        return set()
    return {"bearish" if rest[0] == "-" else "neutral" if rest[0] == "0" else "bullish"}


def first_value_token(
    content: str, logprobs: Sequence[TokenLogprob], key: str
) -> tuple[str, dict[str, float]] | None:
    """The generated token that starts the value of `key` (minus any text before the value) and its
    alternatives as {text after the same prefix: probability}; None if tokens do not tile the content."""
    match = _VALUE_START[key].search(content)
    if match is None:
        return None
    offset, pos = match.end(), 0
    for tok in logprobs:
        end = pos + len(tok.token)
        if content[pos:end] != tok.token:
            return None
        if end > offset:
            prefix = content[pos:offset]
            candidates: dict[str, float] = {}
            for text, logprob in ((tok.token, tok.logprob), *tok.top):
                if text.startswith(prefix):
                    candidates.setdefault(text[len(prefix) :], math.exp(logprob))
            return tok.token[len(prefix) :], candidates
        pos = end
    return None

| `POST /api/analyze` | as `/api/signal`, `scope` default `full` | `meta`, `signal`, `entity`, `summary`, `truncated`, `timings` |
| `POST /api/analyze/stream` | as `/api/analyze` | SSE: `meta -> sentiment -> summary_delta* -> done` |
| `GET /api/models` | - | Allowlist (kind, endpoints, installed, size, `signal_rules`), per-endpoint defaults, parsers, extractors, scopes |
| `GET /api/health` | - | `ok` / `degraded`, Ollama reachability and version, backend label (`native-metal` / `docker-cpu`) |

```
- Generative `/signal` and `/analyze`: rubric A (definitions) or B (impact questions) x 0 or 4 synthetic shots =
  v1-v4; for `qwen3.5:0.8b` each runs on both the label and the ordinal schema.
- Decision models: rubric or plain one-line question x described or bare criteria = v1-v4.
- `/analyze` follow-ups, paired against v1: v5 (the tightened summary rule) and `v1-summary-first` (the field-order
  check, on `qwen3.5:4b` and `ministral` only).

**Confidence policies** ([`confidence.py`](../../../backend/src/veritrade/inference/confidence.py)):

- **probability** (decision models): argmax of the native class probabilities; abstain when it is below `min_p`.
- **label-logprob** (generative `/signal`): first label-token probabilities, renormalised over the tokens the grammar
  accepts, with the same `min_p` rule. With **`directional_tau`**, a neutral argmax still yields the likelier
  directional class when that class holds p >= tau; below tau the row is a served neutral, not an abstention. On a
  first-token label collision the adapter re-asks with the ordinal schema.
- **ordinal** (`/analyze`, streams, fallback): a score from -2 to 2, directional only when \|score\| >= t. It is read
  mid-stream as soon as it closes and needs no logprobs (Q3); logprob-weighted streaming confidence is on the backlog.

**Scope and field order.** `/signal` reads `lede` by default (headline plus opening paragraphs, body capped at 200
tokens); `lede` and `full` are both scored on articles. `/analyze` reads `full` and emits the sentiment field first,
so the score streams after a handful of tokens (R3).

**Error analysis and freeze.** One hand-written read of the grid counts
([`grid/notes.md`](../../../evals/results/grid/notes.md)) drove the changes listed in section 5. The `freeze`
command then wrote [`frozen.json`](../../../evals/results/frozen.json) and
[`models.toml`](../../../backend/src/veritrade/data/models.toml):

| endpoint | model | frozen prompt | policy | threshold | field order |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/signal` | `qwen3.5:0.8b-q8_0` | `v2@ff82e957` (rubric A, 4 shots, label schema) | label-logprob + `directional_tau` | min_p 0, tau 0.28 (ordinal \|s\| >= 1 fallback) | - |
| `/signal` | `clef-flash:9b-q8_0` | `v4@fcc93f1b` (plain question, bare labels) | probability | min_p 0.80 | - |
| `/signal` | `nimble:9b-q4_K_M` | `v1@a1e34f63` (rubric, described criteria) | probability | min_p 0.97 | - |
| `/summary` | `qwen3.5:2b-q4_K_M`, `qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M` | `v2@84ce3858` (tightened summary rule) | - | - | - |
| `/analyze` | `qwen3.5:4b-q4_K_M` | `v1@7daf4f28` | ordinal | \|s\| >= 1 | sentiment-first |
| `/analyze` | `qwen3:4b-instruct-2507-q4_K_M` | `v5@e2b57fc6` | ordinal | \|s\| >= 1 | sentiment-first |
| `/analyze` | `ministral-3:3b` | `v5@e2b57fc6` | ordinal | \|s\| >= 1 | sentiment-first |

Freeze rules: `/signal` keeps the dev300 best rule unless it clearly fails on the articles. `/analyze` takes v5
unless the whole paired 95% CI of its gap against v1 is below zero on dev300 or the articles, which rejected v5 for
`qwen3.5:4b` (articles -0.080 [-0.178, -0.014]). Summary-first needed a dev300 win without an articles loss; it never
got one.

def parse_logprobs(raw: Any) -> tuple[TokenLogprob, ...] | None:
    if not isinstance(raw, list) or not raw:
        return None
    return tuple(
        TokenLogprob(
            token=entry["token"],
            logprob=float(entry["logprob"]),
            top=tuple((alt["token"], float(alt["logprob"])) for alt in entry.get("top_logprobs") or ()),
        )
        for entry in raw
    )


def _error_text(response: httpx.Response) -> str:
    try:
        body = response.json()
    except ValueError:
        return response.text[:300]
    error = body.get("error") if isinstance(body, dict) else None
    return error if isinstance(error, str) else response.text[:300]


def _status_error(status: int, text: str, model: str | None) -> VtError:
    name = model or "?"
    if status == 404 or "not found" in text.lower():
        return ModelUnavailable(
            f"Model {name} is not available in Ollama: {text}",
            hint=f"Pull it with `ollama pull {name}` or pick an installed model.",
            upstream_status=status,
        )
    return ModelUnavailable(
        f"Ollama rejected the request for {name} ({status}): {text}", upstream_status=status
    )

            return InferenceTimeout(f"Ollama did not answer in time for {model or 'request'}: {exc!r}")
        return LlmUnreachable(f"Ollama connection failed: {exc!r}")

    async def request(
        self, method: str, path: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None, *, model: str | None = None
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """One JSON round trip with Ollama errors mapped to typed VtErrors."""
        try:
            response = await self._http.request(method, path, json=payload)
        except httpx.HTTPError as exc:
            raise self._transport_error(exc, model) from exc
        if response.status_code >= 400:
            raise _status_error(response.status_code, _error_text(response), model)
        try:
            body = response.json()
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned non-JSON for {path}") from exc
        if not isinstance(body, dict):
            raise SchemaViolation(f"Ollama returned an unexpected body for {path}")
        return body

- **Where to see them**: the signal and analyze pickers in the UI; the **Threshold** row and the threshold and tau
  marks on every signal card; `GET /api/models`, whose `signal_rules` maps each signal endpoint of a model to its
  `policy`, `threshold` and `directional_tau`; and every `signal` in a response, which carries the `threshold` and
  `directional_tau` it was held to. A label-logprob rule falls back to ordinal \|score\| >= 1 on a first-token label
  collision; `signal_rules` lists the primary rule.
- **"No signal" is an abstention, by design** (precision over recall, Q2 and Q3): when the winning class is below
  the model's frozen threshold, the service returns `sentiment: "neutral"` with `abstained: true` instead of a
  directional call it is not confident in. The UI shows **No signal** and says why, e.g. "Abstained: the top class
  (Bullish, 73.0%) is below this model's 80.0% threshold, so there is no directional call." A neutral with
  `abstained: false` is a neutral verdict. With these rules only the 9B decision models abstain (dev300 coverage
  72.9% for clef-flash, 26.3% for nimble); the defaults hold back by answering neutral
  ([design decisions](#design-decisions)).

export function formatMs(ms: number | null | undefined): string {
  if (ms === null || ms === undefined || !Number.isFinite(ms)) return "-";
  if (ms >= 10_000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`;
  if (ms >= 1000) return `${(ms / 1000).toFixed(2)} s`;
  return `${Math.round(ms)} ms`;
}

export function formatPct(value: number | null | undefined, digits = 1): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined || !Number.isFinite(value)) return "-";
  return `${(value * 100).toFixed(digits)}%`;
}

  return value.toFixed(digits);

class LocalFetcher:
    """Serves stored article HTML from memory, so network variance stays out of the timings."""

    def __init__(self, pages: Mapping[str, tuple[str, str]]) -> None:
        self._pages = {normalize_url(url): page for url, page in pages.items()}
        self._pages.setdefault(normalize_url(WARMUP_URL), (WARMUP_URL, WARMUP_HTML))

    async def get(self, url: str) -> FetchResult:
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        page = self._pages.get(normalize_url(url))
        if page is None:
            raise UpstreamHttp(f"{url} is not in the local latency set", upstream_status=404, retryable=False)
        final_url, html = page
        return FetchResult(
            requested_url=url,
            final_url=final_url,
            status=200,
            html=html,
            content_type="text/html; charset=utf-8",
            fetch_ms=(time.perf_counter() - t0) * 1000,
        )

    async def aclose(self) -> None:
        return None


def local_pages(examples: Sequence[ArticleExample], paths: ArticlePaths) -> dict[str, tuple[str, str]]:
    pages = {}
    for example in examples:
        fetched = read_fetched(paths, example.id)
        final_url = fetched.final_url if fetched and fetched.final_url else example.url
        pages[example.url] = (final_url, example.html_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    return pages

import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from "react";

import { coldStartNote, formatMs } from "@/lib/format";
import type { LaneStatus } from "@/lib/run-state";

import styles from "./SummaryPanel.module.css";

interface SummaryPanelProps {
  status: LaneStatus;
  text: string;
  /** The server cut the summary at the model's output limit. */
  truncated?: boolean;
  model?: string | null;
  streaming: boolean;
  /** Client-measured time from submit to the first summary token. */
  firstTokenMs?: number | null;
  /** The model had to be loaded for this request (known from the stream's meta event or final timings). */
  coldStart?: boolean | null;
  /** Ollama's model load time, once the final timings arrive. */
  loadMs?: number | null;
}

function statusLabel(status: LaneStatus, text: string, streaming: boolean, coldStart: boolean): string {
  const waiting = coldStart
    ? "Loading the model into memory (cold start)..."
    : "Waiting for the first token...";
  switch (status) {
    case "pending":
      return streaming ? waiting : "Waiting for the summary...";
    case "streaming":
      return text ? "Streaming..." : waiting;
    case "done":
      return "Complete";
    case "error":
      return "Failed";
    case "cancelled":
      return "Cancelled";
  }
}

export function SummaryPanel({
  status,
  text,
  truncated,
  model,
  streaming,
  firstTokenMs,
  coldStart,
  loadMs,
}: SummaryPanelProps) {
  const active = status === "pending" || status === "streaming";
  const footer: ReactNode[] = [];
  if (model) {
    footer.push(
      <>
        Model <code>{model}</code>
      </>,
    );
  }
  if (typeof firstTokenMs === "number") footer.push(`first token ${formatMs(firstTokenMs)}`);
  // While nothing has streamed yet the status line already says the model is loading.
  if (coldStart && (text || !active)) {
    footer.push(<span data-testid="summary-cold-start">cold start: {coldStartNote(loadMs)}</span>);
  }
  return (
    <section className={styles.panel} aria-labelledby="summary-heading" aria-busy={active}>
      <div className={styles.header}>
        <h2 id="summary-heading" className={styles.heading}>
          Summary
        </h2>
        <span className={styles.status} data-status={status} data-testid="summary-status">
          {statusLabel(status, text, streaming, coldStart === true)}
        </span>
      </div>
      {text ? (
        <p className={styles.text} data-testid="summary-text">
          {text}
          {active ? <span className={styles.caret} aria-hidden="true" /> : null}
        </p>
      ) : status === "done" ? (
        <p className={styles.empty}>The model returned an empty summary.</p>
      ) : null}
      {truncated && text ? (
        <p className={styles.note} data-testid="summary-truncated">
          The model hit its output limit, so this summary was cut short.
        </p>
      ) : null}
      {footer.length ? (
        <p className={styles.footer}>
          {footer.map((part, i) => (
            <Fragment key={i}>
              {i ? " · " : null}
              {part}
            </Fragment>
          ))}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
